comments:
The rooms were clean and tidy. Beds very comfortable.
Thank you Belinda.
Good space and quite an interesting home in a quiet location - a lovely park across the road which is rare in Singapore. Nice place to stay if you are in big group as we were.

It was a comfortable place. Belinda was a kind and helpful woman who helped us have a nice accommodation there and find tourism sites easily. The place was beautiful and calm. The maids were helpful too.
Totally it was very nice trip. BEAUTIFUL SINGAPORE

We are four mature age travellers and stayed for one night. We had a wonderfully warm reception on arrival and she allowed us to check in much earlier than is the usual case. Only a short taxi ride from the airport.

We asked about getting into the city centre and we were escorted not only to the nearest bus stop, but also to the train station. And we were helped with buying our first train ticket. Excellent customer service!

We had two bedrooms, both air conditioned with a clean shared bathroom.

On our departure Belinda was still gracious and helpful: she made recommendations on what to see in our remaining time. Very concerned about us experiencing the best of what "her town" has to offer visitors.

Belinda is a great host! She helps you whenever you need asssistance.

The house is well kept and maintained, though the rooms are not spotless but are clean, presentable and comfortable to live in.

The location is unexpectedly convenient, you just need to walk 5 minutes to the bus stop at Siemei Road to take a bus to the MRT station just 2 bus stops away!

The street is quiet and a small park just nearby with children playground and simple keep fit facilities. Thanks, Belinda,
We have very happy holiday in Singapore. Ms.Belinda is very kind and helpful. She is very nice. All of us are very comfortable living there. Only one thing, there is a little far to the downtown.
Very good host and made out stay great
I booked this apartment for my friend, as he use airbnb very little. He's very happy to stay in Belinda's apartment, everything just same as pictures. Will come back again!
預定兩間房六人入住兩天~一間房間有雙人床及單人床,另一間卻是雙人床和一壞掉床架在用釘上木板,兩間共用一個衛浴設備,跟房東反應卻推給菲傭說她搞不清楚狀況,明顯得再推卸責任,第二天一大早便退房不願意再繼續住宿,真是讓人失望.
Even though just stayed for a couple hours(because we need to catch the early morning flight), the house keeper was super warm.We had a nice stay.
not bad
Attractive place to stay for 4pax when visit Singapore.
出行方便，房东人非常好。也很热情。是个不错的选择
The location is very close to EXPO and Bus stops and MRT Stations. It is very convenient if the purpose is being close to EXPO.

Outstanding value for money. The place is near Changi Airport, the Upper Changi MRT station, and the Singapore EXPO hall. It’s not in a neighborhood buzzing with energy at night, but that means your sleep will be much more restful.
Really hepful with everything. Answered really gast and she hace us some a lot of things to see and do. Thank you for the hospitality
Great location, great hospitality
It has everything you need.
Belinda was really welcoming and the checking in process was really easy!

Belinda is a kind host who certainly tries to accommodate your needs. We didn't see her much, but our interactions were certainly warm and respectful.

The room is extremely spacious, and there is a cupboard to put luggage. There are other furniture around to make working easier. The shower is a shared shower, but it is cleaned daily, along with the room.

Transportation is quite convenient once you learn the shortcut. While you have to take a bus to the MRT station (semei), it isn't that far once you get used to it.

Belinda has been very responsive:  always pick up my calls, reply my emails right away.   She has been extremely helpful: SMSed with direction to the house, offered a ride to airport, an extra mattress for my son, helped us call taxi.   Overall, my 3-night stay at her place was very pleasant and well-worth the money.   The location is not that close to downtown, but being close to airport and the ferry is definitely a plus for us.

Interesting guest house, and really convenient to airport, especially for short stays!

Thanks again!
The place was nice and Belinda has provided all the necessary toiletries, coffee and water as well. We just found out the shortcut to the place on the night before leaving on the next day hahahaha.

We spent two nights in the room offered by Belinda near to the airport in Singapore. We were travelling as a family group, with two small children, and we needed a simple and relatively cheap place to sleep. It can be difficult to find hotel rooms that allow you to put extra beds on the floor for small kids. The room offered exactly what we were looking for.

We applied to Belinda to stay in the room and she was very responsive and answered all our queries very well. Upon arrival we met Belinda and some other people that were staying in the house (it is a very big house). It was a very friendly reception and Belinda had put out two extra floor beds for the kids in our room which was great.
The room itself was clean and comfortable although a little bit dated in its decor. There is a basic adjoining bathroom which is also shared by another guest room.
Belinda and co were very helpful in getting us taxis arranged for trips to the zoo and airport early on the day of the departure. All in all it was a good experience and we would say that if you are looking for relatively cheap, basic, clean and comfortable accommodation near to the airport and expo in Singapore then this is a good option. Belinda was very professional and friendly in her approach to the whole experience.

Belinda's house was convenient as we arrived late in the day and were only really minutes from the airport. We soon got into the routine if taking bus 2 or 24 (end of the street, turn left and then across the road is the closest bus stop) to Tanah Merah MRT station. This is the shortest walk and we also did walk to Simei MRT station (through park across from the house to the right and walk down Simei Street 1 for 15 minutes) Closest shops are there too.
I did use the washing machine, one of the maids will show you how and put on slippers that are at the back door when using the work area. Clothes will almost dry on the racks there and will finish off in an air-conditioned space (the bedroom!) Internet connectivity is good which my children enjoyed.
Thanks to Belinda and John for showing us some of Singapore we may not have seen otherwise.
For the airport transfer we used bus 24 from the the stop near the end of the street. It goes to Terminals 1, 3 & 2 and the cost was $1.11 per person.

Definitely a budget choice for staying in Singapore. Belinda was very responsive and helpful, and professional. The room is clean and spacious with a fridge, a closet, and airconditioning. It is about 30-40 min from downtown if you want to use the public transportation sytem.

I chose the place as it is near to Singapore Expo, the destination I was heading to with my mother. It was few bus stops away. A fair price for a fair room with a shared bathroom. The tenant next door smoked in the bathroom, causing smell when I arrived. I messaged Belinda and she immediately warned them. However the next day they smoked again in the bathroom. Shame on the tenant. The housemaid was very friendly, her name is Dewi, assisted us in many areas, called cabs for us. Belinda also dropped us off at the airport at the end of the trip, very kind of her. Overall a pleasant trip.

We would very much like to thank Belinda for a lovely stay. Everybody was really friendly and it was fantastic were very welcome although it was still early in the morning. Her house is situated in a nice and cozy neighborhood where you feel save. It was a great place to rest after a long flight.

BELINDA and her family were perfect hosts. Her beautiful home was comfortable but mostly we enjoyed visiting with her other guests and her family. I will always stay at her home on future trips to Singapore.

The room is in a beautiful home and, although we did not meet Belinda until we were leaving her family made us feel welcome and provided anything we needed.
When we were leaving Belinda drove us to thr airport even though it was very early in the morning.
The shared bathroom is actually accesses directly from the bedroom and we never savor heard anyone in the other adjoining room

Pros
Location: 2 bus stops from the airport
Clean, average size, en suite bathroom (you feel like in a hotel)
Sufficient Wi fi (varies from 5 to 25 Mbit/s)
Cold air conditioning
Tea and coffee facilities in the room
Good "quality to price" ratio for Singapore

Cons:
Location: not central. 10min by bus +30min by train to the city center
Like hotel: you have to fill a check-in form upon arrival. No interaction with the host (only with the cleaning lady who also lives in the house). The fridge is in your room so it shows you are not supposed to use kitchen facilities.
Air con blows cold air right through one side of the bed so one might catch flue during the night.

Belinda's B&B was in a convenient location close to the airport. The room was large and very clean. Personal touches included several cool drinks in the bar fridge which were most welcome after a long hot flight. Unlike many B&B's, it had several lounge areas where you could escape from other guests.

I was given a warm welcome by Belinda and her staff member (Ismay). They helped with moving luggage to my room and booked a taxi for my departure next day. The staff were very friendly and were ready to assist with any request.

The B&B is a short walk to the MRT (city 25 minutes) and a 10 minute walk to excellent food courts.

I would recommend Belinda's B&B to people who would like a relaxing holiday in Singapore away from the busy city.
Very friendly and helpful people, room wasn't clean enough for our expectations.

Room was comfortable, spacious and close
to airport . Friendly helpful host.
弾丸旅行のため、深夜に到着し、深夜に出発した我々を暖かく迎えてくれ、また送り出してくれました。短期滞在で他の宿泊者との交流ができなかったのが残念です。お世話になりました。
房间和描述的一样的，离机场很近，坐9路两站就到地铁，还满方便的。这个房间与2号是共用卫生间的，清洁度不错，早餐是鸡蛋炒米粉，稍简单了些。

It was a nice experience staying at Belinda's place especially that it was close to STC. Room was clean, bed comfortable, breakfast provided and the maids were great help. Even had a bike to get to the shopping centre and food courts by Simei MRT. Overall a pleasant stay and would definitely come back
Belinda was very friendly and a great host. We enjoyed our stay.
The place was really awesome and comfortable. :) it is also affordable
Belinda的热情好客给我们全家留下了深刻的印象。若你喜欢中华文化，Belinda家中的古玩字画会令你大开眼界的。出门600米就是地铁站，距离市中心乘地铁约35分钟即可，很方便。下次有机会的话，还会选择入住。
Nice neighbourhood, and great place to stay if you're wanting to be by the airport

Highly recommended. Friendly host and no disturb when at stay and such a comfortable place to stay in. Very clean environment and love the both rooms that i've been staying in. All that i want is in. And quite a big space for a living. Me and my fiance was very happy that we get to stay there with our request accepted by the host for ou work purposes.

Highly recommend! Belinda's place is near Changi airport, because I got emergency cases need to take early flights on second day and check in late but Belinda still treat me very well,you are a good host,Belinda,thank you very much for the stay

I stayed at Belinda's place for 4 nights during my vacation. Seeing the location on the map I had been prepared for airplane noise since Changi was located quite close, but I didn't have to worry about that.  The surrounding area is a quiet, peaceful residential area.  Bus no.38 gave me a quick acces to and from Simei MRT station. You might think you cannot pass from the east end of Simei Street 1 over to Jalan Pelatok, which is not the case; there is a small park in-between which you can easily walk across.  Room was well cleaned up, cozy and big.  Belinda and her family were very helpful, too bad I didn't have much time to talk to them though because I always went out early & came back late. Overall it was a very good first step for me to enter the world of Airbnb!
A wonderful house with all the amenities, proximity to bus stop and train station... more importantly warm host who exceeded our expectations!
It was fine. Perfect for someone wanting to be close yo airport but for exploring the city - to far away. Almost 1 hour to get to city center is tireing and a bit a waste of time.

We had a wonderful stay of a week at Belinda's place recently. Situated in front of a lovely garden with exquisite green parrots, her big abode turned out to be a nest for us to rest and wake up refreshed everyday. It is very close to the airport and not very far from the Simei MRT. The caretaker's family is wonderful and the cleanliness is definitely commendable. Good privacy and a good heartland experience - away from the din and rustle of the crowded city area. Kitchen facilities, Internet and washer/dryer are also available. I will definitely consider Belinda's place for future stays. Great family to spend singapore vacation. Will go back again and again, if given a chance.

My family and I really enjoyed Belinda's top hospitality during our stay and I will definitely recommend Belinda's home to families, young couples, business and solo travelers.

Easy access to the bus, underground and taxis (a taxi ride from Suntec to her home only amounts to 15 SGD, unless you love walking, I suggest you use taxis in Singapore).

I look forward to staying at Belinda's home with my family in the near future when we visit Singapore again. Thanks Belinda for being an amazing host!

It was unfortunate that Belinda was not arround as she had to be away from S'pore during our stay.
The place is just like anybody's house. had it been very clean it would have appeared as a guesthouse.
We have no complain.
Maids, Jullie & Deuii, both are very coperative.
Jullie took all the trouble to show us the way to the nearest MRT station, Semei.
We should have stayed with her only, instead a few days in another hotel prior to this stay . Only disadvantage is the distance from the main city culture, but MRT made up all.
Belinda can think of providing toilet soaps etc and a bare cup of tea in the morning to add to the homely ambience.

Positives are
1. Good value for money stay location for a family of 4
2. Safe place and decent location
3. Belinda and her family was extremely non intrusive
4. Very prompt with responses to emails and text messages

Negatives are
1. Bathroom is not very child friendly. Also we were in for a shock that on day 3 & 4 we had to share a bathroom with a co-visitor
2. Towels were not changed everyday and were damp when we got back in the evening.

Overall, I would be happy to recommend this to anyone who is in for some value for money travel. Will be great if Belinda and her team make this a bit more personal!
Its is clean and nice room and the house is amazng. But the room is a bit small to fit 4 adults.

it is a big room which was nice and very comfortable. the only drawback is that the bathroom is connected to the other room. it was quite uncomfortable having one bathroom for two rooms. lucky for us the other room wasn't occupied. the house is really big and spacious. the host is very nice and accommodating. she will give you advice and tips to help you around singapore. the attendants are also nice and pleasant. they will help you around the house if you need anything like if you want to cook. just for everyones information, there are 3 dogs in the house and 2 nice kids. overall the experience was great. the house really felt like home. you can freely go out and come home as you like.
beautiful house, our room was spacious, train station not a bad walk.

The room is quite small but comfy. It has aircon, small refregirator. You will share the bathroom with 1 neighbouring room. Wifi signal was quite weak in the room. The area is quiet and the house itself is very spacious and lived-in. Belinda arranged to meet me late at night.

We did not meet Belinda although we were hoping we could have. Our flight arrived at 11:30pm and we arrived at the house before 12 and another guest let us in. One of the maids showed us to our room and we left at 9am the following morning and whilst we asked to meet Belinda the guests did not where she was. As the taxi was waiting we left.

The room was good - the air conditioner worked well (needed in Singapore) and the bathroom was ok. It may have been a little different had the second bedroom been occupied and the bathroom had to be shared. I would stay here again and next time I would like to hopefully meet the host :-)
房间和描述的一样的，离机场很近，坐9路两站就到地铁，还满方便的。这个房间与3号是共用卫生间的，清洁度不错，早餐是鸡蛋炒米粉，稍简单了些。
房子坐落于simmei（四美）的排屋区。房子很安静，房间整齐。居住下来才知道房东太太是出租车司机，这一点大大的方便了前往机场的我们！居住很愉快，但也有两点遗憾：1、屋子不好找，若以后能配上地图就更好了；2、有蚊子。

The location is easy to find with Google Map. The room is comfortable. The breakfast is delicious and hearty. The host and the maid are friendly and helpful. The hostess is a taxi driver so it is really convenient to book her taxi for pick up and drop off at the airport. However the Wifi signal is weak inside the room and is only accessible in public area.
It was a nice stay in a home of a warm and friendly family. Really helpful to me and my 2 sons, brought us to  the airport. We'll come again.. Many thanks, Belinda! Marie & son's
Located coveniently close to THE AirPort. Nice staf.
Excellent House! Big, clean and feel like home. Hospitable house-owner. Hope to get chance to live again.
Belinda was very welcoming, even though I did not end up personally staying there (my friends stayed there). The room was as advertised, and rather nicely located.

Belinda is a very soft spoken, kind and sweet person. She made me feel really comfortable the moment I entered the place by detailing out not just the room and the facilities but how I could commute, and also food options in the area. The room ? Well the picture says it all. One should experience staying in such a room at least once. Its antique! The entire house is antique, calm and well designed.. Its very clean. The mattress and sofa were so comfortable that I got great sleep after a long day at work. There is a refrigerator which meant that I could bring some snack and quick food to munch on. While I stayed alone there, the room is perfect for someone looking for a romantic setting. The area is quiet, calm and green. It was great walking in the neighborhood. There is a park right in front.

It's terrible.The house near the airport ,but you can go there only by taxi.It is too old and untidy, We didn't sleep well all night because it's too dirty，even have much hair on the bed.I think the owener didn't do a good job.
Good for stay if you have your exhibition or seminars at EXPO, 5 mins drive to EXPO
it was a quite nice place
Thank you very much for the ride!
집이 넓었고 호스트분이 친절하였음. 그리고 근처가 주택가라서 한적하였고 공항이 가까워 편리하였음
我是帮朋友定的民宿，她们住得很开心，都说很不错！希望下次再定。

I liked staying there. Belinda is a very welcoming person. She even drove me to the airport at 11 p.m.! The place is not very central but that is already obvious when you book. For me it was fine because I had to work near Expo. To reach city center it take 30-40 minutes by MRT. From the airport I took a taxi- cost 11 Singapore Dollar. That’s absolutely ok.
It is a room in a house, which share a bath room with neighbour room. Quite close to airport, and 10-15 min walk to subway station.

Super Like!!!!
Belinda is super host. Me and my wife stayed here for 24 days and we had pleasant stay. Belinda is really helpful, i never felt like out of home. Kitchen, washing machine, water purifier etc. is so easy accessible and very clean as well. Room was very clean too and spacious enough for 2 person. I recommend this place if you want to stay near Upperchangi road. Thanks Belinda for being a wonderful host.

Neat and clean place
Near to the airport

As returned to our home, host Mom welcomed me. With many children, I was able to stay comfortably without hesitation. Thank you very much for your support and response. Next time I want to stay more slowly.

Belinda is so accommodating that she even initiated to pick us up at the airport when there was strong rain. She even accommodated us earlier than check in time since we arrived earlier. Nice place too. Just 8 mins drive from the airport. And walking distance from Mrt station too.
Great place

Belinda was such a great host and very accommodating! One of the nicest hosts I have ever encountered. The room has all you need with a big bed and aircon for the humid Singapore nights. It is very close to Changi so perfect place for a layover. I highly recommend Belinda - such a great host!

Ideal airport location (6 min car ride) that’s comfortable for 2-3 people. Belinda was a great host, and we particularly appreciated her hospitality — from recommending local eats to helping us with our luggage at 6 AM as we were checking out, Belinda went above and beyond to make it a great stay.

Belinda was a fantastic host. The room was comfortable and spacious and plenty of common areas to relax too. I was able to work when necessary with a very strong WiFi connection and the house was located perfectly for both the Airport and MRT. I would definitely stay again, Belinda is a very nice lady and I very much enjoyed my stay in Singapore.
It’s a great place to stay!
no hot water.
nice stay
Very understanding and caring
Convenient location to the airport. Quick communication from the host. Comfortable space.
It was good for a short stay. Convenient location to the airport
I had a nightmare of losing my visa right before my departure. So it's my wife and aunty who came instead. Belinda was fine and kind about it. Thank you!
Belinda’s place is big and stylish, I will come here again.
Good location, cleanliness and amenities.
공항에 늦게 도착해 다른 곳으로 이동하기 전 하루를 묵었습니다. 의사소통도 문제 없고, 방에 들어가서 저희가 더워보였던지 얼음물도 늦은 밤에 가져다주셔서 좋았습니다.
Elizabeth's place is fantastic! great location with lots of character. As a host, she is extremely thoughtful, accommodating, interesting to chat with and very easy to communicate with.

I stayed a couple of days with Elizabeth. She is a great host. I wasn't prepared for that trip and she offered me a lot of information where to go and what to see.

The house is located in a very quiet area, though close to the city center. Just a short walk away from newton station. You can reach Little India by bus in less than 10 minutes.

I felt very welcome and enjoyed my stay. Would stay there again at any time.

I stayed there for 3 days and it was a really pleasant stay. Elizabeth was very helpful and caring as a host.

The house is in a quiet neighbourhood located very near to the MRT station and food court. Also, it's just a walking distance to the city centre. Very nice, spacious room too. Enough to accommodate two people comfortably.

Very highly recommend this place for anyone wanting to experience Singapore!

Betty is a wonderful host. She stayed up late to greet me even though my flight arrived very late at night/early in the morning. She had bagels and cream cheese for me plus towels, soap, shampoo, all the comforts of home. The room with the balcony is very picturesque, the house is quaint and in a great area-very easy to get to either Newton MRT or Little India. Plus the famous Newton Hawker Center/food court is only a block or two away.

Great stay!! Elizabeth was very accommodating. Having traveled a lot and previouly working in hospitality she understands what it's like to be a traveler. She was also very helpful and knowledgeable on everything Singapore.

The room was a good size and the bed was very comfortable. The place is a short walk from the subway and half way between little india and orchard road. For me the place was great and Elizabeth made the stay even better. I would recommend this place and would stay here again.

The house was clean and the host, elizabeth is helpful to give you all the information.
I was staying for 3 nights and had no problems at all.
We were out quite early in the morning and back to the house quite late so haven't really spent the time so much with elizabeth but sure she is a nice person.

There is a little cuty dog in the house. so please be aware :-)
Had a good time staying in Elizabeth place, on the first night we stayed she bring us food for dinner to welcome us =). The place not too far from orchard.

Amazing place! You are indeed 5min away from everything: Newton station, buses to Orchard rd, McRitchie reservoir, temples... Plus there is a handy food court just out of the station, so you have everything you need while staying in a quiet and friendly environment: Betty has been most helpful and accommodating, and the room was very comfortable. I will definitely come back again to visit!

Duration of Stay - May 12 - May 18

The Place: This first floor row house has two bedrooms for rent. This is a very typical and fast vanishing post war row house. The house has three bedrooms and all three share the bathroom and WC. The location is definitely its best selling point, very convenient to center city (Orchard Rd), the Botanical Gardens, Gleneagles Hospital and very many attractions nearby. Also the road is relatively quiet and there is a nice park nearby. Under five minutes walk to the closest subway, Newton.

The Host: Elizabeth is a very warm, kind and gracious host. She will definitely make your stay that much more closer to home. She was very helpful in telling me about the best places to see and hang out. She also made sure I was OK, especially when I did not get back late at night. She will provide you breakfast, all day coffee and any other dietary special requests.

Conclusion: Great value for your money. Experience Singapore living as it once was. (Make sure which of the two rooms you are booking, so you know what you are getting.) Great host.

Elizabeth is very nice person.
She was kind to me variously.

Also close to Orchard is good.
Excellent location and relaxing place to stay.  Slept very well at night.  Elizabeth is a friendly host, even dropped me off at the conference center in the morning!

Elizabeth's residence is very convenient, close to everywhere ! The place is just a short walk to Scotts Road and also very near to Orchard.  The place is well maintained. What's more, Elizabeth is a great host and also very helpful. Thanks Elizabeth !

Its a good and relaxing place near the city.  With just a few mins of walk, you will be able to access buses and train to your desired destination. Best thing is, Elizabeth is a great host! She will make sure that everything is well taken cared of. We had a great stay, enjoyed Singapore and relaxing mode when you get back to her place. I will surely recommend her place!

Elizabeth's residence is very centrally located with easy access any type of transport bus, MRT or taxi. Its also just a few minutes to the city center, Orchard road etc. Elizabeth herself is a very pleasant lady and very helpful for me to find my way around. She knows the city well and will try her best to ensure that you see as much of Singapore as possible!

Had a great stay at Elizabeth's residence! It was very near the heart of the city, and yet it was also a nice and quiet area to relax after a long day. Elizabeth was very kind and accommodating and even returned home in the middle of the day to say goodbye before we left.

Elizabeth was definitely the greatest host we met during our 2 week trip with my gf! She was very flexible! Most of the hosts require a 12pm check-in and a 12pm check-out but we arrived earlier and Elizabeth was not home but she gave the key to our neighbor so that we didn't have to wait for her outside and on the day we left our flight was late and she allowed us to leave our luggage at home and even to take a last shower to feel clean before our flight! And she even cooked for us!

She has a little poodle dog that is pretty calm and never barks so don't worry about that!

The room was clean, AC and fan worked perfectly, the hot water in the shower as well.

Elizabeth is a person who travelled a lot so she does everything to make you comfortable. She gave us some address where to go eat and hang out, she provided us some maps ( and also a basket of soap, toothbrush and toothpaste!)

But just to be clear, this place is not a hotel but more a place where you can share things with people who live in and with the host so just a little warning for people who want a fancy room, they should just book in a hotel!

Oh yeah one more thing, the location of the house is perfect! 3 min from the Newton foodcourt and 5 mins from the Newton subway station (only one station from Orchard Street)! And it's also pretty close to the airport (less than 20 SGD by cab/30 min during rush hours).

If this is your first time trying airbnb, elizabeth will be the best host for you! She is considerate, friendly and know when to give you space, patience and always be there whenever you need something! The 2nd night I didn't have dinner because I was busy with work and she even offered to cook for me! :)

Elizabeth is more than just a good host!

I have travelled to places and stayed in different types of accommodation..and I must say Elizabeth's house is one unique, definitely value for money and very comfortable to stay in.

I am very happy with my first airbnb choice and next time I am back in Singapore, this will be my first choice!

Ps: Thanks Elizabeth, see you again soon! :)

We were disappointed with the accomodation. The bed linen and towels were old and tired with very lumpy, uncomfortable pillows. Air conditioning worked well.  The bathroom consisted of a small rectangular room with nowhere to place clothes while showering. The facilities were below par. The common areas ie kitchen/sitting room, were very untidy. Location is good. Close to MRT and buses. Good free Wifi.

Me and my friend stayed a couple of days with Elizabeth, we had a great stay at her place. She was there when we arrived and made sure we had everything we needed. We slept very well because the room was comfortable, clean and AC worked well. She provided us some maps, towels and a basket of soap, shampoo, toothbrush and toothpaste such as in hotel :p We were out early in the morning and back to the house late, so we haven't talked and spent the time so much with her but she was very helpful, very nice and she is a great host! I highly recommend staying at Elizabeth's. Thank you so much and see you ☺
Elis's house is very near Newton MRT and hawker center and the room is clean and quiet. She is a good host who will prepare breakfast and would like to chat with you. We enjoy our time in her house.

I had a very enjoyable stay with Betty, who is very friendly, and sociable. The room was quite large with an efficient aircon and situated in a quiet central location. Very easy access to buses (recommended - use Google maps for bus routes) otherwise Newton MRT is closer to 10mins walk, if you use the overpass.

The house is a typical local home, so don't expect hotel accomodation, but do enjoy the experience real Singapore living.

Thanks for a great time, I hope to see you again soon.

PS. I would not recommend Newton FC though, it is expensive and touting shouldn't be encouraged!

A nice clean room with a very comfortable bed in a good location and a tidy shared shower/bath hosted by a kind and friendly woman.. Elizabeth accepted our after-midnight arrival without a quibble and guided by phone our slightly lost driver to her door.

Жилье находится в тихом месте между двух больших дорог. К сожалению квартира на фото выглядит гораздо лучше и свежее. Комната в которой мы жили нуждается в ремонте или обновлении. Телевизора у нас не было, но все остальное (лампы, вентиляторы, кондиционер) работали исправно. Так же при выборе мы не учли что у хозяйки есть собака и поэтому не понравился запах. Дом в котором расположено жилье очень старой постройки это заметно по туалету и душевой. Были удивлены большим количеством тропических насекомых в квартире! Пару раз на кухне видели большого таракана.
Так же не совсем близко до метро около 15 минут ходьбы, в основном из-за того что приходится много раз переходить дорогу.
Мне кажется, но наша комната была самая достойная в квартире, хотя было немного тесновато.
Хозяйка была добра к нам и даже вошла в наше положение.

----
The accommodation is situated in a quiet location between two major roads. Unfortunately apartment in the photo looks much better and fresher. The room in which we were living in need of repair or upgrade. TV, we did not have, but everything else (lights, fans, air conditioning) work properly. Also in the selection we have not considered that the lady has a dog and so did not like the smell. The house in which it has a very old building housing it is noticeable over the toilet and shower. Were surprised by a large number of tropical insects in the apartment! A couple of times in the kitchen saw a large cockroach.
It is also not very close to the subway station about 15 minutes away, mostly because it has a lot of time to cross the road.
I think, but our room was most worthy in the apartment, although it was a bit cramped.
The hostess was kind to us and even got in our situation.

A really great place to stay in Singapore - Elizabeth was a very kind and generous hostess whom after just a few days we now regard as a new friend. The accommodation she offers is reasonably priced and well located for exploring Singapore. Elizabeth definitely embraces the full Air-BNB ethos of sharing a space with a local and benefitting from their knowledge and advice to get the most from your time exploring a new place.

Our flight was delayed but Elizabeth stayed in to ensure we arrived safely and also gave directions to the taxi driver. Located in a quiet street - just 10 minutes walk from the subway station, the house is a charming, typical local home, you won’t get a sterile hotel space – you get a spacious room with bed, A/C, desk, lamp wardrobe etc. and use of the private balcony. The room and kitchen & washroom facilities were clean & adequate for our needs and well worth the money and we benefitted from the free Wi-Fi that was available. We were also lucky enough to meet her little dog who is quiet and well behaved.

Elizabeth’s home is ideal if you are a traveller looking to share stories and get the most out your visit to Singapore – a far more personal ‘real life’ experience than staying in a characterless hotel. Highly recommended and we'll definitely stay again next time we're in Singapore - Thank you Elizabeth!

Nice bohemian little house, very central. Its great for short visits
because the Appartment is quite small so you stay in your room, which has a huge comfortable bed and a balcony to hang out.
Also Elizabeth is a very friendly and helpful host.
Thanks again!***
Elizabeth is a very nice. I very much enjoyed staying at her place. It's very conveniently located between Novena and Newton subway. I'd definetely book this place again!

We had an incredible visit to Singapore and enjoyed staying at Elizabeth's apartment. The apartment / room itself wasn't immaculate, but whatever it lacked in comparing it to a 5-star hotel was more than made up by its convenient location and the generosity of the hostess.

Elizabeth went above and beyond the call of duty to make us feel welcome and to make sure we had the best possible time in Singapore. She offered to drive us around to some of her favorite restaurants as well as to a jazz club to hear some local musicians performing. She also gave us plenty of suggestions for her favorite foods and attractions. My wife and I had never been to Singapore before, but with Elizabeth's help, we feel we got a proper taste and will definitely be back.

The apartment is walking distance not only from the Newton subway station, but also to United Square mall and food court and the infamous Newton Food Centre, home to 80+ stalls of all the Singaporean classics - prawn noodle soup, chilli crab, Hainanese chicken rice, plus more Indian, Malay, Thai, and Cantonese food than you could eat in a lifetime.

Elizabeth is a super host. She has a wealth of knowledge about Singapore, and she is always willing to share it. From where to get good local food, to where the best happy hour deals are. She was super helpful to me as I relocated to Singapore, knowing so much about the entire city.

Elizabeth's place is very close to major transit hub (MRT) and also close to the famous Newton Food Center. You can also walk a short distance to a major shopping area, United Plaza. Her home is more traditional style, so there are some stairs, and it is an older building. If you want some sort of hotel stay, don't stay here. If you want a comfortable, homey stay, with loads of local knowledge,a good location and a super host, stay with Elizabeth!
Betty was very easy to communicate with and very hospitable.  The room was as advertised and the location of her apartment was convenient.  Great place to stay in SG!

We stayed at Betty's place in May at the beginning of our travelling and again in June before we left again. Betty was travelling herself at that time so we did not get the chance to meet her, but her flatmate was very nice and helped us if we needed advice. Also, Betty kept in touch with us via telephone and e-mail. The room comes with a small balcony and (more important) :-) with an aircon and a fan. There is a large shared shower in the apartment. The place is a few minutes walk to the next MRT station Newton. All in all it is definitely worth staying at Betty's place!

I stayed at Betty's place for 3 nights. I stayed at both rooms (the one near the kitchen and the one that have a balcony). Both are nice, but I prefer the one with the balcony simply because it is bigger and I can sleep better (don't know why).
The location is perfect with reasonable price. It is near Newton MRT station and Bus Station. You have to take a walk and crossing the street.
I didn't get a chance to have a long chat with Betty. But I did meet her and she seems nice. She was communicative prior to my arrival. She contacted me through e-mail and update me that she wouldn't be able to meet me on my first day. However, the check in was smooth as the instruction was so clear.

As a matter of fact, I will be staying at her place again on my upcoming visit to Singapore :)

Elizabeth was a most charming and likeable host who took me to the best Jazz bar in Singapore that I failed to discover in 4 years of living there. Her house is a charming part of old Singapore and is a beacon of down to earth values in a land of faceless modernism. I highly recommend staying with her.

The location is very good with a walkable distance from mrt to the house. The house is very clean, tidy and decent. Can do some simple cook inside the kitchen and enjoy the food in the open kitchen. Elizabeth is very nice to us. We can enjoy stay there and looking forward to visit Elizabeth very soon.

Betty is the super host. I arrived really late at night (after midnight) and she was waiting for me and giving the direction to the cab driver. The place is really closed to the Newton MRT. I really like the area where her home is as it is really green - you don't feel that you are actually in town while in reality it is so close to Orchard!

Elizabeth contacted me a couple times prior to my arrival, to ensure that I knew what I needed to do to make it to the room easily. She was very friendly and helpful throughout the whole pre-arrival planning. Upon reaching Changi Airport, I was able to hale a taxi and find my way to the house quickly.

Once I arrived, Elizabeth had everything in order to make this a very nice stay. This is my first time using AirBnB, and I believe (from this first impression) I will be using them again, especially if I come back to Singapore.

This is a great place to stay and I would recommend it to anyone who wants a comfortable room in a quiet neighborhood. If that is you, you can't beat this place.

We found our booking with Elizabeth to be extremely straightforward and organized. She made sure we had a number with which to contact her upon arrival, and gave very clear directions on how to get the house keys and get into the house. The room was clean and spacious enough for two. We were provided with clean towels and toiletries, as well as a huge collection of pamphlets, which we found especially helpful. Elizabeth made sure to check in on us atleast once a day to see how we were going, and provided suggestions on where to eat and places to see. The house is a 5-10 minute walk to Newton Food Centre (definitely a must!) and train station. While the accommodations are not hotel standard (and realistically you should not expect as such anyway), we found Elizabeth to be a very thoughtful host. For the price, you won't get a better location! Thank you Elizabeth for the wonderful stay.

location is ok near to newton mrt about 4 blocks but you have to go up walkway/overpass so its not ideal for those with luggages to use MRT, better get a cab. no escalator on walkway. There's a hawker center on the way to MRT. no supermarket or convenience store nearby.
My friend and I only stayed 2 nights not convenient for those used to staying in orchard area. :)

We have just returned from spending five days in Singapore staying at Elizabeth's house. We contacted her from the airport and the cab driver had her address, so finding her place was reasonably easy.
We were met by Elizabeth who made us most welcome. The location is great, within 10 minutes walk to Newton Circus food stalls, and the local supermarket at United Square. You can catch the MRT from nearby in both locations, and is a short journey to Orchard Road and the centre of Singapore. Elizabeth kindly took us to an art exposition before we left which we found very interesting and appreciated. We found our stay very comfortable and was a very relaxing atmosphere. If we are ever back in Singapore, we would seriously consider staying with Elizabeth again.

my boyfriend and I had a great stay here. We just feel like staying at home.Elizabeth is a friendly host and she shared whatever she knows.She recommended some nice places to eat.
If you are on a budget travel like us, you can definitely consider her place.

Elizabeth is a very warm person, but the place is very very basic with shared bathrooms. you will get a clean room only for the first time then it wont be cleaned for the next days till you are there , even the towels are not changed. and though its written flexible time to check in & check out but there are no extra keys to enter the house ,my flight was at 10 p.m . i had to take my luggage with me at 12 in the afternoon because other guest was coming & there is no extra key for me to take if i want to come at around 7 pm to take the luggage . apart from this Elizabeth is very warm ,friendly & helpful person .

A very pleasant experience. Elizabeth was a charming host, pleasant and helpfull. Our room was clean and and the bed was comfortable, there is air conditioning and a small balcony overlooking the quiet street which has a small and pleasant park at the end of it.  The location is good being only minutes away from public transport and other amenities.

Très agréable !  La chambre est sympa, dans un petit appart accueillant et proche du métro, c'est très bien situé pour aller visiter la ville !  Elisabeth à été très chaleureuse et prévenante avec nous.
I had a great stay, Elizabeth was a good host. I recommend staying there!
We had a lovely stay with Elizabeth. She's a great person and the place was nice and comfy.

Charming British style house in a quiet, but very convenient side street. Newton Circus was less than 10 minutes walk away, as well as the MRT. Elizabeth is well traveled, and has plenty of good suggestions of places to go. She provided towels and toiletries, which was a welcome surprise as we were traveling quite lightly. The balcony, combined with the ceiling fan, meant we could sleep comfortably despite the heat without needing to use the A/C. Singapore seems to have surprisingly few mosquitos, and we left the balcony door open without a problem. If that doesn't suit you, the A/C works just fine. She also included electrical adapters, which came in handy. You get the feeling Elizabeth has hosted a lot of people over the years, and that experience shows up in convenient details.

The place is a bit difficult to find. It took a while for some taxi drivers to figure out exactly where it was. Elizabeth was helpful when called though, and if you store a map of the destination on your phone it shouldn't be an issue. Part of the charm of the house is its age, but that also means slightly antiquated plumbing. She also lets some of the other rooms out from time to time, so there is a decent chance you will meet other travelers. If you are social, this can be great. We received some good advice, and hopefully passed some on to those who came as we were leaving.

We are easy going travelers, and enjoy experiencing the local life of a city. We had a great time staying with Elizabeth, and would definitely consider staying there again if we have the fortune of passing through Singapore another time.
Nice and convenient apartment. Definitely worth the money. Elizabeth was also a very helpful host - providing toiletries, towels, and tourist information.

The place is quite central and convenient, Elizabeth is very helpful too. The only thing I think it can be improved is the light in the room, the light doesn't work very well since its kinda old and the  power cord is not well connected. But all in all, its a good choice if you need a budget place to stay in Singapore.

Thank you Elisabeth for your warm welcome. The place was relatively easy to find - a 5 min walk from the Newton station. The room is exactly as described with aircon and a nice little balcony. If you are looking for a relatively cheap room with good value then I would recommend staying at this place
Great location! Charming British-style house. Close to Newton MRT. Elizabeth is very welcoming and can help answer all your questions about Singapore.
Great location. Great hospitality.  Elizabeth is a great host.

Staying for a couple of nights at Elizabeth's was very pleasant. The balcony overlooking the street was nice. Keep the fan on at night for a breeze and to keep anything that wants to bite you at bay. The only issue I had was that I needed to swap the chair for something more sturdy, but that was easily fixed.

If you're planning on walking from the train station, ask for detailed directions, as it's a bit tricky for a first timer, but quite simple once you know the way.

Elizabeth was friendly and very helpful. Staying at a real Singaporean house was great and an antidote to staying in hotels.

I and my husband had good time with Elizabeth for 6 nights. Shes very nice and helpful all the information about Singapore. Her house is very close to the MRT Newton(next to MRT Orchard) also food market and a little convenience store. If you wanna stay close to Orchard it could be best choice its only 15-20 min by walk.
Elizabeth is the best! Always eager to help and give you any information, she has maps and information ready for you as you arrive! I will definitely stay with her again!

Elizabeth is a very good host. He gave us all the details, prepared maps and suggestions what to see. Thanks for everything! You were so helpful!! The room was nice, with quiet air-con, clean. The location was good, about 10 minutes to subway (which works perfectly in Singapore). The city is marvellous!.

Very pleased with space and location. Singapore is dense and crowded. Elizabeth's space is just off the beaten path, with some elbow room and some greenery. We very much enjoyed the daily short walks from public transport to her home.

The small balcony outside the bedroom we used was also a pleasantry.

She was eager to assist and provided us with numerous suggestions for things to do and places to go.

We had a great time at Elizabeth's place! We were there for a week over Christmas. We loved staying in an older Singaporean house on a quiet street, waking up to the sound of tropical birds, being within walking distance of two MRT stations and a great food court, and enjoying the balcony attached to our room. We would definitely stay there again. Thanks, Elizabeth, for hosting us. You are welcome at our place any time!

Elizabeth was a very welcoming and hospitable host and we enjoyed our stay.  We were in the room depicted in the photos, and whilst comfortable it no longer looks quite like the photos! We were also surprised to find three other guests although it was good to meet them and that is what AirBnb is about. The bathroom facilities were very poor and in our experience not up to the standard we expected from previous AirBnb.  However, the location is very convenient for the city

We never saw any host. Elisabeth hasn't been there for months and will not be there for months to come (according to info received by phone, after arrival). We spoke to a person on the phone from the airport who told us the key would be under the mat, together with keys for other guests. The place was quite filthy: dirty shoes in the sink, empty wine bottles in the room; holes in the sheets, and everything covered with grime. We decided we certainly couldn't cook there. It appears that this is simply a boarding house - 5 people stayed while we were there - 2 checked out early and none of us ever saw a host.
The spirit of airbnb - to stay with local families who provide local knowledge certainly was absent.
The location is about 15 min walk from the MRT (subway), but one has to cross busy highways. Once on the MRT everything is easily reachable.
Of our many airbnb experiences, this was the only serious disappointment. I would not stay here again and can't recommend it to anyone.

We had great time staying at Elisabeth's. The room is comfortable and nice.  We didn't meet any hosts during our stay. But we talked sometime through the phone. Elisabeth and Rene are very helpful. I'd like to stay at Elisabeth's room again. Thank you for hosting us!:)
Quiet neighborhood and not far from MRT. Elizabeth is a great host. Staying here is a 'feel like home' experience.

Terrible terrible landlord!! The landlord Elisabeth's attitude disappointed me badly!!!
I did a eye surgery in Singapore, after the surgery I couldn't see anything, just had to stay in the bed.
The toilet is very small, The bathroom facilities were poor and i got a house gecko infestation. Gecko is everywhere to scare you!
But I can't move out cause I had to lie down so we had to stay in the house. 2 weeks after, the doctor changed his mind and told us we could go back home to relax, so my daughter talked to the landlord Elizabeth about shorten the reservation, But she refused to talk!!!!
She didn't response the message, didn't answer the call, didn't response to the request.
She is ignoring our request in order to earn more money!!!!!
So I had to call the Airbnb to help me and gave Airbnb the chat record.
But the Airbnb didn't give Elisabeth a deadline to respond to the alteration request according to the rules, so after I cancel the reservation, the landlord got so much more money for the cancel!!! It's very very expensive!
Fear and anxiety are gnawing me when I can't see anything and the landlord refused to help.
So don't choose this house, don't let yourself being angry and helpless!

We had a great stay here, thank you Elizabeth.

The bed was extremely comfortable and we were provided with clean towels on arrival. We had a lovely evening sitting out on the balcony with a lantern and some Kopi-C from the local food market Newton (only a few mins walk down the road). The location was fantastic because it was quiet and peaceful yet so close to the city centre. Only 2 stops away from Orchard road on the MRT and Newton food centre just down the road was excellent. We found everything to be clean and tidy including the room, the main house, the shower room and toilet.

It was nice to meet some of the other guests briefly but we had our own privacy in the room which was nice too. One of the flatmates gave us a great recommendation to eat at Serangoon food market which we enjoyed a lot. Elizabeth sent us a list of recommendations too which was much appreciated.

Elizabeth really made sure we were ok and kept in touch with us via email. Communication with her is great. If you're looking for good value accommodation, I'd recommend this. Thanks Elizabeth!

I had a great weekend at Elizabeth's listing located near Newton Circus. I enjoyed the neighborhood SO MUCH that I basically stayed nearby most of my time. I went up early jogging in the park (50m away), I explored the neighborhood and talked to people, the food court (200m away) provided enough delicious local food which was quite convenient. Elizabeth was quite helpful that she let me in very early in the morning right after I landed. The cleaning lady came during my staying there, there was a nice chat with her as well. All in all, to me it was a good experience.

Elizabeth responded to our spontenous request very fastly and we we're able to stay at her place eventough we requested the booking at the same day. However, when booking a double room there is a difference of 11 euros if two people stay there. So when booking a double room for two people you have to pay 11 euros more even if it is not displayed at first and still the same double room..why? Further the pictures look much brighter and newer than the house is...but nevermind..it is expensive singapor..yet, the most weird and akward thing are the two webcams in her house. It seems she is never there..and maybe afraid of people destroying her house or whatever..but this is not what airbnb is about. It's about trusting and meeting people from other cultures and countries..or if you only have money on your mind, then you have to handle possible negative side effects in another way ..but not by setting up webcams? That's how we feel. However, via viber Elizabeth was nice and provided us with good tips about Singapore.

The experience was great even though my purpose for going Singapore wasn't that successful, but the home in which my friend and I were welcome to was a great experience.
Our host, though not around and probably far away at that time, constantly checked to see how we were doing and gave suggestions and advices on our spare time which was really helpful.
And to Miss Elizabeth, you have both our warmest wishes and greatest appreciation for your efforts to make our stay comfortable and the trip worth it.
God bless = )

Elizabeth was very helpful during and after the booking process and directions to her place were detailed. Only a 5 minute walk from Newton MRT it is ideally located for traveling around Singapore. The room was large and light with a comfortable bed and desk. I enjoyed my stay at Elizabeth's and hope to be back soon.

Elizabeth was a great host, checked up on me just to make sure everything was ok even while she was not present. Neighbourhood is quiet but nice with an outdoor gym nearby and hawker centre a few minutes away. Newton station is ~10 mins away as an FYI.

Overall positive experience, I intended to stay one week but extended for almost three. Would recommend this place, spacious and has everything you need. Caveat that it might be difficult to catch a cab in the mornings but again bus and MRT options are all around.

Élizabeth was a very reactive host and all was in line with the presentation. The flat is very well located, approx 10mns from newton tube station, which will drop you in less than 10 min in marina bay. Area is nice and very calm. Just a small remark, a renovation of the house would not be a bad idea as the shower could be a bit more modern. But for that price in Singapore and in this location, not ray to find a better deal.
The place is close to the food center and the mrt station. That's a big thumb up. Room is ok.

Elizabeth was very helpful and even though she was away she was always available to help by viber. The room was bright and sunny with a comfy bed and good internet. Although it is an old house it was very clean. Lovely thing about this house is that it is one minutes walk from a little park, you can hear the birds sing in the morning, and its fairly quiet even though it is near main roads.
The location is very central - only warning I would give is that although you may be able to get to Newton in 5 mins if you are 16 - I am 60 and negotiating the overpass plus the walk took me 10-15 mins. I would not want to try it with luggage.
I was there for a week and had a lovely stay

Elizabeth is a warm, friendly and easy to get along with, though her house is located in the center area and close to the main traffic roads and the subway station, walk around the shopping center and life square less than 10 minutes, however, here is a rare quiet place in the downtown.Rooms spacious and comfortable big bed, high-speed network services and a full set of kitchen utensils for my holiday has brought a lot of convenience and enjoyment.Especially Elizabeth warm and thoughtful service, let me have a feeling of living in their own home.
Thank you very much, Elizabeth.

she is a very nice host.  I did not see her but feel she is taking care of my thoughts.  My room there are tissue paper box, iron and ironing board.  Her accent is American style and easy to understand.

I had a really good stay at Elizabeth's house. I was in the front room with the balcony. The room gets plenty of light which was great because I was working some of the days.
The house is well kept and the cleaner came to service everything each week - I was there for 4 weeks :)
It is just under ten minutes for Newton SMRT station and there are numerous buses close by. United Square mall is 10-15mins walk where there is a Cold Storage to buy groceries.
Would recommend staying here, thanks Elizabeth.

We stayed in the Room just for 2nights, we arrive at midnight and the area in Front of the house smelled like badpo...
Honestly i wouldnt pay this money for this room again!
It was clean and tidy but not worth it!
The house is a old building the Toiletdoor is open on the top.
The hotwater in the shower was not working.
The furniture is the same except of the bed, but the pictures are photoshoped! It was never so bright in the whole building!
We never meet Elizabeth, we just had contact per E-Mail viber and Air bnb. I think she is a nice Person but she made us crazy! She was so worried that we would not find the house, that she wrote me so many emails and massages explained everything six times that i really was worried! But it is so easy to find it! Tell the Street Name to the taxi driver and stop on her gate.
I am sorry.

Overall: Comfortable, clean, quiet, out of the way homestay-like set up, with 3 rooms being rented out. Communication with the host could be more streamlined, clearer, and organized. The host, as stated in other reviews, seems to live elsewhere.

Bonus: The Newton Food Centre is a short walk! And there's a washing machine on premises.

Cons: 1) The kitchen does not appear to be newly renovated. Faulty stove, and refrigerator needed to be replaced while I was there. According to the host, the holiday interfered with delivery of a new fridge, so it was wrapped in bungee cord for the entirety of my 7 night stay, which was unfortunate. 2) Communication with the host was cumbersome and created some difficulty initially. I think providing options other than Viber to communicate important info--such as Skype calls or calling card calls--would have been helpful.

To be sure, the space itself is comfortable, even with faulty kitchen, which I understand will be remedied soon.
It will satisfiy our expectation: place is cozy and quiet, traffic is convinient, host is nice.

A townhouse in central Singapore. You barely get that experience where accommodations are up in the sky. The location is superb, within walking distance to bus stops and Newton MRT station.
Thinking there were other tenants in the house, my wife and I came back to a dark house on the first night! Coupled with the quiet neighborhood we were pretty freaked out at first! We left the living room lights on the next few days just to feel safe.
Elizabeth was an excellent host! She had all the information prepared for us prior to arrival, including directions to the house, wifi password, recommended attractions etc. She even called us prior to arrival, and message us on and off to check if everything is alright!
If you're looking for a quiet neighborhood, yet in a central location, this is the perfect place. If you want to be right in the hustle and bustle of everything, with city lights, crowds and atmosphere, this may not be your cup of tea.

The house is clean and quiet,It takes about 5 minutes to Newton MRT station,the most important thing is that the house is near to the Newton food centre,It is convenient to eat.Elizabeth is friendly,she give me the information about Singapore before I depart,about where I must visit,What  I must eat,and how could I buy the ticket~It is useful for me and I can make a plan for my visit.During my living,she is also ask me that if I am Ok,It is a wonderful trip,and I am satisfied with the house.If I can go Singapore again,I will choose the houseO(∩_∩)O

The house and room are both comfortable, clean and close (at 5min of walking distance) to public transportation. It is worth noting
as the house is closed to Newton Food Center as it is convenient to eat. Elizabeth is a very nice host. She gave me a lot good and useful information about Singapore. Definitely, I will come back again.

The place is close to Newton food market and station. The room is big with all the facilities you can think of  and even comes with balcony. And the most important is that it's rare to have the opportunity to live in this kind of old-styled house in a city. I would recommend this house.
The place was lovely and felt like home. A very nice deal!

Although I didn't met Elizabeth personally, she gave me very clear instructions about check-in. Before and during my stay she was also very helpful. The room is cozy and sunny. The house located within 5 minutes walk from the Newton MRT station and the Newton Food Center, where you can find a lot of tasty food at reasonable prices. I recommend Elizabeth and her house.

I really enjoyed my stay at Elizabeth's place! It is very well located, next to Newton metro and very close to little India as well ! Elizabeth is very responsive and she makes sure everything is alright for you. On top of that she gives a lot of good recommendations in order to have a great stay in Singapore. I would recommend that place anytime!

I informed the host that I was booking for my in-laws before she accepted this booking. The house is some walk away from Newton MRT but the walk wasn't sheltered. Given SG weather, its not particularly convenient. The house and room are definitely not as new and neat and bright as shown in the photos. Its rather clean but the kitchen lacks microwave and the stove doesn't work although we've tried a couple of times and even asked the host about it. My in laws couldn't heat up the food that they bought back. However, the room is big and clean although dark. My in laws said the bed is comfortable and they slept well. The host is difficult to deal with. She demands a lot as a host based on my experiences throughout the years and across countries. She's the first host to request for me to send scanned passport details before arrival which made me uncomfortable. When I asked why its necessary, she said its legal requirement (which she can't pinpoint which section and unable to direct me to a website for me to check when I asked for it), that I booked the room for my in laws and not staying there myself (she shouldn't have accepted the booking if it makes her uncomfortable) and that she wouldn't be in Singapore to check us in (so be in Singapore?). I relented and emailed her my-laws' passport details to stop the long chain of communication and she promised to send me EIGHT emails regarding check in details. After she sent FIVE (each of the email containing only ONE or TWO photo/document), she requested (yet again) for me to send my in laws' contact number so she can liase with them personally. She really got on my nerves with her endless requests because of her own choice of not being in SG and confirming my booking knowing I won't be staying there. I told her my in laws are old and are not tech savvy and do not have access to internet as often as I do. She argued with me back and forth until I put my foot down and requested for her to make the whole process smooth and fuss-free for me. The house is at Newton that is the center of Singapore and very convenient. It's  so close to the underground I just walked 8min. And it's very safe, there are many local people living next to me. I think that is right choice to live here and I will live here next time come

Elizabeth is a very responsive host and just a call away.

The experience from the get-go was amazing. Pre-trip communications, smooth check-in and well-equipped place.
The walk is also refreshing as it traverses the park to the Newton MRT station. Room was cosy and well-kept.

My stay at Betty host was perfect. The bed room  is very cozy and the other places of the home so clean. On the other hand, Betty is a wonderful person, so worried, kind and polite. She explained to me all what i needed. Really an excellent place to stay in Singapur, which is a incredible city-country to meet.

Great, clean little spot about an 8-10 min walk from the Newton MRT and the Newton hawker center! The green room was as described, the bed was comfortable, and the amenities were also acceptable. Betty is kind and super communicative, and goes above and beyond to make sure you have all the resources you need to explore Singapore. I wasn’t even expecting her to take care of my laundry, but she did, which was so nice since I was in Singapore for a couple of weeks. Overall I had a lovely time and I’ll definitely stay here again on my next trip to Singapore!
Nice amazing location to stay , great host willing to accommodate the request that I’ve put up

The place is safe and convenient(close to Newton food court & MRT).The rooms are clean and neat with elaborate decorations. Elizabeth is so nice to us. She gave us much helpful information about our explore in Singapore. We had a good time here!

I chose to stay in this house every time I visited Singapore. It locates in a quiet area, just few minutes walking from Newton MRT station. I really loved the two-storey townhouses on the block of Elizabeth’s home. A departure from the sterile condo buildings of the city,  and reminiscent of a Singapore that doesn’t really exist anymore. nice host, convenience location!

Very reasonable price and good location. Betty is very caring.

All I have to say about my stay has been said in the few negative reviews I found.
I am seriously baffled by the generally positive comments on this place. I suppose for young backpackers who are ready to endure Thai hostels, this is good enough.
First and most important, it is a run-down, shabby appartment. Wherever I looked or went, it was messy, dirty (beyond the immediate surface), old and shabby. My sense is that the host actually does not live here -- she was in Australia my entire stay, 10 days -- and simply milks the asset with the help of a "cleaner". No tidying up of the place, no maintainance at all (for at least 10 years, perhaps 20), only superficial cleaning, change of bed sheets and towels (mine was missing, by the way).
All the cheap talk by Elizabether about "my humble, simple home" should be discarded and replaced by: this is a cheap, run-down, shabby place, fine for backpackers who want to avoid hostels. Everyone else should look elsewhere.
Finally, the host herself. She is absent but nonetheless a control freak. She messages constantly and wants to talk, uselessly, including before you board your flight to Singapore (?!). I had to stop her. And she's awfully mean, constantly mentioning the price of electricity; she wanted to charge $5 to use a non-heating washing machine, for which you have to unfold a hose into the shower: seriously? She demands that you send a scan of your passport beforehand, pretending it's a legal requirement, which is plainly wrong. (What is a legal requirement, which she ignores, is to comply with GDPR when you ask an EU citizen for a scan of their passport. What does she do with her guests' passport scans?...)
I do not recommend. Avoid.

I had a great stay !!
Everything was perfect !!

I totally recommand this place !!!!

It is really a budget stay here but in walking distance to the Expo as advertised. The host are friendly and help with the taxi every time I made the request. I used this place for sleep only but others can have a great time at the Playground just opposite of the house.

We are a couple of French travelers aged 56 and 61. We enjoyed our stay in the house of Belinda. The house is clean, quiet and comfortable. The home maintenance staff is friendly and helpful. The metro station is 1/4 hour walk. With the metro you can go in downtown Singapore in 1/2 hour.

However, we booked the budget room. The website say that the room is for one person but you can add an extra mattress on the floor for a second person. But the room is really small for two people. We did not know where to put our luggage. We have therefore chosen to move to a more expensive room, on the first floor with private bathroom and refrigerator. The price was S $ 100 for one night. Not at all the same price as the budget room.

The wireless internet connection is very good. We were able to use the washing machine for our clothes. It was not a problem for us but there are two small dogs in the house.

We recommend the budget for a single room. For couples, it is best to book the more expensive room upstairs.

Nous sommes un couple de voyageurs français âgés de 56 et 61. Nous avons apprécié notre séjour dans la maison de Belinda. La maison est propre, calme et confortable. En revanche, nous avions réservé la budget room. Le site internet indique que la chambre est pour une personne mais qu'on peut rajouter un matelas pour une seconde personne. The place is cozy and small, which is very suitable for single traveller for short stay in Singapore. The room is clean and tidy on the day of arrival. The only thing that bothers me is the wifi signal is kinda weak inside my room. Other than that, everything else is generally acceptable and I'm pleased with the overall services.

I will recommend a bigger room if you looking for a longer stay in Singapore. For me it's enough for three nights of stay.

It was my first Airbnb experience and I liked it very much. The house is located at a central or convenient location, close to eateries and public transportation. Elizabeth was helpful, she provided information essential on how to get around and where to find good food.

Both thumbs up, couldn't have gone better. Elizabeth was always in contact to make sure I had all the information I needed. It's so interesting that me and another girl who was checking in and out on same dates as mine, similar age and backgrounds, also coming from the same city, met in Betty's house!! good. very nice location.
great communications. Elizabeth was friendly and helpful. an excellent host. The house was clean. bed was comfortable. Thanks

Betty is a very caring host, gave complete description on direction to her house and other places I needed to go. I stayed in a very comfy bed and the room was exactly as in the photo...spacious and cozy. Her place is 5 min.walk to Newtown MRT and there is a big food court nearby.

Friendly host.  Old Singapore townhouse but clean and cozy.  About 15' walk to Newton MRT.

It's a nice house! And the owner is very helpful and kind. Thanks a lot

Elizabeth was very helpful and friendly made my stay welcome and enjoyable , plus she could give you any recommendation . The place is clean , nice and peaceful, excellent location , close to the MRT . Thank you Elizabeth for been a great host

We had a great time in Singapore. The room and all facilities were as described and Elizabeth is a fine host. She is very friendly and advised us perfectly. Because I liked Elizabeth's place during my first stay, I came there for a second time. The host is kind. The location is very convenient. It's walking distance to mrt and newton food court. Besides, I like the flexible check in time.

Pleasant place to stay, its very close to Newton food center and Newton MRT station. Overall, we enjoyed our 3 days staying at Elizabeth's place. She was also very helpful with all the information needed and she provided a fast and clear communication response even before the we arrived Singapore.

Elizabeth is very nice to my parents, even though she don't speak Chinese but she always give us travel experiences and care of my mum by texting me. Her place is very easy to find by her tips. And her place is clean and cozy. Good for long term stay.

Quaint townhouse in a quiet neighborhood within a 10 mins walk from Newton MRT Station. Elizabeth was a very nice and considerate host who went out of her way to check that there were no problems during my stay.

I enjoyed my stay here. This is an old colonial British house, and it was a unique experience to stay there. But do not expect it to be like a new condo.

Great room at great location. I liked that it was very close to Newton station and also the Howkers neat the place. Elizabeth helped me a lot for me to checkin and out smoothly!! I will definitely stay here for my next visit as well. Highly recommended!

Betty was a great host!

Elizabeth is a very caring and hospitable host. Her place is very well situated - near both Newton and Novena. She has some great eating out tips and is always up for a chat. Highly recommended!

I had a great stay. Elizabeth was helpful with directions from airport and recommendations for food and sight-seeing.

it is a vintage house with great location. I love elizebeth, she is so caring and responsible. If you are lucky she will be in singapore to host you.

Elizabeth is a perfect Airbnb host. Her home is very charming and she took care of me in a brilliant way. She's concerned about the details which is great... Elizabeth is a great host! She truly cares about her guests’ safety, comfort, and even taught us how to take the public transport and where to go for sightseeing. Elizabeth’s house were the place where I started and finished my travel around some cities in Asia. In February I enjoyed it so much, that I knew I’m definitely going to stay with her in April. And Elizabeth is such a great host! We spent a lot of time together, e.g. went out for dinner several times and enjoyed some live jazz. She is a great networker and introduced me to lots of her friends, all charming and obliging - like Elizabeth! If you’re looking for a host who really takes care of you, this is the place to go!

Elizabeth is warm and gracious hosts and very accommodating.

Thanks, we will stay here again someday.............

Elizabeth is a great host. She really cared about my well being at her place and my experience in the city. On my arrival she helped me get organized and took me out to a nice art gallery. But overall it's a quite place to stay at.
Cozy place, very nice host. Near to MRT. Reasonable price. Perfect to travelers.
Lis is a lovely host...felt like staying with your family, she looked after us and gave the best service she could provide, a pleasant to stay there..

Betty's the best! She regularly asks if I am comfortable in her home and have everything I need -- and even feeds me vegetable soup and kiwis! Her house is not far from the MRT, and the walk there is quite pleasant as the streets are lined with trees and other foliage. But back to Betty, she's such a fun and bubbly lady, and cares very much for her guests. I couldn't ask for a better hostess! Thanks Betty! :)

Elizabeth was a nice and flexible host, she was there when we arrived and made sure we had everything we needed.
