Elizabeth was great...she's a nice and flexible host, very accomodating; the room for the Singapore's standards is big, air conditioning worked well, wi-fi very good, value for your money, near MRT Newton station; the only thing wrong is the bathroom, too small and you have to cross the whole house to take a shower and than come back in your room...but all in all it was a happy stay.

This is my first bnb experience and I truly enjoyed my stay there. Elizabeth is a very nice and thoughtful host who always make sure I get what I need and is always looking out for me if I need any help. On the first day, she even postponed her dinner with her friend just so she could meet me and pass me the house keys. Whenever we were both around, she'll talk to me about everything just like a friend. The room I stayed is perfect for me for the price I pay. Best thing is it's close to the bathroom. Another thing about this place is the location! It's really just 10 mins walk to the newton mrt station which is only a stop away from orchard. It's that convenient. I wish I could stay longer. On the last day, Elizabeth even offer to send me to the mrt station just so I didn't have to walk with all the luggage that I brought. It was pleasant experience staying with her.

We stayed with Elizabeth for 2 nights.  She was incredibly welcoming and very flexible.  Our flight got in very late and we did not arrive until 1am, but that was no problem for her.  The bed was comfortable and the AC worked well.  She showered us with brochures of things to do in Singapore and was really excited for us to make the most of our visit.  She is very warm and accommodating.  Her apartment is old fashioned, but we really liked that as it gave a more authentic feel of life in Singaapore.  She is just a 5-10 minute walk to the metro station and just one stop away from the center of the city.  Very convenient.  Overall, we would recommend Elizabeth's apartment and we think others would enjoy getting to know her and her city.

As our first airbnb experience, the stay with Elizabeth turned out to be an excellent two days and nights.

The location is at the quiet neighborhood just a short walk away from the Newton subway station, which is itself a pretty central station in the city. Elizabeth is very nice and welcoming, and at the same time not imposing. She made sure that we know how to get there, and personally met us, even though we arrived after midnight. The room and apartment had all that we needed, everything worked fine (AC, shower, kitchen, comfortable bed, towels, a basket with bathroom amenities, WiFi, power plug adapters, etc). I suppose that the stay in her house feels much more spacious than in a typical Singapore hotel room, especially at this price. We had our own keys and full freedom to go out or in at any time, just like in a hotel. We checked out late (about 7pm), and Elizabeth was totally ok with this.

To summarize – very recommended!

This is a great value accommodation in this expensive city.  The room is aircon and the bed comfortable.  The hostess Elizabeth is very friendly and welcoming to overseas visitors.  The property is located within easy access of public transport.  I enjoy my stay.

Elizabeth is a really nice host and the location of her flat is just perfect if you want to explore Singapore and stay in a quiet and safe area. The room is comfortable and if you're not to fussy about bathroom and toilet, go and stay with Elizabeth for a couple of days - you won't regret it!

This is my first experience using Airbnb and I have to say it was great. Elizabeth is a very accomodating host and she provided me with all the necessities (e.g. towells, shower gel, toothpaste etc.) to ensure that my stay was a comfortable one. The room is spacious, next to the bathroom, and also has AirCon which is most welcome especially with the excruciating heat in Singapore. Place is also 5mins walk from Newton MRT - convenient if you are looking to travel around Singapore. Elizabeth also provided me with travel brochures and suggestions on where to go during my short stay. As they say, it's that little bit extra that makes a different. However, please bear in mind that this is not a hotel so make sure that you come with expectations. Overall, I would recommend staying at her place and I would do so again.

Elizabeth treated us like a family and she is nice.
The room is clean and the location is near the Newton Food Centre which is almost opened for 24 hours, It is great.

Betty is an accommodating host who is very invested in making sure her guests are comfortable. I was having some problems organising my flights before I left for Singapore, but Betty stayed in communication with me until I managed to sort everything out. She was up and waiting for me to arrive in the early morning and made me a cup of coffee which I really needed after my 'red-eye' flight.

The room was spacious and airy with a ceiling fan and a cross-breeze coming through the two windows so that I didn't need to use the airconditioning at all despite the humidity. The double bed was very comfortable and I slept really well each night. Betty made sure that I had all the toiletries I might need as well as towels. The bathroom and toilet were just next to my room and these were clean and functional.

I appreciated the use of the Wifi as I didn't have a phone connection while I was in Singapore and had to do most of my communicating through Facebook - having the Wifi access enabled me to contact all my friends.

The location of the house, near to the Newton MRT stop, is central and really good for exploring Singapore. It is only one stop to Orchard Road if shopping is your thing. The Newton Circus hawker centre is a 5 minute walk up the road if you want to try local food.

Betty is warm and friendly, great to talk to, and provides as much tourist information as you could want. Unfortunately, I was unable to take her up on her offer to go shopping or out for a snack as I was busy seeing friends most of the time that I was there, but I hope to see her when she is next in Australia.

Thanks, Betty!

Betty is very helpful and always recommending places for us to go.  The location of the place was not bad but unfortunately there were alot of construction going on so walking to Newton was confusing.  Once you know where to go then it's not so bad and its SUPER close to the newton hawker center.  AC was great for during the day and at night time but the fan in the room makes it pretty cool so AC wasn't used as much during night time.

Elizabeth is a friendly host that does her best to help you along your stay. She is always concerned with the wellbeing of the guests and you will feel like home here.
The apartment is her home as well.
The apartment is 10/15 min walking distance from the subway station, but the journey to the centre is very fast!
The prices in Singapore are quite expensive so this is a cheap place to stay. Therefore, don't expect the same as a hotel, but as a home of a friend, which has it's benefits especially if you need someone that gives you tips about the city like Elizabeth does :)

Elizabeth's place is great value for a stay in Singapore, I had a big room, plenty of information about the city, very good wifi, and also other people staying there were helpful with any information needed ! The bathroom and toilet are a bit out of date, but everything was working properly. Elizabeth is very caring, she even offered me soup at my day of leaving; take enough time to call/search a taxi for the airport, especially when it was raining just before ;-)

This was my first time trying AirBnB, and I enjoyed it very much. Elizabeth is a lovely host who'll make sure that you feel comfortable in her place. She's easy to talk to, but, at the same time, she goes the extra mile to make sure that you're satisfied with your stay. When I arrived, I found the room clean and well looked after. Most importantly, she is very quick to address any concerns or problems you might have which I found very reassuring, like helping with MRT questions.

The room is a good size for Asia, and her place is located near the MRT, shopping mall, and a hawker center (outdoor food court), making it an ideal spot.

Elizabeth was and is a fantastic host, immediately eager to help us have a good experience even though our arrival at her place (thanks to international flight schedules) was at 2 a.m.!  We were immediately made to feel at home and the next day were supplied with a pile of brochures and maps as well as great advice for where to start and what to see. The room we stayed in was closest to the shared bathroom/shower, which made it easy to poke a head out and slip in there during mornings. We were given our own keys to the apartment and were free to come and go as we liked. Elizabeth also excels at little, generous touches: she kindly supplied us with some bread our first day so we could have toast for light breakfasts, house slippers, some toiletries with our towels, and later arranged for help with our laundry before we left. As you can see from other reviews, by this point Elizabeth is a pro at hosting, so you can't go wrong. A fantastic experience that I would recommend to anyone. In fact, I just did. Right here.

I had a 12 days amazing time at Betty's place. She is a very nice, flexible, helpful and also a nice host. The first time when I came in the morning, my room was still not available. But she gave me an opportunity to fresh up, so that was nice from her.
Further very convenient to MRT station and also bus stations as well. If you are really like walking, just try to walk from Orchard to Newton. It is just 15 / 20 min and it is nice. Especially during the night when it is not to hot.
The room was clean and nice. Further the bathroom, toilet, towel, wifi internet and were all available, so it was just perfect. An example of what I have experienced so far during my stay at her place: Malaysian dinner what she set up and also very organised as well. The food was yummy yummy yummy!
Further the gifts from Holland, I didn't forget that, but happy as she was: the Belgium chocolate :).
Thanks Betty for everything and especially the New Year's Eve at Sauce Bar! Without that, I was probably among with the other people hang out with the huge crowd haha.

We stayed 5 nights at Elizabeth's place. We stayed in this blue room, with a shared bathroom. Elizabeth's place is a private house, located in a calm area, a park next door. The advantage is that it is in the city center, with Newton MRT next door. Therefore, the ride by public transport and by taxi are short. It is also next to a nice outdoor food court, which allows us to eat various types of Asian food!
Our overall stay was good, and Elizabeth gave us very useful advises. She is very energetic, always available to give you local advises and also tries to help us improve our Singapore Experience. Thank you Elizabeth!!

Perfect weekend stay with Elizabeth and she was so friendly and warm - made sure I was OK when she saw my lights switched on late into the night/early morning on day 1 (I was working!). She even had me ask the cab driver to call her just so she could give him directions to her place and met me at the house (she had originally told me that she may be in a meeting at my arrival). You'll do alright staying with Elizabeth.

Her place is about a 10-minute walk to the Newton MRT and Newton is just 1 stop away from Somerset/Orchard - bingo, right smack of Singapore's shopping and restaurant route. With Singapore's MRT connectivity, you can get about to anywhere you want. Also you can come back at anytime since she'll give you a set of keys. A set of maps are provided but since I'm pretty familiar with Singapore, I didn't need them.

I had the room at the back of the house and it was "large" enough for 2 pax; the air conditioning and fan worked well and there are 2 standing lamps by the side of the bed. This is probably the low point of the room - I would have preferred a brighter room, perhaps another lamp near the dressing table. Its a shared shower and the heater (if you need it) worked fine; also she allows you to feel free to use the kitchen as well as make your own coffee./tea etc.

It was my 3rd time to visit Singapore but my first time to stay at a local's house. I had the best time! Betty was great, as other reviewers have mentioned. She gave me suggestions on what to do while there (I did the Bay South Gardens which was quite amazing) and we actually hung out and are now good friends! I stayed 2 nights in each room. Slept really well in the blue room. It was smaller but very quiet and peaceful. I loved that I didn't need any AC as there was cross ventilation & a ceiling fan. Moved to the other room (by choice) after 2 nights & enjoyed it too. Bigger, with desk space and a great balcony, Bit noisier because it's by the street but not much. Still very peaceful for me. Although I prefer not sharing a bathroom, it was never really a problem during my visit.  I hope it is available again next time I visit. Thanks Betty!

Elizabeth was super friendly, she couldn't be there in person when we where there yet she called us and made sure our stay was pleasant, even shared tips on what is happening and the must see areas.

I enjoyed the peace and quite of the place. Stay could be much better if curtains were used instead of blinds to keep the sun out for ppl like me who sleep late & wake up late :P

Betty's place is definitely will be my choice next time when I come to Singapore! My flight arrived at the airport past midnight and Betty stayed up late for us and welcomed us with recommendations of attractions and must-have food for our short trip .The townhouse is in a quiet neighbourhood and very close to the metro station.We went to the sailing club with Better and watched her sailing match. It was great fun staying with Betty. Print the map and take a cab to get to her place,folks! Don't put this lovely lady into trouble having no idea how to expain the direction for u!

Elizabeth is the best host on the earth. I strongly recommend her house and herself. It is much better than "cold blooeded" Hyatt Hotel.

I enjoyed very much. Although I am not good at speak English. She is very friendly to me and looked after very well.

I've just stayed for three days. but she gave me a great experience for me.

First I arrived Singapore, She navigated me to her house via taxi driver. After I arrived and made sure I had everything I needed. She prepared a lot of brochures for me. I was very glad. because I did not have any guide book for Singapore.

I traveled alone so that she drove with me to a lot of place. We had really tasty clubs with black pepper at the local riverside restaurant. after that we had Singapore style meal at the food court.

She took me to a luxurious opening galley event at Raffles Hotel. We watched traditional Chinese lion dance in a art galley as opening event.

I was really surprised , You know lion dance is famous as Asian new years event. Can you imagine that Chinese lion dance in the art galley? Maybe, I will never see again Lion dance in art galley in whole life. She introduced a lot of her friends. I was very glad.

As above. She is quite familiar with tasty Singapore restaurant and wines. If you want to find good local restaurant.. You will get good solutions from her.

She even offered me meal at my day of leaving. I really loved.

She is very kind and gentle, in spite of I had a lot of misunderstanding.

In addition, she gave me good flavor tea as souvenir.

I would like to back to her house still now.

Elizabeth is a great host and a very friendly person. I strongly recommend you to stay her house. In fact this is my first time experience staying people's house and actually it was fun and know new people.

Staying at her house is so convenient because her place is near to MRT station and also the food court where you can get to eat the local cuisine till late night.

For shoppers, the newton MRT is just one or two stops to Somerset/Orchard. Or if you don't mind do the walking it just straight road towards orchard.

Elizabeth is also very kind to share which places to check out and she keeps telling us to go to the gardens on the bay but eventually it did not happen because me and my other half went for mosaic music festival where happened at esplanade.

So if I ever go back to Singapore for shows/short trips, I will be definitely go back and stay at her crib!

Elizabeths home ist really in the Centre of Singapore,this is a simple house with Aircondition as well as fans, located in a quite & safe area surounded by luxury appartments, i get everything what i need for my 2 days stay in Singapore. i could reach Orchard Road by MRT in a few minutes, or by bus for 3 Busstops both station at Newton, 5 Minutes walk from the House. Elizabeth is very helpfull, has many information & Brosures for what to see & do in Singapore. As i came from the airport, The Taxi driver could'nt find the house easily, so it is recomended to print the acurate map to the house location & ask the driver to call Elizabeth so she can explain the driver where exactly the house is.

The location is excellent and the price can't be beat. The AC was strong and wouldn't even be needed some nights because of the cross breeze created by the two windows in the room. Elizabeth was very helpful and accessible for any questions we had during our stay.

The room was everything we needed; clean, cool, comfortable, fast wifi and shower and toilet right next door. Elizabeth was a friendly, caring, considerate host and the location, an easy walk from Newton MRT, was perfect. Highly recommended!

I'd stayed this awesome house for 4 days. Highly recommend you who wanna experience the local life:) Some of them who expect to stay HOTEL-like accommodation might feel something is wrong tho.
The room is spacious and comfortable with plenty of sunlight and freeze. Also the Bathroom and Kitchen are not "stranger" for me/you. No frills, No formality. There are tons of stuff she's collected all over the world like Bottle, plate and candle.
Elizabeth is the perfect owner. Although I arrived at her place during her absent, she kindly arranged via tell and SMS. She always cared about me. She even invited me to a party when I was free till night.
It's so hard to look for a house esp. town house that it must be unforgettable memory like I got.

You can stop looking for a place to stay in Singapore NOW as you’ve just found the perfect location, Elizabeth’s place. I had the chance to stay at her flat for 3 nights on my first-ever Asia trip in early May 2013. I landed on a Saturday evening and despite having dinner and party plans she made sure that she was at home to welcome me, provide me with a quick tour of the flat, and to give me some maps of the city. My room was very spacious (I stayed alone but it can easily fit 2 people), had AC and a fan, a wardrobe to hang my clothes, and a comfortable double-sized bed. She provided me with towels and basic toiletries (shampoo, deodorant, hand cream). She has a shared bathroom and a separate toilet. They were both clean and up to standards. She is a very, very, very good host as she not only provides you with plenty of brochures and maps but she is also happy to share some homemade dishes with you (she cooked a nice vegetable soup when I was there). She also gave me a list of Singaporean dishes that I had to try (carrot cake, laksa etc). A BIG plus is that her place is literally a 5-minute walk from Newton hawker centre ( a good-sized outdoor eatery with plenty of food choices and juice bars, open until very late) and also from Newton MRT. It is in a very central location but in a nice & calm back street. If you feel like a stroll, the famous “shoppers’ heaven”, Orchard street is 15 minutes by foot. All in all, I had a wonderful stay and would definitely come back on my next trip to Singapore. Thank you, Elizabeth!
Elizabeth was a great host, the check in time was flexible and the room was great, I found a distance to newton MRT rather long though, there was a bus stop just beside the house.

Elizabeth was kind enough to confirm our last minute booking request. In spite of her being away during our checkin, she managed to get everything prepared in advance for our arrival–directions to her place, room, Singapore maps & guides, and basic toiletries.

We stayed only a couple of days at Elizabeth's home but the overall experience was just perfect for us couple. Elizabeth's home is very rustic and unsophisticated. Location is just near Orchard–Central Business District and Newton Hawker Center which is often by locals. Despite us being away during the mornings of our stay, we're able to catch up one night and she recommend some good wine bars and restaurants to us.

If you're looking for a place to stay with a local vibe, homely and comfortable – I highly recommend Elizabeth's home. If you're looking for a 4-5 star Hotel experience then go somewhere else.

You can't go wrong with someone who enjoys wine and someone cares for dogs.

I enjoyed my stayed at Elizabeth's place during my visit in Singapore. Elizabeth left for a trip after taking us in, but she arranged everything to make sure we have a pleasant stay.

The location of the place is really convenient. it is in the central of Singapore, and near MRT, there is a famous newton food court right beside, this ideal location actually saved us a lot of time and energy for the short visit. :)

so overall, be prepared for a relaxing and pleasant stay at Elizabeth's place!

The location is quite good. As advertised, it's a short walk from the MRT and there is a hawkers food center nearby. The room is very basic. We appreciated the air conditioning in the room as Singapore is very hot and humid.

Unfortunately, the check in process was one of the WORST Airbnb experience for us.

Elizabeth was away when we made the trip to Singapore. Elizabeth requested that we ring Ursula (her helper) before getting into taxi at the airport so that Ursula can provide directions. At the airport, we tried calling Urusla twice, but no one answered. We also tried Elizabeth's number... same result. No one answered. Luckily the taxi driver up for the challenge and found the place after a couple of wrong turns. We knocked on the door and when no one answered we tried in vain to ring both Ursula and Elizabeth. It wasn't until about 20 minutes later that we got through to Elizabeth... We were told that Ursula is on her way, delayed because of she had things to attend to at her other job... When she turn up 10 minutes later, there were confusion about the room arrangement. Adding insult to injury, the room we are supposed to stay in has not been cleaned. The bed was not made up, dirty towels scattered on the floor.

The whole process was extremely frustrating and wasted about 1.5 hour (30 minutes of which was spent carrying our backpacks standing outside the house).

We are sure our stay Elizabeth's place could have been great has the check in process been smoother. Elizabeth was apologetic about the incident, she was also responsive when I contacted her 2 weeks after our trip to see if I have left a piece of clothing behind.

However, given the experience we do not recommend this place and will not be staying here on our next trip to Singapore.

Elizabeth ist sehr herzlich und um ihre Gäste bemüht.Wir erhielten im Schnelldurchgang eine Einführung in die Örtlichkeiten, die Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten von Singapur.

Wir haben jedoch leider nach einer Nacht die Unterkunft verlassen. Diese Unterkunft ist sehr geeignet für Backpacker oder auch Single-Männer, die auf eine bestimmte Privatsphäre verzichten.

Für Ehepaare im fortgeschrittenen Alter ist diese Unterkunft nicht geeignet, da mindestens 3 weitere Parteien die Dusche, Toilette, etc. benutzen.

Останавливались у Элизабет в июне 2013 года. Проживали вдвоем в течение трех дней.
Все соответствует описанию: близко от от станции MRT, рядом большой фудкорт, тихая улица, приветливая общительная хозяйка. Ни каких проблем с проживанием не возникало. Хозяйка вручила ключи от квартиры и объяснила где можно поужинать, как пройти до станции метро. В нашей комнате были приготовлены полотенца, тапочки, средства для душа, даже крем от загара, много карт и туристических буклетов о Сингапуре. Пользовались кухней (готовили завтрак). На кухонном столе для гостей чай, кофе, сахар. О своем выборе не жалеем. Если снова доведется побывать в Сингапуре, выберу этот дом. Большое спасибо Элизабет за гостеприимство.
We had a nice stay at Elisabeths room. We arrived late in the evening, but were welcomed warmly. The room was clean and Elisabeth is very helpfull.

Elizabeth's place is well located in Singapore, in a quiet neighborhood, only a few blocks away from a food center and the Newton MRT, which was ideal to travel around the city. Our room was fairly basic but nice, with a small shared bathroom right next to it. We appreciated the AC and the fast WiFi. Elizabeth was a friendly host who gave us good advice and recommendations about what to do in the city. In spite of a few misunderstandings with her at the beginning of our stay, she did her best to work out solutions to make us feel comfortable. On the whole, our 6 nights stay at Elizabeth's place were fine and we recommend her place for low budget travelers with reasonable expectations.
Simple to check in.  Elizabeth is very welcoming and nice.

Betty was a lovely and most helpful hostess.

Room was as advertised and comfortable. thank you, and we hope to meet again, possibly to return the hospitality in New Zealand.

We stayed at Elizabeth's place at the beginning of September, 2013.
The room is quite modest, but at the same time is very nice and cozy. And the neat thing about it is that the room has windows on opposite walls, so if you open both windows there will be a nice flow of fresh air. That is why even though there was an air conditioner in the room we didn't switch it on, simply because it wasn't necessary.
The location of the house is very convenient for anyone who is going to sightseeing - it's quite close to the center and just about 5 minutes from MRT station. And in addition, there is a famous Newton food center on the way to the station (which is open 24h), so you can always have a delicious and inexpensive breakfast or dinner there on your way from/to the station.
Elizabeth was very friendly and really flexible in terms of arriving/leaving time. In short, we would highly recommend this room for anyone looking for a place close to the center for the reasonable price.
I had a nice time! Elizabeth is very helpful and nice host. She showed me a map and told me about places.the house is very cozy I felt I was in my house!

Elizabeth is a very friendly, helpful and open minded person. She helped us with several tips what to do and what to see in Singapore. The room was clean. It's near from Newton MRT, so you are near Orchard Road. From there you can go everywhere. Perfect place to discover Singapore!

The place was great for my purpose. I needed a place close to the city / MRT and eating places and this is very much meeting all of those! Elizabeth is a very sweet lady and was very nice to me. She is a good host. I was happy with my stay and I was able to accomplish my tasks.

Getting to Newton area is very easy..it is close to Orchard just 5 mins away from the Newton MRT and Newton food court(open until 3AM). Soon as I arrived at Elizabeth's doorstep, she had left a note with clear instructions as to where the keys are, the wifi password, and a few things around the house. Elizabeth also gave us a welcome toiletries and a couple of Singapore maps with places of interest. My fiancee and I both were very happy with the room. The house is tiny but inside was actually what we needed- a clean, comfy, and beautiful bedroom. The room is air conditioned yet also has a fan. The bathroom has a hot water shower. There's also a fast wifi provided. Elizabeth was friendly as well as helpful. I definitely would come back to stay with Elizabeth, probably the only place I'd stay if ever come visit Singapore again! We love the house and the host as much.

Nice comfortable bed and room with aircon and fan made for an excellent stay. Elizabeth was very welcoming and gave good advice about places to visit. Extremely convenient location, near Newton food centre and mrt. Thanks!

Elizabeth was a great host and it was lovely staying at her place.
The pleasant experience started already when we arrived in the taxi and it was raining cats and dogs and Elizabeth was already waiting for us outside with 2 umbrellas so we wouldn't get wet.
She also supplied us with tons of useful information about Singapore as came in very handy as we intended to stay for long-term. She knows this place in and out and will advise you well what to see.
The room is cozy and the bed is very comfortable. From the house to the metrostation Novena was less than 10 minutes walk. At the station there is a huge mall where you can buy anything you need.
We now found a longterm place but I would definitely stay at her place again if we hadn't. I recommend to stay at hers - you will not regret it.
Elizabeth was adorable and helped me a lot with great tips! The house is lovely and very well located
Elizabeth is a great host, very kind and easy to talk to. her place is ideally located in a quiet area yet still close to the MRT, with places to eat near by. couldn't have asked for more!.

We stayed at Elizabeth's place for 8 nights at the end of November. She is a fantastic host - very accomondating and friendly. She has a variety of maps, which is useful for those new to Singapore and full of suggestions of what to do and where to go. She also makes a mean Tom Yum Soup (Singapore-style).

The room was clean and photos are accurate. Her home is located in a great area, just outside of Orchard Road. It's about a fifteen minute walk to Orchard Road, and a seven minute walk to the nearest train station, and five minutes from Newton Food Centre where there's plenty of hawker food and open till late.

Thanks for the lovely room Elizabeth! (We did manage to eat up our funny food - noodles and grapes etc, that was in your fridge!)

its been great to stay at Elizabeth home. We felt like homely environment. we was on our honeymoon and really got enough private space to enjoy the trip. Elizabeth is very warm and friendly. thanks for the lovely stay.

The place is very convenient, not far from the MRT, near the food court(BTW, the food there is great ).
Elizabeth has been a very friendly and helpful host.
It is overall a good experience. :)

Elizabeth was a really great host because she's also a traveller and so she knows exactely what YOU need! She can tell you the must-see, must-do and must-eat and so you don't need to do the tourism stuff but see the city as it's really is. And it's wonderful :-) At Christmas Eve she bring dinner for my friend and me and so she really touched our heart and we will never forget about our stay in her clean house!

It was my first time in Singapore and Elizabeth made it great. She is very well organized and knows to make your stay very comfortable. Her home is very well located to get a good impression from Singapore just walking around. She gave good tourist information. I can highly recommend to stay with Elizabeth. Nice talks and every time felt welcomed. Thank you very much Elizabeth !
Mz yee is a very nice person.We arrived at a midnight,though she waiting then.it`s a pity we have no time to chat more, for staying there only three nights

Elizabeth's place was a basic room in a good location for exploring Singapore. Newton MRT station is about a 10 minute walk away, and from there it's easy to get anywhere in the city. Newton Food Centre is about a 5 minute walk away and highly recommended for food. Elizabeth was away on a long trip when we stayed so we didn't benefit from the in-person hosting that has been so positively reviewed, though she was available via AirBnB messaging. It's a small room with basic bathroom and washing machine facilities.

We would recommend that you only stay here if you are familiar with Singapore and are just wanting somewhere convenient for the centre of the city.  The accommodation is very basic and comparable with the sort of room you would find in a hostel.

The most terrible travel experience in my life. The room and whole house are way older than shown on the pics. Dirty and smell in the house, bedroom full of dust from under the bed and behind the blue curtain where owner store all her belonging.
We were not being informed about sharing the house with 3-4 other guests who we never known before and that all 5-6 people had to share only 1 toilet!
Our room could not be locked from outside and imagine we had to share the whole house with other 4 strangers.
Owner was not in the house and we was informed about this obly few days before arrival.
Toilet and shower get dirty since the first day we arrived and yet no one cleaned it. I had to clean the shower to get rid of pile of vomit or something similar before I could take shower on the 3rd night.
The worst part and made us moved out the house at 1 am on the 3rd night (we booked for 5 nights) was that we found so many bedbugs all over the bed!!!
The owner refund us from the 3rd night and appologized. But this is not worth our time and money at all. We were having difficult time finding the hotel at 1 am and didnt get to sleep the rest of the night. The bedbugs are still haunted us since we are afraid they might attach to our belonging and back to our own house.
One of the most difficult bugs to get rid of.
I dont understand how other people have reviewed this place so positive but for me it was nightmare.

Elizabeth was out of the country when I arrived. She had set up a friend to let me in, but unfortunately his cell wasn't working, so I spent some time at the airport til it got worked out. The room was comfortable w/good aircon, which was nice in the hot weather. It is close to the MRT, but does require a walk up stairs to cross an overpass. She let me leave my suitcase the last day & come back for a shower before my evening flight, which was very kind. Overall, it was a good place to stay.

The location of this house is perfect if you are looking for somewhere within a short traveling distance of Orchard Rd.  It was within a few minutes taxi ride from the hotel that my conference was at and a few (3 - 5) minutes walk from an open air Hawkers food court!  The MRT was only about another 1-2 minutes walk from the food court.  Unfortunately I didn't get to see Elizabeth as she was out of town on business.  Maybe next time!

Location of Elizabeth's house was really convenient, Newton Food Court is nearby, just approx. 10 mins walking distance, and the famous Orchard Road is also very close. As most of other visitors (according to their reviews), we also did not meet Elizabeth, which was unexpected. However, she gave us pretty good directions so we found her place easily. From the airport, we had to call her friend who told us where the keys are.

The room was really small and looked nothing like the photos. Obviously, we did not expected 4stars hotel, but the price was not so low and clean room and bathroom would be highly appreciated. The whole house was much older than shown on the pictures.
However, it is a good starting point to explore Singapore.
nice place
nice place

Hello, Elizabeth was extra-accomodating and super communicative to help me get settled even though she was away. The room was indeed a close walk to Newton MRT. Best route was through Newton circle hawker centre, which allowed for some good eats en route :) Room was very comfortable and good value, with great fan and A/C and plenty of power points to plug in, as well as fast wifi.

Yes this was my first Singapore experience. I liked the location close to the Newton food market. and Orchard road was only one stop away. I was really quiet The price was good the place was clean and basic. The aircon worked well. I didn't meet Elizabeth as she was overseas as all the other reviews seem to have stated as well. Its a bit strange having a web cam in the kitchen but I got used to that. Elizabeth sent me some info for the must see attractions. The info was good. I felt I got good value.

It says 5 minutes walk from Newton MRT but actually it's not 5 minutes, maybe 8-10 minutes. From the mrt you will have to walk thru the footbridge then pass by Newton food Centre and another long walk going to Keng Lee Road.
On the other hand, the guest unit itself was some of an disappointment. The restroom isn't what we've expected. The flush from the toilet is like 1960s style or so. It was my first time to see a toilet flush such as that. The room on the other hand has no closet for the guests to use so we have to utilize the room floor for our stuff. Also the room was much cozier in the photo. Thanks to Lightroom and SLR quality images. Overall, the rent was expensive for the below average facilities in the unit. Thumbs down.

Nice stay in this house，but walk to Newtown MRT need 10 or 15
min not 5min

Расположение - самое главное при посещении Сингапура. От метро можно пройти несколькими путями, самый короткий около 5 минут пешком, но нарушая правила дорожного движения. Мы так ходили много раз. Второй путь через фуд корд, очень удобно, возвращаясь из города, можно купить еду в фудкорде и комфортно покушать дома на кухне. Мы просто не привыкли кушать на улице.
В доме есть все необходимое.
Местные жители нам рассказали, что в этом районе живут богатые сингапурцы, все везде красиво. В пешей доступности есть несколько автобусных остановок в разные части города, мы пару раз пользовались автобусами.
Когда я выбирала место проживания, то сравнивала отели по аналогичной цене, они были или дальше от центра, или номера крошечные.
В комнате было места гораздо больше, чем в отеле за аналогичную цену, также можно было посидеть на кухне.
Если кто-то из моих друзей поедет в Сингапур, думаю, буду рекомендовать арендовать эту комнату.

Although the host was not at the premises during my 5-day stay, she was available via Skype or by email if necessary. I was very satisfied with the accommodation since it was near Newton and I was able to easily go back and forth to various parts of the city. I would gladly stay there in the future.

Elizabeth wasn't around during my stay but was very reachable through different communication options. The room was nice, but not as flattering as the picture shows. The location is great and the long-term guests were friendly.

We never got the chance to meet Elizabeth, but she seemed nice. Unfortunately she gave us important information in the very last moment or even when it was already too late. A pity. The room was very nice and clean, the location was perfect. The furniture and sanitary are old, but they were ok for the price we paid.

Staying with Elizabeth was comfortable and convenient for us. Her style as a host is very hands-on, and she prefers to keep in contact with her guests. She was fastidious and attentive throughout, even though she was out of the country during our stay. The house is located in a quiet inner city suburb, and the 7 minute walk to the train station is an easy stroll.

While the house is old and in some places shabby, its fixtures have been well maintained. The room does not have opaque curtains on the windows or an overhead light, but it has some closet space, and is cleaned twice a week. Its door opens to the kitchen, which also borders the toilet and shower, so the living spaces may be too cramped for some. On the whole, the place was clean, comfortable and tastefully decorated.

During our stay, it seems that the washing machine broke down and this issue gave other guests some trouble. We had no such problems - the cleaner soon visited and hand-washed our laundry.
She made me feel welcome..listing was good..neighborhood is very good.
Thank you to Elizabeth, although I never seen her, staying in her place was very good experience for us.

Very nice neighborhood and close to the MRT. The space was of an older style which we found cozy. There is a place to go running just outside the house and both buses and trains are easily accessible. Laundry machine was provided as was water boiler and assorted coffee and tea. The bed in the room was not the same as the one in the picture. It was still comfortable and the same size but it seemed to be older. The room is located further away from the other rooms which makes it more private. Everything worked as expected however such as AC, restroom and so forth. If you are looking for a no frills, good location and fairly cheap place I would recommend this place. It gets the job done without being inconvenient, just be open minded to living in a different environment.
Elizabeth's house ,the style we adore so much. Not very big but exquisite, a little bit old fashioned and elaborately  decorate.  Fell in love at first sight

싱가폴을 여행하기 좋은 위치와 생각보다 더 안락하고, 싱가폴 특유의 주택 구조를 경험할 수 있는 숙소라 좋았습니다. 비용도 줄이고 편안하게 지내다 가네요. 특히 친절한 호스트 덕분에 유쾌했습니다. 한 가지 걸렸던 부분은 집에 방이 세 개이고, 각 방이 따로 에어비엔비에 올라와 있어요~ 옆방에 남자 분이 같이 지냈는데 사전에 남녀가 함께 지내는 구조인지 몰랐어서 좀 놀랬답니다. 전체적으로 너무 만족스러웠습니다.

This place is perfect for someone travelling alone for a few days. The location is great and Elizabeth is very helpful in making sure you know what to see and what to do. The place is clean and well managed, plus very well located. The only thing that I would say I was confused about is that I presumed that I would be sharing the flat with Elizabeth but you are actually sharing the flat with other airbnbers. This isn't necessarily a bad thing but it would have been good to know before hand.

Had a decent and centrally located place to stay while i was there, and more importantly felt like the host personally ensured that I have all that is needed i.e. keys, direction to get there and tourist info.
And that for me was vital in making my decision to stay @ Elizabeth place.

J'ai passé une semaine chez elizabeth. Ma chambre était celle qui se situe près de la cuisine. Très old school, la literie reste confortable. La salle de bain et les toilettes sont vraiment rustiques, j'y ai vu des lezards... Le seul hic fut le bruit et l'irrespect des autres hôtes qui ont utilisé la cuisine sans pour autant la laisser propre juste après. Ma chambre étant près de celle ci, je n'ai pas apprécié les mouches et les odeurs...  Sinon, le quartier est calme et sympathique, il y a le métro, les bus et un hawker center juste à côté. Je n'ai eu des contacts avec Elisabeth que par mail et viber . Pour conclure, je trouve que ce n'est pas forcément un bon rapport qualité prix, étant déjà passée par Singapour en début d'année avec airbnb (cette fois, la chambre n'était malheureusement pas disponible).

Elizabeth is a very nice hostess，she had contacted me many times for confirm the information before I go to SG，and send me some detail -mail about the google map，how to go to the house，the notes....the house is very nice ，and near to the SMRT，also near the food center and shopping mall，like it very much~

Nice apartment, comfortable and clean. Walk from Newton MRT takes more than 5 Minutes. Communication before we arrived in singapore was a bit complicated, we wrote many mails and had to call Elizabeth. As we we're travelling it was not that easy. But Elizabeth was cooperative. Its a nice trip becuse of the convenient place and the nice   homeowner  that no matter what happened u can find her online to ask for help .Thanks for Elizabeth'trust to give the house to us to live .I hope every guest can love this cute house and keep it clean .No chat with Eliza face to face is a pity ，its a nice person that i really want to know

I love here!  Betty is very patient and kindness. always consider the things n the problems we might meet. Even when we leaving she give me two numbers to call taxi in case in big hour. Though that time she was not in Singapore.Thank you betty. next time still stay in ur lovely house.

Second time I live in the house Elizabeth. A silent place for rest after difficult day. The location is great and Elizabeth is very helpful.
The place is clean and well managed

Elizabeth is a helpful host. Even though she is not in Singapore but she is reachable by call and text. Room and apartment is located near to newton food centre and newton station. We had a wonderful experience in this house whose environment and location is really good. It's close to food center and MRT station. And the suggestions and notes given by the host are detailed and useful.
It is very convenient to go to the places of Interest.The room is small but clean,though there is no hairdryer.

Listing description is just accurate. The house is old-styled, yet very clean and neat. the house is cozy and clean, Elizabeth is very helpful, with staying in her room whose position is really convenient, I spent a pleasant time staying in SG.
highly recommend beth's apartment!

Из плюсов - хорошее расположение и недорогая цена для Сингапура. Из минусов - квартира не новая, в таких наверное жили сингапурцы в 80-90е годы. За свою цену и с таким расположением в мою поездку это был самый лучший вариант на airbnb. Хозяйка также хорошая, знает где купить билеты в популярные места со скидкой.

Elizabeth communicated well before our travel dates and she gave us information and recommendations in singapore and instructions. Clean comfortable and good value.  The house is an older property.  The location is a bit difficult to navigate from Newton MRT station. It's actually easier to get to from Novena.

awesome place to live. It looks skeptical a little bit but it is totally fine. Hard to find the place but you will get used to it. Safe and nice area. Host is awesome, super helpful and communicate very well.

Quiet and convenient neighbourhood. Host were helpful and reachable. A very organized place.
Nothing to say
Great host, perfect and quiet location with excellent access to Singapore's public transportation infrastructure. Walking distance to Scott's Road, Hyatt, Ion shopping mall and Orchard Road.
Nice and cozy place, very quiet and convenient, close to the bus stop and walking distance to Newton Circus for meal

Great and friendly host. Very nice and convenient place to stay in Singapore, walking distance to bus station and MRT station. Would strongly recommend this place and looking forward for second time visit.
It is a good place to live in a short time. It's clean and neat the MRT(10min walk) and the bus station. The house only has one bathroom but it's clean. The host is friendly.
Great host, very personable and friendly. Nice location, not far from a lot of attractions in general! I enjoyed my stay.

My family and I spent an unforgettable time at Elizabeth House. This was our first time to go to Singapore. Before we set off, we did not do a lot of travel preparation, but Elizabeth had sent me an e-mail in advance, including the address of the house, the traffic line, the surrounding food recommendation, the shopping guide, etc. and let me add her whatsapp, in order to contact with her easily at any time. Eventually we found her home smoothly.
Elizbeth's house is a two-story building. It's about 10 minutes walk to Newton subway station. The bus is also very convenient around, there are 66 Road, 67 Road, etc. You can take the bus directly to Little India. The surroundings are beautiful, green and very quiet.
Elizabeth specially prepared for us a large room, and provided bed sheets, bath towels, tourist maps and so on. Kitchen, bathroom facilities are complete, you can easily use them. There are two long-term tenants at home, who are foreigners working in Singapore. Everyone can get along very well.
There were two things that made me very touched. Elizabeth and I talked about our trip plan everyday, and gave me some good advice. When she learned that I have not been to the Esplanade, nor to see the landmark attractions in Singapore - Merlion, Elizabeth reminded me to watch the performance and the light show——"time of the wings". Then we went to see it. We were really shocked, what a worthwhile trip!
In addition, because many shopping malls and subways air conditioning temperature is very low, I accidentally got a cold. Elizabeth reminded me to to buy some fisherman's friend tablets in the convenience store , which can relieve my cold symptoms. And she also provided salt water, they were very helpful to my cold, Thank you very much!
Hope to see you next time in Singapore!

Elizabeth's place is central and strategically located. It is within 5-10 mins walk to the popular eatery Newton Circus. The nearest MRT station is Newton, which is just opposite the Newton Circus. It is cozy and homey, located in a quiet neighbourhood. The bed broke on the first night of our stay but Elizabeth got it fixed up. She is very accommodating and provided extra pillows for us. We enjoyed our stay with Elizabeth.
The location is pretty good, it is close to good courts and MRT station. The host made sure you arrive safely. Overall, it is recommended if you going to travel and stay somewhere quite.
Nearby the MRT, very convenient!
The house closes to the MRT and bus station, it's very convenient.

The host is kind and welcoming, can always ask any questions to her. The place is clean and also comfortable to stay. It feels like home. The location is also convenient and near to mrt station. Overall, i had a great stay during my holiday.
Nice room, great location. Highly recommended!

Elizabeth's place is right exactly with her listing description (though, she is too kind to give us another bigger room with balcony in the house).

Nice room with great position. The host is very responsive. She confirmed our schedules before our reach, sent us the pics of gate to make sure we would arrive at the right place and gave useful trip advice.
Great location and a very friendly host.

Great host .... great house ... great room ... clean ... comfy ... warm ... all good ... very good ... very near with bus stop and MRT station ... so you can easy to go to the place that have a lot of fun ... Marina Bay Sands, Marina Garden By The Bay, Orchard, Botanical Garden, Vivo City, etc ...

Excellent experience！
Elizabeth was so helpful and nice. Her place is close to the MRT and a foodmarket. We definitely enjoyed our stay at her place.

Из плюсов. Район тихий, до автобусной остановки минут 5 пешком, до метро около 10 минут. Рядом есть фудкорт, который работает до поздна, цены умеренные, довольно чисто. Элизабет очень общительна, дала рекомендации по местам посещения, всячески пыталась помочь, когда мы ждали потерянный багаж.
Из минусов. Комната на фото выглядит больше. Но это не так страшно, как грязь. Шторы очень грязные и в пятнах, вентилятор страшно включать, тк его не мыли миллион лет, на кухне очень грязная мебель. Комната рядом с туалетом и ванной комнатой, очень хорошо слышно как другие жители моются или ходят в туалет.
정말 아늑한 집이었습니다. 따뜻한 물도 잘 나오고 수압도 세서 머무르는 내내 좋았습니다. 또한 집주인께서 친절하시고 여행자들을 위해 여행 명소, 음식 등을 추천해주셔서 덕분에 좋은 여행할 수 있었습니다!

如果你的旅程是以新加坡核心城区为目标，那么住在这里是不错的选择。（1）交通非常便利，通往滨海湾花园、city hall、来福士、克拉码头、小印度、牛车水（唐人街）等都是极其方便的。 （2）住宿条件基本满足自由行需求，房东提供厨房给客人用，只是没有牙膏和洗浴用品，毛巾浴巾最好用自己带的。床上用品马马虎虎吧，就是那种普通的七孔棉材质。（3）房东比较热情，给客人各种tips。她应该是马来裔或者菲裔，一个人独居，英文语速较快，略有口音。（4）附近有个大食代叫Newton，其实是蛮贵的（与国内比不贵，在新加坡是比较贵），在外面玩的时候就可以把饮食解决掉，非必要情况，不要去Newton吃饭。。。总体是满意的，五颗星推荐。

A pleasant and friendly host who on several occasions went above and beyond the call of duty. Brilliant location for all transportation - buses, MRT and expressways.
Only a few minutes walk from the famous Newton Food Centre, yet nestled along a small side-street so no problems with noise from outside.
If you don't want to be bamboozled by the vast array of shopping malls on offer in Orchard Road, then Novena's 3 shopping malls are only 10 mins walk away and most things you will want can be found there..
Thanks Betty!

Elizerbeth is very nice. And communicate me many times about how to get there and how to check in. And also recommend me many beautiful place. And this place is close to downtown and newton station. You can go everywhere easily. Also close to Newton food center. You can enjoy many many good food.

Great Stay!!! I've stayed in a lot of AirBnBs around the world and the stay with Elizabeth has been one of the best. She is very friendly and likeable and will go out of her way to help you out.
The room is clean and organised and apartment is located at a very convenient location in Newton. Its very close to the bus stop and the MRT station. The newton food court is also a short walk from her place.
We even went out together and she was more than happy to show me the city. Overall it was a great experience to live in Elizabeth's place and see how local Singaporean's live. I would definitely select her place again to stay on my next visit to S'pore.

Great location, 10min walk to Novena shopping mall, 5 min to the Newton food court and MRT station. Elizabeth was quick to respond and helpful in recommending places to go out. Good value for the price, personal items of host are under the bed and around the room. Bathroom was shared with 2 other people.
All in all, we had a great time.
Elizabeth is a very friendly and hospitable host! Her place is also very near to the city center and she has a lot of suggestions to offer if you wanna explore Singapore

the location is very convenient to go to many places. there is a food center nearby with diversifed offers.  Elizabeth is very nice host. she is friendly and kind, she even get up so early before 5:30am just to get a grab for us as we have a very early flight.

very nice and convenient place, I like the architecture of the place, very special style, old traditional English villa. Very quiet place. For the tourist, the place is perfect. Elizabeth is so kind, échange to us very often and tell us so many useful infos:) just the room is little small...:))) anyway, very good experience!

If central location is what you are looking for at an affordable price, this is it. The MRT station is around a 4-5 min walk and the Newton Food Court is right next to the MRT station for any late night grabs. The room was very spacious (which was a pleasant surprise) and came with all the necessary amenities. The bathroom is shared, but I barely saw other guests who stayed over so had no problem with that. Most of all, Elizabeth was very professional and she had a list of recommendations for food, tourist attractions, etc. and provided many suggestions. She personally helped me with many details during my trip. Very grateful for that! Would really recommend if you want an authentic, traditional Singapore experience.

I stayed with Elizabeth for 3 nights and I can't speak highly enough of my experience. From the moment I made the reservation, Elizabeth was extremely helpful with advice on how to travel to her place, local public transport, and taxi info. Her apartment is ideally located a 6 minute walk to Newton food court (where I followed her food tips!), and is also less than 10 minutes from the local MRT. I was in AirBnB temporarily while I looked for a long-term place for myself and Elizabeth offered wonderful advice on what areas might be best suitable for me and my commuting needs. The room itself was spacious, very clean, and well lit. Aircon was excellent (and much needed in Singapore!) and the bed itself was very comfy. I would highly recommend this AirBnB to anyone who is looking for something well-priced and close to the city. A home away from home. 5 star rating!!

Elizabeth is great at communicating making sure everything ran smoothly for check in. We found the house very easily. She provided clear information about the local area and tips on where to go and places to eat. We did not get the opportunity to meet Elizabeth during our stay but she was in regular contact making sure we had everything we needed.
The location is excellent. You only need to cross one road, which has pedestrian lights, to access the Newton MRT. The best part for us was the Newton Hawker/food centre which you walk directly through on your way to the MRT. One of Singapores oldest food centres means you will never go hungry during the day or late into the night. Several times we walked from the MRT and food centre at midnight and always felt safe.
The house is shared with other guests but is quiet and cozy. It's and older style home but well maintained and clean. Great wifi, comfortable bed, good water pressure in the shower. The room was large enough for a couple with small luggage. The bathroom and kitchen are situated right next to this room which means at times you may hear the other guests. There were 2 other guests staying in other rooms but we rarely saw them. Given the great location and wonderful host we would highly recommend staying with Elizabeth

Very personal apartment close to Newton MRT station (less than 10 minutes walking) with food market around and United Square mall also very close to the house. Quiet and safe area. Air conditioning perfect.

Location is the biggest advantage of this place. It is really close to MRT. Although the room was a bit small but Overall worth the price. House was clean, comfortable and cozy. Our check in and check out was a smooth process. The host is very friendly and accommodative. She provided perfect instructions to reach her house and placed a lot of pamphlates on things to do in our room. Would recommend if you are ok with sharing a bathroom and toilet.

Really great place to stay in Singapore. Located near Newton MRT which is close to everything. Room was quite big for Singapore and wifi was good and the house and area was very peaceful. Betty was very detailed in her communication. Actually its very good value for staying in Singapore.

Great location for the price.  In about 10 minutes, you can walk to the nearest Metro subway station which will take you all over the city.  Air conditioning works very well in the bedroom - which is a necessity in such a hot and humid city.  Comfortable nights sleep due to the A/C. stylish place , i am sure if you are a creative person you will love this. it reminded me the place i stay in London, very brits old style. Elizabeth is lovely and she enlighted the whole space. i am sure you will love this.

The place is great, there are multiple rooms rented out in the house so we met a few groups of travellers while staying, and the style of the house does feel like a real home!
This room was lovely, it was cool in the evenings and has a fan and air condition to help too. The bed was SO comfy it was difficult to get up and go!
Elizabeth has a lot of local tips and knowledge and she'll give you a full run down of the quickest and easiest ways of getting about, which helped us alot and saved us LOTS. also she sent us to a travel agent who saved us 1/3 off all of our activities over the week which was amazing (ask her for the Chinatown pricelist it has all the offers). In the room is a basket of brochures for you to flip through!
The location is great in a quiet neighbourhood, and has nearby metro stations and bus stops with lots of route options, you can download an app which helps navigate them easily, but it was so clear we didn't even use it in the end.
It's easiest to get a taxi to the airbnb the first time so you don't stress getting lost (S$10), but if you're feeling confident then the airport does have a metro line that goes nearly all the way there, to little India, and then it's a quick walk to Elizabeths (less that S$2). So up to you!
Anyway great place, great host, great stay, would definitely come back!

Good play to stay within a budget , it is easy to get there through Newton's train station and it has a good hawker center close by.  Elizabeth gives constant and detailed information about the house rules, the location, instructions on how to get there, tips to explore Singapore and she makes sure everything is alright, very kind and attentive.

This place was nice for my stay in Singapore. Very straight forward and comfortable. No frills but the location was unbeatable. I’d definitely recommend and Elizabeth was very communicative and gave great tips.

Excellent location and close to downtown without the added cost. Convenient access to MRT and buses allowed us to visit Singapore’s must see sights without breaking the bank. We even got to taste truly affordable Michelin rated foodie stalls in Chinatown . Thanks Singapore and Betty for the memories. We’ll be back!
Nice lovely n cozy place to stay. We opted for a blue room which was very spacious. House vibes were very nice. The host is also a lovely lady. N very helpful

Betty was a great host. She liked to inform me about the night shows, festivals. I would have missed the night festivals without her! Even though the place were darker than i thought, the location was perfect. I loved the newton food center. Thanks for everything betty!

Elizabeth’s home is a great location and is accessible by grab taxis, the mrt, and buses! Yong Xing was a great host, communication was great and she met us promptly. She went out of her way to make us feel welcome and gave us a massive list of good places to eat. The apartment is in a great location not far from everything and is clean and cosy. Would definitely recommend.

My parents and I had a very comfortable week-long stay at Yong's River Valley condo. The property is exactly as advertised - modern, sparkling clean, compact, yet fully equipped with everything you could need for a short or long stay.
Yong is a perfect host. From the beginning, she was extremely prompt and helpful with her responses, and I have to say, quite patient with my long list of questions!
As soon as I finalised my booking, she messaged me on Whatsapp and was in constant touch to respond instantly to any and all of my queries.
The condo is quite centrally located - bus 32 right outside takes you to Orchard Road and Clarke Quay. Both the property and its host have my highest recommendation!

Yong Xing welcomed us when we arrived and showed us all the neat little workings of the condo. It has everything you will need with plenty of storage.  She even had a special toothbrush and kids towel for our daughter - how thoughtful! The condo is located in a great neighbourhood with 2 bus stops just at the end of the street, about 3 minutes walk. There are restaurants, shopping malls and a grocery store all within 10 minutes walk. She was very welcoming and even bought a few snacks for us! She helped us with all our questions and had lots of recommendations based on our interests. Yong Xing was available easily by WhatsApp for all our questions. She even helped us with our bus passes. The condo was very clean, bright and modern. Thank you for your wonderful hospitality!

The place is fantastic, literally packed with all kinds of goods, every little thing I could think of - it was there - kitchen utensils, stationery, scales, soft drinks, etc. Everything placed thoughtfully at expected places, very neat and comfortable. Compact luxury best describes Yong Xing's place. Ideal for two and OK for three. Everything you need including some very thoughtful touches such as a welcome pack of drinks and snacks and spare toiletries. Sparkling clean and in a handy location with buses close by and the MTR about 15min walk a way. I was in Singapore for a few days work. Yong Xing Wu's apartment was perfect. Good location, great swimming pool, and very well equipped apartment. Little touches like snacks and travel card made the visit so much easier. Would definitely stay here again when back in Singapore

Yong was a very attentive host and great communicator. The apartment has all the essentials you need and us in a great location. We really appreciated Yong taking the time to wait for us to arrive after a slight delay at the airport. No problems at all with this stay.

This is the first time we used airbnb.  It was a very good experience.  The host prepared everything for us including S$10 Bus/MRT card.  The host is very kind she showed up everytime when we had problem.  We enjoyed our stay here.  The location is nice too.  Thank you. Yong Xing!

Very clean. Nice Location. Fantastic Host. Yong Xing's place was spotless. It had everything we needed - cooking utensils, condiments, etc. The place is very accessible - 3 bus stops away from Orchard or 15-20mins walk. Yong Xing is very thoughtful and absolutely delightful to communicate with. She left snacks and drinks for us. She even had ezlink cards that we can use. My family had a wonderful time staying at her place and would definitely recommend to others.

The apartment was as set out in the listing.  Great facility, great location.  The apartment is fully stocked with everything we needed for the week long stay. Yong Xing stayed in contact with us in the days leading up to our arrival and provided plenty of wonderful advice to make our stay as enjoyable as possible.  Highly recommended and will certainly be staying here each time we visit Singapore.  Nice pool to right outside the apartment.

I had the best stay at Yong Xing's apartment. It is clean and very well equipped. I was pleasantly suprised with her very warm welcome. She also gave me suggestions on places to visit. Definitely one of the best holiday we had so far. Will come back another time!

Stayed there for 5nights with my parents. Yong Xing's place is located conveniently near river valley road with direct bus to tourists spots in central area and restaurants/food court.
She's really friendly and has prepared lots of local fruits in the fridge. The place is clean and well furnitured with cooking/laundry equipments
it was so awesome and cozy ;-) we enjoyed staying there a lot! the host is so nice and friendly she prepared many things for us ;-) we really appreciated it! and the location is also good!

Perfect apartment, it has everything you need, plenty of storage, great kitchen area for cooking your own food, bed is comfortable, apartment is modern, spotlessly clean and so well designed.  Its close to Great World City which has a good grocery store, and plenty of places for dinner, if you walk the other way there is supermarket and coffees shops even closer, the buses stop right outside if you wish to get to Orchard (although I found it easy to walk there) and I never waited more than five minutes outside for a taxi.  Would recommend this for short or long stays. Host was always helpful, this was so much better than staying in a hotel.

Staying at Yong Xing's place was a very lovely and cozy experience. Yong Xiong is very responsive on airbnb and Whatsapp throughout the process. She also checked in 1-2 times a day on Whatsapp to make sure that I got everything I needed at the apt as well as got good suggestions to go around in Singapore.
The apt is situated in a very good neighborhood, the cross roads of river valley road and shanghai road. There's a small size shopping mall across the road that has supermarket and restaurants which open until 10pm or later. The condo itself is very new. Facilities are all decent and convenient. There's a swimming pool right outside of the balcony, which my daughter and I almost used daily. My daughter enjoyed it so much.
The apt is spotless clean, bed is comfortable, and has good facilities in the kitchen including a washing machine. In addition, Yong Xing is so thoughtful that she prepares not only water, snacks in the apt before our arrival, she also checked in with me and prepared a bathroom stool, kid's bath towel and kids utensils for my daughter. These friendly details went a long way during our stay. During our five days stay, her helper, Yuuli, also came over for one housekeeping which included the change of beddings and towels.
Also Yong Xing will prepare a Singapore transportation card for MRT. I only used it once, but I appreciate the hospitality.
All in all, Yong Xiong is a very friendly and thoughtful host, and her apt is nice, convenient and has everything that needs for a group of 2 or a small family to have a nice stay.
Thanks for hosting us, Yong Xing!
Excellent stay, very easy communications and all the arrangements. Flat is exactly as described, clean, well organized. Overall, highly recommended.

We enjoyed staying at Yong Xing's place so much. We stay there with two kids . The apartment is clean and located very near to the city (only $5 to orchard area by cab and 3 stops by bus) We arrived at the apartment earlier than the check in time, but Yong xing and her helper Yuuli let us to put our bags, so we can go out for lunch.
And Yong Xing is also very helful, thanks for helping us with the admission tickets and the cab to airport on the last day, and for the welcome snacks too.

Great apartment when visiting Singapore. Easy to find, centrally located and well designed apartment.. with pool! Young is very helpful to make you feel at home and find your way around Singapore. I will come back there when I will be visiting Singapore again.

This is a great find. A modern, newly built, very clean and cosy small apartment, meeting every possible requirement that travelers may have. The host is a very helpful and generous person. Though we could not meet him in person, we were always well connected with him through social networking.
I would very strongly recommend this place.

This was my first ever Airbnb booking, and I have to say that it set the bar pretty high! I stayed here with 2 girlfriends during the 2015 F1 Night Race weekend. The flat is spotless-clean, contemporary and stylish. Every square inch is optimally-designed and the amount of storage space is astounding! As an architect/designer, I tend to notice and appreciate these sort of aspects. It is also equipped with pretty much everything you'd want in a basic, but efficient flat: stove, microwave oven, fridge, electric kettle, toaster, coffeemaker, utensils, washer & dryer, iron + board, cleaning materials, flatscreen smart TV and lightning fast internet connection, among many others. Bonus: the balcony overlooks the swimming pool and you'll have access to the gym as well! The location is pretty central, it is near several bus stops, shopping centres, groceries and restaurants. If you're in the mood, you can even walk to Orchard Road from there. It is nestled in a nice, quiet neighborhood, a slice of heaven in the hustle and bustle of Singapore. However, the best part about this flat is the host, Yong Xing! Her experience in the hospitality business truly shows in the way she deals with guests: Even prior to booking, she answered all of my queries nicely and promptly. We were in constant communication via Viber a few days before our arrival and she allowed me to check-in early with the assistance of her housekeeper Yuuli, who showed me all the ins & outs of the flat. Snacks, drinks, & basic toiletries were all provided as well as maps and pre-loaded EZ Link cards. Yong Xing also checked up on us daily via Viber to see if we need anything or if we have any queries. For our last day, she allowed us to leave our luggages in the flat and have a super late checkout so we can do some last-minute shopping, aside from offering to book us a taxi for the airport! We weren't able to meet her in person, but we're truly appreciative of her thoughtfulness and generosity. If you can't already tell, I (as well as my friends) have completely fallen in love with this Airbnb experience and we highly recommend this place to everyone who wants to visit Singapore! :)

This was our very first stay using Airbnb and I very much hope the rest can live up the wonderful standards set by Yong Xing's beautiful Singapore apartment!

From the initial excellent communications, the very clear directions from the airport right through to the very warm and friendly welcome we received from Yong Xing in person (always so nice in an unfamiliar part of the world!), every part of our stay was fantastic. The apartment is very tastefully furnished and has all the conveniences you could need or think of, including an ingenious rotating TV and possibly the most comfortable bed we have ever slept in! We also loved the welcome pack of snacks and cold drinks (perfect on such a warm day!) and the swimming pool right outside the apartment was a godsend after a warm day's sightseeing.

The high standard of the apartment really made our stay in Singapore perfect. We have a friend visiting Singapore later this year and have already recommended that they stay here! Thank you again.

Absolutely fantastic!! Had everything sorted for the two boys sleep wise and had a few goodies there waiting for us!
Helpful with getting us a taxi ride to the airport and being there when we arrived!
Would stay again!
Loved the pool too!

My parents stayed at Yong Xing place when they came to visit me in Singapore. The apartment is very comfortable and convenient. Yong Xing was very nice and available for any questions we could have. Thanks to all this, they loved their stay in Singapore !

Yong Xin Wu was a fantastic hostess for our very first time using airbnb, as well as our very first time travelling as a family (11 month old in toe). Yong was very approachable (any day or night), and was always on hand to help us out. We look forward to staying here again on our next trip to Singapore!
Everything was perfect great host and fully equipped apartment

Yong Xing is very responsive, his place is spotless clean and well stocked up, out of my expectation on top of the 2 access card, he also gave 2 preloaded mrt (transport) card. The fridge is stocked w water, and other sampler beverages, he also provided instant coffee, tea bags and crackers.

Yong really made us feel welcome, explaining every single detail from airport to place, and even giving us tips what to visit in Singapore. When I get back to Singapore I would definitely book this place again.

Great apartment in good location. Perfect for couples or families with a toddler, like us. Has everything one needs. We definitely will stay next time there and strongly recommended this place.

Highly recommend! It was a breeze to check in as Yong Xing's helper was there to let us in and give us keys (along with bus and mrt cards). The place was clean and the neighborhood was very walkable with a mall very close by and only about a 15-20 min walk to orchard. We were close to everything we needed for our stay and the place was also stocked with some supplies on arrival which was very thoughtful and helpful. Yong Xing was a great host with very fast communication and we were sent all the details for our arrival a few days before. We brought our 2 year old daughter who loved the place and especially the pool as well. We'd definitely stay there again.

The house is clean and comfortable with almost complete of home/kitchen appliance. It's a great location with a bus stop just around the corner and shops within a five minute walk so everything is at your door step. Taxi is always available
The pool is such a bonus, so nice to cool down on a hot day

The apartment was very nice and cozy, there was all the necessary equipment, even toys for kid and cards for buses and mrt. There is a bus stop 2 minutes walk from condo, supermarket, cafes. 房子小巧别致，外面可以游泳，房间的设施很全，很周到贴心，主人很热情。房子外面就有公交车站，去乌节路非常方便，过马路到对面有大世界商场，有很多吃的，还是很方便。只是外面马路上的车流还是有点躁音，沙发床太软了点，其他都很好，住了3晚，感觉还很不错。谢谢Yong Xing！

Yong Xing is a thoughtful and patient host. She arranged everything ready before our arrival and departure. bus stop just outside the apartment block

Also thank you for the personable touch, mandarins, red packets, helpful suggestions and everything :)

Thank you! From Alex, Jo and Sam Cutler

I loved Yong Xing as a host, despite all the trouble and carelessness I imposed, she was patient and always prompt to help. Meticulous host *thumbs upppppp*
very nice and clean , quiet environment .. .. .. good and helpful in every Intermet rent by owner

One reason we stayed with Yong Xing: the many 5-star comments.

Yong Xing is a very welcoming host. She was very helpful with everything and gave us a lot of advice for Singapore. The apartment is very clean and there's everything you need from toothbrush to even snacks and cold beer in the fridge. The pool is a nice extra too.
We really enjoyed staying there and would recommend this place to everyone. Thanks Yong Xing!

We stayed in Yong Xings apartment for 11 days while in Singapore for a combination of work and holiday. We truly enjoyed the apartment and the surrounding area. Yong Xing was a fabulous host, she really made me feel at home, gave me bunch of advices, her answers were always swift and she even welcomed me with a small present !
Her place was very clean, well located, I warmly recommend.
If I have the chance I will definitely come back next time I'll go to Singapore !

The stay was amazing and the best amongst all the places I have stayed through AirBnB. Yong Xing is an amazing host who not only provides for on what is promised but goes out her comfort zone every time to make sure that guests are comfortable. The bus stop is literally outside the apartment complex with Orchard Rd a 5 min drive.
More than anything else, she is a nice human being. The only unfortunate part...couldn't meet her personally to say my Thank You!

Cheers,
Sriram
YX did everything she could for us. A great welcome package, lovely service! No problems!
Listing is accurate. The host is responsive, got back to me in a few minutes each time I had question.

Super awesome place. Location is good: Bus stop to orchard rd is just outside. Famous yummy food area is just opposite the house. The apartment unit is small but super cosy. Thanks for being an awesome host Yong Xing!
It was a perfect place to stay with everything taken care of by Yong Xing. Will recommend this place to anyone.

Yong Xing's very accommodating service was at par with the concierge service in a five star hotel. Yong's educational and work background in the hotel industry shows in every email and speedy action to requests.

Apartment is very clean and although around 10minutes away from Orchard, buses will take you to and from there and other locations like Marina Bay by bus. Taking the bus is just as easy and convenient with the bus stop is right in front of the apartment and the SG bus system being as efficient as it is.

You get the service of a give star and the warmth and homey feel of an AirBnb rental when you book with Yong. You get the best of both worlds!

We stayed here with family and we could find it most convenient.

The pool in the apartment is good and kids enjoyed a lot.

I would highly recommend this place.

YX is an Amazing Host. Apartment is top-notch, clean functional and absolutely beautiful with so many nice little touches like train passes, recommendations and drinks and snacks. Yong Xing a été très réactive à ma demande de disponibilité et a immédiatement pris contact avec moi pour préciser les conditions d'accès à l'appartement et proposer son aide pour organiser notre séjour à Singapour.

When we arrived, the housekeeper already inside waiting for us. Everything as detailed from her description.

Host is very hospitable and friendly, accommodation is very nice! Very good overall stay!

Yong Xing was friendly and easy to communicate with. Access instructions were clear and her apartment although compact was neat, clean and well equipped. Location was pretty central to many places of attraction. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
