Yong Xing was lovely, as was the apartment. Has everything you need. would stay here again.

The place was amazing. Very clean and convenient. YX was a great host. Fast response and very accommodating as she allowed us to check in late and also check out late due to our flights. It was very easy to take public transport and the taxi drivers know where the Condo is as it is in a well known area, River Valley. The apartment is big enough for 3 people and the pool is a plus. Would definitely stay here again and reccommend it to everyone who stays in Singapore

The place was exactly what it said! It is in a very convenient location, only a few bus stops away from Orchard and even less than 10 minutes walk to Great World City. 地理位置不错，附近有超市、便利店和餐馆。房间设施很新，很好用，各种生活用品齐全。房东超级nice，而且细心，所有你想到的想不到的她都会帮你准备妥当。

The best host I've have the pleasure to meet. The acc was clean and in a great location. Yong Xing is a wonderful host with a wonderful apartment. Very comfortable. Very conveniently located. YX was very helpful in answering all our queries. I will definitely recommend it to everyone looking for a comfortable stay in Singapore. :)
Yong xi is an awesome host. She's very accommodating and super helpful. Her place is clean and has everything you will need. Will definitely come back to her place
The apartment is great, very close to city centre. YX is a great host as she had instant feedbacks to all of my question. Perfect for couple or 3 persons
We don't have anything to complain about. We were surprised about all the small things our host prepared for us. We just can say thank you VERY much!
Great! Very satisfied!

I was very happy staying at Yong's place. It is very cosy but modern unit that is equiped with evrything you need for your stay. If you do care about the clean enviroment and comfortable bed Yong Xing's apartment is absolutely the right choice. My family enjoy a quiet and cozy night here. I'm appreciated Yong Xing 's quick reponse. Thx.

The bnb has pretty much everything a traveller would need. I'm amazed that it even has a baby potty seat available. The location is convenient because of public transport, supermarket and food close by.

Nice and very convinience stay in yong xing's unit really satisfied me

One of the best air bnb hosts
Yong Xing is a great host with patience and kindly guidance. The home feeling house is quiet, clean and easy traffic.

房东人很好，入住之前没有任何沟通障碍。家里东西很齐全，房东特意买了糕点欢迎我们，很好吃。家附近交通便利；离乌节路很近；满足生活基本购物需求；斜对面有几家吃饭的：文东记的鸡很赞，比天天好吃。家里设施齐全。阳台外面就是游泳池。

The condo is perfect size and it is close to a bus stop. Also there is a famous hainan chicken restaurant nearby. Yong Xing is a very nice host. 第三次来新加坡，第一次选择Airbnb.男朋友之前一直反对，质疑我为什么不选择之前住的Park Hotel或者圣淘沙的Hardrock Hotel!但事实证明我这次选择是很正确的，从泳欣和他的先生来地铁站接我带上了小点心和水果就开始了我的完美旅行，每天早上都会询问我睡眠质量并且告诉我一些旅行的Tips.当之无愧最赞房东！我比较挑剔床，所以我旅行朋友最大的问题就是我特别入眠，但是这次5晚几乎每天都睡到自然醒，我觉得这套新加坡本土牌子的床上用品真的很舒服很亲肤！沐浴乳是Spa功能的，味道很特别，很舒适！厨房柜子打开所有设备一应俱全！虽然我不游泳，但是拉开窗帘看到清澈的泳池，心情很好！公车线路也很方便！总之这次的行程选择住这里没有任何可以挑剔的！完美！

This is a great place to stay in Singapore. It is quite and clean, and provides all the amenities you need for a good stay. Yong Xing was a great host; very quick in communication and very responsive. I would definitely stay here again!

Host responds very promptly and supported in a "out of norm" request. Much appreciated!

Very clean and close proximity to amenities-within 5-10mins walking distance supermarkets/ bistros/ clinics/cinemas . Secure location.

The best airbnb I ever stayed in. The place is superb. Very clean, you can walk to Orchard road , the bust stops are just outside the building and you can reach to every attractions from them. Yong is an excellent host helping us every time we needed informations. Five star service, better than I ever expected. I would highly recommend to everyone to stay here.
Very good experience, strongly recommend

I would definitely recommend this host and apartment.

5 stars! The host is very helpful and assists us whenever we have any questions. Couldn't find a better host than Yong! 100% recommendable.

The apartment is small but perfectly formed! It's in a good location near to plenty of places to eat and shop. The river is also just a few minutes away. Yong Xing is the perfect host. 泳欣非常热情好客，房间设施一应俱全。还准备了许多小零食还有饮料让我们非常惊喜。难得的是她还给入住的客人在入住期间准备了冲好值的交通卡。真的非常贴心。外面的游泳池干净人也少...下次再去新加坡还是愿意住在这里。
I have anything I need to make my baby calm and feel comfort like our home. very recommend place to stay..

I haven't read all the reviews and accolades that that Yong Xing has received, but I have noticed that she has a 5 star rating in all categories. I willingly support the ratings. She had assured me, after on an exchange of messages, that she would have food items for our breakfast and god bless her heart the food was there. There's a good selection of tourist brochures there as well. We were given keys, transport cards and a local sim so we could be in contact with Yong Xing if the need arose. It was only our first full day there when we found we had a real problem. The effort Yong Xing and her husband put in to help us try and sort the problem was just unbelievable. All this on a significant day for the family. We needed he help in a big way again on our very last day. Again Yong Xing came to the fore with flying colours. I may have deviated a bit from the review guidelines but to me it is most important for new visitors to have a host of the calibre of Yong Xing. The apartment itself was perfect for a holiday in Singapore. For two of us it had room enough, was well equipped, very clean and extremely well located. We travelled a lot on Uber and the condo block must be reasonably well known as the drivers mostly found their way there. On closing, I would like to thank Yong Xing for being such a wonderful person and an exemplary host.

Yong Xing took us on an electric scooter trip to gardens by the bay which was awesome. She is a perfect host. We miss our little home away from home. Thanks!
Friendly and responsive host. Nice stay!

Great accommodation in fantastic location. Very clean and organised. Highly reccommend.

3) will suggest Yong Xing to stock a few non-asian snacks too😀, especially if you are tired to go out on the day you land..

This was my first trip to Singapore, and my flight arrived an hour late, so I didn't arrive at the Chee home until about 11pm. Even so, Jerome and his mother were awake to greet this weary traveler from Beijing. This warm and gracious hospitality would repeat itself in various ways over the next few days, including introducing me my last evening there to the local eatery, Chomp Chomp. This hospitality came from not only Jerome and his mother, but the father and four daughters. They are a delightful, interesting family, possessing a truly generous and gracious spirit.

I should add that the house, in the district known as Serangoon Gardens, is very attractive and accessible to various bus routes (though a 20-minute walk to the nearest MRT station), and therefore it is easy to get to most anyplace in Singapore from this location. I wish I had had more time to sit out on their front deck. They do own a frolicsome cat, one with a real personality. I happened to like this. The bedroom is comfortable, and the private bathroom has more space than any one traveler would need.

Finally, as someone who enjoys traveling and meeting others, staying with a family is infinitely more interesting than staying at an inn. Through the eyes of the family I was able to learn more about Singapore itself, especially in the area of education; however, one night the father, an engineer, gave my a map tour of the island's developments.

I highly recommend what the Chee family has to offer. Indeed, I hope to return for a visit with them over the coming months.

He and his mother, Margaret, were always helpful and knowledgeable whenever I had questions about places that I wanted to visit.

Also, there's a bus stop nearby the house (took about 5-minutes walk) to wait for buses that take you to the MRT station, so transportation was pretty easy. Just make sure you bring an umbrella cuz it sometimes rains at random times in Singapore... If you want to get a taxi, Jerome has this cool app on his phone that lets you book one online.

On my last night, it was Chinese New Year's eve, and the Chee family kindly invited me and one other housemate to celebrate and have dinner together. It was a nice gathering and definitely one of the highlights of my stay in Singapore.

All in all it was a pleasant stay and I would definitely check with them first if I return to the city in the future.

If you want  affordable, and true value-for-money accommodation in Singapore, that is certainly it! Jerome and his family were so nice to provide me with a room in their flat for two weeks. In my first evening with them, they invited me to their dinner to celebrate the Chinese New Year! This is one thing that you cannot find if you stay in a hotel room :) Before my departure, they invited me to go out to try some local food, so this is how I met the sugarcane drink, splendid! :) It was very nice to know them, their culture and the places around the city.

It was my first experience with airbnb and I must say it couldnt be better. Jerome and the whole family hosted me just perfect. You can ask any question and get everytime a helpful answer. Whit that lovely atmosphere I felt like at home. This place will be highly recommended and the Chee-family have a place in my heart forever!

Jerome and his family were lovely they helped me so much. It was my first time using airbnb and my first time to Singapore and they helped make it much easier for me, I would defiantly recommend them to anyone wanting to visit Singapore! They have a beautiful house located in a quiet street but near lots of eateries so lots of choice for local food tasting :) Although I had friends in Singapore who helped me around, I feel had I needed more advice or help I could defiantly asked Jerome or his family. As a single, female traveller i felt safe and secure staying here, glad i chose over a hotel. Can't wait to visit Singapore again! Absolutely loved my three weeks!

We really enjoyed our stay in Singapore thanks to Jerome and his family. They are really nice people and helped us with everything we needed – even with our short trip to Kuala Lumpur.

The room was clean, air-conditioned, so we had no issues. You can really experience the Singaporean lifestyle even when you are tired and don't want to go too far.

Getting there is relatively easy, affordable and doesn't take too much time, all thanks to how great the public transport in Singapore is. There is really nothing to worry about!

I and the host Jerome became very good friend. he was really welcome that i stayed their house.
i spend really good time their because he and his family are super peaceful and respectful.
i stayed their house just one night but we met the other day and talked a lot about each countries or what we do.

Jerome and his family were wonderful hosts and should win the 'friendliest family in Singapore' award. We enjoyed talking to them and getting tips on places to go since it was our first time in Singapore. They even let us borrow a good umbrella when it was raining! The location is great because it is near 2 great hawker centers and a bus stop that goes to MRT (total time to get downtown with bus and MRT was about 45 minutes). Also, if you have the time, Jerome and his mother are more than willing to grab a bite with you- we went out with them twice. We enjoyed our time here an recommend it to anyone who wants an experience that is more homey than a hotel.
Jerome and his family are all very friendly and helpful and the room was quite nice.

I stayed with Jerome and his family in May, as a solo woman traveller
I was made very welcome and felt very safe. It was easy to access
public transport night and day. nearby shopping centre was great for eating. Iwould recomend this home stay
thanks Jerome Leigh

I had a great time at Jerome's place. It was a real 'home stay' experience. All family members were kind, considerate and helpful. Twice they invited me to have dinner with the family and once even had a dish cooked to my specifications. These were the best highlights of my stay with the Chee family.

In Singapore, if you are looking for an excellent home stay, that is both affordable and rewarding, I recommend Jerome's family home as the best.

PS. The cat is very cute.

Very spacious room/ house Jerome is staying. Nice ambiance and super easy-to-find location - although not located directly from MRT but still easy to reach by bus. Jerome's parents and maid are very helpful and nice. Havent had a chance to meet Jerome in person but had been helpful via whatsapp communications!

Well the reviews are not wrong! Jerome and his family are very welcoming and the location was ideal for me. Although I had a full-on visit this time and did not have as much time to meet the family as other reviewers had, I am sure I will get the opportunity to do so on my next visit as I would certainly book up at Jerome's again.

Jerome and his family was kind and considerate. They welcomed us and made us feel comfortable. Jerome's mother helped us to buy some souvenir and treated us breakfast at hawker center. Jerome and his father recommended us tourist spots kindly. The room was cool and clean. I recommend you to stay at Jerome's house, if you want to experience Singaporean's happy family. thanks.

I was on a short trip to singapore and had not so much time to experience the city, but Jerome and his family made me a warm welcome and they are very nice persons at all.
I am sure, that we will meet us again (maybe in Berlin) and i can recommend everybody to stay at this host.

I had a great stay at Jerome's house. Very convenient location, comfortable room and bathroom.

The house can be noisy sometimes, specially if you are a light sleeper but nothing some good ear plugs can't fix.

The family is very nice, will go with you for lunch/breakfast and always in good will to help.

Overall, happy with the experience.

Thanks to the Chee family !

I was very gratefull to Jerome and Margret for managing my request last minute. It was easy to meet at the bus interchange. The Serangoon area is defenetly a good place to stay in Singapore. Make sure you try the nearby hawker stall. I was very happy to share two family events with them. And when I left I even got a lift to a mrt station, close to woodlands. I can certainly recomand to stay at this place.

My stay with Jerome and his family was great.  Everyone was so welcoming and it made me feel like I was not even a stranger.  The last night my friend and I were invited to join the Chee family and their friends for some Singaporean dessert!  The room was what I needed.  The best part of it was the firm bed which allowed me to fall asleep almost instantly after a day out in the city.  The house is located in a residential suburban like neigborhood away from the busy city center.  The bus stop is very close by.  The bus and MRT system was efficient and easy to use.  Thank you for sharing your space with travelers of the world!

Set in a tranquil neighbourhood, Jerome's house offers a very homely and warm feel for any of his guests. In addition, his house is very clean, one attribute which i really like and have failed to see in many other airbnb places. On top of that, Jerome and his family have been amazing hosts who not only meet your every needs but also go the extra mile to know their guests. I highly recommend this place for anyone who wish to have an amazing first visit to Singapore or for those who have not tried it yet!

Ben and I had the pleasure of living with Jerome and his family during our 3 weeks stay in Singapore. Clean and comfortable, Jerome's place is located a stone throw away from one of Singapore's best food center (Chomp Chomp) with plenty of shops nearby to cater to your every need.
Jerome and his family (Siti, their housekeeper included) were extremely helpful and hospitable and I would definitely recommend them to fellow airbnb users.

An unforgetable experience for my first time in Asia.
All the family is ready to help you and share their smiles with you.

The room is correct, with a large bathroom.
Serangoon Garden neighborhood is really nice, quiet qnd beautiful.

Jerome is the man for the job!

It could be a pleasure to see you again.

Manuel, a french guy.
Very much enjoyed my stay at Jerome's! He and his family were very hospitable and nice to spend time with.

A big plus is the prime location in a private home just in the second land from Serangoon garden. Another plus is the private bathroom.
The position of the room next to the kitchen (without a proper wall in between) makes the room a bit noisy (if you have a light sleep), as there is activity starting as early as 6 AM.
It's really nice that stayed at Jerome's house, big toilet comfort room and really kind of this family.

Staying with the Chee family is like staying with old friends. They are welcoming and very relaxed. They have rich and active lives. Good conversations and a lovely place to stay. The other reviews read well and recognised the comments. In addition to chomp chomp as a fabulous place to eat I found Serangoon Gardens Market. Fascinating. I made friends there and loved the mix and variety of local food.
All highly recommended.

I actually didn't stay in the room too much as I had such good sleep there I had lots of energy to go out and enjoy Singapore life morning till night!!! The Chees are great and laidback. It's relaxing to live in their house and they like talking to foreigners. I will be back, hopefully for much longer ;)

I really had a good time in Jerome's house with his family. The bedroom and bathroom's condition were clean and well organized. Jerome's family were considerate and friendly. Jerome's sisger brought us to dinner which was very good. I would like to stay this place again if I go to Singapore again.
굉장히 가족분들이 친절하시고 단순히 호스트와 게스트의 관계보다 많은 것을 교류할 수 있습니다. 방도 넓고 깨끗하고요, 화장실이 딸려있는데 화장실 상태는 거의 욕조가 없는 호텔 화장실 급이라고 보시면 됩니다. 지하철 역까지 버스를 타고 가야 하는 불편함이 있다면 좀 있겠지만 그것 빼고는 정말 좋았어요! 저녁도 얻어먹으면서 한국에 대한 이야기도 나눴어요. 여자아이? 소녀? 중 하나가 한국 드라마랑 아이돌을 굉장히 좋아해서 한국에 대한 좋은 이미지를 가지고 있고요! 가족 구성원 모두가 영어를 쓰기 때문에 사실상 생존영어만 하실 수 있다면 살아가는 데에 불편함도 없습니다! 게스트하우스 묵었다가 너무 상태가 안 좋아서 옮긴건데 처음부터 여기 묵었으면 얼마나 좋았을까 싶어요ㅠㅠ! 완전 추천드려요!! 게스트하우스보다는 약간 가격이 있지만 전혀 아깝지 않을 거에요!!

Positives:
1. The people. Jerome and his family were very welcoming and made us feel right at home. They even let us borrow an umbrella because we didn't prepare for the rain.
2. Food. It's next to the famous Chomp Chomp food center, which is an outdoor area with many tables (which are usually full during dinner and you will have to fight for your own table) and many restaurants that deliver right to your table. You can try grilled sting ray + many other sea food. Try the "sour soup" fruity cold drink, which isn't very sour but definitely refreshing.
3. Bathroom is huge, with plenty of space next to the sink to place makeup and other items.

Negatives:
1. Small bedroom. The bathroom is large but the bedroom is tiny. We (party of 2) opened two or our regular size luggages next to the bed and we had no space left to walk around.
2. Location. Yes, there is a bus that takes you to the MRT, but it's an extra layer of inconvenience. Of the 45 minutes we needed to go to Chinatown from the house, 25 minutes were spent on the bus or waiting for the bus. During busy time, the bus got stuck in the traffic because the streets are small. The delay added another 20 minutes or so.

Jerome and his family were great to stay with! I just moved to Singapore and they helped me acclimate to the neighborhoods while I was looking for a more permanent place. Thanks for all the help Jerome!

Me n my wife's experience was excellent at Jerome's house. Being first time travelers to Singapore, Jerome n his family members were highly supportive n helpful. We were warmly welcomed and his sister helped us wid our luggage as well. It was a great experience being with them for 5 days.
Jerome responded quite fast to our message as compared to other people n I strongly recommend the place as the ideal stay option due to the family which makes you feel at home. We interacted really well with Jerome's mother, sister n dad. In short, it was really good to be with such people in Singapore.

房東先生很年輕是位和善活潑的男孩

重點是離地鉄站很近很方便到市区
下次去新加坡一定会再入住的:)

Hi Jerome
Thanks very much for the warm and kind hospitality during my stay. Your family especially the gorgeous girls ,they are lovely and have been very helpful. Enjoy chit chat with them, you and your wonderful parents.

All the best to one and all.

Cheers
Patricia

No problems finding the place, Jerome quick to respond and I got many good tips from him and his lovely family.
The room is as described, with lovely A\C and private bathroom.
It's an easy bus ride to get to the Singapore metro, the chomp-chomp hawker food centre is definitely worth more than one visit, surroundings full of cozy bars and restaurants.

Would stay again!

Jerome and his family made me very welcome. The room was as described and served my purposes well.  The neighborhood is pleasantly suburban with bus connections and many shops and eateries just two blocks away, including one of the very best hawker centers in Singapore.

Thank you Jerome for everything in Singapore.

Everything was clean and the family was very awesome and very friendly!!

I spend two wonderful week in Jerome's room. The room is spacious with it's own bathroom ! It is very clean.

Jerome is a very nice guy, curious and talkative. I deeply recommend this room in the Chee's family !
Love the place. A bus ride away from serangoon MRT.

The room looks exactly like on the pictures. The AC works well so sleeping even in this heat is no problem. I had the chance to get my laundry for an extra charge done and got it always on the same day back. The family is very friendly and we had interesting conversations about Singapurian life and habits. It was a nice experience to get to know the family and I can recommend the stay with them. Thanks for helping me when I had questions and made my stay this comfortable.
Its a nice ambiance to stay it feels like home;)
My parents had a very welcomed stay at Jerome's place, his mum and dad are super nice people.
Jerome and his family were very nice and friendly during my stay, they even invite me for dinner, really had a good experience and value for money

This was my third time staying with Jerome and his family.  They have always made me feel very welcome and now that I've gotten to know them better, they make me feel like a part of the family when I'm there; we often have meals together and interesting long discussions.  Jerome is a fountain of knowledge about really good places to eat (this is very important to me when I travel!) and things to see that are off the beaten path.  The room is very comfortable, with an ensuite bathroom.  If you're looking to experience everyday life in Singapore, the location couldn't be better.  There are two great food courts within walking distance (2-3 minutes walk away) as well as a bus interchange where you can connect to the MRT which will take you into town.  The neighborhood is quiet (although quite busy on the weekends) and this being Singapore, very safe.  If you're looking to complement your trip to Singapore with a really rich experience, this is the place to stay.
Great cosy host and nice room with ensuite bathroom! :)
Great host and ambience!
Its always nice to be back ;)
Loved my stay. Joelle was nice and helped me settle in. The house is beautiful and safe. Very convenient location, a nearby bus to get anywhere. Will definitely stay again :)

This was my fourth stay with Jerome and his family. If that isn't a glowing recommendation, I don't know what is!  If you're looking for a place off the beaten path, for more of an experience than a location, then this is perfect. You'll really get a sense of what life is like in Singapore and the Chee family are awesome hosts. Very close to public transportation, easily accessible and two great food centers within a 3 minute walk!  Highly recommended!

Jerome and his family are super nice and happy to get you acquainted with Singapore. The room and bathroom were very clean. At least in my experience, rarely do you actually get to interact a lot with the AirBnB hosts, and so I was really excited to learn so much from them.
You'll really enjoy your stay!
Jerome was very responsive to all my messages. The room was very clean & have a big toilet. Everything written in his page are all accurate. My entire stay was all perfect.
Jerome was very helpful and the host family was very nice. Lots of good possibilities to eat nearby. Very lovely neighborhood. I would come again.

The host was really friendly to talk to me. They accepted me to put my big baggage in the living room after I checked out the room until 3pm!
The were also extremely polite, honest and friendly!
The house was quiet. There were small shopping mall, restaurant and ATM located!
Why don't you grab the room?

Staying at Jerome's was a mind-blowing experience that I wouldn't trade for anything. 'A traveler' commonly does things that many others can do, but I was 'the traveler' who was lucky enough to stay at Jerome's. This difference made my 7 days in Singapore special. Be the traveler to choose an unforgettable experience in Singapore by staying with Jerome's family!
For someone who visits Singapore for the first time, Jerome's family was more than helpful. I enjoyed my stay and I'll recommend it to anyone.

My time at Jerome's place was nothing short of amazing. Him and his family were absolute gems and to stay with. The room was exactly as described, extremely spacious, clean and had all the amenities one would need. The home was also right next to a plethora of food options, supermarkets and a bus stop with buses taking you right to the MRT. While the room itself was fantastic, the highlight of the stay would have to be the hosts.
I had the pleasure of going out with Jerome a couple of times and got to learn a bit more about himself and of course Singapore. His mom and dad were also fantastic with reccomendations on places to visit and things to see. They did a great job of welcoming me and it felt as if I got to experience being part of their family. If you are planning to visit Singapore, look no further as you will not be disappointed staying with Jerome. Many thanks for the wonderful stay!
Lovely place with awesome family, greatly enjoyed my stay there even though I was out most of the time visiting. I now know where to go for my next trip in Singapore!
Excellent access to food , banks, post office and transportation. Very relaxed ambience.

It was really wonderful experience to live in Jerome's house. I especially liked the family; they were kind, helpful and generous with their time. Also, the place I stayed was quite nice as there were LOTS of place to eat nearby the house. I would recommend to anyone who visits Singapore to try Jerome's house.

Ample sized room w/ large bathroom.   Good amount of common space including a big patio.   Everyone in the family was super kind, informed and helpful.  It does takes a 10min bus ride to the nearest MRT stop but I loved neighborhood.   There's a ridiculous amount of good food around--like 3 food centers and bunch of restaurants.  The hosts went out with me one morning to help me pick out the good stuff to try.  I would definitely stay here again.

Jerome's mum and dad were extremely friendly and warm-hearted. Price of this room was definitely worthwhile, having a toilet to yourself. Aircon was working well too. Location is close to all of Singapore's heartland hawker food. You won't have trouble finding food even in the earthly hours (supper at RK house, having prata - indian food any time in the night). Very underrated and affordable overall.
It’s a very quiet place, very clean and comfortable. Jerome is a warm guy. I will choose to stay again if I visit Singapore! 这是一个非常棒的民宿，很安静很干净很舒服。Jerome主人非常的友好，他的家人也非常的nice，感谢他们，我拥有了一个美好的时光。

Ich kann das Zimmer nur empfehlen. Ich wurde sehr freundlich von der netten Familie aufgenommen. Das Zimmer liegt ca. 3 Gehminuten von der nächsten Bushaltestelle entfernt, von wo aus man gut zur nächsten U-bahn fahren kann, um in die Stadt zu gelangen. In unmittelbarer Umgebung gibt es mehrere Essensmöglichkeiten.
Das Zimmer war mit Bettzeug, Handtüchern und Duschzeug ausgestattet. Leider konnte man das Zimmer nicht abschließen und es gab kein Fenster zum Lüften. Lediglich ein "Fenster", das zur Küche ging.
Insgesamt bin ich jedoch sehr zufrieden und wünsche der Familie alles Gute!
nice place and nice families, thanks so much for their hospitality. it is my first stay thru AirBnb, I highly recommend Jerome's place if you visit here for short term or long term stay.

Was a great place to stay especially for a long duration. Was close to my work and was away from all the business of Singapore. It's quiet and the family there were amazing. Made me feel welcome the moment I stepped in. Would definitely recommend!

This was my first AirBnB experience and it was great - Grace gave me a heap of local info which was incredibly useful, and made me feel very welcome. It was a perfect base while in Singapore, not far from the local train station (MRT) in a refined part of the city, and the room having its own entrance was ideal and meant I didn't feel like I was disturbing my hosts when setting off early for the airport. Thanks Grace!
It was great :). I would repeat :)

A Cosy and comfortable room. The USP of this accommodation is that it is independent and you do-not disturb anyone while entering or exiting the room. The open area at the rear which is available for use by guests is an added attraction.

We had a very comfortable stay, and Grace and her family were hospitable beyond expectations. Looking forward to staying with them again.

Col(Retd) Rajeev Joneja, New Delhi India

This was a very comfortable and convenient place to stay as I wanted to be near holland Village and with easy access to transport , shops and restaurant. I received a warm welcome from Grace's parents. The private access allowed of easy ingress and egress. I will definitely consider staying
there again on my many transits of Singapore. Thanks Grace

Grace and her family were great hosts, and their home is in an awesome location - Holland Village is really a hard neighborhood to beat. Gladys, their helper, is accommodating, and the kitty adorable :)  We highly recommend the place and would definitely stay again.
Love the neighbourhood and the kind hospitality of Grace's family!
We had a great time staying at Chip Bee Gardens. Everything was better than expected. Thank you.

Grace was a fantastic host, she had everything covered from the start, she is very friendly, kind, organised, and always willing to help, every question I asked was answered instantly, Grace even took the time to write out a map of the street and shopping area, she also provided tourist information, washing instructions, shopping information etc that was all left conveniently in our room which was great. Everything is Very clean, tidy and to a very high standard. I was often asked if I needed the room cleaned or any washing was needed. The area and room was very quiet so I could work in my room with no distraction.

The shopping area, MRT and bus is very close as well as many shops and places to eat that are open until late which was nice.

This really is a great place to stay and I can't recommend it highly enough.

Thank You for an amazing stay, I really felt at home.

This was my first experience with Airbnb. It was perfect!

The room itself is comfortable (with a Queen size bed), the Web is fast and reliable, everything is clean. It is very conveniently located, 5 minutes walk from Holland Village, Chip Bee Garden, MRT, Cold Storage, etc. and the surrounding residential area is nice an quiet. Grace, her parents, Gladys (and of course the cat) are all very friendly and keen to help, always making sure that you are okay and have everything you need. Highly recommended!

What's not readily apparent from the listing is that this is a room (with your own self-contained bathroom) that has its own entrance at the back of a house in a rather nice area of Singapore - i.e. most people don't get to live in as nice a place as this!

Just outside the room is an semi-open air kitchen, and the close-by bedroom of the housekeeper, who is always happy to help out. But one can cook, keep stuff in the fridge and do washing independently if one wants.

The layout of the room was slightly different too : There was a full double bed set up for us, as well as an extra mattress for our toddler. That, coupled with the best WiFi we had experienced in Singapore, made our stay a real pleasure.

I had a very pleasant stay at Graces house. It is very clean, with facilities for WiFi and a kettle for hot drinks. There is a really nice very clean shower room.
It is located in a nice and quiet, clean estate and not far from a wonderful little town with great bars and restaurants. At the house they had a very helpful maid called Gladys who will help with any queries and do your laundry for you at very reasonable prices. The family cat is lovely and may pop into your room.
I was expecting to meet Graces family and have a bit more of a local experience but sadly the room is self contained from the rest of the house so I could here them but not see them. Grace was also too busy and I didn't get to meet her until I left the property on my last day. I only stayed for two days so maybe if I stayed longer it would have been different. I would highly recommend Graces room to any one traveling through.

Great location in Holland Village, walking distance to the MRT and a great variety of restaurants and bars. My husband stayed there to telecommute for 2 weeks, with me visiting for a weekend. We think it's a perfect set-up with its private bathroom, access to a kitchen, private entrance to the room for similar long-term stay situations. He's been overall happy with the experience. I think his only complain is that you dont get much sunlight from inside the room. But I think that's only an issue when you are stuck inside all day (which he was).

Grace was very nice, flexible with our arrival time and my weekend visit, and accessible with our questions. Thanks again, Grace!

We were warmly welcomed by grace's parents. The room is nice with bathroom but lack natural light. The neighborhood is excellent, very quiet with café, ice cream and restaurants 5 minutes walking distance.

I haven't met Grace in person but I got a warm welcoming by her mother when I arrived. The studio is maybe a bit smaller than the photo suggests, but still big by Singaporean standards (many people on a small island). The room is clean and nice and suited my needs to work perfectly. The area of Holland Village is a very calm and classy area of Singapore, while still being close to bars and nightlife. I appreciated my first nights so much that I extended my stay here to over two weeks in total.
I warmly recommend this studio for both leisure and business travelers alike.

Thank you for my making my very first Airbnb experience a memorable one. The location was awesome -- convenient for work travel, exceptional for afterwork socialising, and (most importantly for me) nearby the best LEGO shop I'd ever been too. My only regret is not having had the chance to meet you, as well as having more time getting to know your cat (we crossed paths very briefly, both times). Thanks again for allowing me such a delightful stay.

Grace greeted us at 2 am in the morning and opened the unit for us, showing us all of the features and the internet username/passcode. The unit is better than described - it included access to the kitchen which included a stovetop, refrigerator and microwave. The kitty-cat was there every morning to greet us. We shared the kitchen with Joy, the landlord's housekeeper. Joy made us coffee and tea every morning - and went out of our way to ensure our stay was comfortable. We felt safe and secure, and is in a nice neighborhood. The unit is located in walking distance to the Holland Road Shopping Center and Holland Road stop on the circle route of the MRT. These two features made this location perfect: We had access to many, many restaurants including two Holland Road Shopping Center outdoor hawker (vendor food stall) markets, and the MRT stop gave us access to virtually the entire island of Singapore. The MRT is user friendly and we used it 2-3 times daily to reach Little India, Chinatown, East Coast, Downtown CBD and Orchard Road shopping (among other stops). Each district of Singapore has many places to explore. We highly recommend this AirBnB unit to anyone who is new to Singapore - or who is a veteran visitor. It has everything you want and need when you visit Singapore."
Joe & Sue Dielh

Grace's place is great for its value. Less than 10 minutes walk to the MRT station and the room has all the amenities you'll need. Clean and quiet at night. I wish there's more natural sunlight though but since I don't stay in the room much I don't really find it a problem. Grace has been very responsive and accommodating the whole time which makes things a lot easier.
Lovely quiet roomy. Very clever too.

Although Grace's father (who welcomed me at my arrival) was extremely nice and helpful in giving information about Singapore and the best places to visit in Singapore, unfortunately the accommodation itself did not respond to my expectation. I think it should be mentioned that the room does not have any window. Therefore, it is quite uncomfortable to stay in all day (as it was at times my case since I had to work) since it is a bit 'claustrophobic'. Moreover, it should also be mentioned that the room is right in the middle of two kitchens (the one that it is in the house and the other one that is outdoors and that has also the washing machine. And the washing machine is very noisy as well ). Therefore it is quite uncomfortable during cooking time (since it is 'heavy cooking') since the smell goes in the room and there is no change of air. Without mentioning that the people of the house use the indoor kitchen at any time during day and night time without considering that the room is attached to it. Therefore it could be quite noisy.

Grace's apartment provided everything it advertised and everything we needed for a week-long stay - comfort, air-conditioning, excellent Wifi connection, plenty of power points, more than sufficient cupboard and drawer space, quiet, and conveniently located. Quick responses to all our communications. We were met on arrival by Grace's mother, and helped with washing machine, ironing etc by housekeeper Joy. We'd happily go back.

Both Grace and her mother were there when I reached. They are such lovely and easy going people! Grace explained the room and facilities in details. This place has all amenities you need to have a pleasant stay.

The neighbourhood is quiet and peaceful. Great for work and even better for holiday.

I never had any issues during my stay. Trust me these people are just awesomely cool in every manner.

The bed is big enough for 2 people, The fridge is huge, AC works perfectly, has a fan too, kitchen has all tools one might possibly need. Best of all there is a park just back side of the house. Can go for a jog in the morning. Just to clarify for one of the reviews down below, I NEVER HAD ANY ISSUES WITH ANY KIND OF SMELL OR ODOUR. The door has parts which can be opened to let fresh air come in and above all you have the AC!

It's quite easy to find. Take a cab to holland village or MRT to holland village station. Cold storage super market, Gurdian for medical needs and lots of food options in Holland V market is 5-7 mins walking distance.

Had a great time staying at Grace's place. Her folks are very nice. If you manage to meet George, he is a well mannered gentleman and a great person to have a chat with.

I am sure you will love you stay here as much as I did mine (:

My husband was the lucky one who got to travel to Singapore this time...and he loved the neighborhood Grace's place is in, and loved her place. Thanks for the hospitality Grace even though we didn't actually get to meet. Thanks to Joy for leaving an umbrella outside my room on the second morning when it was raining. Can definitely recommend this room to others as a great place to stay.

Great stay at Graces Place.
Good location, nice and quiet.
Everyone involved was very helpful and i would highly recommend staying!

The place is excellent, for whoever is looking to live in a cute neighbourhood with small apartment houses and lots of trees and flowery gardens, in close proximity to the vibrant Holland Village where you have plenty of opportunity for food and drinks. It is a bit dark as the only light comes in through the door to the backyard, but as this is mentioned in the room's description I was aware of that and I didn't mind. One note of caution, the walls are not sound-proof and the room is right next to the kitchen, so some nights you'll hear people talking, TV from next-door house, and regularly cooking early in the morning, so if you're sensitive just bring a pack of earplugs (that worked for me fine). Paul was not there during our trip but was great during the coordination of the details of our arrival and departure. His roommate was very friendly and hospitable. My co-worker and I enjoyed our stay at their apartment.

Paul is a great landlord and roommate. He was consistently courteous, neat, and respectful of my personal space. The location is fantastic! Paul's place is a neat place just next to the MRT and rooms just as good as the pictures. Paul will give you a good guide to the vicinities and take you down to some great bars and restaurants around the town. I thoroughly enjoyed staying with him.

The place is in the very center, conveniently located. Being at the 40th floor, you don't hear much from the road. But I can't say I was happy with my stay. The bedroom opens on the living room which the host use it for his job, calling by phone and/or skype until very late. The bedroom door is made of glass. Even though can't see through, the big screen TV on the living room (always on) fires and reflects the light into the room. At 1.30 AM I had to tell Paul to please turn it off.

Between the second and my third, final day, I got a medical emergency and I had to spend a night at the hospital instead of staying at Paul's house. I informed Paul saying that I would stay at the hospital for the night and that I would come back the next day to pick up my stuff and checkout as planned.

The next day Paul pressed me since 9.30 am to know at what time I would be back. The hospital delayed a bit because they had to give me papers and get the last test results.

I told Paul that the cleaning people could get into my room, put my few things somewhere and then I would come to collect my stuff before 3 pm. Paul proposed me to pay for one more night or at least pay $50 because he said that the cleaning people were there waiting for me, the checkout time was 12, my room door was locked and they couldn't go in to clean (no duplicate key? what if a guest loses the key?).

I arrived at Paul's house at 2.30 PM, rushing from the hospital still in a difficult health condition. When I arrived, the 2 cleaning women didn't look like "waiting", they were working at his house, ironing his clothes and cleaning the house. As he asked me, I payed $50 in cash for the delay in checking out. Too weak and too rush to get my flight to discuss about it.

I would really have appreciated a bit more understanding of my condition.

The studio is amazing, Richard has really put effort, love and his excellent taste into making the space impeccable. The room is spacious and he bed is a dream, but the best part of the studio is still the beautiful bathroom.
The area is also great, small beautiful shop houses, and a bit more quiet then living in the CBD. We would definitely return to the rabbits retreat when stoping by in singapore again!

If you are looking for a hip and happening place to stay in trendy East Coast Road then this place ticks all the boxes. Individually designed rooms give that feeling of being somewhere totally unique. The choice of  traditional furnishings and modern art work blends well with the heritage Chinese building which has wonderful wooden floors .Rabbit Carrot Gun cafe is located directly under the rooms so not far to go for delicious breakfast- poached eggs best I have ever eaten- or if you want to relax in evening after busy day in steamy Singapore. Music from cafe can be heard through the floor boards but it never closes very late so not a major problem.East  Coast Rd is rather busy and noisy for my liking although the double glazing helped as well as the very comfortable beds. Not near to MRT but lots of buses stop outside and area has that great mix of local Singaporean culture mixed with a myriad of trendy and traditional eating places. Chris from Dorset sorted out all my questions and is great at hailing cabs or carrying yr luggage up the steep steps to the room. Rabbit Carrot Run is a great brand and feel sure the service and style on offer will mean it will be hopping onto a bigger platform in the not too distant future.

Great stay across 4 nights. A very responsive and helpful host. The bar (Trenchard Arms) and restaurant which are part of the same organisation and just downstairs from the BnB rooms, are convenient, reasonably priced and the restaurant food is very good.

A "character" neighbourhood in Katong in the Eastern part of Singapore.

Great stay, Great room. The team made me feel very welcome and could not have been more helpful.
The atmosphere of the cafe also provided a welcome place to stop off at the end of the day.
Stay, relax, enjoy....

I had a great stay at Rabbit Carrot Gun. Lord Trenchard has such an elegant and eclectic style and it is reflected in the room's decor. This bed and breakfast is perfect for a business traveler or couple. The bathtub is AMAZING. And the food at the restaurant below was excellent. I had 3 meals there and loved every one of them.

Had a fantastic stay at Rabbit Carrot Gun. The bedroom was really comfortable with an awesome bathroom. The location is great with lots of good food within walking distance. Richard was also easily contactable and ever-helpful although I sadly did not get a chance to meet him personally when I was there.

If you're looking for a place and neighborhood with lots of character to stay in, you won't find many places better than Rabbit Carrot Gun.

I booked this room on behalf of friends who were visiting Singapore. The location is great in a more local neighbourhood which offers a different experience to that of staying in the city.

Overall the stay was comfortable. There were a few hiccups, however the phone was always answered and in most cases solutions provided.

We loved our stay here. The room was stunning with beautiful decor, great layout and plenty of space. The bathroom was fantastic with a bath and large shower.
We were extremely comfortable and it was so relaxing and peaceful, we could have stayed there all day.
Great accommodation, fantastic communication with owners before arrival and easy check in.

Rabbit Carrot Gun is a great place to stay when visiting Singapore or even when looking for a short boutique "staycation". Located right in the middle of charming Katong. There is a restaurant downatairs that has great food and good prices on beer. This place offers a different perspective when staying in Singapore.

Very recommendable host. Fast reply, good communication, helpfull. Place was far away from the metro station (2km) but instead I used taxis, which are really cheap in Singapore (to Marina Bay Sands 11 S$). Katong area is nice, full of shopping possibilities, prices are more affordable than in city center. Lots of foot massages and beauty centers, good and cheap food everywhere. Suite is a bigger room with desk and chair, no TV, but really big bathroom with bathtube and walk in shower, comfortable and with style. AC and big fun working o.k. Was a little bit too dark, if you are long time in travel you may need one day off and this place after few hours is a little depressive. On the other hand downstairs is very nice restaurant with good food and coffee (though cappucciono and espresso priced more than in starbucks ;-)). Sometimes they put too loud music in the restaurant (especially in the moring I didn't like it). In the end - I really recommend this place and host, we had nice one week stay in there.

I had another great stay at Rabbit's Retreat. Although I arrived really late at night, Richard went all the way and had the keys ready at 2am in the morning.
The place is very stylish, tons of great restaurants around (try the Japanese place across the street in the shopping mall). Make sure to install UBER on your phone as getting a taxi can take a bit in the mornings.
This is one of my go to places in Singapore and I will surely come by again!
Rabbits Retreat is a fun place to stay a little outside the tourist trap. The studio is just above a friendly cafe that makes for a great start for your morning.

Looking for a unique experience? This is it. Rabbit's Retreat is a charming beautifully-decorated room with plenty of light and a huge bathroom. I often started my day with coffee in the cafe downstairs.

Richard and his staff responded quickly to my questions. They were warm, friendly and welcoming.

Thanks to the hosts for giving us a great place to stay for New Years'! The suite was beautiful and made a great staycation venue. Also great bathroom with vintage appeal. Pity we couldn't stay for breakfast, but we'll definitely drop by next time. Thanks for giving us a great start to this year!
The room was lovely and Richard was helpful with everything that we needed. I definitely recommend staying here :) I loved the shophouse and being the Katong area was food haven.

This was the absolute best experience I've ever had with any hotel, bed and breakfast etc. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted promptly and shown to our room. It was perfect. The soft sheets and giant bathroom doesn't even begin to cover the comfort we felt here. After checking in, we spent time lounging a bit before heading downstairs for an amazing birthday meal. The restaurant is superb and the service was genuine and on top of it. We felt at home. I think that's the biggest compliment and most honest thing I could say about Rabbit Carrot Gun. I cannot wait to travel back to Singapore and stay for longer :)
The place is very beautiful and looks as charming as the pictures! We love every bit of it and left us with a lovely experience. Thank you for everything!
nice location

The stay was amazing and despite a misunderstanding at the beginning, host was very nice about it. Place is beautiful and cosy, perfect if you are looking for a quiet getaway! Also near many great foodplaces. Loved my stay. Would definitely recommend to others and rave about the place to friends☺️
Beautiful room. Lots of privacy and tastefully decorated and comfortable bed.

Richard made us feel very welcome! The room was beautiful with a very comfortable bed and block-out curtains it was great for a sleep-in. The bathroom was lovely and spacious. Lots of great places to eat and drink nearby. Would definitely stay here again if in Singapore!
Beautiful room. Don't take my word for it, check it out. One of the awesomest toilets ever! Like seriously, did you see the tub? Great food all over too. Extremely convenient and relaxing.

What a fantastic place to stay. It beats a hotel anytime. Very spacious and exceptionally comfortable, the apartment was very well decorated and furnished. Richard couldn't have been a better host and with a stonkingly good bar and bistro below I cannot think of anywhere I would rather stay in Singapore.  It is ideally situated for quick and easy taxi access to the city centre and the airport. I cannot recommend highly enough.

My son arranged for me to stay at this lovely place. It was very comfortable, in a great area with plenty of dining/shopping nearby. Public transportation was easily accessible. There is access to a living area equipped with a TV/refrigerator/stove.   Richard and his wife were very accommodating. They even lent me an extra large pot so I could make my son/girlfriend chicken & dumplings!  Thank you Richard, I enjoyed my stay!
nice place to stay!, everything you see in the picture, is exactly the same as what you will get there. oh and also it has a big living room and kitchen area too.
big room with a great bathroom in a restored shophouse. the area is loads of fun with plenty of places to go and eat.
Thanks very much for a great stay Richard, the room was lovely and the beer too!

Richard's place is comfortable and elegant. The location is quite convenient for exploring Singapore especially if you are interested in nightlife, yet the place is family friendly as once inside it is completely quiet and cozy. It had all of the accoutrements of a fancy hotel without the price of one!  Definitely would recommend. As for the host, Richard is very helpful, warm and kind. It's clear that he has a lot of experience in the hospitality industry and knows how to make his guests feel welcome and taken care of:)

The accommodation is in a great location for restaurants, bars and the East Coast Park and beach.... its got easy access to CBD and the airport. The owner is a really nice guy and the accommodation perfect, clean and spacious as the photos suggest. Would love to stay again

The room was clean and spacious, and exactly as shown in the pictures. My parents in law had a very comfortable stay here, both hosts, Richard and Tricia, made them feel very welcomed. With lots of bars and restaurants and a couple of malls close by, this location was ideal for them, without the need to travel out of the area while they were here for a 1 week vacation. Would definitely recommend this apartment looking to stay in a more local area in Singapore!
A lovely spacious room perfect for a stay in Singapore for those looking to stay somewhere with a real neighbourhood feel to it. A home away from home.

Rabbit Carrot Gun is a fantastic place to stay. Beautiful and individually finished rooms in a heritage Chinese shophouse with one of the best cafes in Singapore below you and a fantastic host and team looking after you. The cafe opens at 8.30 most mornings and has really excellent espresso

Outstanding in every way. Richard the host goes out of his way to ensure your stay is as comfortable and hassle free as possible.
Highly recommended!

Very happy, great location and very convenient
Spacious too!
Location was central and near to many restaurants and cafes. Richard was timely with his responses and helpful.

Please is great for a quick getaway from the busy city singaporean lifestyle.
Really enjoyed my stay there!
Great space, perfect location, good for business travellers

彼ら夫婦は本当にいい人でした！

Richard's place perfectly suited our needs. The bed was super comfortable and the room got nice and dark for sleeping. Check-in was easy, even though we arrived later in the evening. We even received a "friends" discount when eating downstairs at Rabbit Carrot Gun during our stay (thanks, Richard!). Overall, we had a lovely time!

A cosy little spot, but a little too far away from the action for our liking.  The bed and bathroom were comfortable to use, but we regret not staying at a hotel with a swimming pool, and at a more central location.
Excellent location for a longer or short term stay. Close to everything. Don't expect latest fashion and upmarket - it is a lovingly restored Peranikan heritige building.
Richard was friendly! The room was really clean! Spacious toilet with an accommodating bathtub!
Great apartment in a location that suited us. Richard is a helpful guy and great communicator.

I stayed at Richard's place for five nights while in Singapore for a family wedding. The room is beautiful and very comfortable, and far nicer than the hotels nearby that other members of family had booked. The neighbourhood is  superb. Katong is full of beautiful shophouses, including this one, and there amazing food in every direction (328 Katong Laksa is visible from the room and I would have eaten there every day if I could have). East Coast Park is a quick walk away for running or walking, and the centre is an easy bus or taxi ride.

Best value bathtub in Singapore!
We loved the bath, and the room, location and host were also great. Taxis to/from the city or airport were cheap and easy and the food downstairs was delicious with friendly service. The first part of our trip we stayed close to the city so it was good to see another side of Singapore. We enjoyed the shops close by and the coastal park where we had a nice bike ride.

Great place for friends or family to share. Big and roomy. Good location. Close to a lot small restaurants, coffee shops and a pretty good supermarket. About a 30 minute uber ride from the city center.
The bed was comfortable and the AC worked well. Especially in the living room. This was my first trip to Singapore and I had no idea how humid and hot Singapore was. Even compared to Bali where I was traveling from. It’s like Bangkok hot. Ok. Maybe not as bad. But close.
Richard was a great host. And runs a nice restaurant below. Had dinner there my first night and enjoyed it. Great staff. Especially Tyler and Victor.
This is just the most delightful place to stay and east in Singapore. Wonderful rooms, really great staff and fantastic food in the kitchen and bar below. I can't recommend it enough.

Wonderful apartment in traditional house. Loved the matrace, haven't slept so well since a long time :)
The bar downstairs definitely has a wonderful atmosphere to start the day. The beach close bay is fantastic for a bike ride !

Tolles Zimmer mit Gastgebern die immer erreichbar waren. Ihr Restaurant ist unten im Haus. Wir konnten sogar deutlich vor der geplanten Zeit in unser Zimmer rein, was nach einem langen Flug super angenehm war. Es gibt eine kleine Küche mit Kühlschrank zur Mitbenutzung. Das traditionelle Handelshaus liegt an einer größeren Strasse, es ist also etwas lauter.

Place is well decorated with a unique style.
Clean and well furnished with an enormous bathroom.
A lot of cafes within the vicinity so you will never lack for food choices.
Staff at Rabbit Carrot Gun are fantastic. Warm & friendly with great food to match!
The pictures are telling a lie...the actual space is much much more amazing and the ambience simply delightful! :)

I really enjoyed staying @ the Rabbit Carrot Gun. Being in town only for three days for meetings this location made the whole trip a memorable one. Fantastic location, fantastic room and the food in the restaurant.... Need I say more, I promise to be back.
Great boutique place to stay in singapore.  Awesome eatery staff downstairs. Quick with Grab or a taxi.  convenient buses.
Definitely recommended! Superbly decorated place in a very nice location, lots of good food around.

There are several things not shown from the description of the listing. First it’s an old shophouse so old that the construction of the building is actually unsuitable for people living. It’s on the second floor and the fists floor is a bar and restaurant. Whenever there’s movement downstairs the room itself shakes too. I’m a sound sleeper and I woke up from shake during my first night. Then I experienced loud traffic noises as shophouses are very close to roads.
Second in pictures there’s a bathtub and listing says hot tub in amenities (after my complaint it might be gone but it was there when I booked it). The water was actually below human body temperature not suitable for bath (unless you feel ok to soak in water of room temperature). I communicated the problem with the host, got a few “tips” like turning it on and off, waiting a few minutes and fill in the water again etc but still it’s not hot water. I told the host so and then he’s become really nasty: he wouldn’t take responsibility, nor would he admit a false and misleading description. I had many Airbnb experiences in Singapore and this is the only one I feel disappointed.
Great stay

Had a wonderful staycation at Richard's! The bathtub was huge, place is uniquely done up and clean. Food downstairs at Rabbit Carrot Gun was incredible too. Richard and his wife were really friendly as well. Last but not least, location is fantastic with lots to do and eat around the area. Thanks for having us! :)

Richard's place is in a great location for those wanting to stay a bit away from the busy downtown area and enjoy a more laid-back stay. Being in the centre of the Katong area, there are tons of great restaurants and cafes nearby, and I rarely spent time outside the area during my stay. For those wanting to do more sightseeing, the location is convenient enough that you can take buses and rideshare apps to get anywhere.
The place was clean, and check-in was very smooth.

Loved our stay in this gorgeous gem of a place. Trish and Richard are Devine hosts and make you feel at home. The room was so comfortable and the bathroom super spacious. Loved the location, just walk outside to their lovely restaurant and bar. I highly recommend this property.

I had a wonderful stay at Richard's place! It was really easy communicating with Richard prior to moving in and throughout my stay. The room and the shared living area are both spacious and well-furnished, and the place is beautifully situated at the heart of East Coast Road—surrounded by many great cafés, restaurants, and shopping centers. The place is extremely accessible as well: the nearby bus stop has buses that can take you all around Singapore.  I really enjoyed my stay with Richard, and I particularly recommend having some of the brunch items at Rabbit Carrot Gun (right downstairs)—the food there is delicious!
Excellent location and great space! The crew were really hospitable and made the experience even lovelier!
Fantastic apartment, a lot more spacious than I was expecting, really great vibes! The food and staff at the pub downstairs were both lovely. Richard is a very responsive and accommodating host.

Its a pretty nice room for the price. Absolute value for money. It was very well located whether it was for the night destinations or to the universities.
I had a great time. Thank you Mr KP.

Generally a good place if you need to stay in the heart of the city for you have easy access anywhere. Just make sure you have most of your personal things to use that are comfortable for you like the glass, mug, cutleries etc. Bathroom is a bit small but maintained clean. The host responds easily to requests so any problem you might encounter he will try his best to resolve quickly.
Beautiful room! Truly a five star spot! Great attention to detail and the neighborhood is very vibrant. HIghly recommended!

Rabbit Carrot Gun, from the café downstairs to your own private door, the Imperial Suite offers the perfect bolthole while in Singapore. Suffering from hotel fatigue, where each hotel room looks the same, the Imperial Suite proved the perfect antidote. Huge bed, antique furniture and windows that open! I might never go back to the blandness of western hotels.
Richard and Trisha are great hosts and the staff at their café, provide a perfect balance between familiarity and one’s need for privacy. I look forward to coming back next time and trying out another suite.

I highly recommend staying at Rabbit Carrot Gun! The rooms are impecable and the location is great! After visiting Singapore for many weeks, I can comfortably say that this location is much more interesting and lively than most parts of downtown. There is a shopping mall 2 minutes away and lot's of great restaurants nearby. Richard is responsive and friendly. Excellent experience!
Great place, clean large rooms with a great bathroom. East Coast area is so convenient to get around to the city for work. Will definitely stay again.
Another great stay at Rabbit, Carrot, Gun!  Best place to stay in Singapore.
Great place!
The Gun! A favorite for myself and my workmates. Couldn't ask for more in a room.

I really enjoyed my stay at rabbit carrot gun despite not feeling my best during the trip. The check in/out process was great and hassle free. Good correspondence also with the host before and after the visit. The room is gorgeous and the most comfy bed ever! The besting thing is the location in Katong. For those who suffer from mall or hotel fatigue in singapore this is the best antidote. Amazing neighborhood with proper real shops with Nonyang flavours. Love all the renovated shop houses and local eats Only downside is not the place for super light sleepers as it is above a bustling bistro and pub unless you want to join the fun till at least 1 am. Highly recommended. Although this is more room to sleep rather than the other airbnb experience where I've really interacted with the hosts a great deal during my stay.

Richard and Trish were great hosts. They were really friendly, helpful, and accommodating. My family and I felt very well taken cared of here and we really enjoyed our stay.

The room was very clean and comfortable. It's much larger than most hotel rooms in Singapore and much nicer too! I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for an affordable, comfortable, clean, and convenient place to stay at in Singapore.

These guys have a really great place. The bedroom was very nicely done, the restaurant/bar are awesome and the people are cool.
Place was spotlessly clean--cleanest airbnb I have ever stayed in-- and check in/out was a breeze. I saw some reviews mentioned the bar noise--this was not a problem at all. I could hear people talking on the street and some music downstairs, but I didn't fly all the way to Singapore and rent a room over a bar just to go to bed early. It's a long walk to the metro, but it's a short walk to awesome restaurants, a really cool huge park with a fantastic seafood hawker center, great views and good coffee..I would stay here again for sure.

What a wonderful welcome Richard gave us from the beginning. He was standing on the footpath ready to receive our taxi and took us up to our room making us feel like old friends. We loved staying here as it had everything we needed.
We're so pleased we chose to stay here as the best food and drink was downstairs at Richard's establishment or at the best laksa in Singapore over the road. The area has an interesting Peranakan history which seems to be undergoing a revival with various shops and cuisine.When we wanted to travel into the city we went by bus right outside the door which was convenient, cheap and enabled us to see different areas.
Richard and his staff were wonderful...... .answered all our questions and acted as tour advisors all with the benefit of local knowledge.We so loved our morning coffees and breakfast...big thank you to Richard and his attentive friendly staff for making us feel at home.Next time we will definitely stay longer unless RCG becomes so popular there will be no room at the inn!

Richard was a great host and communicator. We had a delay in arrival and they were able to accommodate us. Also the staff helped us to get a cab on the day when the city's streets were blocked for a state funeral. A great room and great people. Thank you.

We enjoyed a wonderful stay at Rabbit, Carrot, Gun! The property is in an excellent location-walking distance to the coastal park, close to local shops (including supermarkets for any forgotten essentials!) and lovely restaurants and bars-most notably the cafe and bar attached to the property itself. We enjoyed 3 meals here over only 2 days and the food was delicious!

This is a very clean and comfortable room with a lovely big fluffy bed, good storage space in the cupboard and modern bathroom facilities.In addition to being on the coast the property is a very short bus ride (or even shorter cheap taxi ride) to the centre of town- where the museums, shops and other attractions are located.

Lord Trenchard was a brilliant host-very friendly and a good communicator. We chatted a few times while we ate in the cafe and he made it clear we could contact him or any of the staff if we needed anything. The staff in the cafe and bar downstairs were lovely too- very helpful, attentive and warm.

If you are considering booking Rabbit, Carrot, Gun for a vacation or staycation (as in our case) in Singapore I would highly recommend it!

I really enjoyed my stay at Rabbit carrot gun.
Live like a local in Singapore.
The room is lovely,bed is so comfy.I love the restaurant in downstairs.However, there is a little bit noisy at night.

Host was very friendly and welcoming. Rooms are nice escapes in Singapore that don't feel as sterile as the big chain hotels. Since you're on the second floor, there is some honest morning street noise (metal shutters from shops opening, car noise, etc). Personally we enjoyed it, but if you're picky maybe it's not the right room not for you.

The room is just as amazing as picture. Although there is no MRT nearby, the bus stop is close. btw, the restaurant downstair is awesome as well. Even if you don't stay here, still have try the Eggs Benedict.

What a hidden little gem in the bustling metropolis that is Singapore!
I was recommended RCG by a friend of mine who i was visiting for a couple of nights, he couldn't have made a better recommendation. The room was perfect, well equipped and the service was spot on. Check in was simple despite us not arriving till near midnight and we got a chance the following morning to eat in the cafe downstairs which i highly recommend, as it was delicious! Will definitely stay here again :)

The staff was enormously helpful, lugging my suitcases up and down the stairs and tending to my every need. The original room I booked was not available but lucky me, I was moved to the largest of the three rooms available. It was wonderful.
I am familiar with the neighborhood so the activity in the neighborhood was also familiar to me. Very convenient to all kinds of restaurants, stores, taxis and bus transportation.
Richard was very cordial and I appreciated the fact that he could tell I was wiped out from the heat and quickly gave me iced water!
A very pleasant stay.

Would love to say a big thank you to Richard and Trisha for having our family at the Rabbit Carrot Gun.
We had a lovely time and if you are looking for a place to stay that is unique and different from standard hotels and condos in Singapore then this place could be for you.
We wanted somewhere to stay that gives a taste of old Songapore and the Rabbit Carrot Gun did mot let us down.
The beds were comfy, food great and the drinks refreshing. Location was great, only a 10 minute taxi to the city and the airport.
It was great talking with Richard and Trisha as well.
We had the two bedroom apartment and stayed with two small kids. Worked really well for our family.
Thanks again Rabbit Carrot Gun? If we come back to Songapore we will stay again.
Richard was a 5-star host, great stay, great place, very highly recommended!
Richard was a very nice guy. They have a food / coffeee place downstairs and it was better than I could have imagined.
It was a super nice stay in Singapore at Richards place. The flat was awesome and everything worked out very good.

We absolutely loved our stay at Richard's apartment in Singapore.  There were three of us (one couple and a single lady) and at no point were we running into each other.  The spacious rooms, each with their own bathrooms, are separated by a living area (complete with washer!) which helps with privacy.  The keyless entry made coming and going so much easier than trekking a key around with the possibility of losing it.  Upon arrival Richard showed us the space and then rattled off a list of recommendations for our time there.  We used a vast majority of them (thanks Richard)!  We ate breakfast twice downstairs at Rabbit Carrot Gun and had drinks the first night next door.  Richard's wife and friends were also incredibly hospitable (shoutout to Stewart!).  Everything you want to see, do, or eat is either a short uber ride or within walking distance.  Although not important to everyone we LOVED the art/decor/architecture of the space.  Don't think twice about this place, just book it!

If you are looking for a great base in Singapore, away from the TripAdvisor crowds, surrounded by great food and drink, and with awesome hosts - then this is the place for you.

Richard and Trish have created something special in Singapore, off the beaten track, yet on the exclusive one.
Great stay, great host. Highly recommend!
Consistently excellent as always - feels like home from home.
Richard and Tricia are terrific hosts - wonderful location, very comfortable and close to all amenities - highly recommended
Dont want to visit again... never

The place was very clean and quite accurately represented in the photos provided. Location is great, just along a street of different variety of foods and shops. Richard was very accomodating as we booked on such short notice, and very welcoming when we met him. He was a fantastic host for the week that we stayed there, and would definitely come back for another stay the next time we travel to Singapore again.

This place is really wonderful. The photos don't really do it justice. I stayed here with my wife and young daughter and everything we could want was provided. The location is fantastic for restaurants and bars and the bus is right at the doorstep. The rooms in the apartment are large and each has its own bathroom. The bathroom for the main bedroom is huge but unfortunately has open vents to the outside so can become very warm in there. All the other rooms are air conditioned. Overall a great comfortable stay and highly.  recommended. The host Richard and his wife and staff are very friendly and helpful.
Check-in was a breeze. The rooms were clean and cool. The staff at the pub downstairs were unbelievably friendly and helpful. Richard was very responsive. Overall a fantastic time!
Awesome stay , great location and and great food. Highly recommended.  This will be my go-to first choice  .

Easy access to local delicacies, such as the most famous Jadong Laksa, five star chicken rice and Bak kut teh. Lots of buses to reach Fullerton, Marina and City Area. Also, the brunch options were very delicious. Recommended

We enjoyed staying at your place.
The location was superb and within walking distance from restaurants n pubs n shopping center
The rooms were well kept, clean and has a nostalgic feeling on the old colonial dwellings.
Overall, would recommend to everyone who wants to have peaceful quiet stay in Singapore. Will definitely stay again during our next visit!
Great place to stay! One of the best place to eat laksa just five meters  away, shops around and east cost for morning run and long walks nearby.
We arrived very late at night but his stuff still helped us check in. This place is nice and convenient. The communication with Richard was easy.

Понравилось все. Интерьер оригинальный, число, далековато от метро но автобусная остановка 10 метро от входа в апартаменты. Бодриться можно в любой конец города, да и автобус удобней в Сингапуре чем метро. Интернет просто летал. Соотношение цены и качества отличное! В оснащение кухни можно добавить микроволновую печь и поменять сковороду ( сильно пригорает), но мы адаптировались и все было отлично. ! Для компании 4 человека это лучший вариант размещения ! Рекомендую.
An eclectic space, very spacious and comfortable in an interesting neighbourhood
uhmmm... 5.
Great!!!

Kubric Suite is an oasis in the heart of the East side of Singapore. Nestled in a quiet junction, this room blends an eclectic character with whimsical flair. Though very different, it does not forsake good ol' luxuries like a great rain-esque shower head.

Richard and Trisha were incredible hosts as they guide you to what's great around. They own the restaurant below and it serves up a great breakfast.

Overall, the hosts were great and the room was fantastic. Forget the hotel, stay here. Now.

I actually got upgraded to another room since the lock was broken.  Loved the location - close to great restaurants and east coast park.  The room itself was well designed and decorated.  The air conditioner was so quiet that at first, I thought it was broken.  Bed was also very comfortable.

Fantastic stay - Booked for three days, liked it so much that I extended to 10 days. Richard is an excellent host, outgoing and charming. Room is beautiful, very artfully decorated. Location is fantastic- Can't ask for anything more. Highly recommended- try the excellent beer downstairs!

I highly recommend staying at Rabbit Carrot Gun! The rooms are impecable and tastefully decorated, not to mention that the location is great! After visiting Singapore for many weeks, I can comfortably say that this location is much more interesting and lively than most parts of downtown.
