There is a shopping mall 2 minutes away and lot's of great restaurants nearby. Richard is responsive and friendly. Excellent experience!

Highly recommended, Rabbit Carrot Gun is like a hotel without service but in a good way!  Great room, perfect for a solo traveller or two people who know each other really well (the bathroom is open to the room).  Its exactly as pictured with whisper quiet aircon, force 1 fan, pitchblack block out curtains and comfy bed. No noise from the restaurant below at all and gentle traffic noise during the day so you can get a great sleep (in).  I didn't get a chance to eat at the restaurant below as I was too busy exploring the fantastic hawkers centres and kopitams nearby.  I can report that the coffee is excellent, the beer icy cold and the staff very friendly.  Taxi stand and buses across the road, really interesting district and the East Coast Park a short walk away. This is where you should stay, but don't tell everyone as I want to come back!

I stayed at Rabbit Carrot Gun for a second time and would highly recommend it to everyone.

Great location, great apartment, fantastic host.

Great Location and good value for money.  Richard and his staff were very helpful and make the place feel more like a home from home.  Only slight negative i would note is that the building is on a reasonably busy road and as it is a restored old shop-house the sound proofing is not all that great so you do get some street noise.  But even with this i would still highly recommend RCG.

The room is perfect for one person or a couple (it has an open concept shower and toilet). The room is cosy, has some super funky artwork and oozes character and individuality.
Located on the upper floor of one of Singapore's classic shophouses, it was the perfect place to rest my weary bones after long happy days in the tropical sun! Prepare to carry your luggage up one flight of stairs (and remember that what goes up, needs to come down, so be careful about all the shopping you do!)
Although the room is directly above the cafe, in a bustling neighbourhood, I wasn't disturbed by anything (although I am a sound sleeper!).
There are plenty of shops, and quirky affordable and delicious eateries peppered across the neighbourhood, and proximity to shopping malls and the beach are an added bonus. Definitely try the weekend brunch at Rabbit Carrot Gun. Service is friendly and efficient. All in all, a wonderfully stay! Highly recommended!
Great location, lovely room and friendly hosts ideal for business or short holiday stay in Singapore.

We arrived to have the most delicious quiche and salad at the Rabbit Carrot Gun. We loved this room in the charming corner shophouse in a diverse neighborhood. Great artwork, Super comfortable bed, duvet, block out curtains, well designed shower.
We were able to walk a block to find printers for last minute professional printing, and a few blocks the other way for a bottle shop and Din Tai Fung!
Reluctantly our visit was short, but enjoyed the best capuccino at the resto for a very good send off. Look forward to discovering more on our next visit to Singapore.

My partner and I had a lovely stay in the Kubric Suite at Rabbit Carrot Gun. Richard was very accommodating with our late night arrival and late check out. It was great to eat downstairs in the restaurant and have a drink at the bar. We would happily stay here again. Thanks Richard!
This room was a gem. Beautiful and quality furnishings, super clean, a good size, great value.

A most excellent stay at the Kubric Suite was had. Simple and just right. Spartan but dialed in. Dare I invoke hip? Katong / Joo Chiat offer a brilliant change of scenery from the typical shopping mall out the doorstep. Great local grinds up and down the road; I never really had to walk too far in search of whatever hit the spot. Brunch at the Rabbit Carrot Gun, a walk the stairs and you're there! East Coast Park for a jog, stroll or roll. Quick quick to and from Town or the airport. Two words, super convenient.

A mention to those in search of serenity. The music playlist from the Rabbit comes on at 0845 in the morning and can serve as somewhat of a wakeup call for those of the late night lifestyle. Expect to hear it as long as you are in the room, but courteously so, it keeps a reasonable bedtime for those of the early a.m. ..
Great stay.!The room was clean and very nice. Location was wonderful with good food and beer steps away.  The host was very nice and accommodating.
10/10 stay, 10 mins and $1.50 bus to city right outside. 15 min to airport with Food and shopping close. What more could you want? I would highly recommend.

Remarkably restored room. It was clean and comfortable. Location cannot be better. Be in a bustling and hip neighborhood with tons of local flavor and yet be minutes from the center of town.
Lord Trenchard was a fuss-free, easy going host. HIghly recommended.

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut zwischen Airport und Zentrum gelegen. Beides ist problemlos in 15 Minuten zu erreichen. Das Zimmer ist schön und schlicht eingerichtet und natürlich klimatisiert. Der Gastgeber ist sehr nett, unkompliziert und hilfsbereit.

Great room over a very good restaurant. Location is nice because you are away from the hustle and bustle of the downtown area but are a quick taxi or metro ride away. There is some street noise, but that's to be expected considering it is a shophouse. A great way to stay in Singapore!

This place is great.  Well furnished and above a very trendy cafe and bar.  The area is very up and coming and easy to access the city.  The rooms and set out very nicely with some great art pieces.  All staff were very friendly and welcoming.  We'd definitely stay there again.

My stay at Rabbit Carrot Gun was awesome. Location is great with lots of places to eat within the area. Don't forget to have breakfast at the coffee shop below.  I will definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants a relaxing place and have a homey vibe tucked away in the east area.

My hubby and I stayed in the Kubric suite for a week and we both agreed that it has been very enjoyable. It was a very pleasant experience for us to stay in this charming restored shophouse and we totally dig the decor of the room. This place is conveniently located and it's very easily accessible via public transport. For those who are keen to live away from the city center, I would definitely recommend this area. Right downstairs, there is a restaurant and bar (also owned by them) with the most wonderful food and service. There are a couple of malls nearby where you can find pretty much everything you need.
Richard was very kind to meet us up on a hot Monday afternoon to pass us the keys as the restaurant was closed on Mondays. We are also very grateful as there is a lady who comes and clean up the apt occasionally. What's better than coming back to a mess-free room?
The only downside was that the music from the bar/restaurant downstairs can be pretty audible and thus, not good for early sleepers (or those who sleeps till noon because they serve breakfast at 9am). Good thing is, the music doesn't last all night. I think it stops around midnight or earlier. My suggestion is to just hang out and enjoy a drink at the bar till its closing time. TADAHHHH! Problem solved. Then, wake up early and take a walk around the area where there are tons of old or restored shophouses, cafes and restaurants. It's a good way to observe and experience the local lifestyle in Singapore.
In conclusion, this place is highly recommended for travelers who would like to immerse themselves in the (in my opinion) most charming area of Singapore and yet not wander too far away from the city center. Love it! Will definitely be back!
lovely room, good staff were helpful. The location is a great destination for foodies, convenient to airport and CBD via bus or Taxi

I enjoyed a lot staying in the Kubric Sute at Rabbit Carrot Gun. Richard and his wife have been great hosts. The interiour of the room is wonderful and it is an exelent experience enjoying a historical builind in such a way.
In the Restaurant Rabbit Carrot Gund which is just based on the ground floor of the same building you can enjoy a good coffee & breakfast. In the evening they serve great dinners and excellent beer.
Great place with a great atmosphere! Very enjoyable place to stay.

Highly recommended. I bought this for my parents to stay in when they came to Singapore to visit me and they had a lovely stay. I emailed in advance with some requests and not only was everything perfectly taken care of the but my parents had their room upgraded to make them feel even more welome. Would defiantly recommend to family and friends again.

another great stay at RCG... love Katong and was just what I needed after all my medical stuff in Singapore. Accommodating last min extension. Thanks
Will stay again! Katong laksa opposite is undergoing renovations at the moment so it's a little noisy during the day at the moment but not a big issue at night.

another great stay at RCG... love Katong and was just what I needed after all my medical stuff in Singapore. Accommodating last min extension. Thanks
Will stay again! Katong laksa opposite is undergoing renovations at the moment so it's a little noisy during the day at the moment but not a big issue at night.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Rabbit Carrot Gun - located in Katong, 15 - 20 minutes from central Singapore...

Located above a beautiful, character-filled restaurant and pub and directly opposite what is reputed to be the best laksa in Singapore!

Richard and his team are superb hosts and you can pop downstairs for a cheeky glass of wine (or a wonderful apple crumble and ice cream) as your heart desires.

The only thing to be aware of is the music from the restaurant below - it's great music, but it does play till around about 10:30pm at night, so if you're an early sleeper just bear it in mind.

Another great stay at Rabbitt Carrot Gun. Logistics are very easy and the restaurant and bar are a great place to spend some time. Lord Trenchard is a warm and interesting host. I will definitely be back again.

Room was not the one I booked but upgrade into another room. Room lovely and lots of space with best bed. Word of caution is that shower and toilet are only divided by glass partition it was not a problem for me as I was by myself. Yes it is a little noisey from restaurant downstairs but that wraps up around 10.30pm and its Singapore, the restaurant and bar are part of the business and the bar was excellent. Don't bother going next door to 328 Laska as the quality is 4 out of 10, just eat in. Morning Coffee from downstairs was 10 out of 10 but don't start serving till 8am and I had left by then but there is a good hawkers market close where I could get my fix of Singapore kick ass coffee. Nice neighborhood and easy access to town by bus directly opposite the street.

Tha place was clean and beautiful !
Very interesting location.
Many shops and green !
Don't forget your amenity set !

The host wasn't there to receive us so it was the restaurant (owned by the host) staff who showed us to the room instead. Extremely cosy, homely feel but still was as luxurious as any hotel you could.

Location is convenient with buses to the city (20mins), many restaurants, cafes and drinking places around the area. There's a cinema in a nearby mall (5 mins walk away). Beach is also a walkable distance away.

Only gripes is that music from nearby shops starts playing quite early and theres no door to the toilet. Any sound you make while doing any business, as well as any smell can and will be heard/smelled by the entire room. Also the it may be a bit pricey as you can get proper hotels (the room does not provide toiletries but do provide towels) for a similar price.

Host is friendly and replies to emails/enquiries extremely quickly.
Excellent location, really enjoyed the big breakfast to start each day at Richards restaurant below. Richard is a great host and the room was perfect.
Great location and great host. Will return.

If you want to spend some time exploring the East Coast, this is a convenient location. There are several bus lines servicing the neighborhood and plenty to eat, see, and do nearby. Unfortunately, the room itself was a letdown. At our agreed upon arrival time, the host was not there and the key to the room had not been left with the restaurant staff downstairs. We had to wait more than half an hour to be let into the room. No apology was offered. When we struggled to connect to the WiFi (which was spotty throughout our stay), the host shrugged it off; he said, rather arrogantly, that his computer was working so the problem must be ours. We eventually got it to work on our own, but only by using a VPN. A caring host would have helped his guests resolve the issue. Our bigger problem with the room, however, was the noise. From about 8 a.m. to 11 p.m., the host's downstairs restaurant blasts clubby lounge-y chillax New Age music. You will wake up to it and you will (try to) go to sleep to it. The host claims to have "soundproofed" the rooms; whatever he has done doesn't make a difference. The bass is so loud on the music he plays, it shakes the floor and walls. If this weren't bad enough, the guest in the room next to ours was blasting pounding techno music well after midnight. When we complained to the host, he said he'd already left for the night and that we should knock on the guest's door and deal with it ourselves. How's that for professionalism? On the plus side, the room itself gets good natural light, the A/C works well, the shower stays hot-ish for about 10 minutes (long for Asia), and it has some cool vintage furnishings. But we advise you to read the amenities list very closely, as there are none. No blowdryer, no clock, no water glasses, no toiletries, no garbage bag in the garbage can, not even a soap dish to hold the soap you have to buy yourself. There's also no door or curtain blocking the toilet; if you're traveling as a couple, plan for your partner to hear and see everything. One other thing: The listing here fails to mention the room's mice infestation. We spotted two poison trays and a huge glue trap beneath the bed and had the pleasure of listening to them scratch and chew all night long. Sigh. We've been traveling Asia for more than six months and renting tons of places via AirBNB, all of them about a third of the price of Rabbit Carrot Gun; this room was the least thoughtfully outfitted and most unpleasant. We would not return nor recommend it. If you need further convincing, read the reviews of the host's restaurant on TripAdvisor. Red Flag City.
Room was great, Tricia was very helpful in getting us to our room and transport to the city. A great option to avoid those overpriced hotels!

The reason why you should book this
1. Located in very centered among famous local resturant. Everything just walking distance.
2. Cappuccino in rabbit carrot gun is so devine, best coffee in sg so far
3. Great opportunity staying in shophouse which quite eccentric. Feeling like you run away.
4. Lord Trenchard and his staff is amazing host. Respond fast n assist me every step of the way
Disadvantages for this place
1. Floor made of old wood and wall is really thin. So I heard guest next door walked back with cracking sound n heard every songs on their playlists in middle of the night. N like other review said. I got wake up service from music downstairs start from 8 am-10 pm. Like clockwork. You probably don't feel private from this point.
2. No amenities
3. Clean up service wasn't daily during my stay.
4. Not quite convenient commute to downtown
Overall love the room, service n neighbour. Coming back ? Probably not

Accommodation was great, the rooms were large with good shower facilities with air conditioning as well as free Wi-Fi. Location was convenient for access to and from the airport as well as the office at Chai Chee Road TechnoPark. The rooms were very competitively priced compared to the local hotels, the other positive is that it is connected to a good bar and restaurant, which serves a wide range of draft beers and wines along with sports TV. The only downside was it would be nice to have some toiletries in the room, such as shampoo, soap etc and the room could be noisy in the morning during the weekends from the music coming from the bar below, apart from that it was a great find and would stay there for my next visit to Singapore. The owner Richard and Trisha are very accommodating to ensure you have a great stay.

Listing is accurate and the place is really nice. Our room was large and the bathroom was beautifully restored to a colonial "black & white".

Richard's wife was super helpful with advice and accommodated a few requests re providing and iron or extra towels very quickly.

Rooms are above the Rabbit Carrot Gun Gastro Pub and the staff are super helpful and friendly.

Cracking spot to grab a decent nights sleep in Singapore!
Couldn't recommend RCG highly enough, rooms are perfect and match the description well and there's the added bonus of a good bar and lovely cafe.
i have been a guest of richards for the second time. it was again a wonderful trip. i do not know what else there is to say except i wll be back
A nice staycation...very peaceful one

Funky apartment with quirky features, prompt communication and great team of people providing support.
Away from the city Centre but easy access to bus and taxi.
Made to feel incredibly welcome.

Richard, the gregarious host of East Coast hideaway was flexible with our booking. We had to shift out by a day last minute and extend by a week later, and he made it easy. Rabbit Carrot Gun, his pub downstairs had a great coffee and food. The locale (Katong) is very cool - very cosmopolitan. The room was quirky, and although the toilet didn't have door, it was quite comfortable. It was serviced twice a week and had a good washing machine and adequate kitchen facilities. It was good for a long stay.

Richard is a really nice host! The communication was prompt and uncomplicated. The breakfast was fantastic. Room was clean and comfortable. Rabbit Carrot Gun is located in a nice area (lots of restaurants and bars...). We had a great stay! Wish to come back.
Richards place was lovely, convenient and as advertised. Communication was very smooth and Richard and his staff helped us with any hiccups. Highly recommended.

Richard's place was amazing! It was just as pictured and described. Richard is an incredibly nice and caring host. His cafe downstairs serves a wonderful breakfast - highly recommend the French toast and avocado spread!! His bar also served great drinks - the Sauvignon blanc was the best I've ever had. Highly recommend Richard's place.
Nice place. Very clean and right next to public transportation. room as described. would certainly stay here again.
I had a lovely staycation here during the new year. Food & drinks & transportation are easily accessible. The area is peaceful and the room is clean. Perfect for a short getaway.

Great place to stay, extremely convenient with restaurants all around, bus stop right outside the place. Richard was very welcoming and helped whenever we had questions/concerns. Would definitely stay here again!

Rabbit Carrot Gun Restaurant and upstairs apartment was a great authentic contemporary Singaporean experience. Great Location, Excellent Food in Richards and Partners Resturant downstairs and great staff with great service. A nice feel to the accommodation, bed is great !  Simple, Spacious, Clean, Comfortable and Courteous Experience. Thank you Richard
Perfect spot for exploring all Singapore has to offer. Close to many food options and public transport. Really lovely place!
It was great staying in Richard's place.

Richard's place is great. It's in a quiet out of the way neighborhood that's still an easy bus ride to down town and close to a variety of great restaurants. If you're looking for a different Singapore experience, Richard's place is a great option!
Although it is located on the 2nd floor of a busy restaurant, the apartment is very quite. It has shared kitchen with another room.

Маленькая комнатка с туалетом, душем и умывальником в ней же. Расположена в хорошем районе, рядом красивый парк, можно пройтись к нему пешком, Так же много-много разных кафе вокруг, совсем рядом автобусная остановка и несколько небольших торговых центров.В общем расположена квартира удобно.Но она подойдет скорее тем,кто собирается там только ночевать, а все остально время гулять по городу. Заселились мы без проблем.

Great listing for a single traveler or a couple staying a few days. I loved the neighborhood and the restaurant right below. This is a private room with a private bathroom but you do share the kitchen and living space with others.

Authentic, quirky, stylish and fun, Rabbit embodies the funky Katong vibe.
It's the perfect spot for exploring the East of Singapore. Walking distance to the beach, in the heart of the restaurant & bar zone, and an easy taxi / bus hop into town.
Friendly and helpful staff, and (quite literally) above a fantastic British themed pub serving delicious grub.

Both my partner and I had a wonderful short yet sweet stay at Richard's. The location was perfect quiet yet central. Good food places were close, access to public transportation aresuper easy. It goes without saying that check in, commuinication and cleanliness was tiptop. We'll be back for sure. Husni & Angeline

I like staying in places that are unusual, thematic. Richard's space didn't fail to stimulate my senses the moment I entered the rooms. I especially liked the outdoor-feel bathroom (I was upgraded to the Terrace Suite btw). Created a very unique atmosphere, you gotta be there to understand.
Another highlight of my stay was hopping on to an oBike and stroll around east coast park.
Always a pleasure staying at Richard's. A must when you come to Singapore.
Richard's place is a really nice comfortable room in a fantastic location with lots of restaurants and shops around. Great place in a vibrant, more "local" part of Singapore.
We spent good time here. The decorations of room are trendy. Will be back for sure.

Great location, a bit off the beaten track but all the better for it with lots of local eating spots and bars in the immediate vicinity. The 'boutique' design style of the rooms is a real feature, and the friendliness and attentiveness of staff, and managers Clarence and Victor in particular, was exceptional - they really went out of their way to be helpful.
I would highly recommend

Enjoyed our stay! Andy (working at the restaurant) welcomed us in an incredibly friendly way- thanks again for the welcome beverage! On departure day we could leave our stuff at the apartment and even take a shower before taking off. Having breakfast at the Rabbit was a nice treat- the granola and coffee were very tasty (we loved the coffee in Singapore). Great time!

The location might be slightly off the MRT (for now), but that lends the area it's own unique charm and measure of laid-blackness. It's still only an easy bus or short Grab ride to the more major sights, anyway. As for the space itself, it's ideal: spacious and comfortable. A shared living room and kitchen allow for home cooking; although with a wealth of tasty local food around the corner, not to mention the excellent (and friendly) Rabbit Carrot Gun downstairs, you may not make too much use of it. The bed is soft and allows for a very good sleep, and the large bathroom has both a roomy walk-in shower and a free-standing bath. It's an excellent place to stay, and Richard and the team below at the restaurant are always on hand to help and offer tips and suggestions for around the city. Highly recommended, and will try to stay here again when I next return.
Great place for a hideaway, the host is super nice and amazing place to stay!

Laura was very accommodating, with my very early morning arrival.  She always made me feel comfortable.  A delightful person and setting.  I truly enjoyed my stay here and would never hesitate to stay here again, should my travels ever return me to Singapore.
Great location!
Great landlord, very friendly and easy to contact. Room is exactly as advertised. Very good location in central Singapore .
Every thing is ok,the host is good

Between the 8th and 13th February me and my girlfriend want to celebrate Chinese New Year in Singapore.
Singapore can be quite expensive for accomodation and, as we wanted to be right in the middle of the celebration what better place than Chinatown it self, in a cheap place.
The place is right above the Underground Station, the double room is big and we had private living room, the apartment is on the 31st floor and you can see Singapore from high..this is a plus.
The price is very good price for the place and position.
Room is basic, only down side is that there was no duvet cover and even if say possible to do light cooking there was no plates.
Overall is more than positive.
The host let us store luggage for few hours the day we had to do check out.
Very kind.

Itsepalvelu sisään kirjautumisessa sujui hyvin ohjeiden mukaan. Yllätyksenä oli lattioiden epäsiisteys, jonka vuoksi minulle luvattiin palauttaa siivousmaksu.
Tv ei toiminut ja pyynnöstäni korjattiin. Ulko-oven koodilukko ei toiminut, joten hiukan turvaton olo. Kokonaisuutena epäsiisti vaikutelma. Rauhallinen asunto ja upea näköala.
Very good and convenient.

Land and Kim were great hosts. they openned there house to me and were friendly and warm despite my short stay. Their home is uber chic, the location unbeatable and the service from the helper- beyond par. 6* stay

Travelled to Singapore with my wife in December 2014. Landy was very prompt in responding to the stay request. We had a splendid stay at Landy's place!! The house is located at probably one of the best locations in the city. All modes of public transportation are very easily accessible, at the same time the neighborhood is very quiet and calm. The house is very beautifully furnished with all the amenities and the wifi is superfast. The bedroom is cosy and the bathroom is excellent. A special mention to the host for being extremely flexible. Before checking in we requested to cut down the stay by one day as we wanted to extend our stay at Langkawi. The host was ready to accommodate our request despite having all payments done, it even involved waving off the minimum stay clause at their place(it didn't materialise though due to non availability of flight tickets). We requested to avail the facility of house's washing machine which was agreed to as well(use of washing machine was not mentioned in the house manual). Maridel, the house maid is very sweet and was a great help. It was very nice of Landy to leave a welcome kit for us including tourist guides, maps and some discount coupons.
Overall a memorable stay with exceptional hosts. Would recommend to each one travelling to Singapore.

オーチャード駅とSOMESET駅は徒歩15分ぐらいですが、タクシーを使えば問題ないですし、お散歩にも最適です。
チキンライスの有名店「文東記」も近くにあるので、ロケーションがかなり良いです。
お風呂がなく、シャワーのみです。二泊しましたが、二日目はなぜかお湯があまり暑くなかったです。
寝室は広くないですが、リビングも貸し切り状態で使えます。
メイドさんがおりますので、部屋を整理してくれます。また朝食もトーストとコーヒーは用意してくれるので、うれしいです。
値段・立地・部屋・サービスなど全体的に考えると、コスパがかなり高いと思います。是非お勧めしたいです。

Landy was a gracious host that provided a clean and safe environment. Provided detailed instructions on many things regarding my stay in Singapore. He checked in on my stay to see if I needed anything. I forgot my international power adapter and landy was kind enough to lend me his. his home was beautiful and was in a very upscale neighborhood and MRT and buses were all with 15 mins walk away. There is a very upscale mall right on top of the station. Chinatown and little india are 3/mrt stops away tho u need to change lines. All in all I'd def would stay at landy's home again. Thanks Landy!

Our host was in New York while we were in Singapore, however his notes to us, and the apartment itself, made us feel welcome.  His description of the accommodation was very accurate.  The location was perfect, delightful area, comfortable walking to the Orchard Road MRT. We explored Singapore until exhausted and it was always nice to come home.  Maridel was always pleasant and the little dog was fun, never barked, never jumped.  Everything worked, although the king sized bed was a bit of an obstacle course. Very happy with our first airbnb experience!

Landy made us feel very welcome in his home which is a quiet, comfortable, spacious apartment on the 7th floor.  Maridel (his maid) cooked us a great breakfast to start each day, and the apartment is just 10 mins walk to Orchard Road and within easy taxi reach of most of the main attractions.  Would definitely stay again!
Great stay - spacious room by Singapore standards, a good location and a very hospitable and friendly host.

The apartment was nice and clean. The host was not in during our stay, however, the housemaid was very friendly and prepared a nice breakfast for us every morning. Our little girl enjoyed her stay. The location is a 10 minutes walk to Orchard Road. The security guards were very friendly and the place is very safe. Wifi facilities was very good. Overall our stay was pleasant.

The apartment is very comfortable and the hosts are very friendly. We had a lovely time staying at the apartment, making friends with Landy, Kim and Maridel. We enjoyed playing with the dog, Uni, too. The building guard, James, was also most helpful. The apartment is centrally located on prime real-estate. The neighborhood is safe and quiet. It is not far from the botanic gardens which we visited twice and particularly enjoyed the orchid gardens. We highly recommend this apartment.

Landy provides a very unique Airbnb experience. My stay at Manhattan Mansions was outstanding. The pictures and description are accurate. The location is excellent. Orchard and Great World are a short walk and River Valley Rd. has a couple of famous Chinese restaurants, Boon Tong Kee and Five Star.

Landy is a true gentlemen and a meticulous host. Kim, his wife, is a warm and good-natured person. The maid Del, is diligent in looking after your needs. Always had clean towels, well kept bathroom and room. And then there's Uni, the adorable, fluffy Maltese.

Landy, like me is a true foody. During my stay we shared a few great meals around the dining room table.

Thank you Landy and Kim for a lovely stay at your home.

All the Best- Patrick

Professional hosting. Comfortable bed. Clean room and private bathroom. AC, fan & WiFi is working. Quiet location, 5-10 minutes walk to Orchard road (malls and NS underground line which gives you easy access to main attractions). I would recommend.
Thank you.

My stay at Landy's place at Manhattan Mansion on Grange Road was wonderful experience. The apartment and rooms are spacious and the decor definitely has a lovely personal touch to it. The location is very central, with Orchard Road barely 10 minutes away. And, although the hosts were not in during my stay, Maridel (their help) made sure I was comfortable. The security guard too were very friendly and helpful.  I can recommend the place and would surely stay again.

I have just returned from a wonderful stay in Singapore and a lovely accommodation experience at Landy Eng's luxury condo.
Landy, his wife Kim and their maid, Del, made me feel very welcome from day 1 of my stay. The condo was exactly as pictured on airbnb, the location was, as stated, a leisurely 5-10 minute walk from Orchard Road and if desired, public transport was also available regularly about 100 metres from the condo. James and Martin, the buildings security guards were also very friendly and helpful and all in all, I felt very much "at home". Del was most helpful, particularly when a small water leak occurred in my bathroom; nothing was too difficult and I thank her for her duty and friendship towards me. My time with Landy and Kim, overlapped a few days because of their respective travels and it was so nice to be able to meet and spend time with them. Both suggested different places for me to see and dine at, and on my first day Landy even walked me down to Orchard Rd, to make sure I knew my way around. To choose to stay at Landy's condo, is to choose "a home away from home" and a welcoming & lovely stay.

I felt that Mr.Landy was welcome us sincerely.
The Condo and room is very clean and very convenient for us to move around the town and city.
The most impressive thing is that he is friendly to us even though I ask a little bit difficult request. (In fact, the room we stayed is suitable for 2 pax(adult). I asked 2 more person though I had a long story. But, he gave me a agreement with extra charge, of course).
If I have a plan to visit singapore again, I will get in touch with him. Thank you!

It's my first time to use airbnb and don't know how all things work, but i have to say that i would continue using as i had an amazing stay in Landy's apartment. He wasn't around when i arrived so his domestic helper picked me up downstairs and brought me into the house.

Living room is spacious and carries a nice vibe with Chinese traditional culture; bedroom gives a warm homy feels, there are also aircon and ceiling fan for me to shuffle in case it gets too warm; reading room is also available and looks just like the picture. One more thing amazing about my stay was that i could get immediate help from domestic helper whenever, whatever i requested. Awesome experience!

Noise level: Very low
Accessibility: Great, very near to Orchard Road
Service: Good, they have a cute dog that doesn't bark too

We had a pleasant stay thanks to Landy. The place was neat and clean and very well maintained. The biggest plus of this place is the location and we could walk to Orchard road . We would like to thank Landy and his staff Maridel. We wish them all the best in future.

Me and my friend went to singapore for a conference. It was trully a great place because it was close to our conference venue. Plus walking distance to everything, the mall (which by the way is very convenient specially with the great singapore sale), transportation either bus or train. Although if riding a taxi, its best if it has gps or just get it from grab a taxi.
We had a minor problem on the first night but was easily taken care off the following morning. Landy was not there, but we were greatly accomodated by his maid mabel, who is also a filipina, hence very hospitable. We were even given coffee and bread for breakfast, a point that was highly appreciated.
The condo was huge! And everything that you need is there as specified in the details.
Hence this place is highly recommended! And we'll surely rent it again when come back to singapore :)

My wife and I had a 10 day stay in Landy's condo. We found everything as expected. The accommodation is beautiful, calm and very very relaxed. Landy was a warm and inviting host, and his housekeeper Maridel was sweet and eager to please. We much enjoyed the pool area to cool down and relax at the end of a hot day. The position was quite central, with easy access to many places we wished to visit. It was especially great having a large firm bed.
We have no hesitation in recommending this accommodation which we would describe as 5 star to anyone.

I would highly recommend Landys apartment . Fabulous location , central to everything . Landy leading up to our stay was totally professional and helpful , which made my partner and I feel very confident. The apartment had nice views , was quiet and our room was comfortable and clean . Landys maid was helpful and pleasant . We will definitely stay at Landys again .

Landy was a perfect host and the BnB is in a great location. So close to ION and all the action on Orchard. I wouldn't stay anywhere else. The house help Dhel is great too. She is courteous and helpful and makes a genuine effort to keep guests comfortable.

1:firstly,I would like to say something about the location.good location,the condo is near the orchard road and it takes about five to ten minutes walking to the nearest MRT station（Orchard），the MRT station is in the shopping mall(orchard ion）2:secondly,Landy's house is well decorated ，the introduction picture describe the house truly.It is comfortable and quiet。3:the extra service is also satisfactory，Landy  ”s house have its private maidservant，she makes breakfast during the period of my accommodation and always gives us good cleaning!wooni is also one member of the house，it is a lovely dog which my daughter loves very much and brings happiness to my daughter! 4:one more thing I would like to mention is that we also feel a pity ,Landy is so busy and going out so early ,we also coming back to the house so late .we do not have enough time to communicate sufficiently!but we knew that landy is a driven man ,and so successfully!we live in Landy house for four days and enjoyfully ,thanks all!

I arrived at 6:30pm greeted warmly by Maribel, she made great pancake with her special yogurt, her bfast is excellent.
I loved the couch with the windows open in the early morning, great fresh air.
i had a wonderful 3 nights stay, wished i stayed in more to enjoy the nicely decorated apartment.
Will look for Landy in my next trip to Singapore.
Thank you Landy.
房东Landy非常热情，沟通及时到位。房子收拾得非常干净，洗手间也不错。位置距离地铁站乌节路不远，但走起来也要10分钟路程，还算方便啦。

We were living in Landy apartment for the last 2 weeks. Great location, close to public transport stops where you can travel to anywhere closeby, easy to get to Orchard Road. Family of Landy is very friendly to guests. However, we noticed a problem with washing at the first time, Landy fixed that issue straigh away. The area where we stayed is quite, green powered, easy to hear morning songs of birds in the mornings. Many thanks for your help, Landy! See you again!

Our 2nd Airbnb experience and 1st time for private room. Highly appreciated Dhel for waiting for us on our late arrival. Great and safe location. Only issue, internet keeps disconnecting at night during the last 2 nights of our stay. Overall still a great experience. Thanks Landy and Kim for the dinner and hospitality. We'll miss Uni a lot :)

We stayed 5 days at Landy's. The room has it's own bathroom. The whole place is clean and the bed is comfortable. The walking to the MRT is about 10 minutes. We enjoyed our stay a lot and thanks for Landy and Kim's hospitality.

Ellen and Ti-jeun

Landy and Kim's home is immaculate and very close to the Botanical Gardens which were a highlight of our Singapore trip. Yuliana had only been with them a week but was very lovely and eager to look after us.
The bathroom was a nice size and wifi worked great. The king size bed is comfortable but the room itself is very tight for 2 people.
It was my daughters birthday while we were there and Kim surprised her with a peice of chocolate cake which was very appreciated.

Had a great stay with Landy in Singapore. The apartment is extremely convenient if you desire to be near Orchard Road, and while I was on the run and not in the apartment much it was comfortable. Landy and family were very welcoming, would stay again if in the area. Thank you kindly.

Stay at Landy's condo was very comfortable and overall experience was very nice. I felt being at home away from home. Our personal cook, Yuliana, was also sweet and caring and made all that we requested.

It was good place to stay. Size of room is compact but actually bigger than picture.
Room and bathroom are very clean everyday.
Location is good as well though it takes around 10-15 minutes to MRT station. But bus stops are close, so I recommend to take bus than MRT.
That was a very pleasant stay in a convenient location for an affordable price

Our stay with Landy was amazing, the condo was everything it was described as. Landy was very helpful with everything from where to shop and eat to transport and sights to see. The helper could not have done more for us, very friendly and would defiantly stay there again

Landy's place was really ideal for our trip to Singapore. The location was superb; it was only almost 10mins of walk to ION in Orchard road, which is where all the good food and shopping are! It's also really easy to flag or call for a taxi using an app. It is also very safe, with a security guard downstairs at all times. Room was comfy, with a toilet with hot water. Room was always clean whenever we leave and return. Towels are always clean and ready for us. Landy, wife and his helper Yuliana were all very hospitable, helpful and always tried their best to help us out. We had a late flight and Landy allowed us to leave our luggages way after check out time. Lovely stay.
Fabulous hosts, incredibly friendly & always willing to help & made my stay so enjoyable. Fantastic location - would definitely recommend to anyone wanting to visit Singapore.
Good and quick communication with the host. Smaller than I expected.
Clean and quiet room, a bit more spacious than expected, for a reasonable price, great for a short (1 month) stay. The host is very accommodating and nice.
The place is wonderful and the host is really friendly and nice. Arrangement and communication with the host is smooth also.

Yuan was a really great host and her apartment was really spacious and clean. It was in a rather central locations and it was easy to get around from her place. The pictures are accurate representations of the apartment and Yuan made everything really convenient and offered advice on how to get around. I would not hesitate to recommend this for travellers looking for a central place to stay. Thanks Yuan! (:

Yuan was a great host! Her place is as shown in photos and she was very helpful and quick to respond on emails. Would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone looking for a homely stay in central location :)

The location is central and ideal. Surrounded by lots of local food and convenient to city center. The facilities is also new so you will have the feel of being in a boutique hotel. Yuan's place is definitely a little haven, dressed up for the Princess!

Yuan is very welcoming, her place is clean and very convenient - the bus stop just ouside the condo. The room is just fine for one person. Great: exlusive use of the bathroom, as Yuan has her own ensuite bathroom. I would come back any time.

Yuan is a very nice and enjoyable person, and she responds very quickly to emails. Her place is clean and you get your own bedroom and bathroom. It's located very conveniently in central Singapore. You do have to walk 15 minutes to the nearest subway station, but there's a bus stop right in front of the apartment. She works a daytime job, so if you're a person who likes privacy, this is a very good place to stay at. Definitely a place I would recommend!

Yuan is so nice and friendly, I stayed there for two weeks and we had so much fun.  The flat is really cosy and clean. The swing on the balcony and the swimmingpool are really nice too.  The place is very convenient (MRT and bus around).  I would definitely recommend this place.

I was looking for a temporary place to stay until I found permanent housing (relocating for work from the US), and this apartment was PERFECT! Super clean, you get your own room and bathroom (really rare in Singapore), and the apartment facilities include a nice pool and small gym! The bus stop's really close by, so other locations are pretty easily accessible.  Yuan is the SWEETEST host, and she's lived in Singapore for a while AND is a foodie, so she knows the great spots to eat! If you have questions about Malaysia too in case you want to travel there, she'll be able to answer them!  This spot is a great place whether you're relocating, want a vacation, or if you're backpacking alone! Thanks Yuan!!

Yuan is a wonderful host and her apartment is beautiful. You are made to feel at home the minute you arrive and Yuan is extremely helpful is making sure you know how to get around Singapore and is always ready to answer questions. I don't think you could find a better place to stay or a better host in Singapore.

What a cute cute apartment!! The room is in perfect size, tidy and cozy, and you got your own bathroom. :)

Yuan's place is located in the perfect area if you want to experience living in the area with all the locals. The nearby food market offers authentic good eats and they open late till 2am.

There are bus stations right down stairs and also easy to catch a cab. The Orchard is 7 stops away from Yuan's apartment by bus.

Though I had a short stay at Yuan's, I really enjoyed my time there. Yuan is super friendly and very helpful if you have any questions for gear to do, where to go. If totally stay at Yuan's again if I visit SING next time!

Yuan is the perfect host making it super easy for her guest to stay with. It feels like being at home! Her apartment is as pretty as it looks on the photographs and she takes very good care of you. You have your own bathroom and even a closet where you can hang some clothes if you want. The location is pretty good with bus stops right outside the door and the MRT only a 10 min walk (or two bus stops) away. I will definitely try to stay at her place again if I come back to Singapore.

We were very pleased and happy to stay with Yuan.Her place is very clean and comfortable.The location is very convienent to discover Singapore.I was appreciating that she took my booking with my son.Yuan is a very openminded and kind woman.
She gave us tips,how to use the bus and left us even a elinkcard,which was of good use.
We also enjoyed very much the pool which belongs to the condo.I really can recommend her home to any woman traveller to Singapore.Also the communication was very good and with quick replies to emails.
Thanks again to Yuan beeing such a good host to us.
I spend 3 nights at Yuans place and I felt very well.Yuan is very uncomplicated which I apreciated very much.

Yuan was an incredible host. very respectful and flexible. the apartment is really cute, and clean. it is very comfortable in a good location...
and Yuan is really flexible!
Highly recommended.. and of course next time i would not hesitate to repeat!

I had a wonderful stay at Yuan's place! It was exactly as you can see on the pictures, cozy and clean and I love the swing on the balcony! Yuan is very helpful and answered to all my questions. Yuan is very kind and cute. Her room is perfect. You have your own bedroom and bathroom which are very clean and comfortable. I spent at her apartment only for 2 nights but felt fully relaxed. I would definitely recommend to stay. Thanks Yuan!

Yuan was very communicative leading up to my stay. She had to travel while I was there, but her friend checked me in and explained everything even though I arrived somewhat late in the evening. The apartment is really cute— I loved the swing on the porch!

This was my first time ever using airbnb and it was great. I had a great time at Yuan's- she was just too fabulous and friendly and really helpful. Her home is lovely. I would recommend yuan to anybody that is looking for an ideal place to stay.

I highly recommend Yuan's house for girls :) I had my own bed and bathroom so I didn't feel any inconvenience when I came back to home very late.
Room and bath room was clean enough, had own air-conditioner(which was very nice), Swimming pool is same like as photos.
Great location for Ochard, but there was no MRT station near by.
Yuan is a very kind girl, always smiles and even offered me to join for dinner, drinks :)
No need to worry at all if you are looking for a comfort, safe, and clean place.

Yuan is very charming and friendly ，introduce us various attractions, local Food and shopping, she is patient with children, my son likes her . A very good experience, Thanks ,Yuan ,we will come again.

Yuan responded to my inquiries very fast before I decided to stay at her place.
She is a warm, friendly, hospitable, and sweet person.
On the night we met, we went out for dinner close to the Whampoa market, at a food court that has really good local food.
I had stayed at her place for 2 weeks while looking/waiting for a flat to move to. We had some really nice and fun conversations, and she dishes some really good advice on Singapore--apartments, areas, prices, restaurants.
She also offered me awesome dinner/dessert/drinks/snacks.
Her place is as pretty and cute as on the photos. The room is not big, but does not feel cramped. The guest also has the bathroom to herself too.
The pool is also very nice.

I didn't have the chance to really explore the neighborhood, but saw that there is a Balestier trail--it seems interesting to take a stroll, if only Singapore weather weren't so hot.

I definitely recommend Yuan's place to a nice girl looking for a friendly and cozy place to stay in Singapore.

Yuan has been very helpfull during my stay in her charming home.It is well located with a direct bus to ORCHARD, and her condo is brand new with beautifull pool and facilities.
My room has air cond and also a private bathroom.
I really recomand her place to ladies who wants to explore Singapore.
Thank you so much Yuan, it was nice to meet you!,
Christelle from Paris France

I had a wonderful time at Yuan's place ! She is sweet and nice. Her place was beautiful. She mades you feel comfortable right away and like home. Was my first experience and I'm glad it was with her ! I'll definitely go back to her place if I ever come back to Singapour ! Thanks for everything.
Yuan is very friendly and lovely. i had a pleasant staying of these days. You may take a good rest while you are in Yuan's cozy room.

Yuan was incredibly pleasant and friendly to talk to, advised me on things to see, and helped me with maps on my first day. The apartment is extremely nice with access to a wonderful pool, workout room, air conditioning, and a beautiful balcony. I definitely recommend staying with Yuan!

I spent a few nights in Yuan's place for a holiday. Even though she was out of town the whole time I was there, we were in constant contact from check-in to checkout. I liked how easy her place was to get to via public transportation or taxi. The neighborhood was quite safe with quite a few hawker centers for local food. Her apartment is very clean and the bed was super comfy--had the best sleep in my 3months being in Asia! My favorite is the swing in her balcony! I loved spending evenings there, snacking on some sliced fresh fruit.
Totally recommend any solo female traveler visiting Singapore to stay with Yuan! :)

It has been such a pleasure to live the Singapore experience with the help of Yuan.
Very welcoming, she puts everything she can to make you feel at home. Her beautiful and clean appartment is right next to all the city can offer!
:)
The house is nice and clean, with a lovely balcony from where you get a great view of the city. Buses are easy to catch

It was my first experience with airbnb and it was perfect.  Yuan's place was just the same as on the pictures.  It was easy to find and in a modern building with gym and swimming pool.  The room was clean and had a separate bathroom for the guest.  Yuan has the lovely personality and showed me great hospitality.  Yuan brought me to the local eating places to have lunch.  The chat with Yuan was very informative on the locality.  I highly recommend this place to ladies who travel alone.  And I wish Yuan all the best and all her dreams come true.  Cheers!

Yuan is a great host. She gave me good sightseeing and shopping advice, informed me well in advance about the location, address, how to get there etc. The place is really nice and looks in real like on the photos. I would definitely come back :)
Nice, clean, small room. Bathroom also very clean. Yuan is a nice host who helps you to find bus or MRT connections to the places to be. Would choose the place again.

Yuan was very helpful, and friendly. From taking me to my first trip to Orchard, introducing me to her friends over a yummy meal...she really went above and beyond to make my first visit to Singapore memorable.

Mein Aufenthalt in Singapore war wundervoll. Yuan was an amazing host! Her condo is exactly how it looks like in the pictures and it is extremely clean. I felt comfortable the entire time. She is always available if you have any questions and she is very accommodating.

I would love to stay at her place again. She provides everything that you need (wi-fi, washing machine, soap, shampoo, conditioner, hair dyer, etc...). I highly recommend staying at Yuan's condo.

I absolutely loved staying at Yuan's place in Singapore. Yuan is a really lovely person and I enjoyed our evening talks very much. She is also a very good Cook :)
The flat itself is very nice and clean and perfectly located to trips out and about Singapore. There is a bus stop right in front of the building and 3 Metro Lines near.
I would definitely stay with Yuan again when I am in Singapore!
Thank you Yuan!

Yuan is a girl who loves life very much, I been her house two days, the location is not far, take bus or MRT or walking all OK, she can give some good suggestion，easy too talk, it is a good choice for the girl who travel here to live

Yuan was incredible as a host! Upon my arrival, she already provided a lot of the information that I needed, gave me an Ezlink Card for transportation and the building and door passes. She gave me a lot of tips and advises and even talked to me about Singapore and the culture in the city. She helped me know a lot of the place in such a short time.

Would really love to go back :)

My 3yr old & I had a pleasant experience living with Yuan, the host. She gave us a warmth welcome accompanied by great hospitality. And the location is very easily accessible to the city. Convenient enough for traveling with a child. We had a great time!

Really enjoyable stay! Cute apartment and room, very clean and conveniently situated. I enioyed taking the bus across the road to all my destinations including city centre, Orchard, Clarke Quay etc. Yuan is also lovely and easy to chat with!

I am sorry for my comment until now. We lived in Yuan's house for 4 days. She is very nice and patient. She prepared breakfast for us, told us the routine and communicated with us friendly. Thank you for your care. Welcome to China and look forward to seeing you again！
Lovely small apartment close to shopping (for food and basic necessities) and right on the bus line to Orchard St and the Quays.
Really cute apt a bus ride away from the center. Nice amenities close by.  Yuan is lovely and very helpful.

Really enjoyed my stay with Yuan in her pretty apartment. Everything was tidy and the bed very comfortable. Bus 145 takes you from the doorstep downtown, right in the heart of Singapore. The MRT is a 12 minute walk or two bus stops away and also very convenient to explore the city. I liked the area with many food options very much. Be sure to visit the food stalls at "Whampoa Market" across the street for breakfast or dinner and dine with locals.

Yuan was a great host and helped make my stay in Singapore enjoyable. Her flat is like showed on pictures, the bed was comfortable and I had my own private bathroom. There are many convenience stores and restaurants nearby. The apartment is a 30-minute walk from little India and Orchard is easy accessible by bus. I also used the gym on the 7th floor, there is a treadmill, and elliptical trainer and an outdoor pool. Overall, a very nice experience, I highly recommend staying at Yuan's.
Thanks for hosting me! Love the place , easy access to everywhere! Definitely will be back

I loved my stay with Yuan in her apartment! From the moment of booking, Yuan was very responsive in her communication with me and confirming my booking. The apartment itself is about a 20 minute taxi ride from the airport and is also right in front of a bus stop. It is very easy to get around the city from this apartment using the bus or the MRT station (located about 10 minutes' walk away). The apartment is surrounded by great food and is walking distance from Little India and all of its sights.

The room was exactly as described with access to a private bathroom, as well as use of the entire apartment (including a balcony, kitchen, and washer). I was also provided with a hairdryer and clean towels.

Yuan was an amazing host and tried her best to make my stay as enjoyable as possible. She is a great cook and baker and very knowledgeable about the city. She graciously cooked for me several times and took me to explore her favorite coffee shops.

I would not hesitate to come back and stay with Yuan again in this apartment. See you soon!!

Thank you Yuan for making me feel at home, it was the perfect landing place for my work trip in Singapore. Yuan is a sincere host with a real interest in other cultures and traveling. Yuan is a talented nail art-ist - I recommend making an appointment during your stay ;)

I enjoyed staying with Yuan, who is friendly and a matured young lady of her age.  she is very helpful and knows the city very well. Her apt is exactly like in the photos, nice and clear, and bus stop is just one minute walk from the building. Foods are plentiful and convenient stores are around. I really had a nice, good stay in her apt.  Thank you Yuan...hope to come back and stay with you again.

Yuan was away on holiday when I stayed, but stayed in touch and was wonderfully helpful with information on how to get around the city. The apartment is lovely, exactly as described and super clean. A real home from home - definitely my first port of call if I ever get the chance to come back to Singapore!

Yuan was out of town during my visit, but she was kind enough to arrange for someone to meet in the middle of the night and let me in. Not far from the market you can find several reflexology shops and you can treat yourself to a massage. Yuan was flexible with my travel needs and in the end we overlapped for an evening at her place. She is delightful and meeting her is clearly an excellent reason to stay at her place.

Yuan is the best host ever, super communicative, outgoing, great cook and a super foodie! I had to do a bit of work during travels and Yuan made breakfast then brought lunch for me~ so pampered! I highly recommend Yuan's place and will definitely go back again~~ tks yuan!

It was a short but rather pleasant stay in Yuan's place. Not only the apt is a very clean, comfortable and cozy one but also Yuan is a very nice and thoughtful girl. I enjoyed my stay there, a recommended good place particularly for a solo female traveller!
Great apartment, easy to find and a convenient location for city adventures & work. Thanks for your hospitality Yuan!

What an amazing time and person Yuan the owner... I was so sad to leave and say goodbye... From the first day I arrived I was so happy the apartment very clean and great location, I also know have a very dear friend in Singapore. Thank you Yaun and I will definitely be returning.

Me he sentido realmente muy comoda en casa de Yuan. El apartamento es tal cual se ve en las fotos, así que no ha habido sorpresas. Está bien situado y es muy facil moverse por la ciudad usando preferentemente los numerosos autobuses.

1、房间很小，比照片看着小很多，房间也就5-6个平方左右，床铺是一张1米的床铺，靠着窗户，有点类似于中国的飘窗台；
2、位置不太理想，附近没有地铁站，到各地基本都是公交倒地铁，附近的超市要步行15分钟；

另外说下我对新加坡民宿的感觉。老实说，Yuan的房子是Airbnb上的超赞房东，也是我精心挑选入住的，我住的时间段每晚所有税费加一起550/晚，且只有一个1米的单人床。Yuan因为有事，我是独自入住的。但同期，我住的乌节路的假日酒店是1000/晚，房间大位置好，如果民宿的价格是四星级酒店的一半以上，其实说明新加坡整体的民宿性价比不高，这个不是针对Yuan的房子来说的。我自己作为超赞房东在杭州的房子10个平方的双床，才138/晚，当地的四星酒店在600左右，价格约1/4，我认为这个才是好性价比的民宿。供大家参考

PROS:
- Mariel's mom is one of the sweetest ladies I've met while traveling. She treated me out to lunch and we had very interesting conversations about the prosperity of Singapore, traveling, and general aspects about life.
- The family is super accommodating to your requests. I needed a desk lamp and power adapter to get some work done, and they had one for me. Also was able to get my laundry done here, which was great. Mariel's dad also was very nice, we shared a lunch together.
- you have a private entrance to your room in the back of the house, so no worries about waking anyone up if you come home late.
- room is close to the toilet and shower
- bath towels provided
- the family is just super pleasant and friendly! This alone makes the experience worthwhile :)
CONS:
- The MRT situation, depending on how you look at it.
- the household generally wakes up super early, and there is no soundproofing into your room so you will wake up if you're a light sleeper. Make sure to carry earplugs with you if you plan on sleeping in.
- no shampoo or bath soap on the washroom, so make sure you have our own accessories.

This was the.first time we visited this area of SGP and we had a comfortable month. The hosts were very friendly and professional. They were working most of the time and we were out everyday so we hardly met, but the distance was perfect for us.
The room was just right for my wife and 2yrs old girl. We were told the maid will clean every once a week, but had to ask everytime since she will easily forget. Really great place,  very unique and spacious and a very lovely host

The house and room are really nice. It has all the basic amenities that you'll need and much more. It really does feel like home away from home.
Really happy!!
Sheryl is a very nice host. She always replied instantly and her attitude very good. The place is exactly like the picture shown. Love the neighborhood.

wow the highview level 30 of city over parts chinatown and cbd is amazing! windy room with fresh air!

Violet is such a warm host. Her family's nice and friendly too, including Maya their dog. I had a meaningful rest when I stayed in their place. The beach park is a few minutes' walk which was very relaxing as well. A great first experience with airbnb!

We had a very good stay with Violet and her family. Spacious room with airco and a very good bed. Also the bathroom was very pleasant. Such an amazing experience to stay at their place.  The whole family was so accomodating.  The place is a hidden gem. Few minutes walking to the beach and park with good restaurants and bike rentals. Great stay at Violet s place , thanks for your warm welcome.

Violet is an excellent host. I almost felt home. Dianne

Keave was very nice host everything worked well..
he was very helpful with any questions i had during my stay at his place.

Very helpful.
Room condition is not bad, decent property for short stay in Sg.

Solid, communicative renter. No major complaints, though cleaner floors and more in shape couch would be appreciated. My rent was a little pricey compared with competing renters in the area.
房东回复及时，入住时有详细的PDF文档指导入住，路线清晰；有个人的带锁冰箱，还有相对个人的客厅和淋浴间，不过是用布帘遮挡隔开的；公共卫生间较小，要是大胖子就有点挤；网络速度很快，周边生活方便，就在牛车水地铁上面，有好多小吃。性价比比较高，但是要是对卫生条件要求特别高的就要慎重，不过，要是条件好了，也不会是这个价格了。
This place is in the heart of China Town and a great cultural experience. Kaurus was very communicative and available for any queries.

good location

Sumans townhouse is fabulous! Great colourful decor with large bedroom leading onto to balcony. The place was very clean and the houskeeper very friendly and helpful.  A great choice,

It was a treat to stay at Suman's beautiful house. The 5 star description does not decesive, this truly was a luxurious experience. As for location, this was a funky neighbourhood with some great restaurants and shops nearby.

We had a wonderful time at Suman's home... the entire house is made very lavishly.. there is a nice balcony beside the room..though it is quite far from the city, there is good connectivity of bus and MRT..had a comfortable stay..and would definitely like to stay again. Recommended!

Suman Place was definitely a five star home.  The shower is amazing and there is a balcony off the room that is comfortable to hang out at night. Thumbs up to this beautiful house and the worry free checkin, check out.

Thank you, Suman to share a such nice house with us.

There is probably not a nicer Air BnB accommodation in all of SE Asia. Suman and Jason have a beautifully appointed home. Your room and bathroom are indeed "five star." Although you have a bit of a ride to get to the action in Singapore, the benefit of being near the reservoir more than makes up for any commute to the city.

I will certainly consider this for my next stay in Singapore

Suman was a friendly host with professional approach. I appreciated her really quick replies. She has a beautiful house in quiet and green neighborhood. The room is very comfortable with enough space and a terrace looking west. The rain shower in the bathroom is great after all day activity. I was happy the house was not overcooled by A/C like many other places in Singapore. We enjoyed our stay, slept well and recommend this place to other travellers!
Suman's home is gorgeous and she and her helper were lovely. There a lot of eating shops just down the road (walking distance) free parking on the street. Would definately stay here again.

The place is fabulous. Yes, definitely better than a five star. You can see that a lot of thought was put into every single detail. The room is exactly the way you see it in the picture. Suman's home is indeed 5 stars! Enjoyed my stay there. Room was gorgeous and bathroom was awesome. Host is very friendly accomdating and will ensure that everything is alright throughout our stay.Lots of food places nearby. Not forgetting the reservoir just 5 mins away, definitely worth a visit. Will stay here again in future.
We had a great time at Suman's place! She was a really nice host, giving us tips what places to go to. We would book it again.

Confortable and beautiful room although bit far from center. It is a family house and they have several rules that let you know when you arrive. We missed can use the kitchen at less to prepare breakfast. You only have the option to pay and they prepare breakfast for you but its quite expensive. To go inside the house we had to use an sliding window because they didn't gave us the keys of the door and one of the nigth was closed, we arrive at 23:00 and we were knocking the door and calling Suman but we couldn't get inside until 00:30, and because other guest woke up and opened us the window. I don't know why they don't give you the keys of the main door.

La habitación es preciosa y aunque hace mucho calor tiene aire acondicionado y ventilador, la casa es muy bonita pero alejada del centro (necesitas coger bus y MRT para ir a cualquier sitio). La casa es enorme pero existen una serie de normas que te entregan al entrar donde se indica que no se alquila la casa solo tienes derecho a usar la habitación, ni siquiera la cocina ni para prepararte el desayuno, eso si, pagandalo no hay problema. Es algo impersonal comparado con otros Airbnb que hemos usado antes con un trato mucho más cercano, es más como un bed&breakfast, pagando este último a parte claro. Solo te dan la llave de la puerta de fuera (de la calle) y debes de entrar por una ventana corredera, lo cual me parece falta de confianza total, una de las noches llegamos sobre las once y la ventana la habían cerrado y nos pasamos llamando a la puerta y por teléfono a la propietaria más de una hora hasta que otro de los invitados se despertó y nos abrió (casi a las una de la mañana).

Susan and Jason are friendly, ease to relate with, helpful and accomodating. The room is fabulous..spacious, well decorated, comfy and just a step away from bathroom. The deck with private access is a big bonus too. I enjoy my night sitting there to chill privately. All the amenities are very good qualities. Easy acces to mrt station and city. Bus stop just 2 minutes walk from the house. Will recommend this place to anybody visiting sing.
Suman is a nice host, she provides everything you need, and her house is really so big and nice, with many nice decorations. There are a food court and many restaurants nearby.

Everything about the room is excellent... it is large, comfortable, plus you have access to a balcony. The host is also very friendly. The location is great provided you don't mind a 5 minute taxi ride from the MRT station. I personally liked that I was in a quiet neighbourhood. If you expect to be out past midnight on a regular basis, you'll be better off staying close to the CBD, but otherwise this is perfect.

suman is really nice host and the coolest person i have ever met. room is also nice and comfortable. the thing I love was taking a rest in balcony after sightseeing singapore. My mom loved this place. she woke up early and walked around suman's place.  she flet like being singaporean! I hesitated because of the location, but it was great to stay in her house no doubt!

when we arrived, we were not being led by the host as she disappeared after guided us to the entrance so we had to call her out to show our room this was first impression. the house is really more than five stars...so nice house, however, we couldn't enjoy it because it was not for guest. Like she mentioned, there were no TV, fridge and no Kitchen. you can put some small food inside of their fridge. the washing room is shared with another guest room. the good points are the room and balcony...they're really beautifully decorated. We had a very romantic night at the balcony. Even though there were some inconveniences, my wife eventually loved to stay this house.

Although Suman was not in town during the duration of our stay, her housekeeper was extremely welcoming, friendly and made our stay very comfortable. We absolutely love the balcony and the rain shower. The whole house is wonderfully designed - architecturally as well as the interior design. The bed was amazingly comfortable and we were provided with more than adequate toiletries. The place was conveniently located - a quick bus ride away from great cafes and food.

This was my first Airbnb experience and was very apprehensive of what was to be. Right to the point of being at the front door I was ready to forfeit the deposit and turn around. The idea of walking into a stranger’s house was rather unsettling for me. Lucky I didn't back out as looking back, the whole experience was absolutely hassle-free and fabulous. Just to back track a bit here, I put in my request for a room for two nights late Wednesday afternoon November 29th for that very evening, and Suman the host of the house responded promptly. When the necessary paper work was in order she sent me detailed directions to her place and was quick to respond to my sms messages. When I got there Suman greeted me and her helper carried my bag to my room. Suman could not have been more welcoming and pleasant host, and was an absolute a delight to chat with. I felt like I was in a friend’s home within minutes.

The home was beautiful. Very spacious - very stylish - and most importantly meticulously clean. The accommodation met and exceeded the listing description by a long shot. The room was large, beautifully appointed, with a lovely desk for my computer, plenty of shelf and closet space to hang up clothes and a very comfortable queen bed. The air conditioner in the room worked well and there was also a ceiling fan. Bathroom was very clean, modern, and after a long days work it felt great just standing under the rain shower in an oversized bath area. Large glass sliding doors gave me direct access from the bedroom to the verandah, which had deck chairs and lovely mood lighting at night. While I was gone most of the day, it was easy to tell that the room would have access to plenty of natural light.

Five minutes up the street from Suman’s place were a selection of nice restaurants and cafes to select from. The location of the house also had quick and easy access to public bus and taxi service.

Suman thanks very much for hosting me. While I was only renting a room, I felt like I had the house to myself. Without any hesitation I would give your place a 6 STAR thumbs up. All the very best.

Cheers,
Mario

I enjoyed my stay with Suman, Jason and their 2 lovely boys. The room was perfect, just as pictured with a nice balcony and bathroom, great AC and very comfortable. Suman was very helpful and explained the best places to go for runs, how to get a taxi, etc... The bus stop was very close by (less than a 5 minute walk) which was very convenient to get around Singapore. I enjoyed breakfast with them on Saturday morning. Please note that there is another room available and if someone else stays there, then it is a shared bathroom. The bathroom and bedroom were kept exceptionally clean daily and there were many toiletries and extras stocked in the bathroom. I definitely recommend staying here if you want to be in a nice, more suburban area close to a great running park and reservoir.

A beautiful place to stay and feel like a local instead of a tourist! Suman and her family have been a perfect 'home' to stay.

The room is exactly as it is described and shown on the photos. Which means a 5-star quality room, bathroom and amenities, and a gorgeous house. The area is lovely, local and quiet, with a really good coffee place around the corner. It is relatively far away from the city center, but don't let that scare you. Several bus lines around the corner, and a taxi can always be called anytime.

But the best part about staying here isn't actually the place itself, rather the feeling of being welcome and feeling comfortable. Suman and her family made me feel very welcome. They made the stay very easy-going, gave advice, and we had personal conversations, which made it not just a trip, but an experience!

If you're looking for a local, high-quality, and welcoming experience, I recommend trying airbnb with Suman.
This is our second time back! Once again, it was lovely and perfect. Suman is a fantastic host. Great communication and always pleasant. Will definitely be back.

I've had a lovely stay at Suman's place. The room is clean, nice and looks even bigger that the photo. Although she was out of Singapore, she has been very thoughtful and follow up what I need during my stay. Her housekeeper bahadur was very helpful as well. I would definitely recommend this place to others and love to stay there again in the future.

Gorgeous home in a great suburb, eating place just a stroll away and a lovely bedroom. Suman was away but left very clear instructions and her gentle house man was v helpful.
We walked to Peirce reservoir across th road and took a Short bus ride to Macritchie reservoir for a more extensive walk. A perfect location for us and a good respite from th main drag.
I enjoyed my stay. The house is clean and the housekeeper is willing to help. The facilities are top class and the balcony is an extra feature you don't have in hotels.
Everything smooth Suman's helper was very helpful as she herself was out most of the time but at checkout I was able to briefly meet my host and she is extreme nice and we had a very pleasant chat.

Suman has it well organized. Directions are good, description is good, the help showing you to the room.....  I am in Singapore on a regular basis for work and this was a real nice alternative over a hotel. Of course, you will find yourselves in the house of someone else, but staying at Suman's is a pleasure. Loved the balcony with and without rain. The airco is good, quiet and a must in Singapore. When you look for a city center location this is not it, but for me the location is perfect, since it is walking distance to my office and I love the local shops and food court. There is a convenient bus into the city.

Awesome house with really nice host family! Suman is a charming lady,she wrote very detailed instructions for guests to make sure a pleasant stay.Her little boy took an initiative to help me carry the luggage ,and her parents shared their culture and food with me in a kind way. I do enjoy my stay at Suman's place and highly recommend it.

Suman's home is beautiful, clean and safe. I highly recommend this place if you are looking to stay in singapore for 2 weeks or more.

The only minor setbacks of this private room are the shared bathroom and the lack of facilities to lock the room when you are out.

It was a very good experience stayed in this brilliant house for 2 days. Although the locate might be far away from the city center, the enviornment and the air there was very very fresh. Also,  we received warmly welcome by Suman. Overall a nice trip in Singapore

Anyway,I like the trip and restarants nearby the house.

Thanks you Suman.

The house is wonderful and the room amazing. Located in a great area very closed to shops, parks and 15 min by cab to downtown. The host and her assistant are very nice and kind. I definetely suggest this place as a great deal.

Sumans house is beautiful and the room tastefully deccorated. I wish I  had booked for longer. It was a home away from home and that was the best part, I was able to sleep very well. Her housekeeper is so kind and helped me with the suitcase etc. The toiletries provided were top of the line, I reall couldnt have asked for more. It was better than staying at a five star hotel:) I will come back again soon!!!

This was first ever AirBNB experience and I was very nervous at first. As soon as I entered Suman's house I was welcomed and felt comfortable within few minutes.

The house and the room is in immaculate condition and had all extras that you would not even find in hotels. I had forgotten my international charger and was so glad to find it in my room. The Wifi password was already on my table with instructions - Great! Suman is well organised. We had a great conversation and Suman even offered to drive me into town as it was pouring and I could not find any Taxis or Uber.

Bahadur who is a helping hand was great and helped me with getting few things sorted. Thank you Bahadur!

My stay was great - I can't thank Suman enough for been such an excellent host.

Fabulous!
If I'm limited to describe my experience in one world at Suman's place....Fabulous!!!

- The place is more pretty than the pictures...

- neat, extremely clean...
- and I love the balcony out side the bedroom... It's really big..I love having breakfast, suntanning, reading, dinner there.... It's a very luxury space to have in SG....

And I have just renewed on more week here, what more?
I will definitely come back!!!
Lilian

I will always come back...
Just renewed one more week at Suman's... It's truly great pleasure to be here... Hardworking day, and relaxing eve at the place, running in the park - 3 minutes walking distance away truly balance the work stress out...

My first time using Airbnb and I'm glad I managed to get this place. Host is very friendly. Comfy & cozy place to come back to after a long day sightseeing. All amenities are as available as described. Will come back here if I ever decide to go to Singapore again. Recommended!

Thank you Auntie, I'll definitely come back to your place next time!

Convenient location.  Room is big and you can find everything you need for an apartment.  Shirley is very nice, fast response and always there to provide assistance.  We will definitely stay in Shirley's apartment again when we come back next time.

가족여행으로 대학생, 중학생 자녀와 같이하는 싱가포르 여행을 준비했습니다. 숙소는 아이들이 커서 4명이 함께 묵을 수 있는 에어비앤비로 검색하였구요. 유독 평가수가 많고, 만족도가 높은 Shirley 의 집으로 정했습니다.

Shirley's place is amazing! The name of her place is 100% accurate. The apartment is spacious and the amenities are great. They cleaned the place everyday. It felt like we were at a hotel.
