We stayed here last week (me, hubby, and 2 adolescent kids), and it's PERFECT. We wanted an accessible, relaxing, and somewhat private place, and were lucky to stumble upon Shirley's listing.
The place is in a lovely residential neighborhood. It's not within the city central, but it's 3 mins. away from an MRT station and a couple of bus stops. So it's very easy to get around, as you have several options. We had our own entrance and private room, with a lovely mini-garden outside, so if you just want to relax and listen to the birds, you can.
The food options near the area are also fantastic. There was this fantastic Indian restaurant just 5 mins from the place that served awesome biryani. And a great Chinese place beside it, too. Not to mention a couple of 7-11s in the area where we would buy breakfast which we would microwave back at the place.
There's also a reason why Shirley is a super host. She sent us lots of tips in pictures and documents a week before our trip, e.g., where to buy attraction tickets, MRT cards, etc. We had no trouble finding her place at all, bec of pictures and maps she sent.
She had clear instructions for how to use things. She even lets you use slippers and umbrellas, as long as they're returned. She was out when we got in, but her associate welcomed us. And then when she arrived, she came by to say hello. She was very sweet to kids, even giving them a pack of candy. She'd chat with us whenever we were available, giving more tips about where to eat, etc. Also, she sent over some lovely tea that she made from the flowers in her garden!
We definitely highly recommend Shirley's listing and would come back here again, given the opportunity.

This was our first experience with Airbnb. We were very pleased with the results. The apartment was perfectly located for a visit to Singapore. In the heart of the city and close to the MRT (subway) system.

Although we never met Stephanie personally, she was an excellent host. She responded to emails within a couple of hours at the outside and made sure that everything was in place, even when our arrival was delayed by 14 hours (because of a missed flight due to bad weather).

The apartment was clean and the bed was very comfortable. There were sockets for all international plugs, good WiFi and free laundry right outside our door. The bathroom is modern and functions well. The air conditioning was reliable and kicked in quickly when we started it after a day of being outside.

A couple of things to note. The apartment is very small. Yes, it is a studio, but the image of the bed gives the impression of something a bit larger. You enter to a long narrow hallway that ends at the bed. There is a small kitchenette area (with fridge and heating appliances) on the right and a little desk on the left. It is fine as long as you plan to be in the apartment mainly for sleeping.

Also, the design of the bathroom is such that water from the shower invariable leaks down the steps leading up to the bathroom. Not a huge deal and you can wipe it up with a towel, but you have to do it every time.

Finally, the apartment is located right on the river at the start of a string of restaurants and bars. As we dozed off at night, we could hear / feel the faint beat of music from one of the nearby bars. But it did not disturb our sleep, especially with the air conditioning (which you need in Singapore!).

All in all, this apartment is very good value for the money. You have clean, well-functioning accommodation, an excellent host and a superb location. It is an ideal spot for two people in Singapore.

There are food courts (BK Eating house, Hainan) if you are on a budget and they will refuel you just fine (you need to try hard to spend more than $12/person).

Overall great stay if you are a traveler and looking for prime location, eateries nearby and use the place for resting after a tiring day of

Pros: Great service, great location, nice views from the room window. Cons: Room is rather small. It’s basically a hotel room with a small kitchen and bathroom. And WiFi can be finicky.
great place to stay at a fantastic location. lovely view of the SG river and MBS
Fantastic river views & sweet staff! Request a physical key ideally, much easier check in.

The service from the entire team has been beyond anything I have ever experienced at an Airbnb. Incredibly communicative, friendly and more than willing to help wherever possible. Location is amazing too

I love Heritage, there are so many things that you can see and do there.... many restaurants, beautiful scenery to see...or you even can relieve your stress by jogging/walking around there....
Nice and friendly host....
Excellent location and very quiet. Staff is professional and quick
Extremely good location right on the river.
Great value/price, even though it’s above the river line bar district, it’s actually very quiet, especially after 10:30pm. Great team, very friendly and attentive.

excellent place, really close to everywhere. food, gym, bars, principal place to visit in the city. I loved it.
great staff, Kenneth, Mubien, Irean, Hanna and Heera are always in touch and help in case you need anything.

You could not ask for better in terms of view and location. Overlooking the Singapore River with Parliament House and Boat Quay just outside is amazing. You don't get to live there and also expect quiet. It was not as noisy as I thought, but there is some some noise. I would stay here again.
Fantastic hosts in a great location
Nice place ! but little noisy
Room was good. Staff was great.

I really enjoyed my stay at Heritage. Its an approved hotel for the Vaccinated travel lane visitors. The location is amazing and everything is within a 30 min walking distance. Kenneth, Irean and Wenney were really helpful. I had an early arrival and was able to store my Luggage until my room was ready.
Great location, very caring with private WhatsApp group only for me.  It was very easy to communicate with the staff even they don’t have a concierge
Very patient and always ready to help. Definitely recommend 👍🏻
Its a nice place, very happening at night. Host is very helpful. Nice experience. Will stay again in the future

Great location between 2 MRT’s and right on Clarks Quay. Lot of restaurents and nightlife around and a spectacular view of the skyline of Singapore from room and top roof bar in particular. 20 points from me if that even exists
Good location complicated check in process especially if you arrive late evening
really liked the place. its right in the center of everything. good for walking and also for local eats

This team is the most responsive team with which I have ever had the pleasure of corresponding regarding accommodation! It was an excellent experience to stay here. It was smooth and easy. I would say the best parts about this place were definitely 1) the communicativeness of the team and 2) the location! Many other things were great but I would say those two were the best. The room was very lovely and also functional. The view was wonderful. The biggest drawback is, in part due to the ideal location, there is some street noise on Fridays and Saturdays. This is unfortunate but I remedied this with white noise (you could use YouTube on the television in the room, your phone, or something else). I would have no hesitation staying here again — //especially// on weeknights. Thanks so much to Wendy, Irean, and Ken — I’m very grateful!

Very courteous and professional customer service, very attentive to details and very friendly.
The room was small but clean and modern, and the location was fantastic, with a nice view of the Singapore River.
Only negatives:
(1) There were washing machines and dryers right outside the door (room 207), and people were using them at all hours, which made A LOT of noise. This is NOT acceptable. If they cannot find another place for the machines, at least let the person know what they are in for if they book this room.
(2) There was someone (apparently a restaurant) next door doing renovations, using hammers and a hammer drill frequently EVEN AFTER 10PM! Thankfully, when I contacted the Heritage staff about it, they took care of it immediately.
Overall: great staff, great location, clean and modern, but a few small things that could be improved.
Awesome location and views

Great space in a brilliant location- ideal for exploring Singapore. The room had everything we needed and the hosts kindly arranged an early check in which was appreciated. The key is via a phone app which can be a little temperamental, but otherwise no issues. We hope to be back!

Heritage was a very pleasant place to stay. Had all the necessities and was accurate to the pictures. The location and view from our window was probably the best part! We were walking distance from most tourist things and had a ton of tasty restaurants right outside.

Wonderful place, incredible view, close to everything. Really perfect for a longer stay. A little loud on Friday and Saturday nights but that is too be expected. They were very responsive over whatsapp.

The team that look after the accommodation do a great job to make it a hassle free experience! The room is excellent value, it has all the necessary amenities for an individual or couple stay and is in a fantastic location! The view from the room out the window to the river and skyline is worth the cost alone. Check-in was straight forward and well supported, and we were confident if we had any needs during our stay the team would be very responsive. The building sits above a busy dinning district, so there can be some noise from the restaurants in the evenings, but we found the double glazed windows drowned out the bulk of the late night noise. Can't recommend the place enough for value and location! Thanks!!
Great location. Great staff. Made visiting Singapore an exceptional experience since I was at the heart of it all.
A good place to stay, very conveniently located, excellent operations team!
Perfect location for exploring Singapore. The room was great, and the hosts were very helpful.
Great location. just the right size for what was needed. Helpful when help was needed. Thank you.
The air conditioning in the room was not adequate, but everything else was fine.
Great Airbnb! Very clean and primely located close to bars, restaurants, malls, shops and Hawler stalls. Highly recommend and would deff rent again the next time I’m back in Singapore!

This was a truly great experience. Jarwin, John and their whole team provide an amazing service. They were highly responsive and very helpful. The apartment was clean and was located in a great neighborhood. Highly appreciated their assistance and can fully recommend working with them!
Great value and super location. Recommended.
Great hotel @ a great price in a great location! Plethora of pubs & dining options. Just eat, drink & party.. then go upstairs to sleep. No walking, no fighting for taxi. #Bliss!

I truly enjoyed my stay here. The location is just amazing with view of river and MBS in one frame. The cleanliness, the easy check-in, the furniture and everything was hassle-free. The hosts were amazing and very helpful, any assistance was just a WhatsApp message away. Kudos to the team, Irean, Mary, Naw, Jun wee, Ken and Jarwin. I will surely be recommending this and be back here sometime in the future.

The Good: The space is great. Clean, convenient location. Hosts were responsive. Gave me a keycard to use rather than my phone to open the door.
The Bad: I did not realize that the room would be on top of a bar with loud music from 2pm to 4am. After 4 days (of a 10 day stay), I asked to check out early because it was simply too loud. I couldn't handle the bass non stop. It really was bad. In their defense, I think there are other rooms available in the building that might not have the loud noise problem.
The Solution: The host was able to move me to another hotel nearby. That room was spectacularly calm, clean, quiet. Everything I had wanted in the original room.
I would book again with Heritage but confirm that the room I get is not a room that is above a bar...

Le logement est extrêmement bruyant par la présence d'une boite de night à l'étage et un restaurant au Rez-de-chaussée . Prévoir des boules Quies jusqu'à 3 h du matin tous les jours.
C'est dommage car le studio est bien placé , propre et l'accueil très serviable .

This property was great for our trip to Singapore. The room listing was very accurate - we didn't spend too much time in the room but when we did we found it to be comfortable and spacious. The staff are extremely friendly and helpful. They added me a messaging group so I could ask any questions and someone usually answered immediately.
The property itself was located very conveniently. It's right on the famous Boat Quay. We were in room 401 and had a fantastic view of the Singapore River and Marina Bay Sands. It was less than a 5min walk to Clarke Quay MRT and about a 10min walk to Raffles Place. Between these two stations, interchanging to most MRTs within Singapore was a breeze. If you don't mind walking for about 15 minutes you can access most of the popular food centres from here as well.
A couple of things to be aware of: the key-card system for the property is Bluetooth based via an app on your phone. It also requires you to disable NFC when in use, which might be an issue if you use G Wallet/Apple Pay to pay for things. If you struggle with smart phone apps, you might want to contact the hotel staff for alternate arrangements.
The other thing to note is that the property is very close to a bar/club that plays loud music till very late/early in the morning. As someone who usually falls asleep fairly easily, I was kept up a few nights by the loud bassy music and the noise of the revellers spilling out into the street. This would usually last till about 2am-3am. If you're able to sleep with earplugs or headphones it shouldn't be an issue. From our anecdotal experience, the music usually began to ramp up at about 4pm.
All in all I was very happy with our stay here. Thanks team!
Love the convenience of this place! Mary & Naw were also incredibly responsive to all our needs!

We had a great stay here this past week. The room was clean, self-check in was smooth, and location was close. to a lot of attractions in the city.
Special shout out to Mary and Naw who were able to accomodate some last minute requests post-check-in. Thanks both!
Great location super convenient and central.

I thought the location & the room was excellent. You will get some noise from the crowds @ the restaurants but you get used to it after the first night. The bar on the rooftop was one of the highlights of Singapore @ incredible views. The bed was comfortable & the room well equipped. I’d recommend the Heritage & thanks for your hospitality.
A great place to stay if you like to be in the centre of a buzzling city and nightlife 😁

Nice overall location during the stay with a kitchen including large fridge. The room is on the smaller side, but you get what you pay for. Our main feedback is based on the back riverside room 308, which was very noisy. The music from the neighbors would start around 8pm and last through 4am. Not only was it very loud, but the loud vibrations from the music made it difficult to ever get a good night’s sleep.
Separately, during check-in, there was lack of communication or signage as to where room 308 was. The sign for the laundry would’ve been helpful to also include signage that additional rooms where through the doors. Lack of signage for our room and response made it very difficult to self-check in.
Heritage Collection Boat Quay is a great property with a beautiful view. Our hosts Mary and Naw Gem did an amazing job of onboarding and helping us throughout the stay.
All good, perfect communication and always helpful.
Heritage Boat Quay is a great location from which to reach everywhere if interest easily. Very helpful staff were always available.

My stay with Heritage was amazing. Certainly one of my top best stays I’ve had through AirBnb. Mary and Naw were lovely and went above and beyond to ensure I had everything I needed throughout my stay. Min, in housekeeping, was amazing as well.
The apartment was perfect, a really clean and well-equipped space. The view over Boat Quay was beautiful, too! The location was stellar, right above the main restaurants in a very active neighbourhood. A conveniently located 24hrs 7/11 just outside as well. If you are a light sleeper I would recommend earplugs for the evening, but I never had a problem with the noise.
Overall, I very much recommend staying with Heritage during your stay in Singapore - I know I’ll be back next time!
The staff were fantastic and friendly, helped us out with a few issues! Would gladly stay again

The room itself and location were both fantastic, good air con and the bed was comfortable too. The guest experience team, Mary and Naw were absolutely amazing and assisted us greatly.
We ended up checking out early due to the nightclub music being so loud that the bass reached us on the fourth floor, and not even ear plugs helped us. It went till 4am every night (Sunday, Monday and Tuesday). We are not usually light sleepers either. We would consider this to be more than “street noise”. We would have accepted a new room from Heritage if they had one available but unfortunately, they didn’t.
If you’re not bothered by night club music, then the place is great.

The location is great and the communication with the staff is fantastic. our room was a little small for 2 people and the tv was not a smart one. ( i.e. no android connectivity). Restaurants and bars are really close so food was no problem.

This is a great location, the staff is very helpful and the rooms are great. However I need to mention to future guests about the volume on the streets. There is a nightclub nearby and it made it very difficult for me to sleep. The team relocated me to another room which was a bit less noisy but still noticeable.  I ended up putting on this white-noise in my headphones which helped a bit.

Location, location, location. I've travelled to Singapore plenty of times and this has to be one of the best locations for going around. From the property you can easily walk to the National Museum and National Gallery. Orchard Road isn't too far and neither is Marina Bay.
As mentioned in other reviews, if you follow everything this will probably be one of the smoothest check-ins ever. However, you can't go anywhere without your phone that has the mobile key. I can imagine that being very inconvenient if it happened. That said, this property worked for me because everything was electronic and automated.
Mary and Ryan were very helpful and proactive and started communicating even before I landed.
Overall, 100% would stay here again on my next trip.
Great place, great location, recommend 100%

Great location if you're looking to be near the nightlife in Singapore. Restaurants, bars, shopping centers, and grocery stores are nearby (walking distance). Self check-in was easy. The girl who worked up front was really nice and always made sure everything was good with my accommodations.
Great place to stay in Singapore, close to retaurants and bars. I was hosted by very friendly and responsive team (Mary, Irean and Ryan)

The apartment is exactly like in the pictures! It is small, but well furnished and comfortable. It is a self-checkin place, but the staff is very responsive and you can communicate with them from your phone or from a panel in the entrance of the building. In general, Irean and Ryan were always very friendly and kind! The location is amazing, from the windows there is view to the river and the Marina Sands Bay in the background. Clarke Quay is full of amazing places to eat and it is very lively at night. Obviously, this means that it is not going to be as quiet at night as a property in a more remote place. For sure I will stay there again when I return to Singapore.

Great deal and very helpful and friendly staff. The room was very small, but clean and comfortable, and accurately described in picture.
Only downside with this particular unit is that it is right above a restaurant on Boat Quay that plays bass thumbing music literally until 4 in the morning, every night. Not great for a business traveler (me) but might be great for Boat Quay party goers who stay up all night, or folks that sleep through anything (not me). I understand that the company has other properties nearby which are likely quieter. I will try that next time.

Irean and Ryan have been super responsive in the chat room they created for me, and super helpful from check-in arrangement, extending stay, to helping me move my bulky suitcases to another wing 30 meters away, to help me smoothly check out with suitcase storage.
Great place! 10/10

The room is absolutely perfect, with a comfy bed and a nice small kitchen to prepare coffee/tea etc. The staff is very kind and helpful, and it’s also nice that the laundry services are complimentary. The listing mentions that there will be street noise, and warns visitors that it may be loud, but I want to make it clear that it is not “street noise”, it is specifically a night club that blasts music until 3-4am every night. Even with ear plugs it was quite noisy. The staff do offer earplugs to guests when needed, which was nice. Otherwise an excellent stay, and the location is super walkable to everywhere.

Very central location right on boat quay. The building has a rooftop bar with beautiful views of marina bay. Downside is the constant noise at night with bars and restaurants downstairs keeping music volume high til early morning.
Team was super responsive and helpful. Still, checkin is only possible through downloading of mobile app. And the same app is required every time you enter the building / elevator / unit. Not the most convenient option, in my opinion.
I also asked to change the dates of my reservation as I had a business commitment. Was supposed to be leaving singapore one night earlier, but the team was unable to accommodate my change. Even though I would have still met the minimum stay requirements.
All in all, it is a good option for a few nights.

Absolutely incredible place to stay in the heart of Boat Quay.
Unlike other complaints the noise from the bars isn’t too bad, sound proofing is great.
Very responsive and will definitely be staying again!
Great stay, king bed was a plus! A little noisy on Boat Quay at night but otherwise fantastic! Will def book Heritage Apartments again as they loads of locations in Singapore. Thanks!
AC blowing on bed

The location, communication, and accommodations were all top notch.  As the property description and other reviews mention, the street noise can be heard.  However, as someone who is a pretty solid sleeper, I found it to be much more disruptive than expected.  The neighboring establishments have incredibly loud music until 3-4am (weekdays and weeknights).  This is no reflection of Heritage Collection, as my experience with them was top notch.  However, due to the property placement this is something other travelers should consider.  Great for night owls, but can be an issue for others.
so good.will come back again.
Great location and hosts. My 2nd time there and will book again in Feb. 2024 when I go to SGP again. Prefer a room with a kitchen sink like my first time there😁

Well kept place, looks same as shown in images in listings. Beautiful view, clean and well maintained house. Felt like home. The host was very communicative and helpful to make check-in and check-out easy. The location is prime, all prime landmarks are in walking distance (1-3 km). Many restaurants downstairs with variety of foods.
Great place and great value.  Minor warning for very light sleepers: the wonderful location on Boat Quay comes with a little outside noise.  We slept fine.  Our contact, Ryan, was very helpful.
Ryan ,Loc,Kim and Divina were very responsive and helpful ..Ryan especially .He helped me with my luggage and was very friendly .The place was very neat and bathrooms were great ..thanks
Great location and comfortable studio. Hosts are very responsive

I had a rather disappointing experience with this Airbnb host. Firstly, the host tried to deceive me by asking me to cancel the booking on Airbnb and then book again on their personal website, where I was subjected to numerous baffling charges. They charged an absurd 30 Singapore dollars for a room key, which they only gave because their own app wasn’t functioning properly. The property lacked basic services; I found hair on the bed and the location was incredibly noisy, with the noise persisting till 4 AM. I strongly advise against staying here. I've also lodged a complaint with Airbnb regarding these issues.
Enjoyed our stay here.

Bad experience overall. No early access, you literally have to wait till exactly 15.00 to check in. Had to go through 2 different check in processes/forms and had to give certain info 3 times! After the check in process the room was still not available as they still needed to do major cleaning. Even after that the room was not clean and I had to do some cleaning myself. There were stains in the shower curtain and on one of the towels and I also found a brush in the bathroom and a sweater stuck between the bed and the wall. There is only on site personell from 9 to 5 and both on-site and off site resources are not helpful or considerate. Would not recommend them
Everything was excellent and perfect. We were greatly assisted by the host, and he was always available to us. Looking forward to meeting you soon.
We enjoyed our stay here. Great location with plenty of nightlife around the area.

Great location, clean apartment, easy to get into and very responsive host.
Highly recommend staying here.

Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Man hatte eine schöne Aussicht auf das Marina Bay Sand vom Bett aus. Die Restaurants vor dem Hotel können bis 3 Uhr Nachts aufhaben und etwas lauter sein, dass ist der einzige Punkt der etwas negativ ist. Wir konnten aber trotzdem ohne Probleme schlafen. Bei Problemen wird einem über WA sehr schnell geantwortet und geholfen.
Good location! The listing is as pictured, and clean. Check-in was really easy and the Hosts communicated well and ensured we were well supported throughout the stay.
Good place to stay and nearby great locations
Great host, great service. Will definitely recommend.
After a rough start with the check-in process, had to do with phones and local/my sim card , the whole stay was great. close to public transport, lots of food choices and stuff to do in the area

The heritage property was a pleasure to stay at. Easily accessible so obviously the location is perfect. Right near the MRT and many restaurants at Boat quay. There is a 7 eleven right around the corner too.  It was clean and the staff are extremely responsive. They even gave us recommendations for museums we wanted to check out since we had time to kill before the 3pm check in. Special mention to Ryan for always being around to help and guide us. My brother and I had a really pleasant stay and would recommend it to anyone who is okay with a little bit of noise from the street (wasn't a problem for us at all!) and who prefers a comparatively bigger room for the price.
Good place

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Singapour. Nous avions réservé à la base une chambre d’hôtel qui ne nous convenait pas alors nous l´avons quitté et réservé cet appartement au dernier moment. Il est très bien situé, très propre et dispose de toutes les fournitures nécessaires pour tout le séjour. Un grand merci à Angelika, Ed et Ryan. Je recommande ce logement à 100%! 😃
Great apartment, very close to the centre. A lot of food and entertainment options. Definitely recommended.

Great location right on the river and the staff, Angelika, Ed and Ryan, are super friendly and ultra responsive.  All in all a wonderful experience with them from check in to check out and throughout, always making sure we were ok.  Thank you guys!
Place and people were great.

Great location but since it's right on Boat Quay, it can get a little noisy into the late night. Didn't bother us but might bother some light sleepers.
The property hosts (Ryan, Ed & Angelika) were super responsive and kind. They helped us store our luggage before check in, always answered questions and checked in on us to see how we were doing. The many entrances to the hotel building were also useful so you never needed to go around the block to get to an mrt station or to boat quay.

Le logement était spacieux et très régulièrement nettoyé, l'équipe était très réactive et attentive et le système de clefs sur téléphone fonctionne super bien.
Le seul problème était le bruit, je conseille aux voyageurs de prendre des boucles quies en cire professionnelles pour pouvoir dormir, surtout les week-ends. Mais avec, on dort sans problème! Merci au staff pour ce séjour
We enjoy our stay. Thanks to Kim, Ed, Ryan and other staff for being responsive to our request .

Great experience and will definitely book again if I’m ever back in Singapore. Room was very nice for a single person (or even for a couple), very clean, plenty of space and a very nice view. Location is convenient and close to a lot of shops and a 5 min walk to a train station. The slight noise that some reviews have mentioned  is because of some bars and restaurants outside but honestly is not that bad (unless maybe for a light sleeper or elderly person, etc.).

The location is fantastic, bustling with life, and conveniently close to everything, with breathtaking views from the room. Kim, Ed, and Ryan are exceptional hosts, always going above and beyond to ensure a stress-free stay through proactive communication and assistance. I couldn't be happier with my experience.

Very good experience to staying here
everything is great and wonderful

let me say that Kim Ed and Ryan though I never saw them in person felt like my own personal concierge. I've never been treated like royalty before. my sun rises were beautiful my sunsets were amazing and the conveniences of everything make me want to come back right now. I will be back.

great
Thanks for Kim, Ed and Ryan’s great support.
Everything is so great.
Great location, very clean room, Absolute gem for the price. Noise wasn’t a problem, no different than most major city thoroughfares. Would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay, good communication . Can be a little noisy since it’s right at Boat Quay. But was alright! :)

We had a great time!
Thank you very much Edmar and Ryan🙏

Great place at a great price.
Keep in mind this is just over Boat Quay so is not the quietest place ever. Music and street chatter can be heard until 1-2AM.
The hosts are very responsive, and have been a pleasure to deal with.

The unit is really well located and right on the river.  Five minutes from the Clarke Quay MRT stop and convenient to the downtown, Chinatown and Little India areas, as well as all the activity at Clarke Quay.  The river is lined with restaurants and there is no shortage of food and beverage of all descriptions.  Modern and sparkling clean.  Heritage made a point to communicate but not over-communicate and were prompt in refunding the deposit.  Because there are restaurants on the river side, entrance to the building is on a small street in back of the building.  This is not meant to be detrimental but helpful when a taxi driver is challenged to find it.  I would definitely stay here again.

Another amazing stay with Heritage.  This apartment is in a great location. Yes, it’s a little small and you can hear noises  from the bars and restaurants outside at night but, its  location more than offsets those issues. The apartment has everything you will need during your stay including free use of washer and dryer in the building and there’s a great rooftop bar with an amazing view on the 5th floor.  I would definitely choose to stay here again.
good

Location is amazing and we had a great time. Property is clean and tidy. I would definitely recommend.
Check in was little headache.

Location is fantastic but comes with a lot of noise on weekends from bars and restaurants. I read reviews and came prepared with a noise machine. The staff is extremely helpful but be sure to read instructions before arrival as the entrance can be a bit confusing at first.
Preis-Leistungsverhältnis absolut in Ordnung. Gute Erreichbarkeit und zentrale Lage. Mit gedämpftem Musiklärm der angrenzenden Restaurants muss umgegangen werden können. Ist aber gut aushaltbar.

Amazing staff! Our late arrival at night did not pose a barrier for the staff to help us at the door. We had a representative show us how to handle the electronic at the entrance door, and the entrance to the apartment. The team was truly a digital concierge! Edmar, Cora, and Jona were quite communicative with us. They were proactive in responding to the minor issues we encountered, for example, they informed us that we had a faulty security box, but they could arrange for a technician to fix the issue. They did so quite quickly and were informative that the person what quickly visited just in case we were in the unit. Likewise, we reported an issue with the TV, and it was replaced immediately.
Mind that the space is quite cozy and may be more suitable for one visitor rather than a couple. One of us had to climb over the other since the bed was placed against three walls.
Also, the neighborhood is lively; expect noise and music at night, so if you are a light sleeper beware.
Great place with easy walking distance to the MRTs. Place was large enough for two of us to be comfortable.

Le premier logement proposé était bruyant la nuit mais le staff d’Heritage nous a rapidement proposé un autre logement dans un quartier beaucoup plus calme de Singapour. Le personnel est très réactif et les appartements très biens équipés.
Great apartment, everything was great! Thanks a lot and I booked my next stay already

Très bon emplacement, logement très agréable. Attention beaucoup de bruits la nuit entre le bar sur le toit et les nombreux bars dans la rue. Jusque 2 - 3h00 du matin. IL faut mettre la ventilation et les doubles fenêtres pour compenser
Exelente Todo 👌 me encanto muy organizado y bonito 🙏
all good, would do it again, thanks for hosting.
Good quality hotel, nice and clean. The only problem is that it is near the boat quay, and it is a bit noisy at night.
Good and tidy hotel, and the price is fair

We enjoyed our one-week stay at the Heritage studio apartment. We found it clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the online listing. The digital check-in process proved to be somewhat cumbersome at the point of obtaining the digital key in a very hot lobby. Luckily, Maica and her team came to our rescue right away and provided us with a physical key card, which we ended up using instead of the phone app. The "cruise-ship-size" bathroom was clean, with a very nice shower. However, because of its size, we could have used a portable rack to hang our towels to dry. While you certainly cannot beat the studio location, the restaurants below and above stay lively and noisy well into the wee morning hours. Overall, we enjoyed our stay, and our thanks go out to Maica, Ed & Vannie for being available and making our visit to Singapore a very comfortable one.

The property was exactly as advertised, very well located, and a very generous size space given such a central location in Singapore. Amenities provided was perfect, and whilst there is indeed noise from the neighbouring bars/ restaurants in the evenings, noise canceling headphones did the trick no problem. Check-in issues were resolved quickly, and the Heritage team were very responsive. Highly recommend this property, and I would stay again :)
I enjoyed the stay a lot! The location is perfect. It was a bit noisy at night but not too much for sleeping. I will definitely come back here when I visit Singapore.

The Heritage Place was the perfect location to spend our trip to Singapore! We were walking distance from major tourist attractions and had easy access to public transit. Downstairs there’s a ton of great restaurants as well. The staff were very kind and helpful, especially when my sister wasn’t feeling well. They were always checking in and offering help. The AC and shower were really nice especially given how hot and humid it can be outside. All in all would 100% stay again and recommend to others.
The location is great tho sometimes you could hear your neighbors from the next room.

Great location. Due to location, we were able to walk to most of our destinations, so it was great for both sightseeing and minimizing unnecessary taxi expense. The location is above a nightlife hot spot, so definitely is as noisy as others have said. That said, I'm a noise-sensitive sleeper and had no issues falling asleep on any weeknights. Saturday night I did need to use headphones. My travel partner had no issues falling asleep any night.
The room was clean throughout and had all we needed. The bed was very comfortable. The concierge team was extremely proactive in providing instructions to locate and access the room, and in checking in to see if we needed anything as soon as we arrived. I did need to find a local pharmacy and received recommendations almost as soon as I asked. Thanks Vannie, Maica, and Edmar for a comfortable stay - it was exactly what we wanted!
Great accomodation. Great location with helpful staff

I have a great stay, value for money, lots of restaurant , accesable..
Great support. Always on whenever i need something.
Very good place to stay.

I will be back! Just absolutely perfect place for a week long stay in Singapore. I visited as a solo traveler for a conference. This place has everything you could want, nice private room, at a great value. Amazing location, food and restaurants everywhere, walkable and super close to train station. I could go on and on.
Also, wonderfully friendly hosts and staff. I had an issue with my card on the grab app on my way in from airport - Faiz was onsite and paid the driver personally while I sorted out my card! Saved me from a very stressful moment!
I saw some other reviews about noise. My room was right over the quay front side and I didn’t find it too bad, didn’t even need earplugs. It might be worse on the weekend, but overall was a non issue during my stay. Thank you to the team for a lovely experience 😊
Very clean place, I read the reviews people complaint about the noise, I came prepared but I can barely hear the noise outside. The room is spacious and every where is accessible!
It has been truly wonderful staying here, especially being surrounded by so many great restaurants. The food scene makes the whole experience even better.
Very amazing and nice treatment for their guests

Most professional Airbnb ever. Top-notch service and communication. Excellent bedding and functional décor. The studio (80 Boat Quay 407) has a stunning view over the river and Parliament and is well sound proofed. The nightclub bass thumps do penetrate some until 2-3 am, but we could still sleep. Pretty good kitchen with hot-plate burner for light cooking. Only quibbles: the unit needs a cooking vent to consume cooking odors, and the keyless system could be made less clunky (their mobile app for that is pretty slick, but it's still a bit of a pain to have to use it and wave your phone around to get around in the building).
Great view and great people. Very responsive and helpful when minor problems arose

Great stay at Boat Quay. Wishing to come back to different Heritage units in future work trips.
Recommended for long or short term stays. Has everything you need and more.
The place was clean, comfortable, easy to access with lots of things to do around. The river view was awesome, too.
Very good location, would definitely book again
Really helpful hosts. Edmar was always there for us when we needed something. Highly recommend staying here!
Very well located to the main sights, museums and restaurants.

This my 2nd stay at Heritage Collection South bridge boatquay and it felt home. Digital and onsite support is very supportive and responsive. Edmar and Vannie they are 24/7, always attending my needs.
clean and cozy apartment

The place is quite convenient: many restaurants nearby and two metro lines in 5-10 min walking. It’s close to Clarke Quay and shopping malls. The room is clean and its furnitures are in good condition. Since my room is close to the share laundry machines and dryers, it’s a bit loud when they were working.
By the way, the tissue papers provided were not sufficient and I could not find spare ones. There was also no dish-washing liquid.
Good location and nice place to stay
Amazing spot super close to Marina Bay Sands. Great amenities and very communicative hosts. Would def recommend and happily stay again.

My wife and I had a fantastic stay in this airbnb/hotel. Our window had a view of the river, Marina bay sands. There was tons of great restaurants and very easy to walk around. We stayed for a full week and it was perfect to go shopping, walk around to the tourist spots.
The only disclaimer is that it is right above the restaurants/bars which they did disclaim in the post that it could be noise, which it was but nothing my earplugs couldn’t solve. So do be aware of that.
Trisha, Shannen, and Edmar where a fantastic point of contact and made our stay lovely.
Love this place great view and superior cleanliness. I would definitely come back again.

Pros: Location because of MRT.
Very responsive host.
Washing machines
View
Cons: Noise during nights
a bit of less clean
Overall Good Stay. Will definitely consider for my next visit
Excellent price and location, very social neighbourhood, fantastic river view from my room. Thank you Jean, Edmar & Shannen!!
Everything was great! It’s difficult to find a similar place at this price in Singapore.

I had a great time at heritage, super convenient location. Cosy vibe inside and very comfortable bed. The staff, Edmar, Shannen & Jean were very accommodating and proactive in their support. Will stay again soon.

My stay at Heritage Collection was excellent! The hosts were incredibly attentive and responsive, and I had no issue checking in, checking out, accessing the building, etc. The only issue is that this is right on the Boat Quay waterfront, so I could only sleep with earplugs because of the loud music right outside and the bar upstairs. Otherwise, Edmar, Shannen, and Jean were very helpful at every step along the way. I will be back!

The property was so well located, right in the heart of Boat Quay with lovely river views over towards Marina Bay Sands. We walked nearly everywhere but it was only a short hop to the metro.
The apartment was super clean and had everything we needed.
Hosts were lovely - both the virtual and real life ones.
I would definitely recommend this property 💚

the room was spotless.  The location was excellent.  The view was spectacular. I found the facility reasonably quiet despite what some reviews stated. I spent 11 days here and had a tremendous experience
非常好的酒店呢。响应及时。工作人员热情有礼貌。酒店很大👍🏻就是房间里有台阶没注意看路会摔倒。其他的都非常满意。周边非常热闹。我不在乎晚上吵。
Great place to stay if you enjoy the nightlife. Bars and restaurants are right downstairs. Also, the staff Mary, Maybelle, Edmar, Shannen and Rome were amazing.
Great place to stay while in Singapore.

It was very clean and tidy and the staff were friendly. The location is great and as mentioned can be a bit noisy. It's right on top of a night club, which can be loud on Friday and Saturday, but I found it fairly quiet the rest of the week, and it was usually over by 3 am. I took ear plugs and had no issues sleeping with the noise whatsoever
Extended my stay because I loved the place. Mary, Shannen, Rome was great as always. Attentive, helpful and friendly.

We stayed at Heritage Collection for almost a week and had a fantastic stay! The location was great and close to public transportation and a wide variety of restaurants. The overall room was lovely with a great view of the waterfront! We had the privilege of meeting such a kind staff, Mary, who quickly helped us into our stay!
In terms of getting there, please be sure to double check which location you'll be staying at, as there are two locations within in the area. The instructions were very clear so we were able to navigate to the location quickly. Regarding the noise levels, we felt the noise wasn't as prominent, but rather vibrations from the rooftop bar, especially during the evening on weekends. We were fully aware of this prior to our arrival so we brought earplugs just in case!
Overall, loved the convenient access and great location and would definitely stay here again next trip! Thank you, Heritage Collection team!

Das Heritage Collection on Boat Quay (South Bridge Wing) hat eine super Lage mit Zimmern Richtung Flußseite. Obwohl diese Appartements (von mehreren in der Stadt) in einer sehr belebten Gegend sind (Restaurants und Bars bis 3 Uhr nachts geöffnet) hat man auf den Zimmern eigentlich seine Ruhe. Viele MRT Stationen sind super zu Fuß erreichbar und bringen einen an alle wichtigen Orte in Singapur. Besonders gut war die freundliche und unkomplizierte Kommunikation über whats app mit den Mitarbeitern. Gepäckaufbewahrung ist ebenfalls sicher und zuverlässig aufbewahrt. Wir sind vollends zufrieden mit der Wahl dieses Heritage Collection Hotels.

Support from Mary and rome was super helpful. From check in to checkout it was a too smooth process. Property is at perfect location with views of MBS and just at the right party spots.  Very convenient and accessible from cityhall mrt.

Really appreciated Joey's patience in dealing with my credit card issues and trouble finding the apartment (I had no Singaporean sim), and helping me check in to the place without help from the host.

It's a very small room on the 6th floor of a block, seems to be some sort of dorm. Bathroom shared with I guess a half dozen other rooms, though I never met anyone in my single night there.

About a $5-10 taxi ride from anywhere interesting.

Wifi and air con were both good!

Convenient location. Food court just outside MRT so you can get food easily and an NTUC supermarket on the way too. Apartment is clean and i had no issues using the shower and laundry facilities whenever i needed it. Landlord is responsive and friendly

Transportation, 5 minutes walk from the subway station. The room is very clean, the air conditioning is also cool, the bathroom and laundry, dryer is also convenient to use. Only to think some minor shortcomings is that the room on the main road is litter noisy upstairs.
交通方面，离地铁站步行5分钟以内。房间很干净，空调也够凉，浴室和洗衣、烘干机也方便使用。唯一让觉得有些小小缺点的是，房间在主要道路楼上，有些嘈闹。

Jeff responded promptly to my emails/inquiries. He was very accommodating and flexible with my check-in, especially since my flight was delayed by 1hr.  Got a warmth greeting from Jeff when I arrived at his place, very friendly person.
I stayed at Jeff place for a week during the Jubilee weekend. The room was as advertised, a great kingsize bed with own bathroom (not shared). Room is really big compared to SG standard, and Jeff also provided a work table.  A 4 door closet was available and was very convenient (with 2 locked drawers). Room is air conditioned with huge TV, though I barely used.. Wifi works well, quite fast connection.  The bathroom (not ensuite) was very clean and of decent size (as advertised).
I had access to the kitchen (fully equipped) and used it daily for breakfast and occasionally for lunch/dinner as well. Jeff provided breakfast as well. Overall, Jeff's house is very tidy, well organised and fully renovated.
Jeff's place is conveniently located when it comes to food and other basic needs. There is a nice food hawker place downstairs and some convenient stores, including a bakery, wet market, fruit stores... etc.  Jeff showed me the surrounding area on my first day there.  There is a supermarket nearby as well (Fairprice), 5 mins walk. There is also the Bishan-Ang Moh Kio Park opposite to Jeff's place.  Regarding transportation, the nearest MRT (Ang Moh Kio) is about 15-20 mins walk away. There are multiples buses that go to AMK Bus interchange/MRT. I took the 262 mostly though from AMK Ave 1.
Overall, I had a great stay at Jeff's place. Jeff himself is very friendly and was a great host. I've used using Airbnb several times already and this was my best Airbnb experience so far. Hence, I would definitely recommend Jeff's place and I would for sure come back again.

Jeff is the consummate host! He personally checked me into my listing and I was blown away how much friendly he was and by the attention he paid to every single detail that goes into making a guest stay comfortable...the bed, the bathroom, the AC..etc. EVERYTHING.

The room was extremely welcoming (honestly the photos don't do justice to the room) and spotlessly clean. It was so comfortable and I wished I had spent more time sleeping! The environment is super peaceful and it makes for a good night's sleep.

The neighborhood is very safe (it's close to a gorgeous green park) and convenient with a huge variety of local delicacies and affordable food options. Jeff knows what's best -- so be sure to check in with him for his recommendations on what and where to eat.

I couldn't have asked for a better listing for my brief stay in Singapore and am extremely grateful and super happy that Jeff warmly welcomed me to his lovely apartment :)

I had a fantastic stay at my Airbnb host's place! He's a helpful, friendly, and proactive guy, which made my experience even more enjoyable. The stay was definitely worth it, and I would highly recommend his place to others. Thanks for making my trip memorable!

I have been with Jeff for 3 months and I have to say that I felt at home… The room is spacious and with large wardrobes, the bed is large, private bathroom… Clean, quiet and perfect environment to study or rest… Jaff is a fantastic person… polite, kind, clean and smiling… Always available for every need… Never intrusive… I have to say that the world needs more people like him… A true friend…

Need an ensuite last minute for an old friend visiting singapore, Joey was very responsive and advised on the pros and cons of the ensuite after i booked. I went ahead with it and find everything wonderful with no complains. :)

The private Balcony and Bathroom is a great part of this room, great views of the neighbourhood and had a chit chat with the other housemate sharing this balcony.

Recommended for anyone.

self checkin for me at 10pm. security guard 24hrs at lift lobby, feels safe.

Listing as described, simple loftbed with standard beddings and aircon.

Chinatown neighbourhood here is vibrant and interesting, i like it!

PROS:
1. Spacious bedroom
2. Private living room with sofa and tv (no one can enter)
3. City chinatown view from level 30
4. Windy free air
5. Very convenient location access to everywhere
6. Food 24hrs and 7-11
7. Responsive Host
8. Clean room and good aircon
CONS:
1. Long-winded security guard
2. Complex main entrance close by 10pm, need to enter via side door
Very nice value for money.
This room is a bit worse than I expected. The bed sheet is too old, toilet doesn't have cover, the tap got very small water flow. Anyway, the price is cheaper.
its a nice place. Nice Host
The room is ok

My over all experience was great considering the high quality of the apartment and the location. I love the neighbourhood because it gives me a sense of safety and cleanliness. I love that the bed is super comfortable. I had a really good night sleep there. I really like that they provide a hair dryer and laundry soap.

I did not have a chance to meet the host Stephanie, but I had some interactions with (her assistant?) JJ at check-in. All the interaction I had with Stephanie and JJ were pleasant.

I'd like to be honest with my experience here. We had a check-in issue. I could not meet my host at the promised time which was 8:30AM. Since I arrived at 5:30 AM to Singapore, I was killing my time at the airport cafe after a redeye flight. I was exhausted, but I repeated going to the front door,wait, coming back to the back door, and wait.

My phone was a non-Singapore phone, and sometimes it might not work properly overseas. We kept calling each other's phone but we could not get in touch till 10am. Finally I could get in touch with host and checked in at 10:30 am.

Upon check-in, JJ asked for a copy of my passport and asked me to sign a contract that I was not aware of prior to booking.

I found no towels at listing so I called in at 11:10am, and JJ brought towels at 5 pm. I was not sure when they were bringing me towels, so I took a nap. At 4PM, I could not wait any more so I took a shower without a towel. I wiped my body with paper towels.

Also, there was no body wash, shampoo, etc, so I recommend bringing your preferred toiletries. I had mine, it was all good.

There was a brief viewing for the room on the 3rd day. I was not asked but told about it on the 2nd day. It was held while I was not in the listing so it made me feel a little uncomfortable but I was too busy working to get bothered by it.

The rest of my stay except the first few days went super great and awesome!! The host was reachable and responsive when I needed assistance in using washer and drier through message thread.

There is a bar on the 5th (rooftop) and I was staying on 4th floor. I could hear music and noise from upstairs at night but it didn't bother my sleep because I was super tired everyday.

If your work is close to Clarke Quay central this is the most convenient listing to stay! And I recommend the place if you want a comfortable convenient, and clean place. Thank you for sharing your space.

Room is just as fresh and clean as it looks on the pictures. A/C and facilities works great and cleaning was done once a week. Stephanie was very keen on asking if everything was alright or if we needed any help. Very helpful.

The location is about as central as it get's with a lot of restaurants and bars in the direct neighbourhood. Which means you'll find a lot of good food and it's close to Ruffles Place which is a good hub to get to other parts of the city via MRT. This also makes it a bit noisy in the evenings which I suppose is to be expected.

I think the listing is a bit pricey but can definitely recommend if you really prioritise high standards and living central.
We had an amazing stay! Great location, great service, friendly and helpful host.

This flat is perfect if you're travelling alone for work. It's a cosy, super functional studio with everything you might need. The location is unbeatable: 3 min walk to the Clarke Quay MRT station and shopping centre. The flat was spotlessly clean and a complimentary cleaning service was offered since I stayed for over a week. It was very easy to communicate with Stephanie, she replied to my messages very quickly! Overall excellent stay! Will definitely stay here next time :)
Very welcome, very efficient.  Great location with a beautiful running route right below.
The room is located right in Boat Quay, so if that is where you would like to stay while in Singapore, then this place will suit you.

Stephanie is a very professional host. When I asked something or need help, he always responded very quickly. The room is very clean and organized! Also, the location was great!! First I thought it may be little noise because it is tourist spots but there was no problem. The place was very convenient to walk to restaurants and attractions. Perfect location! I will definitely come back for this listing!

Stephanie was a great host. Although I never met her, she was very prompt with all the email email conversations and the check-in/check-out process was very smooth (with her representative who I only met on the once at check-in - it was perfect actually). The studio was supplied with all essential items which was absolutely great - thanks Stephanie for taking care of that.
The only small concern I faced was that concierge service was not great at the apartment. For instance, the dryer at the laundromat would not even 50% dry the clothes and there was no one to help me get that resolved during my 15 day stay there.
Another concerning point was that I felt the studio was quite tiny for the price listed for it. The locality is great - it could not have gotten better but with two people the space felt quite cramped to me.

I am happy that I chose to stay at this listing. The studio is very well equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The room looked exactly as it was shown on the pictures, it was very clean, the bed was comfortable. My room was on the waterfront so I also had a really nice view. The location is good especially if you want to explore downtown Singapore on foot or eat out in the numerous restaurants nearby. If you want to visit other places with public transportation, the Raffles Place and Clark Quay MRT stations are just in a couple of minutes walk. I would stay again.

The studio is very compact and in a great location. Perfect for a business traveler who needs a central location and a few convenient facilities. Can be a bit noisy but that is because it is close to bars etc. Room is quite small but ok for one. Not all have river views, so check first.

Stephanie and her team made me feel very welcome! I had to call on them for 2-3 details and always got responses within a few mins or 1 hr max.

The studio was very central and all the pictures are accurate.

There are tons of hawkers stalls open during the day behind the studios/apartments, as well as some opened at night. You are walking distance from many cools non-hawker bars and restaurants.

Remember that this area is noisy by nature, so expect it to be like that which offers you the vibrancy of the city and CBD.

Enjoy!

I needed to drop off luggages before check-in time and DJ was so nice enough to greet me in the morning and even move all my luggages up to the room when I came back in the evening. The room was neat and clean, little bit small but has everything you need for one person staying. It was at the center of the city, so walkable distance to Raffles Place or Clarke Quay MRT stations, even to china street and club street. But since it's in Boat Quay, it can get loud in nights from karaoke next building. I don't recommend this place to anyone who's sensitive to noise or who can't sleep with noise. Oh and it has the best rooftop bar in SG, Southbridge!! It closes at 12 am, so no noise if coming from the bar at night. I enjoyed a long stay with nice views both days and nights. Thanks again to DJ, who was always there when I needed any help!

I had a great stay at Stephanie's. The studio was very comfortable, and she and DJ were helpful and responsive throughout my time there. The neighborhood is lively and convenient -- a great option if you want a central place to stay.

This location is not an apartment, but a studio exclusively designed to receive guests. I like airbnb when I stay in a living apartment, not in a simili hotel room.
Apart this, the location is convenient, the studio small and comfortable.

These service apartments are run like a hotel—i.e., impersonal. The check-in host (not Stephanie) required my credit card for a security deposit, and passport #. Check Airbnb's rules before you book—you shouldn't have to give this info. As others have said, this is a noisy neighborhood, the studio is small, but the location is central.

Very good service! Run like 5-star hotel with complete kitchen and full size refrigerator.. Also near in 3 SMRT Stations (Cityhall, Raffles & Clarke Quay). Tons of food hall with different cuisines nearby. Abigail & Gwen was easy communicate with and very responsive to my queries and request. Also, staff are very accommodating and considerate (Sam & Desmound). Defintely value for money and will stay again on my next visit to SG.
All went well, thank you very much!

Wilson was the perfect host - communication great.
Place is right on Boat Quay, walk to Clarke Quay.
Location is great - Lots of very good places to eat and drink on your doorstep.
The place was in Boat Quay where you can enjoy everything around - however, might a bit noisy in the night. Abigail and Gwen moved me to a quite place which was very satisfying.
Great place.   Looking forward to my next stay.

Abigail & Gwen's place is in the heart of Boat Quay. I really enjoyed being able to lie in bed watching the boats pass by below, and the view of the Marina Bay Sands. The apartment is clean and tidy and in a great location. If you stay, be sure to visit the rooftop bar upstairs. A perfect way to end the night. Highly recommend and look forward to staying again some day!
Good place
Excelente atenciòn especialmente Hatta siempre disponible. Todo limpio y aseado
Thanks for the accommodation. I especially appreciate the friendliness of the staff.

A truely excellent appartment.every amienity is well thought out.
Great location.
Very clean and really vood valuw.
I will definately stay again and I have recommended it to friends already.

Absolutely phenomenal location.
Walk directly out onto Boat Quay, which is a great strip of bars and restaurants along the Singapore River. 5 minute walk from Clarke Quay, a great nightlife spot. 15 minute walk from Raffles City. MRT stations within close walking distance. I walked/trained everywhere. Didn't have to uber or taxi once because of the central location. Cher (Guest Service Manager was fantastic and responsive). It can be a bit loud at night and the room is "cozy" but as long as those tings don't bother you, this is the best place/value you'll find in Singapore.

Wonderful and awesome place, a great host by Cher too.
His little gestures like buying us lozenges because he overheard my Girlfriend coughing when we check in and getting us milk touched us.
Overall it’s a great place to stay if you don’t mind the apartment being small.

The unit was very small and there was not really a proper kitchenette - it was a hotplate and only the bathroom sink to wash dishes in. Noise from neighbouring units was quite loud. Great location though and the hosts were very professional.
Very nice place !
If you’re going to Singapore then this place is perfect! Seriously.
Good location and free Netflix.
We loved it- excellent location and super helpful hosts! Worth it!
Great place. Very very clean. Comfortable bed. Thanks for a great stay.

Absolutely loved the location. Incredible views outside the window, and very walkable, lively area. Could be a bit noisy at nights, but earplugs easily fix that. Check-in was easy enough. I called Heritage Apartments once I was outside the apartment and a guest manager appeared a few minutes later to let me in and give me a tour of the property and amenities (i.e. complimentary shared washer/dryer + detergent). Check-out is as easy as dropping your keys in a drop-box by the elevator whenever you leave. There's a brand new 7-Eleven outside on the water for any last minute needs + on-tap draft beers to enjoy on the water. Short walk to Clark Quaye MRT (train station) and hop-on spot for bumboat rides. There's a hawker center even closer by for some authentic, cheap eats. The room itself is small, but efficient. Bathroom feels large and they provided extra towels, toilet paper and body wash + shampoo. Bring your own conditioner if you need it. I stayed for a week + a day so they provided housekeeping once in the middle of the week (i.e. chnage the linens and clean-up). Would absolutely stay here again and have already recommended to others traveling through.

Have a great stay at No. 81 Boat Quay. Fantastic location overlooking the river and Downtown area. Cafes, pubs and restaurants and anything else you need all super close.  Host Cherry and Jarwin were great. Very polite and helpful, often checking up to see if everything was ok. Thank you guys!! I will be making a return trip here.

This is a great place to stay if you are looking for a single (albeit slightly small) room with a wonderful location. The amenities are good, rooms are sparkling clean, and overall it’s a comfortable experience, especially with the restaurants on Boat Quay and 7 Eleven right downstairs. Jarwin and team make a spectacular effort to put you at ease and feel comfortable. Highly recommended!
Great hospitality from Jarwin. Great location with 7/11 downstairs and you are right there on Boat Quay.  Get a room at the back to avoid the noise at night.

Perfect location for this nice and clean studio. The host is very nice and always ready to help, on premises during the day. The place is very comfortable and well equipped. The place is cleaned once a week during the stay with fresh towels and the laundry machine in self service is very useful. Really recommend this place to visit and enjoy Singapore, at the heart of the city yet calm in the evening. Roof top bar with stunning views is an extra bonus for this place.

This is a truly well-managed apartment, though quite a small one, smaller than a usual hotel room. Location is unbelievable, as well as window view. However, this is one serious issue with this room - it is built in 3 levels, there is an elevated platform between the bed and the kitchen/toilet area. It took me 10 stumbles to remember there is a step there. Not for people that trip easily. Not for night walks to the toilet, avoid it ))
Great location , comfortable bed and good air conditioner.. Checking in was a pleasure.. Jarwin and Cherry went out of their way to make sure everything was Ok.. highly recommend

Heritage Apartments is located in a good area and the apartment was clean and really comfy, well designed with all house equipments.
Jarwin was really polite and very helpful.
Thank you very much!

The check in process was extremely smooth & communication was excellent.
I requested a river view room & was given one so was very happy!
The space is very small but as were only planning to spend minimal time in the room it was fine for us.
The location was excellent-we loved being able to lie in bed & watch the activities on & around the river. Loved being able to see the Marina Bay Sands Hotel. Walking distance to Chinatown was a bonus & short walk to Raffles Place MRT.

Great two week stay
We booked at the Heritage Boat Quay for two weeks for a business trip/vacation. We loved this place. Great location. Awesome view to enjoy every day. The apartment is well set up and Jarwin was very helpful with anything we needed during our stay!
You can hear some music at night from an adjacent property as others have mentioned in reviews, but it didn’t bother us at all. We would book here again for sure.

We had a good time in this very convenient place.Jarwin was really helpful and available for anything we needed, we appreciated that ! :) Thanks to Rinda as well for her service, we wish the best to both of them!
Nice apartment, clean, Good location and has everything you need.

My girlfriend and I stayed 7 nights in Singapore at the Clarke Quay studio apartment. We stayed in direct contact with the apartment manager Jarwin, ensuring that everything was up to our standards, ensuring an easy check in and check out. The apartment is in a great location situated only a walking distance from multiple MRT lines. Several bars and restaurants are also in very close proximity, there is even a great bar upstairs on level 5 which shouldn't affect your sleep as it closes at 12pm. Having said that, if you are a light sleeper the walls of apartment  seem to be quite thin, and you may hear your neighbours. Other than that the place was perfect for two guests and very convenient,  I would highly recommend the apartment if you are looking for an affordable city experience of Singapore.
very central

Lovely apartment with an amazing view towards the river. Jarwin, the guy in charge of the place was very helpfull and friendly, making my stay a lot better. Ask him for any tips or advice and he'll be more then happy to help. Thanks for an amazing experience, hope i'll be back someday.

Place is convenient and clean. But if you want to extend your stay. The sales team is inflexible and not accommodating. Place good. Guest relations good but sales team lousy. I would not stay here again because of the sales team.

My Singapore experience was made richer by staying in this property.
Great location - by the river with a lovely view of Marina Bay Sands and 2 mins walk to Clarke Quay, a central mall and transport station for getting around. Lots of nice places to eat and fun night life within easy reach.
Great amenities - very clean and with all you need during a vacation, including washer and dryer with clear operating times for everyone's convenience. Apartment is very secure too. There's a 7-11 downstairs in the same building which is convenient.
Great Service Experience - Jarwin was kindhearted and accommodating throughout my 11-day stay. He would check-in often to ensure everything was alright and even gave my roommate and me a lovely Christmas present with a thoughtful note.
I would absolutely stay here again if I'm ever in Singapore. Great value for money.

We stayed for 10 days and its a good place to stay. Thanks to julia who gave us a free upgrade room during our holiday in Singapore. The room is clean, the access is strategic near to MRT station, near food center and surrounding by resto cafe and bar.

The Guest Relations Manager Jarwin is warm and very kind. He did very best service when we stay. Thank you.
The location is good. Room is not too big but full functionality, equipment is very good. Thank you Jarwin for your great support and warm take, hope to see you again.
There might be a music noise till at 2 am~3 am. excepted noise, it is a quite nice place. if you have a good night regardless of noise, It will be a perfect stay.

Room is not big and is cosy for two - you will be climbing over each other regularly.  Host was very friendly and although a little late for the agreed early check in, all was efficient and easy enough.  Location is smack bang at one end of boat quay, and surrounded by plenty of bars and above a convenient 7-eleven.  Kitchenette not really usable apart from maybe breakfast, but loads of choice nearby for eating, so no issue for me.  Quite noisy on weekend well in to the night, and even during the week too, but considering location was not as impactful as it could be - it didn't stop me sleeping. All in all, as described if smaller than pictures let on, and a good budget choice compared to the hotels available in Singapore - would suit many travellers needs, especially if on a budget.

Jarwin is a very good host and takes care of you, whenever needed. The communication was very easy through WhatsApp. This was the perfect place for us. The flat had a nice view on the river and everything we wanted to visit was easy to get to. There are two underground lines close by. Sometimes it can be a bit loud in the evening from the street below, but sleeping is always no problem. Below and next to the flat there are small stores, where you can get everything you need. Los apartamentos están en una zona muy buena y bien comunicada. Rodeada de bares y tiendas a pie de calle y sin embargo el apartamento es muy silencioso y tranquilo. Limpieza impecable. I had a great stay during the past weeks, and Jarwin was such a nice host, very helpful and caring. I enjoyed my stay, thanks!

The bad abd the ugly:
Rooms are small - 160 square foot. To change to a larger one, if available the management charges $30 "moving fee". Quite dirty rooms with window seals nver cleaned, handles on windows falling off, bathroom curtain hanging pipes fell off hurting me in the head. The worst is, the roof top of the building is a restaurant and bar that plays loud music. Ground floor also has a restaurant and bar. You can't sleep until 4 AM any given night due to loud music and noise. PLUS there are roaches in the groundfloor lobby due to restaurant on ground floor (I have pics to prove it). They call it a studio but the kitchen is nothing more than a table in the middle of 160 sq ft room.
After complaining several times, the "management" put me in a larger room that was 260 sq ft or so (give or take) after charging me "moving fee". Check in process IS HORRIFIC.
The good:
Only good things about this hotel are 1) the proximity to Marina Bay and, 2) the hotel staff, I found to be very courtious and helpful. However, they had no decision making power so had to "check with the management" on everything/all requests. 3) proximity to Clark Quay MRT and bus stop - within 5 min walking distance. I had requested an extra comforter and sheet which they provided day later but did provide and didn't charge me. If you are a party person or don't have any other options, you can book this but manage your expectations and be ready.

My stay at the Heritage property was great for my short work trip in Singapore. The location was great for walking to/from my office in the financial district, and also made it very easy to explore the city via the river walk (which is right outside the door) and by accessing the nearby subway. The room itself was clean, the bed was comfortable, the shower pressure was good and the Wi-Fi was strong.
My only critique relates to the laundry - I washed a load just before checking out to leave for the airport. It was early, and so they had the dryers turned off - which meant I had to fly with wet laundry in my suitcase. Fortunately it was just a few things. I would advise that they turn off BOTH the washers and dryers, and/or communicate this no-morning-laundry policy more clearly.
Other than that, I had a great stay, and would definitely recommend to others.

The issue with this place is the lock/check in system. First, my phone broke and the way you get in is a remote key in an app. Heritage has a device on the wall of the building which lets you text with a staff member as there is not one on site. They told me to open a lock box with an "emergency phone" in it that can download a key. The phone was so cheap it took nearly an hour to get it to activate the bluetooth lock, with the staff member telling me to try holding it upside down, backwards, etc. I then started having trouble doing this with my personal phone, as did everyone else (a group of 5 people were sitting in the lift trying to get it to work; they thought the lift was broken but it was the bluetooth lock not working). Each time I needed to get into my room it took around 15 minutes total. Eventually a staff member on the wall device told me how to find a key card and I just refused to give it back the rest of my stay. The lock system is just too cheap and doesn't work.

房子设施一般吧，但是住着也很舒服了，东西都很齐全，服务的小妹妹人很好，大半夜的等我们到，会提醒我们拿雨伞，只是不会中文，呵呵。我们住在一楼，早上会听见鸟儿和昆虫的叫声，推开门，绕房子走会有个后院，但都是杂草，要是种上什么水果或是花卉，好好整理一下，就更好了。

第一次在airbnb订房真的很满意，感觉性价比很高。房子很干净整洁，房间跟图片一样，有独立卫生间，wifi，工作桌，电视，衣柜......等生活必需品，.最重要的是还有厨房，人多的时候可以一起做饭吃，这是很有意思的事。房子离地铁站很近，属于别墅，里面好像有共8间房，好几个厨房，可容纳的人数还是挺多的。 我们在那共住了7晚，房东的菲佣挺感动我的，主动的把我们的衣服放到阳光下晒，下雨又第一时间跑去帮我们收回来。
房东人很好，很热情，走那天还顺便把我们带到了樟宜机场。
对了，房东那时还有自行车可以寄....

最下面有中文的评论。（Bottom is review in Chinese）

Really nice place. Absolutely close to MRT, about 3-5 mins walking distance to MRT, food court (24 hours), super market (24 hours) and 2 7-11 (24 hours). I attended the food court and super market at 3-4 AM, still many people there and still delivering services both. The place is very quiet, can always have good sleep.

The room is very clean and new. Attached bathroom (including toilets) provided extra convenience. The hot water is also 24-hours and shower works well. A refrigerator and a washing machine are shared with another 2 room tenants. Other refrigerator/washing machines at the other side of the house can be used too if first 2 are being used. A open kitchen can be used if need too. Complimentary instant coffee and tea bag is provided. A 40-inch LCD TV is in the room. English/Chinese/Malay channels there. Air conditioner and a ceiling fan works also very very good. I never feel hot in room.

Though it's a villa and there is a yard. I found no mosquito or pest problem at all. It seems Singapore has no mosquitos...

The room directly connect to the yard. Which means you don't need go through the living room. You won't affect others, vice versa. As I said, sometimes, I returned home at 4 AM, I can still quietly go back to my room directly without affecting others.

There is a maid who will clean my room once a week. She is very shy and quiet, you won't see her often. But if you need her, she will be there. She helped me collect and fold my clothes when I'm not at home. Very helpful.

I work in the Changi Business Park which is around EXPO MRT station. It's only 1 stop away from this place (Tanah Merah station). So convenient. Expo station also has 2 big shopping malls and many restaurants you can visit there.

All in all, very good place and very good host. Will stay again for sure.

位置非常好，步行3-5分钟到地铁，同样步行5分钟到24小时食阁（大排档），24小时超市（很平价，也不小，蔬菜水果都有），2个24小时7-11店。不过新加坡的7-11很贵，在超市买东西就好。我有几次都是凌晨3点多过去，大排档依然营业，而且不少人，超市也是一样。

屋子很新很干净，有单独的浴室，24小时热水很方便，水量很大。有空调和吊扇，都很给力。有一个40寸液晶电视也有本地中文节目。甚至还有一个小米盒子，但是我没用到。

屋子很好的一点是一开门就是户外。整个房子是个别墅，有自己的院子， 三个房间的租客公用一个冰箱和洗衣机。院子正面还有一组冰箱和洗衣机也可以使用。洗衣机和冰箱都很给力很好用。 有户外空间可以晾晒衣服。房东有摆在外面的便携折叠晾晒架子。有开放式的厨房，需要做菜可以使用。还提供了免费的速溶咖啡和茶包。

有一个菲佣，每周会收拾一次房间。人很友好，存在感很低，一般都看不到她。不会打扰你，但需要的时候就会出现，一次我不在，帮我收了衣服都叠好。非常感谢!

我在Expo的工业园工作，这个地方是Tanah Merah地铁站，去Expo只要一站，很快很方便，去市中心也不用换乘，大概20-30分钟就可以到Raffles Place，去乌节路要换乘一次，但总共也就20-30分钟，还是很方便的。

是Lip接待的我，也算是这里的房东。人很热情也会随时响应我的一些疑问和要求。

另外，房东不会干涉你的作息时间。我有几次都是凌晨4点回来，房间最好的一点是直接通到户外，所以进了院子就可以直接进入自己的房间，不需要走过起居室，也不会打扰到别人，别人也不会打扰你，很方便。

toch graag een kleine meededeling,    het wordt in de advertentie omschreven als een luxe appartement,  dit klop NIET helemaal.  het was een nette kamer. Great host, good location accessible to a lot of main spots via bus stop right outside the stay. All amenities are available, worth the money!
The place is spacious and well maintained. Communications were easy and overall had good experience.
房东很热情，环境很好。下次过来希望还能订到。

This place looks like the best value for 2 people, with a place to sit down that was not the bed, anywhere near Chinatown. It was perfect for us. When we return to Singapore, I'd be happy to stay here again.

Great place to stay, close to Singapore CBD, friendly staff, spacious room and daily cleaning service.  I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting or working in Singapore for a month or two.  The Tanjong Pagar area which is right next door is very cool, loaded with restaurants, bars, shopping malls.

Host (and staff) welcoming and hospitable. Flexible with my room arrangements. Small but tidy and clean. Room cleaned daily with replenishment of two bottles of water daily. Great location with proximity to Chinatown. All in all, a very pleasant stay.

Beautiful place, great location (CBD).
房间非常不错，老板人也很好，介绍了很多好吃的地方
Solid 5 Stars. The property is in an ideal location, lots of trendy restaurant and bar options nearby. Alan was accessible and hospitable. Recommend to all.
Super kind host and pleasant to stay!!! Even my late check-out (after mid-night), the host kindly was on-site to help my check in. The room is perfect for sole trip (or couple).
Great location, fabulous units. Nearby Hawker centers, Chinatown. Will stay again. thank you

Nice place!

perfect location, perfect people, perfect service

Great host and place to stay.

Accommodation was very clean and the host was very responsive.
