Would recommend if you’re staying in Singapore

It was an excellent place! Absolutely recommended! Andy and Allan are very kind, flexible and helpful people.
The room was spotless with a big, confortable bed.
The accomodation is close to the metro, buses stops in front of it. Small shops and restaurants are close in case of need.

We didn't see Andy, but his assistant, Allan was very attentive! I would ask for one of the rear building apartments in future, we had the front one and Cantonment Road traffic was extremely noisy! Would definitely recommend!
Allan was very charming and followed up on the TV tuning and anything we asked.

A terrific place to stay in Singapore!  Public transport was close by which connects to everywhere.  The studio apartment had a bright and airy fell thanks to the big windows and high ceilings.  Blinds effective for making the room dark for sleeping.  Plenty of cheap food options nearby and also a nearby the Fairprice Supermarket  If you want more cheap eating out options,  a couple of stops on the bus takes you to the famous Maxwell Food Center aka Hawker Centre which has a bargain Michelin rated Hainanese Chicken Rice at one of the stores.  Responsive and helpful hosts made staying here a pleasure.  Thank you Andy & Allan!

Pros: Excellent location near restaurants/buses; MRT is a 10min walk. Alan (real service provider) was very helpful with late check-in and fixing issues.
Cons:
1. Significant cleanliness and maintenance issues. On arrival, the shower drain was so clogged it flooded the floor, and the shower doors didn't seal properly. We found ants (A LOT) on the table that persisted for all 4 weeks. The AC beeped and cut out nightly for the first week until Alan fixed it. The room is much smaller than pictured; the stove is awkwardly placed next to the bed/closet with no nearby sink. Dish soap/sponge provided, only if you carry the dishes all the way to G/f😅
2. Hospitality: The host, Andy, was unresponsive for 11 days pre-arrival. Essential supplies were extremely lacking. Providing 1 roll of toilet paper/1 box of tissues per week for 2 people is unreasonable for a long stay. We had to negotiate for basics (great, they provide 2 rolls of tissue)
and even ran out of shampoo it wasn't refilled.

It was our first experience to book a room from air bnb. First of all, we would say that Sebastian is a great and helpful host. Not only he offered a pick up and drop off on the first and the last day, he also guided us on the mrt /public transportation route. His house was 15mins walk to the mrt station but you can easily catch a bus ride just in front of his house and it helps you to save the hassle to walk to the mrt station. Sebastian's house was very comfortable, clean and cosy with everything including washing machine, oven, microwave and fridge. Also, we would like to thank Sebastian for his consideration in providing us a hair dryer. Overall, I got a stay which rates better than a 4 star hotel. We enjoyed our stay in Sebastian's house and will definitely recommend it to our friends who plans to visit Sg!

Sebastian have been a very helpful, sincere and patient landlord my non-English speaking client. There were several times where he has helped my client and I beyond being just a landlord but almost as a good friend. He went out of his way to make my client's stay comfortable, convenient and he is also very understanding to our special needs. I highly recommend him not just for his professional attitude towards his customers but also the comfort and convenience of his place. I hope there are more landlords like him!

The room is exactly as how it looks like in the pictures. It is extremely clean, with regular services. Guests are allowed to use kitchen and laundry facilities.
There are guests living in other rooms but I did not feel I was sharing the place at all as it was so quiet.
Location wise, it is located in a very quiet landed property area, with two MRT stations (Tai Seng and McPherson) within walking distance (~1km away), and there is also a bus station just outside of the house which takes one to Paya Lebar station with a 10min bus ride. It has foodcourts, supermarket, mini-mart and a newly opened shopping mall all around walking distance (within 15-20mins)
Sebastian is a warm hearted owner; He offered airport pick-up at 1am, and also drove me around the area to show me directions.
I look forward to staying in this place again when I come back.
Clean, good location (really close to MRT), easy check-in
We can expect such a calm and silent place you can identify your inner one.
Sebastian was a very good host- very kind to drive me to his place on the check-in day. Great place to stay.
Great location to the MRT and Food with thoughtful landlord! Highly recommended!

great host, great place, great location.

I stayed for two nights to attend the U2 concert on 1 Dec. I really enjoyed my stay at the Airbnb and Sebastian’s hospitality made my stay even more memorable. The best Airbnb experience ever!!! Anita and David are the nicest hosts I have ever had. They made sure I had everything I need. I even found cute welcome card and fruits in my room. Haha. The room was super clean and huge. 5 mins walk to Novena MRT. Lots of great stores near by. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who plans to visit Singapore.

Anita and all of her family were so nice! Best Airbnb host ever!!

Definetally recommend to stay at Anita's place in Singapore!!!

Anita's house is perfect and more than what I was expected. It's similar to what is being described in the listing.

The place is located in Novena and close to MRT(which in the underground train service). Place it quite calm and I didn't had time to discover places near the place.

I really liked the place and I'm happy to visit this place when I'm going back to Singapore.

Both David and Anita were welcoming as hosts. Their pet and house helper were very friendly and helpful too. Breakfast was great and most importantly the room was very comfortable and spacious. Another plus point was their house location which is close to the MRT yet located on a peaceful stretch of road away from traffic. Will come again to stay next time

Everyone was very friendly from Anita and David, their housekeeper and the cute little dog. They even booked a taxi for me on the last evening as I was leaving at 5am to go to the airport and couldn't pick one up from the street easily.

I will definitely stay again.
Loved it! It was just one night, but the room, the bed and the onsuite bathroom we'te wonderfull! And Anita, her husband and Kiki we're really nice!

I have recently stayed in Anita's place for 2 nights. Very spacious and clean room. Nice breakfast, cute pet dog and very friendly hosts. Breakfast is delicious too. In addition, MRT station and shopping mall is just nearby. Highly recommended.

Anita's house is exactly as described. Large and spacious. It is also very clean and the wifi works perfectly. Anita, her husband and her helper are extremeley gracious people too and I really enjoyed staying over. Looking forward to staying again.

This was my first experience with AirBnb, and it was a very good one! Traveling alone as a woman isn't always easy. Anita and her husband made me feel very welcome and safe. The lovely Kiki as well. They were so kind to offer me breakfast in the morning and i was free to come and go as i wishes, which is admiralen because after all i was living in their house. The room they offered me was very spacious and cool, with a beautiful and very clean private bathroom. I am very grateful to have had the opportunity to stay at this place and i can recommend it to anyone who wishes to go to Singapore and stay with kind people.
Very nice neighborhood. Short walk from the MRT. Clean house wirth REALLY spacious rooms. I would highly recommend this place and would go back if in SG again.

It was great staying at Anita's house. They made us feel at home. The location was awesome,very close to Novena and other restaurants and public transportation and the most enjoyable thing there is Kiki who take care of whatever we need. The house and all the rooms are very spacious and comfortable. We definitely recommend Anita's and David's house as they are really nice and great host!!

I had a very pleasure stay in the house in a way that I feel warm welcomed and impressive with the room  and breakfast service provided. Please visit me if you travel to Australia. - Joseph @ Sydney Australia

Fantastic airbnb experience in Singapore. Highly recommended and great value for money. Thank you for making my stay so confortable

첫번째로 집이 매우 깔끔하고 동네 자체가 조용해서 마음편히 지낼 수 있었습니다. 무엇보다도 호스트분이 한국인이여서 정신적으로도 편안했습니다! 그리고 남편분도 다정하게 잘 챙겨주셔서 감사했습니다. 제일 중요한건 방이었는데 방도 넓고 깨끗하고 개인 화장실도 있어서 좋았습니다 그리고 역 근처여서 편리하기도 하고 시내 나가기에도 가까운 역이라 시간절약도 가능합니다. 싱가폴 여행 계획하시는분들은 꼭 추천해주고 싶습니다! 진짜 너무 좋음

I would highly recommend this place to anyone planning a trip to Singapore.
很高兴在新加坡的之旅都是在这里度过的。我们住的地方离NOVENＡ地铁站非常近。所以出行都很方便。下楼时有可爱的小狗和鹦鹉会和你打招呼！房东很和善，为我们提供了很多帮助！离他家800米有超级好吃的肉骨茶！从这里打车到机场也很方便！以后有机会还会选择这里！新加坡是个旅游的城市，环球影城、日夜间动物园、海底世界、未来水世界都很值得一去！

We had a wonderful experience in Ms. Anita's comfy nook. It feels so homey. The house is walking distance from Novena MRT, which by the way is super convenient since it is inside a mall. Ms. Anita and her family is very accommodating!

The description was accurate. The hosts were great and warm. I enjoyed staying there and the many conversations we had. The location is very close to everything that one may need in a new city.
A very warm and friendly place, close to the MRT and with clean rooms and en-suite bathroom.  Happy to recommend.

Thank you for everything!

에어비앤비를 통해 숙소를 잡아본 건 처음이었는데 처음에 약간 걱정했던 것과는 다르게 정말 좋았어요! 우선 숙소를 찾아가는 과정이 어렵지 않았어요. 싱가폴의 중심지 쪽인 novena역에서 5분정도만 걸었더니 찾을 수 있었습니다^^ 숙소 내부가 깨끗하고 아늑했고, 저희가 여행하고 돌아올 때마다 정돈도 잘 해주셔서 감사했어요ㅎㅎ 아침에는 아침식사도 차려주셔서 번거롭게 나가서 먹을필요가 없었습니다. anita님과 남편분, 키키가 따뜻하게 맞아주시고 챙겨주셔서 기분좋게 지낼 수 있었어요 정말 추천합니다!

A very special feeling of staying with a friendly host. Clean, quiet and easily accessible to all parts of Singapore via taxi and mrt. The nearest mrt stop is Novena. I would like to recommend to whoever coming to Singapore to try out this experience of staying with a local host than staying in a hotel room.

Very spacious bedroom, comfy bed and ensuite bathroom, all conveniently located within a 5-6 minute walk from the MRT station. Host and housekeeper were very friendly and made you feel welcome. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this listing. Thank you!

这是我第一次使用Airbnb订房，起初有点顾虑！但当我和房东Anita女士沟通以后我决定订房尝试新的旅行体验，新加坡我第一次来一下飞机就觉得这个国家给人感觉很舒服，然后我从机场坐出租车驶向Ainta家费用约24新币，位置很方便离诺维娜地铁很近而且附近有纽顿美食城很多中国菜！作为专业酒店人我对她家的房间很满意相对于这样的房价在新加坡是很划算，房间布局总体简单但是亮点是：宽敞、洁净、床上用品舒适！这是我对经济住所最大的追求，可以说是很棒！房间有小冰箱每天都有两壶水一瓶常温，一瓶冰水，管家Kiki是位很热情的女孩总是微笑待人，在此谢谢你Kiki!每天早上都有早餐，三种吐司，咖啡，茶，橙汁，新鲜水果，及煎蛋配美极鲜酱油很好吃！楼下是个小花园泡杯清茶在早晨阳光下小憩是不错的选择。还有房主会给你三把钥匙你可以放心的进出，只要没有太大噪音不用担心回来晚。总之，Anita的家是个不错的选择，我还会回来的，谢谢！
I would like to recommend Anita house it's the best choice in Singapore!!!!
I really love Anita's place. So clean and comfy. Feels like home and everyone is so friendly and sincere. I will be coming back soon.

We are very pleased with our stay in Anita's home. Anita is very attentive and responsive, in particular in providing guidance to her house. Im glad to be back at Anita's amazing place. I really like it there, everyone is so nice and friendly. The house and room was so clean, and I feel like home. I miss the cute sweet puppy too :)

Anita was super quick in responding which immediately put our anxiety at rest while planning our vacation trip. The house is nice and comfortable, with enough privacy to the guest room. The room was comfortable for 2 adults and 2 children. Anita has a helper kiki who is very efficient in providing necessary info and support once you arrive. The location of the house is very nice close to.MRT , a short distance to Orchard and other places.
My son really enjoyed playing with her dog who is very very sweet.

Great thanks to Anita and I have no hesitation in recommending Anita ' s house for staying in singapore. Actually i wish I could have stayed longer than 3 nights.

すばらしかったです。セキュリティーもきちんとされているし、部屋がダブルくらいの２つのベットに、広々としたお部屋に、同じ部屋にトイレ、シャワーが完備。ワイファイも問題なし。メイドさんもいらして、対応してくださる。駅からも近く、変にオーチャードのホテルにして朝食代が高く、駅まで遠いのより、はるかに上でした。その上、心配して迎えに行こうかといってもいただきました。清潔な部屋で、文句のつけようのない、スーパーホストです。また来年お願いしたいです。素敵なおもてなし、ありがとうございました。
Had a great stay at Anita's place. Room is very clean and ideal with children. Her helper entertained us so well. Til our next visit.... Thank you!
とても快適で素晴らしい部屋でした。親切丁寧に案内してくださったので、安心して宿泊することができました。ありがとうございました。

I was in Anita's place two time during my week in Singapore. The room is huge, confortable with a big restroom. Everything very clean. Including the breakfast. You realy feel like home. Kiki always there to help you. I am a Superhost too and recommand very stroung this place. BTW, you have to go on Balestier place to eat until very late in the evening. I spent nice time there. Thank you so much Anita. Mario Joseph
Anita's place is amazing. Second time there in one week and if I go to Singapore again, I will stay in her house again. Thank you so much Anita and Kiki.

Le séjour chez Anita & David s'est remarquablement bien passé !
Le logement est conforme au descriptif, la chambre est confortable et très spacieuse. La salle de bain est attenante et privative !
Kiki, en charge de l'intendance, a été formidable et très sympathique durant notre séjour !
Idéal pour une famille avant des enfants, même en bas âge !

Anita & David are great hosts. They are friendly & kind. My stay at Anita's place is like visiting friends, very comfortable. The room is big, nice, clean and exact as described. The location is good, just 5' walking to the MRT station. Highly recommended! Would definitely come back for next stay!

Anita and her family were a really superhost. They are very casual and welcoming. The location is close to the city centre while it's in a quiet residential area. The place is also clean and tidy. They also invited me to celebrate their grandchild's birthday as well.

I had an excellent stay at Anita's home in Singapore for one night. They were accommodating of my request for an early check-in. A very comfortable and large room to stay in. I look forward to staying here when I am in Singapore again.

我带着四个孩子（4到十二岁）选择了住在安妮㜓的家，很不错的体验，房间宽敞干净明亮、琪琪煎蛋很好，小弟弟每朝都能吃完两片方包夹一只蛋，比在家里还棒。小狗希尼和小妹妹影嘉都是小弟弟念念不忘的。交通也很方便，我甚至在第五天让九岁的哥哥带四岁的弟弟从牛车水乘地铁经多美哥转线到诺威娜站再步行8分钟回到住处，他们也做到了。屋主夫妇都很热情，退房的当天早上还告诉我因为当天的住客晚上9点才到，我们可以迟一点退房，我们因此而再去圣淘沙玩了四次滑车，近三点钟才退房。这7天的假期确实尽兴了。推荐家庭出行的住这里。
房间不错，在市区里能有这样的房间，交通便利，实在难得。管家非常好，我儿子走前还问她：为什么不在中国工作。小孩的语言最真

整栋房子所处的街区非常地安静、舒服，距离地铁站走路不过几分钟，交通比较方便。

第二天早上遇到主人一家正好要出门，简单打了招呼，觉得都是非常NICE的人家。KIKI尽心做了早餐，咖啡、土司、煎蛋、水果，吃得很开心。
谢谢你们的招待！五星推荐！
非常愉快的住宿体验！房间非常大，很干净，也很舒适！早餐有牛奶、橙汁、烤面包、荷包蛋、水果。距离地铁步行10分钟不到，附近有商场和便利店，很方便！特别喜欢家里的狗狗，好乖好可爱！房东很热心，我老公入住期间发烧，房东提供了退烧药，还关照KIKI解决午餐，非常感谢！

Anita and her family were fantastic hosts. They have a gorgeous home in the middle of Singapore. Communicating with Anita was a breeze, she was always available to answer questions before I checked in. The Room is extremely spacious, which again is rare in a city like Singapore.

Anita really went above and beyond the call of duty at every stage of my stay. I landed a little early and requested her if I may leave my bags at her place. It was drizzling that day, and she noticed that I wasn't carrying an umbrella and very generously handed me one of her own.

I would highly recommend staying at Anita's place if you're ever travelling to Singapore. Easily amongst the best AirBnb experiences i've had around the world

It was a good stay @ Anita place. I didn't meet Anita. Her housekeeper, Kiki looked after me for my entire 3 days 2 nights stay. It's handy to note that the bedroom is located at level 2, u have to walk up the stairs. Kiki cooked breakfast egg & toast to order and OJ. It is a good location for Orchard road shopping. It is 25mins taxi to Changi airport depending on road traffic condition.

Very good experience. The room was big and clean. I enjoyed the private bathroom. The location is 8-10 mins walk from the mall and metro station. I saw Anita 30 seconds on my last day. Her 2 nannies where handling my requests but I didn't have many. Everything went well. I will definitely rent this room again.

Gorgeous house in a convenient central location, spacious and comfortable room, immaculately tidy  (with lots of nice little touches like cool jug of water on arrival) to make you feel at home, everyone in the house was helpful and accommodating. I cannot recommend Anita's place enough!

I stated at Anita 's house 2 days. House is Big comfortable. Anita & David is very nice and very helpful at ans all of my questions. The house in CBD 7 mins to MTR, taxi SGD 16 return to airport.

I would definitely recommend this place while in Singapore.
This is the third or fourth times I stayed at this place. As usual, it is a great experience. Quiet, clean and spacious room.

I had a great experience in Anita's place.
Anita's house is good location, where is about 5 minutes to MRT station.The room is big, clean and comfortable.
There is a private shower and toilet.Anita and David are very kind and nice! Their househelper is warm and friendly!
This was my first Airbnb experience and I am glad that I stay here .I recommend this room highly!! I will definitely return if I visit Singapore again.Thanks so much Anita and David for a wonderful stay!

The stay at Anita's place was really great.
I didn't get a chance to meet Anita, but I met her husband, Dave.
Very friendly and welcoming.
Love the breakfast and the dog, Ceiling :)
I have recommended this place to some of my friends and I will also definitely come back to this place.
Room is very big, clean and accommodating.
AC, Wifi, small fridge, water in the room - also cold one, towels, shampoo, liquid body soap and 2 queen-sized beds... what more can you ask?
3 minutes to bus stop and 7 minutes to train station.

We booked Anita's place for a 4-night-stopover. Was a great choice. The room was big, the beds very good and the ensuite bathroom had a great big shower. Bus stop 2 minutes and underground Station Novina 7 minutes to walk. I can absolutely recommend this place for a stay in Singapur. Thank you!

This is my second stay here and everything is just as perfect as the first time. Due to a lot of confusions on my date of travel, i made the booking for one extra day! Anita was gracious to refund that. I really do appreciate that!

This is my second stay here and everything is just as perfect as the first time. Due to a lot of confusions on my date of travel, i made the booking for one extra day! Anita was gracious to refund that. I really do appreciate that!
Very nice place and wonderful experience, the location is perfect!

Since I stayed with my family for long duration, it was important that public transport is accessible. Anita's house is conveniently located near metro station & bus stand. Still it is away from the city hustle bustle.

My kids loved pets - dog & parrot.
I'm a vegetarian and so one thing I would like to mention that there are very few vegetarian restaurants near by. We needed to go to Rangoon road to get vegetarian food. These restaurants were about 15 minutes away (walk+ bus).
With above pros & cons, I would definitely stay there if I visit Singapore next time.

Stay was good and comfortable, Anita and David were very accomodating and helpful. My family also felt very comfortable during our stay at Anitas place. The location is also located very close to Novena MRT giving easy access to all transportation.

Anita and David were very friendly and accommodating. Their place really is a home away from home. Recommend for family stay. Clean and homely. Hosts were very warm, welcoming and friendly. Nice family feeling in their home. Friendly clients with their children. Perfect hosts in convenient location, the room is huge, comfortable and spotlessly clean. Anita's is where I choose to stay when I travel to Singapore.
I travel to SG fairly regularly. I always stay at Anita's as she is the Perfect host in convenient location, the room is huge, comfortable and spotlessly clean.

I really enjoyed my brief stay at Anita's house and look forward to the next opportunity to return. The room was very comfortable, clean, tidy and exactly as I pictured it from the description . 房間很舒適，交通也很方便，

The stay was as pleasant as the first one. I think I will stay here every time I'm in Singapore.
Thank you!

Anita and her husband were very gracious hosts.
If you like a nice quiet place close to town it's great.
The linens were fresh. The housekeeper was great. Sitting in a compound in Singapore was a great calming experience especially in the morning for breakfast. Charming place to stay.

I will definitely stay here again:)

I like to stay in Anita's place. If you have company, You should choose this place.

Anita's place is a beautiful spot very close to public transport. It's immaculately clean. Her staff does a great job around the house to make her guests feel very comfortable and welcome. The place was really clean and nice, Anita and her husband were really great hosts. The room was really spacious and comfortable, internet connections was really good and having the room cleaned regularly was great.

This is one of my all time favorite airbnb places.  It was my second stay here and it feels like my home in Singapore.  The host is very kind, the room is spacious and the bed is so comfortable.  My favorite thing is coffee, eggs and fruit in the morning.  What more could you ask for to start the day.  Finally, special mention to Anita's helper.  She is so nice and kind and goes above and beyond to help you.
Very comfortable and spacious.  Malu (the helper around the house) was very helpful.

Very hospitable hosts. Anita and the husband are friendly and helpful. Central location and neighborhood especially to the public transport - train and buses. I just so so so love Anita's lovely home and the whole kind family. The house is very convince, clean and comfortable. It will definitely make your journey memorable. Wish the family  all good luck.

This is my 3rd stay and I'm so greatful to have a comfortable that feels like a home in Singapore.
My second time staying at Anita's place. And its always a pleasure. She's been a fantastic and accommodating host.
Always a pleasure staying at Anita's place. Its my second time and it was as wonderful as the first. I will certainly be back many more times.
非常愉快，感谢招待。

We spent two nights at Anita's. Although she offers a room in a house, I felt we had complete privacy as we had a room on the top floor with its own (spectacularly clean) bathroom.
While we didn't meet Anita, we met her husband Dave and their helper Malou. Both were very welcoming, making us feel very much at home. In short, Anita's place is a great value proposition for a Singapore visit.

Well located, very relaxed place, with big rooms, a served breakfast.
We spent three days with our Kids at Anitas place, its save, children are warmly welcome and the rooms are enough big to stay with a family.
We got all support we needed.
It was great there, we will come again.
交通非常方便，5分钟步行距离到地铁和商场。周边很安静，房间很大，有独立的卫生间，很方便。

绝对会存在心愿单里，如果再来新加坡，还是会住这里。房间大不说，很安静，且非常干净，位于整栋的顶楼三楼。入住时车一到就有保姆出来帮忙搬行李，保姆讲英语，菲律宾人。房东应该是会中文，但个人觉得英文沟通会更顺畅一些，怕中文咱这快嘴，万一让人家会错意，便不好。早餐跟我家风格很像，面包，牛奶果汁有选择，鸡蛋需要煮的，还是煎蛋，还是炒蛋，都可以跟保姆讲，会按你要求来。早餐很多种水果，是我和娃最喜欢的。入住两天，整个时间来去自如，虽然和房主同住一栋房子，但是房主分寸把握的相当好，完全没有赶到不方便。需要帮助的时候出现，互不干扰，惬意的很。

Exactly what I expected! Very convenient location. Spacious rooms!
Both host and in house caretaker were very helpful. A simple breakfast was provided, very thoughtful of them.
Quiet location in a nice neighboorhood. Good place for staying a couple of days in Singapore.

David and Anita were great hosts and Malu was there to take care of all basic requests.I would highly recommend stay here for families and guests who like peace and quiet. We will not hesitate staying here again when in Singapore and wish David and Anita all the very best as Superhosts.

It was a good
stay. Anita is a kind host who is willing to help guests. Malu is also there to take care of all the house keeping issues. Their dog is friendly so no need to be scared at all :) Generally good and value for money.

I have stayed at Anita's place many times over the last 12 months.  It's always perfect, and I never want to stay anywhere else in Singapore.  Thanks again for another enjoyable experience.  I will be back again soon.
A very nice home and very close to MRT. Family is very welcoming!
Great place to stay equidistant from downtown area and airport area which is what I was looking for my early AM flight. Room was very spacious and clean with great AC. Check in process was very easy!

带着家人朋友入住的，五个大人，一个小朋友，定了两个房间，room1，真的很大，完全够五个人睡，但是怕长辈拥挤，定了两个房间。

親切的房東 希望下次再入住
Room very spacious.

I had a wonderful stay at Rebekah's place. The room is brand new and the apartment building is conveniently located next to the Holland Village MRT station, restaurants and a grocery store. Rebekah was always responsive and even waited up for me when my flight arrived late at night.

Great host! Communication was excellent with instant reply! Flexible with my requests and she was very kind to hold the room for me even when I was unsure with my check –in dates.
And also, I was upgraded to another room in the apartment so the room will be different than the one pictured in the page– you just have to trust me ☺
The room was perfect! Newly renovated. Artistic display of decorations, combined with top notch cleanliness make the room feels like a 5 star hotel room. The rest of the apartment is regularly maintained and cleaned, complete with kitchen and washer facility.
The apartment located right next to the entrance to Holland Village MRT- can’t be any more convenient than that. It has easy access to other MRT interchanges. Grocery needs, eating/drinking, banking are just within 1 minute walk.
All in all, was definitely a pleasant experience. A perfect place for light traveller and a perfect place to rest after a tiring day at work/sightseeing/shopping. Thank you for your hospitality, Rebekah!
A very clean house.  Good.
Rebekah was available to let me in through the main secure entrance & explained all I needed to know in a very pleasant & unrushed manner

It was very close to the MRT station, and Rebekah was a great host in terms of communication: very kind, responsive, and accommodating. There are a lot of food options around, very convenient and safe for travelers. I'd recommend this to people on a short business trip.

Note that there are other long-term tenants staying in the unit, so in the public area - such as bathroom - you'll see other people's towels / bottles of shampoo etc. The bulb in the upstair bathroom was not working well during my stay. The kitchen area had some visible stain when I arrived, but after the helper visited on Friday, the public area got a lot cleaner. Overall, as I was out most of the time, and I didn't need to use the kitchen, the condition was quite acceptable.

Rebekah is a wonderful host - friendly, responsive and easygoing. Sometimes when Rebekah is away for work, her lovely sister would come to help, for which I greatly appreciate.
As noted in prior reviews, the apartment is located in the center of Holland Village and is less than 2 minutes away from the MRT station. There are dozens of restaurants and eating places. You may also find some fun stores across the street.
My only and BIG complaint is the hygiene conditions in the apartment. Some tenants cook regularly but do not clean the kitchen area after cooking. The trash bins are filled with trash (egg shells, rice, plastic, ants, etc.) most times. The issue has been reported to the host by more than one tenant but has never been effectively handled except some friendly reminding messages.
I would have given this place a 5-star review should the host have handled this problem more effectively.
everything apart from the stairs was great

Awesome place nestled close to everything; train station, market place and an amazing food place.
Endroit très bien placé, chambres propres et hôte sympathique.

Stayed at Diane's place for a 2 day stop over in Singapore before flying back home to London. Diane was a great, friendly and accommodating host and the apartment was very nicely furnished and super clean, with all the facilities you could ask for. Internet also worked perfectly.

Eddie's place is special. The house and the various rooms are exactly as you see on the pictures. We stayed in the roof top studio. It is spacious, receive plenty of light and has a private kitchenette, bathroom and huge terrace. Both Eddie and Susan are very nice and helpful and will do whatever they can to make you feel welcomed. The neighborhood is very green and quite, which is definitely a plus in Singapore. It takes 20 minutes walk to the closest MRT station (which has the usual mall+food court + hawker center + supermarket package) and approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes to the Marina Bay area by public transport, or 20 minutes by cab. Singapore University of Technology and Design, Changi Airport and Changi Business Park are extremely close though, which makes Eddie's place the perfect location if you work at SUTD or CBP. There is also a bus stop just 3 minutes away.

Located in Changi airport - Singapore Expo location, in a quiet, calm, green, organized neighborhood, the house is everything we would've asked for your trip. Only one note, it's a bit far from city center (20 min by UBER / 30 min by MRT), so some planning is needed for those who want to explore downtown areas. A part from that, everything's great!
Nice, friendly maid :) And of course the place is awesome! Is 6 star hotel!

No food options nearby, you have to either travel to some other nearby MRT station or do your lunch/dinner in downtown itself and then head back home. The place itself has some light morning breakfast though, which will get your day started and you can hold on till you reach downtown for lunch. Breakfast on first day had cornflakes, milk, bread, butter, jam, coffee, etc. pretty light breakfast. On second day it was similar with eggs and apples in addition.
The place is pretty neat and clean and can easily accommodate 5 people. Owners are Father-Son pair who are really helpful and nice to interact with, but care-taker Susan is a bit unfriendly, but gets the work done anyway.
Overall good value for money even though a bit far from downtown, as MRT is a lot cheaper than taxis and very well connected. As far as I know, first MRT is at 6am and last one at 12 in night.

The house is beautiful! Stylish. The room is big. Me and my family, there are 7 of us, spent the new year holidays at Eddie's place and we had a really great time! Eddie is very kind. Thank's a lot for having us, Eddie. Will stay again for sure if I come to Spore next time.

Some tips from an American traveler staying in Singapore:
1) The MRT system is all you'll need to get around this beautiful city-state. Although it's possible to walk to the nearest MRT station from Eddie's place (takes about 15 minutes), we found it most convenient to snag an Uber/Grab. This costs between $6-$12 per trip from the house to the station, depending on the time of day. Once you're at the MRT station, talk to the employees behind the glass booth and snag yourself a preloaded MRT card, as the card will need to be swiped every time you get on and off the MRT at various stations around the city.
2) It can be both cheap and expensive to eat in Singapore. If you want to stay on the cheaper side and experience what Singapore is known for, visit as many of the "hawker centers" scattered around the city as you can. Think of these as massive food courts, some with up to a hundred vendors, selling a variety of delicious genres of food FOR CHEAP (we're talkin', like, $3 per person cheap). Chicken & Rice is Singapore's "national dish," so look out for that at every hawker center. Hit up Google or YouTube for the best spots to eat.
3) Bring cash! Although quite a few restaurants will accept your out-of-country VISA card, every hawker center we visited was cash-only. There are ATM's scattered around the city, and always at MRT stations.
4) If you're looking for souvenirs, the place you need to visit is CHINATOWN (and again, bring cash). Seriously, don't buy anything from touristy spots like Gardens by the Bay, the Singapore Flyer, Marina Bay Promenade, etc unless you want your wallet to get hosed. Chinatown is packed to the brim with vendors selling super cheap Singapore souvenirs, clothes, toys/plushies, decorative items, jewelry, and more. We often found the exact same items in Chinatown that we saw at Gardens by the Bay, for example, for a fraction of the cost.
5) It's hot and humid in Singapore, so pack accordingly (including lots of water). Maybe bring one or two nicer outfits for fancier outings, but for our week-and-a-half stay, I was almost always rockin' shorts and a t-shirt. Also, be prepared for the occasional sprinkle. Rain in Singapore is random but quick, and never seems to stick around long.
6) There's quite a bit to do for entirely free, so hit up Google and find a list of sights to see without spending a dime!

Eddie's place was top-notch, a really beautiful house in a nice quiet suburb, super handy for the airport (S$15.00 taxi), and just a five minute walk to the MRT (underground) station, which whisks you into downtown in 35 minutes for just S$2.50. Worst accommodation experience ever due to VERY Poor Noise Isolation. We have stayed here for 4 nights from 7th Jan 2016 - 11th Jan 2016. We have got a room called The Lily Room, which is located on the ground floor of the house, next to a shared shower/toilet.

During our stay, there were people (guests?) constantly moved in-and-out of this house and we could easily hear their conversation; people came back to this house at 12am/1am/2am in the morning, the door sound, shower and hair dryer noise got into our room even with the door shut, we felt so tired during our stay at Eddie's place, especially we had to wake up early the next day to follow what we have planned.

This is like a guest house, most people here are guests that stay for a night or 2. The housekeeper Susan lives in this house but I don't think Eddie does. We have seen Eddie 2 times during our 4 nights stay.

Not a great place to stay if you need a silent place to sleep. Other things and services are fine just like other comments.

与己不欲 勿施于人 房主比任何人都了解他的房子，隔音效果很差，自己不住， 为何还要安排其他舟车劳累的旅客居住而不能好好休息呢？ 我们满心期待的住进了网上好评如潮的房间，确实房子的内饰装饰非常的美观大气，但作为旅客最基本的需求是得到充分良好的休息， 但很遗憾，我们没有得到.

2016年1月8日， 我们抵达新加坡机场后已是凌晨12点，马不停蹄搭车来到这里，较为顺利的入住。 但一进来便给我们带到1楼屏风后的房间‘music room'. 一张单人床， 以及一个从床底下拉出来的床垫。 有些失望，记得是双人床才对， 再三问过管家说没有双人床之后，我们决定将就一下，等到洗漱完毕准备休息了， 听到门外又有旅客到达的声音。然后管家敲响了我们的房门，说是房间给错了，我们住的房子属于门外的年轻小伙们。给我们安排别的房间而且是双人床的。我们把行李拿到了可以淋浴的卫生间旁边的卧室后，困扰也随之而来了。

因为客厅岛淋雨卫生间有几段木板路，有声响。白天不碍事，夜里却听的格外清晰。加之隔音极度差，卫生间里的一切声音直传耳朵，马桶声，淋浴声，吹风机声，一切动作仿佛在我眼前一般。 躺下10分钟，听到脚踩木板的声音由远到近，打开卫生间门，上锁，马桶声，水龙头声，淋浴声，吹风机声，开门声，脚踩木板路声再由近到远... 一个又一个，真实的上演等待‘第二只鞋子’的情景。

加之床垫较硬，床单也不是纯棉的，廉价的布料睡起来很不舒服. 任何人进入卫生间都会让浅度睡眠的我们瞬间清醒。

可以说这是个非常糟糕的体验，房主无法改变卫生间的隔音，却可以控制安排房客的布局，给予旅途中疲倦的房客一个安静的睡眠环境，才是每个旅客所需要的

Eddie's place was incredibly close to the airport--a 9SGD Uber ride that took only 10 minutes. Eddie's house was just as pictured--even better, in fact. The pictures for the Lily Room showed only a mattress, but in fact there is a proper bed. Check-in was super easy with Eddie's house helper. We were also pleased that there was a basic breakfast with bread, jam, hard-boiled eggs and beverages. The neighborhood is perfect for a morning jog. It is residential and safe. We met Eddie on our way out, and he was a very friendly and appreciative man.

Our only caution is that the Lily room gets a lot of noise from the pond outside. There was a cacophony of animal sounds that made falling asleep a bit of a challenge. Once asleep, however, I slept great and the noise was gone by morning.

On the whole, this was a GREAT experience and I would certainly stay with Eddie again if transiting through Singapore. Great location and nice accommodations. Enjoy!

We stayed for 6 nights. Eddie had asked what time we would be arriving. Because we arrived early in the morning, we asked if we could check in in the morning. It was possible to leave the bags and check in in the afternoon. Mind you that usual check in time is after 2 pm. The room was clean and quiet and had good air conditioning and a small fridge. Potable water is in a jug and you can also boil a water jug for coffee tea etc. Susan the housekeeper can help with calling a taxi and was usually around. A light continental style breakfast is provided, which we had every morning.  That was convenient. We did not encounter a lot of other guests. But it could be a full house, with six rooms occupied. We met Eddie somewhat later during the stay, but he is very reachable via the Airbnb chat function or on his mobile. He offered to take us to the airport at 6:15 am for our early morning flight, which worked out well. Eddie has got a van, which can take quite a lot of luggage, and he is very punctual. The room has got a good lock and the compound has also got a locked gate, which made us feel secure. This was the first time we stayed for so long at an Airbnb. We usually walked to the Simei MRT station (15 mins). When we took a taxi we found we did need to give directions. Eddie gives good directions which we we used. Stayed in the Lily Room for NYE and I have to say his place is like a holiday by itself. Ambiance is amazing and cleanliness is very good.
Great place to stay, near to the metro!

Fabulous designer house like an antique museum or curiosity shop. Very zen and full of oriental decorations. Real plants and soil on the ground indoors! Housekeeper Susan was very helpful and the view of the pond and water lilies from the Lily Room was wonderful. 5 minutes walk from the MRT station, but it is a 35 minutes ride away from Downtown. Love sitting in the lounge and absorb the mood. Pity did not get the chance to meet Eddie but other guests were very friendly. Definitely will stay again there - if there is a spot. Will try other gorgeous rooms next times.

Kind people, great value, beautiful home and a quick walk to the MRT.
I highly recommend this home.
Please note your metro ride will be at least 30 minutes from the downtown core, but after a day exploring this vibrant city nation you will welcome the quiet. So close to the airport too.
Very nice room/house, I can recommend!
大氣的別墅，靜謐的陽光灑落於室內佛像，身心也似洗滌而飽滿著能量…很不同以往的國外住宿經驗，謝謝親切的Eddie父子和Susan的幫忙…

The Lily Room is beautifully decorated, moderately big, calm, and best of all, our room balcony is facing a lily pond. I would recommend travelers who have events at the EXPO to consider Eddie's place. It's about 10 to 15 minutes walk to the Upper Changi MRT.  Best of all, you can walk back to his house from EXPO although there's no MRT service available past midnight. I'd done it, not once but twice. Once again, Thank you Eddie and Team!
環境清靜及美麗 距離機場及地鐵站很近 交通非常方便 主人待人和藹可親 非常滿意

这是一次难忘的住宿，房子很典雅幽静，susan也把房子打扫的很干净！让旅途的疲惫一进去就一扫而散！每天Susan会准备好早餐，想吃什么都有选择！而且最大限度的给于了私人空间，虽有其他租客，但一直很和谐融洽，唯一一点可能是因为离市中心较远吧不过地铁也很方便，如果有带小孩的可以多考虑下，如果都是大人住这无遗是最佳选择，屋主很耐心的跟我们讲解怎么玩可以玩的省时省力，会告诉我们路线哪样子更快，对了我宝宝还收到了红包，特别感谢，也祝你们新年快乐    Here i really want especially tkx Susan,for first time  she looks cold but after for days talked,i can see she is a very kind and responsibility housekeeper, tkx Susan,if u can see this, tkx everything u do for us.

交通很方便，就在地铁蓝线的倒数第二站，但是离市中心，比如滨海花园还是比较远的，地铁2.4新币每人，打车估计在25新币左右！
老板一家都很Nice，新年入住还给我家两个小朋友发了红包，非常感动！就是做卫生和负责早餐的菲佣不会说中文，而且每天表情都很严肃和烦躁，和其他几个房客沟通，都表示看着她，有点影响心情！
花园修理得很精致，我们住在一楼最里面的那间房，推开落地门就可以直接到小花园，卫生间在隔壁，独用，但不是套在房间内，还是得穿戴整齐出卫生间！
早餐是土司，麦片，牛奶，果汁，咖啡，住了两天，其中有一天还有白水蛋。
整个环境都很安静雅致，看得出房主品味高雅！

Eddie's place is cozy and clean. The decoration is very Chinese and beautiful. I especially like the pond outside the lily room. The house locates close to airport and only 5 mins working from MRT station. Singapore is small, even u stay here close to airport you can still achieve downtown easily. Eddie and Edwin are friendly and helpful. Strongly recommend to everyone.

Wonderful place to stay while visiting Singapore! Very clean, spacious, breakfast amenities, very helpful and accommodating hosts. Only note is that it’s a bit far from points of attraction. But Eddie’s place is a short walk from the MRT, which can get you anywhere you need to go. Eddie’s place is also very close to the airport, which was perfect for getting to our 6am flight. Would most definitely stay here again!
Great airbnb!

Eddie's place was nothing short of amazing. Our Lily room was comfortable and the view every morning was quite relaxing. It was walking distance from the MRT so transporation was a breeze. We didn't meet Eddie but Susan made our stay very easy and relaxing.  Susan was great from the very start and I appreciated her hospitable nature. Thank you Susan!
Everything was super. We highly recommend Eddi's place.
Very clean and stylish house, and the room is clean and neat. Everyone else in the house is well mannered. And the son gave us some local traveling tips.

Eddie's house is the most beautiful house we've stayed with airbnb. Stylish while keeping the original Chinese heritage. Not surprising to know it's the masterpiece from Eddie the architect. Love our chat with Edwin too. The house is ultra clean with small caring details (i.e. tissue box and towel hanging tacks in the room). It's also 5 mins walk to Upper Changi station, and within 10 mins bus ride to Changi airport. Thank you for hosing us. : )

This place is close to the airport but a long way from Anything else 40 mins to everywhere and several changes on the mrt. Eddie was there briefly and was reasonably friendly, however the lady who looks after the place is almost useless unfriendly, unhelpful and one of those moany nothing is my fault people every request for help or information was met with a stern face and I don’t know. when we asked for a taxi to the airport on the final day I said three times we need a large cab as well e had several cases. Although I asked for it to arrive at 1415 she didn’t contact them until that time then ordered a small taxi saying I told you I only had number for small taxi !! An outright lie ! My wife and son had to go to the airport in their own as their wasn’t enough room. House is beautiful but very hot our room was small and cramped good air and Wi-fi in the room breakfast was cereal hard boiled eggs and self made toast ! Not a friendly atmosphere and no real help. Don’t be swayed by the pic of the place the rooms are very different !
Wunderschönes Ambiente. Ideal gelegen in der Nähe zum Flughafen und trotzdem mit guter Anbidung. Supernette, hilfsbereite Gastgeber. Rundum Wohlfühlatmosphäre!!
Very comfortable room. Nice experience!
謝謝Edwin以及Susan的照顧，Edwin很親切的與我們聊了許多新加坡的文化。住家離地鐵站Upper changi很近，走路五分鐘就到，房間佈置擺設雅致，傍晚在庭院乘涼非常舒服，值得再訪
Eddie's house is wonderful and unique, situated in a quiet and nice neighborhood.

My second time of staying here, this time in Lily Room. The lily pond is such a gorgeous touch, really worth spending some time by the pond. The room itself was perfect in every sense, comfortable bed, all amenities provided. Edwin and Susan helped make my stay completely satisfactory, and I look forward to staying here again!
Edwin and Susan really nice person, clean room, good location, highly recommended to all travelers. Sure will come back.

The Lily room is a beautiful space. Nice large cozy room that opens out to a lovely lily pond. The flowers were blooming while I was there, and at the nights you can hear the frogs singing to each other. The rest of the house is gorgeous with a beautiful layout. Many gorgeous antiques and furniture, amazing artwork, and a beautiful yard for relaxing and reading ...or just enjoying the weather. I was lucky enough to catch a thunder storm in the distance on my last night there and watched the lightning flashes and listened to the thunder from the deck on the 3rd floor.
Eddie's house is very beautiful in an upmarket suburban street, reasonably close to airport and public transport. Exquisite furnishings, very clean and breakfast provided. Very quiet house!
每天都有准备早饭这一点非常的棒，理地铁站也非常的近。作为与机场的中转和过渡非常的好

We had an amazing stay at Eddie’s place! The location was close to the airport and walking distance to the MRT which made getting around extremely easy. His son, Edwin, was friendly and accommodating. All in all, we had a wonderful stay and will definitely be reaching out again for any future stay in Singapore.

Eddies house has architectural flair. Awesome design and furniture. So special. Susan the housekeeper is very caring and helpful and Eddie is a lovely guy. The property is spotless and incredibly well run with attention to every detail.
Very quiet, clean and nice place to stay. Walking distance to upper Changi MRT. Highly recommended.

很開心在新加坡居住在這，附近有地鐵（樟宜上段），有付早餐，早上可以跟一起住的人聊聊天。
附近環境很安靜也很安全
Great place. Host is really nice and allow us to check in early in the morning at 8

Eddie's place was hosted by his son Edwin who was very helpful with local tips and a really nice and funny guy with the help of Susan the housekeeper. The place is situated in a very nice and quiet neighbourhood. It's about 15-20mins away of the airport by bus which is convenient when you have an early flight. Plus you get breakfast every day as well. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay there, would definitely recommend and return if I have the chance to. Thank you again for everything.

Eddie's place is perfect for your stay in Singapore - close to the airport and a short walk to Upper Changi MRT. It is in a quiet leafy area with private 3and4 storey homes.  Displayed in the home are many antique and Chinese traditional works of art. A nice breakfast is served each morning. We thoroughly enjoyed our second stay here.
Lovely home for travelers looking for a relaxing experience.  Walk to MTR station is about 6 minutes and it usually takes about 45-50 to go downtown.
房間很舒適；望出的風景，猶如身境巴里島般的心情。每天起床，睜眼的那刻，心情極好。房東人非常的好，提出的題問，都能詳細解說。住了6天，感覺像是住了幾個月似的。舒服；愉悅；輕鬆；自在，一切都很美好。還在猶豫住哪的旅客，立即下訂唄！！別猶豫了，指尖給它按下去就對了！！！

交通便利，離捷運(地鐵/電車)站散步5分鐘的距離。
這是小站，附近沒有商城，買/吃東西要到隔壁站才有（搭車1站，走路10-12分鐘），也因此這區很安靜宜居。
住家非常乾淨，地上一塵不染，棉被等直接接觸物洗得比我家自己洗還乾淨！
房東很好心，出遊去玩過程中還幫我們查旅遊資訊。
超讚啦～

I had booked the Lily Room at Eddie's place for 5 nights with my wife. It was a very pleasant stay. The room's balcony opens up to a Lily pond which is soothing every morning. Edwin, Eddie's son manages the place and  he was nice, funny and always up for helping the guests. He offered to drop us to the airport for our return flight and we took the generous offer. The place is well maintained and well designed. The only down side is it is a bit far away, but the MRT is a walk away and is well connected.

Insgesamt definitiv zu empfehlen. Hervorzuheben ist die Gastfreundschaft des hosts Edwin (Sohn von Eddie), der uns mit Tipps versorgte und sehr um unser Wohlergehen bemüht war. Der Check-in verlief reibungslos, die Räumlichkeiten waren wie erwartet und augenscheinlich sauber. Die Lage ist ruhig, nah am Flughafen und ca. 30 Metro-Minuten von der Innenstadt entfernt. Das Frühstück war einfach, am Tag nach der Anreise gab es jedoch frisch zubereitete Omelettes. Das WLAN funktioniert nicht einwandfrei und ist zeitweise sehr langsam.

Eddie’s son Edwin has been a great host. He is very approachable and considerate. He gave us many good advice of local attractions. We appreciate his lovely house and wish many more guests will enjoy it here too. (Our housekeeper Susan does excellent job in keeping the house tidy ;) )

What  you get here is outstanding hospitality, a home away from home with all amenities that you need, and a family-like host that will make your stay a memorable one. Thank you Edwin, Eddie and Susan for always making my stay a pleasant one.
호스트분이 답변도 빨리빨리 해주시고 친절하게 대해주셔서 좋았습니다. 아침에 씨리얼이랑 카야잼 땅콩잼 등 조식 제공돼서 편했고 MRT역도 가까워서 이동하기도 편했습니다. 방은 생각보다 조금 작긴했는데 청결했습니다. 다만 욕실에 도마뱀이 여러번 나타났어서 너무 놀랐었네요..

We had a great stay at Eddie’s place. His place is in the east of Singapore and is conveniently located near the Upper Changi MRT station (5 mins walk).  This is the place to go if you want quietness and authenticity. The housekeeper prepares simple breakfast every morning and this saves us the hassle of going out. We met his son, Edwin on our last day and we want to thank him for his kindness.

Hey all of you!
I can HIGHLY RECOMMEND this accommodation to everyone!
Check-In is completely uncomplicated. Location is super close to the nearest Mrt Sation and the airport. (You can´t hear any planes at all). The facility is super adorable and definitely worth to check it out! There is even a small pond with beautiful sea roses and fishes. Everything is kept clean and every morning there is the possibility to get a breakfast! The hosts are super nice and very helpful. You also get a city map and all attractions shown!
There was also free wifi!
All in all you feel right at home surronded by friends!
Again, I would highly recommend this accommodation to anyone who wants to visit Singapore!!
It was an honor for me!
best regards, Tobi :D
非常棒的一次体验，离机场很近，半夜也可以随时入住。房东的儿子会讲中文，非常热情，帮我们规划了游玩路线，告诉我们如何搭地铁到各个景点，这里离地铁站也非常近，真的很方便。每天早上还有简单的早餐，就是要早点起来吃才会有比较多的选择。每个房间的旁边就有卫生间，虽然不是全私密的，但是也非常方便。总之， 一切都很顺利，在这里开启新加坡之旅真的很开心：）

This was my second stop at Eddie's place, conveniently located not far from the airport. Since last year, there is a new MRT station very close to the house (5 min walking), making transportation to center easier.
房主很nice，地铁蓝线很快就到了，不过除开市中心住处这里也是另一种体验。还可以结交朋友

Traditional B&B style house with neatly furbished and very clean rooms. Furniture is really sophisticated. Room is good size for two and we could see beautiful lotus pond from our room. Owner kindly suggested how to enjoy our Singapore life and it was very helpful. It is very close to Changi Airport, only one or two bus stops from the airport and the best choice for transit. I am pretty sure to recommend this homestay to  all!
房子装修非常有特色，房东儿子对人非常热情，给了很对好的建议，性价比非常高的一家民宿，强烈推荐来新加坡旅游的游客住宿！
A great accommodation! Eddie and Edwin are nice host. Feel at home.
Great location. Walking distance to MRT. If you are planning events at EXPO, would be a great place to stay as it took 15mins to reach your destination :)

Nice location and very clean room.
My flight was very late but his
Housekeeper waited me to check in.
His son, Edwin told me useful information what I should visit in Singapore.
I recommend everyone to stay Eddie’s house !!
热情而有品味的房东，谢谢提供如此房源，给我和孩子们在旅行途中多了一份见识。孩子要我转达，她们很爱sunshine。

The Lily Room is a beautiful homey space that overlooks a peaceful lily pond. The bathroom has a door opening out into the pond, and I love that my showers were accompanied by gorgeous postcard scenery and the lovely sounds of a froggy choir.
Just a 10 min cab ride to the airport, the space was perfect for my partner who was catching an early morning flight. A stay at Eddie's house is recommended for those keen on exploring the east of Singapore, though travel to the west and north will take more time by public transportation.
Communication with Edwin (Eddie's son) was efficient, and his earnest hospitality came through during my brief interaction with him.
Super interesting house decor. Chinese Buddhist style! The lilies right outside the room are just beautiful

Eddies place is fantastic and a well deserved super host. As soon as we arrived Edwin greeted us and gave us great tips for visiting the city. The location is fantastic, it is very close to an MRT station and just over 30 mins to the city centre. The breakfast was also very good and generous. Overall we had a brilliant stay and would highly recommend. Also the Lilly pond is a very nice feature and view to wake up to.

Eddie's place was as described, a quiet and stylish haven in a pleasant neighbourhood.  We enjoyed our stay there and would visit again. Susan, Eddie's housekeeper, was kind and unobtrusive,  assisting in any way she could to make our stay comfortable. She laid out ingredients for our breakfast every morning, which was an unexpected benefit.  We thank Eddie & Susan for their hospitality!
Eddie的房源很不错，在新加坡这个寸土寸金的地方可以说是性价比很高了。装修的很有风格，每位房客必须脱鞋进入，卫生间是不在房间里的但是在隔壁还算方便。每天早上会提供一些简单的早餐。房东很负责，回复消息很快，有一些其他需求也会尽力帮忙，环境干净整洁。唯一有一点不方便的可能就是离市中心较远需要乘坐一个小时的地铁但是好在有直达的地铁在附近

I can only recommend this very nice and quiet place near the airport. I enjoyed the time at Eddies lovely home and get a lot of helpful tips to Singapore. It's easy to find and you are fast in the city with MRT. For my next time in Singapore I will also book this host.
Thank's for hosting me Eddie!
房东儿子有几次过来跟我们讲了些可以去的景点。感谢。管家有准备早饭，这一点也不错。这次房费中爱彼迎收了服务费，清洁费，总体评价是这会是我第一次也是最后一次体验爱彼。后面还是订酒店了
It was really nice to look out over the Lily pond. What a peaceful,quiet location that is close to the trains and also the airport.
I recommend people who look for accommodation in Singapore cleanses and very good location from MRT.
房子真的很特別，住的也很舒服！

Eddie's place is a very special place to stay. It has an outstanding style and it's very evocative environment to stay.
Hospitality was great: Susan, who welcomed us and was always available for any help; Eddie and Edwin gave us a lot of tips to visit Singapore to have a very great experience.
The house is located very close to the MRT station ( about 3 minutes walking) so you can get to the centre very easily.
Definitely recommended! We will be back the next time we pass in Singapore .
Fantastic stay. Hope to visit again one day.

Very good accommodation in a awesome house with a great design.
The family was every time friendly and helped me if needed!

This was by far my best Airbnb yet, great location, and definitely super host. Eddie’s son Edwin ... was truly welcoming right from our first encounter.... he organized for a early checking and dropped us off at the airport, even helped us every morning to plan out our day and gave us a lot off helpful tips. Love their home, and had a great breakfast each day. Mrt is super easy from their home or any local transport.

The room is located in a stylish house in a quiet suburban area near the airport, with direct MRT connection to the Downtown, Chinatown and Marina Bay.
I haven’t met Eddie, but his son who was there was very helpful and shared a number of local tips.
Highly recommended!

Unique, stylish house located just 10-minutes (driving) from Changi airport and 5 minutes walking distance to Upper Changi MRT Station.
Checkin was quite easy and the Lily room was well-equipped with super nice view of the Lily pond. We were looking for places to eat frog porridge so we asked Edwin the son and he gave us super good recommendations. Moreover he was kind enough to offer us a ride to Simei station so we don’t have to transfer to another line.
Only thing to be noticed is the pillows are pretty thin, it was thinner than I expected.
I’d highly recommend this accommodation to anyone, especially anyone who comes for event at Singapore expo (like I did)

This place is close to the airport and quite far from tourist places but an MRT and bus station is just nearby which makes the travel a lot easier. Edwin (Eddie's son) and ate Susan(the caretaker) are so nice to us and even allowed us to leave our luggages behind when we went to Kuala Lumpur for 2 days. Id certainly recommend this place, clean and comfortable and not to mention, they serve breakfast!

Eddie, Edwin, and Susan were all just great hosts. We didn't feel like strangers. Their house is unique, artsy, and refreshing, which reflects to their personality as well. It's artsy yet everything is clean and in order. Breakfast was served daily, with lots of options to take. The dining area was really special, it was such a treat just sitting there while admiring the house. How I wish we own a similar house.
All of them were also very helpful during our stay, gave their time when we needed help and shared really helpful tips. We stayed there for a week and every single day was a joy.
On our next trip to Singapore, we know where we're staying. Thanks Eddie, Edwin, and Susan.

Amazing house design, very lovely peaceful area with a very short walk to the MRT and a large shopping centre. The house was very clean with a a beautiful lily pond outside our room and  a good selection for breakfast, felt so homely! With only a 10 minute drive to the airport it was a perfect location. Would stay again!

The property is in a quiet residential street within a few minutes drive of Changi Airport and  a few minutes walk to Upper Changi. The house. Is very peaceful and guests are asked to respect those sleeping off jet lag so not a place for loud parties! There is a private (but not ensuite) shower and toilet. A small fridge and kettle can be found in the room. It was a great place for us to meet up after arriving and leaving again on different flights.

Eddie’s place was the perfect place to stay as our final stop before we went home. It was away from town and was quiet. The house is about a 5-10 min walk from the Upper Changi mrt station and is about a 40 min ride into downtown. Susan was there to greet us when we were there and is the one to prep the breakfast each morning. Very thoughtful!
They were also very accommodating - they let us leave our stuff in the house as our flight was not until evening. This allowed us to browse a little more without lugging our suitcases around.
Thank you Edwin and Susan for everything!

Eddies place is an amazing place and gives you the feeling of an authentic Asian home. Both Eddie and Edwin love to entertain guests and are genuinely interested in views and opinions from their guests.

This is the second time we have stayed with Eddie and can genuinely say that the high standard and warm hospitality we experienced previously has been maintained. This is a quality home with wonderful aesthetic appeal, always immaculately clean, conveniently located to public transport, and in an upmarket residential area. The train station is a comfortable 5 minutes walk from Eddie's home. We recommend purchasing an
EZ-LINK card which gives access to economical train and bus travel and is much cheaper than the 3 day pass sold at the airport. This card can be topped up and lasts for 5 years. It is the equivalent of the UK Oyster card or the Sydney OPAL card. The card can be purchased from the ticket office at the train station. We were able to travel by train to many of the popular destinations such as Marina Bay Sands shopping mall, Gardens at the Bay, Little India, Mustafa Centre, Chinatown etc. to see the main tourist sights. Trains are very frequent, ultra modern, air-conditioned. Looks like Eddie's place is becoming our home away from home. Thanks a million Eddie! Johanna

Everything about my stay was lovely. Eddie was always quick to respond with directions and any questions I might’ve had, and Susan was friendly. When my friend had to cancel unexpectedly, Eddie even offered a partial refund since now I would be staying alone in the room, which was really nice of him. The Lily room is really calming with the Lily pond right outside, and the entire house is very beautiful. Would definitely recommend!

I had very good days!!
Because this area is quiet and Lily room's bed is soft, I slept comfortably.
Susan treated us kindly.
If I go to Singapore next time, I'd use to this place again.
The house is really neat and cozy. Very conveniently located. All the details are mentioned properly. Eddie is a very welcoming person and helped us in any way possible.

提前很久就预定了这家，是看着很美丽的住宿，想度过一次难忘的圣诞。交通也很便利，去机场非常方便。房间也布置的很有特色。不得不说房东很周到，从我下单开始就开始及时联系细节，回复很及时。但我们到达后一直都是一位不会说中文的管家服务，脸上一直都没有笑容。明显有差别对待中国客人和欧洲客人，比如当我们询问早班机来不及吃早餐，是否可以带一些家里的面包走时，她回答，你们为什么不自己去买？而德国客人要带走她做的糕点她爽快的同意了。种种让人很不舒服。这趟行程是为了给我妈妈过50岁的生日，过圣诞以及带她体验一次民宿，这样没有人情味儿，我为什么不住酒店呢？这点让我很伤心，如此漂亮的房子却留下并不愉快的记忆，连一张照片都不想留下。

Beautifully decorated space. The breakfast provided was such a bonus. It creates an opportunity for a lovely chat with the host Edwin (son) and to meet other travelers too. The Lily room is located on the ground floor so no need for climbing stairs. Susan the house keeper is friendly and nice to have around. The local tips given was very helpful too. You will have a great stay.
可以期待

What a wonderfull house !
Everything is like in the pictures, and the bathroom next to the lily room is big.
Edwin (the son) was the most friendly host I’ve seen, we always had a great time at the breakfast sharing about Singapore or anything else.
Eddie’s wife is also so attentionate, she offers me another blanket as I was travelling with me dad. A really appreciated little attention.
Bonus point : The house is really easy to find from the MRT Station.

비행기가 연착되어 자정이 넘은 시각에 15 싱가포르 달러 정도를 지불하고 택시를 타고 에디의 집으로 들어가게 되었습니다. 수잔이 기다리고 있다가 에어컨 작동법, 샤워시설, 냉장고 등등의 설명을 해 주었고 에어컨 2개가 정상적으로 작동되어 상쾌하게  잘 수 있었습니다. 미리 사진을 보고 간 저는 그리 놀라지 않았지만 남편이나 아이들은 에디의 집안 분위기가 고풍스럽고 럭셔리해서 아주 좋아했습니다. 4명 가족이 묵기에 큰 방이고 그 안에 작은 아이가 1명 있는 가족은 엄마 아빠까지 함께 잘 수 있는 크기의 침대가 하나 있습니다. 저희는 4인 가족이라 남편과 아들 2명은 작은 방에 있는 매트리스를 수잔이 가져다 주어 깔고 잤습니다. 이틀을 묵었는데 한 20분을 걸어 시메이역까지 가서 MRT를 타고 올드시티, 마리나베이 등을 다니는데 별 불편함이 없었습니다. 호텔 스위트룸과 같은 분위기였고, 큰 방 옆에 작은 방이 있어 가방, 옷 등을 번잡하지 않게 놓아둘 수 있었습니다. 아침은 아메리카식으로 나오는데 5불 정도 지불하면 수잔이 누들을 만들어준다고 합니다. 저희는 추가 지불없이 그냥 토스트와 시리얼, 과일, 커피, 달걀 등을 먹고 외출했습니다. 에어비엔비를 몇가지 이유 때문에 이용하지 않았는데, 에디의 집은 처음으로 에어비엔비를 이용하고 싶다는 생각이 들만큼 매력적이었습니다. 싱가포르의 모든 숙박시설을 통틀어 아주 훌륭한 선택이었다고 생각됩니다. 호텔보다 훨씬 저렴한 가격에 부티크 호텔같은 독특한 인테리어와 편안한 서비스를 즐길 수 있었습니다. 체크아웃을 하는 시각에 운이 좋게도 에디가 시간이 있어 다음 숙소까지 픽업을 해 주었습니다. 1시간 정도 떨어진 거리를 차로 데려다 주어 너무 고마웠습니다. 운이 정말 좋았다고 생각됩니다. 에디의 집에는 방이 여러개 있어서 2인 가족이나 3인 가족도 머무를 수 있다고 합니다. 여러분들께 에디의 집을 싱가포르의 여행을 위한 최고의 숙소로 추천하고 싶습니다. 특히 밤에 도착하는 여행객들은 시내로 택시를 타고 갈 시간이나 체력이 없을 때 가까이 있는 에디의 집에 숙박을 하신다면 더할 나위없이 즐거운 싱가포르 여행이 될 것입니다.

非常棒的房子，房东布置的非常精致和有品味。位置离机场近，但离地铁远了一点。

离机场挺近，打车13新币左右，内部装潢确实不错噢，很中国风，都是红木的家具。但是住了感觉不好，可能是我们到的晚了，晚上十一点到的，house keeper应该是susan吧有点不高兴的样子，带我们去房间讲了些注意事项，英语有点口音听的并不是很明白…在这之后就再也没见到过人了 想问问第二天怎么去机场什么的也不知道。因为是栋别墅，在各个房间装了空调，公共区域非常热。本来住民宿是想体验当地生活，没想到完全没人理。走到地铁挺远的，1.5公里
The place looks fantastic.
很好的房间、住的好舒服、老板的儿子也好好人、还好有耐心的解答我们的问题，有时还会顺便车我们去地铁站、真的很值的住的、下次来了我还要来这里😬😬
非常適合家庭旅行，因為帶著寶寶，3個人給我們安排了主人房，太豪了～～乾淨，舒適，之前就糾結帶寶寶不想住酒店～ 這樣的旅行可以經常去～ 這個區域屬於富人區，衛生防護很好，本人從事園林，看見房東的花園，知道他很用心～ 太謝謝你，我們下次還去～ 希望你的旅行也愉快！
Great place, close to bus station, only 5 or 6 stop to the MRT. Big house, very clean and quiet.

My family and I are so happy we stayed at Eddie's place! We had such a great experience overall.
First of all, the location was convenient for us. It's near the airport which is great since we arrived and left at around 3am. In terms of going around Singapore, Simei MRT station is just a 15-minute walk. There's a clear map in the house showing how to go there. There are also bus stops nearby. Although it wasn't in the central, it wasn't really hard to go places. Plus there's a good mall with restaurants and a grocery in Simei station.
Eddie was also very accommodating. And it's very easy to communicate with him. Even if we arrived and left really early in the morning, he made the necessary adjustments for us. He instructed ate Susan well. She really waited for us even if we arrived an hour later than agreed because our flight was delayed. And she even booked the taxi for us to go to the airport since we needed to be there by 4am. Ate Susan was really helpful the entire time. You can ask her about anything.
There's also free breakfast which is not usually common in Airbnb's. Personally, I enjoyed having the toast with kaya spread and great coffee for breakfast every day. It's a major plus!
When I go back to Singapore, I will definitely stay in Eddie's place again! The interior is intricate and beautiful, the room is great and complete with the necessary facilities, plus Eddie and ate Susan are great people. Will also recommend this place to everyone!

Nice experience ,love it!
Eddie and his Son are good hosts,always be around to give help and advice.
Will definitely stay again if have a chance.

The place is spectacular! Full of unique antique home decors that definitely added to the great ambiance of the place. The place is home-y, a home away from home! We appreciate the simple but delightful breakfast prepared by Susan, the Home's caretaker. :-)
感谢房东儿子对我们一家的帮助，怕我们找不到地铁还特意开车送我们去，很感动！房间很干净也很漂亮。susan虽然在我们第一天到的时候有些黑脸，不过人还是挺好的。总之，是一次不错的住宿！
위치가 조금 애매하긴 하지만 관광지와 색다른 주택가를 느낄 수 있는 점에서 의미가 있습니다. 숙소는 넓고 깨끗합니다.
Eddie's place is superb. Very clean and well maintained. We loved staying there.
This is a very nice place. The antique collection was amazing. Susan was a very accommodating host. We will recommend this to our friends and families - Raymond and Lea

숙소에 아침일찍 도착해서 가방만보관하고 나갈려고 했는데 열쇠를 주셔서 이른 체크인이 가능해서 좋았습니다 방크기는 4명이 머물기에 충분했고 방상태 또한 좋았습니다 근데 방안에 밝은조명이 없어 칙칙해보일수 있습니다 욕실에 작은수건이 없고 큰타올만 있습니다 참고하세요 아침에 간단한 씨리얼이랑토스트 먹을수 있어서 좋았습니다  마지막날 가방보관할곳이 없어 고민했는데 흔쾌히 가방보관해주셔서 마음편히 관광하다가 오후10시쯤에  숙소에서 공항으로 갔습니다 3일동안 내집처럼 편안이 잘쉬다 왔습니다 ^^

Eddie's house is amazing! Located in a beautiful neighborhood of villas, it's literally a museum of Chinese antiques ( you can easily spend an hour admiring each piece of his art collections)
We stayed 6 nights at his place, both the antiquity room( or more like a suite) and the sanctuary room are very comfortable and facilitated with basically everything you need ( like towels, tissues, fresh blankets, shower gel and hair dryer which is really important for female visitors. And most importantly air-conditioners xD)
Another big plus is the great breakfast that eddie'a housekeeper Susan prepares every morning. Fresh boiled eggs, toasts, fruits, juice, cereal ( even a great cake on one morning ) and the famous Singaporean KAYA bread spread which I fell in love with. ---> THANK YOU SO MUCH SUSAN!
Eddie's place is just 10-15 minutes away from airport if u take taxi , and within a 10-min walk you can reach the Simei subway station which brings you to downtown in 20 min.
We also met Eddie'a son Edwin who was extremely friendly and gave us a brief guide to Singapore's sightseeing spots.
The star of the house, Sunshine, is the cutest dog I've ever seen! Miss him so much!
All in all, I would definitely recommend eddie's place to my friends and if we were coming to Singapore again, it'd be our first choice !

창이공항에 늦은 시간에 도착하거나 귀국할 때 이 숙소에 머물면 좋을 것입니다.
공항과 근접한 거리에 위치하며 타나메라역에서 버스 6정거장 거리에 있습니다.
숙소는 인테리어 및 청소상태 등 너무 훌륭하며 곳곳에 볼거리가 풍부합니다. 아침식사를 넉넉히 제공해 주는 점은 매우 좋습니다.(근처에 상업시설이 없어서 어쩔 수 없는 면도 있는것 같습니다.)

I will definitely go back! This is a place of serenity and beauty and all the peace and quiet you would need in a vacation. The house balances the busy cities of Singapore. Such a lovely place to come home too after a long day of SG strolling.
房子总体非常干净敞亮，结构很好，里面有只柯基很可爱，床和枕头非常舒服。唯一不足的就是离地铁站远了点，步行要15分钟。

The house is very nice, I like the design and style. The breakfast was served on time and Susan is very helpful in giving us tips and how to go around with lesser expenses. 처음에 도착했서 벨을 누르고 응답을 기다렸다. 응답이 없어서 세 번쯤 벨을 누르니 대문이 열리며 집에서 일하시는 여자분이 들어오라고 come, come 이라고 하는데 그 흔한 hi 한 마디도 없이 낯선 집앞에서 제대로 찾아온건지 머뭇거리던 우리에게는 너무 불친절한 첫응대라고 느껴졌다. ㅠㅠ 그 여자분이 굉장히 화난것 같아서 혹시 우리가 뭐 잘 못했는지 언짢으신건지 물어봤다. 그러자 그 여자분이 boss가 우리도착시간이 2시 정도라고 했는데 우리가 늦게 도착해서(5시에 도착) 밥도 못먹고 기다렸다고 했다. 우리는 체크인 시간이 2시 이후인줄 알고 너무 늦은 한밤이나 새벽이 아닌 이상 두 세시간 이후에 도착하는것이 문제가 될 것이라는 생각을 못했다. 여행중에 변수가 생겨 예상도착시간과 달라질수도 있는것이 아닌가. ㅠㅠ 그래도 3박을 하면서 그 여자분이 무뚝뚝하시긴 하지만 책임을 다하시는 분이라는것을 알게되었다. 발코니에 널어둔 빨래를 나간 사이 비가 왔을때 방안으로 넣어주셔서 감사했고 마지막날 체크아웃이후 짐도 맡아주셔서 감사했다. 숙소는 지하철역과 가깝고 근처에는 상점이 없지만 걸어서 15분정도 거리인 시메이 역근처에는 대형슈퍼마켓이 있어서 간단히 요기할 음식과 기념으로 카야잼도 구입할 수 있었다 ㅋ 관광지와는 다소 거리가 있는 위치의 숙소이지만 지하철이 워낙 잘되어있는 나라라서 큰 불편없이 잘 다녔다.
