Uniquely decorated spacious rooms.
Eddie的房源非常好，也非常有特色，性價比非常高，房間的裝潢我非常喜歡，有溫馨的感覺。還有，Eddie的任何回應都非常迅速，令人感到很安心。我衷心推薦。

Eddie's place was very comfortable. The neighborhood is very peaceful and the MRT is walking distance. The decor of the house is unique with interesting antiques. The sit out has a beautiful garden and a lotus pond.

Tha room is spacious for the five of us. The breakfast is very good,there's cereal, juice,coffee,tea, eggs, bread, fruits and different jam. Aling Susan is very nice and very accommodating.The place is a 10 min walk to Upper Changi Station and 15 min walk to Simei Station. We will definitely stay here again when we come back to SG.

Edwin greeted us in the morning as we got some light breakfast provided by him. He was very kind and spent a lot of his own time showing us a map of Singapore and where to go. He recommended some good spots :)
The location was very close to airport and train station which was very handy.
非常满意，房东儿子人超级好，很善谈～给了我们很多出行建议，更加完善了我们的出行计划，我们一家四口住在这个房间刚刚好，只是另外一个是床垫稍微有一点不方便…其他真的都很完美～无论地理位置、服务还是早餐，都非常的好～出行无论是地铁还是巴士都非常方便～～总之下次来还会再选择这里～
Nice place, very near the airport and MRT station. You surely wouldn't miss your flight!
The room is bigger then expected. Lovely design and a helpful host. Thank you for the great experience.

Eddie’s hospitality was above and beyond.  We had a very enjoyable stay.  The accommodation was as described and very clean.  Great basic breakfast was provided.  Would definitely return - Thankyou Eddie
Check this place when youre in Sg. Definitely, a must stay!

This was the first room we booked and I would say it was exceptional. The hubby and I loved everything about the place--very spacious and lots of amazing decors! Hospitality was at its best with Susan always around (she helped us in locating the bus station and train station, both of which were very near) and Edwin visiting us on the second day, giving us tips and suggestions in touring the Lion City!
Great choice !

感謝你們熱情招待，我們非常欣賞屋主每天早上會向客人打招呼，簡單早餐，一起傾談，分享遊歷經驗。屋主會簡介星加坡的環境和旅遊景點，有一天我們計劃出發去聖淘沙，早上仍下雨，屋主拿出件雨衣給我們，非常貼心的安排。居住環境理想、整潔，遠離市區環境清幽。推介大家😊
Thank you for your hospitality. We really appreciate that the owner will say hello to the guests every morning, simple breakfast, talk together and share the experience of traveling. The owner will introduce the environment and tourist attractions in Singapore. One day we plan to go to Sentosa. It still rains in the morning. The owner has two raincoats for us, very intimate arrangements. The living environment is ideal, clean and tidy, away from the urban environment. but near the MRT and peaceful place.
a unique and great place to stay in!
英語も出来ずとても不安でしたが、とても丁寧に観光地や、地下鉄の乗り方も教えてくれました！部屋はとても素敵です。高級感があります。チェックアウトの時間があったのですが荷物を夜まで預かっていただいてとても感謝しています。シンガポールに行く機会があればまた泊まりたいと思います。

La casa es increíble, tiene una tranquilidad inmejorable, todo está limpio y armonioso, es muy amplia y está muy cerca del metro que es la línea principal de Singapur y de ahí te puedes transportar a cualquier parte de la ciudad sin necesidad de tomar otro transporte, el aeropuerto está muy cerca y todo se Felícita, el desayuno es muy rico y el comedor está súper limpio, la verdad fue mucho más de lo q esperaba, aunque no conocí al anfitrión pero su hijo fue súper amable y en todo momento nos ayudó a mi madre, hermano y a mi, recomendado a todos los los que nos gusta hospedarnos en Airbnb
Very nice and peaceful place. It is more or less an 8-minute walk from Upper Changi Station of Downtown Line and maybe 4 minutes from the nearest bus stop. Free breakfast is a plus.

The house is exactly what the pictures show,the antiquity room is so spacious that can accommodate 4-6 people. The room is cleaned every day so you will feel comfortable in the house.There would be toast eggs and some drinks provided every morning.
The house is about 1 kilometer far from metro station, 10 minutes by walking. And about half an hour far from China town by metro.
The son of house owner who can speak both Chinese and English is very kind.He showed us some famous sight spots on the map and recommend some restaurants and shops which local people like to visit.He also help us to make a booking of taxi to the airport in late of night.that solve a big problem for us.That is a good trip in the house.
房东的儿子人超好，会中文，给我们推荐许多当地人喜欢的餐厅，商店。并在地图上给我们指路，超级nice。我们是半夜飞机，他还帮我们叫了出租车，特别有心。
房子很棒，在当地新加坡人的居住区，很有当地特色，当地的装饰中式复古，配套齐全，距离地铁站走路一公里，走路十分钟。距离牛车水搭地铁半个小时。打车到金沙大概16新币。
我们是亲子出行，房子很舒服，很合适。

Great place to stay. Really nice, accomodating host and caretaker.
Thanks a lot Mr. Eddie and Ms. Susan. will surely book this place on my next visit.

Eddie’s place is the most stylish and interesting place we have ever stayed at. I fell in love with interior design of new building with traditional furnishing and trinkets dotted around! Susan, the housekeeper, really looked after us well. They do laundry and breakfast on request. Edwin, Eddie’s son, is helping manage the property and provided me with an abundance of local tips and map! Comfortable space. Location is not central but the MRT is only 5 minutes walk and the line it’s on takes you through all of the tourist destinations for cheap price

My girlfriend and I rented this place because it was hard to find homestays that were affordable in Singapore and we were more than pleasantly surprised. The atmosphere of the house was very nice and the nights were quiet and peaceful. The room was very spacious and accommodated to all of our needs.
Edwin, Eddie's son, was super helpful. Every morning during breakfast he would answer all the guests questions and had great recommendations.
This place is far from downtown but we didn't mind the commute. The public transit is amazing in Singapore and it was actually pleasant to commute everyday like the locals. In hindsight I think it would be even worse being in all the commotion of downtown.

GREAT PLACE TO LIVE.
THANKS EDDIE.

Fantastic room - it felt very regal! The surroundings are within a peaceful and secure environment and I was kindly provided by lots of tips by Edwin on places to see and visit during my stay. Breakfast was provided and it's really easy to reach by public transport.
房間十分寬敞，可以容納6至8人居住，環境優雅，且有古雅的收藏品，提供貼心服務，每天更換垃圾及裝滿飲用的開水以及早餐的服務，毗鄰地鐵站，位置理想，是不二之住宿之選。

If you want to live outskirt of the Singapore, I guess this is the best place for u. This place is quiet day and night, close to singapore expo(always has weekend sales) and also close to changi City point where u can buy running shoes or casual wear at a cheaper price. Close to busstop and Mrt Station

Great location as the MRT station is a 3 minute walk from the house. Eddie is an excellent host as he maintains frequent communication about directions to the house as well as other helpful tips. The house is very beautifully maintained and check in is a breeze. A simple breakfast is provided in the morning which is nice since some Air BnBs don't always provide this added touch. Overall, this is a very nice place to stay in a safe neighborhood and is a good value too!

这是我第一次在爱彼迎订旅行房间，一开始还有些忐忑，但是实际到了后被房东的装修品味惊艳了，特别美很有韵味，而且价格实惠便宜，其实出门坐公交或坐地铁甚至是打车都蛮方便的。房东Edwin人特别热情好客并且善良，第一天来由于路不熟所以房东还特别热心的开车载我们去了四美吃饭。并且给了我们很多旅行建议，建议我们去的乌敏岛真的很推荐很惊艳，父母特别喜欢Edwin和他的家。特别推荐大家入住。虽然管家Susan有时候会有些不开心但是不影响啊，因为房东的真诚可以给120分。

Eddie’s place is quiet, clean and relaxing. Our room is spacious enough for a group of 6. It’s near upper changi mrt and bus station. What i love most about the place is it is near changi city point and changi airport! I would recommend this place and we’ll book this room again when we get back!

Room is so wide and nice.
My kids liked to have fresh fruit that Ms. Susan provide on breakfast everyday.
I went to MRT Bencoolen for study everyday.
I think it is very convenient access to get there, just 5 min. walk to Upper Changi station.
No transit access to business district.
Great house in a lovely, quiet neighborhood.  Conveniently close to MRT to take you in to town.  Accommodating  host, provided conveniences when requested. Thank you!
everything is nice.... love this place... a little bit far from center but it's ok..
Eddie place is very clean and spacious. Susan was very friendly and show us around the place when we checked in the middle of the night. Highly recommend Eddie's place to stay.
eine tolle Unterkunft, gut erreichbar, sehr ruhige Lage, 5 Minuten bis zur MRT Station, 5 Minuten mit dem Taxi/Grab zum Flughafen.

英語が片言しかわからない私達にもお手伝いのSusanは親切でした。タクシーを呼んでくれたり、充電器を貸してくれたり。助かりました。
ゲストルームがたくさんあり、ほかのゲストと顔を合わせることもありますが、皆さんマナーも良くとても静かに快適に過ごせました。
冷蔵庫、ハンガー、洗濯物干し、ティッシュなどもあり、価格以上の快適さではないでしょうか。
駅までも近いですし、利便性の高い宿です。
环境好。

시내랑 거리가 떨어져있어서 걱정했지만 집근처에 지하철이 있어서 시내 어디든 다니기 용이했습니다. 아침은 굳이 따로 말하지않고 시간맞춰 내려가면 간단하게 준비되어있어요. 마지막날에는 짐도 보관해줘서 잘 쉬다가 왔습니다. 다만 수건은 처음에 부족한듯이 주셨는데 요청하니까 바로 더 가져다 주셨어요!
방도 사진보다 더 넓고, 방이 아니라 객실 하나 빌린 수준입니다. 정말 좋았어요^^
Eddie and father and the housekeeper were super nice host, we could not ask for more amazing place to stay calm and relaxed in Singapore!
友善的房東和管家，有需求都可以馬上反應並配合，很謝謝他們的招待

Eddie's place is amazing and I just can't stop taking pictures of their backyard... its really that good! House is very stylish, quiet neighbourhood and is 5 mins away from MRT and closer to the airport. The Antiquity Room is also very spacious and can probably fit about 5-6 people. It also comes with a free simple breakfast which is a big plus. Only downside is that you're bit far from the major places like the Marina Bay and Chinatown and that there are no shops around the area to buy stuff (there is a 7/11 nearby though). Other than that, this is by far the most impressed places I've ever stayed at with Airbnb and I would definitely come again!

Great host and great stay in Songapore.
When One of my friend left her sunglasses in tje grab, he helped us to find it. Thsnks to his warm heart, I had a wonderful trip in Singapore. I was really thankful to him.
The house was located in peaceful area. Although the house is far away from downtown, it wasn’t too much inconvenient. It was very good to be near the airport.
If I had a chance again, I want to stay here.

Eddie’s place is everything as advertised and more.  It’s spacious, spick and span, stylish, and a real value for money.  I think it’s even way better than hotel rooms of the same or higher price range.  From the looks of it, the property is located in what seems like a posh residential area.  It’s safe and accessible with the nearest MRT station just a 5-minute walk away.  We didn’t have the chance to meet Eddie, but his son Edwin and his housekeeper Susan were such superb hosts.  Edwin was quick to communicate from the start and had always been so helpful.  We’re simply all praises for this place and its hosts.  My family and I actually missed our room the moment we left it.  Thank you for making our first Airbnb stay beyond great!
Good home to stay near Changi airport
很贴心的房东，还有热情的Susan，下一次新加坡旅行还会选择这里哟。

The most important trait in hospitality business of being warm and pleasant is missing.
Firstly and most important trait in the hospitality business is giving a warm welcome to the guests, honestly the welcome completely lacked this bit and followed by instructions which almost sounded like orders.
Secondly, when we asked for coffee cups during breakfast we were questioned about the cups taken couple of hours earlier. Indians have an habit of drinking coffee early in the morning and once after/during breakfast. I didn't understand the need to Sulk to give cups. For a moment I felt thinking to myself if I was staying for free.
Thirdly, Since they charge extra 15 SGD per person, I think the breakfast should be better. As travelers we would love to try the local cuisine but a very simple English breakfast doesn't translate into value for money.
Fourthly, this place is 50mins away from main attractions like Gardens by the Bay, Chinatown etc by MRT. As travelers you are bound to walk a lot at these attractions and getting back to this place is quite a daunting task if you had a tiring day.
Fifthly, there are absolutely no restaurants or hawkers centers close by. So you have to ensure not to reach this place hungry.
Now coming to the positive aspects, The place looks good and very clean. Completely appreciate all the efforts put in by the owner to make your place beautiful.

We loved Eddie’s place, we knew it wasn’t central but with good access to mrt by foot and we wanted a place to unwind and enjoy his beautiful home andbe away from the hustle and bustle of the busy city life. The house is charming and in a lovely neighbourhood and we had the pleasure of meeting both Eddie and his son Edwin who gave great local tips and we always available for us if we needed. Thanks again, we would return.
A very spacious suite, well appointed and friendly hosts. Easy rapid transit access.
Thank you for your kindness

Eddie’s place is a beautiful large home crammed with an amazing array of art and decor. The room we stayed in was very spacious with a lounge area, equipped with a desk that my husband worked at. The MRT is a five minute walk away and is very close to the airport. No eateries within walking distance so need to eat out before returning home. Lovely peaceful street and easy check-in and out.

Eddie communicated very well with us from the outset and we had no problem finding his place.
The house is beautifully decorated with lots of antiques and has character.
Our room was very large and we found it comfortable enough for a family of four.
Unfortunately our room was not as clean as we would have liked, so despite the cheap price for Singapore we did not feel it offered value for money.
Very nice vila with all comfort. Next time I will book again.

We had a very pleasant stay in Singapore. Edwin gave us all information we needed to know beforehand and also very good recommendations where to eat and what places to visit during our stay. Susan, the housekeeper is a very lovely and kind woman. She took us buying grocery on the first evening we arrived. The room was very spacious with good air conditioning and a big bathroom. The neighborhood was very quiet and a relaxing place to stay. Public transportation is also just a 5 minute walk away. Breakfast was kept modest but that didn't bother us at all as the garden view was wonderful and in general Singapore has a lot to offer for trying out new food.
I'd definitely recommend staying at Eddie's place and would come back again when visiting Singapore. :)

Wenn man einer ruhige, gut bezahlbare Bleibe für Singapur, mit stilvoller Einrichtung sucht, und in Kauf nimmt, dass man schon weit von Zentrum wohnt, ist man an der richtige Adresse. Dafür ist dann die Reise zum Flüghafen wirklich sehr kurz, man ist in 10 Minuten da. Auch mit dem Bus dauert die Fahrt 14 Min.

Eddie’s rooms are very cozy and comfortable. We felt like at home and had great sleep because the house is very quiet. Amenities are available including hair dryer, towels, ironer and we had a clothes changing room! The house is just 5min walk to the mrt and 13min drive if you book a Grab from the airport. Also, it takes within 15 mins if you take the mrt to Changi airport, which is so convenient! We didn’t have to rush before our departure.
Near to the MRT station. A nice place to stay in Sinapore
我们的入住人员有些多，但是房主非常亲切且周全的给所有人准备了住宿用具等，非常感谢。有机会再来新加坡，这个民宿一定是首选~

Eddie's place is amazing! You will be attracted by the aesthetics of the house when you enter the front gate. Susan and her sister are very sweet, feel free to ask them for help! I chose this place due to my early flight, which departs before the MRT opens . It won't cost too much to take a cab from Eddie's house to the airport in the really early morning.

The space was a short train ride from the airport and equally easy walking distance from the MRT line which could take you directly to the city center. If you get a tourist pass for three days it’s definitely worth it. The house is in a safe quiet area and very tranquil. We had a huge room to ourselves with a comfortable bed and all the amenities required. I would just ask for an extra towel if you need one and they are more than happy to give you one.
Beautiful space and lovely people who are always open to chat!
Good place if you want to be close to the airport. Otherwise, it's a bit far from the city.

Fantastic hospitality and superb bungalow couple with wooden furnitures.
500 meters short walk from MRT station, walking along a cozy neighborhood.
Two stations away from Changi airport, most of the sight seeing is on the same MRT line.

went on a short trip to singapore and eddie made the process super smooth and helpful from the beginning to end. everyone was very friendly and would most definitely stay here again if i'm ever in the area again! So for anyone visiting singapore, this is would be a great place to stay because it's in a very convenient location.
Eddie's place is big, stylish and well located for access to Changi airport. It was no problem for them to accommodate my very late arrival (at midnight).

It's a great experience to live here. I like the Chinese style very much. My room is very big and comfortable, and good view out of the window, The transportation is very convenient. subway or bus station is not far，The tips were detailed ，The housekeeper also nice to smile everyday and prepared breakfast and everything for us....thx so much, Thank the landlord for providing such a nice place. hope to come again sometime....：）
房間距離機場很近 非常方便就可以找到 到最近的捷運站步行5分鐘左右 房東很好客 還幫助解決在當地發生的小意外（出租車事件）非常的nice 雖然距離機場很近但是沒有噪音 休息很舒服 以後來新加坡還會選擇這裡
Great place to stay. Good value for money.

Edwin and Sharon were a joy to deal with.  Quick responses and very helpful.  Breakfast was nice, toast, jams, peanut butter, daily fruit, coffee, juice, and cereal.  Using public transit took awhile to get.to places but still great experience.  Thanks Eddie for opening your home.
This is a lovely and tranquil place to rest after long travel and close to the airport to start the next part of the journey.
房間非常大，整體也非常乾淨整潔，房東跟管家都非常友善，中秋節還受邀一起共進晚餐，非常感動！！交通也非常便利，離地鐵站近。在這裡度過了三個月的開心時光

Spacious and well designed room in a spacious and beautiful house
Quiet and nice neighborhood
Near bus stop and MRT station
Owner Eddie communicates really fast and; is friendly and kind
Highly recommended
Eddie's place is a must stay! The host Mr.Edwin is very welcoming and understanding to the needs of his guest. Susan aunty also took good care! 5 stars for sure

I rented the room for my work colleague Pam for 3 1/2 weeks. Rebekah is a great host. Very friendly und super helpful. Nothing is too much for her. Communication is very easy and an instant reply is guaranteed. She even let us check the apartment before confirming the booking. The room was clean, very spacious and newly renovated. Great location, surrounded by restaurants, coffee shops, supermarket etc. MRT is right in front of the apartment. I can only recommend it and would rent it again.
Excellent high quality accommodation. Very good host and excellent communication. Will stay here again.
Wonderful room with en suite - great location, great aircon comfy bed and lots of storage and facilities. Super place!
Clean , spacious and close to HV MRT. very responsive host. location surrounded by eateries , clinic, supermarket nerby.
I had a great stay and the host was very friendly and helpful. Would recommend

Bad experience due to loud noises from the street although the location is great and the room is big. It’s too close to the street and the window is single layer which can’t stop the sound. I can’t sleep well in the first night and have to wear the ear plugs in the following nights.
nice place
Very nice house and very kind host.

Rebekah is a friendly and approachable host. When the room I wanted to book was no longer available, she upgraded me to a room in another apartment of hers. The room is spacious, perfectly clean and neat. It is so near the MRT station, very convenient.

There is no disturbance, with privacy nicely protected.

at most of all, if you look for the best comfortable accommodation with transports and living in SG, it is Rebekah's house. Actually when I knew how close MRT is from house - it is just by house like being attached and how convenient i take a bus, i was very surprised.
No words, just go! You will be satisfied very well.

Amazing location in Holland Village with tons of food options and pubs. Right next to MRT and several buses to get to other areas of Singapore easily. Rebekah is very responsive and helpful. Apartment is clean and quiet. It's a fourth floor walkup so keep that in mind if you have a lot of luggage.

I had a very pleasant stay at Rebekah's place. The room is clean, comfortable and adequately equipped. It's central location makes it exceptionally convenient as well - a stone's throw away from the MRT station. Also not forgetting to mention that Rebekah is a very helpful and friendly host. I would strongly recommend Rebekah's place to anyone out there looking for accommodation around this area!

An excellent host who I recommend to you strongly. Very nice and welcoming.
Apartment well located, offering the opportunity to enjoy Holland Village lifestyle
Definitely would recommend
Great location, the apartment is big, room is clean and bright. Would recommend
Great place for great location!
A comfortable, clean and quiet place on the 4th floor (no elevators) with transport and eateries right next door.

I stayed 6 nights at this apartment, and really felt like home. Quiet and comfy. Though was not much space to move around, you have everything from kitchenware to linen.

I didn't use shuttle bus to MRT, but walkable distance, and lot of shops in that town centre area.

Shirlyn's apartment was very cozy. We enjoyed our stay very much and made good use of the facilities, especially the pool. It is a small apartment but fully equipped, thanks to the thoughtful arrangement (basic essentials plus food and drinks) by Shirlyn.

I am not the guest, but my mom and my youngest sister along with my dad. I just frequently drop by to spend time with them.
Place has a limited space to move around but it is a very cozy, quiet place. Host did prepared everything from big needs to smallest needs guest might need. There are snacks and drinks stored as well. Host is very accomodating and will really check on you whether everything is fine.
Place is about 15min away from mrt. The only thing is you have to walk a bit more if you wanna go to a grocery or grab some food. Despite all this, my mom still liked the place.

Shirlyn was a great host and a great person. My mum and I needed a place to stay during a renovation of our home within Singapore itself. She warmly welcomed us and gave us a very good orientation of the home, which made us feel comfortable immediately. Staying in Singapore itself, this home felt like an upgrade from our own home. The listing is exactly as described and shown in the pictures, yet the coziness and the comfort level surprised us. It is incredibly well equipped and furnished to suit our every need. We did not need to bring or buy much to make us feel as though we were staying in our own home. We had a delightful 2 week stay, and if we ever needed somewhere to stay in Singapore, we would probably stay here again. My mum especially enjoyed the peaceful tranquility of the patio/balcony area. The neighborhood was very pleasant and peaceful, giving a sense of exclusivity that is hard to come by, staying in HDB flats in Singapore. It is very near to the MRT that is 30 minutes or so away from the popular town areas. I would highly recommend this wonderful home to anyone coming to Singapore to have a short stay.

It was great! Very cosy and well-equipped apartment. It was situated in a quiet neighbourhood and supermarket is within walking distance. It was a very relaxing staycay for us and our dog enjoyed himself too! We tried other apartment before but he was not as comfortable. Definitely recommend this apartment for couples :)

We stayed in the apartment and enjoyed the modern and well equipped apartment. Also the pool and gym were a great facility. Quinn was also very helpful thru out our stay. We will certainly come back when we are in the area again.
Quite and cozy place. Perfect for spending quality time with my beloved fam. Complete amenities provided by the host! Highly recommended place...no doubt.

Quinn was so accomodating & understanding host .She was quick to response and her place was pretty cosy and warmth and it is located nearby the food joints and easily accessible to public transports & Causeway Point. Thank you for hosting us , Quinn!! ☺
Excellent property and the host is very cooperative. Everything was beyond my expectations.

The house is beautiful and for us in the perfect location. Less than 5 minutes you can find a 24 hr store and food shops of your choice. House is gated, gives a little extra security which in this country is not really need. Super safe.

Sebastian was a great host who offered help whenever I needed it. The apartment was great and it was very comfortable. The other long-term tenants were really nice. I would definitely recommend the room to anyone and would choose this apartment again for myself when I return to Singapore!

I had a wonderful time staying at Sebastian’s place.

The host: Sebastian and his wife were very helpful and friendly. They picked me up and brought me to the house. Sebastian showed me the surroundings (walking distance places) so I get used to the area.
My U.S. phone wasn’t working so I bought a local sim card and he lent me a phone. If you plan to stay for a week or more having a local number can become very helpful. The day I was leaving SG he even took me to the airport.
Bottom line, he was always available whenever I tried to reach out to him.

The place: The room I stayed is pretty comfortable, with your own bathroom and balcony. Wifi, AC, TV working perfect.
The kitchen is wide, you have utensils to use or cook your own meal.
Washing/dryer machines working perfect as well.
Groceries, Hawker center, LRT (bus), MRT (subway), etc, are pretty close.

Staying with Suan Khim and her family made my 10 weeks in Singapore such a pleasant and special experience - my sincere thanks to Suan and her family for your ever so friendly welcome, for your kindness (also for your care and the beautiful food when I had a cold). The place is convenient as it's at the ground floor (no going up and down in lift), good facility (my kids loved the pools), neat and clean. Great if  come by car as visitor car park is free and near the apartment. Only complaint we have was the bathroom water heater didn't work in our first night (but worked the following night).

Aloy and Sandy made us feel extremely welcome. They helped us just settle in extremely easily and helped in every which way possible including letting us know of fun events coming up in Singapore. We traveled with 2 kids and the place is very kid friendly...They were also extremely patient as we got delayed due to an unexpected meeting while checking out.

We would very much recommend anyone looking for a place in Singapore.
Thank you for the wonderful apartment,  and your kind help during my stay in Singapore! My expectations were exceeded, and I will definitely book for my next stay in Singapore.

The apartment was very nice and the facilities were great, kids loved the 4 pools, only 10 min to 2 MRT. Aloysius and Sandy were very friendly. We would definitely stay there again, and would recommend it to others. Thank you!
It was a very good stay for my family especially my kids enjoyed the stay. Aloy and Sandy was very cordial and helped with all details to make our stay very comfortable.

Amazing stay! Aloy really went out of his way to accommodate us, meeting us at our convenience both at check in and check out. He was very flexible with a few last minute changes we had and was just such an amazing host.

The listing itself is very conveniently located a few minutes from Buona Vista MRT. The apartment is clean and well furnished, and has all the conveniences and amenities you'll need for your stay.
Aloy was very nice and very helpful. Good communication. The place is very nice and convenient, you have all need for a pleasant stay. Totally recommended!

Aloysius og hans hustru er venlige og imødekommende værter. Da jeg afleverede nøglerne til lejligheden kørte de mig til den nærmeste togstation. Aloysius tog imod mig, da jeg ankom, og skrev til mig under mit ophold for at tjekke om alt var ok med lejemålet. De var meget fleksible omkring tidspunktet for udtjekning og altid med et smil på læben.

Jeg følte mig meget velkommen - og vil bestemt overveje at bo i lejligheden igen.
Easy check in and out, great location and apartment as described.
Aloysius place is comfortable and an easy walk to the MRT. It was nice to use the swimming pool. Aloysius was very responsive and helpful.

Aloy’s apartment is exactly as in the photo’s and as described.
Communication was very responsive .
At check-in they were very flexible considering the delay of my flight and were very helpful getting me to their place. Showed me around the apartment and explained how everything worked. Super hospitable.
Location and amenities are good and easy access to taxis and public transport.
Good value for money for this part of town and would recommend it.
The apartment looks nice, however there was no mention of the smell in the description.
The suite is really cozy and clean and have a complete set of facilities. Aloysius and Sandy are also nice & warm.

Such an enjoyable stay in what is an ideal apartment by owners who could not have been more helpful. The entire experience exceeded our expectations and was a wonderful introduction to our stay in Singapore. Highly recommended on all counts.
Grazie RC & SC

Aloysius and Sandy are wonderful hosts, a warm and friendly couple. They picked me up from the subway station and brought me right to their place, explained everything thoroughly (air conditioning, kitchen features, television channels, on-premise laundry, etc.), then took me to the nearest grocery store so I could do my grocery shopping. Truly above and beyond the call! They are also a great source of suggestions on what to see and do in Singapore, and for good places to eat.
The apartment is spacious, airy, and bright, super clean, well air-conditioned (very important in Singapore), on the first floor (a plus), and only a 15-minute walk from the subway system, which can take you everywhere in S'pore efficiently and inexpensively. The building and grounds are safe and secure. There's a free washer and dryer right off the kitchen. The bed was large and comfortable. There's a good collection of restaurants less than 10 minutes away. I highly recommend this AirBNB in every respect. ~Michael
Sandy and Aloysius are very friendly and quick at responding. They are flexible about check-in and check-out time. Their place is clean and quiet. We enjoy our stay a lot.

A great place. Very spacious, comfortable and felt like a home away from home. Hosts were extremely gracious and friendly, showed me around and made it easy for my first time in Singapore. Lovely time. I would definitely recommend this place, mostly because of the awesome hosts, but also because it’s such a lovely spot. 🙌🏾
Great place, good location and cool hosts!
超级棒，离地铁近，附近超市多，挺好的。下次继续来住
位置好，步行到地铁站10分钟，公交车站5分钟，附近有超市和食阁，生活出行都方便。小区的游泳池挺好，儿童游泳有喷泉戏水功能，孩子非常喜欢。
It was good

We had a great stay at Melissa's place! The location was convenient for getting to the east-west train, and there are also a number of buses close by. There is a very nice pool in the complex that we enjoyed, and we loved having laundry in-unit! The apartment itself is simple and without too many amenities, but it was just right for what we needed, and the price is right. Just note that if you have two parties staying together who will be doing different things, it can get a bit complicated with key exchange, so you might want to talk to Melissa about that ahead of time. On that note, communication with Melissa was great, and she was incredibly accommodating regarding our arrival time, which we thoroughly appreciated after our long overnight flights! Overall, I would definitely recommend Melissa's place and wouldn't hesitate to stay again if I ever return to Singapore.

The entire room is good, clean and well maintained.
The area overall might be good for the youth but not for elder, especially who need to walk around using public transport, because there is a part of the street that is elevated. The place is quite far from public transport station (for elder).
However, Melissa as a host is very responsive and helpful.
Overall it was a nice place to stay.
The apartment and kitchen are very dirty. Especially, the fridge is terrible. The living room and kitchen dont have enough lights.

The place was as advertise. The unit is spacious and clean, with thoughtful touches such as the laundry soaps, shampoo, bath soaps and hand soaps which we appreciate very much. There was a slight problem during check in but the host came and assisted right away. We had a wonderful stay. Highly recommended!
非常棒的民宿体验，退房耽误了时间，房东非常友善，希望下次来新加坡还有机会入住。

Prim is an amazing host, he helped me with everything such as my credit card problems and my early leaving. When I arrived he showed me everything inside the home, and he gave me a new bed sheets and towel.

The best thing in this room is the location, bus stops are around you everywhere, so you can reach any place, and also the MRT station is close. It’s very easy to find the food and anything you need in everywhere near you, you just need to walk for two minutes!

Inside the room and the house everything was good, you will get a good space for you inside the kitchen, the air conditioning, fridge, washing machine and dryer are very good.

One problem that the bathroom was not clean some days, and sometimes I was unable to use the kitchen because it’s smell was very bad after cooking.

Generally, the room is very good and I recommended it for anyone.

The host is very friendly and helpful about any concern upcoming. the location of the apartment is very good, with a good connection to the NUS campus and also many stores and a hawker in walkable distance. the view of the room is pointing towards a nice green park like area, very nice landscape.

Prim was a very good host. Despite the ongoing pandemic he helped me feel at home in Singapore and showed me around as much as the situation allowed. When he heard that I like hiking he provided recommendations of hikes in the proximity of the apartement that I could even enjoy when Singapore only slowly started lifting restrictions. He was also very respectful and understanding towards my non-asian cultural background which I very much appreciated, especially with the stressful and unusual pandemic situation that I got to experience during my 10 months stay.
Queensway homestay was the perfect location for me, as I could reach my work place at National University of Singapore in less than 10 min by bus. There is also a plethora of busses going towards the CBD, Orchard road, botanical gardens, the central water catchment and harbourfront/entry to Sentosa, so I could easily explore the entire city of Singapore. Also, there a plenty of food options in the neighborhood, for example Alexandra village hawker center just across the street, and I got to try a lot of very good local dishes.
I had a good time in Singapore and Queensway homestay and hope that more people will get to enjoy Prim's hospitality!
As a host, Prim is highly grateful & highly responsive in answering all of my enquiries. He makes my accommodation as worthwhile as he can. Blessed to meet a host as wonderful as Prim.
The location is very strategic and the host has been very helpful during my stay

It was our first experience with AirBnB. Kingsley was a great host whom not only adapted to our needs, he was also generous when we asked for two eggs as my partner and I were so hungry! I will surly recommend to any who wants a cosy and enjoyable stay!

overall is a pleasant and calm place to stay. nice area to go for a jog in the evenings too  :) sometimes gets a little messy due to cockroaches or insects since the apartment is on the ground floor. but the host tries to keep the place pretty clean. rules can be a little strict at times but is okay haha :p thanks Kingsley for having us over!
Wonderful host. Very close to the Chinese garden. Clean and comfortable room.

I enjoy my stay at kingsley's place, spacious and cozy room, clean and near from bus stop...in the morning i also can have a very fresh air the surrounding is many trees and you can find alot of local food near here jurong food market, last but not least kingsley is a very nice person, he detailed explain about his place and very very helpful, easy to find his place, recomended place, will be back for my next trip here
friendly host, comfort place to stay
Kingsley and his parents are very nice. The bus stop is just outside the building. It is very convinent to go lakeside or Boon Lay.

I stayed in the Masterbedroom. The whole apartment was clean and nice. The room offers everything you need like enough space for clothes, a big bed, Aircon, Fan, Mirrows, Bathing tub in the bathroom, pretty furniture.
The host is communicative, helps with everything and answered all questions everytime.
I can only recommend this apartment.
The room is so nice and clean. Kingsley is so friendly :) must be recommended

Kingsley and his family are very friendly and helpful. The room was very spacious, but not as bright as it looks in the pictures. Still, we had a great time there and always felt super comfortable. The Chinese and Japanese gardens are just a 5min walk away and the perfect place to spend a day out, as you can observe lizards and turtles and have a nice walk around. Shopping malls are very easy to reach, as the busses run directly in front of the building. Other than that it is a quiet area and it takes a while to get downtown. However, thank you so much Kingsley for the great time we had staying at your place!!
Alloggio tranquillo....
Me and my wife had a great stay there. Kingsley is a great host. Very responsive and understandable. You have a complete kitchen there. Can cook very easily.
clean and clear. The host is very kind, he introduces everything in the house. Highly recommend if you have to stay for working somewhere near NTU.
Overall great.
位於住宅區所以比較安靜 房間硬件齊全  適合兩個人住 但去MRT較遠

The room is big and clean.
Kingsley and his parents are very kind. They help you for anything.
Wonderful experience.
Nice hospitality, Kingsley is helpful always. My stay was a pleasant one. The property is near to Japanese/Chinese gardens and just behind the busstop.
Kingsley and his family have shown the great hospitality! This is the best bnb and host I could ever ask for!

It is suitable for 2 people to live. Convenient and quite. Kingsley is also very friendly to us. When we have questions., he will immediately give responses.We had a good experience in living here. Thanks,Kingsley.
Easygoing host with a clean place!

Perfect place to stay!! I travelled to Singapore to visit my friend from college. Kingsley’s place was close enough to Jurong East, and relatively inexpensive for me. It was the perfect amount of space, VERY clean(which I take seriously), towels, soap and shampoo provided, and nice access to the kitchen. It’s nice that he has Air Conditioning because you’re gonna need it if you’re a first timer in Singapore. Thanks for the great place man!
recommended to other travellers as kingsley's house is convenient.
Kingsley was a great host. Thanks a lot for your help during our stay. I personally recommend Kingsley's place to anyone visiting the town
Pretty nice house host and also have private toilet

We had a great stay at Kingsley's place. The room is clean, spacious, and bright during daytime, but the windows have thick curtains for privacy/in case you don't want the sun. Since there are a lot of trees in the surroundings, it's also cool at night. The house is walking distance from a nature park, several hawker centres with really good food, and 24/7 supermarkets--FairPrice and Sheng Siong. The bus stop to MRT station and shopping malls in west area like Jurong Point  IMM, Westgate, and Jem is just in front of the house. Lastly, Kingsley and his family are really nice and approachable. We felt welcome, happy, and comfortable in his home.

We have repeatedly booked Kingsley's place and all I can say is that he's the best host ever. He's very approachable and helpful. The place is nice and quiet too. It's far from the CBD but only walking distance from nature parks and a public pool. There are several malls and outlets nearby too.   Bus stop is just in front of the unit and the nearest mrt station (lakeside) is only a few bus stops away.

My stay here for 14 weeks on the whole was enjoyable. I can't stress how lovely Kingsley and his parents are, really lovely people and his parents are very easy to live with. Kingsley himself is great at communicating and letting you know about events going on in Singapore and he replies very quickly. Generally its very quiet at night but you are on a main road so can be noisy at times. Cooking facilities are generally ok however the oven doesn't work so you are limited to the microwave and a hob for cooking however there are cheap hawker markets nearby (within 10 minute walk).  My only negative comment would be that the photos are very dated - especially of the living room. I think updated photos are needed of the apartment as its much more lived in now and there is a lot of clutter in the living room. The photos of the bedroom and  bathroom are fairly accurate but the room has different furniture now including the bed and desk/table. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Kingsley est un hôte très agréable et le logement est parfait, que ce soit sur son emplacement, son cl fort et sa propreté.

Catherine is an amazing host ! She does everything possible to make you feel home. She is always willing to assist (for example,she dropped and collected my laundry !).
About the master room, it is exactly as described. Your privacy is fully respected as the bathroom and dressing are connected to the room.

I highly recommend.

Nous avons été très bien accueillis par Catherine, qui nous a donné de bons conseils pour visiter Singapour et avons passé d'agréables moments avec elle.
L'appartement est moderne et confortable, la chambre lumineuse avec sa salle d'eau et de grands rangements. Nous avons bien profité de la grande piscine, après une journée de visite c'est agréable.

The room was great, windows on two sides with nice view of the pool. Attached private bathroom with shower was convenient. Catherine provided everything that was needed - towels, shampoo, soap, etc, lots of extra touches. Highly recommended.

Catherine is very welcoming, the room is exactly as described, a nice master bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom, the appartement is very clean and we could use the kitchen and the fridge. The neighborhood is safe and there a lot of cheap restaurants. MRT station to downtown is 10 min walk.

Was für eine bezaubernde-nette Dame. Catherine hat ihr Bestes gegeben dami wir uns wohfühlen. Das Zimmer ist supersauber und schön. Es befindet sich ein Bad direkt im Zimmer. Catherine hat uns sogar Brot, Marmelade, Cornflakes und Saft fürs Frühstück besorgt  und hat imme wieder nachgefragt, ob Sie uns sonst noch was besorgen soll. Kaffe und Tee gibt es auch umsonst. Im Zimmer sind Broschüren über Singapur ausgelegt, Pläne für die Öffentlichen und Stadtmappen.Catherine hat auch zwei Metro-Karten, die sie Ihren Gästen gibt. Die Gegend ist super. Bus und MRT sind nicht weit, superviele Restaurants mit gutem Essen direkt ums Eck und in der Nähe und Massagestudios, die sehr empfehlenswert sind. Wir haben uns eine an unserem letzten Abend auf dem Weg von der Metro nach Hause gegönnt und waren super zufrieden. Wir haben uns wie zu Hause gefühlt und werden defintiv bei jedem Aufenthalt in Singapur bei Catherine anfragen. Mehr als empfehlenswert!!!

Catherine was an amazing host !
It was our first experience at someone's flat and it couldn't have been better.
We arrived at 1.30am and Catherine was waiting for us, she let us feel home at the second we arrived. In the morning, she offered us a nice breakfast and really good advices about the city (plus MRT cards and maps). The room is spacious, clean and with a private bathroom, it is exactly like the pictures.
We loved Singapore and we would definitely stay again at Catherine's house ! Highly recommended !
Catherine is a great host! We were glad to stay with her. The location is very convenient. Lots of eateries around the estate. Would like to stay again  for the next visit.

The flat is very well situated, close to the airport and the city center with top-notch service (plus we did not have to shop for breakfast as it was generously offered). Catherine is warm and helpful.  She made us feel really at home and shared her excellent knowledge of Singaporean life and culture and provided us with reliable advice. She is a smashing host that made our short stay so very enjoyable.

Une hôte extraordinaire. Toujours au petits soins, accueillante, présente et discrète à la fois. Catherine est adorable, cultivée et jamais avare de conseils. Les discussions partagées étaient riches et passionnantes. On se sent très vite accueilli comme si on était de la famille. Catherine ne cesse de tenter d' améliorer votre séjour.
Peu de gens sont de sa trempe. Alors profitez-en vous qui aurez peut-être la chance de la rencontrer sur Singapour.

Da Catherine mich gebeten hat, meine Bewertung auf Deutsch zu schreiben, komme ich dem gerne nach.
Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in ihrem Apartment! Die Kommunikation mit ihr war schon vor unserer Ankunft sehr unkompliziert. Uns stand vor Ort genug Platz und ein großer Schrank mit Ablagefläche zur Verfügung. Das Zimmer ist ansonsten sehr hell und gemütlich und kann mit Vorhängen abgedunkelt werden. AC hat problemlos funktioniert, genau so wie das Internet.
Da wir das Zimmer gemietet hatten, um selbst ein Apartment in Singapur zu finden, haben wir uns riesig über Tipps von Catherine bezüglich Einkaufsmöglichkeiten usw. gefreut.
Wir haben uns sehr willkommen gefühlt und fanden es toll, dass man sich mit Catherine so nett unterhalten konnte. Sie hat uns sogar für die ersten paar Tage Frühstück eingekauft. Marmelade, Toast, Cornflakes uns Milch. Wer sich länger versorgen will, findet in Geylang genug Geschäfte mit Obst und Gemüse oder einen Fairprice gleich um die Ecke.

Foodcourt-Empfehlung: Old Airport Road Food Center!
Catherine was a very caring host. She would always ask you if there was anything you needed and I found that absolutely welcoming. Wouldn't hesitate staying with Catherine again.

It took approximately a ten minute walk to get to the nearest subway station so was in an ideal location. Catherine was a great host who helped me a great deal with getting my poster printed for a conference I attended. She also had great guides for trips around Singapore. Overall, I would highly recommend this place to others.

Catherine was lovely and the apartment was just as pictured. The bed is super comfortable and I also loved Catherine's big balcony and the nice swimming pool. We stayed at Catherine's for 3 nights and would absolutley recommend it. Lovley place, with a spasous room and separate bathroom, easy to get to the MRT and very Nice host. Thank you for the stay!

We had a great time staying at Catherine's place.  She is a very thoughtful and friendly host. CatHerne est une hôte fantastique! Elle nous a accueilli avec beaucoup de gentillesse et nous a donné de très précieux conseils qui ont contribué au succès de notre séjour.

We had a great stay at Catherine's place!

I would recommend this place for those who are looking for a short stay in Singapore.
Catherine is a gracious, generous and considerate host. The apartment itself is new, very clean and well maintained. Would recommend this!

very nice host

I can highly recommend this accommodation!

Wendy and Kieth's home is comfortable and easily accessed by public transport. They were great hosts, helpfully pointing out nearby ammenities, attractions and transport and were attentive and flexible in terms of communication and dates. Would stay again!

Wendy and Keith were really nice.
I felt welcomed and I totally recommend this place.
Nice location and a really comfortable bed.
Very clean with private bathroom and the hosts, wendy and keith, very warm in welcoming me even though i came late night. I really recommend their place esp if you have activities in the west.

This is my second stay at wendy's house. Everything is alright. Recommended.

Wendy and Keith, thank you so much for being such a lovely host.

Wendy and Keith were really nice. The place is neat and accessible. Would highly recommend it to anyone.
房间很干净也很舒适，可以享受到独立的卫浴和空调，地理位置不错 出门就有巴士站 离mrt也很近。房东很热情友善 非常乐意提供帮助并且解答你的问题。很推荐大家入住。

I really recommend Wendy's place as she and her husband are very kind and helpful hosts, the apartment is very spacious, cozy and clean as well as located close to public transport. Very convenient to deal

(1) The loft is only high enough to accommodate a person up to 180 cm or so; otherwise you can suffer a head injury if you're not vigilant. (2) The place has sharp corners made of metal, wood, and cement jutting out here and there inside and outside the unit, so keep your eyes open. (3) The laundry facilities are insufficiently ventilated, so it can take a long time to wash and dry, all the while wasting enormous amounts of electricity for the owner, not to mention that it's often hard to find a free machine which is in working order. (4) They ask to clean your unit after a few days, which is very disruptive because you need to move all your stuff for security reasons; this would be unnecessary if the laundry facilities were more available, and also if there were a way to opt out by an SMS to the cleaning person (who nevertheless did an excellent job). Me and boyfriend stayed at Joyce's place during the long Easter weekend as our little staycation. We had a lovely time in the cozy designer room. So much so I felt more at home there than at my own home. The estate has a unique design, very unlike the typical condos or flats in Singapore.

Joyce was hospitable and attentive (she allowed us to drop our bags early so we can go island hopping baggage free). When we came home, she had moved the bags into our room.
There's a mini fridge in the cabinet with chilled water, toffees and orange juice.
The cable TV was handy to chill out after a warm bath and scrumptious dinner. Tanjong Katong was just a 5mins walk so we had access to a quality french bakery (Do Main), delish ribs with truffle fries and to-die-for salted caramel rainbow cake (Toothsome Cafe).
There are buses nearby that takes you into town or the nearest train station. If you are coming from the airport, taxis will be able to find their way into the estate too.
On the day we left, we met a young friendly golden retriever whom Joyce was babysitting. He was so sweet and affectionate, a reflection of his caregiver too.
You will definitely have a pleasant stay, for a distraction away your usual routine or a slice of Singapore's hippie suburb.

我們對Joyce Home的評語只有無數個 “好好好………”字，記得第一天到她家是早上七時半，她已經在家門等著，並允許我們提早入住，實在太感激她，免除帶着行理到處走麻煩，還可以稍作休息梳洗後再出動。Joyce Home位置休靜，房間簡約潔淨，像我腳踝受傷的住客，有電梯代步上落，非常貼心。找食方面，只要你肚子有空位，就有好東西吃，雞飯是必吃的（午飯最少要排隊20-30分鐘），Katong Laksa, Toast Box, 菜頭粿, 粿汁, 鴨飯, Rojak……，地道美食，應有盡有，還有一間專賣糕點舊舖，非試不可。交通更是四通八達，完全可以乘坐巴士代步，有直接巴士到China Town, Clarke Quay(松發肉骨茶) , City Hall, Sands Hotel , Garden by the Bay, Old airport Road Food Centre(好食一族，非去不可) etc… 下次再到星加坡，Joyce Home係我必定選擇。
Nothing to say! Just Love here!! And wish to be here again. Thank you so much Joyce:))

Joyce is awesome! Very welcoming and accommodating. Flat is very clean and modern. For our first time in Singapore we were delighted to meet Joyce. She kindly provide us all information to get tobher place and all accomodations. Her interior decoration and fit-out make her place a very nice and confortable place to stay. Thank you Joyce!

I highly recommend staying here if you are ever in Singapore.

Joyce's room was perfect for our stay in Singapore.

We had a bit of a mishap when some bug spray leaked and damaged a table but she was understanding and that issue was resolved quickly.
Thanks for having us!

Joyce was very helpful and nice. The room itself is extremely clean and comfortable to stay in. definitely worth the price. the location was superb , many eateries around. I'll def will stay with her again on my next visit.

Excellent experience.  Joyce was a wonderful host and we are happy to have met her. After staying the downtown shopping district, it was nice to see a quieter side of Singapore. We would highly recommend staying here.

Had an awesome time as this is a little retreat for writing. Great food nearby, great help from Joyce, as well as a perfect setting to really allow oneself to be blocked out from the rest of the world.

The building was designed and decorated with great eye and concepts and is a definitely perfect location for the artistically inclined. Very cool lift system and lighting system that ensures that you're able to figure your way around throughout.

Joyce is a nice owner. She is very friendly to us. first day she treat us for breakfast and prepare us for some juice. The next day, I had a bad headache at night, she gave me some drugs. Here I thank you very much again.
Excellent house with excellent holder.Don't hesitate to try!

The place is very quiet, private and clean. The decoration is cool and my partner loves it very much.

joyce很nice，还准备了橙汁给我们，住的房间也很干净、舒服。有两张ez link卡给我们用，用完把余额补上就可以了，有了ez link 之后坐交通工具出行太方便了。第二天去动物园，joyce还帮我们查了路线，顺路载我们去车站。我一大一小都玩得很开心。非常感谢！

The area where the AirBnB is located is in an area called Katong. I won't bore you with details, but if you're curious, look it up. It's got a very different vibe than the city center, but it's still packed with culture and much things to see. Just Google "Joo Chiat Street"

Joyce's place is THE BEST! Interiors are very modern and minimalist just the way we like it. Bathroom was all to ourselves and was huge. We actually looked forward to taking a shower everyday! Haha. The room was really nice, clean and comfortable. The neighbourhood is very convenient. Thanks a lot to our hosts, they were really nice and helpful. Recommended 100%

The view is as-shown, and once you figure out the mildly confusing path network through the apartments complex, you can access public transport buses (and MRT via a bus or taxi) with ease. Overall the location is a good compromise between being close to the airport and downtown. Best of all though is the very close location to East Coast Park, which is just 10 minutes' walk from the apartment. This is a great place for a walk, or to grab some famous chili crab. In fact, you can also cycle all the way down to Marina Bay Sands hotel via the new barrage, which is about 45 minutes' ride.
The apartment was very clean, spacious, and quiet, and it was nice having the bathroom for my own use. The bed was large and comfortable also.

Very nice room with amazing view! Highly recommend for budget stay in Singapore. Mr.Ong and mrs.Elle are the best hosts. Great location. Highly recommend.

I loved staying here. My hosts were kind enough to pick me up from the airport and carry my bags up to my room. They were friendly helpful and did everything they said they would. My first trip to Singapore was nothing short of awesome, especially since it was only going to be a stop over to Thailand. I'm glad I came!
The room was just as pictured. Everything I could have desired was in there except there was no mini fridge. I felt safe at all times. The MRT really is straight down the lift but not so loud and noisy like I worried it might be. The apartment is in the middle of Chinatown, so there's lots to do and see right under your nose. Choosing to get anywhere from Chinatown was so easy to navigate for a new comer and Elle's assistance showing me around.

Location is great - right in the centre of Chinatown! The room is very cosy, and provides the perfect place to chill out with an amazing view of Singapore. I was travelling as a single female and felt very much at home with all of Elle's help! Thank you
非常非常的不错。整洁，干净。就是位置不太好找。不过楼下吃饭方便。Elle非常热情。我后面想继续预定，可惜被订满了。
地下鉄チャイナタウン駅直結で、大変便利でした。仕事優先の旅でしたので、部屋の設備充分で対応も良かったです。

The location was one of the best features about the room, as the Chinatown MRT was is literally at the bottom of the complex. Elle, who lives in the flat and checks over the guests, was incredibly sweet. She was even willing to stay up for my late arrival (1am) and help me settle in.

The room was small but all you really need for one person, the AC/Wifi worked really well, and the toilet is conveniently directly across the hallway. There are some other flat mates but I never had too much trouble sharing the bathroom with them.

Overall an 8-8.5/10 in comparison to my previous experiences on Airbnb.

Thanks Again!
Place is just unbelievable. Room is really cozy and the bed is really comfy.  Muss Ellie is of the kindest women I ever met.
It was a great location. Clean and tidy, Elle greeted me and made me feel so welcome she was so kind. I would recommend this place to others.

Perfect location and really cosy place.

Perfect place to stay in Singapore !
Chinatown area is great. It is just near by the night spots.
The person which manage the room is very nice !

The place was comfortable and the description on the web accurate. Room size was adequate, very well thought out space utilisation with wardrobe, shelves and hanging space, and the bathrooms although small, super clean and very well maintained. The view from my bed (sunrise/cityscape silhouette and night lights) simply stunning.

I enjoyed my stay so much. Everything in their house has a purpose. If you are a solo traveler this is the best place to be. Also, Elle fueled me with positivity and treated me like a king!
I am an explorer type so I never stayed 2 times in the same place, but for Singapore I would definetely break this rule!

Joe and ate Elle picked me up from the now permanently closed Lulu hotel where the airport bus dropped me off at 2 am! Their hospitality and excellent customer service is impeccable! I was so relieved to see them as I had stayed in Japan 9 days prior to coming to Singapore and did some major shopping there. They helped me with my 2 check-in luggage, a carry on and a backpack. We had to go up the stairs, up the cross walk, down the stairs, and a little walk into the elevator of the People's Park Complex building. The elevators don't stop at every floor. We had to go up to 30th Flr and go down the stairs 3 floors to the 27th flr. I don't know what I would have done without them!
The room is clean and well equipped with a nice comfortable bed with a great view of the city. There was a nice sized closet with a locked drawer, a desk, a chair, a small fridge, a hair dryer, iron, even a spoon, fork, knife, a plate, and a glass. Ate Elle had stocked my fridge with a nice large water bottle and it was a taste of heaven from all that walking. There is a nice ceiling fan and air conditioner which I loved as Singapore is quite hot and humid even in October. The bathroom is right across my room and is fully stocked with shampoo, conditioner, body soap and mouthwash.
The apartment is just above the MRT train so it is very convenient especially after a whole day of sightseeing.
Ate Elle lives in the apartment so she is available to answer all questions and is very accessible should there be any emergencies---I accidentally locked myself out of my bedroom when I went to the bathroom at 4am! She was so nice but I felt really bad for waking her up. And when I wanted a massage, she gave me a recommendation where to go where they give discounts if you tell them she sent you.
Thank you so very much Joe and Ate Elle for a great stay in Singapore. Your welcoming gesture set a wonderful tone to my weeklong vacation in your country! I will seek your place again the next time I visit Singapore!

They were great from the first minute. My flight was delayed 6 hours and they stayed up until 2am to let me in and make sure everything was taken care of.

The location is very convenient and for the price it's an excellent value in Singapore.

Elle helped me find the place late at night after my flight arrived. She was so sweet and hospitable! Her home is quaint, clean, and charming. I traveled alone and could not have felt safer or have chosen a better location! Located directly above the Chinatown MRT and market (tons of great food), with a gorgeous view of the city. Walking distance to Lau Pa Sat and Marina Bay Sands. If you're jet-lagged and up early enough you can watch the sunrise from your bed with a cup of tea or coffee. Reliable fast wifi + cold AC.

My trip to Singapore was for the writer's festival as a guest, and would love to stay here again, because Elle was fantastic and very helpful, the location is interesting (Chinatown! Food!) and very close to a subway. The room very comfortable to me! I always sleep like a log. It is recommended for solo travellers and those first timers looking for an affordable yet comfortable place to stay after a long exhausting day with tons of food around. Hope to come back here next time i go to singapore again travelling solo!

Very convenience, close to MRT. Lots of places to shop and eat. A really good location for travelers to stay. The only problem is, don't know where to put the clothes when showering. Besides this, it's a really good place to stay.

The place is exactly as described, no frills, incredible views in the heart of Chinatown.

Was sharing the apartment AirBnb with some other guests in other rooms (3 in total?) who were coming in as I was heading out to the airport 5AM.

They are very accommodating and even did my washing :) Was perfect for what I needed while working in Promenande.

Perfect stay in Singapore if you are a single traveler. It's located right in the center of town, in a building above Chinatown MRT station. Despite the central area, the apartment is in a high building so no noise around whatsoever. Elle, the host, made me feel at home from the first moment, and even helped with doing the laundry at no extra charge. The room itself was very comfortable. To summarize: a feeling from home away from home, my review score: 5/5.

The house owner was so nice! I checked-in the house around 5am. But she waited for me and introduced so nicely!! And location of area was perfect. It's really easy to approach to MRT CHINATOWN station.
Everythin has inside room!! Hairdryer, refrigerator, pot etc..

This place is ideally situated very close to the MRT to get anywhere in Singapore. Communication with Ong was great and he provides a really good overview and directions.
The accommodation is located in a tall building with great views. There are a couple of flights of stairs but nothing too much.
The apartment is very clean and the room was surprisingly spacious and had all the facilities and extras I needed. There is a shared bathroom but this was fine.
Elle met me when I arrived and was very welcoming and helpful.
This is an ideal value optional and it was great being in Chinatown as there were plenty of food and shopping options.

I stayed in Ong's apartment for 2 nights. It was as described in the write up. The room was clean, as was the shared toilet. Elle was a wonderful host, very helpful and friendly. The apartment is in a very good location. Very easy to get the MRT from there.
I was there on Chinese new year's eve and could see the Chinatown fireworks from my window.
Had a good stay at Ong's.

The perfect base for exploring the city and clean room with everything you need to kick back and relax after a long day exploring. Elle is super friendly and Ong was quick to respond to any messages. Thanks guys!

Elle brought me to the Bus station to go to Malacca, which was not easy to find. Thanks a lot Elle for everything, as well for the pictures u took from me in the room :)
İ booked already my next visit in Singapore at Ong's place in 2 weeks before İ go back home, looking forward.
Great place for single travelers!

Ong's place is perfect for a solo traveler who need a place to stay. Is strategically located because is in The middle of everything. Her place is clean, quite, the room is cozy like home. She is very kind because she put some beverages in my refrigerator everyday. Thank you for everything.
Very accessible to public transport and Elle is very accommodating.

I had a great time during my stay in Singapore. If you don't mind the hustlenand bustle of Chinatown, this is a great place to stay if you're a solo traveler.  Elle was very kind and attentive, made sure that we had everything we needed.

I had a great stay at Ong's place while in Singapore. I had everything I needed and felt very comfortable. The room is upstairs from Chinatown Station and a big food and mall complex, which was very convenient.
Most downtown destinations are walkable from here or a short cab ride.
I would definitely stay here again when in Singapore!

The place was as advertised. Small but ample space for a short stay, clean with an amazing view. Centrally located in Chinatown and right by the MRT which made getting around super easy! Never met Ong though he did check on me upon arrival.  Elle was a blessing and a sweetheart! Would love to go back and hang with her. I believe there was supposed to be a common area which I never saw.  Didn't matter though, I was hardly there and when I was...I was sleeping. Nice stay at Ong's. Close to MRT, restaurants and the marine. Great view from the room! Clean Apartment.  Elle is a very nice host and good to approach.

Accurate as it's described online. It's good for single traveler with limited luggage.  Nice and clean.

Mr Ong ang Elle are very good hosts. They are very welcoming and heart-warming. I got to meet Mr. Ong in person and we had dinner together! Elle is always there willing to help if you have any questions.
Room is exactly the same as shown in the picture. It is in the heart of the city, 2 mins away from Chinatown! The bed is very comfortable and I slept very well during my stay!
Will recommend Mr Ong's place to anyone who's coming to Singapore!
Place is as advertised. Very good location to explore. Clarks Quays, lau pa sat, chinatown are all within walking distance. Elle is fantastic and very helpful.

Bedroom was perfect! Great view, stong wi-fi, water and comfortable bed. There were two other guest at the time but I rarely ran into them. The bathroom is shared and I would suggest shower shoes if you're not used to showering next to the toilet in an open area. Clean apartment and awesome contact with Ong and Elle. I brought my own laundry detergent pod and was able to wash my clothes with no problem. Highly recommend this location!
The location is very good, in the heart if Chinatown, very close to metro and bus station. And you will have a spectacular view from the 27th floor.

I really loved the place. It was my first time visiting Singapore and I'm glad I stayed in Mr Ong's place. Chinatown station literally right below the building. It's also a secured and safe building with active security 24/7. So much food stalls and shopping centers around and everything is walkable.
Elle was very welcoming when I arrived and it felt like home already, It was very clean and peaceful plus the view from 27th floor is very beautiful especially during night time. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit to SG. Thank you so much for everything!
这里位置很棒，楼下就有food court、牛车水地铁站、711，很方便

Ong's place is literally in front of Chinatown MRT line. His place is hidden behind the People's Park Complex. The only issue I had was the elevator only stopped on certain floors so guests will have to go up four flights of stairs. So for individuals with a handful of luggage, you will have to make 2 or 3  trips up their floor. The house was nice and clean and I did not have any problems with sharing the common bathroom. There was no heated water which was completely fine because of the warm weather outside. The room was adequate, had a TV, small fridge, hot water maker, and the internet was fast. The home attendant, Elle, made me feel welcomed. The bed was very comfortable and the view from the window showed the lit up sky scrapers of Singapore. I would stay here again should I tour Singapore again. It is very close to several hawker centers as well as walking distance to Marina Bay Sands and Merlion.

チャイナタウン駅の目の前のマンションで便利な場所にあります。マリーナベイサンズも窓から少し見えていますし、電車でも少しでいけるところにありました。部屋は思っていたより狭い感じでしたが、夜景見えるし 寝るだけなので問題ありません。自分以外にも宿泊者います。トイレやシャワーが共同ですのでご注意下さい。あとエレベーターですが27階まで行きたくてもボタンは25階までです。そこからは階段で登ります。自分は中華料理が好きなので、この場所をすごく気に入りました。本格的な中華料理です。駅近くにはセブンイレブンとマクドナルドもあります。料理と買い物を楽しむなら、道路を上に通路を渡った方のエリアがたくさんお店がありました。

Perfect place to stay for solo travellers. The place was so cozy, I didn't even want to get out of bed haha!
Location was so convenient because it was so close to the MRT.
Elle and Ong were also very accommodating. If you have any questions or concerns, they'd be very willing to help. I definitely recommend this place. A home away from home.

I recommend this place. Hope to stay again in the future.

It's my second time staying in this room! It's right in Chinatown and Elle is super friendly and welcoming! Will always stay here if I come to Singapore!

Over and above level of service and hospitality. Space was comfortable, amenities were good and building was right above an MRT station. Two flights of stairs up to the apartment but easily manageable. Overall a fantastic experience.

I'd love to be back there and wil surely do when I visit Singapore again. Thank you Ong and Elle!

This was a great place to stay. Clean even the shared bathroom was great and clean. The room had amenities that helped when needed and to have a window with a view was an extra treat. Right above MRT a little difficult to find. But having directions supplied by the host, made this a breeze. Central to many shopping facilities and good food almost at the door. The host needs to be awarded a special thanks for his contribution to a successful Airbnb stay. Highly recommended for somebody wanting to visit Singapore.

Liked the room, and the view! The bed was super comfy and the room was cosy. I liked all the thoughtful touches - water and coffee in the room, the reading lamps and rug. Overall though if you pack light and dont mind walking, the room is definitely worth the price and the location is great- right near the MRT.

Mr. Ong and Elle were very accomodating. Room was very cosy - felt like my own little space.
