The room was as shown in the pictures and was amazing neat. definitely i recommend than any other rooms in SG:)

The room is clean and quiet, The host is very nice and helpful.  The location is great, easy access to food and the Chinatown MRT is only a few steps away. Great view of sunset from the outside by the way.
麻雀虽小，五脏俱全。Elle很好人，知道我很早在楼下转悠，她说我应该早点和她联系的，早点入住休息。形容房间就是：麻雀虽小，五脏俱全。一个人短住是觉得足够的了。就是没有地方晾衣服，不过新加坡似乎都这样，几乎每家每户都是通过窗台伸出竹竿晾衣服的。所以衣服只能晾在衣柜了，不过睡觉开空调什么的，还是很快干的啦。

Both Ong & Elle are extremely helpful to ensure I can find the place, get to the apartment & settled down in the room as I was not able to arrive at the stipulated time to meet them.  All good!!  Room is good, small and cosy, clean & neat, very comfortable for a good night rest.  Once fully recharged, there are plenty of local foods in the nearby food centers and restaurants from day to night.  The location is central to anywhere in Singapore via train, buses and taxi.  If you are travelling alone, this is one great place to stay.

Wonderful for those who spend the day away from the room.  Clean, quiet, and cozy.  So easy to sleep!  Elle, Ong's assistant was so helpful and thoughtful.  Such a wonderful woman!  Definitely recommend a stay at this property, can't beat the price!  So many food choices right downstairs too.  Thanks again Ong and Elle!

Ella is amazing. She gave the perfect directions for reaching the room. The room was great. It's much bigger than what you'd expect it to be. The bed was very comfortable, internet rocked and you can even screencast your laptop to the TV to get an extended screen. It was perfect for me as I was out during the day and needed to sleep and work at night. The place is silent and peaceful. Ella is very friendly, helpful and cheerful person. Highly recommended for folks travelling alone.
Perfect for what I needed. Elle was really helpful. The location is great, huge range of hawkers stalls below, shops, and Chinatown right there.

Elle was very accommodating and friendly. She was always offering us food, chocolates, drinks, sightseeing tips, etc. The room was exactly as pictured, the air conditioning was great, the toilet and bathroom were always kept clean. The location was the best part because the building is right above the Chinatown MRT and you can find basically anything you need at the stores below.

The space was perfectly adequate for my needs as a solo traveler gone all day.  Lots of amenities, although the t.v. didn't work.  The hostess was very amenable, helpful and accomodating.  The only disadvantages were (1) difficulty in finding People's Park Complex (there are other buildings with similar names) and difficulty finding how to access the high-rise residences; and (2) a bit noisy due to the flimsy door to the individual room.  Good a/c.  An interesting array of switches involved in using anything electrical in the common area, but just ask and the hostess will explain.

Good for a single traveller if you want to avoid hostel dorm style stay. Located conveniently above chinatown mrt station and a mall. But it doesn't mentioned if I need to go to level 27 via level 25 since no elevator goes directly to level 27 so I need to climb the stair at respective stair to the unit number.
Room is small but it has anything you need.
一個人的房間恰到好處,任何需要一應俱全,Elle非常友善,讓4天的旅行像是長期在新加坡;房間比想像中完美,位置更在MRT牛車水上,美食/逛街/匯兌/通訊都方便完成!!

Elle n Ong welcomed me as if I was a member of their family. Also location is really good.
Anyway my first trip in Singapore was amazing thank to them. Xx
Elle was very friendly all the time. The room is as described.

Great location, right next to Chintown MRT, and heaps of local food stores around. The famous Smith Street is just minutes away! Bed is comfortable and everthing is clean!! Elle is very nice who gave me lots of information. Highly recommended!

While I didn't meet the host, Elle was very warm and friendly. The room is exactly as pictured and the aircon is heaven. The door is a little flimsy and not at all soundproof so if you're a light sleeper I'd suggest airplugs. The location is fantastic and easy to access on the MRT.

Important to note: there is a payphone outside the building complex. I was a bit worried about meeting Elle as I wouldn't have any means of contacting her after leaving the airport but then found the payphone. She came straight down to show me in.

The owner (Mr Hock Leng Ong) was very quick in responding to messages after booking. The host (Ms Elle) were extraordinary friendly and offered assistance/guidance whenever you need it.  The check-in time was extremely flexible. The apartment was located right above the train station, with a shopping mall and 2 big food centers within an 8 minutes walking distance. It should be noted that the room is located on the 27th floor while the elevator only stops at #25 and #30, which requires you to walk up/down a staircase for about 60 steps. The room was fully equipped as described, and it was extremely suitable for travelling purposes.

Its hard to express in words but I just love how I was welcomed upon arrival. This is my first time using airbnb and its really beyond my expectations! No words could express how much I love my stay here, its the best if YOU could experience it yourself. You will not regret and will definitely be back here again!

The room was as advertised and it was right above the Chinatown MRT which was very convenient. I did not meet Hock but the communication via email was good. Elle was great, nice and friendly. Since I am Filipino by blood, she recommended and told me how to get to Lucky Plaza which has many Filipino businesses. I was able to enjoy some traditional Filipino desserts. The room had air conditioning and good Wifi. I also had convenient access to the bathroom and shower. I would recommend this property to anyone visiting Singapore. Excellent value and I would stay here again!

Good ~
Bed was very comfortable
and room was clean
Ellen&Hock Leng is so kind

Place is conveniently located near chinatown food courts. Just cross the bridge and you can explore lots of shops and still more food stalls. The train station is a stone's throw away! Good enough room with a smart tv, that is if you're not too tired from going around the city.
Great location and close to everything. Only set back is it can get noisy due to the room is not properly wall and can hear water running everytime someone uses the bathroom

The host was fast and patient enough in responding to my queries. And she welcomed me so warmly. But the biggest surprise is that she speaks my language and had been so accomodating & hospitable. On my last day i had more to see in Entosa, so she even allowed me to leave my luggage in the room, yet i was supposed to be checking out already.
The room is comfortable. It wasn't hard for me to find it. It is right outside the Chinatown MRT station, exit C or the Eutong Road exit. I just asked some vendors down and they showed me the elevator. There's security in the elevator to confirm the room or unit youre looking for. The proximity to tourist attractions is good. I highly recomment this room. It is clean and safe.
Thanks Elle for being wonderful.
I stayed here for 2 nights just this month. I didn't have a hard time since the location is near the bus stop and MRT. Thank you for the warm welcome Hoek Leng :)
房間小但很舒服，不建議體型過大者入住。隔音不太好，所以怕吵的人不建議住這。門是拉簾式的~

숙소가 차이나타운 역 바로 앞에 있어서 상당히 편했습니다.
숙소는 27층인데, 엘리베이터는 25층과 30층에만 멈추기 때문에, 25층에서 내려서 걸어서 올라가야합니다.
그 밖에 체크인, 체크아웃 시간도 조율해서 고를수 있고 화장실도 깨끗하고 방도 아늑하고 좋았습니다.

チェックインまでの連絡も迅速でわかりやすかったです！
滞在時もElleはとてもよくしてくれました。
ロケーションも便利でAirbnbの体験としてオススメできるリスティングです！
I have not met Joe, Elle was very kind, nice and friendly. Excellent stay and I would stay here once again!

The room is as described. The previous reviews are pretty informative and I got well prepared reading those.
Joe and Elle both were welcoming and helpful as I didn't have international roaming and that caused some communication problems upon my arrival but we solved everything. Elle made sure that I felt well there and is a lovely hostess.
If the noise of the running water bothers you, try to close the bathroom door between the kitchenette and bathroom areas, it helps.
PS, don't expect that all people at the Chinatown are speaking English.

Had no problems when staying, in Joe's appartment, two nights in Chinatown, Singapore. The room was small, yes, and it was very hot, so air conditioning, which worked fine, is a must. WC and shower was also available, making it an enjoyable stay. And location is really central, with short access to the MRT. You get what you pay for here, so don't expect more. All in all I recommend this place for one person to sleep :-)
Good location and value for the rate.
Fully satisfied.  Thank you.

The apt is as described - clean, cozy and centrally located. Elle is such a sweatheart! She helped with directions, recommended places to visit and made sure my stay was as enjoyable as can be. Thank you, Elle! :)
Just perfect! Really enjoyed my stay.

Lady here, She is super nice very attentive and helpful. I can't say I had perfect sleeps here, but Singapore is hot country and this room does not have windows. Can't complain.
Enjoy food stuff right down apartment and subways.
地方不错，就是比较暗，闹区是这样的了，性价比高，

The place is very near to Chinatown MRT blue and purple lines and major thoroughfare for public bus, lots of food stalls and restaurants nearby, shopping centers just below, and Chinatown shops, restaurants and bar just across the major street. The hospitality of the host really makes you feel at home. She is always offering help whatever she can. The toilet and shower are very clean but shared. The room is small but just good for sleeping with good airconditioning.

Great little place in the heart of Chinatown! Good food, drink, and company is just steps away, though it helps if you speak some Chinese. The room itself is small but very nicely done. Strongly recommended.
You get what you see + a friendly host.
Good value for money. Near mrt, clean and well equipped room.

This was a fantastic location smack in the middle of Chinatown.  Good access to MRT.  Elle was very attentive.  Room was clean and had air conditioning and a TV.  Wifi was good.  Not there is no communal living area, eg. living room.  This is a great place if you need an easy place to crash, low budget but easily accessible.  Ong sent excellent direction on location.
It's comfortable and quite place, it takes just few minute to MRT station
Clean and cozy, very nice location
Though the room is small, it has everything a traveller needs. Definitely worth the money 👍👍👍

Budget room in expensive Singapore. Ideal for a short stay but would recommend the other rooms on offer in the same apartment which have windows with great views over the city. Excellent location with MRT on doorstep and central enough to walk to the major sights of Singapore. Very friendly host who was happy to chat and offer lots of advice on where to do and where to eat.
Elle is hospital and all things have been set up in advance. There is one private bathroom for me. Only one problem is noise insulation.
Very convenient location and the friendly host responded quickly to questions.  A great value for money!

I was really enjoyed my stay here. Location is perfect, many foodcourts around, places where to buy souvenirs, shopping mall.
actually chinatown is that place where you can find everything you may need in a two steps distance.
room is small, but very convenient, you can place all of your belongings and clothes with easy access.
aircon works perfect. if you feel hot at night - use fan, it maybe better then aircon.
everything was clean, nothing to complain.
Elle is supernice and friendly, communication is perfect.
so if you need a place to sleep well - you found it. there is no common area or living room, but there are many places around you can sit on the bench, dring sugarcane juice and stock in your smartphone ;)
Great location, great price
It's like the Airbnb equivalent of budget airline. It gets the job done. Nothing more and nothing less. As long as you manage your expectation right, it will be a decent stay.
The host is so sweet :)) Thank you
Very nice place, Ong is very kind~

Elle is amazing! The best host ever. She will help you out with anything and I'll answer all the questions you have. The room is stocked with whatever amenities you need, as well as he shower. There's even snacks and water. Great stay!
Clean and cozy room, just perfect for a short stay with lots of sightseeing. Literally above the MRT station which is perfect :-)
Very nice and cozy room. Easy access to public transportation and walking distance to restaurants and shops.
The place is clean and easily accessible to the Chinatown MRT. Room was to my liking. Elle, who coordinated my check-in is a charm! ;)

Room does exactly what it says on the tin. Location simply superb. Owners were extremely kind about a very last-minute reservation, let me leave my bags late, and also provided loads of unexpected free food and drink!

Elle was such a fantastic host! She was very accommodating and welcoming. The description and pictures are exactly as advertised. Would recommend people to stay here if they are travelling on a budget!
地下鉄の駅のそばで、どこへ行くにも便利です。四畳半くらいですが、寝るには充分です。親戚の家に泊まりにきた感じ。コスパ良し。エレンが親切に対応してくれるので、気になることは気軽に聞いて大丈夫です。会話は英語のみです。
Affordable place near a lot of hawker centers. Great for budget or solo travelers.
Very nice location. Close to everything. Place is clean and quiet. No issues with the shared bathroom. Will recommend to friends..

Ong and Elle are very friendly, i feel lucky to have such great kind hosts. As i arrived at China Town at around 11 am, Elle allowed me check early than the deal and also provided me with isotonic drink.
if u want to travel around Singapore, Chinatown will be convenience, so if u choose china town as a place to take a rest for ur journey, Ong's place will be ur best choice.

comfortable place and the great location!!!!
easily access to any place in Singapore
Easily accessible to the metro, so you even don't have take umbrella in rainy days. Elle was helpful!

Elleが色々教えてくれるので、わからないことがあれば相談に乗ってくれます。
キッチンもなく、light cook も出来ませんが、下がチャイナタウンで
It's a very convenient location for traveling. Room is tiny. Host is friendly and helpful. A good place for short trip travelers.
Great place to stay. Easy to transport, Elle is very friendly and helpful

Great location, just above the mrt station with lots of food options and foot massage places below the apartment. Room was very comfy, place was very clean. Host was very friendly too. Very reasonable rates too. Highly rexommeneded.

This room does the job for a budget traveler who spends the entire day outside the room.  It's clean, with good A/C, and a hot shower.  I brought ear plugs and recommend them because the room is made from temporary type walls so you can hear when other flatmates move about.  Solid value stay!

Fantastic location in the heart of Chinatown. Elle and her sister friendly, gave plenty of information on arrival. Small room but everything you need. Great Wifi. Shared toilet in wet room among 3 or 4 rooms not ideal but fine. Wonderful view from the stairwell. Will definitely look to stay again next time in Singapore.
在新加坡这个价钱有独立房间算不错了，但房间其实是隔出来的，房门是拉帘式有给你个小锁锁门。整套房子被隔成5、6个房间的样子，有2个浴室1个厕所。elle人很好很热情。

The room is as its shown and the unit is in the centre of Chinatown: close to restaurant, shops and MRT. Indications given by the host are clean and simple to follow.
The hosts is very helpful and want to make sure you will have a great time in Singapore.
If you have any question do not hesitate and you will get an answer...
I would highly recommend to stay at Ong's place.
房子在牛车水，交通非常便利，吃饭逛街都很方便，房子干净整洁，适合一人旅行人事居住，房主人非常好，推荐给我旅游路线，还给我免费的饮品，总之非常棒。

Dit was de eerste keer dat ik airbnb gebruikte en het was een geweldige ervaring. Ik werd erg vriendelijk verwelkomd en het was fijn om de hele week onder Elle's zorg te wonen. Beide Ong en Elle waren zeer vriendelijk.
De kamer is eigenlijk groter dan het lijkt op de foto. Het was goed te doen voor 1 persoon. Hou er wel rekening mee dat de kamer enigszins rumoerig is (andere gasten die douchen, wasmachine die aan staat), dus kies niet deze kamer als je een lichte slaper bent. Voor mij was het geen probleem.
Dankjewel Elle en Ong!

Great stay. Everything you need is in the room. It is small, but I felt sick and had no problem just lying in bed watching tv and resting when I needed it. I didn't need anything else. They took me out to lunch and were great hosts. I'd recommend this to everybody.

If you're looking for an incredibly convenient place to stay,  this is it. Location is fantastic,  right in the People's Park Complex in Chinatown. MRT Chinatown takes you directly to your building. There is food everywhere, and there is a big hawker center attached to the complex. When you walk off the elevator from your stay,  you'll be walking straight into a mall with basically everything you may need,  like a convenience/ grocery store. Elle was very warm and welcoming and she was great. Everything was very clean. My room was very small,  but I've  always loved small spaces. There are several units in this complex,  so there are bigger ones available. With the particular room I stayed in,  keep in mind that the walls are thin. Also, there is one bathroom in the complex with a toilet, which is shared. Thankfully, the A.C. units were reliable and powerful. (Trust me, you'll be so happy to have AC in Singapore.) The price was very reasonable. Overall all I was very happy to stay here. When I come back to Singapore I will seek out this spot again!

I was greeted by Elle who was super friendly and happy to help. The bed was a bit small - I'm an average height female and found myself hanging off - but otherwise the room was quiet, clean and had everything I needed.
It was a really nice room with amazing host! The location was good with great connectivity. I had a really nice stay.
It was a great experience..I faced no issues at all...Elle and Ong were great hosts to be around... Recommended stay in Singapore..
Great location, great value
Best airbnb host!! Seriously, as advertised and couldn't have been more helpful, book with Ong and you'll have a great stay
Great place to stay if you are a budget traveler considering the price! Most importantly the air conditioning worked amazing and the room was nice and clean.
It was nice place , comfortable and close to public transit and foodcourt the host was nice and generous

Great host. Very responsive.
Location is great, just next to Chinatown MRT station. Elle is very hospitable. There's a lot of resto around. The apartment is also always clean. Will definitely recommend this place.

Overall a Good place to stay, close to the mrt. Throughout the whole stay the major problem I had was the noise, the walls are really thin, even the sound of water flowing in the restroom came to the room, makes it difficult to sleep. Good ear plugs are a must if one has to stay here.

The home is right above Chinatown mrt, very convenient to travel. The room is clean though a bit small but serve my requirements. Ong is super prompt in communication and his helper Elle is very friendly and responsive. Will definitely come back when visit Singapore.
Great location and great value for budget travelers.

Ong's place was really comfortable. All necessary things were available. The location was very convinient and I could go everywhere by public transportations. The cost-performance was really good. I recomend to stay here.
Great host, appartment really close to MRT station and local sightseeing
Walls are thin, so bring earplugs, but the location can't be beat, and the value provided for your money is excellent. Ong and Elle are excellent communicators. I'd definitely book again.

Pro
Great value and location
Great storage space
Courteous host
Con
Small space
Bathroom always wet

Great location. Very close to MRT (allows easy access around the city). Also close are food/restaurant and shopping (grocery/mall).
It's best to travel light since space is limited (similar to other big cities in Asia)
Elle and Ong are friendly and nice :)

Very central location - right above the MTR. Elle and her nephew were very friendly and helpful - even helping me to carry my luggage up to my room. Very much appreciated. Will definitely stay again if I'm back in Singapore sometime.
La casa Ong è vicino la metro quindi ben collegata,pulita,ordinata e loro sono di una gentilezza unica e molto ospitali... consiglio a tutti questa sistemazione.

チャイナタウンのほぼ直結する建物にあるアクセスの良い立地。
他の人達の言う通り、ここのホストElleさんはとてもフレンドリーで親切な女性で、彼女に聞けばなんでも教えてくれます。新築の綺麗な部屋が好きな人は他にも沢山選べる部屋があるけど、私は彼女の優しさを忘れることなく、次もこの部屋を選びます。幸せな旅行でした。
Exactly what I knew it was going to be  perfect for just me and traveling light.
Strategic location, literary minutes away from Food and MRT. Nice a cosy room if you dont require a huge space for your room then this place is perfect.

I had a great time staying in this Airbnb. The value for location was incredible, the host (Elle) was super hospitable, and I comfortably had my own space. The picture's are accurate in that the room is quite small, but it was never an issue for fitting my one suitcase + backpack.
是一個很熱心幫忙的房東，房間很小，衛浴是共用的，但如果想要節省住宿開銷，非常推薦可以來住，很方便的位置，有吃不完的美食

This was the perfect little space, meaning it has everything you need (including chargers, kettle, fresh water, etc). Shower was hot, WiFi was great, and location was perfect. Just as a few of the previous reviewers mentioned, the walls are indeed thin so bring ear plugs, but I really had no trouble sleeping. Elle was so kind to me (even ironed my shirt!), and let me park my bags after checkout. A wonderful stay in Singapore - thank you!
Perfect location with easy access to the MRT. I would return.

If you're a budget traveller looking for a place to stay while you explore this city-state, personally this place is a relatively good place for you.
To start off, the location of this place is simply immaculate. Chinatown MRT station is literally at the doorstep of the building which houses the place, and this MRT station pretty much links you to everywhere you'll need to go in Singapore.
The whole place, from the bathrooms to the room, is pretty clean. The room is undeniably pretty small and the wall is pretty thin, but with the price it offers, plus the convenience of the location, there isn't much worth complaining about, especially for a budget travellers like me!
Last but not least, a huge shoutout to Elle for being incredibly friendly and hospitable during my stay. She made the whole check in experience to be incredibly pleasant, and most certainly made me felt very welcome. Thanks for the stay!
A very friendly welcome. Clean and everyday utensils are available, so it's helpful.
The place is perfect for solo backpackers. It's got good space and well quipped with all the basic amenities. They even have a smart TV with access to YouTube and Neflix apps.

Good place to stay and good location.
In Singapore AirBnB is not allowed. So most of the time have to enter the door and the lift with other resident that stays there. i believe this COULD apply to other Airbnb place in Singapore as well, other than a legal hotel.
excellent place to rest . it's a little small, but you don't need more to visit Singapur.

건물 외관은 허름해 보였지만 숙소는 굉장히 쾌적하고 좋았습니다! 차이나타운 mrt가 바로 앞에 있고 모든 중심지에 가깝게 접근할 수 있어서 편했어요. 숙소애 상주하고 계신 Elle도 매우매우 친절했습니다:) 방은 좁지만 있을건 다있고 티비,커피포트,헤어드라이기 진짜 없는게 없었어요!! 샤워실은 공용이지만 딱히 다른 투숙객들과 겹치지않아서 편하게 사용할 수 있었습니다!물론 샤워실에 바디워시,샴푸 구비되었었구요!! 다만 힘든 점이 있었다면 가벽으로 만들어진 방인지 방음이 잘 안되더라구요 ㅠㅠ 방 바로앞에 냉장고,세탁기가 있어서 약간 더 시끄러웠던것같아요! 그래도 이 가격에 이정도 숙소면 매우 훌륭하다고 생각합니다! 다음에 또 온다면 다시 묶을 의향 100프로 입니다!! 매우좋았아요>ㅡ< 4일동안 묶으면서 얻은 정보를 드리자면 1층에 상점들이 굉장히 많은데 그중 지하철 출구에서 나오자마자 왼쪽으로 들어가는 입구 쪽에 음료수 가게가 있어요!!거기서 파는 1달러짜리 슈가케인(사탕수수)음료 한 번 마셔보세요!!갈증해소에 최고입니다,,,,
그리고 근처에 차이나타운포인트라는 곳이있는데 송파바쿠테,딘타이펑 등이 있어요!멀리 안가도 맛집들이 있어서 좋더라구요!!그럼 다들 행복한 여행 하시길 바랄게요 ♥
It is good price and good location for single traveller. I will stay again in the room when travelling nearby.

Overall great! Location is very strategic, literally above the MRT station. Room, bathroom and common space are very clean, owner response is very quick and informative. Elle was very friendly and nice, makes me feel very welcomed. The only downside are no window and thin walls,  but it was just perfect room for me as I was mostly outside exploring Singapore. But there were many other rooms in the apartment that has window, and wider space. Good deal, will absolutely be one of my list for next visit!

Mr. Ong and Ms. Elle are really a great person. Just minutes after I made the booking I had received mail from Mr.Ong regarding the directions to reach their place. Once you enter Ms. Elle will there to greet you and she's an amazing lady. She take cares of everything and make sures you doesn't feel shortage of anything. The room, toilet, amenities were neat and clean. The place is very safe and you won't feel any kind of fear. I would really recommend you all to stay at their place. It's really worth.

First off thank you Elle! You are awesome! Ong’s place is a perfect spot for solo travelers that wanna be in the center of all the great Singaporean festivities. So many great food halls within a 10 minute radius. And you’re ontop if one of the biggest food hall with and insane selection of food. Just cross the bridge and you’re in Chinatown, a five minute stroll south east and you will see Maxwell food Center. You’re with in reach of two of the best Chicken rice places: hawker Chan and tian chicken rice.
*Buy lots of small tissue packets you will need it, trust me on this.
Best location to stay, easy to find food and easy access for mrt n bus

Greatly enjoyed my stay. As others have mentioned location is wonderful, with Hawker Center right outside the place. Room is loaded with small, useful amenities - there's Netflix on the TV (you need your own account though). Wifi is lightning fast.  Laundry is available as well. Thanks for the wonderful stay!
단기여행 숙소로 위치는 아주 좋습니다. 저는 별다른 문제가 없었지만, 숙소 안에 매니저가 상주해 문제가 있을 때 바로 해결할 수 있을 것 같습니다. 다만 제대로 만들어진 방은 아니고 가구와 칸막이로 가벽을 세워둔 방입니다. 그래서 방음은 거의 전혀 되지 않습니다. 방은 작지만 웬만큼 있을 건 다 있습니다.

I really enjoyed my (too) brief stay here! I was given a warm welcome and intro by Ong and then Elle, who were both very communicative and helpful through the whole stay. The location is excellent in the middle of Chinatown with easy access to MRT. The room is as described and as reviewed by others (small, thin walls, etc) so I had proper expectations and was really happy with my stay here! The apartment has everything you need :) I hope to stay with Ong and Elle again!!
Fully satisfied.

Great place and amazing hosts. The location is perfect because is right in the center of everything and next to the metro station. The room is great as well, it has everything. I highly recommend this room :) Elle and Mr Ong are the best!

Really nice place to stay, and great location. The apartment is in the People's Park Complex, which is full of shops and food centers just below the building, and because of located in the heart of Chinatown so you can walk around across the street and explore a lot of shops to buy souvenirs, dessert shops, food courts, and restaurants, also the building is very close to Chinatown MRT, very convenient to travel.
The host (Ong and Elle) are great and very kind. Ong reply my message fast and gave the direction very clear to get there easily, always available to help the guests. Elle was welcoming, so nice, so kind, and very friendly. She always look after and take a good care of me, bring me foods, sweets, drinks, and make sure I'll feel comfortable and safe while I stay here, and I have to say I'm so happy and it feels like home.
My room is small and have no window but it's not a problem for me, I really like it. I didn't have a lot of things or large luggage. It fits me well, very clean, smell good, silent and peaceful, cozy and comfortable. The rooms are well-equipped with amenities you need. Bed is very comfortable and also have three pillows(with bolster). TV can watch Netflix. Air-con and fan working properly, very helpful because of hot weather in Singapore. Wi-fi is great. Shared bathroom and toilet is okay, always clean.
Really enjoyed stay here for 7 days, much better than I expected, great value, save budget, would stay here again. Highly recommended if you are solo traveler.

It is really a wonderful time to live in Ong's house. The room is not big, but it is tiny and lovely, equipped with convenient electrical appliance including TV, air dryer,  kettle, fan and air-conditioner.  The location is only 3 min walk from Chinatown MRT C exit, and is easily accessible to shopping and sight-seeing. In all, it's a place worth living.
its value for money, and u will feel at home
Great location. Kind and welcoming host, with helpful tips about exploring Singapore for a few days.

A very convenience place to stay (just 1 min from China Town).
A little bit small room (w/ no window) but good enough for 1 pax.
It is a share shower / wash room apartment and there is no common area. I.e. can be inside the room. Luckily, the air con is running good.
the hosts are super nice and helping, and the room is "tall friendly" !
房间很小，所以通风可能没有那么好，不过住的话是足够啦。房东人非常贴心，发了详细的指导帮我找到所在位置，因为电话打不通，Ella就一直在门口等我，非常非常感谢~

It's in a great location in Chinatown, with cheap restaurants galore right downstairs, a one minute walk to the subway, and everything in the cozy room that you could possibly need; great wifi, plenty of plugs, AC etc.

A lovely apartment looked after by Elle who was always friendly, happy and helpful with any questions. couldn't ask for a better location with the MRT rail directly outside the complex and a food court which was both cheap and good quality local food
Good experience
房源的位置非常好。离Chinatown地铁站2分钟，基本去哪都不会超过半个小时，而且周围有很多吃的，去克拉码头步行就可以，去环球影城大概20多分钟，非常方便。房东特别热情好客，非常友善，在新加坡的时间里住的很开心，如果下次有机会再来新加坡，我还会住在这里

The room is perfectly located right above the Chinatown MTR Station and there is also well located to visit all of Chinatown. The room is small but comfortable and Ong was extremely friendly and welcoming. I would recommend anyone visiting Singapore to stay here!
Ong’s place is as described on the website. Located in the centre of the bustling Chinatown area. With everything you need on your doorstep
Ms. Elle is a Filipina so don't hesitate to book! There are also other spacious rooms with window in the same Flat. Comfort room is shared btw
Thanks for your hospitality Ong, the location was great and the owner is very helpful!
Kleine aber man hat alles was man braucht. Perfekte Lage!

It was a pleasant experience as a first time airbnb member/guest. Mr.Ong was very responsive in replying to messages and communication was very effective. I followed the detailed instructions on how to get there from the airport and I had no issues finding the unit. The pictures made it easy to follow the trail.
To be honest I was a bit skeptic about the "room w/ no window" because it looked cramped in the pictures but it turned out to be a bit roomier than what i thought. Although, I must say it really is for a single occupant and if you're of a heavy built it would be a challenge to fit in to the door of the room with the accordion-type of door.
The place is neat and in an excellent location.
And ofcourse Ms. Elle made it a lot easier and worry-free travelling by being so warm, helpful and accomodating. She even gave me some pointers on where to eat, what to do and how to get around places.
I would definitely come back at Ong's place!😁
The host was amazing. She provided extra services and was very helpful explaining the area possibilities... I definitely recommend this host.
It was as mostly described. You are right in the middle of Chinatown. The room is VERY small and I assume it was a food pantry converted to a sleeping area. Not for girls and too small for 2 people.

I really enjoyed my stay at Ong’s place. Located right above the Chinatown MRT, it was a convenient hub to explore the city. Elle was so kind and welcoming and made my stay special. She even did wash for me! The room is as described and quite cozy. Best if traveling with few belongings. The bed was comfortable and I had a hot shower as well. Highly recommend!

Location of the place is pretty central in Chinatown.  I had the smallest room without window. Which is pretty much as described - small. There are also bigger rooms to choose from which are much nicer. But of course subject to availability.  The woman of the house, Elle is a really warm and kind person. Always helpful and generous.
Very good location, clean room and cute and kind lady Elle !
A great place to stay for a flight stop over visit to Singapore. Location is excellent close to everything I come to see.
The place there is accessible by MRT with a walkable distance and convenient to 7-11 and lots of restaurants around. So, it would be a great place to spend your quality time in Singapore.
Amazing hospitality!!!

Chinatown is close to the center and Marina Bay and Gardens by the Bay are accessible by metro without changing trains. The flat is quite big. There are in total 5 guest rooms and three bathrooms. The room is, as the pictures show, without a window. But the AC works good and the bed is comfortable. Never saw a cockroach or other insects in my room.

무엇보다도 역에서 가까워서 좋았어요
시설도 편하게 이용했습니다

I had a great time here!  The location is perfect and the room is definitely super cozy, with everything you might need in a nice little space.  Loved it!  Elle was a very kind and helpful host as well during my stay.  This would be my first choice if I ever travel solo to Singapore again!

They turn this 70 years old apartment into eight small rooms , no kitchen , living room etc with 3 washrooms to be share. The lift can only go to 25th floor and you have to walk up to 27th floor carrying your baggages. Your nightmare begins at night where the sliding doors of bedrooms and washrooms make the noise when all the guests takes turn to use the washrooms.  interval of every five minutes.  Don’t think you can sleep in the day because it’s the washing machines in the narrow walk way turns to keeps roaring, beep and ting and clicking sound non stop with the maid radio on of foreign songs and music you don’t understand. All rooms are separated with a thin wall, you can hear anything that happen under the same roof so clearly like it’s next to your ears. OMG AL LA LU YA.   I left before my full stay.
Great location, two stations away from Marina bay and easy access. There’s plenty of food options around, including a Mcdonalds for emergency and 7 eleven and Ella was very welcoming!

I had a wonderful stay at Ong's. This booking was perfect for my needs, and Elle and Ong were so helpful and helped me make the most of my time in Singapore.
Location/Transit:
This listing is located in Chinatown, People's Park Complex. Chinatown MRT and SMRT bus stops are a 3-5 minute walk from the door of the apartment. Some Grab drivers had a tough time locating the nearby pick-up points- my recommendation would be to walk a little ways to the main road for Grab pickup.
The place:
Ong's apartment is relatively high up in the complex-elevator access only. It is divided into multiple rooms and bathrooms. There's a key to the main door and a key to each room.
Amenities:
My room was cozy and well-appointed- with a fan, air conditioner, hair dryer, water, water heater, tea/coffee/creamer, wall storage, a desk with a rolling chair, and a mini closet. I did not use the TV so I can't confirm what it had access to. I was amazed at just how organized a small space can be. Ong's other listings have windows, but I didn't miss having one.
There are three bathroom areas, the closest of which consists of a shower and sink. Down the hall, there is a shower/sink/toilet combo, and then further down the hall, there is a full-sized bathroom with a shower, toilet, and sink.
If you plan to exercise or spend time outside during your Singapore visit, bring more changes of clothes than you think you need- the apartment has a washer but I found myself having to wash my clothes and take showers much more frequently than I had planned.
Local access: Elle is the major architect of the day-to-day organization of Ong's listings. She helped me figure out the subway system, currency exchange, shopping for my Malaysia excursion, and more- I couldn't have done it without her- thanks Elle!
PPC has all sorts of shops I was able to exchange my money, shop for toiletries, accessories, and other various items without issue. Also, so many hawker stalls, cafes, and grocery options- you will not be hungry.
Great location spot with clear instructions. Elle was also a lovely and chatty lady. The only issue was my room wasn't noise proof so you can hear everyone else.
Great room! Great service :) nice room.
Great place for value!
Amazing location in the heart of Chinatown, central to 4 hawker center and right beside the MRT. Very safe location and lots of things to do in the area. Great value for this Airbnb
a pretty welcoming host and very good location for accommodation and very nice people
Small and cosy, very convenient place
Room is OK for one person. One thi
房东特别好，位置也没的说，以后来新加坡一定会再次住这里的。
Nice room with air conditioning and convenient transportation
Good location.
Nice view from the top.  Host were away, so I was almost on my own.
Es war angenehm und gut. Wenn ich wieder nach Singapur komme, werde ich wieder hier buchen.

This was my first time to use AirBnb as well as to visit SG. Mr. Ong will send you complete instructions how to get there from the airport along with photos so you wont get lost. He and Elle will meet with you near the MRT exit so they can help you with luggage.
If you won't be using roaming of your cellphone, just buy the $15 tourist simcard inside the airport before you go out of immigration (there is a tourist stall) so you can message them that you are on the way. Or you can use the airport's free wifi.
The elevator/lift will service only every 5th floor so these rooms are better for travelers with not so much heavy luggage (altho Mr. Ong will help you bring it up). My room was small (approx 2 x 2.5 m) but quite sufficient to my needs. The A/C was good and can get the room temp down quickly.
Room has lock inside (latch) and outside (padlock) so you know you can leave items safely. There was 6L of potable water too for drinking and a shared fridge/freezer outside the room. There was a washing machine just outside the that supposedly shouldn't be used after 10 (or was it 9, there is a sign) pm but when I was there, someone was doing noisy laundry up until 11pm onwards one time. So bring earplugs since the walls are very thin and the shower and washing machine is less than 5 ft away.
Elle is very friendly and helpful. She met me with some nice cold lemon tea when i arrived and also gave me tips where to buy denim shorts (ended up buying 2!). She also gave me a bowl of mangosteens to eat which i havent had for more than 5 yrs so that was a nice treat!
Location of place is amazing. You go down and there are hawker stalls selling all kinds of food and drinks. There is McDonalds also if you prefer that kind of food. A small 7-11 is also just there. Chinatown MRT station is very handy since it will connect you to most other lines thru nearby interchanges. There is also a handy taxi stop behind the complex (go straight beyond 7-11 until you see the Bunnies Bakery, turn left walk straight until you reach the corner and then turn left again to see the taxi stop) if you want to use taxi/Grab to get somewhere.

It's a clean room but a bit small right next to MRT station which makes it accessible easily and center to most of the things you would do in Singapore (Marina bay is in a walking distance).  Great hospitality.
Small but functional space! Easy to get around and good for a single traveler on a budget.

Ongs place is in Chinatown and walkable to most attractions or by using the MRT which is very close by. The room was as I saw it in the ad and the price was great.
The room and whole place was clean and had little extras that made the stay great.
Near a busy marketplace, there’s no shortage of food available nearby and shopping in Chinatown and the nearby markets.

Room interiors might be slightly dark and getting to the floor might be slightly confusing (no elevator to the 27th floor). But the host is really sweet and nice. Lot of privacy. Very homely. The bathroom is really clean and well equipped with all amenities. It is a cozy, comforting and centrally located place to stay in.
Great location - room is as described so no surprises. Not very noise dampening so you will be able to hear what happens around the apt. Would stay here again.

The place was good and much better than expectation , but the authorities of the building released a notice that the building is banned from Airbnb. Thus making it a-bit awkward going in and out(there is security guard at 1st floor). Overall the room really worth the money. :)
Centrally located and suitable for a short stay, it’s a nice starting point for discovering Chinatown.

dark and quiet room in the middle of chinatown. perfect for everyone who likes it cheap and does not spend much time in the room. the location is perfect. there are very good restaurants around and ong and especially elle are great hosts. be aware, that you can be harassed by the house security everyday because it seems like it's an illegal Airbnb. If you like adventures and don't want to go to a hostel this is perfect for you.
地理位置很好，房东Elle也很热情

The room is advertised as small but for a solo traveller it is plenty spacious and perfect. The bed was very comfortable and the aircon worked perfectly. There were three different showers/toilets to choose from which all worked great. It was not noisy at all.
The apartment is well situated directly opposite Chinatown MRT which is easy to reach from the airport and can get you pretty much anywhere you want to go very easily. There are plenty of food options and two malls right outside the door.
The hosts were lovely - couldn’t do enough to help, allowed me to keep some milk in their fridge, washed some clothes for me and even held a bag for me after I left for 4 days while I visited Malaysia.
I would definitely recommend staying here - it’s a steal for the price

This is an amazing location in Chinatown of Singapore. The building is right next to the MRT or metro, which will take you to the main attractions like Marina Bay, Little India, and the int’l airport in no time. The room is slightly small but perfect for a solo traveler. And Ong is a really nice host. Highly recommended!
A great place to stay.
L'acceuil est vraiment OK, mais c'est petit et peut etre un peu cher pour ce que c'est. Mais dans l'ensemble l'annonce est correcte sauf sur la taille de la chambre. .
位置很好，就在唐人街地铁站出来，楼下吃东西的很多。唯一小美中不足的就是房东没有准备护发素，菲佣很好，借了护发素给我，女性客人可以提前告诉房东，他人很好会准备的。

For a short city trip on a budget: this is the place!!! One couldn'task for more conveniently located in China Town, just steps from Downtown Metro St. The lady assitant is a truly special woman, very kind and helpful.

The room and building was more rough than I expected, however the co-host Elle was very nice and helpful with some local food and shopping tips. It did feel like a nice hostel with a private room or a college dorm since there were many residents also living and using the shared bathrooms/shower.
The location is great and for access to the trains, cheap, good massage place and yummy Chinese food right outside the building. For a place to sleep it was good value for the money if you compare it to all the expensive hotels around the area. Showers and bathrooms were very clean. The bed was not too firm for Asia standards. There were electrical plug converters in the room so you won’t need to bring your own.
Great location! Small room, but has everything you need. Everything is very well thought through. It’s also very clean and both Ong and Ellen are ver nice.

This was a great place to stay! The host was friendly and welcoming and the room was very comfortable. Moreover the location was perfect - there was so much to see within walking distance in Chinatown, and the apartment was also right on top of the Chinatown MRT station, giving easy access to the whole city. Highly recommended!

Amazing host!
Love you Elle!!

The Location is perfet everything is not more than 10 minutes trainride away. The room is clean and tidy. Ellen was very friendly and helped me a lot to organize me. There is a foodcourt right in front of the door where you can enjoy cheap and very delicious Food.  I can highly recommend this room even for a longer stay as you get so much help in everything. Thx a lot

This location was super convenient! The building is right above the Chinatown MRT station and if you're coming from the airport it's not hard to get here. Host was very helpful and friendly, room was clean with amenities. As all older apartments in this area the restroom is extremely small but I felt very much like a local staying here. Loved the big windows also! Be warned you need to take the residential elevators which only go up every 5th floor so you will need to carry your luggage up two short flights.

This location is very good! Great access to food centers, Chinatown MRT station and taxis. Host (and his assistant Elle) was very helpful and friendly, room was generally clean with though the restroom is extremely small and the air condition was in tip top condition.

From the very beginning - even before I arrived in Singapore, Joe was extremely helpful. He's very prompt in replying, and gave very precise directions on getting to the apartment. Once there, Elle is fantastic! She is very pleasant, and even though I was early immediately gave me a drink and a place to just rest a bit before I went out. 10/10 would recommend.

Tip - You have to get out on the 25th floor, and take the stairs on your left. It's a bit of a climb if you have heavy luggage.

Excelente opção econômica de hospedagem em Singapura. Localizado em Chinatown, fica convenientemente ao lado da estação Chinatown do MRT, o que facilita muito a locomoção. O quarto é pequeno porém aconchegante, dispõe de ar condicionado e televisão. Poderia ter um frigobar... Joe e Elle foram muito atenciosos comigo. Recomendo essa opção para quem busca uma hospedagem econômica, porém bem localizada.

Host gave me a quick overview of the amenities upon my arrival and was accommodating to my requests such as borrowing of hangers and so on. Overall stay was pleasant, more than I actually expected because I did not pay a lot for this wonderful place.

Really good experience -- very convenient location, and the room had everything needed for a comfortable stay.  It's the first time I've staying in a "private room" (as opposed to "entire apartment"), and I didn't love hearing the other guests.  But I did a lot of searching before choosing this one -- and it's clear that the price is excellent value for anyone who doesn't want to pay the much higher cost of "entire apartment" in Singapore.  The hosts were very friendly, and again it was perfectly clean and very convenient location.

Jo was great about communicating with me promptly and his directions were spot on. Elle greeted me at the apartment and was very warm. The apartment has just been redone with new bathrooms and a fresh coat of paint and new furniture. You are staying in one of Singapore's first housing blocks and you are really living with the people. The food court and mall on the bottom floors are very busy and the MRT and key buses stop right below you. Great convenient budget place to stay. Excellent view.

Communication for finding the place was great, and the location was very easy to find as it was the building directly under the main train line. Elle met me downstairs when I arrived by train, and gave me helpful tips for navigating around the city on arrival. A cold drink on arrival, and air con was just what I needed and happily provided. Even though the room was small with a shared bathroom it was just as described, and other guests were friendly and courteous. Clean and with a great view on the 27th floor. Thanks!

Good location! The room is a little bit small but convenient. Shared bathroom is not the one i prefer but it's clean.
Overall it's worth for value u paid!
Host care & response message timely.
Great room close to the MRT and tons of street food. Wifi is super fast and Elle was very friendly.

Cozy room with great view. Bed was comfortable. Shared bathroom is small, but well-equipped. Located in a residential high-rise above Chinatown MRT, right next to Chinatown. Communication was fast and efficient, the host and the housekeeper are pleasant and reliable people. All in all, great experience!

Great location, right above the MRT, and hosts are very nice.
A bit hard to find at night

Elle is a very lovely sweet host, she is very helpful and kind to me! I forgot my phone charger and she messaged me that she would keep it for me! she clean the toilet early and the public area every morning to ensure the cleanness, let us stay comfortable and feel relaxed! Thank you :)

Excellent location!!  Close to the MRT and China Town.  The communication prior to arrival and the directions to the place were excellent.  I would highly recommend staying here as a single person.   Elle was absolutely wonderful and so helpful.  I will definitely be coming back to stay.
super Lage (Chinatown Zentrum), zweckmässig zum günstig übernachten, ruhig (27.Etage)

Ong's place is exactly the condition as described. It is very small, both the room and the bathroom. I lived in SG for 7 years before so I know what to expect but I would foresee many people feel uncomfortable about it. But for its price vs. its location it's totally worth it.

This is a clean small bedroom with a shared bathroom right in the centre of Chinatown, so a great location.
Thank you for having me!
Ong and Elle were easy to work with. Elle was an amazing host and made my stay very comfortable. This is a great space in the middle of Chinatown, and would stay again on a future visit to Singapore!

Highly recommended for solo traveller with small luggage. Superb view both daytime and at night from room window as shown in the listing. Shared toilet and bath was no problem, clean at all times. Adequate daily essentials are provided.  Super convenient for both eateries and transportation to other parts of Singapore.
该住房交通非常方便，出门就是地铁口，购物也很方便！房间和卫生间都很干净，是个不错的选择！
Great location and acceptable infrastructure. The cost-effectiveness is outstanding in Singapore and I believe it's hard to find another bnb like this elsewhere.
Host was excellent and friendly. Room was cozy with everything you might possibly need. If I'm ever in Singapore again I will come back. Thank you for everything!

This place was perfect for my time in Singapore. Elle was like an angel, always available with a welcoming smile. She made sure I had no questions, was settled and comfortable. She was there if I needed anything. The communication with Ong was super quick and very efficient. I thought I would have issues finding the apartment, but his directions made it easy to find.
The bed was extremely cozy. Everything was just as described, very neat, tidy, and the apartment was very quiet. I slept like a baby the whole time I was there. You can't beat the location at all. The price is a baragain and I would definitely recommend staying here and will book this place next time I am back!
Thanks for the perfect stay!
Feels like being back at home or a friend's house.
Great value for money

This is my first solo trip ever, my first time in Singapore ever, and I had really good time there. One of the main factor is that I got Mr.Ong's place to stay.
The room is small but cozy and have everything you need ( even a smart hub TV). Shared toilet and bath was no problem, it's clean. Did I tell you about the view? The room have a great view, you can see the whole Chinatown ( and beautiful city) through your big big big window.
Mr. Ong was really helpful and responed quickly to every question of mine. Elle is very warm, careful and kind. Bonus, Elle likes Coldplay too (OMG, we share the same music taste).
All in all, great experience!
位置很好。楼下的那家西安小吃很好吃。

Die Beschreibung des Zimmers war zutreffend. Elle wohnt selbst in der Wohnung und war auch mein Kontakt vor Ort. Ong hab ich selbst nie angetroffen. Die Wohnung ist im 27.Stock, eine Nacht gab es ein Unwetter, demnach war es recht laut. Zu meckern gab es trotzdem nichts.
