싱가폴을 대표하는 랜드마크가 보이진 않지만 차이나타운 과 높은 빌딩이 양쪽으로 보여서 좋았습니다
방에는 포크 나이프 스푼 물 컵 헤어드라이기 커피포트 등등 방에서 나가지 않아도 모두 사용할 수 있게 구비되어있습니다
이번 여행에서 총 다섯개의 에어비앤비를 이용했는데 이 모든게 방에 구비되어 있던 숙소는 없었습니다
특히 너무 좋았던 것은 제가 이 곳에서 2박을 묵었는데 큰 타월을 두개 주었다는 것입니다
맨 처음에 일주일간 묵었던 곳에선 일주일동안 큰 타올 하나만을 제공했고(대만이었음)
이 숙소 직전에 묵었던 싱가폴 겔랑쪽의 숙소에선 숙소를 제공하지 않았었습니다
그리고 방에 무드등이 두개 있는데 두개 다 한국 콘센트랑 모양이 같아서 그 무드등 두개 다 뽑고 제꺼 충전기 사용할 수 있었어요
그리고 콘센트 옆쪽에 USB꽂는 곳이 두개가 있는데 이미 아이폰 USB와 안드로이드USB가 준비되어있어서 핸드폰이나 카메라정도만 사용하지는 분들은
별도의 충전기를 사용하지 않아도 될 것 같습니다
저는 노트북도 있고 충전할 게 몇개있어서 개인용도 추가로 사용했네요
그리고 숙소가 현지여행사와 마사지샵이 많은 건물에 있는덕에 오가며 쉽게 이용할 수 있었습니다
한국인들 사이에서 유명한 씨휠트래블 여행사도 이 건물에 있는데 다른데가 더 싸니 굳이 여기만 가야할 필요는 없습니다
발품을 팔면 팔수록 싼데가 나와요..!
한국돈으로 따지면 총 금액이 몇천원정도 차이겠지만 그래도 발견하는 재미가 있다고 생각해서 저는 다섯군데정도 다녀서
항목마다 싼곳에서 했어요
건물에 맥도날드도 있고 푸드코트도 있고(물론 중국 현지식이라 먹진 않았네요)
방음은 그리 잘 되는편은 아닙니다
저는 잠귀가 매우매우 밝고 예민한데 옆방에서 들리는 코고는 소리가 낮게 울리고 도로에 오토바이소리 시계소리 등 때문에 이어플러그를 끼고 잤네요
근데이건 제가 예민해서 그럴듯!!
아 특이한 점은 숙소가 27층에 위치 해 있는데 엘리베이터가 5층 단위로만 섭니다
1층 5층 6층 10층 ~ 30층은 5층단위로
그래서 25층에서 내려서 계단으로 두층 올라가야해요
계단 갯수가 몇개되지 않아서 힘들진 않았지만 체크아웃과 체크아웃시에는 좀ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ힘들었어요
캐리어가 거의 20키로 정도 돼서..
더 싼데도 찾자면 많지만 매우 만족입니다
elle너무 친절하고 좋음~~

Уютная небольшая комната, с прекрасным видом на даунтаун. Очень здорово просыпаться и засыпать любуясь видами города. Хорошо укомплектована, все необходимое в наличии. Расположена в высотном комплексе, прямо у метро Чайнатаун. Внизу большой фудкорт, где можно недорого и вкусно покушать. На период моей поездки хозяева отсутствовали, но при этом, нам удавалось очень хорошо удаленно взаимодействовать и координироваться. Элли была очень мила и приветлива. Могу смело рекомендовать данное жилье!

Ong's place was in the heart of Chinatown where restaurants abound and foodies will be in heaven.  Catching the MRT could not be easier though there is so much to do just within walking distance.  The room was cozy and had everything I needed including a comfortable bed with a big window to look down on the city. The bathroom was clean and just across the hallway.  Elle, the manager, was absolutely wonderful, very friendly and helpful.  I would definitely stay here, again, in one of my favorite cities, in my favorite part of town!
Friendly Host, Clean and Comfortable Environment. I highly recommend booking your airbnb stay with this host.

Квартира расположена в оживленном Chinatown, в 3 минутах ходьбы от MRT. Также, очень удобно от центра добираться пешком до ближайших достопримечательностей.
Elle замечательная хозяйка, очень радушная и гостеприимная. Очень удобно организовано заселение - возможно заселиться в любое время.
It was a very pleasant stay. Thank you Elle for her help:) i would recommend that place for single tourists.

Such a nice place ! I stay here for 4 days, it's too comfortable that sometime I don't wanna go out , thanks Elle, she is such a nice lady!
Don't forget if u come back in midnight, u need to enter from the back door~
Great place to stay, easily accessible, right on top of MRT station, lots of food choices close by, very clean and well managed.

Central location and right beside MRT. The room has nice city views and the aircon is very good. I only didnt like that I think there were 3 rooms being let at the same time so there can be noise and have to wait for shower to be free. Elle the host is friendly and helpful.

Très central, seulement 2 arrets de metro du Marina Bay. Accès facile, tout est à disposition, du savon et shampoing jusqu'au chargeur d'iphone et adaptateur universel. L'hôte est tres sympathique, je recommande.

Very close to public transport. Chinatown tourist area is just across the road. Hundreds of local food stalls downstairs. Have your own set of keys for convenience. Consistence hot watersupply for shower. Air conditioner works well. Very quiet and had good sleep throughout my 6 nights stay. The size of this room is very comfortable for single person stay. Fantastic view.

I would recommend! the room is small but with all ameneties and perfectly located.
The appartment right on the MRT station Chinatown. Really handy as a base to discover the all city. Chinatown itself is very lively, there are many temples to see, nice bars close by.
Elle, who manage guest arrival & departure, was super nice and offered me to leave my luggage in the flat during my last day (as my flight back was late at night).

The place is clean and cozy and Elle is very hospitable. The train station is close so traveling by public transport is super convenient. Being at the heart of Chinatown, the food choices are abundant. If you're a solo traveler looking for a place to stay in Singapore, I highly recommend this!
I like the room style. And Elle is nice.
Great location in Chinatown.  You will get looked after very well and all your needs catered for.  Elle & Florence will help you with transport & even ideas of things to do.  Highly recommended.
位置便利，房间设施齐全，卫生，但房间较小，楼下吃饭方便

I had a fantastic stay at Ong's place in Chinatown.  Communication was excellent, Elle was very warm and friendly, and the room was quiet and cozy.  Downstairs there is an abundance of amazing food stalls, and many beautiful temples and sites are within walking distance.  Otherwise everything is very accessible by MRT.  I would definitely stay at Ong's place again.  Thank you!
The room is very clean and comfortable. This apartment located near MRT, so is very easy to move.
非常不错的地方，在楼道内可以看到很美的景色。Elle是菲律宾人，非常友好，我早上6点就到了，房客还没有走，就让我到她的屋喝咖啡。珍珠坊的电梯不太好找，如果你发现电梯只能到5层，那就应该去另一边去寻找

Ong and Elle were excellent host. They were very welcoming and friendly. The home is in a great location and it was very easy to get into the city. I will definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Singapore!
Great location for a solo traveler to Singapore.  Right in the heart of Chinatown.  Literally take lift downstairs to all of the shops and the MRT station.  Would definitely recommend.
交通便利，房間也很乾淨，共用衛浴，cp值很好的房間！

My room was completely clean with lots of options for hanging and drying clothes. There was lots of drinking water and drinks options available, much appreciated in Singapore's humid heat. Elle was outstanding as an on-site host, very friendly and helpful. My only concern, which I have shared with Ong, is to give some clear guidelines for the shared toilet/shower area for all guests.

I am usually bad with directions but I got a detailed message from Ong and Elle that led me straight to their apartment once I got out of the cab. They both were very nice and accommodating. The place was clean and as described in the photos. They were thoughtful of the little things you need. I would definitely come back here to stay for my next trip.
Convenient location. Room is cozy, with plenty of gadgets. Elle is very kind. Nice stay for solo travellers.

Nixe place: great location, fantastic view from window, cosy and clean. Elle is living in the appartment and running the hosting. She was sooo nice and friendly. You get a taste of Iocal living. Please check the entrance spot after the shopping center is closed. I would totally recommend this place.
Very helpful people. I felt bad, and they drove me to the hospital. This was an fantastic room. Im happy to have been here

I have nothing bad to say about this place. If you're a solo traveler looking for a place to stay, go for it! The hosts are endlessly friendly and welcoming, the room is comfortable with a fantastic view. Note that the room includes a kettle, drinking water, mugs and teaspoons, coffee/tea sachets, and USB charging.
Don't be put off by the photo of the bathroom - yes it's quite a small little wet room, but kept perfectly clean and suits ones needs while traveling.
I'll be staying here again!

Very good location, convenient for transport and lot's of great food close by. It is a suitable room for a single traveller on a short trip and not looking to work in the room. Good communication, clean and no issues.
They are very nice and the best location. All the great food is around. The room has a great view.

Overall location is very strategic. Easy to move around. Food aplenty. Security is tight. Elle stays in, so it is easy for her to assist me if I needed anything. Bathroom and Bedroom is clean. Get to see nice CBD view from the window. Really value for money. Will stay again if I want to be near CBD area. Communication with Ong and Elle is easy as they are very responsive. All instructions provided before check in is easy to follow.

The room itself is very cosy but still spacious enough to walk around in with a suitcase on the ground. It is filled with so many resources: kettle, tonne of water, drawer filled with coffee and tea, hairdryer, smart TV, aircon, multiple fans, drying racks, and of course a high-in-the-sky view of Singapore. Elle and her sister as hosts were VERY accommodating and so sweet (they even offered to do my laundry!). I would 100% recommend this place to any solo traveller as most amenities are provided and you are upstairs of a few hawker centres and the Chinatown MRT.
房间在Chinatown，离MRT很近，可以方便的去到任何想玩的地方，房内设施干净整洁，而且准备齐全，房间布置也很不错很有亲切感，房东也很负责，会热情提供服务，总之是很不错的体验
Perfect location in the centre of Chinatown, very easy to access and makes a short stay much more enjoyable. The place has everything you need and I would recommend to others.

I loved this place and especially the view! The room was small and cozy and super nice. The location was perfect and it was located in the center of Chinatown. Perfect to go eat nearby, MRT was downstair, shopping malls are around. Would love to come back  soon.
Perfect location !

Reasonably good value, but be sure expectations are aligned with what you have in mind. At its best, on par with an average hostel, and several notches below high quality hostels.
Elle, the house host, is a sweetheart, which makes up for some of the short comings. But given a chance at a do-over, I would consider a private room elsewhere.
Good luck!

Although Ong wasn't at the apartment, Elle was and she was absolutely amazing! So friendly and answered all of my questions. Great communication by both Ong and Elle.  The room was super clean and had great amenities. Perfect location to explore Singapore above MRT station in the heart of Chinatown. They also let me stay well past checkout as I had a very late flight! Would definitely recommend and stay here again!

Little cozy Apartment in the heart of China with amazing food courts and great access to MRT and in walking distance to major attraction. Elle who is running the Apartment since she has been living in one of the rooms was an amazing, helpful nd very hospitable housekeeper! Can only recommend this place for single travelers who are comfortable in staying in a small, but well equipped room!
It is really cozy and the room has all that one might need for a short stay in Singapore. Convenient location and the view is great! Many thanks :)

제일 좋았던건 위치가 mrt역 출구에서 정말 가까워서 좋았구요. 차이나타운 mrt역이 어딜가든 이동하기 굉장히 편리 했습니다 ㅎㅎ저는 밤비행기로 돌아가야해서 체크아웃하고 짐을 저녁까지 맡겨두어야했는데 흔쾌히 맡아주셨고, 체크아웃 후 중간에 숙소로 돌아와 옷을갈아입을일이있었는데 그런것도 전혀 문제없이 괜찮다고 해주셨습니다 (제가 체크아웃하면서 열쇠를 두고가는바람에 , 옷을 갈아입어야하는 저를위해 문을열어주러 숙소로까지 와주셨습니다) 굉장히 친절했습니다 돌아가는날 선물까지 준비해주셨습니당
다만 아쉬운 점이 있다면 아파트 자체가 굉장히 오래되어서 청결에 조금 문제가 있어보였습니다 벽에 개미가 많이 기어다니구요 제가 벌레를 많이 싫어해서 그게 좀 그랬구요, 또 방안에있는 컵들이나 커피포트의 청결이 약간의심되었습니다!! 하지만 가격에 비해 위치나 모든점을 고려했을때 괜찮을것같다고 생각합니다

Die Location ist echt perfekt. Es gibt einen Food Court direkt am Eingang des Gebäudes. Chinatown ist recht zentral gelegen sodass man alles was man sehen möchte und sollte zu Fuß erreichen kann. Ich habe mir keinen Stadtplan angeschaut Sondern bin einfach immer eine neue Route entlang gelaufen. Das empfehle ich euch. Viel Spaß bei Ong.
Die Beschreibung ist übrigens idiotensicher. Jeder wird die Unterkunft finden.
Great location right above Chinatown! Ong is super quick with responses and is super friendly. Overall, a great value for such an expensive city.

Elle was very friendly and made me feel welcome. Room is compact, perfect for solo traveler. Most amenities included. Bathroom toilet a bit cramped. Finding the lifts to the apartment might be tricky. After that, you can only use one of the lifts (for visitor).
Location is superb. Right above food court (and a mcdonalds) so you will never go hungry. MRT is right outside the complex.

The location of this place was great, and it would have been perfect for a single traveller if there had not been bugs. While they were not bed bugs (to my knowledge), there were tiny insects on the walls all near the desk. This made it hard to believe they weren't other places in the room too. They were about the size of a fruit fly, but grey and didn't fly. They crawled like ants. They were tiny so they were difficult to notice at first, however, the desk area was covered in them. I kept my luggage zipped when it was in the room to make sure I didn't take many of these insects with me.
Elle was very kind in showing me around the accommodation and was very hospitable.
At some points in the day, there was also loud drilling, presumably coming from upstairs.
Really wanted to like this place, but the bugs ruined it.
Definitely I will come back, house is clean and the view is amazing

I'm a solo traveller and this room was ideal for what I needed. It was very small but fine for me and packed with essentials. I was able to arrive earlier than the time provided which was a bonus. The location was ideal, being situated almost above the Chinatown MRT and a mall with plenty of places to shop and eat. The view from the room is incredible and provided me with a good start and end to each day. Entrance to the building requires you to show your passport each time which is a little nuisance but giving it some thought makes the place more secure and safe. Tip: take a photo of your passport and present to security on your phone. The shower and toilet facilities were shared but well maintained and I never encountered any problems with using them. Elle is a great host and she was pleasant to talk to and offered to help where she could, including offering to wash my clothes! Note: The room is on the 27th floor with a lift to the 25th and stairs to the 27th so bare this in mind. Again, not an issue for me but could be for some people. Ong is very responsive and provided good detail in how to get from the airport to the room. It took me 50 minutes but the room is situated very central to many attractions. I would certainly stay again.

Good value for your money: centrally located at the Chinatown MRT and near many bus lines. Within walking distance of many attractions. Excellent hospitality from Elle and clear/quick communications with Ong. I would stay here again.
More similar in feel to a hostel than a hotel or apartment. Clean accommodations, hot water, good WiFi and A/C. Fantastic view.
Things to consider: I’m 5’8” tall and felt that the bed was just long enough. If you’re over 6’, you might feel like you can’t stretch out. Also, I have very long, thick hair and did not feel like the water pressure was strong enough for me to wash out the shampoo. Not a big deal since I was only there 3 nights but it would be a problem if I were there much longer.

Ong is a great host. Everything given on airbnb is accurate. Instant informing and responses of the host and his team member (Ellie) was very helpful. It was a full Chinatown living experience and also very close to everywhere by walking or via MRT. I recommend this place.
Very quick responce, very good location and and very nice experience

It was just perfect as I was traveling alone and had a very hectic schedule. It was centrally-located (a few steps away from the ChinaTown MRT Station) and Elle was just the best host. She was very accommodating and went above and beyond in making sure that I was comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!
Nice, comfy and clean place right in the center of Chinatown

Arriving tired and groggy after a long journey, being greeted with a friendly smile, a cold drink and conversation from Elle was a godsend - and her welcoming hospitality continued throughout my stay. The room itself has everything you need, leaving no stone left unturned in terms of amenities. Of course, the amazing views over the city are a bonus and the location really is perfect with a tube station on your doorstep. Contact from both Elle and Ong was regular and efficient in the run up to my arrival - I would thoroughly recommend for either business or pleasure.

Surprisingly convenient location, 15-20min walk from most tourist attractions around central Singapore and the Marina Bay Sands, and right next to a MRT station. Was a little bit tricky to find the apartment the first time, but the host provided photos of every step of the way, which was very helpful. Very comfortable room, very accommodating and helpful host. Thank you!

This place is great. Close to MRT and in the center of Chinatown. Can be a little difficult to find, the first time. But the Host, Elle is extremely helpful and very respectful of your privacy. The room has everything a traveler could need, good wifi, clean water, kettle and charging station. GREAT PLACE!!

Elle and Ong are very friendly hosts and genuinely care about your need. Enjoy my stay in the cosy bedroom with everything I need. Bathrooms and toilet are shared but it’s perfectly fine for me as a solo traveller.

住处位置非常好，出地铁后拐弯就可以到达楼下电梯处。牛车水地铁站去周边很多地方都方便。楼下非常热闹，有很多小吃，推荐对面唐城坊下面的味香园甜品，买林志源猪肉脯也很方便。房间整洁，空调声音很小。不过在卧室桌上发现很小的虫子，而且放吃的在上面的话，虫子会越来越多。这个是一个大房子里面有六七间小房间，公用两个卫生间，不过里面只有一个卫生间有马桶。卫生间很干净，设施齐全。一个人来新加坡的话，是一个性价比很高的选择。
Thoroughly enjoyed my stay here. Safe, clean, located in the centre of Chinatown next to amazing food and a really comfortable bed. Would definitely stay again if I'm back in Singapore.

The apartment is situated in the heart of Chinatown allowing easy to the area and walking distance to the MRT, hawker center and other attractions. Ong and Elle were both very hospitable and flexible even after my flight was delayed. Would recommend this place.
The place is cosy and comfortable. It is well located in the heart of Chinatown. Perfect for a solo journey to Thailand. A lot of food places around some open 24/7.
Great location and all a single traveller would need to see Singapore. Only one toilet (two showers) amongst four rooms but a small price to pay for Chinatown and Singapore eats at your doorstep.
This is a lovely place and Elle is such a nice host. Really made me welcome. The room is in a perfect and exciting place in Chinatown. Loved the view too.

One of my best AIRBNB experiences. The hospitality was great. Superb location,all places that matter are well connected. The room isn't hug but so well planned. Fast internet, a TV that works well, drinking water in room with a coffee maker and AC. The view from my room was great. The food choices within the same building is good. Forex is easily available and ATM's as well. The MRT is right next door. Do try hawker Chang, the michelin star food cart which is across the road. Phenomenal food.
Should I come back to Singapore in the near future I know where to live.
Special thank you to Elle for her warm hospitality.
Nice clean room in Central China Town. Elle is very helpful

Voilà pour moi l'un de mes meilleurs logements depuis que je suis sur Air BnB !
Mr Ong et Mme Elle sont juste extraordinaire, dès la prise de contact, j'ai reçu photo de la marche à suivre (de l'aéroport jusqu'à la porte d'entrée).
Ayant eu un soucis avec mon téléphone je n'ai pas pu contacter Mr Ong à Singapore avant d'être sur le pas de la porte, mais vu UE j'avais le WiFi, je lui ai envoyé un message et aussitôt il m'a aidé en contactant Mme Elle qui m'a ouvert !
L'appartement possède une magnifique vue sur Chinatown (et on aperçoit même le Marina Bay Sands) et il y a dans la chambre tout ce dont l'on a besoin (bonbonne d'eau, bouilloire, chargeur pour toutes les prises, TV individuelle etc... Etc..).
Bref au vue du prix, de la location, des énormes plus mis à disposition, de la gentillesse et réactivité de Mr Ong et Mme Elle (ainsi que du personnel chargé de la sécurité et du check-in qui fut extrêmement aimable), je recommande activement et très fortement cette location !

Good place, good space, good amenities.
not so noisy, fully air conditioned, very good for having a good sleep.

This may be the best air bnb experience I’ve ever had. Your bed has an amazing view of Singapore. It is centrally located as everything is either a short walk or short metro ride away. The host is amazing, she even helped me find size 14 shoes in Singapore (my shoes had torn and I urgently needed a new pair). She will go out of her way to make you feel at home. Cannot recommend this place more.
It is located in Chinatown, convenient to move around.

Wer nur Bett und Dusche sucht wird hier fündig. Obendrauf gibt es eine perfekte Lage direkt in Chinatown, atemberaubenden Blick vom Bett aus, mit Ubahnanschluss und unglaublichen Essensmöglichkeiten. Das Zimmer hat auf kleinem Raum vollste Ausstattung, es mangelt an nichts. Sogar Trinkwasser wird bereitgestellt. Man teilt das Apartment mit mehreren Gästen und Elle die dort lebt und stets ansprechbar und hilfsbereit ist. Hab allerdings niemand angetroffen weil offensichtlich jeder nur zum schlafen hier ist. Die Matratze war nicht mehr die Beste, das ist das einzig negative was ich sagen kann. Würde wiederkommen.
至るところに近い。
Très bon emplacement. Chambre fonctionnelle et accueil sympa.
A solid budget option! The host is accommodating and the place is clean. The location is perfect for exploring the town.

The apartment is located in one of the oldest building in modern (post-1965) Singapore. It is a bit run-down, but it has its character, and clearly historical value. In any case, once you enter the apartment all is very clean and functional (internet, for example, was so fast!!) - plus the view from the 27th floor is breathtaking. The position is very convenient, right in the middle of Chinatown. Ong was a wonderful host: great communication, and top-kindness. Due to a flight delay I had to check in at 4am, but she was there to assist me. In the same way, I needed to leave my luggages for half a day on the day of my departure, and Ong very kindly let me do it. This place is really good for this price, given the chance, I'll stay again next time. Thanks Ong!!

Generally a pleasant stay. Great location and the room is cozy though the bed is a bit small even for a small Asian guy like me.
The checkin process needs some improvement. The host told me the door was open but it wasn’t. As I only have data on my phone, I sent him messages on arrival but he didn’t respond fast enough. So I had to top up to make calls. And his assistant didn’t pick up the phone so I had to call him directly. Though in the end it took about 10 minutes to get inside, the process isn’t quite what I had expected.
So please make sure that you can checkin easy with the host before your arrival.
the place like a home.. i will come back again.....
A truly wonderful room with an amazing view and a fantastic host!
Friendly, professional hosts and great location. Room is as advertised. Would definitely recommend.
Very friendly hosts! Simple room with everything you need (The view is fantastic). The location is perfect to discover the city.
Everything you need. Nothing you don’t. I had a great time and will certainly stay again

awesome location, in chinatown. a short walk to a lot of nice places. the room is clean and big enough to leave a big and walk around. they let me check out late, which was much appreciated as i had a late flight. thanks for the nice stay

Der Aufenthalt bei Ong bzw. Ellen war super. Ich habe leider Ong nie persönlich kennengelernt, ich denke mal das er allgemein sehr viel arbeitet und ich ihn daher nie zu Gesicht bekommen habe. Dafür war Ellen ein Engel. Sie ist super freundlich, hilfsbereit und einfach ein Schatz. Ich musste Wäsche waschen und sie hat mir angeboten, diese auch noch aufzuhängen und hatte auch nichts verlangt. Ich habe ihr natürlich trotzdem eine Kleinigkeit gegeben. Ich hatte das nicht erwartet, aber war positiv überrascht und konnte somit gleich morgens los und meine Sightseeingtour machen. Die Aussicht ist auch der Hammer und es ist alles da, was man braucht und mir hat die Größe auch vollkommen ausgereicht, aber ich glaube große Männer müssten sich ein bisschen einrollen:) was die Lage betrifft-hier kann ich auch nicht meckern. Alles in einem hatte ich ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt in Singapore bei Ong und Ellen. Dankeschön und alles Gute

The apartment is right in the heart of Chinatown high up with lovely views of the city. It is located perfectly to get to all the major hubs in the centre of town and the transport is right there when you want to venture further. The hosts were truly excellent and were so warm and accommodating, they always helped me even when my plans often changed last minute.
I really would recommend staying here, it is am experience you won't forget.
Great place, clean and quite.
Thanks Ellie for being a great host

Great location above all! Just 1 minute to the MRT station and easy access to many buses.
Elle was very nice and friendly. The room was supposed for 1 guest, not very large but providing almost everything i need for stay. Two bath room, one with toilet.
One thing to remind is that the elevator only stops at 25th and 30th floor, so you need to carry luggages to 27th on your own. Might be the only drawback for the house if you're with large luggages.
I recommend this place to other guests.

Couldn't ask for a better location. Right in the thick of Chinatown. All kinds of food and shopping right at the doorstep. Bed was a little too small for 6'4" me. If your 6' or under it should be okay. But the location makes up for the short bed.
This is a simple accommodation steps from the Chinatown station for a good price. Don't expect anything fancy, but a nice host, easy communication and accurate description.

Wer in Chinatown eine saubere und authentische Bleibe sucht, keine Höhenangst hat und auf das leckere
Essen der Hawker steht, ist bei Ong genau richtig. Ich habe die zentrale Lage im pulsierenden Chinatown sehr genossen und als Rückzugsort geschätzt. Gerne wieder beim nächsten Besuch, liebe Ong.
If you want to be close to all attractions in Singapore stay here.

初めは部屋に行き着くまで、少し難しく感じますが、Chinatown駅からすぐ近くで、とても便利なところです。ホストは親切ですし、他の宿泊者も皆感じが良かったです。アメニティは一通り揃っているので、お友達のお家に泊まりに来たような感じです。女性で気になる方は、自分好みの洗顔料やコンディショナーは持参した方が良いかもしれません。部屋に設置のヘアドライヤー、スマホ充電器、飲用水、電気ポットなど、細やかな気配りが嬉しかったです。一人旅におススメです。
Perfect stay in Singapore, very central and clean. Would definitely come again.
Great stay

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay, mostly due to the warmth the help (lady staying at property) provided.
Pros:
-best location, doorstep of MRT and Chinatown foodcourt and complex
-feels very safe (I was a lone female traveller)
-the lady at the property helped with whatever queries I had
-I was allowed to check in early and check out late
-fast communication with Ong
-all amenities provided (towels, cutlery, water, cups, cotton buds, tissues etc)
-although it is a wet bathroom (no separation from shower) it was cleaned everyday
Cons:
-there were ant-like bugs in the room, they seemed harmless but still annoying
-it is a bit noisy, the bed is next to the window and there is a constant wind and city noise
All in all, great value and I would definitely stay again

Great location- connects you well through MRT. Amazing Chinatown experience right below building.
Host shared exact location details which makes check in easier.
Good value overall.
The main value of this place is its location in Chinatown and right next to a hawker center. Otherwise it's about what you'd expect.
Ong人超级nice，很热情，住的也很干净安静，非常喜欢
Ong's place is very centrally located however my personal opinion is that it is not so suitable for female guests as the area is a bit messy (akin to slums).

Ong's place is located on top of people's park complex in chinatown. It's an apartment manned by his maid (which should be made clearer to travellers to avoid confusion). Overall an outstanding place but unfortunately might not last much longer given Singapore's airbnb crackdown.

I had a very good stay at Ong place. The apartment is located at the center of Chinatown, right at the Chinatown MRT stop close to all the highlights in Chinatown. The room is small but clean and the apartment has 3 bathrooms so sharing with other guests was never a problem.
Ong was waiting for me when I arrived and she shared detailed instructions to find her place, I had no trouble getting there. Overall really good value for money, not fancy but clean and functional, just what you need if you plan to be out and about all day and just need a place to sleep.

Really homey, welcoming, and comfortable. Absolutely loved my stay here and definitely recommend it. Super central location with tons of food, shops, and amenities downstairs, right on top of an MTR station, and the historic Chinatown district. Elle is a wonderful, warm, welcoming woman, and Ong is super responsive and helpful. I had no trouble at all as a solo female traveller going about at all hours—its an older area but Singapore is very safe. Clean and comfortable—think of it as staying abroad in your aunt or grandmother’s house.

Wonderful location that’s central to everywhere you want to be. Directions to get here were very easy to follow and was greeted by a friendly face once I arrived. Being so close to the metro station made my weekend in Singapore super easy. Bonus points for waking up to beautiful sunrises over the city.
Good Valuefor money

Ong's place is very very ideal for travelers who want it all in one place; it's accessible, the hosts are very accommodating and understanding, the place is itself very good. I had a great time there and will probably book if I get to visit SG again in the future
cozy and convienent！

Great location and I really appreciated with several rooms rented out that there is more than one bathroom to use. Also having Elle there makes it easier. She even offered to do my laundry when I was out. I got a little confused with check in, so as you exit the train station turn left and go in that building. Follow the signs for residential lift, which will take you to the back right. Pass through glass doors and then check in with security (have your passport ready). Then go up the lift and meet host at the apartment door.  Overall good stay!

A most convenient compact room very close to Chinatown MRT, accurately described, and very well looked after by the helpful friendly hostess Elle. I enjoyed the little touches with some travel books and biographies relevant to Singapore available in the passage way, the fact that there are two bathrooms available for (up to 3 rooms I think) AirBnB guests, the cooldrink cans in the fridge and the instant coffee and tea in the rooms. I'm a 6ft 2inch bloke so the beds were a tad short, although this is standard length I believe in Singapore, and was clearly communicated to me before I arrived. The place is an excellent choice, very conveniently located above one of the Chinatown MRT entrances and close to a bustling range of foodmarkets frequented by locals and travellers alike.

I really enjoyed staying at Ong's place!  The view is absolutely amazing, the air conditioning works well, and the bed is comfortable.  Plus, the location is fantastic; it's effectively at the Chinatown MRT station, and there are probably hundreds of places to eat within the radius of a few blocks.  I would definitely stay here again when visiting Singapore!
下次还会入住，无人check in check out模式很有体验感，环境不错，离市中心景点很近，楼下餐饮很多，如果能在房间放上驱蚊液就更好了，蚊子有点多

I was traveling alone and staying here for 5days.
Its location was perfect.
It takes only 5min from Chinatown MRT.
There was a sign to go this place in the Mrt station so I can find home easily anytime. so nice to travel Singapore by MRT!
Also It’s not that noisy than I thought so
I could sleep pretty well. The bed was cozy enough to sleep. The room wasn’t too small. pretty enough for a woman.
Especially Elle responded me nicely like family! I felt so secure during the trip 😃thanks :)
혼자 여행으로 5일간 지냈습니다
위치가 완벽합니다. 지하철(mrt)역 바로 옆건물이라 걸어서 에스컬레이터부터 방까지 엘레베이터 바로 타면 여자 빠른걸음으로 5분도 안걸렸습니다.
차이나 타운 역은 MRT로 싱가포르를 골고루 여행하기에 아주 좋은 장소에 위치해있어요! 그리고 1층에는 복합 몰과 시장 먹거리 파는 곳이 굉장히 많이있어서 돌아오는 길에 중국음식 먹어보기도 괜찮았습니다. 맥도날드도 바로 문 앞에 있구여ㅎㅎ
소음에 예민한 편이어서 걱정했었는데 생각보다 조용해서 꿀잠 잤어요 화장실 및 욕실은 사용하기에 깨끗했습니다~
그리고 엘리가 가족처럼 넘 따뜻하게 대해줘서 넘 맘이 편안했어요! 빨래를 나갔다오니 손수 옷걸이에 걸어서 말려주심.. ㅠㅠ 넘 감동ㅠㅠ 헤어지는 날에는 한국에 대한 얘기도 많이하고 너무 좋았습니다~ 잊지못할거에요~

Good communications and fairly easy to find.
Good location although I found china town a little dirty but no different to London right!?
First night I was put into my room as the police were knocking on the door! (I guess airb&b isn’t allowed!?)
Second night a guy had locked himself out and was banging on the door for ages. Not even the little lady who stays/lives there would answer. Probably thought it was the police again!? I let him in in the end!
I wasn’t aware but there is at least six bedrooms in this one place so don’t expect it to be quite. Far from. Shared showers/toilets etc. As per description.
Overall it was an ok stay. Just don’t expect a lot.
Personally I would have only stayed here for probably half of what I paid.
Didn’t meet the host just the lady who lives there who was pleasant enough.
What I will say is that it was very nice of her to let me leave my case there for the day and let me shower in the evening before heading to the airport.
Nice central room with a great view. Good value for money especially considering location. Booking and arriving was easy — just be mindful if you have a lot of bags due to the stairs!

Ong’s place is in a fantastic location on top of the buzz of Chinatown but quiet inside. Easy MRT access to all the important sights and great eateries at your doorstep make it perfect for the single traveller.

Allocation is amazing
2min from the MRT station
There are a lot of shops around the residence
The elevator stops only each 5 floors, so if you have heavy luggage, it would be trouble to carry

チャイナタウン 駅からすぐで、
どこに行くにも便利です。
お部屋や共用トイレやバスルームなど、どこも掃除が行き届いていて気持ちよく過ごせました。
充電器や水のサーバー、ヘアドライヤー、TV、カップやカトラリーも部屋内にあり、金額以上の価値があると思います。
常駐しているElleさんには、とても親切にしていただきました。
また滞在したいです♪
Great location and value, perfect for a short stay
Located very conveniently. Lots of train stations nearby. Host was very responsive. Very clean. Great view
Second time to Singapore for courses and choose same landlord and place to live due to convenience. Ong always replies very soon and would love to help me solving any problems. Very reliable

Really enjoyed the stay with great view from our room and shower/bathroom :-)
MRT & Chinatown just next door.
If you are looking for an authentic Singapore living-experience, you have to go there! Ong and Elli are friendly and trustful hosts! Thank you so much, we will come back!

Definitely exceeded my expectations.  Ong and Elle keep the place incredibly clean as described.  The room is small but more than enough for any traveler, and they provide coffee, tea, and water as well which was great.  Immediately downstairs is this amazing food hall as well.  This is very good value for Singapore and I would not hesitate to stay here again

Ong and elle were amazing hosts. Ong gave very precise directions to the hotel, which made it very easy for me despite being the first time in the city. And Elle was very hospitable. She even did laundry for me!
The room itself was very cozy with all the amenities needed (water heater, tissues, TV, ac, etc). And it is situated in a great place in Chinatown with great views.
This place is Amazing!  Fantastic location, clean, and the view is crazy!  Host was very nice and considerate.
Truly amazing location! Central and amazing view. Hosts are very responsive and welcoming.
Very convenient location, great local, affordable experience in the middle of Chinatown. Hawker center at your doorsteps!
Great location, very clean, has all the amenities you need. The shared bathrooms are very clean.
Great stay 👍👍

I had a great short stay at May's flat. I had to book the room last minute due to business meetings and May responded immediately. Location is great with easy access to public transport. May is a lovely and hospitable host - made me feel right at home. The flat and room were clean and comfortable. Would definitely recommend.

I arrived late at night with May waiting for me and warmly welcoming me to her apartment. The apartment was really clean and felt cozy, the room I stayed in was air conditioned and had everything I needed within. I really enjoyed the keyless access to the apartment a lot, because there was no need to carry a key(s) around with you while exploring the city.

Even though I only met May briefly during my arrival and was not able to meet with her during the next day or night, I can guarantee she is a lovely host and I would not only recommend staying in her apartment, but would be happy to stay there again myself.

The apartment building is absolutely divine and seemed really exclusive, and so was the whole neighbourhood, which was really calm and quiet and not full of skyscrapers, but rather medium 5-6 story apartment buildings with private gardens. Enjoyed my 2 night stay there a lot.

I had a very relaxing stay with May, felt at home. Small single room, comfortable bed, very quiet. Own bathroom next to the room, small balcony. Very small pool at the basement. 7-10 Minutes to the subway. Recommended to any single traveler.

May was a wonderful host, her communication was excellent, she was very friendly and helpful.  The check in and check out went smoothly. I could not have asked for a better stay. The apartment is comfortable and clean, the area close to the MRT and I would have no hesitation in staying again in the future if the opportunity arises.
Wonderful and comfy stay! Highly recommend May’s beautiful home :)

Если вы хотите вдали от дома, чувствовать себя, как дома, то тогда это жилье для вас. Мэй очень приятная приветливая девушка, она очень быстро отвечала на все мои вопросы, советовала куда сходить, что поесть. Жильё Мэй очень удачно расположено относительно Орчард роуд, между станций метро Newton и Novena, пешком , что до одной, что до другой станции не более 10 минут, недалеко от дома остановка автобуса. Сама квартира просторная и уютная, для гостей есть отдельная ванная комната.
Я очень рада, что выбрала именно жильё Мэй.

Came here to spend my first couple of weeks in Singapore - cosy, clean room on a relatively quiet street, but still easily accessible to (7-8 minute walk) to both Novena and Newton MRT. Well equipped for longer stays too.
May was super welcoming and helpful in helping me get settled in Singapore, 10/10 would stay again :D
May is a wonderful host! Super friendly and really helpful. The location is very convenient and the room is perfect for anyone looking for a cozy and comfortable stay.

It is an cozy and warm room! The bathroom is very nice and clean. The room is compact and comfortable / suitable to live in. Also, the location is closely near plaza and square, so it is very convenient to buy stuff. Also, the novena MRT station is near the house. May is also a friendly person, who assist me a lot during the living period.
Beautiful apartment, super nice host, very convenient location. I can only recommend it!

Excellent property in a very convenient location! Ms Catherine took great pains to ensure everything was in top shape when we arrived and she explained the do's and dont's very meticulously. The flat is huge by Singapore standards with a great balcony. The location is very close to downtown Singapore and hauling a taxi or grabbing a coffee nearby is never an issue even at odd times. Best of all, Ms Catherine was super courteous and ensured that we got all the help we needed. I enjoyed my eight night stay immensely and I look forwards to staying at her premises sometime in the near future.
A great and lovely apartment with a beautiful swimming pool.

Staying at Stephanie & KT’s place was absolutely great !
Room was perfect, the neighborhood is awesome and our guest were nice and helpful.
Would definitely come back to Stephanie & KT’s place for my next trip in Singapore

Stephanie och KT är trevliga och hjälpsamma värdar. Deras hus ligger i en populär stadsdel i Singapore med typiska shop houses i ett genuint bostadsområde. Grannarna är också trevliga. Det finns massor av små restauranger i omgivningarna, alla prisklasser. Ett större shopping center, Parkway Parade, ligger också i området. En busshållplats ligger ca 25 m från huset och bussarna kör ofta i båda riktningar till midnatt. Det finns direktförbindelse till China Town och Orchard Road. Dagtid är det en del trafik i området. Kvällstid är det lugnt. Jag skulle gärna återvända till Stephanie och KT.
It's been a nice and pleasant stay at this charming but well equipped home.

The apartment is in the roof top of a nice house in good walking distance to grocery stores, restaurants, food courts and even the beach is only 15 minutes away (walking). We liked the fast internet and the "open" feeling. KT and Stephanie are very polite and courteous. Can definitely recommend.
Spacious room with great amenities!
Nice house, central location, lots of restaurants and shops around.  The hosts KT, Stephanie and their son are all very helpful and pleasant.  A great stay in Katong area!
Wonderful location. The whole stretch of shophouses give such a good vibe. You could just sit and relax on a lazy afternoon, read a book while having a local craft beer. Will definitely come again.

It’s traditional private house. Quiet and great to stay for business trip in Expo.
It’s good location for who can travel by bus well, not suitable for MRT traveler.
Host is so friendly and helpful. Thank you and come back other time!
very comfortable.host is so kind to the visitor.
The house keeper is a very nice man.He told us many useful informations. I think it’s a great experience in Singapore. And we will chose the house again next time we visit Singapore.

距离展馆很近，交通很方便，室友都是学生，都很安静友好，房东都也很好啦，值得五星^_^
This place is very near from the Messe, Most of roommates are students, they are quiet and nice. The hoster is very friendly to me . Its very confortable staying ! ^_^

highly recommended. ill be checking in here again for my future trips in SG. value for money with hotel-like room. plus great location. got great foods around the area and direct bus to cdb. responsive and considerate host. giving 10 stars here.
You can expect a clean room. The proximity to bus stops, bars and restaurants are big plus.
This was my second stay here. Good value, convenient location and great hosts.
passable

As the previous tenants said, it’s very nice place to stay. A few minute toI12, lots of bars and restaurants right out of the house. Lovely old house area. Although far from MRT, but buses very convenient. I get everything necessary in my room, iron and board, attached shower, spacious wardrobe, comfortable beds. We have not seen the owners yet. But easy access and private space.

We loved our stay here! It’s a very live area with old Chinese houses and lots of bars restaurants right next to the house. Although subway is far, but lots of buses available direct to many places. Finally buses are very convenient. The room is on the 2nd floor. Very clean and enough space. Whole wall of wardrobe. I guess they transformed the balcony to a private bathroom.  Very convenient to have our own bathroom inside the room. Hot water kettle and many cups and glasses. Also have our own iron and board. Very thoughtful. We would love to come back!
its good. the building is beautoful and the place is nice

Nice and clean apartment, with facilities such as kitchenware and enough space to store your luggage.
The location is good with malls and restaurants around the corner. However it takes a while to get to the city centre since you have to take both a bus and the MRT when traveling with public transport

I really enjoyed my stay at KT and Stephanie's attic room.  Bed was comfortable. WIFI was good, however, when all the tenants were using it in the evening, the reception was a bit weak.  Fridge in the room. Was given bottled water, when I arrived. Hot water kettle and coffee maker, dishes supplied. Had a kitchen area on the balcony, with table and two chairs. Bathroom was out on the balcony as well (on the other side) but very private.  Interesting how this little place was created. Very close to wonderful restaurants, supermarkets etc.  Transit bus system is excellent as the MRT does not run closeby.  I took the bus #36 from the airport (about 30 minutes) and had a short 7 minute walk to their home.   The same bus takes about 10 minutes to downtown, where you can utilize the MRT to everywhere you want to go.  Beach is about 15 to 20 minute walk away.  So nice to have a beautiful park to go for walks.  I found this place to be clean, very quaint.  Good for one person.  There is an elevator in the building as well.  I would come here again.  Felt very safe here, walking around by myself.  KT and Stephanie (and Miss C - I called her)were very helpful with anything I needed.  Thank you again for your kindness and assistance with everything.
It‘s a good stay in the east coast area.

I liked staying a little out of town and in particular loved the outdoor food court next to the Dunman Food Centre as well as the old shophouses on Joot Chiat Road. If you come from abroad you can register your contactless bank card for use on Singapore buses (do this online), this makes things easier as there is no MRT close by to this Airbnb. If you do this, you can just jump on no problem. I didn't meet KT but he was very helpful in getting me set up for a bike trip I was starting and quick at responding over the app - thanks!
Clean, comfortable room in a vibrant area. Recommended!
Great location. Would definately stay here again!
Very good place to stay in central Singapore. The host gave very clear and simple instructions to check in. Very helpful and prompt responses. Worth visiting again.

This room is clean, comfortable. There is bus stop, I can access to downtown smoothly.
But I couldn.t use washing machine during staying. I ask it the host, but they don't reply anything when I stay there. So I will not use this room anymore and don't recommend my friend this room.
Clean accommodation, convenient transportation, many restaurants around.
Great location. Facilities exactly as advertised. Very responsive host. Would definitely stay here again.
Clean place to stay.
Great location and place to stay. Clean facilities, easy check in, will definitely stay again next time.
This place is really a good spot to stay as there are a variety of food to choose nearby. The place is really comfortable and clean and good for solo or couples to stay.

Much smaller than we expected and with less kitchen amenities than we thought would be available but it was fine for the two nights we were there. Never met the hosts but they were very responsive any messages we sent.
房东很友善，附近有很多吃东西的地方，超市，交通都很方便，下次还会入住！

The location is excellent. LRT is just next to the apartment and Seletar Mall is 5 mins walk. Very convenient. Host Esther Ying is very resourceful and helpful in getting us to settle in. The apartment is Excellent , Very Clean and Esther ensures that all the basic necessity is there when we arrived. The facilities at the apartment is resort like. it was indeed an excellent stay.
Apartment was conform to the description.
带父母新加坡过年，联系了几个airbnb的房东只有esther最热情，性价比最高，所以就订他们家了。每天早上8:30起床在“无边泳池”游20分钟泳，再坐门口的小轻轨去各个景区。Esther和她弟弟还会随时提供游玩攻略，真的很感谢他们！我们认为新加坡最佳的体验就是他们家了。

Esther's home is very clean and new. It is in a convenient location: there is a shopping mall nearby and a train station next to it. It was easy to communicate with Esther and her brother, even if she was travelling overseas. It is a very secured place to stay in. It is located in the topmost floor, quiet and private. We enjoyed our stay in Esther's home. We would highly recommend this place.

Brand new apartment in mint condition and latest fittings. Very accessible to the LRT station and a nearby mall just one stop away. Pool and gym facilities were superb and state of the art. The host was easily approachable with requests and questions.
非常愉快的住宿体验，新的公寓非常干净，游泳池很美也有很适合小孩子喷泉，交通也很方便。屋主是很好的人，给了很大的自由。非常推荐需要的家庭！
环境不错很舒服，房东也很亲切。
The whole apartment is so clean and tidy. The host is very friendly and nice. I will book again. Thank you so much for the nice apartment

The place is very very clean and tidy.  Host is attentive to details. .. and very accommodating. Great hospitality. . Even had drinks in fridge for us and kids shower gel.  Host was very flexible about check in arrangements as well.  Is conveniently located near Seletar mall. Overall a nice and very clean place. Highly recommend.

We loved our stay at H2O residences. The apartment was clean and cozy. The facilities like the pool were great as well. Esther was a understanding and helpful host who even provided some drinks for us in the fridge when we checked in. Everything went smoothly.
A nice and quiet residential area with fantastic pool. Suitable for families with young kids. We had a pleasant stay there. However it is bit far from the city centre.

We have stayed at Esthers place all together for around 4 weeks. Her apartment is very near by to the LRT, MRT and bus as well. Supermarket is also less than 5 minutes away, Food court (just pass the river to the next LRT station) is around 9 min away.
The communication was great with her and her brother and the check-In/Out also very flexible from her side.
I have been already at many condos in Singapore.. but hers was one of the nicest.. mainly because of this urban style with the great swimming and relaxing area.
Now I have my own apartment.. so I won't come back. But if I have guests, I will send them their :)
Host and her brother are very responsive and helpful with requests and the check in process. Post-check in, they even checked on us to make sure we had no issues. The stay was a comfortable one.
Very good host, highly recommended!

Christian is a nice guys but could have been more ready to receive guests:
-We didn't have the complete address
-Wifi was not working the first days (another roomate kindly provide his cellphone Internet when he was there)
-on our arrival their was a lot a hair in the guest shower
-we didn't have proper bed sheet
Beside this the location is really great. Close to bus, mrt and food. Close to attraction and downtown. Condo have a really nice pool and is located in a nice street. I'm sure this place will get better
Best location in Singapore for travel, if you don’t mind a small basic room.
很不错的地方

Tryston was a kind and accommodating host. He ensured that the room was in good shape and was patient to await my midnight check-in. The apartment was very strategically located with easy access to public transportation, convenience store and eatery. Would definitely book again if I was looking for accommodation around the neighbourhood.
Perfect area
Good stay.

The room was basic but pretty clean and comfortable. The bed was especially comfortable. There were some ants and little gnats at times but nothing too bothersome. The location is great! Very central. I really enjoyed staying here. The only thing that was inconvenient is that the attached bathroom only has a sink and shower. There is only one toilet and it is in the bathroom at the farthest end of the apartment.

The room and host was nice, and nice location to go to the central area.
The food republic is just in front of the apartment, and the station is very near.

We stayed on the Emerald Hill property. Quiet and beautiful area due to the restored chinese / Peranakan houses. Tryston is  friendly and was very prompt in answering my messages especially when we had the problem with no warm shower. Facilities provided a kitchen and washing machine with dryer which was very helpful. Our room had a attached bathroom which made a top mark.
Overall ok, the best thing is location, near from MRT and food court, sbucks. Tryston himself is friendly guy, kind helpful person, fast response and trusted

The best part about Jeff's place is the location. Its very convenient, no madder where you want to go and the MRT is just outside the doorstep. The room is good for a short visit of Singapore where you are anyways exploring the city. Communication with Jeff is easy and quick.
Good value for money.

I've spent a month in Tryston's place. Tryston is a very good host who provided me with a better room for 1 week, as well as helped me with transportation and bed linen. The location is 5+, absolutely perfect, everything is nearby.
However, I had some serious issues with the water in the whole apartment: sometimes it didn't go for 20 minutes. Tryston explained that it's not the apartment issue, but of the whole house and it's the first time it happened, I believe this.
Also, there is no information about the number of people in the apartment. There are about 8 people together with you, keep that in mind. And what's more, there is just one shared toilet for everyone so expect queues. I wish this information was written in the room details.
Overall, I'm satisfied.

Room was very small and shower smelled bad. Toilet was far away in the other end of apartment. Kitchen was with only very basic equipments, not good for cooking. Fridge was stinky too and toilet had no toiletpaper
Nothing!

Room and bathroom was smaller than expected, there’s no toilet in the bathroom and you need to walk really far away, sometimes the shower doesn’t work properly so you might have to wait a while before the water comes back on. However, the strategic location offsets it all. Absolutely loved the convenience to get around town. It suits me because I don’t stay in the room much. Just a bit annoyed to have to wait in the bathroom covered with soap for the water to come back on. Other than that, I would rent the place again cause it’s affordable and really convenient for everything else.

Super emplacement et chambre propre. Seul bemol, impossible de savoir à quel étage est l’appartement à notre arrivée, et la clé ne correspondait pas à notre chambre.
Sinon une belle surprise, je recommande.
Tryston is very kind and always respond quickly when ever we will needed
Good location

A really nice family and enjoyed my stay. Very accommodating if ever needed anything, also good location plenty of restaurants nearby as well as cinema and shopping centre. Would highly recommend and if required would stay there again.
Highly recommended... Posh locality, and very friendly and warm owners staying in the beautiful landed property. Close to ECP and the Eunos MRT ( 3 stops) with plenty of restaurants n shops close by
We had a lovely stay here. It was convenient to local public transport - 5 mins walk to bus and 20 mins walk to metro station. Would recommend this friendly place to stay :)

Fantastic stay. Absolutely loved the place. Quiet, Clean, Great Wifi, very friendly and welcoming host, I was very happy with my stay.  Astralyn was also great at immediately answering any questions that I had and was always quick to resolve something no matter what I asked. Very friendly and welcoming and always had a smile. If I could have stayed longer I would have. Definitely recommend staying here!

We really enjoyed our stay at Astralyn's place. She was a great host and there were no problems. Very accommodating and pleasant.
The room is out of the tourist area which we enjoyed as it gave us chance to see more when travelling into the city, which is not that far. The neighbourhood is also nice and quiet. There are some nice places for food close to the place.
We would definitely use this place again.
Thanks
The room is comfortable. Lovely family member she has. Unfortunately, the blanket provided very thin, can't really resist the cold.

Famille très accueillante et sympathique, même pour une arrivée sur les lieux à 2 heures du matin. Logement très propre avec tout le nécessaire à disposition. Cartier calme, bus à proximité, métro à 10/15 minutes à pieds.
Great host! Astralyn is Very friendly n helpful, even borrow us a hairdryer. They also provide us a bigger room one level below as my wife is pregnant. Highly recommend
Nice neighbourhood, room was neat. Family members were very helpful

A comfortable double room with ensuit bathroom, as shown in the pictures. Big and nice house in a residential area, close to bus stations, and 20-min walk to the MRT. The hosts were very friendly, always willing to help and know about your day. The add information should be updated as it shows the breakfast is included, but it is not. However, I recommend this house as it is a convenient and nice place to stay.
Convenient location, easy access to Public transport.

Absolutely great place to stay, very nice family. Astralyn is such a nice person, we chatted every day about many things, we promise we would stay in touch which we certainly will.  The room is exactly like in the pictures, it is very clean with a good air-con, in a beautiful villa in a peaceful residential neighborhood with many nice houses.  The bus stations (about 6-7 lines) are at 4 minutes away and from there in 20-30 minutes you are in the city center.
Great stay, friendly hosts and near to the airport! Would stay again

Ashtralyn was the best host I've ever had and you got all the helpful info from her to get around.  The location is closed to the public bus-MRT network and plenty of eateries around and some of them stay open until 2 am.  The room is spacious and the bathroom is within the room just like a hotel.  Will return for sure if the room is available next time!

La habitación estuvo muy bien, muy grande y limpia. La ubicación es un poco lejos del centro, pero se llega en 30 minutos en bus a todos lados. Pasan muchas líneas de bus cerca de la casa.
No te dan muchas indicaciones pero nos ayudaron en todo lo que solicitamos/preguntamos y pudimos dejar las valijas después del check out. Muchas gracias Astralyn.

The room is simple, but cozy, with private bathroom. The hosts are friendly and welcoming. Location is between downtown and airport, takes at most 30 minutes by bus+subway. Great place in a quiet and beautiful residential area.

second visit of here
really a warm place to stay !
Friendly host and everythings is fine. Recommended

Absolutelutely lovely room and very nice hosts! Family in the house was always smiling and ready to help us in any questions. Room felt really comfortable and it was quiet. House is at nice and peaceful road near to Joo Jiat area. I can warmly recommend staying here. We are definetly going back next time we stay in Singapore.
가족처럼 친하게 잘 대해 주셔서 참 좋았어요! 추천합니다.

Excellent value in Singapore - neat & clean accommodation with private attached bath. We found it fairly easy to commute to  the city centre & the airport. Communication with Astralyn was great & her family was very warm & accommodating, including our late 1.30am check in. Great base to explore Singapore, highly recommended for couples or solo travellers.
A very comfortable stay! Astralyn and her family was super friendly with nice personality! 5 star place for good price, worth it!
第一次订民宿就让我有家的感觉！Uncle一家人都很和睦，语言都不是问题，环境也很棒很安静，交通也挺方便的，周边也有328叻沙、海南鸡等等美食。很幸福hhhh

Astalyn and her father were very welcoming hosts, and easy to communicate with. They were accommodating to our late check in and made an effort to make sure we were happy and having fun in the city. The apartment was very spacious, quiet, and clean. An uber downtown was only ten minutes, and the same from the airport. Would recommend staying with them!
Beautiful home and beautiful people. A very relaxing stay with a kind family in a scenic residential area, close to shops, East Coast Park, very safe and peaceful.

Super kind,and so friendly!
it was so nice to stay in Singapore!
thank you so much!

We had an awesome stay! Astralyn's dad is really jovial & insightful and we had great time chatting with both Astralyn and her dad. Very well located and comfortable house. Will definitely stay again!

The stay is great, the room is clean. I have requested for new towels after 2 days and the host is nice to provide 2 sets each for me and my wife for the short stay. Only feedback is the housekeeping, clearing of the waste basket and change of towels every 2-3 days for hygiene purpose will be great.

Astralyn's place is easy to locate and is accessible by public transport its also near to east coast park and bus station. They are very accomodating and hospitable. The place is also very clean. This is really worth the money you paid for, we will book this place again.

It was a very nice stay. Everyone from the family was nice and helpful. The area is quiet and there are not bad bus connections to the city centre.
Off topic: if you cross the border from Johor Bahru by bus, you have to count + 2-3 hours because sometimes it is horrible jammed (have to get off from the bus walk through and get on again...)
Awesome place to stay, super clean and had all basic amenities required. Lovely people.

Astralyns place is well situated within a good food neighborhood as well as close to the airport. She was more than accommodating with a late check-in on account of our late flight at Changi. Will book with her again.
The place is clean and the room is nice. This was my first Airbnb experience and it turned out quite well.
周边公交站很多，乘坐公交很方便。房主一家人非常热情好客，给了我们很好的出游和生活建议，聊得很开心。尤其是在我丢失手机后，带给我很多安慰。第一次和妈妈一起来新加坡游玩，很开心的旅行。推荐入住！

Quick communication and very friendly. The room and accommodations were exactly as described. I had a private room that included a bed, washroom, shower, fan and AC.
The hosts were very lovely people and made me feel like I was a part of the family. Some plans on my trip did not go as expected and they were able to accommodate my changes hassle free.
Location is close enough to the beach you that you can walk (20 min) or run (10 min) there, taking a bus downtown takes about 30-40 minutes and lets you see a lot of the city. Bus stop was a 5 min walk from the home. Many local food shops and business' nearby.

Nice place, great host. Easily accessible by bus from the airport and to the city. The East Coast Park on the beach is only a 20 minutes' walk away, as is the train (MRT) station. Just across the corner there is a street with a few restaurants.
It's a really a good place to stay. As you know Singapore is very costly in terms of hotels also so better utilize the same facility at less price.

The place is exactly as the pictures represent. It's clean and comfortable, and I thought in a convenient location.  Maybe 15-20 minute walk to East Coast Park, easy access by bus to downtown areas, and easy access to airport as well.  The room is on the 3rd floor, and there is no elevator.  This wasn't a problem for me, and actually it provided a great breeze in the room with the windows open. I would definitely stay here again.

방사진만 봤을 땐 몰랐는데 집 전체가 엄청 크고 방에서 보는 동네 뷰가 되게 예뻐요ㅎㅎ 호스트님이 되게 호탕하고 유쾌하세요ㅋㅋ그리고 따님도 너무 친절하시고 배려심이 많아서 좋았어요. 방이 3?4?층에 있어서 캐리어를 나르기가 힘들었지만, 여자분들만 가시게 되더라도 호트스아저씨가 도와주실거니까 괜찮을거같아요ㅋㅋ 다만 너무 주택가에 있어서 버정이나 mrt를 찾기가 힘들었어요ㅜㅜ
我和爱人在这里住了5天，房主的家人都很nice，新加坡的交通非常方便，随便到哪里都很快，规划非常好 ，街区排水、线路铺设都很好。白天暴走，从菜场到大型商超，从旅游景点到政府公共服务机构，从祖屋下的小摊位到豪华街区，晚上和uncle蔡聊历史和人文，学到了很多知识。新加坡的规划以及这里人的优秀品质值得我们学习。深度旅游的首选居住地，点赞！
Een fijne kamer in een gigantisch  huis. Het is een fijne, rustige wijk. Genoeg eetgelegenheden  in de buurt. Iedereen in het huis was zo ontzettend vriendelijk! We raden deze plek zeker aan!

This is a great place to stay. I love the neighbourhood and the wide variety of food options. It is not in the downtown area and thus is quiet and pleasant. Yet it is v accessible to most places by public transport. I like the host a lot. They are very friendly and ready to help.
Sehr sauber. Schnelle Kommunikation. Unkomplizierter Gastgeber.
Hospitality is what first comes to mind. Private, quiet, clean and spacious room accommodation. Nearby restaurants/café at walking distance. I certainly felt safe with this gracious family!
This is a great place. The host was so accommodating to our late check in. It is close to everything, so convenient. We would recommend it highly.
Big and clean room, kind host. Recommended

The hosts are amazing! They are such a sweet family and offered us great information about Singapore. We felt well taken care of. The room is spacious and quiet. We just wish that the bed had been a bit more comfortable and the hot water in the shower was hit or miss. Overall, it was still a good place to stay for our trip to Singapore.
A very friendly and accomodating host. The room is just like in the pictures, comfortable and beautiful. Highly recommended stay.
Hospitable host and most of all I stayed in the room with private bathroom which is important to me.

It was my first experience with Airbnb and it overpass all my expectations. All family members are very receptive and the bedroom was very clean and organized. It is a great place to stay in singapore!

저희는 출장을 위해 7일을 머물렀습니다.
집의 모든것이 너무너무 좋았어서, 다음에도 꼭 다시 머물고 싶습니다 ^^

Singaporean hospitality at it's finest, a lovely neighborhood. A quite place, close to Singapore incredibly accessible and efficient bus system. similarly close to a beach front park equipped with soft sandy beaches and excellent dining at a hawker market. if you are looking for quite retreat from downtown it can be found here.

We very much appreciated the hospitality by everyone. We felt like home! The neighbourhood is really nice and allowed to discover local, non-touristic places! We would definitely come back! Great host!

I had a really splendid stay with Astralyn & family. The house is enormous and my room was located on the top floor, with private bathroom. The room was very clean and comfortable and the occasional ant in the bathroom did not bother me. The hosts were extremely hospitable and friendly. The neighbourhood is calm and has several food options nearby, and excellent bus connections to other parts of the city. 100% would stay here again.
Great host, they have good knowledge of how to get around. Remember the country is using 220v.

Pros: Liked the "hotel" touches of providing toothbrushes, towels, soap and hairdryer. Good value for the attached bathroom with hot water. While the bed is quite creaky and doesn't seem very stable, it was perfectly comfortable for one night.
Cons: Host was cordial over text but did not bother to extend any sympathy when I enquired to cancel the room privately because my dog was in critical condition and had to be put to sleep. While I did not expect to be successful at requesting for a refund, the lack of any empathy showed in one of my darkest hours was disappointing.
While we only used the room for one night and did not need to go in and out of the house, we were only given keys to our room and not to the main gate. This could be quite intrusive for some people or inconvenient if they intended to return late at night etc.
Links to rest of the city were not very convenient as the area is only serviced by a few buses. The closest MRT is pretty far away by bus.
Super easy going place. Thank you for letting us check in so early.
房东和他的家人热情好客，爱交往，很有亲和力。屋子是大别墅，很干净，绿树环绕。房屋距离公交车站很近，也就两三分钟。很喜欢和房主聊天，了解了不少新加坡的人文、习俗。总之，如果下次去新加坡，还会再去住。

My wife and I stayed at Astralyn’s place during a layover in Singapore. The location was convenient between the airport and central attractions of the city that you could access from the nearby bus stop. Astralyn was a great host providing local tips on things to do and the space was perfect with plenty of privacy on the third floor of the house. We would definitely recommend staying here!

Astralyn’s place was great for 2-3 people. We stayed for 2 nights and didn’t have issue/s with our accommodation. Checked-in earlier than previously communicated but no issues. Astralyn and her family were great hosts. YB was a delight! The room includes ammenities and fast internet connection which is very important for tourists like us. This is an easy recommendation. For those who need a room and is in a budget, Astralyn’s place is perfect. The neighborhood is great as well, lots of authentic Singaporean restaurants. Bus stop is like a 5 minute walk and about 30-40 minutes away from Marina Bay Sands, very accessible. 10 out of 10!
Located in a nice residential neighbourhood, this is an excellent place to stay away from the downtown and near the East coast park. I would highly recommend

Nice spacious room in a lovely house. Astralyn is a great host, very responsive and always ready to help. The house is a bit away from the centre but very close to public transport, which is reliable and easy to use. Also nearby there are some good places to grab some breakfast/dinner. Would recommend Astralyn place to everyone.

Astralyn's accommodation was a great surprise. The neighbourhood is awesome, very cozy and well connected with the center by bus and the house is just great. The atmosphere is nice and familiar, the room is big, clean, silent, with a private bathroom and air conditioning. The outdoor space is beautiful too. I felt at home and would repeat my stay at Astralyn's airbnb :-)

I booked Astralyn's room for 2 nights and everything was perfect. No problems with check-in and check-out, very good communication with the host, the room was spacious and clean, Internet connection was fast and power adapters were provided. Also the host left bottles of water for me! :) I definitely recommend!
房東人很好，第一天因為飛機時間，兩點左右才 check in，房東特地等我們 (有事先告知)。房間很棒，想得到的東西都有 (毛巾、吹風機等等）。交通的部分，如果會搭公車都沒問題～

Good and friendly host and host family. The house is in a quiet environment and the room is big and clean. Good value for money.
It will be wonderful had the mattress been better.
great hospitality

A great location for my wife and I to explore the city. The room is exactly as advertised and is very private. The house is located in a very nice area with tons of really good food options (local and international) within walking distance. There is a bus stop right around the corner, which you can use to quickly get to a couple nearby MRT stations.
The hosts were great – very friendly and inviting, but also allowed us our privacy. (Also, if you speak Mandarin be sure to let the mother of the house know. She only speaks Mandarin and will be ecstatic if you do too!)
it was very comfortable room! He and his family were so kind for us and their services were great.
The host was extremly friendly and their responses were very quick.Great locstion for those who like to have a quiet stay.

第一次来新加坡，来之前房东就把坐车的行程发给了我们，从机场坐地铁再倒一趟巴士大约半个小时就到他家了，家门口就是公交站，虽然是在郊区，但是因为新加坡本身比较迷你，到市中心坐车也就二十分钟，跟我们在北京的郊区完全两码事。房主人是新加坡华人，很热情，他们家盖的三层小洋楼，很干净整洁，屋里除了电视之外设施都齐全，有免费的无线网络，吃东西可以去他们家厨房，女主人也很热情，每次看到我们都请我们去喝水，房子很安静，住的很舒服。

A very accommodating and wonderful family who has been nothing but friendly and kind. A nice, quiet place that is away from the buzz of the city, but close enough great cafes and bakeries around. Main mode of transport would be buses that gets you to quite a lot of places. The host Astralyn has been very responsive and helpful in answering to any questions that we had. We would definitely visit again!

I booked the room on behalf of my friend David from Taiwan for one night before we travel to Bhutan.
David likes the places very much and feel like at home . He enjoy talking to Astralyn''s parent and commented all goods but unfortunately he only stayed on one night.
He will definitely come back if visiting Singapore again.

Fantastic place! The location is quite convenient as it's close to a lot of bus stations, and there's a ton of good food just a 5 minute walk away. The place itself is immaculately clean, and Astralyn's family is very friendly and welcoming. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a nice quiet place to stay that's convenient while being around 10-20 minutes away by bus from the hustle and bustle of the center of Singapore.

Comfortable room with private bathroom. The host is very responsive and accommodating. We had an unexpected last minute change in booking and she was able to help us work it out. The house is clean and the room as described.

The host family are very nice and friendly. Uncle and auntie played with my baby, chatted with us and gave us many advices in Singapore.
The house is a landed property which for me is a precious gem in such a rich city. I usually use grab and sometimes my Singaporean friends came to pick us. But I think public transport is quite convenient too.
I highly recommend this place to everyone especially for families with child. They would definitely love the yard with the little pond.
Thanks so much uncle and auntie for the gift to my son. Loved you all.

A cozy nice room in the local area of Singapore. Perfect to explore the wonderful food in Katong or the nearby East Coast park. The place offers a comfortable stay and complete privacy for any traveler. Strongly recommend this place!

Wonderful place to base yourselves for an exploration of Singapore. Room is basic but very neat and clean with a decent airconditioner (big plus in this climate!) and friendly hosts. The room is up a few flights of stairs which can be a challenge with a heavy suitcase or two. Location is excellent with a nice cafe selling excellent coffee just down the road, and a bunch of excellent restaurants and malls nearby. Highly recommended!

My daughter and I stayed this room for one day. We liked there because the host family was very kind, warm and charming. The room was simple and very clean. The room had one bed big enough for me and my 9 years old daughter, a big closet, a desk and a private bathroom. You can take a hot shower. I would like to stay there if I go to Singapore again. It’s far from MRT station but you can take a taxi and it only take 5 mins. You can also use a bus to get to MRT station. Bus may not be easy for tourists, but it is cheap and convenient.
Thank you Astralyn’s family for comfortable stay!

I really enjoyed the stay at Astralyn's place. It's located in an suburb, a nice neighbourhood you wouldn't get to see as a normal tourist. The room is air-conditioned, which is very comfortable as it can get very hot in Singapore. Last but not least: Astralyn and the whole family are very friendly people and i had some nice talks with them :)

Great stay at this place! Clean room and bathroom and comfortable bed. Good location near many restaurants and bars. Bus stups in immediate vicinity and subway station a bit further away. Will definitely recommend!
great area with everything you need around the neighbourhood, we felt really comfortable there, the whole family including indonesia were all super friendly and made us feel welcome
房东一家人很热情！发现有更好的出行路线即使我们走出院子也会骑着自行车赶上我们告知！真的是非常感谢！离开时热情的女主人亲手做了正宗台湾烤香肠……一根不过瘾每人两根……哈哈谢谢女主人我们吃的很开心！
房子很安静也很干净，没有蚊虫。这边环境很好，都是住宅，uncle家里也很漂亮。uncle一家人特别好，很热情。我和妈妈在这里住的很开心，aunty还请我们吃自己烤的香肠。以后有机会还会来住～
We had a wonderful visit. Astralyn was incredibly kind and welcoming. We had a very short visit but an excellent time. Thanks so much for welcoming us into your home!
Ashlyns place is located in a nice and quiet neighbourhood. The room has all you need and is clean. It's easy to get to from the Airport and buses are nearby. The family is very nice and welcoming.

YB and Ashlyn were exceptional hosts and offered us great advice on where to eat and the local transport. They are extremely friendly and warm and offered us delicious local fruits to eat. My daughter who will be studying on an exchange program at NUS stayed 2 extra days while I had to leave and they took great care of her offering treats for breakfast and warm caring hospitality. I would definitely recommend this listing as a fun and light hearted way to learn about this diverse culture. As a westerner, where it's not common, I still appreciate the local customs of removing your shoes upon entering the house. It keeps the floors and stairs so much more cleaner and in this house you are kindly asked to respect that. Thank you so much for being wonderful hosts and new friends. We hope to see you on our next visit to Singapore!
The location was perfect for us having just got off the plane. The family is really nice and happy to give advice about the local area. Would definitely stay again
It was great to stay at this place! The host is super friendly and helpful. The room is very nice and clean , location is good. We were very satisfied and would highly recommend this room!

Thank you for a really nice stay and your warm welcome. We really enjoyed our days in Singapore. The area is nice with good dining options and only 20 min by bus to the city center. Definitely recommendable.
no
Stanza molto pulita e host cordiale. Consigliatissimo!

Tres accueillants
Parfait pour un transit
Propre
sweet
굉장히 청결하고 따로 화장실도 쓸수있고 에어컨도 시원하고 호스트도 매우 친절합니다. 주변에 식당도 많아서 아침 해결하는데에도 문제 없었어요! 아주 좋았습니다^^
房东人很好很热情，离东海岸走过去大约20分钟，晚上散步很合适。
great stay for East of Singapore
房间在三层别墅顶层，周围安静，地铁站会远一些，建议公交出行，公交站就在楼下不远，有直达地铁站的公交车。房间干净明亮。华人夫妇房东好客热情，还给我们烤了香肠吃，短短几天住的很舒适。
