위치도 좋고 전망도 좋습니ㆍ.
公寓离Bugis地铁站很近，可以算是江景房了，对面是体育场，距离鱼尾狮公园、克拉码头可步行，距离圣淘沙、乌节路都很方便，公寓对面那条路上的虾面房东推荐，超好吃，还有亚坤，房东还提供了交通卡，还来地铁站接我们，非常nice
Angelina's place is very clean. It has everything you would need. She replies very fast as well. and the view is amazing! Would definitely book a staycation at her place again :)

Superb!!!
Spacious, sparkling clean, great hospitality from Angelina, lots of amenities, what else?
She even provide baby chair for my little boy. Very thoughtfull of her.
Angelina is very helpful. She provide us with great service, advice us the best route to our destination, provide EZ link card to use, coffee, tea, sugar, plug converter, cooking oil, cooking utensil, even some cereals for my little boy having breakfast!!
Spacious apartment, strategic location, only 5 minutes away to nearest bus station or MRT station. Convenient store and food stall nearby. We couldn't ask more
Thank you for being great host and definitely will come back to your place when we visit Singapore again!
Best Airbnb so far... great hospitality from host and the service is amazing
房东人超好，事先联系好说要放行李过来，房东都准备来地铁站接我们了，哪知道小伙伴们购物耽误了，结果让房东事先离开了，房东走之前还拍了照片告诉了我们怎样去的路线，还提前把空调开好了，位置很好很方便，对面有我们很喜欢的亚坤，有机会去新加坡的话会再次入住

I, in the 40s, and my teenager son stayed for 4 days. we're from Germany, so I rate with German "eyes". Angelina is a perfekt host and perfectly organized.
The livingroom and the kitchen have only concrete which is coated as floor. The bedroom has damaged glued parquet, with PAC glue I assume.
The kitchen is quite good as well as the bathroom. The furniture in the Rest of the flat is really basic. Livingroom and bedroom got separate airconditions. The Internetconnection is almost perfect and enough for WA-Videocalls and streaming Netflix in FullHD. The location is perfect for sightseeing trips. Take Metrostation "Bugis". The view is amazing, but would be better with clean windows.
Singapur is the Most expensive town in the world, compared to this, this flat is affordable.
A hint at the end go to the Suntech Mall for meals. Best variations of international kitchens ever and one of the best public Wi-Fi in the town.
Orchard Road is over rated!
Amazing location.  We were able to walk to most of the places we want to visit.  Super clean place with a great view.  Perfect for our trip.

Overall a good central location, with a good view towards the Kallang River. Also, Angelina was a great host, friendly and approachable. The only comment I have is that the apartment was dusty and some parts of the house actually feels cluttered.
Very hospitable host, who offered detailed room orientation and MRT cards. Spacious and convenient location. Fabulous Kallang River view with plenty of plantation outside and inside the apartment.

Angelina is a great host who provided valuable tips on where to eat and what to see in Singapore as well as waiting for us to arrive after midnight so that we could check in. Angelina's apartment is spacious with great views and in a fantastic location close to MRT stations and eating places.

This house was so good in terms of position and clean.
There were enough towers provided so guests don't need to carry them at all.
And, this house is so near from MRT stations, yellow and blue lines.
So, it's easy to find.
The best thing of this house is the scenery through the windows.
Could see river and wonderful night scene.
And, Angelina is so nice host.
We could communicate so well. She had always replied to my question ASAP.
There was no problem in communicating.
I'd like to recommend this house at the most.

アンジェリーナは素晴らしく、とても親切にしてくれた。立地もよく、空港や観光のアクセスに便利だった。宿の周辺も見所があり、歩いて10分以内にブギスにも行けた。
室内はおしゃれで綺麗、眺めも良く快適に過ごせた。子連れだったので洗濯機とケトルは特にありがたかった。チェックアウト後に荷物を預かってくれ、とても助かった。またシンガポールに行く時はリピートしたい。

The view is not the only thing 5 star about this apartment. The location. The clean, large, quiet condo. And Angelina, who is quick to respond and take care of her guests. All way above good. I look foward to  staying here on my next visit to beautiful Singpore.
Angelina小姐是位超好的房東，她的房子很乾淨，大樓很安全，視野超棒，設備一應俱全，她提供的資訊正確清楚，對房客有耐心且照顧有加，精通中英文，非常能幹，總是立即回應，地點近公車站與兩個捷運站，樓下有便利超商，她值得最高的評價。

整个入住体验和预期的一样好。公寓位置理想，Beach Road是新加坡比较核心成熟但又不那么嘈杂的地段。公寓大楼靠近地铁蓝线Bugis站和黄线Nicoll Highway站，地铁两站到金沙，五站到牛车水，坐公交去滨海湾和鱼尾狮也非常近。如果会使用手机地图，在新加坡公交出行比地铁更廉价和便利。公寓周边生活机能佳，楼下有7-11，离亚坤吐司Beach Road店步行不到五分钟，马路对面就是哈芝巷和阿拉伯街的各种酒吧餐厅，喜欢夜生活的人住这儿也不错。公寓大楼有24小时安保以策安全。房内设施齐备，空调制冷效果好，客厅和卧室窗户都能看见国家体育场和海景。入住前后与Angelina的沟通也非常顺畅，很满意。
개미가 많아요 ㅠㅠ

Angelina is amazing host. She offered quick responses to all sorts of questions we had, whether related to the accommodation or not, she was there to welcome us when we checked in and assisted with our suitcases upon check out.
Her place is super cosy and sparkling clean with everything we needed and more! It is also well located at the centre of the city within walking distance to Bugis.
I would stay at her place again without any hesitation!
my family enjoyed the great hospitality. Thank you very much

Excellent place in a great location. Very tidy! Angelina was a great host and gave us several tips on where to go and how to get things done. She let us use her EZlink MRT passes as well. The place was air conditioned. There was tea and coffee available. Overall, thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Would recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay at Angelina's place. The location is very convenient, the apartment is spacious & clean and has all amenities we need including for our 2year old daughter. There is also a lot of material to read about Singapore. We really appreciated that Angelina could meet us at the metro station and allowed us to store our luggage as we had a very late flight. We can strongly recommend staying here!

Angelinas place was wonderful! She had a last minute overseas trip so couldn’t meet to check in. However, left detailed instructions for self checkin & everything went very smoothly.
It’s very spacious & clean inside. I loved that there was already water in the fridge for us. And the view was a plus!
The location is great. My cousin and I (two women) felt very safe at all times. It’s a street away from Arab street, less than 10 minutes walking from Bugis Junction & MRT, and less than five minutes walking to the orange line MRT. We didn’t have any issues with Taxi/Grab.
Angelina was very responsive (usually within a few minutes) when we had inquiries.
I would definitely book Angelina’s apartment again for my next visit in Singapore.

너무 친절하시고 이지링크카드 등 세심하게 잘 준비해주셔서 편하게 잘 있다 왔습니다
다음에도 싱가폴오면 또 이용하고 싶을정도로 좋았습니다 ^^
It was our second stay in the two weeks of our holidays. We were very happy again :)

Angelina is a great host with super fast and consice communication. She is very helpful and made our stay in Singapore a very pleasant experience.
Her apartment is very close to downtown and to multiple metro lines, so it is the perfect place for those who wish to stay somewhere central and spacious while touristing about.
The great view from the apartment and easily recognizable and accessible building is also a plus.
Angelina was an excellent host, very helpful. And apartment was perfect for us, great access to MRT, restaurant and shops. Very impressed with the sightseeing in Singapore.

Very conveniently situated, close to restaurant strip and not too far from underground station. The furnishing is very basic, and only concrete flooring in main area, but otherwise comfortable and convenient.

The unit is spacious, airy and bright with natural light (not to mention the nice view from the windows,  day and night) and Angelina is one of the best hosts we have ever had. She provided detailed and comprehensive info before arrival and personally show us around upon arrival at her place. We found everything that we needed for our stay in the unit, and there are 2 convenience shops downstairs. Bus stop is just in front of the building, while 2 MRT stations are within short walking distance. In short, highly recommended!

房东angelina很热心，航班晚点到凌晨2点，她也是在公寓楼下等我们。房间位于大楼的26层，客厅和卧室窗户全都可以看到很美的风景，而且6:58am可以准时观看新加坡日出。很美。只是新加坡天气炎热，在厨房台面上如果有放甜食，早上会发现厨房台面有些蚂蚁在搬运食物，阿哈哈哈，很原生态哦........在入住期间有路程疑问，房东都会很细心给予建议。对面就是哈芝巷和阿拉伯街，推荐附近的Landmark自助餐，网络预定可以20%折扣。总之很推荐.谢谢.
All good and helpful host.

We had a lovely time at Angelina s flat. She was a good host and promptly answered all our queries. The place is clean and all things needed to make our stay comfortable. It is an excellent location with great little places to eat in little India and Haaji Lane. The best bit of the apartment is the absolutely fantastic view from the window of Singapore. We would definitely recommend this place.

Angelina's is the perfect place in Singapore. Beautiful view, clean, spacious, and a fantastic location.  Angelina was helpful, responsive, and accommodated our needs even when we needed to leave our bags after check out. You must stay at Angelina's if you're coming to Singapore!

Angelina was a great host, well organised and attentive to details that made our stay more comfortable. The apartment was modern, clean, quiet with great views and had everything a traveller would need. It was also very conveniently located and within minutes from MRT and eateries. Would definitely book with Angelina again if we come back to Singapore.
Very good host and place

Angelina was quick on responding to my inquiries. The Google Doc file she sent upon booking was very helpful.
She was so kind to meet us at MRT station and walked us to the apartment in a short cut as opposed to the much longer Google walking route we were originally going to take.
The apartment was in a great location, easy access to public transportation and many eateries. It’s large and clean with a fantastic view.
Angelina is very nice and helpful. She gave a lot of suggestions for sight seeing. The apartment is very clean and spacious, and is a very convenient location.

我們在晚上九點多從樟宜機場搭Grab 抵達Angelina的公寓（15分鐘），Angelina已在門口等我們，接著，很親切地帶領我們到26樓，並說明屋內設備的使用方式，也熱心地解答我們附近能用餐的地方（散步10分鐘可到24小時營業的Zam Zam、走出去到對街便是哈芝街，晚上ㄧ兩條巷弄變身為酒吧區，我們也點了飲品坐著聽現場演唱）。
公寓內外都很乾淨，廚房、餐桌、客廳是開放式無隔間的格局，必要簡單的擺設，空間感很舒服，臥室也大，從客廳跟臥室看出去的景色，跟照片一模一樣，很漂亮！下次再訪新加坡時若也帶上兩個小孩，也覺得是個合適的入住選擇。
只是其中一晚我們一直無法成功開啟冷氣，隔天早上才發現原來是跳電，重新reset後便無礙，提醒住入房客若有遇到此狀況可重啟總電源。
此外，進門後有一個全身鏡，我個人覺得梳妝打扮很實用呢！
걔믜의써요 거싈쫔 예엌헌 고장났는뎨 못고칀다고햬서 방예엌헌 하날호 버툐써요 더워줔는줄 아라써요 한구긘드릐 만희 찾는숰소가타요 위츼가 먜우 조흔고또 아늰것가타요

Огромная квартира со всеми удобствами. Потрясающий вид из окон. В квартире есть все для длительного проживания.  В шаговой доступности от двух огромных торговых центров с отличными супермаркетами Suntec City и Bugis.  В районе Bugis расположены ряды с недорогой одеждой и сувенирами. В трех автобусных остановках отель Marina Bay Sand, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore Flyer и  Merlion Park. Настоятельно рекомендую!
위치가 정말 베스트 ! 숙소는 개미가 쪼꼼 있었어요 !

Angelina is a fabulous host and great to communicate with. She always responded very quickly as I booked on behalf of my parents who have never done a big OE or used Air Bnb before.  So I was a little worried about how they were getting on (but she put my mind at rest and she really went the extra mile for my parents. She met them to check in and settled them in nicely. The apartment had a fab view and was very nice and the photos don’t do the apartment justice. She gave me up to date information on how they were getting on during their stay and even helped with the shuttle when they were checking out.  I would highly recommend Angelina and her apartment and when I next come to Singapore I am going to stay with at her apartment.
Angelina is a thoughtful, friendly host! Her place is close to amenities, very clean with a super wonderful view and well thought out for the comfort of her guests.

Angelina's 1 bedroom apartment is big with a fantastic view of Marina Bay, being located on the 26th floor. It is just a 10-minute walk to Suntec City, and is just next to Pan Pacific Serviced Suites. The apartment is very quiet. We did not even hear or see any neighbors. It is 5 minutes to the Bugis train station and grocery stores. A seven-eleven is at the same building ground floor, as well as other shops including laundry. Angelina is very easy to contact, met us for check-in and allowed us to stay beyond check-out time after we requested it.  Would stay in her apartment again and recommend it to friends.
Super Unterkunft. Angelina ist eine top Gastgeberin.

Angelina's place is in a high rise tower with very nice views and easy access to two different MRT lines. The apartment is spacious and clean, with good AC and a washing machine to do your laundry. You can walk 30 minutes to the tourist areas if you prefer to not go underground. There are lots of shops and small restaurants nearby. I would definitely stay there again if I returned to Singapore.

Angelina’s apartment is perfectly located within easy walking distance of the MRT & many local restaurants.  The apartment is well furnished, very clean and had everything we needed to enjoy our stay in Singapore.  Angelina is a great host & very responsive to any questions we had .. thank you

Angelina is a star!! She helped us a lot with all directions and also did a lot of exceptions when we were tired after airplane. She took our baggages which helped us a lot. Apartment was incredible and clean also the view was amazing. I would definitely recommend this place - the location is great , close to everything.
Thank you!!! We will be back.
We had an excellent stay!
離CC5捷運站超近，去CC3站新達城shopping 或C號出口右轉去搭鴨子船都很方便。房東熱情又熱心，很開心能夠訂到風景美麗的房源。星期六遇到國慶預演，在家看坦克車隊和軍機飛過，超特別的經驗。推薦給大家喲^^

Angelina provides a very useful info pack prior to your arrival. Check in and check out very smooth. The location is excellent and central, with easy access to food and walking distance to the subway station. Many thoughtful touches in the apartment, well equipped with wifi, adaptors, washing machine, etc
房东中文流利，沟通无障碍，我们一家人玩的很开心，房间整洁，窗外景色特别漂亮，位置也挺好

We stayed at Angelina’s home for three nights while exploring Singapore and enjoyed a comfortable and pleasant stay. It was nice to return to a rain shower, air conditioning, and cold water after long days in the heat and humidity. The view from her home was stunning and we appreciated the black out curtains in the bedroom.
Angelina tracked our flight to Singapore and gave clear directions to her home. She met us to check us in, explained her home to us, and shared local tips with us. She was great with fast communication from the time we booked as well. We would highly recommend Angelina’s home as well as the free walking tours with Indie Singapore, Swee Choon Tim Sum, and Tian Tian’s chicken rice at Maxwell Food Centre.

Angelina's apartment is in a really excellent location, not only for all the nice shopping, food and amenities within walking distance, but also the centralised location to easily reach (within a few subway stops) other places of interests. Angelina perfectly anticipates the needs of her guests, and provides proactive, helpful information. She is very welcoming and tries her best to accommodate our needs in terms of check-in, luggage storage, etc. The apartment itself is clean and has all the necessary amenities (hi-speed wifi!), including some thoughtful touches like adaptors and luggage weighing scale.
Good location, nice view

直前の予約で、すごく良さそうな場所を見つけてすぐに予約。前泊ホテルだったので、「チェックインまで時間があるから先に荷物置いていいよ」とのこと。ご対応ありがとうございます！
コンドは非常にアクセスもよく、清潔感のある場所。
内部は少し古いのですが、掃除や匂い対策も行き届いており、とても快適に過ごせました。
またよろしくお願いします！
Great stay and very warm host.

Angelina is a fantastic host.  She was great keeping open communication, clear instructions how to get to her place and tips to get around.  Angelina was very kind to meet us on day of arrival.  She helped us with our luggages, and showed us around her home.  The apartment has great space with an amazing view.  it was fantastic waking up to the view of the harbor.  Her home is Very spacious for my kids to spread out.  We love the location, easy to access to public transportations.  Across from the apartment is indeed a very hipster hangout place for the younger crowd.  We recommend Angelina’s home to those wanting to visit Singapore for a fraction of cost.  Angelina, thank you for hosting us.  My son loves that dim sum place you recommended. Thanks again.  We will reach out to you again when we go back to Singapore. Take care.

Wonderful location, great host. Very responsive, accommodative and friendly.
The place was slightly smaller than I had imagined, but the location more than makes up for it.

This apartment is a great find in Singapore.  It is large (particularly by Singapore hotel standards) and very well located.  Everything about the apartment was as described.  The apartment is very secure and very quiet.  The air-conditioning in the bedroom and the lounge/kitchen area works well.  The view is great as well.  There are many good shops and restaurants close by (easy walk) including in Duo Centre , Suntec Centre and Arab Street .  Communication with Angelina was great and she kept us fully informed before our trip and met us when we arrived.  I would certainly recommend Angelina's place.

Angelina's place is what Airbnb is all about. Right from our first contact with her, Angelina gave us loads of information about her accommodation and getting around Singapore which was priceless. She even came out to meet us outside her apartment  telling us what she would be wearing - a minor detail but so incredibly helpful in a place with so many people. The apartment was clean, spacious with great aircondioning- essential in Singapore.  The location couldn't have been better , right in the middle of .Kam Pong Glam, with restaurants and local food courts very close. We highly recommend trying The Golden Mile Foodcourt and Angelina's food recommendations were spot on. Being so close to everything gave our family of four a perfect opportunity to explore the neighborhood early morning when the streets weren't so busy and it wasn't so hot. And the view from Angelina's place is fantastic! If you are a family looking at staying in Singapore choose this place!
Angelina will provide a library of tourist information as well as a great place to stay.
친절하고 하나하나 설명을 잘해줬어요! 경치는 생각보다 훨씬 좋았어요! 마리나베이샌즈가 안보이고 싱가포르 플라이어가 한끗차이로 안보이는게 아쉬웠지만 경치좋고 깔끔해서 좋았습니다!

We had a very pleasant stay at Angelinas’. The place is clean and the view was amazing. She was nice to accommodate our flight schedule saved us a lot of time and trouble. We recommend this place. Thank you Angelina!
房东非常亲切热情，来地铁口接我们，还对我们的行程提供了很多信息和建议。房子非常适合一家三口入住，地理位置真的很棒，对面就是哈芝巷和阿拉伯街，再走两天马路就是武吉士火锅一条街，地铁有蓝线和绿线，出行很方便。总体入住感受很好，设备齐全

This is a beautiful, stylish apartment with fabulous views and lots of helpful things for visitors, like guidebooks and umbrellas to borrow.  Best of all is the host, Angelina, who makes you feel so welcome and is so helpful.

Angelina is wonderful at communicating and was willing to help out when we had problems with lost luggage. Both of these things were appreciated BUT as a discerning consumer of Airbnb, and a fairly fussy person I have to say the apartment appears unloved. The standard of cleanliness, quality of finishings and towels are not great.
Bed was comfortable if you like a firm mattress.
View was wonderful.
위치와 뷰가 매우 좋았어요. 개미는 약간 있긴 하지만 큰 문제는 안됐습니다.
房东是个姐姐～人超级好的，交通便利，房间很干净整洁，只是时间匆忙，下次来一定还来～

We spent 4 nights at Angelina's place. Communication was excellent prior to arriving and Angelina met us at the apartment personally to check us in and show us around.
The striking feature is that fantastic view from both lounge and bedroom. Waking up to that was brilliant. It's situated in Kampong Glam, an ethnic neighbourhood with plenty of restaurants and bars. Opposite is Haji lane , a narrow street full of life and plenty of choices for eating & drinking.
It's also close to attractions like the Raffles Hotel and, for further places, we used the MTR at Nicoll Highway to get around. 2 stops to Bayfront and the Marina Bay Hotel & Gardens By The Bay.
The apartment is spacious, well-equipped and with good air conditioning. Our only problem was that the oven did not work but that did not detract from what was, overall, a great stay. We did not want to leave; always a mark of how much we enjoyed in a place.
Would definitely stay here again if we return to Singapore. Thanks, Angelina.
Spacious, clean with good view. Angelina is very kind. She allowed us to check in early n have late check out. Very friendly n thoughtful host.
Angelina is an amazing and thoughtful host! The unit is very spacious and we had a great time! Very conveniently located.

We had a great stay at Angelinas place.  She met us on time and went over amenities, and local things to do.  Her place had everything we needed and was centrally located so we could walk to a lot of places!   Great stay, great hostess!!!

The best location I could ever choose. Apartment is very comfortable, ideal for individualists, extremely well equipped (iron, shampoo, conditioner, big mirror, umbrellas etc...), has a spectacular view. Angelina is a fantastic host, very friendly and thoughtful as well. I would definately stay there again!
Amazing location! Angelina took care to make sure that I have all the information about every part of my journey starting from the airport to the flat, stay and return back. Fantastic stay and host!

Angelina was incredibly hospitable. The location of her home was perfect both for tourist destinations and local cultural emerson. We stayed with a 2 year old, and she provided all the amenities we needed and more. Very safe location.

Excellent location close to two metro stations, walkable distance to many bars and restaurants. Easy access, but no self check-in option. We were delayed at the airport, so had to get in touch a few times to reset our meeting time with Angelina. She met us at the metro station and gave us a tour of the apartment at check in. We did have a problem with a foul odor in the bathroom during our stay, due to another apartment’s drain problem. Angelina responded promptly regarding this.

Angelina is a nice person where I changed my arrival time which caused her inconvenience and she complained nothing.
She explained in detail about Singapore that she is so knowledgeable about food, places and other entertainments.
The place is spacious, which gave me a feeling of coming home instead of staying a hotel. The security is quite good there and it’s good and convenient to stay there

This place is perfectly positioned to get everywhere easily! Walk to Kampong Glam for hipster and ethnic, only a couple of stops from Chinatown, Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa and more.
Angelina is the best host we have ever had: met us at the MRT station and guided us to the apartment, then gave us some great recommendations for food, activities and more.
We will definitely stay here again!!!

Logement très bien situé, parfait pour des jeunes. On a 60 ans....On entend  bien la route la nuit. Il manque quelques équipements de charme pour des personnes plus agées comme nous. Pas de lampe de chevet, une seule table de nuit, éclairage blanc et agressif  comme à l'hopital. Télévision avec 2 télécommandes et pas de chaines internationales. A part cela Angelina est très acceuillante.
Very good location!

Had to stay at Angelina's place for 1 night since our flight was rescheduled. Wish we could have stayed for longer. Angelina is a great host, she contacted us the day before we checked in and asked how we were getting to her place. Came to Singapore for Day6's concert over the weekend and was looking for a place within walking distance from the MRT. Nearest MRT station would be Farrer Park but if you're willing to walk a bit further, you can also take the MRT at Lavender station. Both of these MRT stations are also short rides to popular tourist places like Orchard and Bugis.
Location wise, this place is also great as the nearest mall is City Square mall (where Farrer Park MRT is). There are lots of cool cafes around the area like Tiramisu Hero and The Refinery, all within walking distance. If you're after local food, there's the Berseh Food Court, Sungei Road Laksa, and Scissors Cut Curry Rice (I haven't tried everything I mentioned here but that means there're more reasons to come back)
As for the rooms, or capsules, in this case, I really like the privacy it offers. You won't be able to do much in them as it is small, but there's plenty of space to sleep and roll around. It also comes with a table built in the wall for whatever you need a table for and two power outlets. They also have lockable cupboards at the bottom of the capsules which are really spacious and could fit a small suitcase. It's perfectly ideal if you just need a place to sleep in while you're out finding things to see and do.
In general, it's pretty clean. I like the shelf for shoes as they come with those Ikea casings so it looks neat. There's plenty of shared toilets and shower cubicles at each floor. Rooms can get cold during the night so maybe bring along a sarong or wear socks in bed. You'll also be in close proximity with other people as the rooms outside the capsules are small so if you're bothered by snoring, best you have earplugs.

Location : About 5 min walk from Farrer Park MRT. This is great once you're actually there,but it takes two changes on MRT lines to get there from Changi airport. Check in, staff : seamless, staff are very friendly and helpful.Available at all hours except 3-7 am.
Facilities : Free wifi, a computer you can use in the lobby,a cafe that serves the free breakfast up to 9:30 am ( didn't try it, can't comment ) and ad hoc requests off their menu. Looks adequate. They also sell water and other beverages from fridges near the lobby. There's tons of stores nearby,some 24x7, like the repulsive Mustafa centre if you want other options. They have a printer/ scanner for tickets etc if you need I guess.
The capsules are about six to a room, stacked two high. Privacy curtain,power points and a fold out tray type thing for laptops or whatever. Ladders to,climb the upper deck. I found the ladder rungs painful on bare feet,a be a bit of a drag to keep going up,consider asking for a lower level one if you have issues with climbing stuff.
There are lockers with two doors below the lower bunks, lockable. About the size of a 29" suitcase. Can't really manoeuvre your luggage into it,so leave your bags in their luggage room near lobby and move essentials and valuables into the locker for easy access.
If you're taller than 6' these single capsules are not for you. The doubles look bigger, but as someone says, pictures are fancier than the reality.
Toilets / Bath : toilets are quite clean, showers slightly less so,but no deal breaker. The common sinks and washing machine/ dryer area is small, and has no real changing room as such. Manageable but not ideal. There is no space inside the room with the bunks to do anything.
All said and done, this is a very clean,low budget,centrally located option. It's not a hotel or a traditional Airbnb shared room so manage your expectations accordingly.

Me and my wife were on the way to home (Sri Lanka) after completing a 3-year working contract in Fiji. We thought of staying 4 nights in Singapore and found out this place in Airbnb which is damn worth the value by looking at the photos. We were very tired after a 10 hours’ direct flight from Fiji Islands and this place was astonishingly helped us to relief our stress and tiresome. It is located in the middle of the city and just 15-20 minutes away from the airport (SGD 18 by Taxi). Since it is in the 16th floor the outside view is amazing. It was really modern and all the furniture, cooking utensils, electronic appliances were very new. When I asked from the host he told me he has started to rent the place for guests in January 2017 which should be the obvious reason. Host was so hospitable and thoughtful. The house has a digital lock which is a key-less system. I told the host before I arrived that this is something new to me, so he himself has turned up at the apartment when we reached there thinking we will face troubles in getting into the apartment for the first time. Though the apartment is shared between 2 rooms, luckily there was a single working lady within the period of our stay, who was rarely at home. So, for us it was a bonus, we felt like the whole apartment is ours. On top of that I have done an exam in the last day of my stay, the study room was really helpful for me which has facilities such as printing. Before I arrived, I have informed the host that I'm planning to do an exam and asked about the study table. (I was thinking that I might get disturbed while using the shared study room). The host has arranged a small study table+chair and a study lamp within the room for me, just before the day I arrived. However, I never got a chance of using that since I was always using the study room. My wife's main reason to come to Singapore is shopping in Mustafa, rather than visiting the attractions. And that is also in walking distance to the Apartment, just straight walk, no turnings at all. And one more thing that I must mention, in the last day of our stay I wanted to extend the stay till 6 PM since our flight to Sri Lanka was scheduled at 11 PM. (My initial plan was to stay at one of my friend's place after check-out at 11 AM, however he was busy with an emergency). Then I checked the availability in Airbnb and sent a message asking for an extension by another half day with a fee. Within seconds SK replied that he will extend with no cost which was a real surprise to me. Basically, both host and the apartment has exceeded my expectations and we managed to cover lot...

There is a small gym not so well equipped but basic ..Since it was a long stay, nic was organized enough to provide us with clean bed sheets, towels on request. Overall me and my husband had a great stay. It just felt like home :) if you are looking for a place which is comfortable with a great location and spacious. This is it and I can vouch for it!

Thank you Nic for the stay and let's catch up soon. Cheers- Vish & Shweta
As good as advertised if not better; I had a lovely stay at Nicolas apartment. He was moreover extremely kind and helpful.

Great

Great host, great place. It was clean and he was responsive. I would stay here again.
Great, Very comfortable place. So it's near to my office and also good food in china town. ! Surely I will revisit this place again.
Close to mrt station and comfortable staying..

Keave is one of the few regular hosts i like to book accommodations in singapore due to his large portfolio of private rooms and availability at great budget prices.

Listing as describe, no issues as always for my visiting friend.

Listing and pictures are accurate, nothing to pick on. No frills. Perfect location for a perfect Chinatown stay. :)

Great for tourist, locals, expats, everyone has a reason to be here.
在市区，交通方便，地铁站及餐厅在楼下。电梯到30层，需要走一楼。
Mike was very helpfull host. The apartment was quite clean and because we need to go to the farrer park hospital, this place its ok enough to get there. Not far but not too close.

Mike’s place is quite well located and easy to reach. Communication was fast and to the point. The Apt is well equipped and the Air Cond works fine. Easy access from the garage entrance. Overall a great place to stay.
What a wonderful place; luxurious, stylish and a welcome antidote to the usual identikit hotel. The hosts are charming and the location convenient. There can't be a better spot to stay in Singapore.

A great place, I would argue the photos probably don't do it justice. We really enjoyed our stay here and if you are doing a long term stay (we stayed for 1 month) this is excellent value for money. Staff at the restaurant downstairs were very friendly and helpful if we had any issues. The place is furnished very unusually and has a lot of style - I would say this is a great way to experience a more authentic stay in Singapore than in a new condo or hotel!
On the minus side you do need to be aware it's above a pub/bar so except some noise late at night on Fridays/Saturdays. The wifi is very bad most of the time - the host could probably consider putting some extenders/an additional access point upstairs as for most of our stay it was unusable and we relied on mobile data. The outdoor bathroom looks lovely and is a great spot with the terrace and semi-outdoor bath, however we didn't use it so much because it's right by the kitchen extractor fans so often has a pretty strong oil/food smell. Appreciate there is nothing they can do about this though!
Overall I'd be very happy to stay here again.
Great!

The condo was very spacious and private. There were plenty of places to eat very close by. We primarily used Grab Taxis, but there was a bus stop just outside. The bar is downstairs, but from the main bedroom I did not hear anything at night. The bed was SO comfortable. I would definitely consider staying here again.

Fantastic little place.  The area is just outside the touristic centre of town, but easily accessible by bus or taxi.  There are loads of little bars and restaurants within walking distance in case you fancy a quiet night.
Host was quick to respond and very helpful with my queries.

The 3 of us stayed here for a whole month (couple and young kid). Frankly, we booked it because the price was great and I always wanted to live just above a pub. The place has lots of character, and you can't even compare this to staying in a boring hotel.
There's one bathroom indoors and another one on the terrace outdoors. And yes, it's fun to just walk down the stairs and be in a pub and restaurant that serves delicious food and drinks.
The place is per description.  Nice deco, spacious and good location.  Surrounded by many eateries.  Friendly and responsive host.

The location is excellent - right in the heart of Katong food street - you will be spoilt for choice. The breakfast at RCG itself is fantastic and not to be missed.
Fantastic hospitality by Richard & Victor, check in process smooth, place really clean and chic and tastefully designed. 15-20mins by taxi from the airport and most amenities within walking distance.
Highly recommend Richard’s place to anyone looking for a unique stay in a fantastic location.

Richards Airbnb is very cool! The bed is super comfortable and the bathroom is amazing. All in all I would recommend this place and would stay again (but I would bring earplugs).

Beautiful home. Loved the decor 😍 Location was perfect for exploring Katong and the glorious food the area is well-known for. Was grateful for the help with the bags up the stairs to the property :) If wifi connectivity was better, the stay would have been perfect!

This is an excellent building and cozy loft like apt.  This is the Oasis hotel building which is in a fantastic location and includes a nice pool lounge floor.  The apt is new and nicely maintained. The owner is very nice and immediately accommodated some requests to go with a first time listing.

Top marks - the apartment was perfect and luxurious, filled with everything you could possibly need for a stay. Qing was very communicative, helpful and professional. Highly recommended!

My wife (Ida) and I stayed in Qing's apartment for six days. The apartment was exactly as described in the listing. It was very clean and there were fresh towels and bed sheets waiting for us. The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed for from cooking utensils to WiFi to a washer/dryer.

Additionally, the apartment is in a great location. Everything is easily within walking distance – shops, restaurants, hawker food courts, 24 hour supermarket, metro station, etc. I would definitely stay at Qing's place again.

Ida's comments:
This is a really great, super clean apartment. It was immaculate when we arrived, and is conveniently located next to the Tanjong Pagar metro station. It is also within walking distance of tons of restaurants, a large market, Singaporean food court, Chinatown, and a couple of supermarkets.

Qing is a super gracious and accommodating host. She greeted us on our arrival, made sure we were able to get our wifi set up, and gave us a few tips about the the neighborhood. She noticed I had a cough and even helped me get some herbal medicine from a nearby Chinese pharmacy!

It was a great experience and I would definitely recommend staying here. It's nice to know we now have a friend in Singapore!

Qing was a very informative host who provided us with details of the local surroundings. The loft was very cosy and a great place to stay. The location is very convenient to the MRT and a quick walk to Chinatown.
We had a lovely time during our stay here.

This appartment is fantastic. It has everything you need. Located in the heart of Tanjong Pagar, very close to CBD and MRT. Modern, spacious, clean and so comfortable. I stayed here for a business trip and it's even better than staying in a hotel. I also really enjoyed the facilities (Gym,swimming pool). Whether you are on business trip
or holiday I really recommand this place. Qing is a wonderful host : She stayed up until 3am to let me in for check-in as my flight was delayed. She's been very helpful during my stay! Thanks again Qing. I'll definitely be back here next time I travel to sg

Qing's apartment is really beautiful and comfortable, and she is a great host. Very accommodating and caring, she made my stay really nice. Qing even offered to keep my luggage while I went away for the weekend, and was very responsive to all my needs. Thanks Qing for being an amazing host!

Loved the ambience and the atmosphere of the apartment, the location was superb: literally just crossing the street will get you to the metro station. It is located within the central business district with many tourist attractions nearby or easily accessed by public transport. There are also many amazing restaurants in the streets beside the apartment, they serve cuisine from all around the world and around the clock in some instances!
Best of all, Qing was lovely and extremely helpful, she helped us figure out the public transport system and also recommended places and restaurants to visit and enjoy!

Decided to come back to SG for the 2nd time this year - this time purely for a holiday. Qing made our stay so welcoming and made sure we were well set up from the get-go, explaining and touring us around the apartment and the facilities in the building straight off. She was always very quick in replying if I had any concerns and was very receptive when I asked her of things. She is a wonderful lady with a beautiful home situated in the heart of SG, close by to the famous Maxwell food centre, Tanjong Pagar MRT, lots of local restaurants, bars and super close by to Sentosa Island. Whether or not you are staying for a business trip or having a holiday with the family, this apartment is so clean and so inviting and its fantastic location is the icing on the cake. Will definitely recommend Qing's place to anyone going to SG.

The host is a sweet person and the apartment is brand new and shiny, exactly like in the pictures. It's super clean and the finish is of a very high quality. It has pretty much everything you might need and the Internet connection is fast and reliable.
It's in a beautiful location where you'll find many shops, grocery stores and an excessive amount of nice restaurants. Even though it's in a quite lively area, it's all really quiet.
I'd definitely stay again.
Great location for getting around - nice building and flat - perfect studio

Qing was a fantastic host, very easy to communicate with. Qing was a fantastic host. The apartment was spacious and very clean. I would definitely stay here again on another visit to Singapore
Nice clean modern comfortable unit. Pool is nice as well. Close to Telok Ayer. Walking distance to Marina.

This is a classy and well furnished listing in one of the most amazing properties in Singapore. Absolutely perfect for business travel, or for a romantic get away. Qing is an amazing host who will make sure you have everything you need.  I HIGHLY recommend the stay.
just perfect. worthy!

Qing's apartment was a delight to stay in. It is excellently located near Chinatown, with a wide selection of restaurants and bars. The apartment itself is bright, spacious and well equipped. The pool and gym (plus outdoor dining area) are excellent and often empty.

Perfect location near restaurants, bars, CBD, and the MRT. The building is new and Qing was very accommodating, following up with me as soon as I arrived by flight. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay for transportation (MRT) and CBD office locations while still being quiet and secluded - great facilities, excellent host.

This location was great.  Qing was wonderful and arrived VERY early to let me in the apartment. She has a lot of information available to help with the area. The apartment was very clean and bed was very comfortable.

Qing was incredibly accommodating and responsive. Her unit is spacious, quiet and cool. In the center of one of my favorite neighborhoods in Singapore for food, nightlife, within walking distance to CBD and a few steps from the MRT.

From before I booked, Qing was in touch with me with tips already. Then she met me after 6pm for a late check in. Communication was clear and instant the whole time. Has everything you'll need outside of food. I raided the tea and coffee supplies during my night writings! One thing about Singapore. And it's my first time there. If you're close to an MRT station, you're gold. And Qing's place is right opposite one of the bigger stations downtown. And just a street over from Hawkers food market the other direction. And it's quiet. And very safe! I recommend it highly. She even allowed me late check out cos my flight wasn't until 9pm! Thanks, Qing! You're absolutely fantastic! I loved your place in the small time I spent actually in the apartment. I highly recommend staying here with Qing at her cozy nest above convenience! Thanks for having me.

Very Convenient location in a new and modern building. The Gym and Pool are amazing with very good views. The apartment was appointed with everything I needed and I could not have asked for more.
Highly recommended
Very nice apartment  and service...  great place to Stay. Qing was very helpful.
It was lovely staying at Qing’s place, and she was a formidable host: easy to communicate with, available at any time, and very helpful. Would stay at her place again anytime.
Qing's place is in a great location, totally equipped, and comfortable. I really enjoyed my stay there.
Qing’s place is really great for business travelers. The location is perfect. You can buy and eat everything around 5 mins walk from there. Also, Qing is very kind and she taught me many useful tips.
Very clean, good communication.  Great location.

Qing is the perfect host with clear and prompt communication.  PS/100 is an ideal location for work and leisure.  The MRT is directly across the street, grocery store, 2 food centers and dozens of restaurants are less than 5 min walk away.  Grab transportation was always less than 5 minutes wait.

I travel for work a lot and have stayed in hotels in Singapore many times. Went for AirBnB this time as I wanted a more home-like atmosphere, and really enjoyed Qing’s place. It’s right across the street from Tanjong Pagar station (lots of great food options with AC), there’s a supermarket and hawker stalls behind it, a short walk to either Maxwell or Amoy hawker centers, and a slightly longer but pleasant walk to Lau Pa Sat. Plenty of smaller convenience stores all around. It was super easy to get to other destinations around Singapore, but also great to hang out at Qing’s place and just relax after work. The OAsia building is really pretty, and I loved the birds in the early morning as I walked around jet lagged. It was also nice to keep my clothes washed without having to go find a laundromat. I’ll be looking to book again when I return!
Great space and perfect for individuals traveling for business conveniently located in CBD. And the apartments has everything you need.
The place was super conveniently located. There are a lot of amenities in the house, only the air con is a bit old. Would recommend for a longer period business stay

Fantastic little apartment in the best location in Singapore.  The MRT station is 100m from the door and Hawker markets and cool little cafes are all within easy walking distance.  Qing was a great host and the apartment was sparkling clean.  Highly recommend.

Can’t ask for a better location. 30s walk from MRT. The stylish loft is very clean and cozy. Exceptionally quiet. Qing was very responsive and such a nice and thoughtful person. A+++ host. Will recommend to anyone in a heartbeat. Thanks for having me!

Amazing host who took care of me since day one. She made sure I am comfortable and stocked the fridge with food and drinks. The residence is very clean, and amenities are plentiful. Gracious and accommodative host. Qing went the extra mile to accommodate some special requests during my stay and I’m appreciative for the hospitality and care.

Qing was an amazing host and the place is perfect for long stays. It's walking distance from everything that you need and the MRT is literally 3 minutes away. Everything was sorted nicely by Qing, we had no issues whatsoever in a 4 month stay.

I have stayed in singapore before with other serviced apartments and this has to be the best with price, location, and service. Ms Qing goes above and beyond to accommodate and make the stay as enjoyable as possible.
Excellent host

Great location, comfortable room, nice house helper and everything really good for the client.

チャイナタウンからほど近く立地は抜群。夜は少し騒がしかったかな。あともう少し安ければ言うこと無しですね。

I very much enjoyed my stay at Heritage Apartments in Singapore. The place was very easy to find, in a great location and very cozy. It was also super clean, quiet, easy to get in and out, and I had everything I needed in the apartment. Even washed my clothes a few times and everything went smooth.
Mary, who was my contact for this apartment, was outstanding! Super quick to respond, very helpful and accommodating. She made my stay more sweeter on top of an already great Airbnb find.
To say that I recommend this place would be an understatement. I myself will definitely be trying to book it again next time I am there, and you should treat yourself as well too. And if it happens that you get Mary as your contact -- that's just a bonus!
Great location, price and staff.  Heritage always excels in communication, expectations and cleanliness.

Thanks for pricilla for hosting me along the past 13 days staying in heritage apartment place. It was such a lovely place and she is so helpful and nice. I come for business trip alone and the stay here is so quiet, clean, tidy and safe. Will definitely give a 5 star to their service and this stay! Next time if i come to SG, i ll put heritage apartment as my first option for hostel:)
Had a fantastic stay at the Heritage Apartments. It’s located very close to the Chinatown MRT and has a variety of food options in the vicinity. Mary was a fantastic host!
They can expect good services by the managers and clean rooms

This was a really great place to stay. I honestly couldn’t have picked a better spot. Right in the middle of Chinatown not more than 150 m from the train station I exited.
There is nightlife everywhere, food everywhere, drinks everywhere. When I come back to Singapore I’m definitely staying here again.
Free washer/dryer/detergent were perfect. I was able to get all my laundry done before I left. So now on my trip over to Tokyo for the weekend I have a full set of clean clothes!
Good WiFi!
Mary & Priscilla were great. Very communicative and helpful.

I had a really great time here and it was made so much better by great service from Mary during my stay. I also really appreciated all the quick and helpful responses from Megan. The location was great.
Smaller than what photos lead to believe. No window.

Great location! Very close walking distance to the Chinatown MRT station & countless eating places to choose from. I had a comfortable stay at this studio apartment. Everything was as listed. The room and everything was clean and newly renovated with modern fit-outs. It has everything that I needed during my stay in Singapore. Heritage Apartments' guest relation personel, Mary, was very professional & made me feel welcomed. She periodically checked on me to make sure that my stay was comfortable. Check-in & check-out process was easy. Communication with Mary was flawless. I would definitely use Heritage Apartments again next time I'm in Singapore.
Enjoyable stay once again :) Thank you Mary!

Amazing! Though small, it’s perfect for solo travelers and those on business trips. Mary was an amazing Guest Relations Manager, always responding to my messages promptly as well as ensuring my stay would be comfortable. Thank you, Mary and Heritage Apartments!

I booked my accommodation very late, for a one-month work-related stay in Singapore, and I was overall pleasantly surprised by the high quality service provided by Heritage Apartments.
Although the flat where I stayed was quite small, it was perfectly clean and ideally located in Chinatown, one of Singapore's most vibrant areas. Check-in was instructions were clear, so that moving in went very smoothly, and my hosts were kind enough to enquire about my stay several times throughout the month: I was even offered some fruits when they learned that I was feeling sick !
One point that may discourage some is that there is no window in the flat: if this is not a problem to you, I highly recommend Heritage Apartments for a flawless stay in Singapore !
Great Location!! Close to many places. The manager, Mary, was very helpful and responded very quickly to everything. Highly recommend this place!
Great location, nice and clean room. Will stay again if more than 7 days (min stay is 7 day)

All the positive and excellent reviews that you've read for this property are true. It's great for business trips because of the location, cleanliness and facilities available in the apartment. Mary gave me a warm welcome and orientated me around the property. And the friendliness of the staff here deserve a special mention. Min the housekeeper was also very friendly and obliging. One can also do their laundry using the washing machine and dryer on the property. Fantastic.
Great place in a great location. Couldn’t recommend it enough!

My experience here for 2weeks!
Perfect location, close to mrt, lots of food choices nearby. I arrived early in the morning just wanted to store my luggage, but by chance they already prepared the room for me, best hospitality ever.
Special thanks to staff Mary, Jarwin and the housekeeper who clean my room, they were all very helpful and polite!
I will definitely come back again:)
Excellent stay and great location.  Friendly hosts who go the extra mile.
Awesome location, nice little room with everything you need. Would def. come again!

I love the space, it’s more than i expected. They’re very easy to communicate with when you need their assistance. Special thanks to Mary and Priscilla, you guys are amazing!
The location is very nice too, near to MRT station and you will enjoy looking at some souvenir shops and restaurants all the way to the MRT. You may also enjoy buying some souvenir items since its just a stone throw away from the space. Not just the usual airbnb, its nearly a hotel kind of accomodation! I’ll definitely book at Heritage Apartment when i go back to Singapore.

Really nice place; location is amazing; even has laundry machines! Would recommend if you don't mind having no window and a little humid. The room gets humid but they provide you with a small dehumidifier.
Nice room. Better than I expected. Very well situated in the center next to everything I needed. I would definitely go back if I come back to Singapore. Thanks for everything.

My stay at the Heritage Serviced Apartments was a really pleasant experience. It's the perfect choice for travelers looking for something affordable and located near the hustle and bustle of Chinatown.
Mary was especially helpful with getting me acclimated to the place. She also arranged a late checkout for me at short notice, which I really appreciated.
I would stay here again!

Had a good stay - the place was in a very easy location and coordination for checking in, and key drop for check out was very convenient. Two small notes for future guests: I was expecting more of a traditional hotel, but the building is more of a collection of rooms, without what you might typically expect from a hotel (amenities-wise) in the building. Also, there are no windows in the room. Wasn't a problem as I was out early and in late, but if you plan to spend more time in the room this might be a consideration.  I hadn't noticed this from the pictures.

The only downside was that there wasn’t any windows and the room can get stuffy without the dehumidifier and air con running. Other than that, the room was exactly how it was described. The layout is perfect for someone staying by themselves. You have everything you need. The train station is right down the street and you’re in a great location. A quick minute walk to a Hawker and shops.
Excellent!
No window apartment, so it can get a little humid. But they provide dehumidifiers!
Overall, a goo apartment. Communication was very good at check in and they texted me when I landed. There is sufficient room for one person in the apartment.
Place is outstanding. Would recommend staying here. Close by to train and city.
Great location, very convenient to access hotspots in Singapore.
Excellent value
The apartment is well placed, nice and clean. Mary was very welcoming. I enjoyed the stay at the apartment.
Great location for exploring Singapore. Very close to the MRT Station and room was very nice. Very useful to have luandry and kitchenette.

Super convenient location for both business and sightseeing. Just a few minutes' walks to MRT and large hawker center. The size of the room was better than expected and be able to access the laundry machine was a huge plus. Check-in was smooth with the help of Priscilla, she also gave me a good amount of recommendations from supermarket to a pharmacy to bars.
As others pointed already, there's no window in this room which didn't bother me since I only use this room to sleep. Overall, I'm satisfied!

I really enjoyed staying at Heritage Apartments Singapore! The place is definitely worth its price : it’s clean and cozy. Also it has many good facilities including comfortable bed, TV, washing machine, microwave and a spacious bathroom. The location is perfect , it’s near the subway station and famous tourist attractions. I will recommend this place to my friends!
Perfect location. Tiny but cosy little studio
Отличная квартирка и расположение очень хорошое, в близи от метро.

If you’re traveling alone and you’re not into hostels you’ll find everything you need in this place.
It has a fantastic location, the neighborhood is great, there’s a lot of things to do and also a lot of restaurants.
Chinatown MRT it’s 2 min walking!
The place was really clean, you have the necessary to cook, a spacious bathroom, a really comfy and cozy bed, Netflix, air conditioning and also you can do your laundry for free.
Mary was a great host, she was really kind and helpful.
I really recommend this place and I definitely will come back :)
Great location. In the middle of China town and just around the corner of the MRT. The rooms are set up really convenient.
Great place, good location!
It’s my second time with Heritage Apartment and of course, it doesn’t disappoint. Very comfortable and everything is great.
Its a much better experience inside.
挺好的一切 值得住

Second Time Staying in this flat and it was just as great as first time, Guest Manager Mary is amazing, excellent communication, and fast response to any situation. She made sure my trip was good and I had everything I needed. I Look forward to staying with heritage in the future again... :)
There is no window for this apartment which can be stuffy at times

The place was exactly as described, and provided a lot of useful amenities. Most importantly, the location was very convenient, and made travelling to all the tourist destinations very easy! Would highly recommend
Great accommodations! Simple, easy, and safe. Couldn’t ask for more.
Clean, good location and great food nearby
Great location. Excellent hospitality and communication

Heritage is nicely located within minutes from Chinatown and definitely a great place to stay when visiting Singapore. Though the room is small, it is very functional and has basically everything you need. Mary was fabulous in coordinating everything and made my stay very comfortable. The COVID situation did require some additional things to be done when entering and leaving but this was not a hassle and much needed to ensure we do everything we can to prevent the spread of this virus.
Thanks again for everything and happy to stay here again next time around!
Special Thanks to Mary who facilitated my checkin experience. She’s very helpful and quick in her response. 🙏🙏🙏
Great stay ! Cosy and clean space
Very good!

Good value for money - apartment is cosy but has everything you will need, hosts are very helpful and responsive, good location near Chinatown MRT. The weekly housekeeping service is great as well. The only downside is the room does not have a window, as stated in the description.
I stayed again next time
Pretty good place very clean easy access

- Best Value for Money
- Super clean and surrounded by restaurants and shops
- Mary (Guest Experience Manager) is very accommodating and super approachable.
- Will definitely stay here again given a chance
Wonderful stay! Host was super helpful in coordinating my check in. Space was clean and comfy! Would definitely stay again
Clean, cosy, and quiet (except when inconsiderate guests are loud with their talking and laughter). Nothing to complain nor criticise about. Will definitely consider this place again :)
Great amenities are provided in the room. The location is also very convenient. Recommend for other guests.

Loved the location and responsiveness of the staff during the day. There are many food options, and the room is quaint. It is as advertised, as there is no window, and I never knew how much I loved having natural light before. The room comes with a toaster, microwave, and refrigerator as well.
My only gripe is that the internet went out in the middle of the night, so when I woke up to get work done on the computer, I was unable until the host arrived later that morning. Luckily, I was able to make it to my first virtual meeting of the day.
I would definitely recommend staying here at this location. I was walking distance from a wealth of places to visit for shopping and food, and I could walk to Funan to go rock climbing at Climb Central!

My stay at the Heritage Collection was great! The room was exactly as advertised, clean, and comfortable. I really enjoyed the double shower heads. Having laundry on the same floor was also convenient. Hanna, Alosia, and Mary were great hosts. Definitely recommend staying here especially if you’re looking to be in a central area near restaurants and public transport.
It was a bit tight cause there was no window.

Really good location, only a few minutes from the Chinatown MRT. Small rooms are good for a single person and ideal if you’re not spending much time hanging out in your room. AC worked well, free laundry machines are convenient (dryers are a bit weak, though, so may need a couple cycles). Jarwin and Alosia were the staff that mainly helped me - they are very quick to reply (never waited more than maybe 60 seconds) and both very friendly and helpful.
Everything needed is provided for, the only thing you need especially for small petite lady is to bring your own pillow.  The pillow is abit too high for me. That is the only “complaint” I have.

Everything was really great. of course it being Singapore means on the value front, there is some left to be desired. But everything else was as expected, and the communication from the staff (who were also very friendly) was very clear.
Perfect location in Chinatown! Lovely and clean room though very small. Appliances are handy. All communications are handled on Whatsapp. Nice place for a staycation!
The location is fantastic and it’s a good price for a private room. The room is very small. Hallway noise is excessive in the morning when people are coming and going.

I stayed at the Chinatown location for my very first trip to Singapore. Everything was great. I think the most important thing about Heritage is that they’re available anytime to provide help, and there genuinely care about their guests. It was very easy to communicate with them and they really made my stay easier. The Chinatown location is perfect. I even took yoga classes to the studio next door : super convenient.
For this particular room, you have to be comfortable for tiny and dark spaces, but knowing that most other housings I checked at this price didn’t offer a private bathroom, I’m happy I chose this one. Plus, the room has every amenities you can need. And the laundry in the building is definitely a plus. Thank you Heritage !

I stayed in a studio room (with personal bathroom) for one person for 5 nights. The space was clean and compact, and the major advantage is its proximity to multiple MRT stations and local attractions. Check in was easy, and Irean, Shaine, and Rizza were also super responsive and friendly. Minor downsides are value for money (space was small for the amount of money but it is overall ok considering it's one of the few which offers a personal bathroom), and despite the clear check in steps and high responsiveness rate of the staff I was a little worried about what to do if I lost my phone during the trip as this was my only way of getting into the Airbnb, though thankfully this did not happen. Overall, a nice and convenient place for short tourist stays.

Pros:
- Had all amenities: soap, shampoo, towels, tissue, paper towels, common washer and dryer, even laundry detergent. Obviously if I'm looking for accommodation with a washer & dryer and only for a few days it's much appreciated that I don't have to buy it myself. Microwave, kettle, crockery and cutlery all provided.
- Hosts were very responsive and proactive in providing instructions and answering questions. Thanks very much Irean and Rizza!
- Central location - I picked this place because of access to various food options.
Cons:
- My studio was probably about 10 sqm, if I had brought a medium suitcase it probably won't fit to open it.
- There was a centipede

i definitely would stay at the place again if I ever revisit.  Great location and the place had all the amenities I needed including washer and dryer.  The staff was friendly and very communicative.  Ken and Rizza was very accommodating with my check in and checked up on me on how I was doing.  Since the location was fairly central, it was easy to go back to rest and to cool down from the heat and humidity.
Great place to stay
It was a decent to stay at Heritage. It was quiet expensive but anywhere else this stay would cost even more than that. The only issue is WiFi connection - it was a bit too slow for Zoom calls.

The staff (Ken & Kat) were friendly, responsive and helpful with enquiries. Generally, the digital concierge and check-in/out processess were quite smooth (it was my first time trying this). The room was clean and as advertised (photos and description clear about what to expect). Great location for young at heart travellers who like a bohemian setting but still want a private room. The hotel is close to downtown attractions and within walking distance of shops and public transport.

Perhaps and if not the best place in terms of value and utility that I have ever stayed in Singapore. I've stayed in many places with different price ranges in Singapore, from Hostels back in the day to 5-star hotels. This, without question, is an ideal place to stay. The location is unbeatable, the value is excellent as it provides you with all the necessities and comfort, the staff are all helpful and responsive and best of all - NO NOISE. That's right, being in the heart and center of bustling Singapore/Chinatown, this place allows you to rest well in a small but comfortable living space that surprisingly has everything you need. Laundry? Done. Hangers? You got it. Eating utensils? Yes! Plenty of storage? No way!!! Don't want to buy laundry detergent because of your short stay? Guess what, they provide. Need help from the staff? They respond within MINUTES. Insanely good. I love this place and will stay with them again in the future if I travel solo.
Central and clean !

Not too squeezy and room was generally clean and nice. Free laundry was very useful too. The only strong con is that it’s not really noise-free. Any door that is opened or closed within the building can be heard and occasionally people talking loudly in the corridors or in their rooms can also be heard. But location-wise, this airbnb is truly a gem. Lots to explore and eat.
Place was amazing for one person. Would definitely recommend for solo travelers.
Enjoyed staying here - would recommend!
房间很干净，物品齐全，工作人员非常热情友好，服务周到及时！

A lot is packed into a small space (including a workspace and kitchenette) but everything was well though-out.
Great neighborhood. Walkable, lots to do, see and eat.
Excellent, very helpful hosts.
I enjoyed my stay here.

Absolutely loved my time in Singapore. My hosts, Mary and Alex, were absolutely amazing! The unit was easy to find and in a great location. On arrival, it was clean and stocked and there was weekly room cleaning. Mary was kind enough to remind me of cleaning days so it was never a surprise to when they were coming or if there was any change of schedule.
When it came to check out, they made it to enjoy my last day in Singapore by offering luggage storage and even helping me get my bag to the nearby MRT!
I would definitely stay with Heritage Collections on my next visit to Singapore and maybe try one of their other locations (although, would recommend the Chinatown locations for a truly unique Singaporean experience).
Matches the description. Super close to trains, food, street markets, etc.
El alojamiento escomo lo muestras, la atención fue lo mejor, Mary me ayudó en todo, muy amable y pendiente de todos detalles, lo recomiendo 100%
Schöne kleine Unterkunft mitten in Chinatown. eigenes Badezimmer und sonst alles was man für einen kurzen Aufenthalt in Singapur benötigt. klare Empfehlung!
Had a great stay at the Heritage. It's literally right across the street from the china town station so it was easy to get on the train to other locations.
Maica and Mary very helpful and super friendly. Good location and you would get everything you need while you stay here . Highly recommend. I will stay here again when I come to Singapore

I will start by saying that the Heritage listings are in a great location that is close to Chinatown and the nearest subway entrance. The room itself is clean and does its basic functions. Unfortunately though, Heritage possesses a bit of an inflexible change/cancellation policy. I needed to change my dates at the listing due to medical reasons, and ultimately, Airbnb had to get involved to push for a refund and to get the dates changed because the host refused to do so. Also, the washers and dryers automatically turn off at 9:00PM, and do not become available again until 9:00AM, which is inconvenient for someone who is not at the Airbnb throughout the day and needs to do laundry at night. For a place that costs $150-$175 USD per night, the change policy should be much more flexible, and laundry services should be available at all times. I hope that Heritage rectifies these gaps in their listing to ensure for a better experience for travelers in the future.

I had a wonderful stay. The room is listed as having no window but that’s not true. There are plenty of windows they are just at ground level and can’t really be opened on account of being located next to a busy street.
The heritage team was super communicative and helpful!
地點很方便，服務很好，很友善
Great place in a great area
It was nice staying at this place.

Great for the business traveller on a budget. 120m walk to Chinatown station, then 16 stops to Changi Expo.
Small, but enough to sleep and shower, what more do you need.

A+++ place to stay
very quiet yet very near to the centre and beautiful river walk.
Good directions at the outset.
And everything I could possibly need even aircon and big clean shower and tv and cooking area very clean too!
I will definitely stay again :)

The place was great - comfortable, and the room had what was needed. In case its unclear, this is just a room, apart from the laundry (a nice addition) there is nothing else - no lobby for example, but you are really close to Chinatown and cafes etc
I genuinely couldn't have found a better place in Chinatown if I tried, they earned the 5 stars this visit

Such a great place for a solo traveler! I was in Singapore for 2 nights for tourism, and looking for something affordable but didn't want to share a room or bathroom. This listing was perfect. The room had everything I needed for a quick stay. Mary, Maica and Lily were very prompt and proactive with communication. I met Lily in person and she was a huge help.

Great location, great hosts, easy check in. Two things, I would like to note is that, the room I stayed in did smell moldy. The other thing was the drain flies. They sprayed the drains two days into my stay which helped a little. Would consider just covering the drains when you're not using the bathroom. Other than that, the room has everything you need.
Maica, Mary, and Lily were so responsive and nice. would highly recommend.

This is a great option for a couple of nights in the heart of Singapore. The location was amazing, right on South Gate with lots of coffee options, bars, restaurants and about three minutes from the Maxwell Hawker. Inside it was quiet, no street noise (although I stayed during the week). I used the laundry machine, which worked fine. I was a little worried about the check in system. You unlock the door with an app on your phone. Be sure to do the pre-registration and download the app before you arrive. But the process worked. I would definitely recommend this spot and stay here again.

The location is amazing in Chinatown, the room was clean, perfect, had all the amenities I needed , even free laundry! And best of all the communication and service was above and beyond. They were extreme helpful with everything! I cannot thank them enough for a wonderful stay!!!

Heritage is a good place for a short term stay, the room is compact and super clean.
Check in is very easy, I checked in earlier than the schedule and it helped to have a power nap before continue my activity.
Location wise, it's right in the middle of Chinatown, even the sorrounding is very busy with people, the room is relatively quiet.
In term of price, since I booked a day before my stay and it was peak season due to F1 GP, it's a bit high.
很好的地段，房间干净
Kind service. Surrounding with restaurants.Comfortable and convenience to get to bus/subway stations.

First of all, I have the utmost praise and thanks to Carms, Mary and Maica for their attention to my needs !  Even late at night!  I loved my stay because of their immediate recommendations of where to eat, what to do, esim info, GST tax, luggage storage - free here, massage spas ( Although I give 5 stars to Li Xin Beauty Wellness which is near the Buddha’s tooth temple for their outstanding massage and they accept credit cards).  Their answers were tailored to exactly what I was looking for.  I felt welcomed and that I had an ‘aunty’ or ‘cousin’ who knew where to go, what to see, best way to get a ride.  Due to their suggestions, I felt like I was able to make the most of the short time that I was in Singapore.  Chinatown is the place to stay, close to the MRT, night markets, many restaurants and spas!  Do make use of their services and advice!

Excellent location right at Chinatown, great food everywhere from $5 to $50, close to 3 metro stations, fast, friendly communication, clean, personal shower, toilet and Aircon. Checking in stressed me a bit but worked very well and I grew to really like this place. I hope I can go again.
The team was very helpful. Nice location.
Great location, super helpful and attentive staff, bedding was comfortable, air con was a god send. Would book this place for a short stay again.

Great location and very helpful Hosts!
High humidity in the room though as there are no windows. Things don’t really dry.
Perfect for a short stay!

Cosy comfortable space that is sufficient and perfect for myself (might be a squeeze for two people). The digital concierge team - Mary, Maica, Yani - are very responsive and friendly, and were of great help when I had any questions.
Room amenities are clean and well maintained. Slight scuffs and some wear and tear, but nothing major and still feels homely. Bed is comfy, though pillows are a little too soft for me as a side sleeper. Laundry facilities are shared but free, really convenient. WiFi is strong.
One minor downside is that my door was quite thin so I could easily hear people talking and walking outside, and also the washing machine operating. Probably not great for light sleepers.
The surrounding area is full of good food including cheap eats at Maxwell Food Centre. Also there are temples and other interesting places to check out.
Yani, Maica, and Mary were very communicative, and the location of the Air BnB was fantastic: it was super easy to walk around, and very close to great places to eat!
Had an issue upon arrival but they were quick to respond and remediate the issue. Great locations and responsive hosts.

Nice place, nice location. The room is nice and near the MRT station so that can easy to go to any where. Concierge is very friendly and supportive.
It’s good place to stay at when travel to Singapore. Hopefully to come back there in near future.
nice place near mrt station, local food not bad , one of the best teh ice~~

Highly recommend for solo travelers. Don't worry about the "No windows" thing. You're gonna be using AC due to hot weather so you don't need the windows. The hotel is right opposite to the hindu temple and the Chinatown food street. A 2-min walk will get you to Maxwell hawker centre and Maxwell MRT station. A 5-min walk will get you to Chinatown MRT.
Many breakfast places nearby to try Kaya toasts. For the duration of 7 days I stayed there, I always had only kaya toast as breakfast since there's a lot of restaurants nearby.
Don't bother buying souveniers, chocolates, tshirts, from the actual tourist spots. it will be expensive. Instead, right opp to Heritage you will find the Chinatown street where there are 100s of shops filled with same souvenirs with very low prices.
Extremely safe neighborhood. Host is responsive. Digital check-in is simple if you pay close attention to the email you receive. Skip hostels and try this room instead if you are a solo traveler.

Viendo los precios de Singapur en general, buenísima relación calidad precio teniendo en cuenta la ubicación.
Ideal para una noche o fin de semana para ver todo.
very clean and affordable! staff was  very friendly and check in was easy online!

The hotel is right in Chinatown in Singapore. There are many places to eat around the area. Also, a lot of places to shop, and lovely touristic attractions. Close to metro station (5 min walk).
The room was clean and had everything to make the stay comfortable. Air conditioner was the best because it was super hot outside. Communication was super fast too. They even stored my luggage after check-out.
Thanks for everything! Highly recommended
Nice and enjoyable place, would definitely recommend! Also everything was very clean and organized! Walking distance to many shops and restaurants! :)

I wouldn't consider any other place in Singapore if ever I return. The Heritage Hotel is a modern and affordable accomodation at the heart of the beautiful Chinatown which is walking distance to practically all the tourist destinations around the city. I also appreciated the free bag hold offered which helped me explore the city some more while I wait for my departure.

j'ai passé un excellent séjour! Le rapport qualité-prix est parfait et la localisation au coeur du quartier chinatown et des principaux lieux touristiques est fantastique. Je recommande sans hésiter Heritage collection pour un séjour de quelques jours à Singapour.

Perfect place to stay if you are a solo-traveler. I lived in the extra small room, so it wasn’t 1:1 with the photos but it was very similar. I spent the majority of my day out so it really was not an issue for me, it was a very nice and cozy place to stay during my trip to singapore. The host was also responsive and would always quickly reply to any questions I had. Highly recommend for solo-travelers.

It’s exacty as advertised. It feels like you’re staying in a college dorm. However it was clean, had helpful hosts and it’s in a great neighborhood. One small issue is that I hope they gave at least one physical key so that I don’t have to think about the battery of my phone all the time. Overall I would stay there again.

窓なしの部屋でしたが、日中は観光で使わないためとても良かったです。
チェックイン時は入り口に少し戸惑いましたが5分ほどで見つけられて入れました。
レスポンスが早く助かりました。
ありがとうございました♪

This is a topnotch place!! Like others have said the checkin was a lil nerve-wracking but the service and attention given more than makes up for that!! Honestly, I'm not sure I've ever felt more cared for by an airbnb host...Yani and Mary, OMG top notch and always with a smile. Its not cheap but then neither is Singapore and it was small as advertised but had everything I needed. Definitely recommend...5 Stars*****!!!
Nice place and location.

I loved this place! The location is excellent: walk out the door and there’s a high-quality coffee stand on one side, a bakery on the other, and 100+ restaurants, hawker stands and stores within a few blocks.
The room itself was more spacious than I expected, but the rooms are all different. I got lucky because my room had opaque windows; most do not. This particular room has a little street noise. It didn’t bother me, and it was quiet at night. (Most rooms do not abut the street.)
The room was clean and had dishes and utensils, fridge, microwave, kettle. The bed was comfortable. The a/c worked well.
The host was highly responsive and polite via text, even replying in the middle of the night. My digital key wouldn’t work and I had some moments of frustration, but they took care of me. Make sure you keep all instructions, including the code to get in the front door the first time.
I would definitely stay here again - great value!

Our stay at Heritage Apartment Chinatown was wonderful. Our host, Cherry was very helpful and very accommodating throughout the stay.

Jane is a fine hostess and ready to help with anything you need.

Jane's place is wonderful! I will definitely book it again.
highly recommend
Location is brilliant, right next to the MRTs and there is also a Fairprice nearby.
Very good host. The place’s location is perfect, next to the famous Orchard Road.

Jane is a wonderful host. I stayed for two weeks. The place is as cosy as it says. An older building right in the middle of everything Singapore has to offer. Great food options just a few mins walk away. MRT is 500 ms away.
