Great place,! Jane is very friendly, she told me what areas I should check out and she provided me with utilities for my stay when I didn’t have certain items ⭐️

Great location. Landlord was expedient in taking care of maintenance of air conditioning and broken toilet door.
Comfortable house. Everything as described in the listing.

This place is perfect for two people and has everything you need to enjoy a business or vacation time in Singapore. It was private and accessible to everything MRT, mall, restaurants etc. The host was on point and extremely informative & pleasant. I wish I could have stayed longer and would definitely rebook this place. Thanks for the stay!!
Great stay - clean place and easy check in. Proximity to the MRT station was huge plus.

Aileen place is really nice and comfortable. Really tidy and relaxing. It is very close to the MRT Farrer Park and close to restaurants and malls and the area is really nice. Internet connection is perfect and communication with Aileen is super quick. I would recommend hundred per cent this flat. Perfect for two persons.

Aileen's place was clean, large, affordable, and in a great location just steps away from the Farrer Park MRT. Communication with Aileen was superb and she was always quick to respond. I'd definitely stay here again.

Aileen is a super host! She and her family are responsible, very pleasant in communication persons.
The house is clean, comfortable to stay even for a long time, matches to the pictures.There are all necessary kitchen amenities, easy to cook,if you like.If you do not; there are hawker just footstep away from the apartment and a plenty of tasty restaurants nearby. The place itself is very quiet, no any noise disturbs you during sleeping and at the same time it is close to busy districts of Little India and MRT station to connect you with many Singapore attractions .100% recommend!!!

The apartment is cosy and very well equipped with everything necessary. The location was good, very close to a MRT station. Aileen was always helpful and very flexible with our check-in and check-out times.
Place is very close to MRT and other restaurants.

Aileen's place is accurately described in the offer. It's cosy, has a kitchenette, bedroom is fine, WiFi works very fast and the location is very good, just a few minutes walk to the MRT station. There are also lots of eateries in the neighborhood and also one of the major malls.

Aileen is a true super host. She's extremely nice and prompt. Her place is clean, compact, complete with all the basic necessities and it is exactly as shown in the picture. Just the perfect spot for us. Communication was superb, sparkling place and welcoming team! Small touches that made you feel at home. At the center of Farrer/ Little India and quite near major spots. Mrt station and mall are nearby.

The owner is helpful and responds quickly. The place is quiet as it does not face the Main Street. swimming pool is pretty small and so as gym. We had a really nice 7-night stay here! Aileen and her husband greeted us at check-in and made us feel very welcome! Communication was great. We really enjoyed the location as it very easy to get to downtown on MRT or bus, but also close to stores and restaurants in the area. Aileen’s place was in a great location, near the MRT and the perfect size with everything we needed during our stay for awesome value for money.
The apartment was as described and communication with Aileen and Sam was quick and easy. They made our stay really easy and fuss free. Thank you!

Great location (SMRT, Shopping, Dining), gives you an insight of the middle-class Singapore. Flawless check in and check out. All amenities (except dishwasher). To be recommended as an option to stay in Singapore.

Supreme location close to MRT, groceries shopping as well as restaurants. Check in and out was a breeze. Apartment was clean and you have everything you need.

We enjoyed our stay here.  It was the perfect size for the two of us.  The shower was great.  Relaxing pool on the roof.  Shopping and subway very nearby.  We would stay here again.
Everything is as per the mentioned details. Definitely recommend for people who want to stay near to Farrer park and Little India.
Exactly as described and very nice place
Great apartment conveniently located right by Farrer Park MRT! Check-in was nice and simple, and the apartment was clean and well kitted out. Thanks Aileen for hosting me!

The place is perfect for 2 people , it has everything that u need for a comfortable stay. and is very close to the city square mall and little india. Thanks for being an amazing host and we will surely come back .

A MRT station nearby, a shopping mall nearby, completely a nice place to stay.

Very good location next to MRT station  and in walking distance from Little India. Nice apartment with all the required amenities as washing maschine, f.i.  Very easy check-in and pleasant stay. Thank you, Aileen.

The apartment is very nice, located close to the MRT station. It has plenty of air cons inside and a brand new washing machine. The house was very quiet until midday when refurbishment works started in the neighboring flat.

Perfect place for our stay in Singapore, centrally located (either by public transport or by Grab) and good value for our money. Definitely recommended.

Great stay in Singapore. Convenient location and good spot!

Great apartment in an excellent location.

nice and friendly host

Thanks eric!

Excellent location. So close to station and shops. The big shower was nice to cool off in after a day of sweating.

We required laundry detergent and after a quick message to Eric we recieved a bottle the next morning from the front desk! It was a very easy and well managed trip. Thanks!

Really beautiful apartment and really convenient location. I lost my luggage and these beautiful people did everything to help me feel comfortable by getting me a phone charger and other emergency supplies. I can’t recommend enough

Great place, close to Killerney street which has lots of good local food options and to Somerset MRT station. Helpful front desk and housekeeping staff, and the added Chromecast is a nice touch.

The apartment is Similar to as shown in the picture . It has everything you need to live comfortably. It’s a Basic house it is not luxury . It’s old but looks like has been refurbished . Location is good and convenient.

thank you. it was such a pleasant stay. The staffs are all very friendly. Room is clean, comfortable, and enough for solo travelling. its also near to bus-stops and MRT station. all kitchen appliances and washing machinw also work well. i will recommend this to family and friends.

Great host. Joyce was very easy to contact and Instructions were clear when checking in. price was fair and location is perfect as it is close by shops. 5 minute walk to shopping centre, 3 minute walk to restaurants. Very happy with the stay and would highly recommend 👌

Eric's place is very close to Orchard Road, and very convenient as you get access to many malls and eateries around. It's also close to the MRT that you could pretty much access many parts of SG. The icing on the cake is how kind Eric was.

Nice apt, perfect for 1 person.

Fantastic stay. Apartment was everything that the advertisement said. Looking forward to staying there when I return to Singapore!
We were staying for 10 days in the Apartment and everything was well. The location was good and everything was close enough to reach. If we ever need a place that would be my choice. Thank you.

Overall it is a good service apartment with 24 hour reception and friendly staffs, would consider staying here again.
Good value for money! Room is small, but cozy and clean. There is a seperate bigger kitchen in coridor. Bus stop and MRT is close. Highly recommended!
Great location, nice staff.
地段很好，生活方便，地铁大型超市近在咫尺，房间小而全，服务好。唯一遗憾入住时旁边在施工，有点闹。
Great place and location..perfect for a single person or couple

We had a great stay in Rutchel’s apartment. The location was perfect, close to Somerset metro and Orchard road. All in all, very pleased with our time here and would return again in the future. Thanks heaps!
Very nice small apartment with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Staff was very helpful and friendly.
Good floor budget.
整體來說還不錯，若是能每天清潔房間會更好！感謝🙏

A clean and nice studio apartment close to Somerset station near Orchard Road. I would stay again

Cons: Wifi very poor and not particularly reliable. No kitchen sink which makes washing a bit easy. Service staff can be a little intrusive (they asked to come in to change bed sheets. I was working at the desk and said it was ok. 5 people then came into the room, 3 of whom started plastering and painting the room which took 45 minutes). Given one towel for a week.
Nice place, close to the city and walkable to shopping Malls.

The place is indeed as advertised in the photos. Place is clean and very near to town and amenities. All plus points indeed and nothing to complain about. However, I had received notification to travel at last minute notice just hours after I checked in. Not the end of the world, but a huge hassle and I wrote to the host to try and explain the unfortunate circumstances and asked to alter the dates so I could get a substantial part of the monies back. However, to cut the long story short, he was inflexible and first said Airbnb did not allow the alteration, only to thereafter say that the reason was that he would suffer loss of revenue. Après l’annulation à la dernière minute de ma réservation, j’ai dû retrouver un appartement en urgence. Rutchel a accepté ma demande très rapidement et a répondu de même à tous mes messages.
Il s’agit d’un appartement hôtelier avec services. Tous les appartements sont identiques, ils se différencient uniquement par leur grandeur et leur situation dans l’immeuble (côté rue ou côté cour, étage plus ou moins élevé).
Le check-in se fait à la réception qui possède une grande amplitude horaire, ce qui est très pratique, et le personnel est sympathique.
L’appartement,que j’avais loué, n’était plus libre car le locataire avait prolongé son séjour, et j’ai eu à la place un appartement au 2ème étage côté rue. La rue est assez passante et comme ce n’est pas du double vitrage, cela pouvait être un peu bruyant.
L’appartement se compose d’une pièce avec grand lit, télé, table et deux chaises, meuble cuisine avec micro-ondes et bouilloire (sur le palier il y a un espace cuisine avec un évier et une plaque).
La salle de bains possède une grande douche et une machine à laver (lessive non fournie, de même pas de savon pour les mains).
Le ménage est fait 3 fois par semaine par contre seulement 2 grandes serviettes et une petite serviette sont fournies pour la semaine, ce qui est un peu juste.
Au bout de 2 jours, l’air conditionné est tombé en panne, et malgré l’intervention d’un technicien, il a fallu que je change d’appartement. Je suis allée dans l’appartement attenant, qui différait par le fait qu’il était plus grand et avec un balcon. Il y a de nouveau eu un problème, cette fois - ci les toilettes étaient bouchées et j’ai dû redemander une intervention.
L’appartement est très bien situé à 2mn du métro Somerset (situation centrale qui permet de se déplacer facilement et rapidement) et à 3mn d’ Orchard Street. A une minute, il y a un supermarché ouvert 24h/24 et 7j/7, et à 3 mn on peut trouver le centre commercial 313Somerset avec un très bon food court.
J’ai un avis un peu mitigé sur mon séjour, car d’un côté l’emplacement est vraiment parfait pour visiter Singapour, et le personnel est sympathique et efficace ; de l’autre je trouve que j’ai eu beaucoup de problèmes en peu de temps, côté rue il y a un peu de bruit, et plus de serviettes, du savon et de la lessive pourraient être fournies.

我的俩个女儿也特别喜欢住在这里，她们可以挑选自己喜欢的地方看书学习，Antie Jane还特意在院子里为我们安放了一个桌子，让我们更随意方便。我另外一个女儿还在这里过了新加坡的第一个生日，非常快乐！并且收到了Antie Jane的生日礼物，礼物上写着暖暖的祝福！她说她会保留着。
然后再说说房子，特别漂亮，比我们看到的照片要更漂亮，走进院子，就能看到一棵很漂亮的三角梅，我为它拍了很多照片。旁边有一片草地，还有一棵参天的芒果🥭树，周围有一圈花。我们平时特别喜欢坐在院子里看书，很安静，而且满眼花花草草，微风吹过，心情特别好！往里走有个特别美丽鱼池，大大小小的鱼，特别可爱，我们也很爱护它们，累了就去看看。客厅外面也有花，我没研究它们叫什么，但是爬在架子上，常年开花，特别美。我们住的房间，干净宽敞，有书桌和床头柜，正好适合我们，我买了写书架、收纳架，可以放置我们的书和物品，有两个衣柜，足够放我们的行李，房间外面就是一个小花园，房东细心的放了一个桌子和椅子，方便我们在院子里坐坐。
到新加坡第一个房子就住了有地住宅的别墅，是我们自己选择的，但是能遇到这么好的房东，这真的是老天的护佑！🙏
谢谢你们，你们温暖的家庭，也给了我们一份温暖！我们一定会回来看你们的。🌹❤️

I've had a lovely stay at the place that I feel makes it rise above other accommodations in Singapore. When I first arrived, the host was not there but through some simple instructions I was able to gain access into the apartment simply.
1) Location, it's 5 minutes away from the MRT station meaning you're able to go anywhere easily. It's located right above an eatery as well as a 24 hours supermarket which means you'll never have to worry about anything.
2) The host is an exceptionally kind and generous person, providing many amenities that dont exist even in other highly rated accommodations. The breakfast items he provides is a pleasant surprise and a welcome addition. I'm sure that if you were to ask him for something, he would help you in any way he can.
3) The bedroom js spacious and clean, has many features like a TV, clothes hanger, fan, air conditioning, a closet, wired clothes hanger and more. The bed is a queen sized bed and very comfortable. The other parts of the flat is beautifully furnished with a washer/dryer, modern kitchen, a TV and a large comfortable living area. A cleaner comes in once a week and cleans the entire place, making it exceptionally clean. Wifi is also extremely fast so you'll have no issues with anything internet related.
Overall, this is an excellent place to stay in Singapore and perhaps one of the best. 位置处于克拉克码头，附近有不错的吃饭的地方（类似于食阁，就在马路对面）；去对应的地铁站需要步行一段路，不过不十分远，还能接受；第五楼没有电梯，电梯只到四楼，行李特别大特别重的话，住五楼可能有些费力；总体，离周围逛的景点不太远，比如鱼尾狮公园、游船码头、福康宁公园等，酒店提供了很好的旅程建议，很不错（提一句，如果来新加坡，推荐坐从圣淘沙到花柏山的缆车，自己克拉码头傍晚的游船，非常棒！）
很棒的体验！位置优越，多个景点步行可达，吃饭、购物都很方便！很干净，同时虽地处交通生活都便利的地区，但是很安静！Loc是个很棒的小伙，给我们介绍入住方法和演示设施的使用，回复信息很及时，对我们提出的问题总是能给出很有帮助的解答。
It was perfect! Rooms are on the smaller side - however it was perfect for our needs.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay experience here. From the moment We arrived, we were greeted warmly by Loc, whose professionalism and hospitality immediately made me feel at home.
The accommodation itself was cozy, clean, and well-appointed, providing all the comforts we needed for a pleasant stay. The location was also ideal, offering easy access to local attractions and amenities.
Loc was not only there to welcome me with a big smile but also saw us off with the same kindness when it was time to leave. His attention to detail and willingness to assist with any inquiries made the entire experience seamless.
We have no hesitation in recommending this place to others and I would definitely consider staying here again in the future. It was truly a memorable and delightful stay.

Loc, Ryan and Kim were really nice guys and at anytime available.
Please beware if you booked an early flight because a early chek in is really difficult because of the cleaning.
All in all a great stay and worth it for a second time.

Heritage collection have a few locations around the city but this one was great for us!
The room was described as cosy & small but in all honesty we were pleasantly surprised, it had all the necessary amenities we could think of.
The room was simple but perfect for what we needed from a short stay.
The staff are on hand via the online portal and were excellent. Big thanks goes to Loc who was on hand via text to assist with any queries.
Very responsive, easy to check in and checkout. Good location, nearby subway.  The ambassadors were super helpful.
Great location, really amazing staff, a lot of communication and hosts checked in regularly and addressed concerns efficiently.

Loc, Ryan, and Kim were all quick and responsive to my needs. Special thanks to Loc for helping me understand how simple the digital key process really is!!
The rooms are cozy and clean and many things are in walking distance.
This is a great choice for a stay in Singapore.

I loved staying at Heritage! The communication was very good and the service excellent, have never experienced such a helpful and convenient service! Especially big shout out for Loc, Edmar and Kim - you were the reason for the excellent communication and service.
I was also suprised how quit the room was even tho it is in the middle of a lot of traffic , I had a really good sleep. The AC worked also very well!
I will come back for sure. :) Thank you!

This hotel exceeded my expectations in several ways. First and foremost, the cleanliness was impeccable—every part of the room felt well-maintained and spotless. The hotel is also in a prime location, making it incredibly convenient to explore the city’s main attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. Despite being in such a central area, the hotel was surprisingly quiet, offering a peaceful retreat after busy days. The staff were friendly and helpful, which added to the overall positive experience. I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a clean, well-located, and quiet place to stay! We also loved the Apple TV and the Wifi was fast and reliable. Thank you!
Staff was very friendly and proactive. Space seemed bigger than photographs. All amenities needed for stay.
観光に最適の場所でした！

Wir haben uns sehr gut aufgehoben gefühlt und eine ständige Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber war möglich. Das Zimmer war sauber und die Lage ist sehr praktisch, um von dort aus die Stadt zu erkunden. Das Bett ist etwas schmal für zwei Personen. Insgesamt hatten wir einen angenehmen Aufenthalt.
Great stay, great location and easy check in!

Great place to stay for the location and convenience of being a block away to the MRT, close vicinity of restaurants and night life. Checkin process was clear and easy to go through with no problems whatsoever. Room was clean and no discrepancies from the photos and description. Overall had a pleasant stay with zero issues. Would definitely come and stay again with any of the various heritage collection accommodations.
Very centrally located, with easy check in and check out. A great base for our visit to Singapore.
The overall experience is great! The hotel has great location, and the connectors, Cora and Jona, provided detailed instructions about check-in and check-out procedures in time.

We had a great stay at Heritage Collection, the apartment was in a great location and within walking distance to most tourist attractions.
The hosts were very attentive and helpful, checking in to ensure our stay was the best it could be.
Would recommend staying here if you are visiting Singapore.

Super convenient and just the right kind of place I needed for my stay.
Jona, Edmar and Cora communicated via text with me throughout my stay and provided all needed info and were very helpful also.
Highly recommended and will likely stay with Heritage next time.
Thanks!

I had a great stay here.
The communication and service were excellent!
Thank you Jona, Cora and Edmar!

The location is great. You can walk to various tourist locations or snag a grab at the curb.
The staff were very helpful and communicative. Cora helped store my luggage since I arrived before check-in and was kind enough to place it in the room for me when the unit was ready.
The one challenge I had was with the digital key. The exterior door wasn't too much of an issue, but my room door would sometimes take me a few tries to unlock. Not sure if its my phone, the door device's power level, or something else.
Aside from that one issue, I enjoyed my stay and would certainly return to this or one of the other Heritage Collection properties should I find myself in Singapore again.
heritage has been a wonderful hoat to me. they were there to help with any problems and we're quick to respond. Id you want a nice and affordable place in Singapore, please keep this place in mind.
Great service and experience as per other 5 star reviews!
perfect place and location

Exceptional service from staff - they were always on call to answer my questions (including how to hail a taxi to the airport). The staff will reach out via Whats App prior to your arrival to share information.
You will have to download an app and authorize a security hold ahead of time - but that's pretty standard practice in Singapore. App was easy to use.
This Heritage listing is a short walk from many bars and nightlife - and yet I was surprised by how quite and calm it was inside. I got excellent sleep the nights I was there.

We had a great stay! The location is perfect — everything is close by and easy to reach. The apartment looks exactly like in the photos: clean, modern, and very comfortable. The support team — Edmar, May, and Nica — were incredibly helpful and always available 24/7 for anything we needed. Highly recommend!

The AC was not properly sized to properly cool the room. It’s a thin window so alot of the heat gets in as well. If you’re in the 5th floor, the unit has no central AC. 5th floor is also very loud when it rains, doesn’t seem to have sound insulation between roof and room. Checking in is relatively burdensome since you have to download an app, scan all your info in; if there’s a problem with checking in, you have to go through a chat… the chat is automated with an AI that feels as advanced as AOL chat bot. Even though everything in terms of chat should be kept in the Airbnb chat; When I got there, they put me on the 5th floor. The elevator only goes to the 4th floor(they put this in the description to be fair but I wanted to reiterate it.) But the last thing you want to do after a 17 hour flight is carry 60lbs of luggage to your room. In short, just a lot of bad things that piled up. I ended up just staying at the andaz hotel most of the time instead
Nice room, great location
Very clean space and easy to access with the app. The only negative was that the hot water was very limited for 1 person, let alone if you had any more than that.
Nice place to stay. Everything was super clean, incredible
Everything was great, like always. :) Big thanks to Vannie, Maica, and Edmar!

Overall good. The room is tiny, appears to have been converted from a hallway, with no sitting/eating area at all. I definitely wouldn’t try to prepare anything more than a cup of tea in the kitchenette.
As others have mentioned, the construction noises next door are unfortunate; I ended up taking my laptop to work elsewhere rather than try to do it from the room.
But all that said, it’s clean and well lit and absolutely functional for a place to crash at the end of the day. The combination of AI assistant plus real life staff works well.
The host is very supportive and communicative. We would definitely recommend others to stay here. It is such a pleasure to staying here

No tengo queja alguna sobre el airbnb. La ubicación en Clarke Quay fue ideal y el apartamento queda a 1 cuadra del metro. Hay muchos restaurantes alrededor y siento que es un excelente lugar para una corta estadía en Singapur
Easy check-in, felt very private and enjoyed the laundry services
Ubicación excelente y buen wifi!
Great place, very well located, with an extremely attentive and friendly staff. Highly recommended!
Great, cosy space that is perfectly located close to MRT and the heart of Singapore. Very friendly hosts.
Another fantastic stay! Overall a great experience - check in was easy with help from Cherry and the customer service was on another level.  Always a great place!

It's a beautiful studio, has everything you need and it's very well maintained.
I don't give 5 stars just because the premise doesn't have a gym or a pool. But other than that it's like a 5 stars stay.

Cozy spot right between Clarke Quay  and Boat Quay. Great for nightlife and late night eats. Central enough that you can get almost anywhere quickly. 2 minutes' walk away from nearest MRT. Despite the proximity to the nightlife, I was able to sleep quite easily. Owners were attentive and very helpful. They allowed me to extend my stay slightly for my trip which helped a lot. Place provides room cleaning service once or twice per week. Contains great amenities as well such as a fridge, microwave, and dishes. Also has a local phone that can be used free of charge for local calls and researching stuff to do. Place was quite small and is probably only good for 1-2 people max. In the hall there were two washer-dryer sets which is helpful for longer stays. Detergent was provided as well. Overall I had a great stay and would definitely recommend booking this place.

Excellent place to stay in Clarke Quay. I love it very much especially the comfortable bed and pillow, just like a 5 star hotel! Toilet is clean too :). I was attended by friendly Cher upon check-in and thank you very much for accommodating to my request. I hope to come back real soon! Thanks Heritage Apartment!
Very responsive hosts.

I really enjoyed my stay here! It was incredibly clean and Cherry was very responsive to all of my questions! I would say the location is in an ideal location - somewhat of a midpoint between marina bay sands and the suntec convention center where I was having a conference. The room is a bit small - maybe if it were slightly cheaper it would be ideal. However, I really appreciated the washer/dryer so I didn't have to bring an insane amount of clothes. Overall a great experience. Would stay w/ Heritage apts again.
Good place to stay

The apartment is wonderful! As a solo working traveler it had everything I needed to enjoy my stay. Also Jarwin was a wonderful host! He always answered all my questions really quick. The location is perfect, pretty close to the Marina Bay, super market, restaurants and pubs. I'd definitely go back!!

A clean and cozy apartment with great location. The guest relationship manager, Jarwin, was so nice to get me settled in and help me with my luggage. Nice trip and nice guys in Singapore. thank you so much again.
Convenient location, clean space and extra friendly hosts such as Jarwin and Adrian. The room is pricey but is located in the city centre so very understandable.
Good location, clean and tidy, communication was good, the host is very responsive, Jarwin is helpful and friendly.

Place is at great location. Lots of eateries nearby- very close to river view. Coming to host- they are really sweet and helping. I was welcomed by Jarwin, who really took care of all my needs. He was on vacations but still kept a check on me if I need anything-Thanks Jarwin 😊
Jarwin was extremely helpful and checked on me throughout my stay! Was my personal concierge through my stay thanks Jarwin
. Great location

Clean, has all the essentials, and is located right in the hub of Singapore nightlife. Staff offer great service. A little small if you plan to spend a lot of time there, but perfect if you're just looking for a place to crash.

I thoroughly enjoyed the hospitality of the staff from Heritage apartments. The staff were very responsive to the queries. A shoutout to Jarwin who assisted me with the luggage and a smooth check in. Jarwin was also kindful to extend my check out time as I had to attend to last minute errands.
The location is fantastic. Everthing from CBD and MRT are within 3-5 mins reach. Food options are plenty.
A great place for business as well as for people on vacation.

Kind, fast and responsive personnel, great location downtown, clean and modern,washer and drier makes stay in tropical climate practical and efficient.Near subway/MRT and major buss connections. Near shops and restaurants. Quiet despite being by the main road-good sound insulation. Clean and maintained AC.

An amazing place to stay, Jarwin was incredibly helpful, communicating with me very often in order to make sure that everything was fine. The place is very clean, modern, and well furnished. There was everything… laundry, Apple TV with Netflix, very fast internet, local phone with calls and data, etc. I'd recommend this place to anyone visiting or working in Singapore.
I personally would be staying back here if I’d be sent back to Singapore.
A well equipped single apartment located in a near perfect area for dining and drinking.
Great location. Great hospitality.

最高の立地、MRT Clarke Quay（NE5 パープルライン）駅まで１ブロック（徒歩約３分程）アパートの真横と道の向かいは夜、飲屋街、セブンイレブンがあり、食べることには困らない。部屋は思ったより狭く、スーツケースを広げるスペースがほぼなかった。キッチンウェアも全て揃っていて簡単な料理は問題ない。冷蔵庫も冷凍庫も大きく大変便利。チャイナタウン、ラッフェルズまで歩いて行ける距離。バスの路線もかなり多く、どこに行くにも便利な場所。宿泊前日の予約にも関わらず敏速な対応でチェックインもスムース。朝早い便で到着したので前日から予約をして朝はキーボックスで鍵を受け取り（全てメールで画像付きでわかりやすい説明　英文）特に私をアシストしてくれたJARWINは細かく困ったことがないかいつも気にしていてくれて、WHATSAPPでいつもコントタクトしてくれます。チェックアウトの際も、スーツケースが３つあったので、お部屋から運んでもらい、外に出して、車まで運んでくれました。とても助かりました。ありがとうございます。
Hosts were very quick to respond. Location very good. Close to the city centre. Room is exactly like the pictures provided. Will definitely stay here again!
Good place to stay! They respond very well.
Great host and great location!

nice environment next to Clarke Quay
the apartment was well equipped and serviced
This was an excellent experience and a lot better that the price reflects.  It was a very good stay!

I had a great stay here. You have easy access to good food and public transportation in walking distance. The room is compact, very clean and comfortable. Fast internet, free netflix and a washer and dryer + the soap for it. 10/10 would stay again

Great location! Within 1.5 blocks from two train stations. Lots of places to eat just steps away from the front door. Nightclubs a couple blocks away, but I didn’t find it too noisy and I always have earplugs, anyway. The room was a great mini-apartment: bed, smart TV with Netflix subscription, full fridge, large window, sink, microwave, iron, bathroom with shower, AC. I appreciated that they provided toiletries like bath soap, laundry soap, and  shampoo. My only quibble was that I had trouble with the dryer on the 2nd floor, but Jarwin informed me there’s a dryer on the 3rd floor and said he’d get the 2nd floor one fixed the next day, so very responsive. I enjoyed my stay here.
Great spot to stay for a couple days. Awesome location.
Well Maintained, clean place to stay, with all essential amenities and great host!

Great location
Sparkling clean
Instant responses and easy communication. Total Bang for bucks, would stay again.
Great location. Clean, tidy and had every I needed. Host was very helpful as well on arrival.
Excellent location and great space! I don't have anything negative to say and would definitely stay here again.
Great location, great hosts. You do need to schedule check ins as someone needs to let you in.
This was a great place to stay! The location puts you within walking distance of everything! Check-in and check-out were easy and quick thanks to Jarwin!

Really nice space, exactly what the pictures show. Like exactly. If there isn’t a photo of a window you don’t have a window so that’s something to keep in mind. Really amazing location and great response team from the hosts. Under the beds could use a nice sweep but the shower was honestly amazing. A nice treat to end my trip after staying in hostels.
Great location, near a ton of bars and restaurants. Lots of nightlife choices. Plus the room has everything you need. Highly recommended!
Good location. Close to the river and Marina Bay

They allowed to leave luggage 🧳 until check-in
They cleaned rooms every week
Appartment is in the center, everything is nearby, especially amazing walk near the river
As expected, great place to stay in the city. Customer service was excellent!
Arynna is very considerate and patient, very easy to communicate with
A spacious place to relax, with a strategic location and full access to shopping malls, food centres, entertainment venues and even for leisurely walks.
It's a very nice experience in Heritage Collection during the SHN period. Thanks for the help from Arynna. A good place to stay even traveling. Quite convenient and cozy.
Nice place. Strategic.
Jarwin and Jolene were very helpful and made my day by enabling early check-in. Communication worked very well, have stayed with Heritage before and price/quality is great.
Been staying at Heritage for Stay-cations.  Clarence has been excellent among the 2 times I have stayed. A special mention to Bill a first meeting, Really Great service guys.
Really nice staying here! Thanks Veronica, Khine and jarwin for their thoughtful help during my stay!

The room was just as the pictures and cleanliness was really good. I was also impressed with the kitchen facilities. Location was also great for exploring clark quay, boat quay and the bay areas. I had asked to keep my bags before check in and they were quick to say it was ok but there wasn't any communication till I messaged the day i was to arrive. They eventually took my bags so not too much of a problem. Staff were courteous and nice.

Great spot in Singapore and super clean! The communication is excellent with hosts too. I found it so useful that there was a washer dryer too and hadn’t realised that detergent is in the bathroom cupboard!
Important to note that a deposit needs to put down upon arrival before you have access to your room. 👍
It's a scam guys. The room I got was a closet with no windows. They never replied didn't get a refund either. I went to a real hotel...
I am very happy with Heritage. The room was exactly as advertised and Ken and Wenny were very helpful when it came to assisting me with checking in and out.

This place is exactly what you need for a great and simple base for a trip into SG CBD. The place was easy to access and leverages great tech to make access smooth. The space was clean and good quality with super helpful washer and dryer amenities. They’ve even thought of everything including individual room clothes detergent.
Would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a quality place to stay with all the basics well attended to and with no hassle!

Really nice place, great location, you’ve literally got everything you need like restaurants, shops, bars and the metro within a few minute walk. I came for the F1 and the track was literally like a 5-10 minute walk too. Comfy bed and really helpful hosts too. I’ll book again if I come for the F1 again!

Everything was great! The staff was very helpful and always available to answer questions or assist with anything you need. The room was exactly as described and shown on the picture, very clean and it had everything you might need. The location is great! Close to Marina Bay, Central Business District and Chinatown. Lots of dining options around as well as cafes and bars! Can only recommend!
Thankyou to the wonderful hosts I had at Clarke Quay! It was a great stay, very central to all sights in the heart of Singapore. Easy mobile check-in and all the amenities needed for a week’s stay.

The room I was in was exactly like the photos. The shower and air con were great as well as all the other amenities such as fridge and freezer.
The location is 3min walk from Clarke Quay MRT from where most places can be reached in 20mins max. There are lots of bars and restaurants within a short walk too.

Overall a small but nice and clean room in a perfect place. Everything close by, team always very kind and available via messenger.
I had a bit of bad luck as check-in did not work as expected and texting with the team in the basement w/o AC has been sweaty.
Then a curtain was missing in my room which made sleeping and changing clothes uncomfortable (curtain has been replaced on day 2).
Later a water leakage in the bathroom forced me to pack my stuff and move to another apartment across the road.
Without the issues it could have been a perfect stay.
Very very helpful staff! The room is perfectly designed. I had everything I needed and  felt right at home. I will definitely stay here again.
Good stay with good amenities. Location is good and easily get to the center. Only thing is that the walls are thin so you hear the next room
Nice place, in a very good area. The place is enough for one person and it has everything you need. The communication with the hosts was perfect. I recommend it!

I wish I could have canceled staying here but there is no refund policy. As a result, there was immediately a mismatch. The bed is tiny and the place is not marked well on the map so Grab/taxis never go to the right location. The pillows are impossibly hard and thick so it hurts your neck, though the staff made efforts to make them more usable.
The staff was very responsive on whats app when their checkin app didn't work. If you're on a low budget, stay here as it's fresh and clean but DO NOT book if you can afford a full size bed somewhere else.

Mehr als zufrieden mit dieser Unterkunft. Ein ziemlich großes Zimmer mit einer kleinen Küche und zudem eine sehr saubere Unterkunft. Ich konnte mein Gepäck vor dem Check-In in der Unterkunft lagern und mir wurde direkt geschrieben sobald ich einchecken konnte. Sehr nettes und hilfsbereites Personal. Die Unterkunft hatte eine super Lage. Bis zur nächsten Bus und MRT-Station waren es ca. 5 Minuten Gehweg. Was man allerdings beachten sollte ist, dass in der Gegend ein paar Clubs sind und es deshalb durch die Musik Nachts etwas lauter werden könnte. Ich kann diese Unterkunft nur empfehlen!

The team at Heritage were very responsive. It was great being able to message them and have such a quick response. They were very helpful looking after my luggage when I arrived early and answering my questions. It was all very easy with great facilities and instructions for everything. The bed was very comfy!

I would recommend this place to all my friends! This is a greater place to stay — walking distance to restaurants, the best Hawker Center, malls, grocery, breakfast places, etc. Though Singapore is a very walkable city anyway. Hosts are so nice, lightning fast to responds, and very friendly. I will stay again!
The only thing is that it is a really great value 1 person, price-wise and size-wise. For 2 people, staying in a regular hotel is quite comparable.

Great location, room was as pictured, single bed.  Their app rated 1 star at App store  is your key.  The app showed room 36sb20 on IPhone, truncated.  Called 8 times to their Cust svc phone- no answer.  Finally their other property answered and got me in. 80 minutes delay to get in room. Save all their phone numbers.  Later there was also Chinese couple that could not get in their room.
入住很方便，提前几天工作人员就会联系确认，入住和开门都可以在 app 上完成。房间冷气很足，有冰箱和微波炉，也有窗户可以看到街景。性价比高，如果下次来新加坡，应该还是会住这里。谢谢Kim, Ed 和 Ryan 提供的服务

Great value in the heart of Singapore near restaurants, bars, and transit. Very clean and we'll taken care of. Only downside is that I was given a room on the street side, and there was some music playing from something nearby, so it was kind of hard to sleep.

Good place to stay for a few days. The apartment is as described. Great location. The check-in process seems to be very complicated at first, but turned out to work smoothly. Bed linen was a bit dirty but overall cleanliness was acceptable. Proactive and friendly communication from the hosts.

Location, location, location! Short 10min walk from the light rail to the airport, across the street from Boat Quay with restaurants and bars, 20min walk to Singapore Museum and Asian Civilizations Museum. Room looks just as described. Hosts communicate on text and are very helpful. Highly recommended!!

Looks just like the pictures, clean and the hosts are very responsive. They also gave me recommendations for places to eat and drink. My one complaint is the extensive check in process. Other than that everything was great
Der Check-In war am Anfang etwas tricky, aber wenn man es erst mal kapiert hat, war alles sehr einfach. Sonst alles sehr fein!

Très bon emplacement, à 10-15 minutes à pied de la marina, bien desservi par les transports en communs, proche des commerces et restaurants.
Appartement très propre et accueil chaleureux.

Communication was very quick and easy. Accommodation was clean and suitable for what was required. The door entry system, although digital was fine. Within walking distance of metro.
Thanks Vannie, Maica & Edmar
Aufenthalt war top! Lage direkt zentral, alles zu Fuß erreichbar. Check-in super easy und man konnte Heritage Mitarbeiter jeder Zeit erreichen, falls ich fragen hatte
Great little place and a good location for local food options. Compact but with all the needed amenities.
Good place for a short stay

Took me couple min to figure out how to use the elevator (same as room door). Other than that, great location, many things to do/place to eat within walking distance (though I would avoid walking outdoor in the afternoon -- it's just too hot).
Very friendly and welcoming during check in and check out
Location is very convenient to every tourist spots.
Small space but packs a punch. Great location
Great space to live at

Great place and location is good, managed to even see the fireworks.
Wide variety of eateries nearby.
Would recommend!
地板會一種潮濕既感覺，不過開了一段時間冷氣吹乾就好一點，廚房枱面附近有些小蟻，所以不太敢放食物，煲水後會立刻拿到大廳放，員工都很好，出入都打招呼和笑容，最後離開時還主動幫我地call的士！謝謝！
Great place
Great space, Great location will definitely stay again!
It’s a great little spot, good value, comfortable and with good views. The team are hospitable, friendly, and good communicators.
A+ Location. Nice terasse
交通便利，大阳台加分，电梯很吵，尤其晚上声音很明显，房间空间不大，三个大人两个箱子，显得有些拥挤了，前台的服务不错的

I arrived at site only to find out that the boutique hotel has been closed for a year. Called and enquire but was treated badly by host. This listing should be taken down so as to not mislead future customers. Very bad experience for me.
Contacted Airbnb and was able to get a full refund of the booking.
Klein aber fein :)

服務人員都非常熱情，需要幫助時也很熱心，整個旅程三個晚上都住在這，有被照顧到的感覺。
地理位置非常好，附近餐廳便宜又好吃，距離最近的商場只要走路5分鐘，散步到新達城或魚尾獅公園也是15-20分鐘左右，超級推薦👍。
Good place, easy communication and listing is as described. Great host for my colleagues. Highly recommend their place.
房间离市中心很近，周围有很多好吃的
Small & cozy environment! Perfect for short stay
The room was cosy and delivered what I needed! Thanks, Geraldine :)
Nice

Small room, great location. Bathroom needs maintenance as getting rough around the edges.
Sound insulation on the room is not good especially with other inconsiderate guests making lots of noise when walking and talking in the hall way.

The room it's for Solo travellers ( like me :). It was very clean, and the housekeeper ask me every day for cleaning and give me 2 bottles with water. The personal was very helpful, they keep my baggage after I checked out.
I recommend this place.
Nice small room. Clean, had everything you need.
The no-window single-person room was small, but lovely. I liked the custom design of the furniture.
Great place!

This place is really a good value for your money. Have been looking for an affordable private room in SG and I am so glad to come across this place. The room is big, roomy even for 2 people. There are just minimal furnishings inside the room - bed, cabinet, and television - but this is just really what you need. Aircon is great especially with the hot weather in SG. Outside, there's a washing machine and dryer you may use, a small pantry, and a fridge. There are 5 shared bathrooms -they are a bit small but serves their purpose. Lots of cheap and delicious restaurants nearby - I can get a good meal for less than SGD 5. I also love the fruit stands nearby. It's around 10-12 min walk to Aljunied station but on the way there I can eat a meal, buy fruits, buy Bee Cheng Hiang that you won't notice that you're already near the MRT station. Just found it hard to find the place initially because I went out the wrong exit and totally messed up on how I was reading the map. Lastly, Ec was very responsive. He provided the directions as soon as I booked it and regularly checks on me. What else do backpackers like me need to know? hmmm...they provide towel (big one) but no hairdryer and no toiletries. They allow you to keep your luggage within the floor (outside the room though) after you checkout. Will definitely consider this place again when I return to SG. It's a very convenient place to stay, thanks Ec!

Located in the middle of China town. A supermarket selling a variety of things just down the street on the corner. Trust us, we did it) A kettle, hotplate, microwave and saucepan provided, which made making cheap noodle dinners easy. A washing machine and drier provided. Plenty of toilets and showers, electric hot water, so you don't run out. Never had to wait for a bathroom. Toilet roll kept in your room cupboard, as toilets are wet rooms. The bed was very uncomfortable, the springs were sticking out and it was painful. The windows are very thin so the China town noise comes into the room until 3am (earplugs or heavy sleepers required). Air conditioner worked very well. One English channel on TV (news). Self check in very easy, with picture instructions sent to you. Unfortunately when we walked into the room there was a scurrying cochroach to greet us. There are cochroach traps throughout the place and it is Asia, this was just one trap evasive bug. He was promptly released. Singapore is a very expensive place, so this place was cheaper on average and supplied adequate facilities.

Mik’s place is all you can wish for a traveler.Bright,spacious,extremely clean and very well organized.It is 5 mints to MRT and Newton food court. I also liked the small treats left in the room for guests and Mik’s attitude to help her guess with anything they might need.I can’t recommend it enough-just try it for yourself.

This was our first bad airbnb experience. We arrived late from a night flight and we were looking forward to a good night sleep.
We couldn’t sleep because the neighbour downstairs was throwing a very loud party. At 2am we went downstairs to ask him to turn the music down. He swore at us, told us that airbnbers have no right to complain, slammed the door, and didn’t turn the music down. Party went on until 3:30am. The host did not help us to resolve the issue -we asked Mik to speak to him or call the police but she didn’t do any of those.
All we had was a very bad experience and a sleepless night.
On a side note- there was another guest in the house which we were not aware of at the time of booking.
Хорошее, комфортное и чистое жильё недалёко от станции метро. Очень хорошая и гостеприимная хозяйка. Помогла решить все возникшие небольшие вопросы.
Comodo departamento, cerca del metro y lugares de interes
Very caring hostess! Goes out of her way to make your stay extra pleasant!

Die Unterkunft war genau wie beschrieben, es war alles sehr sauber, man hat sein eigenes Reich mit eigenem Bad. Wir durften Waschen und uns beim Tee und Kaffee bedienen. Einziger kleiner Nachteil: man hat etwa 10-15min zu Fuss zur Orchard Street oder 5min zur Metro. Wirklich im Zetist man also nicht. Es gibt aber einen tollen Food Court, der etwa 3min entfernt liegt. Alles in allem hat es uns sehr gut gefallen und für den Preis echt unschlagbar!

Mik’s place is located in a nice, welcoming neighbourhood of Singapore. It’s tucked away in a street that’s not too bustling with traffic, yet really near Newton MRT and the popular food centre that opens till late. The place is a short walk to the hustle and bustle of the main shopping street Orchard Road. The apartment is well equipped and cozy. Thank you Mik for your quick, friendly responses and being so hospitable!

This is my first experience in Airbnb, and Mik is a great host. If you are on a budget trip to Singapore I strongly recommend Mik's apartment. Her apartment is Clean, Neat, Easy to access MRT stations and taxis, Bus stop is so close to her place, and its a quite & peaceful area in Singapore. Some times her friend/ friends come to home but no worries they wont even use guest's space, the guests will have full privacy. I would like to thank Mik again for all facilities provided by her, especially facilities provided by her for cooking ;-) for those who would like to know more about her space please read my detailed review below.
You will have a King size bed, A/C room, ample space to walk around, 2 chairs, One wardrobe, few cloth Hangers, one table etc. inside bedroom. She will provide a separate key to lock your bedroom and one spare key to enter her apartment. You can go in and out at anytime as you like. You don't need to ring her bell at night after you are back from your busy trips, just open the door using your spare keys. Keep your footwear inside apartment next to the entrance. You will next enter in to a living room area, where you can sit and read. pls. note There are no Televisions for entertainment ( you may not need one as you have to prepare for next day trip ) . The bedroom, Bathroom & kitchen are located on the left side of the living room, where you have full privacy, as she wont cook much in there. We can use her kitchen, we use to cook everyday ( light foods like Noodle, Ready to cook items and coffee) as we are allergic to certain foods bought from outside. We can use her Plates, Cooking Gas, Refrigerator, Electric Kettel Etc. We can wash our clothes and there is a small space to hang our cloths too. You can iron your cloths, and she will provide an iron board too. You can use all these without any other cost. But please remember that you have to clean her plates and kitchen each time after you use, and place every item you pick back to its original position :-) . Bathroom is always neat and clean. She will provide enough tissues inside bathroom and bedroom. There are lot of sticky notes everywhere :-0 ( instructions by her ) you just have to follow the sticky notes to do everything right :-) .... She don't like to mingle with her guests much, as she is busy with her works and all, but she will be there in her apartment after her working hours and you can text her any time asking your doubts and all she will reply ASAP. oh ya .. and you can use her hi speed wifi also. MIKI Thank You very much for making our days memorable !!

L’appartement de Mik est idéalement situé, au calme avec salle de bain privé. À quelques minutes d’un super marché « street food » , quelques minutes du metro Newton station qui vous emmène en 10 minutes vers tous les attraits de la ville, La Marina bay et Garden by the bay, le jardin botanique. Vous pourrez aussi marcher 10 minutes pour rejoindre Orchard street (paradis du shopping) bref, un endroit idéal pour séjourner quelques jours pour découvrir cette magnifique ville!
Très accessible depuis l’aéroport en métro.
Très bonne adresse!!!

Spacious and comfortable private space within a light and airy apartment. Mik was friendly, helpful and prompt with communication. Short walk to MRT and food court and slightly longer walk to Orchard Rd.  Room is internal but has good natural light (windows both sides) and air conditioning to keep air cool and fresh. Recommended!
Excellent host and hospitality. Excellent place.
Private space, clean room, near food court
Great place. Near train station and local food.  Will stay again if we have a chance.  Thanks

Mik’s place is in a great location; you will have a complete feeling of independence as the room is located at the bottom of the apartment; We enjoyed a lot staying here because it felt just like you have a « pied à terre » in Singapore; we highly recommend you staying at Mik’s as you will feel home away from home. Miiki is very accommodating and relaxed. Love the area as it was very convenient to public transport buses and the MRT. Nice place to stay, will come again.

Miki is a great host.  The place is very stylish and the room is big and private - that whole side of the place is separate.  She made me feel very at home.  The location is just down the street from one of the nicer Hawker centers (outside food markets) that I saw in Singapore.  It's a quick walk to the Orchard shopping center too.

She is a good host because she made sure to communicate before our arrival and inform us on any inconvenience and even after, she made sure to check on us.
Would highly recommend her place

Decent place to stay for two nights. Host was very responsive and the place was safe/ very well located. We didn't make use of it but there was a kitchen area and washing machine available for use too. It was comfortable and I would recommend for the price point. Thanks!

The apartment is really good.My husband perfer a private bathroom n quite bedroom,the apartment location is really good,near Newton FC n not far away from Orchard Rd.The owner show us some welcome gifts(including chocolates,bottle water,tissues etc.),n told us several iformation around abt the food republic.We stayed in the apartment 2 nights,n this is our second time to stay in Singapor,we feel lucky 2 visit here.
Miki is a friendly host, quick to respond to any queries and will try to help you as best as she can.

Miki is very fexible and very quickly to answer your inquiries by message. We were very indepent in our room. It was very easy to settle in.  We had plenty of soap, towers and some food details to welcome us. It is very well located. 5 min walk a place to eat and Newton metro. Thank you very much.
small bedroom . private toilet. public balcony. not much persons. ideal for single travelers. ok for couples. very near to mrt.
I enjoy staying at Mikii's bedroom. It's within a private area of her flat. It was calm and really close to the main subway line. Would stay there again.
Mik’s place was perfect for what we needed. Great location, clean place, friendly host and air-conditioning. Thanks a lot for welcoming us into your home.

The place is value for money, serene, tidy and close to Newton MRT. We had slight difficulty guiding the cab on the first day but once we figured the route to Newton MRT from apartment, it was all good.

Mikii is a really good host! We are happy to live here. The room is clean n tidy,you can barefoot walking. And it’s convenient to take the MRT to everywhere you want. It’s a nice experience in Singapore!
The bedroom looks like servants room converted to bedroom. The toilet is away from bedroom. There is no elevator at least till September 18.
Great place to stay for those with a tight budget.

A great stay at an extremely convenient location. Mik’s place is very spacious (and private) by Singapore standards and Newton Station (about 5 min away) is extremely well connected to the MRT system. Mik is a wonderful host. She went above and beyond to accommodate our travel schedule. We are so glad that we choose this Airbnb.
The place is super clean, quite and we have our own privacy.  Mikii is very kind and thougtfull. We enjoy staying at her place.

Spacious, clean, stylish apartment, the separate bathroom gave us all the privacy we needed. Communication was smooth and felt like we always had the help when it was needed. 10 min walk to Orchard Road, Newton MRT is very close, it was easy to get around! Thank you for everyhing!

Mik was a great host and very communicative. Just a short walk to the MRT with a popular food court nearby for both breakfast and dinner options. Very clean, spacious space and a good base for traveling. Thanks Mik for the stay!

We enjoyed Mik’s place, and found it to be ideally located for our needs. Very convenient to MRT, food stalls, and Orchard Road shopping. We did not see much of Mik during our stay.
The bedroom was very comfortable and the private space was spacious. We would consider staying again on our next trip!

It was a lovely stay at Mik's place. I enjoyed the private space and so having bathroom outside the bedroom didn't feel like a problem at all. Bedding and the space were so clean. Her place is so clean and neat, beautiful and comfortble. I am very impressed with her room's decoration. It brightens up the place and make me feel good.

Great place to stay in Singapore. The bed was extremely comfortable, it was nice to have a private bathroom, and Mik was quick to respond.

Mik’s place was exactly as expected! Cozy room. Good location near orchard and Newton Food Centre as well as MRT. She was quick to answer any messages and made sure we had plenty of towels. 非常干净的房间，超乎想象的住宿体验。房东人很好，虽然不会说中文，但是加了微信，沟通毫无障碍。下次再来新加坡还会选择Mikii的家。谢谢照顾！

Great location in Singapore. I spent a lot of time at the Newton food market a 5 minute walk away. Easy to get to via MRT from the airport and to get around Singapore. Would really recommend this place. Thank you Mik!

This is the first time i travel to Singapore which is strange somehow, some days before arrived, she texted me some direction pics on the way to get her apt which is so detailed direction, her password wifi, her phone no, and address, and of course which MRT name. Reasonable distance to MRT and the food court near by is actually really good,the room is super cozy for two and clean,Mik is very thoughtful in every little detail to make sure her guests have a comfortable stay.

Mk’s place is great. She is so nice to let us in early. We appreciated her kindness after 22 hours flying from US. Everything is perfect. Thank you for your accomodation! We will stay again at her place when we are in Singapore next time!
The room is clean, spacious and private. Located near Orchard, it is convenient to reach most attractions and shopping malls. Thank Miki for preparing a nice place to stay during this Singapore trip.

Great location only a few minutes walk from Newton Road MRT.
Mikii was very helpful and flexible with arrival and leaving times, which was extremely helpful!
The accommodation is a private room with good air con along with private bathroom and a shared kitchen, in which we were able to cook our own breakfasts.

Sehr gute Erreichbarkeit zur Newton Station & von da aus ruckzuck in der Innenstadt. Check in und Check out funktioniert reibungslos.
Very well placed, closed to MRT station, closed to downtown but far enough to be quiet. Host is not bothering you. You can find newer place, but more expensive. Great value for money.
Nice place. Good location for everywhere really. All good.

My husband and I stayed here for our short trip at Singapore for my cousin's wedding. This place is very convenient to the MRT station and a decent hawker centre that is open till pretty late at night.
The house was well furnished and tidy, and our room and toilet area was clean and much spacious than we thought!

Although we did not meet Mikii in person during our stay, she was easy to contact via WhatsApp and very helpful when we had questions.

Highly recommend this place and will definitely come again!

Miki’s place is convenient with full facilities. It takes around 8 mins to Newton Foodcourt and 10 mins to MRT. MK’s a super nice host. Her place also spacious for an expensive city like Singapore. My girlfriend and I have great time there. Highly recommend for couples!

Had a great time staying at Mikii's. She was away during our visit but responded quickly to queries we had. We found the room very spacious and it was easy to get around (10 min walk to public transport and local restaurants). Would definitely stay again.
Roomy, clean. Close to MRT and bus stations. You can find lots of variety foods at Newton food center
Cozy room for short stay, extremely convenient to take MRT and cab to downtown, highly recommended to all travelers.

The room is definitely not "chic", but what you see is what you get :)

Miki very nice lady stay at her apartment for 4 nights, easy check in n out , very private, short walk to newton MTR station and food center.

Super great and very accommodating host! We really recommend this place as it is quiet, peaceful and very near Orchard. :)

The apartment is cozy and clean, perfect for couples and for short stays to visit Singapore. I would recommend it for its cleaness, its nice amenities and the excellent service provided by the host!
This place was clean and in a fantastic location. Mik was very helpful and always responded quickly to our messages. Would certainly stay here again!
Our stay was ok and Miki communicated with us very well throughout.

Great host to deal with. Recommended!

When I arrived S welcomed me and made me a tour of the area (metro station, grocerie stores, etc). S always looked out for me during my stay, I really appreciate all the attentions.
The apartment is beautiful and very clean and it has all I needed in my stay. The building, common areas and the neighborhood exceeded my expectations. The roof top view is amazing. Overall a great stay!

It is a very short walk to a bus station and about 7 minutes to the nearest MRT/subway train. Between the buses and trains you can easily get anywhere in Singapore. Unser Gastgeber hat sich vor unserer Anreise schon bei uns gemeldet und uns alle wichtigen Details mitgeteilt. Während unseres Aufenthaltes hat er sich immer wieder bei uns erkundigt, ob alles zufriedenstellend ist und ob er uns behilflich sein kann.
Am Tag der Abreise könnten wir die Unterkunft noch zwei Stunden länger nutzen als cheque out Zeit, da unser Flieger erst am Nachmittag ging.
Alles in allem eine sehr schöne Unterkunft, die wir nur weiterempfehlen können.

房子是藏在树里面的，前院里有我很喜欢的鸡蛋花，从树上落在石板路上很漂亮。房间很舒服，虽然新加坡很潮湿，但是房间里完全没有味道。房间院子都没有积水，几乎没有蚊子，而且房东还准备了蚊香。公共的活动空间也很大，孩子很喜欢小动物，院子里有鸡鹦鹉狗狗和乌龟。早上在鸡鸣声中醒来，房间还有配备耳塞，想睡懒觉也不用担心被吵到而睡不好。家里面有收藏的画和其它艺术品，装修古朴典雅，大部分家具家装都是实木制的，很成风格。主人很随和，在她家里做饭一起吃饭聊天很开心。步行五分钟就可以到地铁站，附近还有一个小市场和小小的购物中心。

首先，非常抱歉，因为工作的事情，没能及时做评价。
对于在peir家里生活的四天时间，像家一样的感觉，表示十分的感谢。肯定强烈推荐给大家，并且详细的做一些分享。
1、如何到达？
地铁“美世界”站下车，走B出口，出来后左转沿上坡路（Chun Tin Rd）到第三个路口右转。(Lor Pisang Bari),第二个路口(Lor Pisang Raja，16)
准确步行470米，7分钟，有些上坡路，所以带老人孩子的，有点心理准备。
2、附近有什么？
地铁B出口前行，一整排，近1公里的美食餐厅。地铁A出口，是类似国内小百货的购物中心，有超市。除此，在加油站附近有个类似公租房的住宅区，好像住的都是华人，楼下有很多经济实惠的商铺餐厅。重点，都会讲中文。所以不大会英语的朋友放心随便走走。
3、Peir的家
这是一幢富有文化，充满爱的别墅。可以看到叔叔收藏的许多珍贵精致的古董、摆件，旧式古钟。随处还能见到整个家庭成员的照片，有全家的，个人的。充满了浓浓的家的气息。仅这一点，就可以给100分。我太喜欢这样感觉的房子了。
4、关于住宿。
房子从1～3层，现在分享出来的是2层的一间主卧，南面，西面都有窗子，有大的衣柜，床有1.5米。特别适合情侣，夫妻入住。（2层还有叔叔和peir的卧室）
3层是个大阁楼间，通过一个很特别的艺术旋转楼梯上去。
1楼客厅位置有1个洗手间。
2楼和3楼共用1个洗手间。所以，如果比较介意公用洗手间的朋友，还请注意了。
5、需要注意的？
a、因为有位菲佣妹妹，所以那怕房子这么大，东西这么多，都是非常非常干净的。进屋需要赤脚。可能有两个原因，一是习惯，二是可以在上楼下楼时或走动中尽所能不影响到他人。我是ok的。但如果你是不习惯赤脚的人，可以自备一双干净的托鞋在家里使用。
b、洗手间没有酒店那种一次性洁具。所以要自带牙具和洗漱用品。有提供浴巾，洗沐露。
c、家里有好多鸡，不是来吃的，是宠物哦。还有一条被遗弃收养来的大狗，还有鹦鹉，还有奇特的神龟。所以你要是怕鸡鸣，怕动物的，也要注意了。反正我是喜欢的不行的。
d、洗衣机可以免费使用，还有专门给客人用的大冰箱，以及各种咖啡茶品。也可以使用家里的厨房用品。
最后，如果你是一个随和的，温暖的，不挑剔的人，peir的家会是你在新加坡最好的选择。因为，在这里，你就像回到家里一样。

He gave me and my friend a room at the first floor which was right next to the reception hall (I think it used to be a storage space but they redesigned it into a room that fits 4 capsules). We could hear all the talking, music, laughter in the hallway and since I can't sleep in a loud environment, I asked the Indian man (who seemed like the boss) if we can get a room upstairs. He said no and said that all the rooms were fully booked. That was absolute nonsense because my friend and I booked separately, and we were assigned a bed right next to each other in the same 1st floor same room. And we checked in exactly at 3 p.m. which is the opening hours. Which basically means, since we were the first to check in, he gave us the worst spots. And he lied that there were no other rooms(beds) left in any other place. Absolute nonsense. If that was true, then my friend and I would probably be assigned different beds in different rooms. Nope. My friend and I were assigned the same room. That means that they assign the bed at check in. And now that we wanted to change the rooms (regardless of the fact that there were probably rooms left in the second floor), he said no. Moreover, he said 'If you want some other room, you are asking me to put someone else in the 1st floor. That's very "NICE" of you' in a super sarcastic way. WHAT???? Then you putting me in the first floor is a nice thing? You shouldn't have made rooms in the 1st floor in the first place bro. Just because he wants to make a few more bucks, he sacrifices the convenience of the 4 ppl who need to use the 1st floor capsules. Wow. What a businessman. Absolute trash. If you are looking for a pod capsule hotel, just find another one. There are tons in that area. And this place costs 2~3 times more than any other one in the area. - Great location, 10 mins walk to Bugis Station metro, plenty to do in the area
- Quiet at night, the pod was dark if you closed the curtain
- Strong wifi, plenty of outlets
- Breakfast was simple but nice to be included
Cons:
- The pods themselves are very stuffy with poor air circulation. I had to go out and buy a fan, which only helped a little bit. If you want air coming into your pod, you will have to keep the privacy curtain open, which is unfortunate at night because the light in the main room is left on.
- Bathrooms (and showers) were dirty and wet. One of the showers did not have a door that closed, so water ended up all over the floor of the bathroom. Also, the trash bin in the bathroom was always overflowing.

Transport is very convenient with nearby MRT stations and easy access to taxis, making it simple to get around the city. The rooms are clean, modern and comfortable, though on the smaller side, which is fairly typical for Singapore. Great service apartment! Very clean, prompt response and front desk was very friendly and helpful! Value for money! Highly recommended!
Well equipped and spacious apartment. Welcoming host and check in staff. Recommended.
Hands down one of the best apartments we’ve stayed at. Bob was such a lovely host and the whole apartment and service was just amazing. I totally recommend this place to anyone.

It was our first time in Singapore. We had the best stay with Bob. Very clean, safe, everything you need plus wifi. Their service is the best and they are so friendly to help you and give more detail about travailing around Singapore.  Thanks for everything Bob!! Much appreciated
Die Unterkunft war perfekt. Alles super sauber und auch unsere späte Anreise war kein Problem. Ich würde es jederzeit wieder buchen.

Great place, great swimming pool and gym. Bob is a great host, all of the staff working at the apartments are super and friendly. Highly recommended to any traveler who wants the quiet but convenient place to stay in Singapore. I will definitely be staying here again!

Place was clean, quiet and the staff were excellent, friendly and pleasant. Check-in was quick and efficient. Even though I was not expecting much, the apartment facilities were pretty good! This was a great place to stay, would recommend it to anyone. It is close to everything you need, shops restaurant, transportation, airport, and the downtown core.

A well equipped, super clean and well located apartment. We stayed at Bob's property for five nights and would highly recommend.  It proved to be a great base for us to explore all Singapore has to offer. The pool was always really quiet. Thanks for having us Bob!
Bob이 매우 친절했고 집도 무척 깨끗했다 혹시 이숙소에 머물게 된다면 수영장에 꼭 가보세요

Bob was really welcoming and made sure everything was fine. The apartment is as described and very nice. Bob allowed me to leave the luggage at reception as I had a late flight. I would recommend to stay at Bob’s apartment!

Loved the room and the management. The location was very convenient too!
Amazing find :)

I've enjoyed my stay here at Fortville.
Check-in was easy and quick, the apartment is clean and house keeping thrice a week is much appreciated. Location is good - fairly central with lots of food around just a few bus stops away and walking distance to the closest supermarket and amenities.
Bob responds very promptly to any queries. I've chosen to extend my stay here and he has been most helpful with the arrangements.
This serviced apartment is good value for money and I'd recommend it to anyone.

The place is nice, clean and quiet. We loved the swimming pool, that was great for refreshing in the Singaporean weather! A good location for public transport, there is a bus stop just outside the apartments.  We would definately stay again.  Thank you, Bob.

Overall, nice place to stay with a friendly staff.

The place runs like a serviced apartment. It’ is clean and comes with Housekeeping services every other day.  There is also a swimming pool and a small gym room in the building. The location is rather central but isn’t exactly convenient. It takes about 10 minutes drive to get to the core central / CBD area. Public transport isn’t exactly nearby Overall it’s quite good value for money compared to most places in Singapore.

check in was super easy and didnt have to wait until 2pm! the building appeared to be quite empty. we only saw one other couple during our week long stay.
the apartment was spacious. very clean, housekeepers were lovely and thorough. kitchen facilities were basic, no oven or toaster. two hobs and all utensils, pots and plates were provided. great we could use the washing machine and dryer, though liquid detergent is provided, it didn't wash our clothes very well.
no interaction from Bob unless you message him. would have been nice to get some tips about things to do during our stay.
bus stop outside but we didn't use the buses so MRT was 10-15 minute walk away, and closed every evening from around 5pm due to train works. petrol station walking distance and small shopping complex about 15-20 min walk away . a nice quiet place to stay other than hearing the airplanes as the building is below a flight path!
gym and swimming pool available but we didn't use it during our stay as we were out all day and it closed at 10pm.

overall, definitely recommend and would stay again!

Great response.
Very friendly atmosphere.
Check in & out super smooth.
Great place.

perfect!!!

Great and well located place
Nice, clean, spacious and comfortable space to hang at a very affordable price.

Great place to stay and whenever come to Singapore, this will be our second home.
Enjoyed our stay and hope to c u soon.
Very smooth stay and quick check in/out process

Bob's place is exactly as described on the site and provides you with a comfortable and spacious base for the duration of your stay. The location is well placed for both getting into the city or exploring the local delights of the Katong area.
Great stay! Definitely will choose this place again!

I was staying in Singapore for a month during my studies. Could not recommend this place enough! It's conveniently located in front of the bus stop and only a 5 minute ride to the train station. Transportation was a breeze here.
Room was super clean, serviced every 2nd day, air conditioned, and has pretty much everything you need.
Pool was great, I cooled of in it everyday.
Would definitely stay here again. A+++++
Bob is very responsive and easy to work with. He gave us confident feeling to book this apartment. We stayed at Bob’s place for 3 weeks and left with a happy note.
Sehr gut für Touristen gelegen. Das MBS und vieles weiteres sind nur ein paar Stops mit der MRT entfernt. Der Foodcourt hinter der Tankstelle bietet ebenfalls reichlich Auswahl und ist sehr günstig.
住宿的条件很不错，fortville的员工也很热心，在这里的8天我们生活的很愉快。下次来还会住这里。
The place is exactly as described. Very comfortable and well connected to the rest of the city! I could leave the luggage before the checking, which was really helpful!
Great location and accommodations. The home was exceptionally clean and well-maintained constantly throughout our stay. Bob was also helpful when needed. Highly recommend this place!

There arw a fairprice express and hawker center near so easy to buy some food.
I will be back

It was a second visit after last year and again everything was perfect and relaxt.  Thank you.
Nice and very clean apartment, good location to explore Singapore and great service. Would definitely book again!
Great place to stay, love the pool and the hotel is exceptionally clean - very friendly and welcoming staff.
Soooooooo goooooood

整体上来说房子算是干净，去市区景点打的士方便，离地铁站很远，吃饭不方便，没有超市，只有一个小便利店在10分钟路程。对于家庭来说，比起住酒店好点，可以随时煮点东西给小孩吃。价格适中。整个小区比想象中的小，只有一栋楼（还是两栋？没仔细看）有点不开心的事，我们有小孩，屋子容易弄肮脏或乱，但是只有两天才来一次打扫房间，屋子也没有扫把给我们自己打扫清理，周日也是没有人打扫，刚好周四打扫一次，就要等到周一才会打扫，被单弄湿了要等打扫人员上班才有的换，管理处是没有钥匙去打开储藏室给换的（我也要求我拿被单过去换，他们开门就好，但是管理处说没有钥匙）
Great place to stay. Location is nice and quiet. Check in process was easy. The staff were all friendly and helpful.

Highly recommended

I recommend Fortville very highly!
The apartment is spacious, clean, and quiet. The cleaning and maintenance staff are efficient and polite. Very good experience overall.

Fortville is a beautiful place to live in. My mom and I are enjoying our stay. We have actually extended our stay. It's wonderful to be here and everyone who work here are wonderful people. A fantastic place that's a fully furnished flat and has great housekeeping and service from the lobby reception.

Apartment looks like the pictures. Place very clean & quiet. Definitively it's a good option if you are looking for a place to stay in Singapore.
nice place to stay

Nice place!! Had a pleasant stay.

The studio was clean, location is good - very near to East Coast park, check-in process was smooth and fast. All in all, we had a pleasant stay.

Lovely clean flat.
Location close to convenient bus stops.

Fortville Apartments, managed by Mark, has been a fantastic place to make a short term stay in Singapore. It has all the necessary amenities and staff are wonderfully helpful and friendly. Sehr schönes und sauberes Apartment.

I’ll definitely book this place when I return to Singapore next year.
amazing stay at a serviced apartment! cleaning happened 3x a week and good location too!

We had an excellent 9 day stay in Mark’s unit. Mark was excellent with communication. This apartment really felt like a hotel and near many forms of public transportation and great places to eat. Would recommend for anyone planning to stay long term.
I appreciated the extra amenities like, washing machine, dryer and Netfix. 24 hours check in was important for me.

Great location, close to public transport, renting the push bikes we got to explore so much more of the city.

Great Appartement, good location and facilities. Would highly recommand to all traverlers.
We stayed in Mark's place for one week. It was perfect for us. Good WiFi and TV. Walkable to many attractions (or at least via MRT). Reception staff were helpful. Gym was convenient.

Mark was a fabulous host! Excellent communication and very responsive.
Apartment was clean and with all the essentials for my stay.
Lovely pool to cool off in too!
Location was perfect for my purposes with great public transport links (bus and MRT), but definitely recommend downloading the 'Grab' taxi app too.
Price was very reasonable for the location!
Highly recommend (and hopefully will be back one day too...!)

This was my daughter’s first trip to Asia, so she was a bit overwhelmed initially, however this space helped ground her. Great serviced apartment, able to self cater as you pleased - had cleaning of rooms x3 per week, good pool and access to gym - easy and flexible check in and check out process - very friendly and excellent value would recommend and return. i enjoy the stay at Fortville. the staffs are very  friendly. the location is great and the room is well organized and clean

great place. comfortable room with great kitchen. easy bus trip to harbour front

Great place. Close to transport. Hawker centres nearby. Pool is awesome, very nice area with friendly people. Staff at Fortville are super friendly, from staff who made up our room to staff who checked us in. Very happy with our stay.

it was really a good holiday. the room is clean and the employees in the apartment are very helpful. the area is quiet and public transportation is very accessible. will book again if ever i visit singapore again
Clean, quiet, and convenient location. Would recommend
Nice aparment and facilities, close to the amazing East Coast Park and public transport, lovely staff. Really enjoyed our time here and would totally recommend!
the place was a great getaway!! would definitely book again in the near future!!!
It was really great. Everyone was friendly, the room was clean and relaxing. We will stay there again next time.

For the length of stay and the price I would not expect to have to buy my own soap for kitchen and laundry. Spa not heated, one of 2 treadmills broken, no pool towels, location is not ideal for evening entertainment. 1.5 mile walk to restaurants and bars, or bus to and fro. Slightly disappointed.

Fortville was a nice facility with wonderful services but do note the extra facilities such as the pool and gym are only usable during 7am-10pm

My overall stay at the Fortville flat was excellent. The flat was spotlessly clean and the facilities, including the pool and gym, were a great way for us to have a relaxing day too. He even allowed us a late check-out as our flight was late in the evening. This was a nice gesture that rounded off our stay. Overall, I can wholeheartedly recommend the flat and would love to come back again.
Kitchen beyond expectation, all the utensils are new and in good condition.  Washer and dryer are very convenient for us. Also has a lovely swimming pool.

優點：公車路線很多，去哪裡都很方便。附近也有超市。

Our host Mark did the needful to be as helpful and clear as possible regarding our questions.

All in all, a super experience. With Mark you’ll be in great hands!
Acomodação bem equipada e fácil acesso aos transportes públicos?

good place to stay

There’s a bus-stop outside the apartment building. I took bus no. 30 and 158 frequently to the hawker centres and MRT station because I did not want to walk in 34C weather.
I enjoyed my stay in Fortville. Mark was very responsive to my questions.

This is a great place to stay even if you’re traveling with a one year old. Me and my family stayed here for 7 nights and we truly love it here. Mark was a friendly host. It was generally a pleasant experience staying there except that half way through our stay we were unable to use the gas stove. We appreciated the housekeeping services and friendly and helpful staff who fulfilled our requests. We were happy with the facilities provided at the apartment. It was a quiet and comfortable stay. The apartment did smell strongly of bleach, and the gas was out while I was there.
Everything was great.

Die Unterkunft war sauber und gepflegt, die Dusche super,
verschiedene Busstationen in unmittelbarer Nähe, das meiste konnte so erreicht werden. Freundliches Personal.

A great stay, the apartment was clean, comfortable, well equipped and had plenty of room for 2 people for a 2 week stay. Very helpful, friendly management team.

I had an amazing stay at the property. It is the same as described, thank you Mark.

Good place for short day.  Will be back
All was great

Great location and amenities matches the description.
I'm very satisfied with the place and service, definitely will recommend others to live here.

This is the second time I have stayed  at Mark's place. We had a couple of queries and they were answered instantly.

2nd time staying at Mark’s place. Great as usual. Internet was a little spotty this time, being disconnected every once in awhile. Otherwise, the stay was still great and I’d be happy to come back again.
