This is our 3rd time staying here and always out first point of call when visiting Singapore. Location even better now with the MRT completion.
Has everything you need for a couple of weeks stay.

Het is een schoon appartement, op een paar minuten lopen van eenvoudige winkels en eetgelegenheden met streetfood. Een paar minuten de andere kant op is het metrostation. De medewerkers zijn heel vriendelijk en behulpzaam.

This place is great value for money!
Convenient location and close everything with nearby public transport.
Clean place and quiet room with good AC units.
Only thing I'd critique is the length of the bed. Me being 193 cm the bed was a bit short.
Not bad
Great place to stay for my family. Great location, and complete ameneties. Highly recommended 👍🏻
Great location. Room itself is alright. Large kitchen area and good if you are cooking.

Fortville had all the necessary accommodations for my and my friend's stay in Singapore. Plenty of room for two and added bonus of washer and dryer in the room. All public transportation is easily managed in the surrounding neighborhood to get anywhere you want in the city!

エントランスの鍵がテーブルに置いてある事を事前連絡したほうが良い。
荷物を置いてすぐ出かけてしまったため、鍵がなく開けてもらった。
あと、Wi-Fiがよく接続切れを起こす。もう少し安定したWi-Fi環境にすることが必要です。
立地はバス・mrtにも近く移動には楽でした。
タオル・トイレットペーパーもクリーニングのタイミングで綺麗なものが支給されるのでよかった。

Super logement tout équipé (cuisine, four plaques ustensiles, fer planche etc). Service de nettoyage dans l’immeuble qui change draps et serviette. Sécurisé (concierge, badge, code a numéro). Metro proche (ligne marron à 2min a pied, jaune à 12min), petit supermarché à la station service à 5min pour dépanner. Les instructions étaient claires et l’hôte était réactif aux questions.

The apartment is nice! It is close to the MRT TEL LINE (Brown Colour). just a five minutes walk.very very convinient .the housekeeping people are very friendly. maybe we will stay in the Fortville Apartment ,when we come to visit
Singapore next time.
We highly recommend the apartment.
Very close to MRT station as well as Bus Stop right outside building. Great homebase! AC works great.

I had a nice stay. I do wish they could’ve gave me more shower gel though.
Very spacious imho for Singapore
Great place to stay. super clean and had everything I needed. Enjoyed using the gym and swimming pool to chill out. Short (150m) walk to MRT under covered walkway.  Definitely recommended.

Good overall but a few things mar the experience.
Pros:

-Good location, quiet in the evenings despite construction nearby
-Comfortable bed
-Kitchen well equipped
-Washer and dryer
Cons:

-Flat weirdly furnished, with no sofa, tables located in odd places and no curtains in the kitchen area.

-Stingy with towels, I had to chase them for more.
-For extended stays, it is not great value but for shorter ones it could be.
Nice apartment in a good location, honestly couldn’t fault it, for what we needed

I cannot fault Fortville. The communication was fantastic; the whole process was seamless, and the apartment was great.
Very accessible by MRT, and nice to be out of the hustle and bustle of the city.
I’d absolutely stay again.

Pros:
Location is awesome as its < 5mins walk to Katong Park MRT station and bus stop is right outside. Check-in staff is helpful and cheerful to guide thru the check-in. Has alternate days housekeeping. Equipped w washer & dryer and detergent. Large fridge and utensils.
Cons:
Toilet has lots of moth flying inside, above the ceiling & around the bed room. We did feedback to front desk but nth was done as it was like this throughout the entire stay. We tried opening the windows but was worried as the next bldg tenants are able to see us through their windows
Requested for 2 extra blankets as bed was too small for 2 (we both weigh less than 50kg). Ended up one of us had no choice but to slp on the flr with the extra blankets. 1 of the blankets came with yellow stains while the replacement had few moths inside when we opened it but was too tired to change
There is no slip on slippers as well
Shower has no proper coverage n caused a flood aft each bath esp if u r washing your hair
Great stay

Wir waren 2 Wochen in der Unterkunft. Check-in und out waren unproblematisch online zu erledigen. Alle 2 Tage kam Housekeeping und hat das Apartment gereinigt und Handtücher gewechselt. Hier ist uns der sorgsame und wertschätzende Umgang mit unseren Sachen besonders positiv aufgefallen. Leider gab es in unmittelbarer Nähe Bauarbeiten und “Tennisplätze”, die aktiv genutzt wurden. Dadurch war es laut. Die Anbindung durch die neue MRT-Linie ist super, allerdings ist sie noch nicht bis zum Flughafen fertiggestellt. Alles andere erreicht man sehr gut. In unmittelbarer Nähe befindet sich auch ein großer Park. In Laufweite gibt es 2 Tankstellen für kleine Einkäufe. Für alles andere muss man fahren. Das Apartment selber ist gut und zweckmäßig ausgestattet. Es gab auch Waschmittel für die Waschmaschine. Außer einem Geschirrhandtuch haben wir nichts vermisst. Insgesamt hat es uns gut gefallen und wir würden wiederkommen.
Fortville is well connected to bus and mrt which makes it easy to move around the city. Since the accommodation was cleaned every second day, it felt very comfortable.

Excellent service ! Le logement est tranquille et très bien entretenu, avec un nettoyage effectué trois fois par semaine. Le transport en commun est facilement accessible à proximité. Je recommande fortement cet hébergement.
Great place to stay for a week. Comfortable & relaxing.
Great stay
Convenient location, easy to get to city. Compact yet fully self-contained.

We had a great stay for an extended trip that was well priced and included the necessary amenities for traveling with a baby! We relied on the kitchen, extra sq footage, and aircon. Our host was wonderful and answered all questions promptly. The property felt well maintained, and was about 4min walk to bus or MRT. Although, the downside was there wasn’t much to do directly near the property, but that didn’t bother us. One thing to note was the kitchen sink does not provide hot water, however, an electric water kettle is provided and sufficed for sanitizing dishes effectively. The cleaning service was on the more essentials-side, like providing clean linens for bed and bath, but excluded dish washing, which is ok but definitely would have been a perk to have (It’s a fairly large complex, so it’s an understandable exclusion). All the pool and gym amenities were as described! Overall we give 5 stars particularly for value, comfort, and host reliability! Happy to stay again!!
Very good location, friendly staff, quiet place and very clean

Fortville is a great place to stay! Very clean serviced apartment with separate bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and dining area. People at check-in / out are very friendly and helpful.
The apartment is 5 minutes walk to the MRT station which brings you almost anywhere in the city. There is a Hawker center about 5 minutes walk as well with local restaurants and fruit stalls. Very convenient.
We had a great time in Singapore and it was in part due to Fortville. We definitely recommend Fortville and will look them up if we come back in the future!
Thank you for hosting us!
服务很好，交通方便，做饭设备齐全，下次还会继续住。

这家比较靠近东海岸，机场乘德士过去也就二十分钟，楼下就有共享单车可以骑车去地铁站或是海边，新加坡的天气很舒服，骑车的感觉超棒。（最好换当地手机卡用mobike，有优惠的）
附近吃饭的地方都是本地人，几乎没有游客，可以感受最真实的新加坡。旧机场路那里还有一个超大的美食广场，好吃的不要太多！！
房间很大，也可以煮东西吃，楼下有游泳池，屋里Wi-Fi也不错，我不喜欢太闹的地方，个人觉得比住牛车水什么的热闹的地方好太多。新加坡不大，地铁超方便！
总之，墙裂推荐啦！！🌝
住了三天，感觉好好哦！除了房间近马路有点吵闹，其它都无问题！下次再去新加坡的话，会考虑再入住，到时给个不靠马路的房间就好了哈哈。
It was a pleasant stay. Thank you!

This really is a  Great apartment with everything you need and help always around. It’s immaculate, clean, the huge bed is so comfortable... with WiFi and TV, the rooms are spacious. The kitchen had everything it even had a cafetière, theres a fan and air con with lots of windows. The gym and pool is an added bonus! and  Easy to use washing machine and separate dryer. This is a stylish and Bob the host was amazing waiting up for us when our flight was delayed for hours. So welcoming and helpful, providing information, change and even printing out vouchers! Perfect! Thank you.
Recommended. Decent location in terms of public transport. Apartment is no too big, but good for couples.

It is solid 3,5 stars . Bob was very helpful and friendly. Prompt communication. The place is very clean, good location with city view. The apartment has no design or decoration and looks a bit tooo simple. This apartment needs woman touch and 2 good quality pillows per person plus kitchen towels.
Excellent cleaning. Large swimming pool and gym. 10 min walk to small shop and 10 min by car to food location
Great service and location for East Coast Park
Bob's place is an amazing place to stay over, it has great wifi and other useful amenities. It's also close to bus stop and convince stores. So all in all, a great place to stay.

Very well presented and comfortable apartment.
Good location with easy access to transportation.
Warm and friendly atmosphere.
Truly a home away from home.
Thanks Bob.
This place is a great because you get the hominess of an Airbnb but the security and attention of a hotel. I was very satisfied. The access to public transportation is also a huge plus.
Good place

This is a great corner unit on the third floor overlooking the pool. Easy check-in at the 24-hour front desk. The apartment is very clean and the kitchen has the necessities. Larger fridge with freezer too. The bed was a little hard, but at the same time I slept very well during my week stay. The unit is very very quiet, which I liked. The windows appear to be lightly tinted which must help with the sun. This unit has two walls of windows, and you have a lovely view of some greenery. Location is not in a tourist area. Bus stops are right outside the building and the Mountblatten MRT stop is a ten minute walk away. Public transport to anything is fairly easy, or use the Grab car share app. Unit is also five minute walk to nearest food hawker center.

Great location and very close to east coast park where I enjoy going for a run and/biking. I used to live around the area when I was based in Singapore for work so this area brings back old memories for me. This place is a great value for money if you are ok taking public transit or cabs to get around downtown.
Very clean and excellent hospitality!
Great experience. Will recommend,
Good value and good amenities - easy check in

Great little appartement. Quiet building with nice, clean pool. Very quiet area, away from the downtown area. 15 minutes walk to the subway. There are rental bikes right on the parking lot, which we used every day. Air conditioner in bedroom was very needed! Kitchen has refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave and kettle. No toaster or coffee maker.

Great large rooms of a service apartments and a good location to get to places around Singapore. And there is good hawker food within 5 mins walk.
My only problem was that the room was too near a main road that had many heavy vehicles passing by during the day which made it very noisy.

I booked this place for my parents. They enjoyed their stay as the room was quiet, clean and spacious. The building also has a swimming pool and gym. Communication with Bob was super easy, as he was quick to respond and always polite. I highly recommend this place!

Excellent rooms, very clean and modern. I very good location close to the subway which is quick and easy. Good cheap food just behind the Esso. My only problem was the road noise which is bearable if you are used to it but request a back room if you want quiet. The whole complex has leased rooms.  Checkin is easy 24 hours a day and communication great. Enjoy!!
Definitely my place of choice on long trips to Singapore

We stayed eight nights at Bob’s apartment during our visit in Singapore. The location was perfect for exploring the city. The bus stop is in the front of the building with a connecton to a nearby MRT station and other parts of the city. We used the efficient and inexpensive public transportation a lot.
The apartment was superclean and it was cleaned three times during our stay. The kitchen had all needed for a self catered breakfast, maybe a toaster would have been a nice addition. Fast Wi-Fi and AC worked fine.
The mattress was a bit too firm for our taste but it didn’t nevertheless disturb a good night’s sleep. The building was very quiet and there was no extra noise from the street or other apartments. There is no couch and the bed is the only place to relax and watch TV in the evenings therefore some extra pillows would have been nice.
The personnel at the reception was always very helpful and it was available 24/7.
The online photos and information is very accurate and there was no surprises. We definitely would recommend Bob’s apartment anyone visiting Singapore.
I really enjoyed my 1 month stay.  Service respond was fantastic. When I reported washing machine not working, within a couple of hours, they replaced with a working unit.
很棒
Awesome place, super quick booking confirmation

This is a fab apartment, gives you everything you need for a longer stay in Singapore. Very clean, great location, 24 hour mini supermarket 5 mins walk away, MRT not too far, bus stop right outside. Would highly recommend and will definitely stay here again.
Nice place to say !!! Definitely recommended....
Fantastic location, flat and hospitality.  If the dates work book it... It's really that simple.
满意的入住，干净卫生，下次来新加坡会再次预订入住的。
Good place with easy check in. Can rest assured that everything is tidy and clean

Outstanding service and quick responses. I suggest choosing an apartment facing the pool side because the street facing ones can be noisy during the day. The military jets passing by are noisy too but I guess that can be an issue anywhere you stay in Singapore. There are a couple gas stations about 5 mins away where they sell fruits, although limited choices. The closest grocery store you need to take a bus, about 3-4 stops. Easy access to downtown and Orchard road with frequent buses. Overall it was a very pleasant stay.

A lovely apartment and is as shown in photos. Liked that kitchen separate from bedroom area. Also sparkling clean. I really enjoyed staying here as able to relax and when I felt like exploring the buses and MRT were not far away. Also access to grocery store and hawker food court. I would definitely stay here again.

Really good place to stay. Just a bit of a walk to the MRT but really clean inside and outside. Room service always made sure to accommodate you if you needed a little bit more time. Laundry machines made it convenient to get clean clothes for next adventure. All in all no complaints.

My partner and I booked the apartment about 4 months in advance for a 10 day stay in September. From the point of booking up until our departure BOB was extremely helpful and swiftly answered all my concerns via Whatsapp. The apartment was spotless and included useful information sheets, large swimming pool, a TV with multiple channels + Netflix, kitchenware, an iron, complimentary tea and even instant noodles! The apartment has 2 bus stops outside, is a 10 minute walk to Mountbatten stn and has a food centre 3 minutes away.  The apartment has a fob entry system so we felt very secure, we even left some of our stuff and went to Indonesia for 2 days, with no fears that our things would be touched. Many thanks to Bob and all the friendly and helpful staff who made our trip special.
Vous pouvez réserver sans hésitation

とても素晴らしい施設、清潔、静かな所、次回も利用したい所です。他のお客にも推薦します。
ありがとうございました。
every time  back to Singapore we stay here ,very  good location and outstanding service.

Bob was nice host. Helpful and gave us good information like all public bus and subway lines close by.
Apartment was nice and we loved our stay there.

Really a nice place with everything you need for a business trip. Can
Only recommend this, great value for the reasonable charge !
Nice place, very clean and comfortable, will definitely come back
Good services with a dedicated team of staff!
Highly recommended. The apartment was very well equipped and clean. Mark was extremely accommodative and responsive. Would definitely stay here again!
Very good living experience!
Definitely worth the money. Easy excess to central area
Very nice, spacious, sunny apartment for a short stay! The front desk and the cleaning staff are both very friendly.

Good clean building and friendly staff. Not everyone speaks English well but most are very willing to help. Location requires a bit of walking to bus stops (5min) and MRT stations (10min). Not many restaurants are grocery stores are in walking distance.

This place is perfect for a couple or solo travel. It’s conveniently located with a food court and 2 mini marts a walks away. And a short bus ride or a walk to east coast park and marina bay sands!
The bed is comfortable, bathroom spacious and the staff and housekeeper are very friendly.
I enjoyed my stay, so much so I extended twice!
Great place, awesome location. Enjoyed the serenity of the heartlands in a quiet part of Singapore, but close proximity to town/orchard. Will definitely stay again.

mark was really responsive throughout my stay. The apartment was exactly as depicted, short walk to east coast park and the train station.
it was a really pleasant 2 weeks stay. (:
Trust this place to be very clean and well maintained. Have been to a couple of units for this price and I have to say this is one of the best I’ve experienced. 5/5

Fortville is a great place to stay . Apartment was great , clean , spacious and well appointed . The host , Mark, is unbelievably efficient and friendly . No request is refused , always with a smile .Absolutely FiRST CLASS
Great place, friendly staff, close to the city!!
Perfect place to stay while in Singapore—comfortable and very close to several bus lines and a short walk to East Coast Park.  Fort Road is highly trafficked, so it can be a bit noisy at times.

Mark was very accommodating and helpful during check in (and even before check in). He answered all of our questions clearly and promptly.
The place was clean and mostly had everything that we needed. There was not much storage for two people but otherwise it was perfect and I would recommend it to others.
Location was also great!
The place is ok and Mark is very supportive host
nice location and staff, they also provided a high chair for our son which was very useful. would stay again

Great location for buses and MRT into the centre and near the East Coast Path for walks and cycling. We borrowed bikes and were able to cycle to Marina Bay Gardens and on to River Valley Road, all on cycle paths. Hawker food outlet nearby and Esso shop for food supplies. Stunning city. Appartment was clean, very comfortable bed. Friendly staff. Great to have pool as a bonus.

Really clean house, they cleaned the rooms every 2 days; and here I want to appreciate the people who really put their time for cleaning the rooms. Actually, all of the people in this place were really nice. Mark answered my questions very quickly, and he was very supportive. The only thing that I should mention here is that you have a bit walk to get to the MRT. Moreover, I asked for a pool view room; however, they gave me a street view room; but it was nice as well. If you want a pool view room, be sure to double-check with them before arriving there.
Nice condo.

The place is 15 minutes from Mountbatten, if you like a quiet place to stay this is a place for you. We've stayed for 2 weeks and we love the big fridge and washing machine with dryer. There's a small grocery store at petrol station too.
Great location and super easy to check in. Loved that it had a gym too!

We had a very pleasant stay at the apartment. Mark even upgraded us… really appreciate it!
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED, especially if you are traveling with kids..
The staffs are very nice and easy to communicate with. The neighborhood is surrounded with bus stations and u can reach MRT station by walking or 2 bus stops away.
Pretty near to hawker center, you can reach the surrounding Malls with bus.
The unit itself is very clean dan comfortable. Very family friendly. The housekeeping will clean ur place around 3 times a week.
Thank u Mark.. will definitely come back to ur place if we travel to SG

A nice place to stay in, if you are looking for something a little bigger in size compared to a hotel for example.
Although the pricing is still on the high end (depends on when you travel here) the apartments are located about 10 mins walk from Mountbatten MRT Station which is on the circle line.
The hosts are very friendly and it's easy to communicate with any of the staff here.
I would say only downside is there are not many food options around the area. The main places being a Hawker Centre and then some shops.
Great stay and would recommend overall!
Everything went well, clean place - always again

Overall a solid 3.5 stars. Very prompt communications prior to our arrival. It is a building full of service apartments so don’t expect your room to be laid out exactly as in the photos. Unfortunately the pool was under maintenance when we were there which given it was the main reason why we chose this over other Airbnbs was disappointing.

Mark’s place is very cozy. We enjoyed our stay there. Location is great as well, close by attractions that we wanted to visit. Check-in was a breeze. Staff were attentive. We will definitely recommend Mark’s place.

Mark was very accomodating to our duration of stay even if we had to extend it due to flight changes. The room was spacious and had all the utilities we needed and service was great. We appreciate your hospitality.
Great!

This place is exactly what we needed for a 10 day break in Singapore. The pool was a lovely place to relax throughout the day and mark’s place is just a stone throw away from a bus stop that will take you to a lot of tourist attractions easily.
We loved staying here, it was clean, the staff were polite and the bed was huge! We would definitely stay here again when we come back to Singapore in the future!

Great place to stay. One tiny thing to note: it's actually more like 15-20mins walk to the mrt than 10mins, but there is a bus right outside the apartment building so it's no major thing. The staff are all very friendly and accommodating and the apartments are well equipped and comfortable.

The room and accommodation was very lovely and modern. The house has a nice pool and the room had big windows with a very clean bathroom and a nice little kitchen. The room service came every two days and even cleaned our dishes.
The connection to public transport was about 15 min of walking away and a nice park was located close by.
I would recommend it to everyone who enjoys a quiet neighbourhood and isn't bothered by having to get the tram to get into the actual city.
The stay is as advertised. It is cozy, clean, and everything we were looking for!
The Fortville apartment was very comfortable and clean. I had a wrap-around narrow balcony on the 15th floor. Communication and check in was easy. I would definitely stay here again.
Had an excellent stay. Easy check in, place was as advertised, and great location. About a 20 minute walk to MRT station. Would definitely return!
Excellent apartment, great views and exceptionally wonderful cleaning staff!

Everything you need for a longer stay in Singapore. If you're staying in Singapore for more than a week then I'd definitely recommend this apartment. It's a stone throw away from several bus stops that take you across the city and about a 15 minute walk to the MTR. The check in and out was very quick and simple and the staff were always very friendly. The pool area was always quiet so we always managed to get a sunbed and usually enjoyed the pool to ourselves.

The majority of this unit was great.
Was 10 minutes from MRT by foot and convenient to get around. Two close hawker stalls, including Old Airport, was a bonus.
Room was not as big as we thought it would be from photos, but more than adequate. Clean, and there was cleaning service as much as you wanted - another big plus.
Or big frustration was the lack of communication around construction that occurred during our stay. We were given 1-2 days notice that the pool would be closed and there was pounding that woke us up (on holiday so we were sleeping in). It would’ve been nice to know prior to our stay that construction would be going on, to give opportunity to look for other locations, but we were told they didn’t know until last minute.
In all, a good stay, and worth the money - but I would ask upfront about what you might not know.

Stayed here for a 2 month work trip. Excellent facilities and a spacious room that has everything you need and is cleaned regularly. Decent location to the CBD, around a 20 minute bus in. Would definitely recommend.
This apartment is a gem as it’s comfortable and convenient to buses and a little walk to the mrt.
Great place - will look at rebooking. The small place is very efficient and has everything at hand.

perfect accomadation
Great location not far from the MRT to visit all the sights

Great place just outside the central part of Singapore
A bus stop on your door step which can get you to and from Vivo City which is near to the Harbour.
The apartment was serviced extremely well by Casey. She was super kind. The pool is ok size and the gym is fine but not huge.
The shower was brilliant and also the kitchen space was decent for a couple.
Lovely place to stay close to East Coast Park which is great for a walk, cycle or run
The location is centrally located and room and furnishings excellent. The only negative is the noise level from the traffic.  With better insulated windows, the unit would rate five stars.
Good place for long term trip
perfekt Spot
It’s a great place to stay in, clean and secure.  Felt like home. Not very far from the main attractions in Singapore.

My husband and I have stayed here for 15 days, I would highly recommend  it as the staff are very friendly, very responsive and helpful.  The room was quiet, no noise at night time, very convenient location with various bus lines around.  Easy to get to East Coast Parkway Parade, Orchard and Paya Lebar with the bus.  The 1st night when we arrived, the Wi-Fi connection was not very stable, the next morning we told the staff and they fixed it the same day and no problems after.  The only thing I would have to pick on would be the replenishment for amenities.  They only replenish toilet rolls, but they don’t replenish facial tissue box, body wash, hand wash, and washing detergent for clothes abc dishes.  To be honest, I don’t think this would cost a lot of money, don’t understand why they only replenish selected item, but would be great if they inform you ahead. Overall it’s a great place with swimming pool and gym.
Great place, we enjoyed our stay at Mark’s place.
Great apartment for a week’s vacation!

Super Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, sehr freundliches und hilfsbereites Personal, Concierge rund um die Uhr zur Verfügung - außergewöhnlich zuvorkommend, extrem sauberes Appartement. Alles in allem wirklich top!
Great location, will recommend to friends and book again if I visit Singapore.

Mark was responsive. He allows us to check in 1hr early. From check in to check out, everything went smoothly. He resolved the cable TV issue fast when we made some feedback.
The staff were all polite & helpful. My fiancé from NL was satisfied with the accommodation of our stay at Fortville. We will be looking forward to stay there again during our visit at SG.

Excellent accommodation for our enjoyable 2 week stay. Sparklingly clean. Easy to get to by bus, taxi or MRT.
We look forward to another visit.
Great apartment! Very cozy and clean. Mark was also very quick to respond to any questions. Would definitely stay there again!

We really appreciated this cozy, clean and practically equipped apartment. The room was bright thanks to the large windows and at the same time, it was possible to darken the room well at night. The cleaning service met our needs, the cleaning lady was doing a careful job and we felt comfortable in the room. Room equipment and wi-fi worked without problems. There were no noisy guests and we felt private. We were mostly alone at the pool. Although we used grab for most trips to different places in Singapore, we appreciated the walking distance to the shop, hawker, and even downtown (even if it's more time consuming, it is possible to walk a considerable part of the way to Marina Bay through the greenery). Not far from the apartment is a large park with a coastal path for pedestrians and cyclists. Since it was the Lunar New Year, we were greeted with tangerines. The staff was friendly and we would definitely come back there.

Happy with the building and the apartment.  Very comfortable for 2 people for a week.  We had a corner unit with lots of windows looking out over a small park.  View was a plus but from our 4th floor unit, the heavy traffic on the street below was noisy. We would probably have been better off with a higher floor suite or around the back.  Public transportation into the city was very good.  Mark very quickly responded to any question and was very friendly.

This apartment is in a great location, it is close to bus stops and the drive to main shopping centres (such as Suntec and Vivo City) aren’t that long of a drive. The room is quite clean and spacious. Safe location.
Thank you, Mark for having us :)
great place. suitable for long stay.
House was in tip top condition.

Great place to stay - Friendly staff - Good location near to MRT (which we used most days) and buses.  The cleaning was exceptional - 3 times a week and included doing the dishes and defluffing the tumble dryer. Pool area nice and clean and welcoming. The hawker nearby served amazing food (A4 Jalan Batu). There is also a MacDonalds and KFC nearby. Plenty of shops to get supplies within walking distance.
if I may suggest would be nice with a toaster and a tea towel otherwise pretty happy 😊

I stayed at mark's place because as was going to an event at OCBC stadium which is about a 20 minute walk or 5 mins and $6 in a grab which was perfect. A grab in the afternoon as a little hot to walk and walk back in the evening via nice surroundings. The closest MRT is 15 mins or so walk away.
Checking in was easy with the person on reception. They explained everything to me & there was a brochure in the room explaining things in more detail. Complex is secure and the apartment itself is exactly as described in the picture. Large bed, quality linen & towels. kitchen well equiped, washing machine & dryer with detergent supplied. Nice big screen TV in the bedroom with multiple channels. Swimming pool was very nice and clean. Gym was small but adequate.The small welcome pack in the apartment was a very nice touch. The place was spotlessly clean with servicing very 2 days.
It had everything I could possible need for my 8day stay. A compact apartment but a great place & would stay again

We found the apartment exactly as described. Easy check in and the night reception staff member (Manu) was very friendly and gave us lots of information about nearby hawker centres, shops, buses etc. He was also helpful throughout our stay. The room service (cleaner - Casey) was very friendly, polite and efficient. She did a brilliant job, always with a smile on her face.
We used the pool twice during our visit and I was a bit disappointed to find twigs and leaves at the bottom of the pool both times. The only thing that was missing from the kitchen was a pair of scissors which would have been very useful and handy.
The location is very central. There is a bus stop right outside and another across the road which we used very often. Its about an 8 minute walk to the nearest hawker center Jalan Batu hawker center (behind the petrol station) and a 12 - 14 minute walk to Mountbatten MRT station and another larger hawker center (Old Airport Road). We enjoyed our stay and hope to return.
Excellent stay in a secure,private apartment close to transport

Апартаменты небольшие, но есть всё необходимое, включая стиральную машину, микроволновку, сейф, рабочий стол. Расположены апартаменты немного в отдалении от основных достопримечательностей, но прямо возле апартаментов находится автобусная остановка. Каждый вторник, четверг и субботу производится уборка, так что в апартаментах всегда чисто. Небольшой минус для нас - что кондиционер дует прямо на кровать, а вот на кухне кондиционера нет, поэтому днём может быть достаточно жарко, но для нас это не было большой проблемой. Ещё в спальне немного шумновато от дороги, но в целом нам это не мешало. В комплексе есть стойка регистрации, где постоянно есть сотрудник, так что проблем с заселением и выселением не было. В целом очень хороший вариант в Сингапуре, с радостью вернулись бы ещё!

We had a pleasant stay. Nice, clean apartment with everything you need, comfortable bed😊
Unfortunately the windows don’t block much noise. The complex is located at a 6 lane road which is busy.
Public transport is super convenient located with bus stops and MRT easy to reach. Local shops and market near by and friendly people. Good neighbourhood
We will stay again, just need earplugs for the night 😉

First time staying at a serviced apartment and the experience was great. Located close to local food/grocery store/market and public transportation. Anywheel shared bike is at the bus stop outside Fortville and makes getting to East Coast beach a quick  10 mins ride.

Practical and nice apartment for visiting Singapore. The locations is great, peaceful and residential, yet close to public transport options (bus and MRT) as well as some hawker centers in walking distance.
The apartment self was great, kitchen, bath and bedroom. Pool was a lot of fun, staff is very friendly and the place was clean and had everything we needed.
Very quiet room as well - we were facing the back.

During my recent two and a half weeks stay, I had no issues. All the staff were friendly and helpful.  The place was clean and kept clean from regular housekeeping. The posting on Airbnb was exactly as shown. The only few things I would recommend would be to provide cutlery in the unit (fork, spoon, knife). Also, most times the shower was a cold shower. I did not ask why that is as many days due to the hot and humid weather, it was refreshing. So convenient with bus and MRT but I so loved the proximity to East Coast Park. Overall, a great place to stay!  Would stay there again when I return.
Really cool apartment and good location
It’s really nice to stay here.  the one who clean the room is so friendly and helpful. The location is near bus stop. everything is great 💓

Mark was very responsive with his communication. His serviced apartment was very clean and accommodating with useful appliances. Situated relatively near MSB and East Coast Beach walking/bike track as well as the Old Airport Hawkers market which is well known for it's food.

The apartment was nice and the host was very helpful. There were a few nice local hawker restaurants close by but not a lot of western restaurants or cafes . The walk to the MRT was around 10 minutes. Overall a nice place and nice location! Very nice host
Great location and service.
Great studio apartment that was safe, secure and comfortable for our week's stay. Highly recommended.
Thanks for a superb stay!
Clean & spacious room, close to the greenery.

It was a clean room.
I was able to live comfortably because the receptionist and cleaning staff were kind.
Outstanding place! So spacious & clean in a great location with nice views. Lovely pool, having a little kitchen was a massive bonus. Great value for money, thanks for the great stay!

Highly recommend this apartment .  Mark and onsite staff were terrific and extremely helpful without any complaints.  Close to many attractions and walkable to Hawkers Market for local food.  Supermarket was also walking distance.
Beautiful location with great walkability to nearby MRT! Thanks for the wonderful stay.

Great place to stay, very clean, great and convenient location close to public transport. The staff were so friendly and made you feel right at home (especially the gentleman on night duty) . Highly recommend staying here.
Very helpful staff. The room was just as described. Loved our stay in Singapore. Will recommend.

Overall, great place to stay with the exception of bugs in the apartment. Apartment is clean and has all amenities you need plus cleaning service. In unit laundry was super nice and worked great. Shower causes water to fill up the bathroom and can be annoying at times. Close to buses and short walk to MRT. Check in instructions were provided but due to our late arrival the provided code did not work and had to check in again with doorman.
Very comfortable stay, good communications. Highly recommended!
Really good place to stay.
최고의 숙소였습니다 ! 싱가포르 여행 중 숙소가 가장 좋았어요 🥰 방이 넓고 깔끔했고 침대도 커서 편했어요. 수영장은 깔끔하게 관리되고 매일 아침 일찍 오픈되어서 1일 1 수영했습니다!! 다음에 또 오고싶는 숙소에요 ~ 추천합니다. 좋은 경험할 수 있게 해주셔서 감사합니다
A very pleasant stay. The apartment was comfortable and the location was also good, not far from the CBD

We had a great time at Fortville. We booked 2 rooms and they both were very clean and had enough equipments. MRT station is a little bit far but the nearest bus stop is right outside the place. Highly recommended!

Nice staff, hot water system completely useless. Pillows like bolsters and located on a very noisy Rd, try and book one of the upper floors ie 6-16, to rise above the din. These are just minor peeves... it has a great pool and pleasant staff.... probably as good as it gets, ie for the money in Sgp.
Very good .
一次愉快的新加坡的之旅，下次还会选择。
Tòa nhà có lịch phụ thuốc muỗi vào thứ 2 đầu tuần nhưng do không để ý nên tôi đã mở cửa và sau đấy trong phòng xuất hiện muỗi.

We were very happy and satisfied with our stay at Mark's studio in Fortville. Overall a quiet place with hotel services (towels + cleaning every 2 days if needed), but very close to the street, which may get loud at times.
The place has everything you need for your first day and the bus station is just outside the premises if you need to get quickly to an MRT or the shops/market. A small shopping area with McDonalds, KFC and Decathlon is also closeby.
They also conducted regular mosquito smoking, so they were almost non-existent during our stay.
Air Con worked flawlessly as Singapore is usually very hot and humid for us europeans.
We would happily come again when we return to Singapore !
一次愉快的新加坡的之旅，下次还会选择。

Excellent affordable place to stay during Singapore Grand Prix. Rooms were extremely comfortable and clean and as pictured. Regular housekeeping during the week. Friendly staff who were very helpful and check in/out was very easy. Mark answered all my questions promptly before we arrived and provided helpful information.
A bit far from local amenities. A 12-15 minute walk to the MRT or a 30 minute walk to the 7-11 and nice local cafes for coffee and breakfast (Tanjong Katong Rd). Would recommend using the Singapore bike hire service as a quicker way to get around. There is a bike park right outside the apartments.
We loved staying at this apartment! It was clean, in a good location and had everything we needed :) we really enjoyed having the balcony, the pool and the gym!! Would absolutely recommend!

Fortville es un edificio muy bonito, cerca de varias paradas de autobus y una estación de tren, también se tiene dos tiendas de conveniencia cercanas junto a un hawkers centre. la ubicación es tranquila y muy bonita, rodeada de jardines.
Los servicios del alojamiento son muy buenos, baños limpios y servicio de limpieza recurrente. Altamente recomendable.
This Airbnb was lovely to stay in.  Very clean and good amenities such as the pool.  Reception staff were extremely helpful.
Brilliant stay in Singapore, couldn’t have asked for any better - close to circle line MRT for easy access to downtown. Highly recommend.

Fortville非常的乾淨 門口亦有公車站
若下次再來新加坡會再次入住

Mark's place really felt like home while exploring Singapore.  We really enjoyed it and Mark even assisted with early check in that helped the jet lag and time adjustments with our little one.  Will defenitly revisit in thr future.
가격대비 좋았다

Loved staying here! The staff at the front desk were so helpful and when I had trouble with the safe, they were so responsive and sorted it right away! I felt very secure there and the room was pretty soundproof. Bus routes were convenient and the area was quiet. Would definitely stay here again!
great place to stay while in Singapore. lovely apartment, with everything you might need. very easy check in and out. looked after our bags for the day before we flew home. thank you!
大変便利でした。

Good apartment.
All went fine.

This place is exactly what you expect from the listing. Spacious and clean, comfortable. Great shower and large comfy bed. Swimming pool is a bonus, sparkling clean. You'll need to walk a few minutes to get to a bus stop or MRT station that will take you into the city, or get a taxi or Grab. We used HelloRide bike sharing on a 7-day pass, and rode 5 min to the MRT each time - worked perfectly for us and great value if you're on a budget.
Mark was friendly and organized and always there when we needed him. Other staff were just as friendly. The hotel was happy to store our luggage after checkout which enabled us to go out for a last day before heading to the airport. We'd love to stay here again.
Well appointed apartment, close to a hawker centre & lots of public transport options. Good sized apartment that suited our needs for a week long stay.

Mark's place was exactly as shown in the photos. we stayed for 8 nights and it was a very pleasant experience. There is a bus stop right in front and Mountbatten MRT is just a 10min walk from the place.
They did regular housekeeping and also kept our bags after check-out in the afternoon till our flight late at night.
I would strongly recommend it to everyone!
Great stay. Highly recommend

Die Unterkunft ist etwas ausserhab von der Stadt, jedoch sehr gut erreichbar.
Es hat alles notwendige vorhanden, perfekt für eine Städtereise.
Die kommunizieren wahr unkompliziert sowie das Check-in.
Sehr zu empfehlen.

Die Unterkunft war sauber und geräumig. Wir haben die gesamte Zeit über die Fenster geschlossen gehalten, und entsprechend keine einzige Mücke in der Wohnung gesehen. Mit der Klimaanlage war es auch temperaturtechnisch auszuhalten ;) Die Dusche hat warmes Wasser! Uns wurde anfangs gezeigt, wie man es bekommt (einfach ein paar Sekunden warten) und das hat gut geklappt.
Der Pool ist wirklich schön und die allermeiste Zeit waren wir dort allein.
Das Personal vor Ort ist jederzeit hilfsbereit und hat uns bspw. flachere Kissen vorbeigebracht, da die ursprünglichen Kissen uns zu hoch und zu hart waren.
Die Lage der Unterkunft ist total okay - zu Fuß ist es relativ weit (ca. 40 Minuten) in die Innenstadt, aber insbesondere die Busse sind sehr schnell zu erreichen, fahren sehr zuverlässig und lassen sich ebenso wie der MRT einfach mit Karte bezahlen, ohne kompliziert irgendwo Tickets zu besorgen.
Das Hawker-Center nebenan haben wir nicht probiert, da man dort nur mit Bargeld zahlen kann.
the place was fantastic. I will come back
Great place to stay walkable bus stop and  friendly staff and helpful people in short had a great time staying there.

the building has multiple units for rent. The unit we were assigned was on the second floor. The kitchen space is compact but efficient and has the bare necessities.  It has a small fridge. microwave and a two burner cook top. Off the kitchen is an outdoor uncovered balcony with a couple of chairs and a small table. The bedroom is large with lots of storage and a safe. the bathroom has a washer and dryer and a large shower.  the pool and gym are also very nice. there are not very many stores or restaurants in the neighborhood, but there are some about 15 minutes away as well as the train station is about the same walking distance, which is very easy to use and gets you anywhere in the city.

Mark’s place was just what we were looking for. A short distance from Marina Bay Sand but easily accessible with mass transportation.  The serviced apartment allowed us the comfort of home.  Highly recommended!

We enjoyed our stay at Fortville, and felt the location, amenities, price, and service was of great value. The apartment is as described and clean. The location is in a quiet neighborhood and perfectly next to a hawker center, stores, and easy access to public transportation.

I had a great stay at Fortville. It’s at a convenient location. The facilities inside the apartment were true to the description. Everything is clean and easy to find.
Mark is very responsive and always ready to help. The housekeeping staff are super friendly too.
The easy public transport around this area is great (a highlight). I could ride bus 30 to the Vivocity to take the Sentosa express (super easy) and take the same bus (opposite direction, on the same side of the road) to get transit (MRT) to airport.
I would stay at Fortville again when I come to Singapore next time. :)
Cozy apartment in Singapore. Quite spacious, with dryer and washing machine. The city center is easy reachable via bus. Easy check in/check in, everybody is friendly. Would stay there again.

Mark was an excellent host. His place (fortville) is highly recommended if you’re looking for a homely vibey place! it’s super clean and the staff is super duper nice! Whenever i come to singapore again i’ll stay at this place! Thank you Mark! Cheers

Great location, listed as described. Host was accommodating and very clear and helpful with the stay.
Definitely recommend and would come back if travelling that way again it really suited our family, host was very helpful with that

Fortville is a brilliant choice when staying in Singapore!  We were there for almost a month.  The apartment was sparkling clean, spacious and very comfortable!  We loved the walk-in shower and the sunshine that poured in from the window!  The air conditioner was in top condition as was the full-sized refrigerator and the washer and dryer.  The staff were gracious, very polite and work tirelessly to keep the apartments, the public spaces, the grounds and the pool in impeccable condition.  From Fortville, you have easy access to buses and a metro that will take you all over Singapore.  Michael and I want to express a special thanks to Mark for making our stay so wonderful!!!

Fortville is an excellent place to stay if you want some privacy and a decent sized bedroom and bathroom. The reality matched the pictures on the listing. Comfortable bed and fab shower! However, the best aspect of the place is definitely the outdoor swimming pool on the second floor. We mostly had it to ourselves during our stay. The compact kitchen had a good sized fridge, microwave and basic crockery and cutlery. It might have been nice to have air-conditioning in here as well as the bedroom instead of a fan. Our bedroom at the back on the third floor had a view of the pool and some greenery which was pleasant. There is building work going on at the back of Fortville but it was barely noticeable. We rarely met other guests in the lifts or round and about. Everyone was so helpful and accommodating and we hope to return at some point in the future.

My partner and I stayed here for a month while visiting Singapore and LOVED it. There are multiple bus stops within a few minutes walk and public transit is great in Singapore so you can get anywhere easily. Having housekeeping come multiple times per week is amazing, and the apartment was always clean and spotless. Having an in-unit washer and dryer is amazing. The pool is really nice and the gym is small but has all the basics. We were there for Chinese new year and the complex even gave us oranges as gifts and decorated the building. A really positive experience.
The ONLY downside is there’s no oven but that wasn’t a big deal for us.
Definitely recommend!

A fantastic base to stay and explore Singapore.
Spotlessly clean good size apartment in a great neighbourhood.
Apartment is very secure and very private with great transport links for getting all over Singapore.
The front desk team are amazing and cannot do enough to help you.
Couple of good Hawker centres within walking distance and the use of the pool was an added bonus atb the end of long days exploring Singapore.
If you are looking for somewhere to stay in Singapore then I can highly recommend this place.

Cleaning service did a great job. Place was very clean. King size bed & pillows were comfortable. Desk staff were pleasant and helpful. Washer and dryer very convenient. Bus stops close by. Small nearby Hawker center, Jalan Batu, was tasty & reasonably priced, less touristy & had a local feel. Gas station market had a wide selection of food and supplies. We definitely would come back. Road noise can be a little loud sometimes. Wish the subway system was closer.
Tolle Lage, freundliches und hilfsbereites Personal. Tolle Unterkunft für eine Woche.
Amazing location, friendly and helpful staff. Great place to stay for a week.
Marks place was awesome, out of the city but easy to connect to. It was clean and bright and great value for money.
Great location if you like to be away from the city center. Love the proximity to East Coast Park. Had a great stay and highly recommend especially if they find a way to better seal the back door!

We had a brilliant stay at Fortville apartments! Great location out of the centre but close to trains and buses, 5 mins walk from a shop, easy walk to east coast park and we never waited long for a taxi the few times we got one.
The standard of accommodation was great, everything you need for a brief stay, staff were really helpful and showed us how to use everything. Would recommend to anyone!!

Very comfortable place if you plan on staying in Singapore for a longer time. We spent 2 weeks here and having a room, kitchen and bathroom all with plenty of room for 2 made it so convenient and we could feel right at home. The apartments are very luminous, they have everything you could need in a home, and the pool and gym make it so cozy and convenient. The centre is only a bus away, overall very well connected with multiple bus stops around and the MRT station close by. Very quiet as well even thought is right next to a bigger street.
I loved the fact that we got the apartment cleaned so often, it was the best feeling when coming back!
Overall I’m definitely recommending this place.
The place was good and clean. Nice surrounding.

The apartment was very nice. Very clean, good shower, comfortable bed, air con was solid. The gym was small but the pool was big with a nice seating area.
The neighbourhood felt super safe (but so does everywhere in Singapore). Not much nearby, but the bus stop is straight outside. Also, they are building a new metro stop right around the corner so it will soon be ideal to get to the airport and downtown. If you're up for a 25 minute walk, there are some really nice cafes. Nearby hawker centre and grocery will get you by otherwise.
Nice place. Easily accessible
A very comfortable unit but for me, the standout was the great pool.  I had a relaxing cool swim each morning - a great way to start the day.

Place is just like the photos. Friendly staff and very clean. Great location, close to both the airport and lots of tourist destinations. There are multiple bus stops within 5 minutes walking, making it very easy and convenient to explore Singapore from this location.

Wir waren 3 Wochen hier....eine herrliche Zeit! Unser Apartment ging nach hinten raus, somit haben wir nicht viel von Straßenlärm mitbekommen (danke an Mark).Außerdem ist es ruhig im Haus, und in der Umgebung. Der Pool war klasse!! Das housekeeping hat eine tolle Arbeit gemacht, 3 mal die Woche, wenn man möchte. Auch die Herren am Empfang waren prima! Wir hatten einen kaputten Toaster, der wurde sofort repariert. Es wird sehr auf die Hygiene im Haus geachtet, was wir sehr wichtig finden. Auch der öffentliche Busverkehr ist klasse! Am Haus, oder ein paar Minuten entfernt erreicht man die Busse. Die ausgebauten Strecken der Busse und der Metro sind beeindruckend, und die Preise sind günstig, für unsere Verhältnisse! Es hat soviel Spass gemacht, mit dem Doppeldecker Bus zu fahren, aber denkt dran, immer ein Tuch mitzunehmen, da alle Busse/ Metro kalt sind. Wir haben uns sehr wohl in dieser herrlichen Stadt gefühlt und in dieser tollen Unterkunft. Danke von Joachim und Gaby

It was a very good stay.
The place was quiet and relaxing.
I would like to visit again.

My family and I had a wonderful and pleasant stay at Fortville! Thanks to the host, Mark, for being so helpful and accomodative to my last minute request of addition guests. The room was very clean, especially the toilet..clean and spacious. All staff were friendly and helpful too. The apartment is very near to east coast part and the surrounding is very peaceful and tranquil. No regrets choosing Fortville for our stay of  total 12 nights! Thank you!

Very comfortable and clean apartment. Staff were very helpful.
Thank you for a great stay.
The place was very clean and close to everything. We could bike ride most places. Mark was friendly and so quick to respond. We were very appreciate that he allowed us to check out late.
Great stay.
Great memory

Mark is a great host, very positive and responsive. Our stay was amazing. The apartment was great and beyond our expectations, the stuff were super nice and I will always recommend on this place to my friends.

We throughly enjoyed our stay. The bed and pillows were very comfortable. Having the little kitchen was great to make coffee and snacks. The pool was lovely. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the location was within a bus ride or train ride into the city.
Highly recommended.

Mark”s place was simply so so nice !
The area is great too ! The house is spotless ! Mark has been helpful and responsive to our requests ! Great place ! We will definitely come back . Thank you mark 🙏🙏
Lovely stay. Nice location with easy access to anywhere. Recommend to anyone who is looking to find a place to feel like home and live like locals. It would be perfect if we could extend our stays.

Lovely flat in a serviced apartment so was easy to keep clean and get fresh towels/bedding, also has the option to do your own laundry for longer stays. It's very close to multiple bus stops and an easy walk to the circle line MRT. Nice pool if you want to stay in for the day but you can get into central Singapore in 20 minutes so very convenient!

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Marks Unterkunft. Das Airbnb eignet sich perfekt um Singapur zu erkunden, da die Metro Station in der Nähe ist. Außerdem war die Unterkunft wirklich sauber.
Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen, wenn wir in Singapur sind.

C’est un bel petit appartement pour rester une courte durée, mais pour une longue durée, pas beaucoup de services pour les enfants autour…
Toutefois, les personnels sont très gentils et ils offrent un bon service.
The staff were very friendly. The place was clean. Easy access to the city

Quiet, clean and comfortable. Wonderful to arrive home and have fresh towels every few days, friendly staff. Great stay overall. Easy bus ride to DT and to Katong. Do take the 196 to the charming Katong area with great shops and restaurants - trendy feel, it’s about 15-20 minutes.  We had a great Airbnb Katong Street Mural Art tour with Jonathan - highly recommend. Also did a great Vegetarian food tour through little India, China Town and Arab street with Eiktah on Airbnb. Really great overview and understanding of Singapore. These were our favorite things we did in Singapore. We didn’t use the gym as it felt a little run down and hot.

Clean, neat and comfortable. Loved the bed, the lighting is perfect both day and night. It could have one more bedside light and a tea towel for the kitchen. It’s super handy that they provide detergent for a few washes and washing up liquid. There is a bus stop nearby and bikes one can rent. They provide cleaning service as well during our 9-day stay. Look forward to come here every time.
Had an amazing time staying at the apartment! Thank you Mark for making the experience smooth

The place was clean however on a main road that carried lots of trucks and buses throughout the day and evening. The apartment is on the 5th floor and facing the road so there is no escaping the continuous noise. I ended up leaving the apartment for many nights because of the noise.

We enjoyed our stay at Mark's place. Check-in & out was via my mobile phone. Apartment was clean and well designed. We enjoyed taking dips in the pool. As it was during the run-up to Singapore's National Day Parade, we even caught glimpses of a flight of a Chinook and 2 Apache helis dur8ng their rehearsal from the pool!
Do note the provided liquid bath soap in the shower is 1-time only (not refilled), so if you're staying for a prolong period, you should bring more of your own or purchase it from local shops if required.
As our unit was on the 3rd floor, we did noticed quite a lot of ants.
Housekeeping were carried out on Mon, Wed & Fri during our stay. We appreciate this, as we hope this will reduce our impact on the environment.
A hawker centre & shops are a short 5 mins walk away. A 24hr MacDonald's and Decathlon sports gear store are a little further away. A newly opened MRT station right by the place makes it even more convenient to travel around.
Overall, we recommend it!
Nice location

Très bel appartement spacieux. Grande salle de bain.
Emplacement parfait à proximité du mètro et des bus pour visiter Singapour.

The property was in a great location, incidentally a new MRT station opened on the day we arrived, it's literally less than 5 minutes from the property. Having this infrastructure so close by makes it an Ideal choice for a stay, as everything you would want is just a few stops away.
The accommodation itself is great, the kitchen is more than adequate to rustle up a quick meal. Alternatively there are two hawker centres walking distance from the property. Jalan Batu being the closest, Old Airport Road being a ten to fifteen minute walk.
The bed is great, the shower is awesome, my only moan is the busy road, but to be honest, it's a fact of life, so it wasn't an issue. The apartment is air conditioned.
A special thanks goes out to the lovely lady who serviced our apartment three times a week, she deserves mention here.
The outside amenities on floor two are also an added bonus.

Superlocatie en vlakbij de MRT, snelle reacties van Mark, reageerden snel op onze vragen en verzoeken en kregen zelfs oordopjes toen we klaagden over het geluid van de straat. Dit appartement ligt aan de straatzijde van het gebouw, dus als je rust zoekt, vraag dan naar een appartement aan de achter-zwembad-zijde van het gebouw. Verder heel vriendelijk opgelost, super schoon, 3x per week schone handdoeken en cleaning service. Wasmachine met wasdroger. Super Service

We stayed for 10 days at the apartment. The location was nice and the connection with the recently opened MRT station was excellent. However the street was a bit noisy at night and the windows are quite thin. There was a hawker center close by and also the service from the staff was excellent. We enjoyed our stay very much.

This was our third stay here. While there were some very minor and uncontrollable hiccups here and there, this will continue to be our go to in Singapore. The staff on property were all extremely nice and friendly, responses here are very prompt and the hosts are very accommodating.

The place is very clean, the AC works well. It's in a little pocket that has only received an MRT recently. It's just a two-minute walk to the train, but you have to go a few stops and transfer to get to most places. There's a lot of stuff, I found, at Marine Parade, two stops north (mall with good supermarket) but nothing right outside the front door of the flat. But it's a good quality place.
marks home is a great location to the mrt. I was able to get around easily. very peaceful

Great stay. Place was as described and really close to everything including MRT and buses, it made it really easy to get around. The only thing that was a little difficult for us was that the air con blows air directly over the bed which can be a little uncomfortable some times.
Overall a great stay.
Thank you for good room
We had a lovely stay at Mark’s apartment. Apartment was as pictured and described and close to bus snd MRT stations.
Fabulous apartment,  well equipped and pristine.  Large comfortable bed, large tv and plenty of hanging space/drawers. Would highly recommend staying here.
Clean, comfortable and conveniently located. Highly recommend Mark’s place in Fortville.

I lived in SG for 6yr and still visit for work. The Airbnb/short-term apt market in SG is poor, with govt pushing you towards hotels. So a min. one-week serviced apt is pretty rare. I stayed for 2 one-week stints in August.
Since the Katong Park MRT opened the area is much more accessible to the metro and so all of the island. Buses stop right outside. My apt was on rear so no noise from main road. Most people will check-in on arrival using phone - small point is iPhone browser blocks the check-in page so need to fiddle with settings. No hot water on arrival but quickly fixed. Aircon is good.
Great for short stays, nice kitchen area. The main space could be better designed to fit a small sofa. It's an investment property so no personal touches (a few wall prints would be cheerful). The 2 pillows are so hard/high that I went to Ikea for a S$6 replacement! Couple of soft pillows please!
Coffee at Goodman Arts Center is a treat. Esso convenience store has most stuff. I'd stay again.
Friendly staffs, clean room. Very pleasant stay.

Marks place is a service apartment that is in an extremely convenient location for Singapore. There are bus stops right in front of the apartment and the MRT is just a short 2-3 mins walk away that takes you directly straight into town. The apartment was spotlessly clean. It matched the description very well. All the staff there were very friendly and helpful from checking in and out to cleaning up the room. Definitely highly recommend marks airbnb and we will be back for our future travels to Singapore.

This was my second one-week stay during a month in Singapore. Katong Park is residential, so quiet, but minutes away by MRT or bus to places to eat, and things like Gardens by the Bay or Botanic Gardens. The new MRT station has really opened up this area for visitors (and a further extension will connect to the airport). Cycle hire from Bike Stop, 10 mins walk, is recommended as the east coast cycle path is well worth trying. Few local places to eat but endless within 10 mins by bus or MRT. Convenience stores at the 2 petrol stations 5 mins away have lots of essentials. It looks like a new building is going up in the next plot so expect day time noise the next year or so.  For my taste these apartments are nicer than a hotel for a stay of min 7 days, and connectivity to anywhere on the island is now a real selling point. A rare find in a very thin Airbnb market.
Highly recommend. Mark is very helpful even let us check out late. Beautiful pool. Everything is good, just be mindful it’s very noisy as our room was near the road side.

Very convenient location in Singapore, great facilities. Definitely recommend!

Great location, very close to train station and great bus stations nearby.

Some listed amenities were missing. E.g. oil, salt & pepper, shampoo. They provide lots of towels and toilet paper every other day though and there is room service (cleaning) provided. The provided laundry detergent was only enough for two and comes with no refills though.
View from the apartment may not be that great so the big windows everywhere were not as nice as expected. Mostly because the surrounding area is not that interesting.
Being able to watch Netflix on the TV is nice and allows for some great relaxing time at home when taking a break from travelling. The bed was also pretty comfortable and washroom is spacious (though the water takes a while to heat up). Overall, for the price and convenience, this place is great.
Breezy and conveniently situated . Service staff polite and helpful

Great stay at fortville!  it went very soonthly. This was the worst AirBnBn experience I ever encountered. The room was different and a lot worse than the one shown on AirBnB. There was no table, no chair and the window was covered to render the room completely dark. On the last day of my stay the air-con nearly gave up. The room is a former storage room next to the kitchen and when the old lady was preparing food, the foul smell (at least to my nose) was wafering into my rented room.
The muslim lady was as little friendly as absolutely necessary.
If I would have had a chance, I would have changed immediately to another AirBnB place. About any other.
The place is for one who wants to look for a budget place to stay. Simple room with fan and AC. There are some restaurants in walking distance.

Please note that the room has no power outlets and so you can’t charge your phone in the room itself! It also has noisy drain pipes in the ceiling. The room was rather gloomy. The hosts were nice though.

air-con did not function well
clean and comfortable room at floor 1, easy to move my luggage in
What a beautiful host and lovely home. Easy, no fuss, everything as described.  Thank you
Great place to stay. Bathroom was very clean. Bed was comfortable. The house is close to bus stop.  We would stay here again.
Really comfortable to stay.
Quiet spot very close to the MRT and four stops from Changi airport. Very friendly host. Recommended as a very affordable accommodation.
Die Gastgeber-Familie waren sehr freundlich und in dem Haus war alles sehr sauber. Die Lage war in Ordnung. Das Zimmer war ziemlich dunkel und klein, aber das Bett war bequem.

Great deal for Singapore! A simple space in a family home, near some really good restaurants, train station and airport. Nargis and her family were extremely nice, and the home was very organized and clean. Perfect spot for anyone on a budget.

The room was very clean. Nargis and her family always responded kindly to our questions. It was a wonderful experience to meet Nargis on the last day of travel in Singapore, although short but very happy.

I stayed in Nargis's place for 6 nights in the utility room with a large bed, a ceiling fan, Air Conditioned room. Walking space is tight as there was two large cabinets one with shelving where you can place all your stuffs. Toilet is shared and on the 2nd floor, that was always dry and clean. Wifi is also available and fast.
Ideal for budget travellers who are only seeking a shelter over their heads for the night and who does not expect much.
Nargis and her husband was especially kind, helpful and attentive. They once saw me refilling my water bottle and every night they ensured that the water storage tupperware was full for me.
Nargis's place is quiet and peacful with several eateries along the main road halal and non-halal. It is also a short walk to the MRT ( East/West Line ) and along the way there is a Masjid which is convenient for muslim travellers. You can also take a short bus ride to more food stalls along onan road.
There is no self laundry nearby but I believe you can work something out with Nargis and her husband whom even took the time to keep me company over coffee for a chat as I was travelling alone.
So for those whom are not expecting much. Nargis is the place for budget accommodation.
Outstanding value for money. Host was very efficient and helpful.
Minimalistic but neat and clean room, and the place has everything that you need. Amazing hospitality, I recommend!
Wonderful hospitality, Nargis went way and beyond with check-in arrangements and overall provided outstandingly friendly hospitality!
Very helpful. Value for money.

101% recommended
This place looks great, very clean place, easy to lcoate, no curfew especially late at night and very hospitable owner. (101% recommended )
Good Place.
Nice and clean.

Room is super neat. Bed is comfy and the blanket is warm and fluffy enough. Mrs. Nargis and her family are really nice. The place is near a mosque and Muslim communities so it's really helpful for Muslim backpackers to find affordable halal foods.
Buen lugar si estás de paso muy cerca de la estación del metro que te lleva directo al aeropuerto y directo también al centro de la ciudad. Ampliamente recomendable
Nothing to comment
位置离机场很近，房间插座在房间外面，房间的灯不太灵敏 总体感觉不错 房主很热情
It’s a very clean house. The bathroom is clean too. Nargis is a kindly person. I have a great memory in here 5days
Clean and big room space
Nice place for affordable price . Thank you Nargis!
Great if you just want a place to sleep. Safe area and friendly host, easy to reach both the airport and the city centre by the train or bus.

Nargis’s place was really tidy and clean.
The host was responsive as well.
Such a great place for short-term stay. Totally worth it!
Clean, quit place to rest, easy access to transport be it bus or train, near by with eatery. A drawback is the toilet and bath room is upstair, however, the toilet is always dry and clean.

The place is exactly what it says it is. It's a small room, don't expect anything else. But it's only a 10-15 min walk from MRT. A good safe area. The AC is good and the room gets very cold. The host are nice and welcoming. I was only here one night but it was a nice simple stay for a cheap price.
Very good host!
Perfect for the money.

Chambre dans maison située à 15 minutes de l'aéroport en voiture et 30 minutes en bus. Très chaud et humide dans la chambre mais situation géographique pratique pour une nuit avec petit budget pour Singapour.

Convenient location just off Changi Rd, with a fairly spacious room, air con (definitely a must), and a shared bathroom. Great for staying a few nights (we just stayed the one night while waiting for a flight)

Nargis's place is pretty much as advertised. It's easy to find from the MRT station and about 5 minutes walk. Good amenities nearby - public transport and good choice of eating places. There is no power socket in the room, but the host has an extension lead which you can plug in in the kitchen a couple of feet away.

The house is clean, but the window cannot be opened, it cannot be ventilated, and it is next to the kitchen, and the food smell cannot be scattered. It is recommended whether the window can be opened and ventilated. Everything else was good.
Local extremamente limpo, anfitriões agradáveis.
It was very nice staying at Nargis’s

위치와 호스트의 친절은 최고였다. 하지만 여자 혼자서 머물기에는 불편한점이 있었다. 방은 1층 부엌안에 위치하였으며, 화장실은 1층에 없고 2층에만 있었다. 공용 화장실이라고 알고 갔지만 1층에 없고 2층에만 있는지 몰랐었기에 약간은 불편했다.
화장실을 자주 가는 여자들은 참고하기를 바란다.

가격대비 좋아요.
