Great host. Wish to visit again when I will have a chance again

Very nice and welcoming family. Perfect communication with Nargis.
It was just a small room next to the kitchen, but good to stay for a night or two.
Would definitely stay there again!

The house and room were very clean and the hosts very nice. The room is on the bottom floor with shared bath upstairs. I stayed overnight enroute to another country so the location was good- close to Changi and cheap by cab ($10) or MRT (2.50). It was a bit of a trek with two bags from MRT and not clear how to get there so I took cab from Changi stop.
House is very quiet and AC made for good night's sleep. On the street nearby are noodle shops and good Halal food across from a mosque. It was a perfect transition between Indonesia and San Francisco.

My room and the shared bathroom were clean. I can drop off my bags before check in which is very helpful. It was app. 20-25 mins by train from Changi and around 30-40 mins by bus. Train station only 5 mins away by walking distance aand the bus stop even nearer (1 mins). Easy to find your way around. A lot of restaurants just across the street. Overall, it was a nice stay at Ms. Nargis home
Really perfect. Everything was very good. The communication, the home, the Owners, the city. Highscore! I would stay everytime again at this home!
A simple place with everything a normal traveler needs.
Value for money. Very clean, and as advertised.
A clean room in a nice house. Thanks for having me!
Very good price and very clean. Close to the MRT Station.

I stayed only one night, just landed on Changi in the evening, and left on next morning.
Mrs. Nargis's house was perfectly good choice with a convenient location.
Nearest MRT station is 10 minutes in walking distance, also can choose No.24 bus route from Changi directly, after get off the bus you can reach by only 2 minutes.
Mrs. Nargis and family were so polite and have warm attitude.
Room was big enough and really clean, my stay was comfortable.
I fully recommend to a person who wants to stay close to the airport with a reasonable price.
夕方にチャンギ着、翌朝のフライトまでの宿泊＋リトルインディアに遊びに行くことを考えて選びました。空港からのMRTだとKembangan駅からは徒歩10分ぐらい、あと24番のバスだと停留所からすぐです。
Nargisさんは親切で優しく、ご主人も同様にフレンドリーな方で、それぞれ英語でのコミュニケーションは全く問題なしでした。部屋も十分な広さで快適でしたが、あくまでも家の中の一部屋を借りる形なので、外からの出入り時は家族団欒の居間の横を通る形になります。普通のお宅に泊めてもらっている感じで、私はむしろ楽しかったです。周囲は完全に住宅街なので夜はとても静かです。一方でバス通りに出れば食堂も色々あるので、近所でも食事には不自由ないと思います。空港近くでコストパフォーマンスの高い宿泊場所を探している方におすすめです。
Great place to stay on outskirts of Singapore

The room is big, and there is enough space for up to 2 person. The bathroom was very clean. The Metro station and some convenience stores were very close. There a very cheap and very nice restaurants nearby.
Easy to get to from Changi and great for a short stay/layover. Nargis was a welcoming host and and the room was as described.
Nice place to stay and house owner very friendly

Nargis und ihr Mann waren super nette host. Ich konnte mein Gepäck noch länger bei Ihnen lassen und spöter abholen als ich zum Flughafen musste.
Bis in die Stadt von Singapur dauert es leider etwas. Mit dem Bus 45min und mit der Bahn circa 25 min.

Nargis’s place is conveniently close to the MRT (kembangan), which is about four stops, or around 10 mins away from Tampines where you can find a mall with a lot of stores some places for food, but most importantly - a gym where you can pay as you go (for S$8)
The room and facilities provided were clean and very useful. AC was provided as stated and they even accommodated a late check-in, which was very much appreciated.
You have some nearby local food stores to try if you wish, but with the MRT being so close and the convenience of the Grab app (similar to Uber, with good rates), it’s a great location to stay if you’re in Singapore.
Nargis and her family are very humble. Their house is sparkling clean and i love to stay here,you'll find a lot of food around this area
good stay!

The reason I chose to stay at Nargis is that I can leave my luggages even after check-out and come back for them before heading to the airport. They are a beautiful family. They were so kind.
Along the road going to their place from Kembangan MRT are many restaurants.
Very nice stay. Would do again
Nargis and is family are very charming and welcoming people. I had a very nice stay at her home. Thank you so much.

The room is very clean, quiet . The house is near to the MRT station and near to the Changi airport, it’s very convenient . Easy to check in. Nargis is a nice host. Really a nice experience living here.
The house is very clean and quiet, and the owner is very friendly. I will definitely come to stay next time.
Convenient location.
Very nice place for great price and with great hospitality.
Simple yet privacy. The bathroom and bed sheet are clean. Thanks Nargis.
the house is very very clear, it is near the airport, just away from four stations that takes half an hour by subway. also easy and convenient to the other parts of the city.
everything is wonderful!

Sehr ruhige Gegend. Trotzdem alles vorhanden ( Shops, streetfood, Restaurants, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel).
Mathis und Fati sind sehr freundlich und zurückhaltend. Zimmer ist klein, aber alles da!
Great place to stay, close to 24 hours restaurants, train and bus station. If you are on a low budget this place is a great one to spend a couple of nights
Einfaches Zimmer
Everything was great. Good location, perfectly clean, amazing host.
I only stayed one night, and I had a good and a quiet night as expected, I couldn’t meet Nargis but was fast responsive thru messages, I hope to come back to singapore again one day!
Generally centralized location! Location is very important whether you are on vacation or work! Everything simply available!

Well located apartment, nice room. cold aircon for hot singapore. feels safe with the common area cctvs. cleaner was welcominig. self checkin instrcutions worked well. well return here. thanks joey!! very helpful host!
The room is suite for 2 persons. It's easier for light cooking and washing machine is also provided for clothes washing. The location is near to MRT and the supermarket is just in the complex.

I love my stay in this house! This place is beautifully decorated, cozy and comfortable and the location is great, close to public transport (mrt and bus) and many nice eateries. Peir is such a superhost, she was always very prompt to help. I had a great short stay here. Thanks so much, Peir!

Im here in Singapore for few days trip and I love the stay in the attic room, it's well decorated, has a table for me to use my laptop, and the bed is very comfy. I particularly like the wooden floor, the room gave me the similar relaxing feel I got in Norway. Pier and her dad are friendly and nice to talk to.

The room under the roof is tastefully decorated and the aircon does a wonderful job of keep the climate pleasant.
There is also wonderful porch/garden, perfect for a relaxed breakfast to start the day.
Peir is a lovely host who made meI feel at home.
A stylish/wonderful place with nice and considerate host/

Peir’s place was great. It was spacious and had everything you needed. It was as she advertised. Although Peir wasn’t there she made sure her helper was there to help with the check-in process. The place is very close to food places and also an mrt station. I am very happy with the stay and would recommend!
Thanks
和房东沟通交流很好，家里很有艺术气息，只是床稍微有点小对于睡两个人来说。阁楼不适合携带大件行李箱的游客，上下会有点困难，清晨有公鸡叫我们起床，很特别的一次入住体验。房东人很好，我想取消后两天的预定，立马同意了。

It was the second time I stayed at Peir's place; as previously, I really enjoyed my stay. Peir and her father are lovely people who make yourself welcome and comfortable. The house is at a 3-minute walk for the MRT station and the Downtown Line takes you all the way to the CBD. The patio is great to chill out and the room is spacious and comfortable. I look forward staying at Peir's place next time I will be in Singapore
Beautiful house, good surrounding, very friendly host.

I had a wonderful and relax stay in Pier’s home. The location is great and easy to travel to central area. It is just 5 mins walk to MRT station. I feel very relax staying there. Peir, her father and also her helper are all very kind. The air condition in my room works very good. Peir is always providing me help whether I request.
Quiet place, Peir and her father are all very nice
I have a great time here. host are friendly and supportive. nice environment and atmosphere. definitely worthy to stay!
Cozy and comfortable place to stay, close to public transport and restaurants.

This place is really cozy with a wide room and its ambience. What is more important, I enjoyed myself living a life of a Singaporian upper class.
If you get tired of the city life in Singapore with a small room and a noisy environmemt, you should definitely give it a try to stay here!

The best people and the best place you can ever experience in Singapore. Go for it fellow travelers, Pier and her father are both incredible hosts and a great company for conversations! Love them to bits !

We had an amazing stay at Peir's place. She and her father were wonderfully welcoming and chatting with them was an experience in itself! They were highly responsive and quick to deal with all feedback as well. The attic room was lovely and quaint and well furnished; the rest of the house was beautiful as well with lots of gorgeous artwork. Rather than feeling like we were in a rented place, it felt like we were being welcomed into their home. One thing that some people may not be prepared for is, as Peir already mentions in the listing, the fact that the roosters will crow early in the morning (5 or 6 am). However it is easy to get used to the crowing (and it is actually quite nice waking up like that to sunrise and the roosters are so friendly too!) and earplugs are provided in any case. It is a rare thing to leave an Airbnb feeling like you've made friends, and the experience was pleasant overall. We will definitely stay there again. Thanks Peir and dad!
Pleasant as always

Still remember the first night when I found Peir’s home. The house is like a beauty hidden in the concrete jungle. It’s nice decorated, very distinctive and really close to the nature. Pier and her father both have eyes to find beauty which makes the house much like a gathering place of beautiful things. What a great experience. There’s no doubt that I’ll choose to stay here If I come to Singapore next time. Lucky to meet you guys! Thank you for your sharing.

Peir and her father are lovely people and it was really nice meeting them. However, there were a few issues we faced during our stay:
- there is no door or lock in the room on the loft
- the staircase to the loft is circular and very thin, making it quite risky to go up and down and that too with luggage or in the middle of the night when you want to use the restroom downstairs
- the bathroom is on a level below the loft room and shared by 2-3 others
- the bed is great for 1 person but quite small for 2
- roosters are indeed very loud and incessant
- the flooring is wooden which makes it noisy for the people downstairs. But you simply cant stop walking in your own room because of this!
- location is not too conducive to central or major attractions. It was not possible to come in the middle of the day to rest and head back. We mostly stayed out all day as getting back home in between was just not possible
- we stayed for 6 nights but didnt get any cleaning. Would have been good to get some level of cleaning (rooms, sheets and towels) at least once in the middle of our stay

peir和大叔对我们家热情招待，不像酒店，住起来冷冰冰的，住他家感觉很有生活的味道。另外她家的装饰很有艺术范。
他家就在地铁口附近，交通非常方便。并且她家附近就有个熟食中心，以及一个大排档一条街，无论是白天吃饭还是夜宵，都非常方便。
我们一家人都非常喜欢住那。
如果有下次有机会，我们还会住在那，也推荐朋友过去。

Such a wonderful experience staying in this beautiful house. We really enjoyed our stay. Genuine and gracious hosts, spacious and tastefully furnished house. Quiet neighbourhood, house full of greenery and birdsong every morning. Much more luxurious than staying in a 5 star hotel!
Thanks so much for hosting us, this was a truly memorable experience. We hope to come back again, and will recommend all our friends who visit Singapore to stay here

Peir and her father are great hosts! The house is really specious and in a good neighborhood. The room is at top floor, so you will have lot of privacy. A lot of nice restaurants close to the house (would recommend A-Lazar and Five Star).
I took the metro to Downtown (about 20 minutes), with Grab/Uber can be even quicker.
I would love to come again!

Peir's place is lovely, clean and spacious. The bed is super comfortable. The location is great too as it's only 4 minutes away from MRT station. Peir and Dewi are very hospitable and helpful. Dewi helped me with my lugage and laundry which I really appreciate. Would totally recommend this place!
Excellent host and prompt reply. The decoration style of the house is nice. Highly recommend!
Peir's place was great . Unique house and less than five min walk to MRT.  Beautiful spiral staircase leads to top floor with great A/C

This is a truly unique place with a real view on what it means to live as a local resident of Singapore. The hospitality of the host family is truly warming and you feel right at home. The fauna and the flora of the place make it the right amount of homey and exotic. We even had fresh mango from one of their trees on our last day. The roosters are a nice alarm clock and refuse to let you sleep in when you should be out and exploring all of the wonderful sights and sounds of Singapore which was a good thing for us since we sometimes sleep too late! The apt is close to one of the best open food markets in Singapore and a short walk to the metro station to downtown or wherever. A cab ride into downtown is only about 25 minutes. Beautiful and cozy place that almost makes you feel like you live there too.

This was our second stay at Peir's place and likely not the last! The hospitality by Peir and her father was top notch just as before, as they welcomed us like part of their family. They were full of local knowledge, stories, and recommendations and it was always a pleasure to chat with them, not to mention they were very quick to respond to our messages.
The location remains conveniently near to public transport (both bus and tube) and also restfully quiet. At the same time, within a short five minute walk or less, we had access to numerous restaurants and cafés, local hawker fare, and supermarkets, as well as a fridge to store our groceries in.
Peir is also very responsive to suggestions and comments. The last time we stayed, we mentioned that the bed was a bit old and springy. This time when we returned, the bed had been replaced with a brand new, highly comfortable mattress, which was very much appreciated!
Overall, another wonderful stay in Singapore at Peir's. Thank you!

It was a lovely stay at Peirs Home. She is a great and friendly host, very welcoming. Spacious and clean room. Everything was like she described it in her ad. We can definitely recommend this place and would not hesitate to come back again. Highly recommended.
很舒服的床！
Awesome！

Pier will welcome you in a truly tropical house.
Neighborhood is really nice and cosy with lots of good food around. Just few minutes walk, you can discover fantastic parks with wild animals and plans. Definitely a highlight of our trip was a run through MacRitchie Trail, TreeTop Walk and Bukit Timah Natural Reserve.
Dont come, if you dont like chickens :) We didnt mind, but they will give you the feeling of being on a tropical farm.
The house is nice and clean, and even though we stayed on the attic which was very hot, the air condition could pull it off. A great plus for us was, that we could use the washing machine, which came in handy after few weeks of travelling.
Very nice villa house which is just what I expected for EastSouth Asia. Good landlord, clean house. 在这个多雨之城庭院听雨。

Beautiful house ... lots of character. I wish I had more time to spend.. this was a short stop over before I flew back from home. The desk in the room was perfect to get some work done and the upstairs was classy ... I loved it !!!

Private and comfy
This is a great location for hiking or mountain biking, and the local stores have plenty to eat and a good coffee shop (Flagwhite).
很棒的体验，房子很美，交通很便利，期待下次来新加坡还可以住peir 家
非常不错的一次住宿体验，房东热情好客，帮助我们提行李，房间很干净，装饰很有品味
peir家是很有新加坡特色的联排，艺术又温馨，离地铁站美世界只有5分钟的舒适路程，地铁站口上就有条美食街，各种美食都有，出行吃饭都很方便，5星

The host actually is kind enough for accepting my reschedule couple of days before booking time.
However, I think the owner of the house should not rent out the top floor for guests, because the floor is made of wood, and when we walk it always makes a sound that she thinks is too loud so it can be heard downstairs.
We have to walk like a ninja when in the room, and whispers to each others because she complains a lot against us and it really disturbs our comfort as room occupants.

Peir is a kind and wonderful host. We had a great stay in this beautiful house! The room was big and spacious with many beautiful artworks in the house, and location really convenient for all the major attractions in singapore. Peir gave us many tips for places to eat around the area as well. Thank you!

A comfy stay during our short getaway in SG!
Peir and her family was very welcoming and very responsive !
Peir is great host, responsive and hospitable. The location is very close subway, about 3mins walk. The place is clean and convenient. Recommend!
如果你喜欢民宿，请一定要来！如果你本身习惯于住酒店，请也一定要来尝试下！哈哈，感谢这几天的关照，希望你们健健康康，开开心心！
The house is lovely, full of antiquities and owned by very kind and welcoming people. It's very close to the metro, so moving around the city is fast and convenient. Highly recommended!
整体来说是不错的，有几个缺点：1，隔音太差；2，楼上区域三个房间共用一个厕所，太拥挤；3，厕所的洗护用品真的可以换一下吗？感觉非常low；4，床单被套什么的有点脏，住了几天得了湿疹；5，家中杂物太多，有种入住仓库的感觉；6，远离市区，每次都要乘坐十几个地铁站才到达市区。不过附近有几家网红餐厅蛮好吃的。还有如果是一群姐妹朋友来住，应该会好很多，如果两个保姆能离开更好哈哈哈。
Very good host ,I highly recommend.

peir是一个很热情好客的小姐姐，全程都有帮助我们，入住的时候帮忙拿行李箱，走的时候也帮忙拿行李箱，真的很厉害，中文也很流畅，有不懂的地方都能够回答到我们。房间和图片一模一样，虽然是在阁楼，但是很安静，peir的父亲也很亲切，给我们讲故事，哈哈哈，园子就是一个小型花园，很漂亮，还有一些小动物，每天早上公鸡都会打鸣，还有一只很酷的狗狗，总之这次入住体验非常美好，交通也很便利，走5分钟就能到地铁站，到各个景点都还蛮方便的，如果还有机会来新加坡，我一定还会选择这里，有家的感觉。
The place is very easy to find and has a very relaxing feel! Peir is very responsive and had been very accommodating during our entire stay. Thanks, Peir!

Pleasant stay in a lovely clean house. A few people had complained about the chickens/cockerel but they never bothered us at all didn’t really hear them to be honest. Peir is a lovely host but as we were out most of the time didn’t really see anyone. Very quiet house. Good location for Bukit Temah and near to MRT and shops/ eateries. Would stay here again.

Peir's home is brilliant, a home in Singapore (not a flat) m, very vintage, brilliant home, great location, near the MRT and with lovely surrounding of birds, what else can one ask for!!! A Superhost!!!

Peir’s place is beautiful. It is located in a very nice residential area. It’s quiet, and her home is a place of natural beauty. There’s a beautiful garden with birds chirping early morning and the whole place has a feel of calm and peacefulness. The bathrooms are finished in marble; also ample closet space, desks, dressing tables, floor length mirror in dining area, small but adequate kitchen with a washer/dryer. The refrigerator was mid-sized and could have been a bit larger. Breakfast downstairs is surprisingly extensive with a few warm items such as soup and savory pastries. There are a swimming pool, tennis court and basketball court on the property. Umbrellas at the door were a thoughtful touch for a city where it pours without much warning. The doorman and front desk staff are warm and friendly, as are staff who clean the apartment and provide fresh towels daily except on Sundays. There is also a dry-cleaning and laundry service picked up and delivered to the door. Having visited Singapore and lived there previously, this apartment was a great find! Last but not least, I would have found it helpful to know this is a large building over 20 stories which consists entirely of serviced apartments. It is perfect for those traveling in large groups.
Overall, we would highly recommend this apartment.

We stayed in Alee's house for 3 days. The stay was moderately comfortable, let me provide brief overview of the accommodation:
Pros:
- The house is near many eateries which are open 24 hours. So, several of food options are available.
- The house is near a FairPrice shop, so one can purchase grocery, fruit,stationary etc at ease.
- The room and toilet were clean. The AC was working properly.
Cons:
- Depending on walking speed, the house is 11-15 minutes away from Eunos MRT and NOT 7 minutes as claimed by the host.
- The kitchen is shared between 6 rooms and very untidy. Neither there was any soap nor any scrubber in the sink. The kitchen tops were greasy. No cloth/mop was provided for cleaning the dining table and the table was greasy. As a whole, the kitchen is very dirty.
- The room lock is defective. One has to try several times before the lock opens. It's a matter of serious concern. I felt tensed when the lock was not opening in the dead of night.
- It takes roughly 40 minutes by train to reach the CBD. So, if someone is short of time and wants to cover most Singapore attraction, this place is not suitable.
- The house, in our view, is not value for money. We have stayed in many Airbnb houses before and giving this opinion based on our experience.
The house is okay for a day or night stay, but we do not recommend this house for anyone who wants to stay for more than 2 days. We reckon, you should find a better house in the same price.

With the limited description for this property we were a bit nervous as to how it would be – thankfully we were pleasantly surprised. The room is within a 5/6 bedroom 2 bathroom house. The house has a full kitchen (gas burners, oven, microwave, fridge) and we had a kettle in our room. There was a washing machine and an area to hang your clothes out the back of the house. The room itself was very spacious – a comfy bed, wardrobe, desk/chair, even a futon with a little coffee table that we could use to hang out! The location was also great – walking distance to the train station and there is a local supermarket about a 5 minute walk away. The supermarket and the kitchen enabled us to cook our meals and save money in Singapore. Throughout our stay Alee was very responsive via Air BnB with any questions and also gave us a property tour when we arrived.
The drawbacks of this property were the lack of bathrooms – most bedrooms seemed to have 2-3 people and with just two bathrooms there were people often in them, showering between 6am and midnight so there wasn’t really an ‘off peak’ time. There are no screens in the windows and the doors/windows seems to be left open (there is a gate so this isn’t a security issue) and the house had lots of mosquitos throughout our stay - including in our room. I was bitten the first two nights while sleeping until we managed to kill all the mosquitos in our room, but they remained a problem in the communal areas. And the last drawback were the thin walls – the longer term residents beside us stayed up late watching loud movies in their room which we could hear in ours. Even with these draw backs, I think the price is great for Singapore and the kitchen really helps keep costs low.

L'appartamento di Diane è un ottimo compromesso per chi vuole visitare Singapore dormendo in un alloggio di qualità ottima senza spendere una fortuna. L'appartamento si trova in un quartiere molto tranquillo (fermata metro Outram Park, a solo una fermata da Chinatown) a 5 minuti a piedi dalla metro. Il portone del palazzo è sempre aperto, si sale al primo piano dove troviamo una porta (questa che si può chiudere a chiave) che dà su un piccolo corridoio da dove si accede ai due appartamenti di Diane. Al centro del corridoio c'è la zona lavanderia. L'appartamento è esattamente come si vede in foto, molto spazioso, silenzioso e pulito. Diane mi ha scritto spiegandomi esattamente come arrivare alla casa dalla fermata della metro (con tanto di fotografie che mi sono servite molto per orientarmi anche perchè noi siamo arrivati che era già buio) e mi ha lasciato il contatto di Nympha, la governante, con la quale dovevo mettermi d'accordo per avvisarla sull'orario esatto del nostro arrivo. Una volta arrivati siamo andati a bussare a Nympha (che abita al piano sopra l'appartamento) e lei ci ha dato le chiavi e illustrato la casa. Nympha è anche disponibile per pulire l'appartamento durante il soggiorno, che sia di un giorno o una settimana. Letto comodo, bagno funzionale, in camera c'è anche divano con tv, armadio, un piccolo stendino e la cucina dotata di tutto se si vuole cucinare qualcosa. Consiglio a tutti questo alloggio, in due EUR 250 per tre notti, sicuramente un ottimo prezzo per Singapore. Chiaramente non siamo né in centro né al 50esimo di un grattacielo...ma a noi questa cosa non interessava, volevamo solo un posto tranquillo e decoroso dove riposarci dopo un'intensa giornata in giro per la città. 入住：很方便，我是晚上10点多到的，也有人值班，在前台填个表就可以领到钥匙，管理员会带着上楼。
房间：房间并不是很大，但在新加坡也不算小了，独立的卫生间和淋浴房。有微波炉、电磁炉、电水壶、锅碗刀具餐具，还有洗衣机和迷你冰箱。每天早上可以自己煎蛋煎香肠。房间wifi很稳定。最最喜欢的是房间里的小阳台，也是我最终决定住在这里的原因，简直太棒了，大概有10平方米左右，有顶，所以就成了房间的扩散空间，可以晾衣服，傍晚可以在阳台上吃晚餐、乘凉。还有一点很神奇，新加坡绿化这么好，虫子却很少，晚上在阳台上开着灯，也不会有虫子绕着灯飞，也没有蚊子，偶尔会有小壁虎经过。
周边：特别特别方便，下楼斜对面就有一个24小时营业的fairprice，然后fairprice再向左20米，有一段大约100米的街道，全是餐厅，中餐、日料、泰国菜、pizza、本地菜、印度菜、按摩店，选择非常丰富。附近是红线someset地铁站，走过去5分钟都不到。地铁站边上有个滑板公园，喜欢滑板的人千万不要错过。穿过地铁站就是著名的乌节路。
房东Joyce：虽然没有见面，但却能感受到她的善意，非常好沟通，并且回复很快。
缺点：边上有个大楼正在建设中，所以白天会有点吵。楼下还有座庙宇，我住的2星期里，刚巧碰到一次法会，念了一天的经，真的非常大声，从中午一直持续到晚上9点多。

Très bon accueil et une bonne réactivité des messages. L’appart est parfait pour un couple et À quelques pas de chinatown et à côté d’une ligne de métro ! Donc accessible

Ji's place is very clean and tidy which makes me feel very comfortable. It's also located in the great location with walking distance to Chinatown, and even the main CBD. I am very happy with my stay in Ji's place.
Thank very much Ji.
The location was great.
Jj's house is very good location and many local food nearby. The house is very comfortable with air con and TV. We spend pleasant time there.

Sistemazione carina e abbastanza spaziosa, soffitto molto alto (credo più di 5 metri) che rende molto caratteristico l'appartamento. Letto comodissimo, location silenziosa, finestre da cui entra forse un po troppa luce la notte (io ho dormito con la mascherina perchè la luce mi infastidisce)

Pros
- Very high ceiling & lots of natural light from windows
- Good air conditioning
- Spacious bed
- Room was clean
- Close to bus stops : you can easily go to downtown/CBD with bus
- Good local eatery nearby (tiong bahru bakery is like 2 min walk)
- Nympha(jj's assistant) was very kind and helpful
- Easy & quick check-in/out
Cons
- Quite far from MRT (10 mins walk)
- No elevators (if you carry a big luggage, this isn't a good place for you)
- "Hot" water comes and goes (usually I had kind of warm water in the shower)
- Sound from the street can be quite loud / annoying, especially during the morning
- Water dropping sound from the bathroom shower drain (you can't hear this when door's closed though)
- Hard to find the right time to use the washing machine because you have to share with other guests (it was always in use whenever I attempted to)
The personal assistant Nympha was really nice and helpful! She even found my lost MRT card and texted me

我覺得在新加坡，這是一個很棒的房間。雖然距離捷運站，走路約需8-10分鐘，但是Jj給了很好的訊息，讓我們很容易地找到它。他的助手Nympha也是一個很好的人。住在這裡，散步2分鐘就會遇到新加坡特色的小吃、咖啡店，5分鐘以內就會抵達很有趣的中峇魯市場，而且搭公車、計程車都很方便。
房間如照片一樣的整潔、明亮，以及擁有基本的設備。位在沒有電梯的3樓，就算帶著行李也不會太累！我很希望下次去新加坡時還有機會再次入住。謝謝Jj和Nympha。
This place is really perfect in terms of location, price, cleanliness and hospitality. Feels like a cozy and homey hotel room every time I stay here. We have the maximum privacy too.
Very good location. Close to the public transport. Walking distance to the local market, trendy cafes and restaurants.
空间虽然小了一点，但是无论楼梯或者房间还是洗手间都很干净。房间在三楼，需要步行上楼。在王子酒店附近，距离地铁有点远，我们都是坐公交车的，坐公交车很方便。有需要就找助理。

la chambre est confortable pour quelques nuits sur Singapour. le metro est vraiment tres proche (2 lignes et selon moi les plus essentielles), le chinatown situé a 2 pas. Jj nous a facilite l'entrée dans les lieux grâce a ses excellentes indications. je recommande pour un court sejour

A very small and simple space but well suited to 1 or 2 travelers looking to get out and see Singapore. Provides everything: clean bed, strong air conditioning, excellent shower, fast and reliable wifi, kettle for boiling drinking water and a mini fridge. Very hip, gentrifying neighbourhood with lots of options (Tiong Bahru Bakery is incredible, Canjob Taproom for craft beer, etc). Metro very near by. Host communication was excellent and step by step instructions on how to get to the apartment (with photos) were provided. Nympha, the assistant, was there to greet us and always around to help. Great value for such an expensive city. Couldn't be happier with our stay.
Strategic location, very nearby to the bus station (less than 5 mins walk). Room and toilet has good cleanliness. Also, a lot of food places & a convenience store right outside the place.

it has been a perfect location for a short trip in Singapore. Facing the apartment you will find a 24 hours shop, a contact person is living next door, all arrival information are very detailed and even with picture, so you won't get lost! All you need in your own apartment, including fridge, kettle, tea, coffee, towels, TV, city information and even house shoes :) If you are looking for an own flat in town at good location, you definitely should choose THIS !!!Thank you for that great time :)

The bedroom is just as described in the listing. It does the job. The house keeper Nympha is super responsive which made things easier. You can find nicer Airbnb’s or hotels in the area, but I thought this place was a great price for a private bedroom, cozy bed, cold A/C, and a private bathroom and shower. I would stay here again. Thank you!

My last travel to Singapore was for medical treatment at SGH. It’s next to Jj’s apartment.
The location only 15 minutes easy walk with luggage from Station. It’s easy to locate. Near to bus station and well know by taxy driver.
The place is clean, towell is good, hot water is excellent, the bed is awsome. Wifi is very good. Food & drink, it’s easy to find a small snack or cold drink. Many restaurant around but mostly with pork menu. But you can find food center not far from the apartment during the day.
One think that need to consider is 3rd floor, high stair without the lift. So be carefull with big luggage. Get your luggage one at a time.
Overall it’s a great place. Will be back. Many thanks to Nympa for all her help during our stay.
The bedroom is really nice, very clean!! Is 5 minutes walking from the Mrt,so you can move around the city without problem. Everything was excellent (:

This place is serviceable for solo travelers. The shower is nice and there is plenty of storage space. The apartment is close to Chinatown and the MRT. Nympha lives on the same floor and is very attentive.

The place is very clean.  Local eating place is just a few steps away.  Host is very prompt and helpful in answering my queries.   Caretaker is very helpfiul too and attends quickly to our needs.  She even lends some things we failed to bring.

Although I didn't stay here myself,  my friend fully recommends this Airbnb - the housekeeper Nympha was adorably sweet and kind and the bathroom is very modern and trendy. Jj's communication has impressed me throughout. All the best for your future endeavours Jj. Laura =)
Nympha is attentive and she keeps all the rooms clean, also JJ gave us all the indications to get to his place it was very helpful

房东人超级好，会提前告诉我们如何过去，每个关键的路口都有拍照片。
我们坐的是红眼航班过去，没有到check in的时间，也同意我们先存行李。
助手nympha也非常棒，那么早存行李打扰她了，会仔细跟我们讲房间的细节和设施。
房间干净整洁!尤其卫生间真的跟干净!离地铁站欧南园很近，去圣淘沙，机场都比较方便。能够走路去克拉克码头。离牛车水也只有一站地铁。去市中心也很方便。
不过我们的面包放在桌上，早上有点小蚂蚁在里面，可能新加坡的生态环境比较好吧，鸟也不怕人，城市动植物都比较多，所以也觉得有点蚂蚁也无所谓啦。
整体体验很不错。推荐!
a very convenient place to stay just a short walk to the mrt. theres a cheers shop right infront so late night ramen runs are easy. overall a much recommended place to be
Nice clean place, it is small but perfect for a couple or solo traveller. not far from the mrt and several restaurant nearby.
The apartment is clean and convenient. Jj is quick to respond to your needs. For  travelers who has  heavy luggages are not convenient to stay at the top floor.

JJ's place is really worth the price and the actual place is way better than in photos. A bit tiny but comfortable enough for 2 persons. They also have Smart TV, which is beyond my expectation. The air conditioner also works really good and  the place is located in a great location which is only walking distance to some interesting cafes nearby Tiong Bahru, including the most popular one, Tiong Bahru Bakery. As a host, JJ and Nympha, the assistant were very responsive and helpful, and most importantly, gave us maximum privacy during our stay. If you want to find minimalist, clean, and strategic place to stay with affordable price in Singapore, this surely is a perfect option!

We loved staying at Jj's. Nympha was very hospitable and helpful throughout the stay. Spotlessly clean, the place had everything we needed and more. Nice location, walking distance to China town, near MRT.
Place is good to stay 👍🏼

We had a great stay at Jj’s place. It is a 5 minute walk to the Tiong Bahru Market and other local restaurants, shops etc. It had everything we needed including air condition and awesome WiFi. Thanks for an awesome stay!
Jj’s place was an incredible value in an amazing location. It was a quick walk to Tiong Bahru hawker center, Chinatown, and the Outram Park metro station.
这个房间很不错，房内摆设布置和图片一模一样，房间干净卫生，每天都有人打扫房间。离市区很近，出门地铁公交都很方便。房间自带卫生间，洗澡这些很方便。我和妹妹都很满意。
本次入住很好，名宿位置不算偏远，走哪里都还是很方便的，离地铁站大概10分钟，整体很不错。
素晴らしいです！
The room on the third floor has an opening is common with the helper’s room. The room lacks privacy.

Amazing place for the value! It was very clean, and the A/C cools the room quickly! Super high ceilings, and great bathroom with plenty of hot water and good water pressure. 非常好的房间，非常好的位置，

In general, a good place if all you need is a place to sleep for the night. There were things that made it a little uncomfortable though - hard bed, across the street was a hotel sign that kept its light on all night, the blanket was too small for two of us, the a/c was fairly weak and took a long time to cool the room, and the room and bathroom is smaller than what I thought it looked like in the pictures. The shower has plenty of space  and is nice, though there is absolutely no space on the sink to put anything. Nympha, the house keeper, is great and would clean the room upon request and showed us how to use the washer/dryer combo. Tiong Bahru food centre is really close to walk to for food, though the MRT is a little further away. We were able to check in around 2 am without any issues, which was really convenient. Definitely don't stay here if you don't want to drag heavy luggage up 2 flights of stairs though.
Muy bueno. El departamento es pequeño, pero lo suficientemente cómodo como para una estancia corta. El anfitrión muy atento. Responde rápido! Sin dudas volvería alojarme allí!

I had a pleasant stay at Jj's and would highlights the pros & "not-so-great" as follows:
Pros:

2. Worth the money
3. Good amenities (Such as Fridge, Water Kettle)

Not so great:

If you want to visit China Town and Little India or Garden by the bay and Singapore Botanical Garden, this place is in good location.
Fine place in center neighboorhood. Room is clean. Small but perfect to spend just the night. Host was very helpful with the check-out. We were allowed to leave our luggage the rest of our day.

Nice room with private bathroom.
Small but big enough for sleeping since we were out all day.

The location in Tiong Bahru is great. Nice breakfast and dinner opportunities around.

10 Minutes walks from Outram Park Station.

Love the room a lot.

Affordable place to stay in Singapore. Really appreciated Jj’s assistant’s help with my late check-in. Tea and the helpful Singapore guides were a wonderful addition to the space! We enjoyed our stay in JJ's apartment in Singapore. The apartment is only 10 mins walk from the subway and is located not far from the main attractions. The apartment perfectly fits our needs!

La chambre est vraiment rustique et ancienne , une forte odeur dans l’escalier et l’appartement. Do not expect luxury or large space, but it is great value for money. 性價比高，小助手住隔壁，要溝通或請求協助都很方便。地點離中峇魯市場很近，覓食方便，走路10分鐘到地鐵歐南園站。房間不會太狹窄，須自帶牙刷牙膏，其餘房主會提供。附帶一提，提供的沐浴乳居然是Le labo～很佛。

Everything was perfect! Nimpha is adorable and Jj is always on touch for everything we need. The room is so much bigger than what we have expected!! Thanks JJ for everything!!
We had a great stay! Nice and clean apartment in a pleasant neighborhood, close to many restaurants and also easy to access the city.

Chambre propre et bien située, proche du métro. Le quartier est également sympa, on y trouve des supérettes, restos et boulangeries pas loin. Communication très facile avec JJ et Nympha.

The place is really great. The bed is very comfortable to sleep in. They have hot and cold showers. Aircon is also working well. If given the chance I will definitely book this room again.
Nice, clean room with own small bathroom. Comfortable bed, good location. Perfect communication and check-in / check-out process.

This is a comfy cozy place to stay in a convenient part of town. Everything was as advertised. All communication and checkin/checkout went very smoothly. Definitely recommended if you need an affordable place to crash for a few days.
Comfortable, affordable and convenient place to stay.

Super clean and the best is we can wash our clothes for free in his apartment, so if any of you stay for many days you will be glad for having washing machine there although it located on another floor. Highly recommended this super clean room guys! :)
Great location, one of the best neighborhoods in Singapore for food, and super-accessible by public transport.  The caretaker of the place (Nympha) is super helpful. Highly recommend this host.

Nice place !
This apartment’s location is really good, and Diane’s check in instructions couldn’t be more clear. Very good value in Singapore.

Marisca was such an amazing host—one of the nicest people I’ve ever met! My roommates and I would not have had such an amazing summer without her! Highly Recommend!

The facilities with outdoor pool were as described in the pictures, although the bedrooms did not both have two beds. Our flatmates were often awake until 1/2am and were noisy.  We were told that we would have to move out of the flat in a month if we were not willing to pay more rent and if we did pay, we could do so under the table without AirBnb. In addition, the family brought durians into the flat several times and stored them in the fridge, so our food take on this smelly odour, making them inedible. Enjoyed my stay at Benny’s place! Give him 5 stars and highly recommended place to stay in Singapore.

We will choose this house next time we visit Sin.

If you’re looking to stay at a place that is close to the airport and public transport, then look no further. Benny’s place is AMAZING! We had everything that we needed and more. For the price, Benny's place is a great bargain. Guests should note that the place is close to the airport, but a bit far out from the city center and main attractions. During our stay, we used Grab (local taxi app similar to Uber) to navigate around since it was pretty affordable and efficient.

Apartment is on the 3rd floor with excellent lift service.  Good space and amenities for 2 people and generally very clean. There is a good size balcony and some outdoor furniture would've been nice so that we could sit ouside sometimes. The bed  and pillows are very hard but Benny sent us round some softer pillows after contacting him, the bed we just got used to.  Benny supplies lots of little extras like shampoo, conditioner, soap, laundry powder and some basic cooking needs which was much appreciated.  Only 1 set of towels provided and have suggested to Benny that a second set would be good for stays of over a week, for use while the others are being washed.    We were told he would meet us at the airport but unfortunately we had to wait an hour and a quarter before making contact which wasn't too good after a full day travelling. (Would be better to take a taxi or the mrt (2 stops) and meet up at the apartment block).  However, when we got to the apartment, he walked with us to the mrt station, supermarket and local food court showing us where they all were.  There are 5 pools in the complex all very clean and surrounded by beautiful well kept gardens.  There are  also plenty of BBQ areas for use.  A small grocery store is also on the premises and very handy if just wanting a few things.  We enjoyed our stay and would recommend the apartment if you want to be out of the city and experience life in the suburbs.

A great stay in a beautiful condo with amazing grounds.  Great food court near by and nice to be among locals. Highly recommended.

I can fully recommend Benny as a host. The apartment is super and perfectly sufficient for a trip in Singapore. We couldn't use the numerous pools in the complex, there was no time for that. For those who don't care about a day more or less, I can only warmly recommend to plan a day for the pools.
The host kindly picked us up at the airport and even borrowed us money for the EZ-Link cards, as they only accepted cash. Then we took a taxi to our accommodation (costs approx. 20 SGD). The apartment is fully equipped, including three air conditioners. Benny quickly explained everything relevant to us and that was it. He always answered questions quickly. Unlimited internet is available. Unfortunately a supermarket is missing in the direct environment, which is somewhat further away. There is a mini market in the 7/11-style on the area. The MRT station is right around the corner, so the distance to the city centre is no problem.
You really can't complain here. Only a few minimal remarks, maybe it is relevant for someone (or a tip for Benny):
- Unfortunately there are hardly any TV channels available. Most of them are encoded.
- There are almost no dishes. There were only a few plates, even less cutlery and apart from a single wine glass no glasses at all. Especially the missing glasses were a bit annoying, you need them, even if you don't want to cook.
All in all I would book this accommodation again immediately and can only recommend it to everyone.

We stayed here for 3 nights and found the location to be excellent. There is a bus stop right outside the condo and it's only a short walk to the MRT station. While this is not an inner-city location, it's perfect for people who are happy to use public transport and want to discover the feel of suburban living in Singapore. There are several Hawker centers in walking distance and it was here that we enjoyed some of the best meals during our stay.
The apartment was modern, clean and comfortable and Benny was very quick to respond to messages from us. His wife met us as we exited the train from the airport and after she checked us into the condo, she walked with us to show us the closest shops and food center. We were made to feel very welcome by them both.

Our only criticism would be the bedding and linen. We found the bed too hard to sleep comfortably and the pillows were very thin. Also, the bath towels were small and thin and there were no pool towels available. This was disappointing because the swimming pool in the complex is amazing and we would have loved to have enjoyed using it. Overall, we were very happy staying at Benny's place.
Very responsive and the place is very clean and big. Benny and wife were kind enough to allow us to leave our stuffs in their place after checkout since our flight was still in the evening.

Benny & Shirley apartment was very cosy, clean and spacious.  His wife Shirley  was very kind and helpful to all my questions and needs. She even show  me  the ways to the nearest shops  although it was raining on the first day. On the whole, I can recommend their places to anyone who is interested.

Great location close to the airport either by cab or MRT,lovely pool and BBQ area,local food open all day everyday and markets are fantastic across the road amongst the Government Housing block.Very quiet given the size of the complex.It makes you experience local life if you choose and you should.

Very clean and confortable flat. Near the airport and a mrt station. Shirley picked us a the station, only 2 stops from the airport and show us where the food court was. We had nice diners here. The swimming pool is great. We will come again and définitly recommand this place.

A small supermarket is located within the area and a swimming pool literally just below the balcony. It is a 20 minute underground ride downtown and just a 10 minute ride towards Changi airport. A nice and decent priced hawker center with many food opportunities is close by and if you would like to experience the real Singaporean life we strongly recommend to go there for having a lunch or dinner.

Benny's Airbnb was amazing! It was my first time in Singapore and I couldn't had a better host than him. My flight arrived at 7 AM and since Benny's check in is at 2 PM I was worry I will have to wait for 5 hours before I can settle in. However, Benny made sure to not only picked me up from the train station but to give me early check in at 11 Am since his guest left earlier. He also provided me with recommendations to visit and had laundry detergent so I can use his washer (this was crucial to me since being a solo traveling can be hectic with laundry). Also, the location for me was perfect because it is close to train station (2 stops away from the airport). You can purchase a 3-day unlimited train rides for $25 and go anywhere around the city. Its much cheaper than getting a Grab (Asia's version of the Uber app)  For first timers, I recommend to check out the light show at marina bay (8/9Pm) and at the garden's by the bay (7:45 Pm). I also recommend to check the night life at Little Arabia Street. Eating by the marina bay is more expensive and more commercial while eating at Chinatown, Little India and Little Arabia is much cheaper.

Benny’s place is spacious and clean. It is a 25-30 min metro ride into the city and a small 10 min walk to the metro. There are many lovely pools in the complex! Definitely visit the sky pool on the roof of building B. Thank you for having us, Benny!

Benny's place has excellent facilities in a very attractive complex, with a large swimming pool. The apartment has great air-conditioning too, a must in Singapore.  We highly recommend Benny's apartment.

Outstanding experience in this apartment. The condo is very calm and clean. Many pools and an awesome rooftop pool as well. Benny is a great host! Dont miss, you need to ride between 20 and  25 minutes to the city by train.

What can I say. We were absolutely over the moon with the quality of Benny's condo. We traveled from the airport on the MRT and we were met by Benny at Tanah Merah Station. We didn't have roaming on our phone so simply sent him a message from the free wifi at Changi Airport to let him know which train we were boarding. After a couple of minutes Benny arrived, he quickly organised a Taxi and we headed to the condo.
We were very impressed with the cleanliness and the quality of the apartment and the complex. Nice sized air conditioned apartment with plenty of cooking facilities if you were wanting to be self sufficient and a large fridge and freezer. There was also TV and fast included wifi. Plenty of TV channels in English to pick from including Australian ABC News.
Just over 5 minutes walks to Tanah Merah Station meant it was easy for us to travel around Singapore using our Singapore Tourist Pass. Plenty of pools ( I think around 8 in total) to pick from around the complex as well as a Gym, a number of bbq's and garden areas were also available.
When we were due fly back to the Gold Coast we had a 9pm flight. Benny was kind enough to allow us to check out late in the afternoon (the room hadn't been booked for that night). I would highly recommend getting in touch with Benny if you a planning future stay in Singapore.
Great host,  was exactly as discribed.

A landed property. Not a typical house in Singapore. Clean and modern. The host offered rides to NTU and the airport out of kindness. Super super host.
小区是别墅区，环境优美，房间宽敞干净。李先生和李太太都很热情，我们去新国立和南大参观，他们开车送我们去，李先生还给我们介绍了南大的历史。感觉特别好，再去新加坡还会住这里。

It’s always feels like you’re coming home when you stay at Mr. Lee’s place. It’s my third time here and they always deliver outstanding hospitality and great service.

worth more than the money you paid. A great place to stay :) :)

It's a very friendly home with welcoming hosts. The rooms were like a hotel and very clean! The hospitality was out of this world. Overall a fantastic experience

Thank you very much Mrs Lee
Well recommended for those who are looking for a place to stay

房间很干净，房东人很好，特别细心的奶奶，开车带我们去NTU溜达，还带我们去逛当地的超市，最后还送我们去地铁站。
This is our first time in Singapore，and first time use airbnb，it’s a nice experience,thank you very much.
房东很热心，会开车送我们去吃饭、上学，帮我们定期不定期更换生活用品。女仆会帮忙洗衣服，做饭，定期整理房间。房间非常干净整洁，设施齐全。这是我们最好的一次住房体验。
期待以后还有机会来住。
Clean and comfortable place with very kind, helpful hosts. It was a pleasure to stay here!

All in all，I feel comfortable and safe living there. Hosts of this house are warm hearted and always ready to give u a hand when necessary. The room there is much better than the host shown in the pics and u will never have any trouble communicating with them in English or Chinese.
房东很热情，并且房子比图片上的看起来要好很多。两位房主都可以流利的用英文或者中文沟通，不存在交流上的问题。
爷爷奶奶非常好，每天会送我们去学校！！还可以和爷爷奶奶一起吃饭！饭也好吃！！超级棒，房间也很干净

非常非常非常好的房东先生（我们都叫他爷爷😁）！！！

Great stay and friendly host:)
Great place to stay, very nice and clean. Host is warm-hearted and helpful.
Red Doorz at Geylang is one of the best places I stayed in Singapore, location is easily accesible lots of hawkers nearby, friendly front staff and very clean, tidy place.... Will stay again
Cheap place to crash

I recommend RedDoorz for backpackers! 😊
Clean and comfortable.
Worth the price.
Nice place to stay. It is a well priced hostel.

Die Lage des Unterkunft hat uns ganz gut gefallen. Die Ausstattung war auch in Ordnung. Jedoch war es in großen und ganzen eine nette Unterkunft.
Clean and quiet, polite staff, very near to National Stadium, recommended!
Good location and super close to MRT！Great if you just need somewhere to sleep and shower. Not the cleanest but could be worse.
Its a grt place, self check in....its like staying at home...away from home....
房屋的地段非常好，离MRT很近（2min），离中国超市（昇松超市）也非常近，周围美食很多，离新加坡体育馆也很近，整体来说地段很好。从性价比来看，这一房源已经很不错了。
A decent stay as per budget.
직원분들 착하시고 시설도 깔끔해요. 다만 싱가폴이 더운나라라서 땀이 나는데 캡슐호텔이라 다른 사람의 땀냄새가 에어컨을 타고 은은하게 풍겨와요. 집에서 가져온 컵라면이 하나 남아서 출국전날에 동생이랑 먹고있었는데 남자 직원분이 오셔서 진라면 큰 컵을 주시고 배고프면 다른 봉지라면도 추가로 주시겠다고 하셔서 감동이었어요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 친절해서 좋습니다
Cozy and comfortable and easy to find food.

I stayed for a few nights in a female dorm. My experience was great, particularly due to the amazing staff hospitality! The location is superb in terms of access to public transit, tourist attractions, places to eat, etc. Communication with the host was always very good and efficient!
I was quite happy to have restful nights: the capsules are well equiped, the beds are very comfortable, the room was quiet and everything is designed to make your stay as convenient as possible.
Overall, the place is clean (there's room for improvement when it comes to the washrooms though) and very stylish. It's the perfect place for the minimalist traveller, not so much for those with large and/or heavy luggage, as there is no elevator in the property.

The pros:
*Great location.
*Staff are hospitable and shared areas seem to be well maintained.
The cons:
*Unresponsive before check-in.
*People don't follow the rules and bring good into the rooms. I saw several ants in my cubicle.
*Room was dusty. I have allergies and could stop sniffling or scratching my legs because of the mites/dust particles.
*Sheet had blood stain.
*Room floors smell like rat(?).
*No indoor slippers provided.
*People can see residents from outside. Which matters if you're on the top bunk facing the window. They can prolly look under your clothes if you went down the stairs.
*Not as soundproof as I expected from past reviews. I can hear everything my neighbors are doing. Even shuffling around the sheets.

What a cute little hostel! Cube was clean and crisp and bug free, and check in was smooth and easy. There are many many bathrooms to choose from, and the water pressure of the showers was 🔥🔥🔥. Right in chinatown means walking distance to all the good stuff.

Great stay for a couple of days, as it’s located right in Chinatown. Walking distance everywhere and public transportation right behind the corner if needed.
I was looking for a “better kind of” hostel or alternatively traditional Airbnb room for myself in Singapore, as I was traveling alone simply in a need of good recommendations and advices. For leisure purpose, I would definitely recommend CUBE.
The owner whose name I cannot remember unfortunately went beyond limits to make the guests feel like home. Big thanks to her for that!
Also the staff in general made an impression. Especially Terry from the Philippines and the guy who was in charge of the bar/reception for a while by himself (on Saturday evening) still remaining super cool under the pressure.

This is a good value spot if you're comfortable interacting and sharing spaces with other guests. It really is an upscale / premium-hostel that is good for the money. The service is great and staff are very friendly + a cool place to hang out inside with free breakfast, wifi, and morning coffee. The only issue I had with this place is that they brand themselves as a hotel, when in reality it is a premium-hostel. Some other guests were noisy in the shared rooms after 9pm when I wanted to rest and it had me missing some of the more private aspects of a quiet hotel in that regards.
Exceptionally comfortable and friendly stay, thank you!!!
centrally located good place at fair rental charges.
The place is great, location couldn’t be better, and the staff very kind and professional. I highly recommend this place. I had a great stay!
as described. clean, staff were very nice. highly recommended
Absolutely great place that is close to so many great things on Singapore! Bonus is that the beds are super comfortable!
Clean and comfortable and they staff are lovely.

Great location! Clean and stylish. Definitely worth a visit.

床铺干净整洁，位置优越，早餐可以自己煎蛋，特别喜欢！
A good place for short stay, especially for single person.
All great

good

Capsules are closed witha curtain and not a glass door.
It's like a luxuary hostel dorm where you get less disturbed because you don't hear as much (still hear when people talk etc.) And you dont get woken up from any lights.
A capsule hotel with great amenities and location. Worth a second visit when traveling alone with fewer baggages

Stayed one night at the Cube and it was a lot of fun.
If you are claustrophobic, I'd recommend booking the queen size room over the twin room.
The bathrooms are shared so expect it to be similar to a hostel but nicer.
The bed was really comfortable and storage for you luggage was spacious. I had 2 large luggages and was able to store it in the cubby under your cube.

My wife and I stayed at Cube Hotel for two nights during our visit to Singapore and everything was perfect. We really do not have anything negative to talk about, on the contrary, only a positive evaluation. These are the details that I think this is a great accommodation: 1. Location: it's perfect. In the heart of Chinatown, just 3 minutes walk from the MRT station. Even though it is in the center of Chinatown, the hotel is quiet, you will not hear any street noise. 2. Cleaning: excellent. We booked a capsule that shared the bathroom with other guests and nevertheless they were clean all the time. 3.Privacy: although we share many spaces, we felt safe and did not worry about our personal items because they provided lockers. 4. Breakfast: Delicious and plentiful, considering that we are talking about a low-priced hotel. 5. Staff: Friendly and willing to help. They allow us to leave our luggage hours before check-in and leave them in the reception hours after check-out. In conclusion: we had a great time. Without a doubt we would stay there again!
有好吃的早餐🥣，卫生间也很干净，睡觉的地方大家都能安静友好💁🏼‍♀️所以总体觉得nice噢

Very cool place to stay. They have everything you could possibly need to stay comfortably. Cubicles were very cozy. Had the queen sized cube with my husband and still had plenty of room in there. Only issue was it got super hot when shades were closed all the way but other than that, we had an amazing stay!

Very conveniently located in Chinatown and only a short distance from the MRT, with plenty of restaurants right on the doorstep.
The 'dorm' is very well air-conditioned but we found our queen cube at floor level to be muggy and so slept poorly. To get to the bathrooms we had to walk through the common area, or up a flight of stairs which when getting up in the middle of the night, or going to shower, wasn't the greatest.
The buffet breakfast was only ok, but for 'backpacker' accomodation it does the job.
A good place to stay
Really good price for location. Nice minimalist cube space.
For such a central location and for such a good price, I don't even consider living in a pod a sacrifice. I had a great time!
급하게 예약했고 캡슐호텔 첨인데 덕분에 아주 좋은 첫인상 남김. 남녀 섞여 자지만 침대 다르고 커튼 칠수 있고 두명이 쓰는 침대는 공간도 꽤 괜찮음!!! 추천이에용 바로 차이나타운이라 역도 가까움

First time in a room with many people! Interesting system! I would do it again! And this Place had the Perfect Location.
The Cube Boutique Hotel is an amazing experience for the ones looking for adventure and comfort. The capsules are small, but all the details are amazing. Highlight recommend for one or two nights.
It was the first hostel of my Singapore trip. All the staff at the hostel are very friendly. Thanks  for giving me a good memory..If I come back to Singapore again, I want to visit again.

Pros: The place is very clean. The host is efficient and good-natured. The other guests are quiet and polite. The pods are new and modern. It's a good place to meet travellers from around the world. There's a free breakfast. It's not expensive. If you're under 30 and travelling on your own or with a friend on a shoestring, it's a good place.
Cons: It has all the drawbacks of a hostel: people coming and going all night. Someone jiggling the locked (with just a latch) shower door till it unlocks and stepping in. The sound of snoring close by all night long. But also the pods present their own problems: The ventilation system is so sodden with perfume that when you close the screen that is your pod door you are trapped in a space ship with the overpowering smell of a New Orleans bordello. You can't open the window because there is no window. And you can't open the screen because it is so hot that you have to sleep in the buff or in your underwear. Unless you have really nice instagrammable underwear, you may have to just pull the pillow over your face (doesn't work). We didn't sleep a wink and lit out at 5:30 even tho we had nowhere to go just to be able to breathe. We never stay at fancy places, but this experience was not for us. Of course, your mileage may vary.

Great place to stay, 5⭐️. Will love to come back. And will recommend it to everyone. Staff so friendly especially Kassey for extra effort to put balloons on our capsules. Super kind and attentive to all our needs.
Great places to stay. Highly recommend. Special thanks to Kassey for putting balloons on our capsule. Will love to comeback again

Les hôtes sont très accueillants. Les cubes sont plutôt sympas et design mais confortables uniquement pour 1 personne, je vous déconseille d'y dormir à 2.
L'auberge était bien équipé et le petit déjeuner est plutôt bien. Elle est très bien situé, dans le quartier chinois, à proximité de pleins de petits magasins.
Bonne auberge pour rester quelques jours.

This is centrally located in Chinatown and easy walking (if you can bear the humidity) to many places such as Clarke Quay, Chinatown Street Food, Maxwell Hawker Center, etc...
There is a small lounge area to work, relax, or plan your day from.
Check-in and check out was easy.

Its a good place to stay. Easy access to almost all attractions in the city. The only problem that i noticed about the air-cooling  system. It is centralized, inside the capsule i havent feel like i am using aircon.

If u don't have a deep sleep, than is it super noisy. Bathroom dirty... The floor towel was super dirty, guess in those 24houers never get cleaned. Check in lady, was a bit pissed, coud not see any gap Ness or a smile in her face.
The bed was super confy.
Beautiful place located in the heart of Singapore downtown. Sparkling clean and easy access for checking in. Great place, would recommend.

The location is golden. The pod itself was ok but it could be better if there were better air ventilation and noise proof. Probably the most competitive price of hostels around that area you could get. There is always overnight staff so the desk is 24/7 which was amazing.
Good place to stay at on a short trip to Singapore. Close to the MRT and Chinatown and also safe to walk to the waterfront.
Great location, wish it has ac inside each room and cleaner.
Kapsel top, Badezimmer nicht so sauber, Frühstück okay, Lage top und Kommunikation über airbnb sehr langsam, aber nett!

Bathrooms were well kept.  I actually ended up extending my booking because I liked it so much.   Internet was also strong, as I needed it for my remote work!
My first hostel experience and it was incredible.  Was surprised with how comfortable and clean the place was.  Highly recommend to others, especially at the price point
The CS response is slow. The room space is very small, and the images in the listing page is a bit confusing and tricky to it’s hostel-like setup, and over beautified.

Location is fantastic. Right in the thick of Chinatown with shops, food, and vendors all around.

I trust Kim’s selection of premium hotel suites.
Kim was extremely responsive (at even ungodly hours) and worked with us to customize the place to match our needs for hosting our guests. Thank you, Kim!
Great place for our party to stay. Close to public transit, lots of restaurants, and culture. Would stay again. The lounge was an excellent amenity to have access to.
Great host, great location

A very good place to stay in Singapore. It has a Good location, very near to the MRT . The room was very clean before u check in. Great stay at heritage in my second time and would highly recommend it.

I had a really great time staying in the apartment. It is clean, stylish and homey. Highly recommended.

Hosts were flexible with check-out time and kept my luggage safe until closer to my flight so that I could roam the city freely.
Overall a great experience!
Great place to stay. Walking distance to the financial district and smack dab in the middle of the hustle and bustle of club st., and several nearby hawkers. Couldn’t have picked a better location.
Very clean, and convenient having access to many great destinations in the city. The host was really responsive and supportive. Thank you.

Great apartment, wonderfully located in Chinatown. Walking distance from the CBD and several metro stations. There is a small gym for the guests and also washing and drying machines at disposal. You can also cook in the apartment, but honestly, with all the hawker centers nearby you really don't need to. You can eat out very cheap around the city. I definitely recommend it to everybody and will stay here next time on Singapore!
Clean and comfortable basically in the centre of the city, I couldn’t have asked for more :)
Great location and ease of check-in.

*Highly recommended!!*
Great location, easy and flexible check-in process at amazingly affordable price. Take note that the check-in time is only until 8pm. I appreciate the help given by the experience managers, Angela and Mary. Angela was very helpful - she helped me with my heavy luggage up to the second floor - and I didn't get to meet Mary, though she kindly let me check out at 12pm. Great service and team - I greatly enjoyed my stay!
If you’re on a budget, then this is definitely one of the best places to stay at when traveling to Singapore. 👌

The host had great communication and the place is in a great location for restaurants and downtown. The photos match the place and the contactless check in was very easy. Jarwin and Alosia were very helpful and responded quickly to any questions! I would definitely stay here again.

Stayed in the property at chinatown. Room was clean and nice. Overall nice stay with them.
Really like the idea of putting everything that is required in one mini room. Great for a single person stay.

I had the best stay at the Herritage airbnb in Chinatown Singapore! I'm from Denmark and it was the first time I travelled so far away from my home, but I was being taking so good care off by the hosts. Irean and Rizza wrote to me from my arrival in Singapore - actually also before and I felt comfortable the whole time. Finding the address, checking in and getting settled went comfortable and easy. I could always write to them and there were no problems, they always helped easily and smiling.
Location:
Really nice location in Chinatown, food places everywhere and it's a nice place to sightsee. Easy location to other parts of the city, a taxi place across the street, and close to the metro. Easy to find breakfast and dinner just beside the airbnb.
The accommodation:
Clean and with aircondition. Small but perfect for me, nice bathroom, aircondition, possibility to wash my cloths ect. Not a lot of noise, it was comfortable (normally I am easily distressed by noises, but not in this airbnb).
Overall I felt safe and comfortable during the whole stay, and this would only be possible with a nice place to stay :) A special thanks to Irean (and maybe I also wrote with Rizza?) for giving positive vibes and always being helpfull! And we laughed a lot! So I will recommend this to others.

Easy check-in procedure, with good communication throughout, room was clean and comfortable and as shown in the photo, great location and close to Pagoda St MRT, Irean and Rizza were so helpful and a pleasure to deal with.  Allowed me to store my luggage for a few hours after checking out too.

This is my first time staying in Heritage Collection Chinatown, and I must say it’s probably gonna be my go-to. I had an event at Orchard, but decided to stay here because it’s walking distance from Maxwell Food Court, and is on a main road that makes it easy to get anywhere. Everything about this place was perfect. I was greeted and assisted by Irean when i was trying to figure out check-in. When I needed anything, i could easily message them online. Their rooms are a perfect size for a solo traveler who’s also looking for a cozy space to do some work. Their showers are GREAT. Water pressure and temperature was perfect. They have 1 adaptor provided, which i greatly needed cause i forgot to buy one for this trip. I always love a place with a good TV, and this one even had an Apple TV connected to it in case i wanted to use Airplay, or watch YouTube. The place is also fully stocked with a kitchen, dining set for 1, a microwave, and water kettle. For the price, it almost seemed impossible I was getting such an amazing experience. Thank you so much to Heritage Collection. I’ll definitely be back!

The location is excellent, the place is very clean, and the staff are wonderful. I was always supported in everything I needed, thank you Irean, Rizza, and Jarwin. The room was well appointed with all amenities, and my favourite part was the free laundry! I made lots of use of that.
One note for other visitors is that it’s difficult to sleep during the day because the walls are thin. So if you’re working on a different time zone, be prepared to find your own ways to get sleep, especially if you get unlucky with a noisy neighbour.
Such lovely people and hosts! Location was great and good price considering it all
Very helpful and prompt replies to my requests. Smooth check in process and the room was great . Very near the mrt and convenient too

As always, it was a great stay. The place was clean and modern: the bed was comfortable, the bathroom facilities modern and clean, and the ref and kitchenette were much appreciated. WiFi was fast: usable for video meetings and Netflix streaming. And this location is great: a few minutes away from the MRT station, and within a few minutes walking distance of many Chinatown sights. The hosts are proactive and helpful, and answer queries within a few minutes.

I thought it a bit OTT to have to download an app just to get access and I did think strong possibility that there would be problems getting in at 22:00 but turned out fine. Overall I was very happy with the accommodation and their staff tried very hard and were very responsive. My main complaint was the Apple remote for the TV, which was a triumph of style over function. Very difficult to use, quite impractical and definitely requires details use instructions. I would suggest they provide written instructions on its use. I would certainly stay there again.

5/5 would stay again!
Heritage has a nice location, clean rooms, clear and upfront instructions, and their staff is very responsive. They are also almost entirely remote. It turned out this worked very well b/c I could contact them 24/7 and felt they were with me right when I needed them. They are friendly, answer questions I have before I even asked them (like the process to leave baggage with them after checkout for example), have a reasonable price, and really there is nothing more I could have asked for.

Great experience with Heritage Collection in Chinatown. The room was clean and cozy. Your reception and management was impeccable. The location is unbeatable.

Heritage was extremely clean and well-situated in Singapore Chinatown. They were super responsive for various requests I had, would definitely stay again.

Heritage collection in Chinatown was amazing, the location was perfect and walkable. The hotel was affordable. The laundry worked great, nice hot water with good water pressure, quiet room. I’d stay here again! Perfect for solo traveller.

The staff of Heritage is extremely friendly and even created a whats app chat for me to ask any questions. It’s a self check in place which makes it comfortable to get in at any time. The location is great also, right in the beautiful china town with a lot to do around.

Was in the area for a couple of days and Heritage Chinatown's studio was a great option! Highlights included:

- Clean, minimalistic, modern apartment with fridge, microwave, etc.
- Flexible check-in and digitized room keys

I got to the hotel around midnight and had some trouble checking in, but Maica, Mary, and Alex responded immediately through messages, made sure I could get in, checked in multiple times to see how they could help throughout my stay, and were always responsive. Their team did a wonderful job in making me feel comfortable. All in all, would HIGHLY recommend as a relatively affordable + amazing location + high quality/clean space.
Excellent location! It was really easy to get to many train stations and get around.
I enjoyed the stay

Awesome place, really enjoyed my stay. All the amenities were available and in good condition. The place was clean and you felt comfortable in the space. Overall I would definitely come back again.
Great stay
Over all - good stay near China Town.

Super convenient and in the heart of Chinatown. Also love that I was greeted by reception host who is very helpful. And even lugged luggage to my room. A gem in the heart of Singapore’s chinatown. Great location too.

Pros: This was a great Airbnb! Right in the mix of Chinatown, but quiet from my room. Heritage team of Maica, Mary, and Lily were extremely responsive. My favorite amenity was the laundry. Ooh they also allowed luggage storage after check out, which was so helpful! The room is small, but great for 1 person. The bed was very firm, which I like, but want to warn others about. There was also no conditioner supplied in the bathroom so recommend bringing your own.
Cons: you need to download a separate app in order to open your door. They also make you communicate over another app (w-h-a-t-s-a-p-p). I would prefer if they communicated over the Airbnb app instead of another app.
If I come back to Singapore I would definitely stay in this Airbnb again!

It is just what you need. The kind of efficient, small, all-you-need, kind of place. Just, as a tourist, I used to get a bit worried on my phone's battery while taking pictures around the city because if it died, then there's no way to get inside the room; your key is your phone.

Heritage location was great and easy to access sights and public transportation. 5 min walk to mtr, buses, Maxwell hawker, Buddha temple, and a Ya Kun. She also noticed the room ventilation was recently cleaned and left a smell so she proactively gave me a room freshener. All in all would stay again.
Great rental! The unit was as described, great location and highly recommend it

Had a great stay. Mary, Maica and Lily were always responsive and very helpful in helping me locate the accommodation and checking in to ensure I had everything I needed.

I did a solo trip to Singapore and this was a great place to stay for a weekend. The unit is small, but impressive in terms of how they optimize the space. The hosts, Carms, Mary, and Maica, were super friendly and communicative. Would recommend to anyone wanting a high quality and budget friendly place.

This room is definitely a no-frills, budget-friendly room, but for what it is it is great! the place is tidy and nice to stay, and close to the market and grocery store.
the only thing that the space of the room is small.

It was a great stay at Heritage. Location was perfect and the room was comfortable! Only downside was that in the middle of the night there was a mechanical sound buzzing for about half an hour, which was a little bothering. But other than that, I really enjoyed my stay!

Good place, good location. Exactly as describes. Feels a bit too small like you are always bumping into something, but that was expected as a small room for the accessible price.

Such a good location and communication with the hosts! They were great about helping you understand the check in process and providing anything you need! Highly recommend if you are visiting Singapore

We had an excellent stay at Heritage apartments at their 229 South Bridge Road location. We were right on the cusp of Chinatown and Boon Tat Street neighborhoods, with an abundance of attractions, restaurants, and night life right at our doorstep. Plus, the Chinatown train station was a quick 5 min walk. Although we used the train quite a bit (it helped to get out of the humidity), we were also able to walk to many major tourist destinations within 20-30 min, if we wanted. The Heritage Apartments team was quick to respond to our questions and requests. We had to use the after hours check in due to our late arrival, which worked well. Also, they accommodated our next day in person check in to the following day so we could do Universal Studios on Christmas Day per our plans. Mary went the extra mile by noticing the brand of museli bars we had brought with us for snacks and left us a box when our apartment was cleaned. This was a surprising and thoughtful extra touch. She also advised us on questions we had about where things were located, sometimes after hours. We had an evening flight and the team provided secure baggage holding services so we could check out, enjoy our day, and retrieve them when we were ready to go to the airport. The apartment was very clean, the once a week housekeeping services were nice, and it had all the amenities we needed (kitchen, wifi, laundry, AIR CONDITIONING, Apple TV, etc).
Some items to note for those trying to decide whether this Airbnb is right for you.
1. Our apartment was big enough for 1 person or a couple. The bathroom wasn't very private (could see into it through glass and could hear the other person's movements).
2. Our apartment had stairs that were on the steeper side with slender steps so if this is an issue check out their other apartment configurations.
3. We have a medium firm mattress at home and the mattress in the apartment was much firmer. We slept well on it but if you prefer a softer mattress than this is something to be aware of when choosing these apartments.
We would highly recommend Heritage Apartments. It was an excellent place to stay.

Excellent place to stay. Very close to public transit and lots of good places to eat. Everyone we interacted with at Heritage Apartments was friendly and professional, but it is super frustrating that their listings are not accurate representations of where you will actually stay. It seems like their policy is to let guests book any listing on Airbnb, regardless of if it is actually available, and then they ultimately place you in any "similar" unit that they have unoccupied in the neighborhood. So for anyone who pays attention when you book, don't expect to get an apartment with the same layout as listed. The units are clean and new, but not particularly thought out in the way that an airbnb with an independent host often is - they lack some thoughtful features such as switches near the bed or a dresser in the bedroom. The sloped ceiling upstairs means we whacked out heads often and there wasn't enough light to see inside our suitcases at night when we arrived (they were kind enough to provide a desk lamp the next day). There is no outlet in the bathroom or anywhere that you can use an appliance near a mirror. Laundry detergent was provided which was nice. The windows do a good job of keeping the busy street noise out, but there are only blackout curtains, no sheers, and since they face the street and are in front of the bathroom you pretty much have to keep them closed unless you plan to get dressed immediately after showering and before leaving the bathroom. Bed was very firm but comfortable. They were able to accommodate self check-in for our late arrival. Overall it was an acceptable stay, and hopefully they will address some of their apartment's kinks and continue to improve.

Also, there's a 23-hour Indian restaurant about a minute's walk up the street, so if you're hungry at 3 in the morning then you're all set. There's also a 7-11 about a 5 minute walk away.
Some things to note: the walls are quite thin, so sometimes you can hear the neighboring tenants if they're on the phone or playing loud music. At the beginning of the stay you're provided with a single roll of toilet paper, so if you need more you'll have to provide it yourself. And lastly, the room is on the second floor of the building, which isn't really a big deal, but if you're someone who has difficulty with stairs (there's no elevator), then that's something you should know.
