Mark has been very helpful and super kind. The place was excellent for a longer stay. We love the location, busses & MRT to get around easily. The very known East Coast Park is right next to it.

Great place, would stay here again!

Second visit here this year. Our studio was spotless as before.
the only suggestion I would make, for privacy is the replace the glass door with wooden one to give more privacy to the bathroom.

This is our second visit to Fortville, and would visit again. The self check in process means that you can save time in advance, and Mark is very responsive to any queries.
The room and facilities were ideal for our needs, and the on site amenities such as the gym and pool mean there is plenty to keep you occupied when not out and about visiting the sites.

We enjoyed our stay at Fortville. Bed was comfy. The shower was strong though it takes quite awhile to heat up (not a problem for me, just had to remember to let it run for a bit before entering).

Great amenities nearby, with East Coast Park and hawker centre within walking distance.

Well, you will not be disappointed when you have to book an accommodation with Mark. He listen to your need and he recommends what he think is suitable for your short stay.

Very nice and cozy place to stay !
Perfect place and neighborhood

beautiful property in a great location.

Very good flat just like the pictures. But with strong mold smell.

We stayed 10 nights here. The apartment was spotlessly clean and had all we needed for our self-contained stay. It was cool and comfortable to come back to every day after the heat. Shirley and Peter

I thoroughly enjoyed my time at Fortville Serviced Apartments. Mark & the whole wonderful team at Fortville are consumate professionals, highly approachable & extremely welcoming. A quick note for others regarding the self-checkin process, please remember to revisit the link sent to you via Airbnb message environment & (re-)use this link to 1) initially register, 2) complete self-checkin and also 3) access door lock code information. All in all - would I stay here again? ... most definitely!!! 😊
Amazing serviced apartments for a short term stay in SG.
My stay in Fortville has been perfect! Clean room, good amenities and cleaning services. Mark has been reactive and made it easy too, thanks!

We arrived late in the evening and the friendly man at the reception still followed us to our room to show us everything and give instructions.
After a long tiring flight, the accommodation was complicated to find, but if you get familiar with the bus lines, it's convenient to reach. Bus stop "Fort Grdns" is right infront of it. The area was nice, safe and clean.
The cozy room had almost everything you need for a comfortable stay. Kitchen utensils, washing machine, dryer, iron, hairdryer, detergent, dish soap, body wash, toothbrush and paste. The air conditioner - a blessing!

Personally we both found the pillows were too high and uncomfortably hard. It caused neck and back pain.
The pool/gym area was pretty and relaxing. We've noticed an slightly unpleasant smell though and the pool was not 100% clean.
All in all we recommend Mark and Fortville 👍🏻

Estuvo muy bien, el piso muy limpio y se ajustaba perfectamente a la descripcion.
Muy recomendable

Die Unterkunft ist etwas ausserhalb des Stadtzentrums, jedoch guet erschlossen mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Die Wohnung ist schön und gross.
Die Mitarbeiter sind sehr herzlich und hilfsbereit.
Um local agradável, com acesso a transportes públicos. Ainda que residencial, o centro de Singapura não fica longe.
This is our second time staying at this place.  Will not hesitate to stay again.

Je suis très contente d’avoir passé mes séjours dans l’appartement Fortville , c’est lux , c’est confortable, il n’a pas des bruits le jour comme la nuit, tous clients respectent les fonctionnement à l’intérieur, les employés sont disponibles avec tous les renseignements qu’on a besoin dans toutes les circonstances, par exemple les endroits à visiter, pour les transports et………
Je souhaiterais d’y retourner pour mon prochain vacances en décembre car je suis très bien dans l’appartement
Merci Mark

We were very happy with our stay at Fortville for 12 nights . Very clean, cozy and peaceful environment. Felt at home straight away. It’s very convenient!
Above all highly recommend !
Ik ben helemaal te vrede over deze plaats. Super schoon en vriendelijk medewerkers. 2 minuten voor MTR ( metro ) en mooie omgeving voor wandelaars. Bedankt voor jullie gastvrijheid 🙏🏾
everything perfect!

Pool and gym were awesome. The apartment was clean and the staff were very helpful. Would stay again.

Great location to stay at close to the bus stop, Katong park MRT, and the Old Airport Road Food Centre! Would come again for my next stay!

Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt.  Die Wohnung war in einem Top zustand der Pool und das Gym waren auch super. Awesome location. Close to the train station and park for running. Despite a little slow in responding but overall strongly recommended.

convenient location and cozy stay
Great location, clean, and good value. Will happily stay there again.

A great private place to stay close to the MRT station and shops. The property was a clean place which was a perfect place to stay.
Appartement spacieux et propre, femme de ménage, emplacement calme, proche des transports en commun, à 15min du centre ville, Check in et Check out autonomes, personnel sympathique.

Great place, big king size bed with plenty of storage space and big room with aircon. Close to airport and busses anywhere. Hist was lovely and there is a pool and gym onsite.

房间非常好，房东也很好，周边生活便利，附近有超市，餐厅，小贩中心，离东海岸公园非常近，晚上可以散步去珍宝餐厅吃饭，然后一路吹着海风就回来了。

The other things which bothered me was the communication from the host. James didn’t want to give us longer than an hour after arriving at the airport to meet for the check-in and we felt rushed. Our flight got delayed and James was annoyed about this and he wasn’t understanding at all about the situation and we had a 13 hour flight which didn’t feel welcoming at all. Eventually all went well and James wife checked us in a couple hours later and showed us the apartment. But a couple days later we got a strange request if we were willing to let a potential tenant look at the apartment during our stay which I think is not a think guest should be bothered with during their booking.
The Apartment is close to the MRT (Subway) and there’s lots of busses too. Something which we missed as well was basic kitchen supply’s like Salt, Pepper, Spices or bigger bowls. It was very bare minimal. There is a Washing/Dryer combo machine which was great. And AC is the living room and Bedroom.
If you are used to sleeping on a very very hard matras this is the perfect place to book. I unfortunately didn’t sleep much and our experience with the host wasn’t very welcoming so I have to give it 4 stars.
If the matras get’s replaced by a softer one in the future and the apartment get’s some more basic ingredients like Salt, Pepper, Spices for cooking and some supplies I think this place should be 6 stars in my opinion.
The couch was okay but could also use an upgrade for a place like this to really make it shine in the future.

This place is phenomenal! I stayed here as a business traveller and
Historic: Original windows and the beautiful architectural details make this a truly special place to call home while visiting Singapore! I loved staying in an old shop house and experiencing a part of Singapore where the trees were larger than the buildings. The entire Ann Siang Hill neighborhood is truly a gem, and features lots of stunning, well-maintained architectural gems.
High Quality and Sustainable: Featuring fancy Ashley & Co toiletries, this was one of the first places I've stayed where the toiletries available were nicer than what I brought from home and I loved how they were stored in larger containers, reducing the plastic waste of single-use toiletries! Additionally, they had glass water bottles in each of the rooms and a water filter available for guest use, meaning I could drink as much water as I wanted without creating a massive amount of plastic bottle waste. To top it off, they had notes to put on the bed to reduce excessive linen washing.
Modern: The bathroom was super fancy, and offered a luxurious bath tub and really-nice shower head. I loved lounging in my bathrobe and felt spoiled with the massage chair and oil-burner.
Convenient: Less than a 5 minute walk to the Central Business District, and the walk was through the beautiful Ann Siang Hill Park, which was such a lovely way to start/end my work day.
Noise: Ann Siang Hill is a super trendy part of town, full of amazing rooftop bars and delicious restaurants. This does mean that there can be some noise from the street that you can hear in the street-facing rooms. I simply used ear plugs, but light-sleepers may want to take note of this.

The only toiletry provided is one soap dispenser in the shower that dispenses an all-in-one shampoo/conditioner/body wash/hand soap. The neutral: it seemed in the pictures listed that maybe there was a separate clothes washer and dryer in the room, but ours came with one washer/dryer unit. There is no kitchen sink even though there is a kitchen area, and housekeeping comes twice a week. Instead of paying for bottled water, we refilled water bottles using tap water from the bathroom sink. That may gross you out, but it tasted fine, we didn't get sick, and we saved a bunch of money on drinking water (as opposed to buying bottled water). Do that at your own risk, but it worked for us.
Bottom line: if I couldn't find anything of a better value, I'd definitely stay here again. Here is a very brief itinerary of my short, but awesome stay in Singapore.
Day 1
Arrive 17:00 from Sydney.
Get SGD30 SIM card which gives you 100GB data (only available to tourists) and SGD35 - airport cab to River Edge.
Dump stuff and get bus/cab to Marina Bay Sands. SGD22 for entrance to CÉ LA VI for amazing views of the bay and the city. You get this back in credit for food/drink but this only got me two bitesize duck rolls. Don’t go up to the SkyPark Observatory, it costs more, you don’t get the credit for food, and you can’t see the famous infinity pools but you can from CÉ LA VI!
Cab/bus home and rest.
Day 2
Morning:
Short 20mins walk to Orchard Station to catch MRT red line to Kranji (approx 50mins) where you alright and catch the 170X bus to Woodlands checkpoint which takes you across the border into JB, Malaysia. 🇲🇾 Passport control is busy going into Malaysia so try and go early to miss the ‘traffic’ but coming back into Singapore was a breeze. There isn’t much except a shopping centre on the Malaysian side, but it was worth a passport stamp but if you have time, definitely better to head further up to Malacca/Kuala Lumpur.
Afternoon/Evening:
Get back to Kranji and then head to Marina Bay to see Gardens by the Bay and mooch around admiring the view of the Marina Bay Sands from below.
Day 3
Morning:
Bus 65 is 5 mins walk and goes directly to HarbourPoint in around 20mins and get a cruises/ferry to Batam, Indonesia 🇮🇩 for SGD49 - Another passport stamp. You can pay directly with Visa/MasterCard on the bus and it’s only SGD 0.10!
Afternoon/Evening:
Return to Harbour Point and head over on the cable car on/around Sentosa - get all day ticket for SGD55. It’s expensive and touristy, but worth a look. Head up on the cable car to Mount Faber for food and sundowners at ‘Dusk’ restaurant/bar. Expensive (SGD10 for a half pint) but a good view and nice and chilled. There is also a light show up there at 8pm. After that head back down on the cable car and get the bus from HarbourPoint back to RV Edge.
It is crazy that a ferry to another country costs less than a few cable car rides but that’s the way it is at most tourist destinations.
Day 4:
Morning:
7:30 am 5km Parkrun at West Coast Park.
Afternoon:
Sightseeing on Hop on hop off bus, get off and walk around in Little India and China Town.
Evening:
19:00 head to airport to catch 22:35 flight to London.
Goodbye Singapore!
Thank you for everything!

I'm always weary about staying in places in Chinatown but since it's Singapore, I figured it's pretty safe. Staying at Peter's place/hotel was awesome (we stayed 2 days). Staff was pleasant. Hotel was easily accessible from the MRT/train/subway to and from the airport and tourists attractions. The Chinatown MRT station is literally just a block from the hotel and about 2 blocks (2-3mins walk) to the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple and the Chinatown Complex for some cheap, local food. It's also about a 5 minute walk to the Maxwell food centre, which is another place to grab some cheap and local food (definitely recommend!!! lots of stalls to choose from, open early and closes late). Chinatown is also prime for some cheap souvenirs so don't buy those $8 magnets at Merlion Park or Gardens by the Bay because you'll see the same ones for $1-2 (same with keychains).
With regards to the hotel and the room, it was clean upon arrival and they provide everyday cleaning and changed towels/sheets everyday (you see their housekeeping cart every morning and your towels changed when you come back). They also replenish water, coffee and tea that the room initially comes with. They also provide other amenities including teapot, fridge, safe, slippers, toothbrush, lotion, shampoo/conditioner, hair dryer, bath gel (soap?), and projector tv with cable. The room also includes an AC. Many complains about the AC not being cold, and it does take a while to get cold right after you turn it on (since the keycard is the one providing power, you can't leave it on all day). But I learned that if you set it lower than what's originally set, it gets colder faster, and it does get cold if it's turned on overnight, so that wasn't that big of a deal.
We stayed in a triple room (1 queen/full bed and 1 twin), and the room is small in comparison to typical hotel rooms, but it's better than staying in a hostel where you have to share a bathroom. We didn't have big luggages, only backpacks so the size was fine for us and cozy. The room is very techy and cool, especially the bathroom's atomized glass! It was raining on and off when we were there so they also provided umbrellas for folks to use.
Overall, it was a great place to stay in 2 days and well worth for the location and cleanliness and amenities provided. Would definitely stay here again and recommendable.

This is  a decent unit in a convenient location. It was not quite what we expected because the listing said "luxurious, new..." It is not a new unit, so they must mean it is a new listing. This unit is not close to new. It also is not luxurious. It is a decent place to stay. There was a significant discount, so it was a good value for the two of us. A housekeeper cleans the unit several times per week and changes the bedding and towels about every four or five days. We stayed for a month, so this was great. The host is extremely responsive. It was usually only a matter of minutes before receiving a response. One night, we returned to the unit late (around midnight) to find the internet and TV were out. I sent a note to the host, expecting a response in the morning. Instead, I received a call within minutes and the issue was resolved in less than one hour. The MRT station is literally less than a five minute walk away (for perspective on that time, we are 64 years old). One of the entrances to Little India station is a few blocks farther away, but still easy walking distance. The neighborhood is a gathering place for construction workers, especially on Sunday, but we were not bothered by the crowds. We often returned to the unit between 2300 and 0000 and were very comfortable walking from either MRT station to the unit. The City Square Mall is a short walk away (you can reach it by walking through the MRT station) and there are tons of small shops within one block. The lowest level of the building is occupied by a small shop with a very friendly owner from Bangladesh. He often had Bangladesh mangoes for sale, which are like eating sweet candy, even when green. There is a safe in the unit, but it is not bolted to anything, so we didn't use it. Since this is Singapore, we really did not have any concerns with leaving our belongings in the unit. Overall, the cleaning service was a major plus that canceled out our disappointment that it was not a new unit. We would stay again if the price is right. If there is no discount, there are units with a similar price that appear to be nicer and have more amenities, like a pool. But, if you are looking for a decent, roomy, quiet place to stay, this will work.

My only issue is with AirBnB, not TS's place. I did not realize that short-term leasing (less than 3 or 6 months) is illegal in Singapore. There may be some exceptions by building type or otherwise, but I'm no lawyer. I assumed it was like South Korea, or Japan, which have licensing and my quick research turned up that it was okay to stay in Singapore. As far as I can tell from more careful research, it is a $15,000 USD fine to the host, but currently no enforced penalty for guests. I have no idea why anyone would risk this penalty. Since it is becoming clear that AirBnB is not taking any responsibility in ensuring local legal compliance, my feelings about using AirBnB in Singapore are entirely my fault for not checking more carefully. TS was very upfront about the whole thing and the flat is very nice. If you are okay with the general situation and comfortable with the risks, I think this place is a good choice to stay. I have had to navigate a few sketchy interactions in Asia and this stay was nothing like those experiences.
I am not comfortable lying to neighbors or immigration (although no one asked us any questions, including security at the building entrance) but I also would not want to cause someone that level of fine. It does not seem that the building is the type of complex that bans short term stays (like some condo associations in larger cities), but it's a small building and I can see that neighbors might have concerns about random strangers coming and going. For this reason, I would have chosen a different type of stay in Singapore for my own peace of mind. If AirBnB were legal, I would recommend this host and stay 110%.

You just have to be very careful not to make a noise if you’re going for a swim at night. If you’re traveling with kids, better bring a pair of slippers. The bathroom tiles are a bit slippery for kids and toddlers if they’re barefooted. Also, since it’s a shared room, just a heads up if you have highly overactive kids. It’s kinda hard to tell them to tone down their noise all the time, since they might disturb other guests. The AC takes a bit of a long time to make the room cool, but it will be fine after about an hour. You just need to turn on the fan also at first. Overall, we loved the place. Great hosts. Value for money. Would recommend it, and we could stay here again.
The place is really strategic. It was so easy to reach airport from this place. The owner also gave us a detailed direction so we didn't find any difficulties to reach his place.

Great location and nice hosting , facilities.

Kevin was very quick to response and organise my check in. The bed was comfy and I slept well. I stopped over for one night before I flew - very close to the airport but also very close MRT.
Thank you Kevin for a pleasant stay.

Kelvin was very communicative with check in instructions and very accommodating to us as we needed to check in late at night. However, his wife checked us in and didn’t really do a thorough check in. We had to ask where the towels were ourselves. We asked the wife in person and Kelvin (through WhatsApp) but Kelvin only responded the next day after we had already checked out hours ago. All in all, the place was tidy and sufficient enough for us as a place to sleep at night.
Not recommended

The place is perfect for a transit traveler with a morning-scheduled next flight. Only few minutes away from Tanah Merah station, and around 10-15 minutes from Changi. The host also gives clear instruction to follow for check in, but you have to follow each of the details. The room was cozy and the amenities were great. More than enough for a night transit.
Thank you, Kelvin!

Kelvin's wife met us upon arrival. The details re. finding the key and how to get to the 3B tower and access the room were perfect. The location is perfect for easy travel to the airport, just 15mins by MRT. There are about a dozen restaurants a 10mins walk from the apartment and we enjoyed a very nice evening at a small Japanese restaurant the night before our next morning flight. Would stay again.

The location of the house is pretty good, two stations away from Changi Airport. Around one minute walk from MRT Tanah Merah station to the house.
The room is very tidy and facilities are also complete. This housing estate has a beautiful swimming pool and it’s free.
Kelvin is a nice host. He allowed me to check in before 11 pm.
Sorry to bother him and his family these days. I will book his house next trip to Singapore.
It’s very close to MRT and airport.. 😊

I had a pleasant night there and it was real close to the airport and also to the train station that is connected to the airport.
Everything was nice and clean. Kelvin was a friendly host. My recommendations.

Kelvin is an amazing host. Very friendly and a positive guy. As mentioned, the apartment is very close to MRT and airport too. The society is nice and have a huge pool.

Great location near tanah merah MRT. Pool view from bedroom. So relaxing.
Spacious room and clean
Perfect location and communication was brilliant. Just the room was for 3 people quite small.
Really great location, easy to get to from airport. Big swimming pool without crowds.

Kelvin was helpful.. the only disappointment was the check in.

nice flat, nice room, close to the airport and the train(mrt)..perfect for a stopover

very good

Thanks you Kelvin for making me feel like home at your apartment. Really close to the airport for someone who needs to make a longer transfer in Singapore.

We arrived very late at Changi airport, so it was great to have easy self check in. The place itself was clean and nice, but the best part of our stay was swimming in the amazing and huge swimming pool in the morning. There were also some great shops and restaurants nearby. I would highly recommend Kelvin's place!
Super freundlicher und sehr schneller Kontakt. Wurden persönlich an der Haltestelle abgeholt. Lage ist wie beschrieben sehr nah am Flughafen und sehr gut zu erreichen

Room is comfortable and quiet. No problems with checking late, and great communication. Recommended.

Clean room near MRT. It was quit, you can use the kitchen and the bog Pool.

very fast and easy communication. Great host
Nice place to stay

It's near 2 mrt stations, allowing me to travel easily. There are at least 5 food courts nearby (I don't usually eat in an actual restaurant). There hasn't been any problem.
The host is really helpful!

I spent a week there working, doing meetings and feeling super productive in an inspiring place, I would recommend this to anyone traveling for work or even for leisure.

Amazing facilities, beautiful rooms, super friendly and helpful staff, lots of co-living spaces including kitchen, laundry, hangout spaces (indoor and outdoor). Definitely a great alternative than a hotel! The place is located in a great area to walk around and walking distance to 2 MRTs, Fairprice, fairprice finest and cold storage. My stay at Hmlet was lovely! Checking in was a breeze and the Hmlet staff were always very helpful and friendly.  My room was stylish, cozy, and clean. The bed was super comfortable. Hmlet is located roughly a 10 minute walk to central CBD and to all the cozy bars and restaurants in Chinatown. I highly recommend staying at Hmlet Cantonment.
Great apart hotel. Check in hosts at reception are very attentive and helpful.

Great location close to supermarket, restaurants, mall and hawker stalls. The extra large studio was a bit smaller than I had expected but the pictures are definitely accurate, just taken from a clever angle. The unit was very clean and there was even water, coffee and beer provided in the communal kitchen.

Hmlet Cantonment was an excellent place to stay. It's been very well renovated with excellent usable spaces both inside and outside. Location-wise, it was a short walk from two MRT stations and also close to areas that are great for walking and eating such as Maxwell and Chinatown.
We highly recommend it.
一场性价比很高，喜出望外的airbnb至旅。房间干净，公共区域很大免费咖啡啤酒健身房等。以后还会住

Visited with family and we love the place. Wonderful staff, great location and great facilities. Perfect for long stays, where you need to feel at home... we highly recommend and we will be back soon for more :)

They have a wonderful community canteen, where there are complimentary coffee, water, and beer, as well as a nice fitness studio that I took advantage of every day. Overall, I'm pleased with my stay!
Super nice place. Highly recommended!

Hmlet Cantonment is well placed as it’s in the town area, about 7 mins walk away from the metro and surrounded by many restaurants. The staff are the most accommodating people i have come across. They assisted us without hesitation every single time. We stayed in the large room which had all the advertised amenities. We will definitely return here!
Lovely place, great staff, terrific location.
Wonderful place, great staff, superb location! Highly recommended, superb for long stays.
Definitely a place to stay while adventuring Singapore. It’s in the middle of everything!!

Place is nice maybe I excpected bigger room!

Awesome place. Very clean. Close to MRTs, Bus Stops. Would love to come back here again.

We had a pleasant stay at Hmlet. A nice a spacious room. Generally very well kept. Good indoor and outdoor communal areas.
Helpful employees.
还是比较方便的,大家都比较热情,很感谢！

Loved the stay here. Location is very central and you could get anywhere in Singapore within 15 mins by taxi. Some are walkable from there (Raffles,  Chinatown etc). Rooms are quite nice though we expected the extra large rooms would be bigger as seen in the pics - but no complains. There is one beautiful outdoor space (common for everyone) where you could just relax and chill. Pool is quite small though. Staffs are friendly and helpful.
Great space with stylish and comfortable furnishings and very friendly staff. The location was great, close to two MRT stations but also quiet at night.

Would Highly recommend this place. Very private, easy to get to everything. Staff is very Helpful. Everything is new, smells and looks great. Can't stress enough how helpful the staff was to me. Thank you so to your staff, and hope to see you in the near future.

This hotel is a fine place to stay when you’re in town. The furnishings are modern and nice, the staff is really friendly, and the community rooms with coffee available any time are a great benefit for a jet lagged traveler. It’s a bit “out of the way,” with no convenient MRT stations or hawker centers around the corner like some of the other places I’ve stayed, but it’s clean, quiet, and pretty, so I’m not complaining.
Fantastic location, modern and clean furnishings, extremely friendly staff and great service.. Would recommend for anyone wanting hassle free quality accommodation!

Had a great 2 weeks stay here - very clean unit, great location within walking distance to a supermarket/wet market/shopping mall/food options. Also really great service from all the staff at Hmlet, super friendly and smiley all the time! And very efficient in resolving any issues we reported. Kudos to the housekeeping team for being so friendly and considerate too!
The room was great and we especially enjoyed the access to the wellness studio. The team was also really warm and helpful. Thanks, Hmlet!

The staff were friendly and helpful but the photos of the room make it look MUCH larger.  I also didn't enjoy having to travel down two floors and to the other end of the building to iron clothes, and there was no where to use the hair dryer near a mirror.  Good location.

We stayed for 27 nights, and was all in all very pleased. The room had anything needed for a lengthy stay. Our AC broke down during the first week, but the very helpful staff at Hmlet did all they could to help out, and eventually located us to a different room, when the AC wasn’t possible to fix. The communication was swift through WhatsApp.

The room is as advertised and a good size, basically a studio apartment. I was perfect for a 10-day solo trip with light cooking and ample space in the fridge for some groceries. It's just about a 10 min walk to the nearest MRT(metro) station and nearby to several bus stops. Also walkable to several shops and restaurants - overall good location. Hosts were helpful and the grounds are well-kept.

The rooms were well equipped for a holiday and very clean. Lovely bed and good shower. We found the location great for walking to local places such as the Buddha Tooth Relic temple, Maxwell’s market for local Singaporean cuisine and Chinatown.
We also found it a good location for a visiting tourist locations such as the Marina Bay observation deck and Gardens by the bay. There are two MRT stations in walking distance and many buses.

I liked the accommodation at Hmlet Cantonment however price is a bit steep for what you get

Great location, close to MRT, 3 Hawker centres, supermarkets and everything else you might want. Perfect location if you want to be in and around Tanjong Pagar

Room was really nice and had lovely showers and a comfy bed (it also had a washing machine in it). Only issue for us was that the pool was close for our whole stay which was one a big draw card to go here with the humid weather. Some of the coffee and beer machines also not working at times. It’s a nice stay if you’re coming and prepared to be self sufficient (over a hotel).
Great Location! Extremely clean property. I would stay at the Hmlet again.
the location is great, but the rooms have thin walls and you can hear everything and it was hard for me to sleep

I shared the extra large room with my partner and it was a good size. The pictures are accurate and the floor plan is very helpful. We had an issue with the aircon on the first day which was really unfortunate but they moved us into a new room within a few of hours of telling them the issue. Great location, close to restaurants, bars, wet market and small hawker stalls in Duxton area, then a close MRT ride to Chinatown or Tiong Bahru. Classic old shop houses and nice walkable area past the main road. Room was quiet with nice leafy outlook despite being close to a big intersection. Break out areas, like the canteen, for people with smaller rooms or travelling in groups also seemed really nice. Would definitely stay again

Hmlet was fantastic. My boyfriend and I stayed in an extra large room for 3 weeks. It was basically a studio with a small kitchen, bathroom, and table. It was a <10 walk to the MRT station and very close to some amazing restaurants and coffee shops (e.g. Nylon and Equate coffee). We used the amenities like common coworking space, pool, and yoga mats in the wellness room. Communication was easy via WhatsApp. Would recommend to anyone coming to Singapore!
clean facilities and exactly as advertised!

We had a really good stay at Hmlt! The staff was very friendly and helpful, the room was clean and tastefully furnished. We especially appreciated that the kitchen is well equipped, so if you want to cook for yourself sometimes, that's perfectly possible.
The location is conveniently close to some metrostations and to Chinatown, which makes it a good starting point to exlore the city.

We stayed at Hmlet Cantonment while we exited our condo and Singapore. We had two cats staying in the room with the two humans. The facilities were perfect for us and the staff were very flexible and accommodating. The location is also great. It's possible to walk to the heart of the CBD in not much time. Otherwise everything is a close taxi ride. Would recommend and happily stay again.
Great service, perfect location and super welcoming!

- location is centrally located and you can reach chinatown very quickly.
Hmlet is a very good choice if you want to explore Singapore.
Great area for food. Comfortable rooms and a communal canteen.

Very cute, comfortable, green and clean space. Staff is very friendly and great location.

Great location!! (very close to MRT stations, Malls, restaurants, supermarket, cafes) Staffs are very responsive.

The location is really great - close to Chinatown, the MRT, great coffee shops like Nylon. Everything was great except my shower was cold for the whole week I stayed there. Staff was very helpful with calling taxis.

Great location and very friendly and helpful staff.
Public areas were great for chilling out and had great facilities
Will book again for my next Singapore trip

Easily one of the best place we stayed in to. Have a lot of hawker and restaurant near by and close to mrt and next by bus stops. Place is really clean and nice.

The studio is fairly large and can comfortably house two people, complete with an equipped kitchenette (induction, water kettle, pots and pans, cutlery). There were no basic cooking items provided like salt and oil, but there are plenty of stores within walking distance, so that’s not a problem really. The bathroom is equipped with all the essentials, including a hair dryer. There’s also free coffee and tea in the communal kitchen.
The location is excellent - close to two MRT stations, and within walking distance of amazing restaurants, bars, and cafes. The space is very private considering how bustling the neighbourhoods nearby are.
The service is great too. Housekeeping is provided two times a week, and the staff was very responsive to all my requests.

Great place, neat room, decent location
Great place to base your Singapore city break! Great shared places, youthful vibe and eeeexcelent all-day free coffee!

It’s a good, casual alternative to a hotel stay. Amenities are good. We were in the extra large room, but any smaller and it would have been tight. We enjoyed our stay.
We had great 3 weeks stay at Hmlet and everything is great!
Great place to stay, one of my best experiences on this platform

Really nice place. Clean, modern, good area, close to the action. Friendly and helpful staff, solid facilities.

Great place to stay that has everything you need! I would definitely stay again.
Room was ok.

Fairly nice apartments, even though not in the city center but all main attractions are within 20-30 mins on the public transport and 10-15 mins on taxi. Ability to use hotel amenities before checkin and after checkout is extremely helpful ✨

I would like to thank Wong and Kal, who were reception desk workers, for their kindness and helpfulness when I got injured at the property. I have not had an accident in many years and it is very difficult when it happens in a foreign country. These 2 people were very compassionate toward me-- but they actually were super kind people from the start before I had my mishap. On the other hand, the management played the blame game on me instead of acknowledging that their unmarked glass door was a liability especially at night in poorly lit circumstances. What I learned from this situation is that even though the Hmlet Cantonment looks like a cool, hipster place, the management only thinks about money and not human well-being. I would not return to this place. I suggest that if people have a little more room in their budget, they explore other hotels near in price, such as the Holiday Inn Singapore Clarke Quay, which has an infinity pool on the 8th floor and fabulous free breakfast.

we really enjoyed our stay at Hmlet Cantonment, it was close to public transport and great food options within walking distance as well. the room was as advertised and enjoyed the space available. reception also provided plenty of information to make it a breeze when checking in

Great place to stay, 5 min walk from amazing restaurants & architecture. We chose to walk around vs the MRT but everything is close. 10 min walk to Lau Pa Sat, Maxwells, 10min Grab to Vivocity to Sentosa, great location.

Everything was clean and spotless. Enjoyed the stay here and would love to stay here again when another chance comes by to visit Singapore again.
Checking was easy.. staff where accomodative and understanding, the Mrt Station was really accesible as discribed felt like i was in the centre od singapore
We loved our stay. The hotel is in a great location - close to Chinatown and the MRT. Great facilities and very helpful and accommodating staff. Highly recommended.

Perfect accommodation for our two weeks vacation. Room with kitchen and washing machine was big enough. Outram Park MRT station only 5-7 min walking distance. Everything was clean and well maintained 😊

This was a great place to stay. Definitely recommend it! The location was perfect, the room was comfortable, and the staff were welcoming and friendly.

Wifi was spotty at times in the room, though there were always people in the reception/working area so I assume the Wifi was better there. We took Grabs the entire week and found the location pretty central to the main sights. Overall, we had a positive experience here for our first time in Singapore.
great place to stay at, friendly staff and clean rooms, location was close to main attractions and walkable distances to mrt stations

Great location, 3rd visit, would come back again

Leider musste ich bei meiner Bewertung zwei Sterne abziehen:
1. Ich habe das "The Extra Large"-Zimmer gebucht, da die Fotos eine lange Außenwand mit vielen Fenstern zeigen, die den Küchen- und Arbeitsbereich lichtdurchfluten. Mein Zimmer entsprach jedoch nicht diesen Erwartungen. Während der Küchenbereich hell war, war der Arbeitsbereich sehr dunkel und hatte nur zwei kleine Fenster. Das Personal erklärte, dass dies die Zimmer am Rand des Gebäudes betrifft. Eine Umbuchung wurde angeboten, aber aus Zeitgründen lehnte ich ab.
2. Der Internetzugang erfolgt über ein öffentliches Netzwerk, auf das jeder im Gebäude Zugriff hat. Dadurch konnte ich nicht per Remote-Desktop auf unsere Server zugreifen, da dies unsere Sicherheitseinstellungen nicht zulassen. Ein minimaler Schutz durch ein Passwort wäre wünschenswert gewesen.
Diese Punkte würden mich von einer erneuten Buchung abhalten. Das Personal war jedoch freundlich und kompetent!

Front desk people were very nice and helpful. However once I got to my room I noticed mold on the AC unit. Looked like the unit was leaking water onto the wall. This happened in the middle of the night and the next morning we checked out and booked a hotel.

Excellent place to stay, very central between Downtown Core and Sentosa island! Would definitely stay again.

Great place, roomy and clean it was great having the washing machine/dryer,staff were very helpful and the location was awesome, lots of restaurants and cafes not too far or expensive to get a Grab into Orchard Road
Nice place and fair price.  Centrally located and walking distance to good bars and restaurants

4.5 Stars. They didn’t have our room ready when we got there, so we had to stay in a smaller room the first night (which they tried to sell us an upgrade lol). Otherwise, pictures were accurate and it was centrally located.

Nice, quiet stay in a convenient, newly renovated historic building. Friendly staff, comfortably modern common area, and craft beer on tap! Located a short walk from Maxwell food center and central Singapore. Thoroughly enjoyed the stay.

Hmlet Cantonment provides a great "value for money' serviced accommodation destination in Singapore for singles, couples and small families. The complex contains three different sized room types, so make sure you choose what suits - the very helpful and professional staff will assist with all of your enquiries plus ensure that you have an enjoyable visit.

I had a wonderful 1 week stay at Hmlet Cantonment, in a Medium Room. It was the perfect base for me, particularly as a solo female traveller who wanted something between a home-stay and a hotel experience. I felt safe and warmly-welcomed, and then I was happily left to it.
The communal kitchen was clean, with open-access fridges, appliances, cutlery and plates, as well as the free coffee machine and a cold drinking water tap. The space was well maintained and a cleaner came twice a week to refresh towels and linen. The decor is modern and simple and also fairly chic. They also operate a trust-based snack/drink system, where you can purchase drinks and snacks/noodle cups from the main communal space if you want a snack or drink without leaving the premises. 7-11 and other convenience stores are a ten minute walk away. Would certainly return if I visit Singapore again.

I was staying here as I was a student at NTU. very in depth review incoming.
PROS: > the place is very clean and quiet.
> the facilities at the complex are very useful eg they have a gym and laundry room
> the people are friendly and he and the cleaner are always offering something to eat.
> the location is very convenient - 8-minute walk to local shopping centre, 35 minute walk to NTU campus, 10 minute bus to boon lay (MRT and big shopping centre).
CONS: > the wifi in the room was horrible, would always cut out and towards the end of my stay i was running on data as the only place it would work was actually in the living room.
> the shower water is not very hot. halfway through the shower it would get cold. i actually moved into NTU dorms later on and the shower was much hotter.
> on weekends it was quite noisy outside because the room is opposite to the pool. i got sick because of the stuffy room, so i had to keep the window open, but then i would get woken up on weekend mornings by the kids in the pool.
> the plug is all the way on the opposite end of the bed. if i didnt have my portable charger with me to sleep, i couldnt charge my device. i could only charge two appliances at a time.
> the washing machine is straight-up wack. my clothes never got washed properly. it tore one of my clothes and simple marks such as ketchup or pen got turned into stains because the machine didnt wash it out. it created so much pellet and lint on tshirts. it also leaked so after every wash I had to mop up. there was a little bit of difference after i bought powder soap bc they only have liquid soap but i still had to prewash my clothes (ESPECIALLY socks). after i moved onto NTU dorm, the difference in the washing was crazy.
> there was hardly any space in fridge for my items, i understand that im the guest and of course their items come first but i had to squish my things or move things around constantly. there is also no space to dry clothes on the rack outside, so i had to put a rack in my room and that contributed to the room getting stuffy and me getting sick. it was especially hard to dry the bedsheets. i didnt think it was right to ask them to move all their clothes so i just dealt with it.
"so why didnt i use the washer and dryer?" - the washer is 4 dollars, and the dryer is 3 dollars (if you want to get the clothes fully dry). i didnt want to spend 7 dollars on washing every other week.
> i didnt know the people i would be staying with would be much older than me. at some times, it made me feel uncomfortable. for context im a 21 yo female student. when i asked before i booked hon didnt give me much details so i wish there was more transparency, though i supposed i couldve asked for more details.
> the bathroom was weird. smelt like sewer and you had to flush multiple times but NTU also had the same problem every time i turned on the shower so might be a region thing. there was also NO space to put anything (eg shampoo, soap etc) so u kind of just have to put everything on the (shower) floor?
CONCLUSION: this is 3 month minimum booking. you're paying SGD$1500 per month. its more expensive than a lot of other flats around. its a fine room and the location is okay, but if you're a student like me, especially going to NTU, i dont think its value for money. i took it because i wanted a private room, but there is actually only a few hours of alone time in the flat. if you were offered a double like me, just take the double and you can swap for a single later on. you will save SO much money and you will be SO much more comfortable.

It was situated at a carpark a few steps from a park that had turtles and fishes that you can feed for 1 SGD. There were birds and the occasional squirrel sighting that were just a hit with our kid. It was a private area, with a 24/7 guard at the entrance so no worries with security.
It was also indeed a few minutes walk through the Haw Par Park to the nearest MRT station. 有机会再去新加坡的话，还会选择这里，非常感谢房东对我们提供的帮助。

Cons: very small, no window, limited space for large suitcases (but as shown in the photos - you know what you are getting). Fixed hangers and a lack of hooks for towels etc was frustrating. Cons:
Room plan: The room is laid out so that two beds are separated by a large closet in between. Hospitality: I was really disappointed with how things were handled at the end of our two months stay. I stayed two nights at this hotel chain. some good, some bad experiences.
the good: this specific chain's location is perfect, and the room was clean and new/modern. room will be considered cramped to many westerners but for me coming from HK, I'm used to it. bed is comfy.
now, the bad: first, the room doesn't block noise from outside much as I can hear not just neighbors but also the ding dong sound the elevator makes. my room is closest to elevator so perhaps other rooms will be better.
the second and bigger to me is the staff do not communicate well. after I booked I got a message from "host" on Airbnb telling me to download the app that is required to check in and unlock room door. the note says I can pre register up to six days before I check in. I kept trying to do this over course of two days but the app wouldn't load. I told the host this but we concluded maybe it's because I'm in Europe at the time. so I land in Singapore on day of check in and I still couldn't get in the app. at this point I'm nervous because I am due to arrive to hotel in one hour and I still can't get app to work. I message host again, he tells me to restart my phone (a pointless advice I've done already. I tell him it doesn't work, he gives me a WhatsApp number to message. I send a message there, the person sees my message but does not respond.
finally I arrive at hotel still having not resolved app issue, only to realize the app CAN ONLY BE USED WHEN CONNECTED TO THE WIFI AT THE HOTEL. so basically all that info about pre registering days before is wrong information. I understand mistakes happen, but the lack of communication after really made me mad. to ignore messages from someone who's already landed in Singapore and on way to the hotel is terrible service.

The pillow case sheets felt damp when we arrived and you could see evidence of mould spores on the door and it just smelled really damp everywhere, which we weren’t keen on as have asthma.
The room didn’t have the touches seen in the photos such as nice cushions and a throw, so the room wasn’t ‘bouji’ nice-looking as the pics. We did rate having a Netflix account logged in on the tv - that was cool.
There was wifi easily available at the reception in order to do the app check in, which was important for us as we didn’t have data roaming in Singapore.
In terms of location in Little India, this was quite good (fairly central, transport links good) but in terms of local restaurants etc they are (unsurprisingly) mostly small Indian places and probably need to walk to Kampong Glam for ‘cooler’ restaurants, but this isn’t too far - maybe 15 mins (but remember its v hot & humid in Singapore so we had to dial down our expectations about walking everywhere all the time eg to Marina Bay!).
There are budget hotels at similar price with full room and windows that perhaps feel better value, but this does have communal area / kitchen if that’s something you need.

Overall, good place to stay for a few days and, given that Singapore is extremely expensive in general, value for money is great.
Pros :
- Place feels safe and clean
- Pretty easy to check in and to communicate with the hostel services, provided you are reasonably savvy with smartphones (if you aren't, this could easily become an obstacle for you, as there is only a reception during daytime)
- Fresh linen, reasonably comfortable bed, small but great shower, smart TV
- Common areas are clean and stylish
- Location is very convenient and great for exploring Singapore, lots of cute streets and restaurants around, Lau Pa Sat is 15 minutes away, MRT station is very close, area feels safe!
- AC in the room is great and you can control the temperature
- Online support is very responsive and people are nice!
Cons :
- Noisy area and our room wasn't really soundproofed. You can hear guests from next room, music from the rooftop bar doesn't stop before midnight, and you can expect to hear noises from the streets as well until late on Friday/Saturday. Also, right now there is construction work (as advertised) next door to the hotel, so starting at 8-9AM you can also expect pretty loud noises. Bringing earplugs would be a good idea.
- Even if the place feels pretty clean overall, there are mold traces on the shower curtain and in the corners of the room
- We got a room with no free space below or above the bed (picture 8/22), other pictures seem to display some of the rooms with a little more space for luggage. In our room, opening our luggage to access our clothes/things was a bit of a struggle, it's really quite small!
Tip :
Don't forget to request the linen/towel change every 3 days through their online chat service, it's really easy to do but they won't come if you don't specifically ask a day in advance!
In summary, we did enjoy our stay and think the value for money is good (for Singapore) and would recommend staying there if you are looking mainly for a place to sleep at night and don't mind noises too much! Thank you for the stay :)!

There's a small window that's opened but instead of exhausting the moisture from the inside, it's really just mixing it with the humidity and heat from the outside, causing a mildew smell that I had a very hard time with. I'm not sure if much can be done here. Inside the room and the communal sitting area near the kitchen/lobby, you don't notice the smell. On the other hand, the Wi-Fi was very unstable and unreliable. A lot of times it just wouldn't connect, not matter which SSID you used. And if it did, it was generally pretty slow. I was trying to use my cell service but in my pod/room area, the signal wasn't great for that either.
Overall, it was a good experience. Oh, if you need to do your laundry, you need to buy your own laundry detergent. I went out and got the smallest pack possible even though I only used it once. I left it behind for whoever needs it, hopefully someone used it.

The room itself, while small, is sufficiently furnished. The air conditioning is powerful, the room is somewhat well-lit thanks to the window and some indoor lighting, and the bed is comfortable enough. There is also good Internet in the rooms and by the front door.
This is a self check-in hotel, which means there is no front desk and no permanent in-person staff, but communication is swift and helpful through the hotel’s own app (the one that must be downloaded to check-in). I was also happy to use the lockers in my last day to leave my luggage after check-out and give the city one final walk before departing.
Unfortunately, it seems rooms aren’t cleaned and the towel provided isn’t changed unless one requests for it. My room had a bad smell when I arrived. It was cleaned that same day, but it acquired the bad smell again by the second day. That made the stay a little less comfortable.
There are two bathrooms on premise, one for men and one for women. The men’s bathrooms had around 3 toilets and 3 showers. That means that one could be sharing a bathroom (toilets, showers, etc.) with dozens of strangers, not only a few.
All in all, I would say: excellent choice for people on a budget looking to explore the city; great choice for those who aren’t pesky about shared bathrooms and little in-person service; iffy choice for those who may not be into sharing or require extra help.
Overall, now understanding how it works, I would return. Hope you give it a chance!

I stayed at ST Signature, Jalan Bazar, for two nights in a room with a private bathroom.
The facility was modern, clean and pleasant. There is a common lobby with a WiFi facility and a shared kitchen area with essential equipment if you want to use it.
When you arrive, there is an online check-in process through a mobile app, and a digital room key is given to your phone. This checking process takes a few minutes, and all the instructions are available in the lobby. When you return to your room, ensure your phone has battery power to enter the room :). I faced a battery-dead situation one night. The staff verified my identity and opened the door for me.
The room and the bathroom are small but sufficient for business travel. The room has a queen-size bed, a work desk and a chair, a luggage storage area, a mini bar and a safety deposit box. The bathroom is clean. One thing that I felt missing was a cloth hanger on the room wall.
The location was very convenient. It's about 20 mins from the airport in a Taxi. Jalan Bazar MRT Station Entrance is just opposite the road. The area is easily accessible through other modes of transportation as well.
The checkout time was noon. I checked out, left the bags at the location, and went out for work until my flight time came. Then came back in the evening and collected the luggage before going to the airport. You can even take a quick shower and get a change in the shared bathroom area before you leave for your comfortable journey to your next destination.
For sure, I'm going to stay at ST Signature again on my next trip to Singapore.

Die Unterkunft liegt sehr zentral zur nächsten Ubahnstation. Sie liegt nicht weit weg von Little India und dem arabischen Viertel.
In der Unterkunft findet man eine Gemeinschaftsküche vor, die alle notwendigen Utensilien besitzt und sehr groß und geräumig ist.
Unser Zimmer war sehr klein, ganz anders wie man leider auf dem Bilder sieht. Es gehen sich nicht mal zwei Koffer am Boden aus!
Für mehr als zwei Nächte wäre ein größeres Zimmer vom Vorteil, aber mit der guten Lage kann man nur zufrieden sein.
Die Kommunikation war sehr gut, sowohl mit dem Besitzer der Wohnung als auch dem Personal des Hotels.
Comfortable

Good Value. Ideal location. Great customer service. It was very helpful to have someone on site to walk me through the check in process.
We booked the loft with private bath. We were given a different room but when I bought it to their attention it was promptly addressed.
Actually I didn’t stay here. My booking was non refundable. But my partner has a very serious ill. The host still refund the full amount.
Amazing location and easy as to get to. Communication was great and everyone was so friendly!
Good location and responsive host

Posizione ottima, a pochi passi dalla fermata della metro nel quartiere arabo. La ragazza che ci ha accolti è stata molto gentile e ci ha risolto subito un problema che abbiamo avuto con la serratura della porta. Grazie! Per il resto purtroppo io trovo inconcepibile pagare 165$ a notte per dormire in un loculo strettissimo dove non c’è nemmeno una ventola nel bagno cieco, dove sentivo il vicino fare qualunque cosa anche il clic dei suoi interruttori della luce, dove se si è un pochino più alti della media dormire in due in un letto incavato tra due pareti è scomodo. Vedendo i prezzi in generale per gli alloggi a Singapore forse non è nemmeno troppo caro ma io l’ho trovato totalmente sproporzionato. Le lenzuola e gli asciugamani erano puliti ma il resto della stanza come il pavimento o il bagno non lo erano molto. La modalità di apertura della porta tramite app da un lato è comoda ma dall’altro avevo paura di arrivare col telefono scarico a fine giornata e aver problemi ad entrare.

I don't think mandatory downloading of an app to check-in and take photos of passports to upload is an inconvenience. The photos also don't match the room since some photos show a bed on a second level of the room, and some show it on the first level. Clearly the photos are generic from the building.

Misleading information about the number of beds, contacted to clarify immediately and yet refused to give a refund or even let us change the number of days. The aircon was leaking and there was a wet patch in the doorway, with mould on the side. Walls were paper thin and it was very noisy. Location was okay and check in and out was easy at least. Reception staff were nice.
Clean, tidy and good location for MRT
it was a great place to stay, if we could we would have stayed more than a night there

We only stayed here for a night but it was a very comfortable convenient stay! The accomodation is extremely close to a metro station and has good food options nearby. The room itself was very comfortable. We would love to stay again!

Excelente Lugar. Frente a estación de metro. Muy cercano a principales atracciones de Singapur.
La habitación con ventana se sentía espaciosa y muy bien organizada. El aire funcionaba perfecto. Nunca se generó condensación. En el lugar puedes cocinar desayuno, lavar (esto pequeño costó) y planchar gratis. Lo recomiendo. Es el alojamiento más costo efectivo de Singapur.
Alles bestens, Zimmer tadellos Sauber, Personal sehr freundlich und gleich in der Nähe der Unterkunft eine MRT-Station
Excelente lugar para descansar, muy buena ubicación, cerca a la estación del metro
Practical for a short stay. Located right next to the metro, it's easy to find. Not all rooms have the same layout, so check before booking.

Zimmer war super sauber und hat völlig ausgereicht, war zwar nicht genau wie auf den Bildern, aber das macht nichts :)
U-Bahn station auf der direkt gegenüber liegenden straße und ansonsten auch vieles fuß-läufig möglich.

Auf den Bildern wirkt das ST Signature Jalan Besar sehr modern und stylisch, deshalb hatten wir uns darauf gefreut. Leider waren wir von unserem Zimmer etwas enttäuscht. Es lag zum Innenhof, war sehr klein und mit größerem Gepäck wird es schnell eng. Außerdem gab es Schimmel in der Dusche und am Silikon rund um das Waschbecken. Das Zimmer entsprach insgesamt nicht wirklich den Bildern auf der Webseite.
Nachts war es zudem nicht ganz ruhig, da man ein dauerhaftes Geräusch von einer Lüftung oder technischen Anlage hören konnte (nicht von unserer eigenen Klimaanlage).
Positiv ist, dass die Lobby, die Gemeinschaftsküche und der Innenhof den Fotos entsprechen und das Hotel wirklich sehr gut gelegen ist, direkt an einer U-Bahn-Station, wo man super einfach zu allen Sehenswürdigkeiten gelangen kann. In der Umgebung gibt es viele Restaurants, kleine Märkte und Massagemöglichkeiten.
Da wir nur 2 Nächte dort waren, war es in Ordnung. Ansonsten hätten wir nach einem neuen Zimmer gefragt.

Fidèle aux photos ainsi qu’à la description du logement. Le quartier est assez populaire mais le métro est juste en face donc facile de rejoindre le centre ville. Les installations sont cependant vieillissantes, la table à repasser n’est pas très bien fonctionnelle et l’isolation est clairement à revoir, on entend tout depuis la chambre. Mais cela reste l’un des logements les moins chers de Singapour !

Die Unterkunft liegt in little India und war gut zu erreichen. Direkt gegenüber befindet sich die MRT Station. Das Zimmer war zwar klein aber sauber und alles nötige vorhanden und man konnte sehr einfach via Whats App um Zimmerservice oder nur neue Handtücher bitten.
Da es ein Co Living Hostel ist hat man eine gemeinsame Küche wo man Lebensmittel lagern und essen zubereiten kann. Alle haben sich an die Regeln gehalten, ich fand es sehr angenehm dort morgens Kaffee zu trinken.
Auch das Personal war freundlich und hilfsbereit und der Messenger Service grandios.
Mir dem MRT kommt man überall sehr leicht und zügig hin.
Wir haben aufgrund annullierter Flüge spontan verlängern müssen, das hat super unkompliziert geklappt und man hat uns sehr freundlich geholfen.

- Great Location
- A bit smaller than expected (I think the "14m^2" include the bed-cavern which has a height of maybe 1.5m -> imo different to actually having the full space)
- Mostly clean
- very thin walls
- considering general price level in singapore, value for price was ok/good

Team was responsive in realtime and I appreciate the assistance in assisting me with my booking and check in
Great location accessible to all the local foods and landmarks
Das Zimmer war kompakt und gut, alles hat super funktioniert. Nur die Klimaanlage war etwas laut.

体验很糟糕，我并无带着情绪来评论这家民宿，完全是出于客官评价。优点:地理位置优越，离很多商圈景点都很近。给我们服务的客服人员也挺好的，帮我们操作办理入住。缺点:房间非常小，小到已经没办法再小了，而且这种设计明显有点不人性化了，就是为了空间的利用，因为大家能看到他们的床是需要上楼梯的，但是事实是，我们分配的房间，床是在下面的，所以我们的房间上方会有一块空间是另外一个房间的床，这样的空间设计如果把隔音做好勉强还能接受，但是他家隔音又非常差，这是我说的最糟糕的部分，早上的时候，打扫卫生的人员六点多好像就在搬来搬去，就是塑料袋易拉罐摩擦的声音，非常明显，还有一些客人可能早起离店，声音也非常大，隔壁房间上下楼梯的声音更是让人无语，还有拖拽行李的声音，还有临街的噪音(我已经关了窗户了)……..如果你是一个轻度睡眠的人，千万别住在这里，噪音将是你的恶梦。再有就是卫生条件也不太好，边边角角不是掉漆掉皮就是发霉的霉斑，洗澡的热水好像也不是无限供应，因为洗到最后没有热水了。可能我很久没有这种糟糕的体验了，我不能给高分，也不接受更改评价。最后提醒大家一下，这种民宿酒店在定的时候多看几个平台，价格会有差异。

Alex a été très accueillant. Les instructions étaient très claires . Le logement est à proximité de tous les incontournables à pieds . Il y a le métro en face de l’hôtel qui dessert Marina Bay, Gardens Bay.
La chambre est spacieuse . Et l’hôte est joignable à tout moment
Je recommande !!

Easily accessible location next to public transport, but would not recommend. There was mould on the walls in the bedroom and bathroom and there was no hand towel or bath mat-no one downstairs to provide one either. Parfait et très bien situé
Awesome spot, super convenient, and best of all, the room was sparkling clean.
Flexibler, schneller Check-In und schnelle Antworten auf meine Nachrichten. Das Zimmer sah aus wie auf den Bildern und super Lage!!

Had a quick stop in Singapore and this place was great for it, just what you need if you need somewhere to rest up and spend the night.
Stuff was friendly and helpful and the place was clean.
Only thing I had a bit of a problem with was the check in as they use a separate app, a bit annoying at first but once you get the hang of it it’s not bad
Has its charms but the air conditioning in our room made a horrible scratching noise & the room didn't match the photos.
很棒的住宿体验，离地铁口很近，无房卡直接手机开门，配备厨房等便捷区域。
Everything was like expected just the Wifi wasnt really good! The Staff are really kind and helpful

Je recommande vraiment cet endroit, sans hésitation! On voyage souvent à Singapour et on a testé plein d'hébergements économiques, pods, petits hôtels... et le ST Signature à Jalan Besar est clairement ce qu'on a trouvé de mieux!
On avait réservé une chambre avec fenêtre. Franchement, on ne s'attendait pas à ce que ce soit aussi spacieux, bien équipé, et propre. Avec frigo, TV, le bureau et une sale de bain privé dans la chambre! Le personnel est vraiment très cordial et sympa, ils nous ont aidés avec l'application lors de notre arrivée tard le soir. L'endroit dispose aussi d'une cuisine commune et d'une laverie.
L'emplacement est top: la station de métro à deux pas, des petites boutiques où acheter une SIM pour pas cher et des fruits frais. Un Starbucks à 5 min à pied, et le quartier indien juste derrière où on peut manger de délicieux Masala Thosai chez Ananda Bhavan.
On reviendra, c'est sûr !

Great place to stay,
A little noisy during the day but no complaints!

Klein maar fijn. Prima voor 2 nachtjes!
Great spot for a short stay. 20 mins from the airport, flexible check in and clean space! Will stay again in my next trip to Singapore

30 feet from a train station and lots of food options nearby. I did notice a small amounts of mold and clumps of hair left over in the bathroom, but no problems otherwise. Overall, I’m satisfied with my stay.
Perfect place
the apartament od very close to metro, not very nosie, the bad was quite comfy. i recommend this place to stay couple days.
The room was clean and spotless. It was smll but spacious as well. Checking and checking out was conveniently easy. Would definitely book here again!
Nice cabin hotel
Nice place

Had a great visit here. The rooms are small, but clean and tidy, and designed so that you can use space efficiently. The location is great, with easy access to multiple MRT lines and the excellent Maxwell hawker center practically next door. I went there almost every day for breakfast while visiting.
The only negative was that my windowed ground floor room didn't have great noise isolation with the street outside, so consider that if you're not a sound sleeper. The hotel is by no means on a major thoroughfare, but there was a little bit of construction noise during the day, as well as voices from passersby and chirping birds during the evening and twilight hours. The upper floors looked to have more modern windows, so I imagine they're much better. I was, however, pleasantly surprised with the noise isolation between my room and the room next to me, which was excellent given how close everything is built.
The shared bathrooms were clean, and I never had to wait to shower or use the bathroom.

The room was as advertised in the photos, overall I had a wonderful experience staying here at St Signature Tanjung Pagar. It's highly accessible and its a brisk 7 minute walk to the nearest MRT station.
I would highly recommend anyone to stay here and I hope to come back again on my next trip to Singapore.

Highly recommend this co-living/fancy hostel. The rooms are small, but serviceable. This was probably the most comfortable mattress I've slept on in Asia. The bathrooms/showers are all cleaned regularly. There is a co-ed bathroom on each floor, but single gender shower rooms (that also have a couple toilet stalls). The staff in the lobby were super friendly. It was nice to be able to put my luggage in one of the free lockers after check out. The storage lockers are very spacious. You just need your own lock. It was a nice stay!
Great location - easy access to famous street food centers and countless restaurants. It’s also a great place to meet new friends from all over the world:)
Pieza muy práctica. Buena ubicación.
The place is nice and well-located.

Great facilities, room cleanliness and helpful online/offline staff. Might need a little time getting used to the check-in process but it isn't complicated. Keep in mind that there is only the ONE kitchen in this block so don't go in expecting to be making pancakes and omelettes every morning. Depending on where your room is, noise from the outside shouldn't be a huge problem and what noise does filter in is pretty benign and doesn't linger past 12 am.
Location is excellent as it is smack dab in the middle of some of the best cafes, restaurants and bars. But best you make some reservations for brunch/breakfast during weekends cause it can get quite busy and places rarely have the ability to accomodate walk-ins. Mind you, it is not so far from the Guoco tower and the Tanjong Pagar MRT where there are a few comparatively cheap restaurants and one not so cheap organic market shop (if you're keen on buying fruits and the like).
I'd ST Signature is ideally situated if you want to go to experience all the major sights and sounds Singapore has to offer. Main mode of transport I recommend using would be the MRT, which is fairly easy to navigate, or the transportation app GRAB.
All in all an excellent choice if you're travelling solo or on a budget but still like to immerse yourself in all the city has to offer.
Excellent stay in a great location. Good value for money, was tidy, clean, and secure

I think the price is way too high for the value of the room. It is not clean under the mattress. You can hear the person in the room next to you (I think they sleep above). The shower is on a different floor.

Deberían invertir en el aislamiento de las ventanas. Mi habitación estaba en la planta baja junto a un aparcamiento de motocicletas. Fue bastante difícil conciliar el sueño por el continuo transito de personas y vehículos. Las ventanas son de madera y no encajan en el marco, se escucha todo.
Nice hotel to stay at

The place’s location is extremely convenient. And the shared bathrooms/showers, especially the ones on the second and third floor are very cleanly maintained. The customer service also responds to requests very timely.

Great city center location. The room was very small but one has to accept the way it is in Singapore for this price. Very good communication with the reception. Room cleaning upon a request on the next day.
All fantastic except the fact that the rooms are not well insulated sound wise
Awesome stay, centrally located near shopping and food.
Fantastic location and excellent facilities. The support team were very helpful and always available to assist. Highly recommended!

The accommodation was very good. Clean and very centrally located. You can reach many things even on foot.
There is only one small thing to criticize - the check in. I had already downloaded the app in advance, registered... And yet it took a very long time via Bluetooth to use the phone as a key. On my cell phone, further settings had to be made. All in all, not exactly what you want when you finally arrive at the hostel after a 10h flight plus transfer at night. And I could see others with similar problems during my stay. Maybe you should not try to digitize everything or implement it better. But otherwise a top address for a stay in Singapore.
Highly recommended 👍🏻😊

Accommodations were exactly what I expected, however the room was VERY loud. You could hear construction from 8-5 during the day and the music from the bar on the roof was clearly audible within the room. Unfortunate when you pay extra money to have a window.

Overall really good! Nice area and a really clean room and shower. Just to keep in mind that the cabin (bed) is not that long. I’m 1,85 and my feet was touching the wall while laying. This was my second time here and I’ll keep coming back.
I love this stay so much. There is totally nothing to be critical about. Everything was great
В целом все отлично для меня, отличное расположение. Возможно хотелось бы чуть больше частоты везде и чтобы окна открывались. За эти деньги отличный вариант.

Great place to stay. Very convenient, host is always responsive (even at 2am!), and facilities are clean and well-kept.
Would definitely stay again.
As advertised. Nice place to spend a few days in Singapore :)

The accomodation was great! Clean, comfy, easy proccess of check in/check out. Linq was always able to help and communicate 🤍 I love also the location but it was quite noisy since there is reconstruction outside. But totally worth it
Good for the price.

If you want a relatively cheap stay in a central part of Singapore, then I recommend this place. The staff is always available in chat with fast response time, and they're friendly.
I will say that if you're tall, above 185cm, the beds may be a bit cramped.
Also, the neighbourhood is a bit expensive, even for Singapore. A lot to do if you like drinking and partying though.
Overall, I had a great time staying here.

wonderful location very convenient. The rooms are quite small but comfortable and extremely affordable for Singapore. The host is exceptionally helpful.
Very good experience. Good position. And good service.
Very good host, clean and very well located.

Die Unterkunft befindet sich in einer guten Lage und hat mir generell zugesagt. Das Hostel befindet sich jedoch gegenüber einer großen Baustelle, die sehr großen Lärm mit sich bringt. Innerhalb der Beschreibung werden lediglich „Renovierungsarbeiten“ benannt. Ganz herzlich bedanken möchte ich mich für die Möglichkeit nach dem Checkout nochmal duschen zu dürfen und für das zur Verfügung gestellte Handtuch. Vielen Dank!

The host is very responsive.
Only caution is always have enough cell phone battery to get into your room after a long busy day. Plus remember to take your cell phone to get back in your room after using shared showers and washrooms.
The location is great, everything worked well (fully automated check-in was very convenient). I enjoyed my stay:)
Room size is good for a single traveller weekend trip. Everything has been very clean and safe. Highly recommended stay for a weekend trip around Singapore.
Nice place, good location.
Great
Not very interactive and friendly frontdesk.. I have experienced better welcome experience with airbnb. But other than that, clean room and bathroom, well located. Had a good time there.
Thank you for the short stay. Overall id recommend if anyone wants a clean but budget stay in Singapore.
very nice and very close to the metro
Great location to walk around and explore the city !
I enjoyed my stay - its a small place and the bathroom is on the Hallway and shared. Was perfect for a short layover!
Nice property will consider of returning.

Great to have a private space to retreat to. Clean and easy. Felt good there as a solo female traveller. Good light in the room and just enough space for a comfortable few nights.
near tanjong pagar MRT, easy to checkin checkout, toilet & bathroom is shared but clean

The apartment is fantastic, great location and hassle free to enter. They let me leave my bags before and after check in. 3 minute walk to the metro station and plenty of shops around. For what you are paying it’s way worth the money and I would have paid a lot more.

A tidy and well-organized bedroom plus two big windows, which overlook Murray Street in a popular location of Singapore.
The location is unbeatable, you can easily visit major tourist attractions, as well as so many delicious restaurants nearby.
Eine sehr saubere Unterkunft, auch für Alleinreisende absolut empfehlenswert, angenehme Atmosphäre, freundliche Mitarbeiter, hilfsbereit bei allen Fragen - ich komme gern wieder.
Great place, small but very functional and it's exactly what i needed for a few days stay in Singapore. Could have been alot better if i was allowed to check in early :)
The location is the best thing about this place. Rooms are clean and tidy as well. Bathrooms, while good, could be better (more lighting, hooks etc.)
The room is really small and it was expensive (I think normal for singapore) but the location is awesome.

Eu gostei bastante do local, limpo e muito agradável. Localização perfeita. Apenas senti falta que a janela do quarto pudesse ser aberta, e poderia ter um marcador de porta para avisar para limpeza do quarto. De qualquer forma foi excelente, banheiro muito limpo todos os dias, água quente.

I love this kind of room, it matches my style. highly recommended

Great place

A centrally located convenient pied a terre. Small room which is to be expected in Singapore and the window makes all the difference. Hotel is close to MRT, China Town and a wide selection of food courts, restaurants, shops and cafes. Great for a few days.

I 100% recommend this listing and its hosts. This is an awesome place to stay in Singapore. I wish I had booked more days. If you get the opportunity to stay here you will love it!
It is close to everything. The room is so perfect, the bed is incredibly comfortable, AC is powerful and for me it had a window which is absolutely essential. Lugar bien ubicado, fácil de llegar. La habitación y las áreas comunes estaban limpias.

An sich war alles gut, leider war nur direkt vor dem Fenster eine Baustelle, die morgens um 8 mit der Arbeit begann und ich mich dadurch sehr geärgert habe, den Aufpreis für das Fenster gezahlt zu haben.
