I was a bit skeptical since some of the reviews made it seem like it was super noisy or the amenities weren’t sufficient, but I can’t recommend this place enough! Super easy and flexible check-in, the location was central to many hawker stalls and centres, and just a few mins walking to public transit. I had a window so just a bit of street noose but thats expected if you’re staying in the city.
Having stayed in hostels before this with shared rooms, having the privacy of my own room but still communal living was a nice change. The bathrooms and showers were ample and very clean. Will definitely stay here again my next visit!

Everything looks as pictured. Nice amenities and things were fairly clean. There was some mold on the outside of windows (so not inside the building) and dirt on the curtains, but the most important things were very clean—bed, bathroom, kitchen, etc. The coffee machine only worked one of the days I was there, and the suitcase lockers were all full when I went to leave my bag on the last day. I wasn’t too happy about that. But overall it was a good stay, comfortable bed, clean, good location, nice staff. I mean it is a reasonably priced hostel, so it’s kind of about how I expected except way cleaner than most 👍.

This is a comfortable and affordable hotel in a very convenient location, which makes getting around super easy. Street noise was noticeable on all three nights, so earplugs are recommended—especially if your room has a window. The cabin-style bed is comfortable, though getting in and out of it at night can be a bit awkward. I didn’t interact much with other guests, but the women-only shower room was a nice feature and made me feel more at ease as a solo female traveler. My biggest annoyance was having to bring my phone to the bathroom each time just to get back into my room!
Really close to everything. Good place

Room is clean. No smell of cigarette. Quite. The window helped me get up in the morning and know the weather. It’s near to maxwell and tanjong pagar stations that made it accessible when commuting in public. The staff of the hotel are kind and accommodating. I had a wonderful 6 nights of stay and will definitely go back in the future.

The hotel provided what was advertised and for the most part fit the description. The bed was comfortable and the walls were very sound proof which was a big relief. Although my window looked out onto an alley behind the nice restaurants nearby, there was no additional noise and I slept soundly at night. I spoke with staff by chat who helped me regulate my air con which I appreciated.
The construction going on in front actually ended around 9-10 pm instead of 6 pm as I had been told by message before booking. Gladly I had been given a room at the opposite side of the hotel.
If you're staying one or two nights it's good value for money though maybe not the most comfortable layout.
Convenient location, clean stay meeting all my needs. The hotel was very flexible with checking in and I was able to check in early for a small fee.

Excellent location in the center of Chinatown! The bathroom/shower room was really clean and the conciergerie was really reactive. I regret only to not have a real chest of drawers or shelving unit in my room to put all my clothes

Nice place to stay for a few nights. Easy to check in and out. Near metro stations. Restaurants nearby. A common kitchen with fridge, and hot and cool water provided.  有中国插座and USB，可以不需要转换头。 Saturday evening was a bit noisy because of the bar nearby, but the noise stopped before 24:00 so it's okay for me. Other days were relatively quiet. Cost effective and recommend.

Stayed here for some time during my exchange semester and I really recommend the place. Its got a pool, gym and two MRT just downstairs as well as different bus stations 2 min walk away. Also a whole mall underground. The views are directly at the Marina Bay Sands.
The room was spacious enough, with AC and we could cook on the kitchen. Jane was also very helpful. Would definitely recommend it.
Great location, clean and convenient to check in.

The apartment is in a really awesome location; close to great hawker eats and Chinatown, but also close to fancier western and Japanese spots. I also loved that it was right next to Yoga Movement which is a fantastic yoga studio with so many great class time slots! The view is fantastic every night, and the windows are doubled so the noise from the bars at night is not bad at all (notably I am from a big city so I may be biased). The laundry in unit was also so great and with no extra cost (the dryer actually dries clothes!!!). Be warned though that this place is super small (even for me at 5’3), there is no elevator, and the proper drop off / pick up spot for cabs is a few blocks away. I also had a few small issues with the cleanliness - bathroom still had hairs and the iron and fridge were not cleaned out when I got there. All in all, though, great for a short stay or if you’re out of town visiting for work near Downtown.

Very nice location, I bit noisy with music that comes directly to the room from the bars downstair, but it finish ear evening and was not disturbing, room is small but it has everything, ironing, microwave and fridge.
awesome location & service, would stay again anytime.

It is our  2nd stay with Heritage.  It is a great location close to all tourist attractions and very clean.  Staff was very helpful  both at arrival and checkout.  Listing does  not say there is no Elevator, but there is no elevator, so expect at least one floor of steps here!
客户的诉求没有及时满足，客户的动态服务群中非常明确，尔专属服务人员推送信息完全程序化
nice and beautiful

Thank you for your everything guys, you made our Singapore trip perfect! Room, location, staff everything was just great. Especially Irean, Ryan, Loc, Kim and Divina helped us a lot and answered our questions in just seconds.. 🙏🙏🍀

Great staff and responded within seconds anytime I needed them. Divina, Irean & Loc are the 3 people running the reception and customer service communications and it was always a very pleasant exchange.

Overall great experience, and I would highly recommend. Thanks again!

Our visit to Singapore was enhanced by the quality and price of the accommodation. Great location with loads to do on the doorstep.
Our stay was made simple by the attentive hosts Divina, Loc and Ryan who were helpful and very responsive and went out of their way to help.
Thanks - we'll be back :-)

Excellent place to stay and so much within short walking distance.
The staff are incredibly responsive and helpful. Thanks Ryan, Loc and Divina!
Great central location. Good communication with the host.

This was a wonderful stay in Singapore! Edmar, Daphne and Nica were incredibly quick to answer any questions and they were very proactive. When I was trying to get from the airport, they gave me clear instructions and helped me get there smoothly.

I would happily stay here again.
除了房间隔音不够好，酒吧声音隔不住，晚上睡得不是很好，进来需要爬楼梯，有大行李的不建议，其他不错的。

Saturday night was too much noise to take at 11pm so I made a complaint to the host and it got much better soon after. Overall good stay for its location and room usability but not for the noise at night.
It was a great experience living here. The location is great. There are many good restaurants downstairs and it is right by the river.
Great location on Boat Quay. I had been travelling for work and had 2 days in between flights in Singapore, apartment had it's own washing machine so great to freshen up clothes. Would recommend

Faultless!
Great place to stay, clean, quick & easy!
Would 100% stay here again or use other Heritage Collections

Amazing staff maica, edmar and vannie were super helpful. I had a knee injury and they helped me with my luggage during check in and check out. Very responsive, and attentive. great place in bustling area. would stay there again

I just completed another wonderful stay with Heritage Apartments in the heart of Singapore. This trip was unique. I originally booked a beautiful unit overlooking Boat Quay, knowing it had many stairs and no lift. Unfortunately, a week before arrival I developed a physical impairment that made climbing stairs very difficult.
I contacted my concierge, Jean, to ask about relocating. Although nearby units with lifts were fully booked, Jean and her team — Edmar and Shannon — worked quickly to find a solution. Within two hours, they secured another apartment about 1.2 km away with a lift and far fewer steps.
The new location was perfect, and our trip including our Valentine’s Day plans was saved. Thank you to the Heritage team for going above and beyond!
Great stay! Very clean and excellent communication. A bit noisy at night.
The location is great and the living condition is exact to pictures provided. Value for dollar on the rates, however check in process was a bit troublesome
Small but clean and in a great location. Would stay here again
Excellent location
Clean and simple, would visit again. All the essentials are there. Thanks!

Great location, the thumping heart of Singapore's lively restaurant scene. 4/5 on the "check in", because you MUST get their app both to check in and you have to open the app every time, to open three doors on the way to the room. Thanks!

Es un lugar bien ubicado cerca del metro o de la parada del autobús, la cama es cómoda el baño esta muy bien, los host siempre al pendiente y nos ayudaron con nuestro equipaje, lo recomiendo ampliamente

Very clean and clam place to stay, fairly busy location in Singapore but surprisingly the room was so quite! Self check in and check out via phone was very efficient, communication is very good and can always get assistance in time.
Perfect for visiting

I stayed at the property for over 4 nights and had a very pleasant stay. The property is located at Boat Quay and two minutes walk away from restaurants and eateries. You can grab multi cuisines from restaurants near this place.

Absolutely love the location, staff and their attitude. Thank you, Heritage Collection. I hope to book this apartment whenever I visit next. :)
Неожиданно замечательное место в центре туристического района. И самое главное тихо в апартаментах. Все было очень замечательно.
excellent service at a reasonable price smack on a very happening part of Singapore.

Overall the place was convenient, well located for what was needed. Clean

Nice stay, quiet apartment in central location!

I had the pleasure to stay three nights hosted by Heritage and I was amazed by the hospitality, and amenities and great value for money. Fantastisch. Sehr saubere, gut gelegene Unterkunft. Eine Ansprechpartner waren zu freundlich, zuvorkommend und immer und überall erreichbar. Das Bett ist eine wahre Freude.  Waschmaschine und Trockner von bester Qualität. Sehr empfehlenswert.
perfect location, very helpful and fast communication with the virtual consierge desk. the room was clean and had everything we needed.

there was a water leak from the ceiling which necessitateed our moving. to Heritage credit, they responded swiftly, arranging our move to an upgraded, nearby facility. we did lose some time and cancelled planned activities, but one could not fault the nice, helpful staff.

A very pleasant stay at Heritage. The place was great. The location near MRT and the surrounding was very beautiful. The host is easy to communicate. Everything is 5 star from heritage. Will come back again soon.👍🏻👍🏻
We had a great stay at Heritage Collection. Will definitely come back here ✨🫰🏻
Responsive host, good location, value for money.

Super central location, great amenities and great communication!

Todo excelente! Pasamos espectacular, los anfitriones unos genios, se comunicaron con nosotros antes de que lleguemos para darnos instrucciones, nos guiaron en todo momento.

Yes it’s very cosy (small) but a fantastic location and very comfortable. For the price it’s great. Would stay again.

wonderful experience staying at heritage collection. The location was perfect according to my itinerary in the middle of everything.

great communication from the staff and always ready to help out. Loc was present to help me out when I had issues with my digital key and checked in to see if everything was running smoothly afterwards.

Very good and fast responding customer service, location is right away the Singapore River. Although there is a lot of bar and restaurants downstairs, it was still quiet in the room.

For me a great location, I was there for 10 days so nice to have a living space and not just a room

Great place to stay and work.

I spent a month here while doing a university internship and I couldn't recommend it more! Super easy communication with the hosts, who were very accommodating, and checkin + checkout went smoothly. Would definitely stay here again if I came back to Singapore :)

Ashton is a fantastic host, fully supporting the guests.
The place is well equipped; the furniture is new and of good quality. The view from the terrace and windows (27th floor) is amazing.
Amenities in the complex match the description - the pool is large, and the gym is also pretty good.
There are a lot of restaurants around. Due to the premium location, they are a bit pricy, But the nearest hawker centre is within a 10-minute walk, so you can "average" the cost of food. Also, the nearest supermarket that isn't overpriced (Fair Price) is within walking distance (also around 10-12 minutes).
I had to move to a different apartment, and although it is more expensive and larger, I felt a bit disappointed compared to Ashton's place.
If I were to stay in Singapore for longer again, I would book Ashton's apartment.

Lovely stay at Ashton's place, the apartment was very clean and tidy and they had a cleaning service every week. The check in process was very easy and Ashton was always very quick at responding over message.
The studio is not huge but it has everything you need and it was very comfortable.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Ashton’s apartment. Ashton was an incredible host, very responsive and left very clear instructions for check-in. The facilities are amazing and the local area is the perfectly situated along the river. The apartment was furnished with everything you need. Couldn’t recommend this place more !
Great place to stay in Singapore ?

If you are considering a stay in Singapore, I highly recommend Ashton and Claudia. My experience with them was exceptional and I truly felt at home from the moment I arrived. They were kind, attentive, and always responded within minutes, making sure I was well taken care of.
The studio was modern, spotless, and had stunning views over the city skyline. It offered great amenities such as a large pool, a relaxing jacuzzi, and a well equipped gym.
The location was excellent, within walking distance of Marina Bay, Orchard, and Chinatown, with amazing food nearby and easy access to MRT and buses.
The studio was spacious with a large bed, plentyful of storage, a proper kitchen, private bathroom, and a washing and drying machine, which felt like a real luxury.
Staying here was one of the best decisions I have ever made, and I am genuinely grateful to Ashton and Claudia for making my exchange semester to NUS such a memorable experience
It was amazing and Fiona is a great host
Central location, easy for public transport. Wonderful swimming pool, clean flat and a lovely ensuit bathroom & toilet. Groceries are nearby and an adequate hawker centre.

This room option has the queen size bed partially under a roof beam so you can't sit up right when you are in bed. Staff provided impeccable service to arrange for another room of equal value. No housekeeping service provided unless you stay a minimum of 7 days. Location is great. Lots of eateries downstairs.

It was a great stay - Listing was clean, sleek and cosy, the friendly team was very prompt and helpful with their replies, so overall a pleasant experience for me. Also the listing was more spacious than I thought! Amazing location and endless of food options within the zone. Will be back again to stay with Heritage Collection and definitely recommending to others!
在市中心，房子很新。接待的Irean非常热情，周围很便利。晚上很热闹。

location is exellent,.easy to access eveywhere. When I checked in I was afraid it was noisy but that wasn't.
The room is not big enough but acceptable.

Great location! And easy check in
Location and communication were fantastic, would highly recommend!

The room is very clean and all equipments (refrigerator, washing machine) are all very useful. The location is very great, you can walk to Fullerton and Clarke Quay without sweating. Really enjoyed our stay at Heritage. The place was superrrrr clean, easy to check into. The staff were super responsive and helpful! Thank again for hosting us!
Very nice and clean place in a good location. From my experience, the noise level was not an issue at all.

Really loved our stay here! The location can't be beat. Right in the middle of Boat Quay with lots of food and views along the boardwalk (it was still plenty quiet inside the unit). The location is perfect, and there are many restaurants right outside the door.
The hosts here are super responsive, and very welcoming.
The apartment itself is so well thought out, and has so many amenities including a washing machine which came in very useful!

地理位置很好 房间也很干净舒适

是高性价比的入住选择哦！
非常貼心準備了所有我們會需要的東西，包括好用的吹風機、洗脫烘洗衣機、洗衣粉、洗碗用品、夠大的冰箱等等，對於旅行者來說非常舒適方便，地點在熱鬧的駁船碼頭旁，有許多美食，風景漂亮，在大部分我們想去地方的中心，並且當地店面在十點後聲音減小，可以獲得寧靜的睡眠，是非常理想的住宿地點，唯一希望改進的，是住宿說明影片沒有自動翻譯字幕

This place was awesome, it had everything you needed. The location was great to get to some of the major sights in Singapore. The food choices are also abundant. The staff was also very responsive and kind.

Loc and the team were amazing.  Response time to my questions was lightening speed.  I would highly recommend this place for all the reasons one wants when traveling.  Thanks for making our staying simply outstanding.

I really enjoyed my stay at this place. It's located in the central district with windows overlooking the waterfront, which is lined with plenty of restaurants. Surprisingly, the room was very quiet, providing a peaceful retreat.
The hosts were always available and responsive, which was greatly appreciated. Additionally, having a washer and dryer in the unit made things so convenient. I would highly recommend this accommodation!
Wir hatten eine sehr gute Zeit. Sehr zentral gelegen, Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten direkt in der Nähe. Alles sehr sauber und wie beschrieben. Sehr empfehlenswert.

Can't beat the location! For the amount paid and the quality of the accommodation, we were very happy. Also, wifi was fast for those working remotely, which was a huge bonus for us. The staff was friendly and always quick to respond, and we appreciated the cleanings for a longer stay.
The only thing was that we had some trouble with check-in, after meticulously following the directions in the email - it seemed like a miscommunication between the staff onsite and the management company, but it was definitely frustrating. It was resolved quickly though!

This place was located in the center of the city, which made it perfect for walking around. Having a washer-dryer in the room was convenient for a comfortable stay. Personally, I found the loft bed to be a unique and interesting experience.
Thanks it was a great stay, great location.

This hotel is in an extremely fun location, right by a lot of restaurants with a young beer-tower hype-music feel. They set you up with a WA group with extremely clear instructions, but unfortunately they also require you to download an app, which means you need to be extra confident you are leaving the room with your phone and with enough battery. Communication from the WA group was always prompt. AC worked great. WiFi was extremely slow the first day, to the point of being unusable, but improved on the later days of the stay. Desk only has one chair so if you are a couple and want to hang out in the room (eg because it’s hot and raining outside and you want to wait out the rain), one person gets the desk and the other person either sits on the stairs or on the bed.
Good place to stay
Nice place to stay at. Definitely worth it.
I had a great stay! Someone was there to help me check in. I like the digital key feature to get inside. Had kitchen essentials, laundry detergent, and shampoo.

I loved almost everything about this place. I love that the place seems newly renovated and all appliances from the fridge to the microwave to the air-con are new and energy efficient. I love that the place is located right next to the river. I love that there are so many nice restaurants nearby; I randomly tried one (an izakaya place) and I really liked it.
A downside would be how difficult it is to check in. You need to fill out a registration form, and then download an app to unlock the three doors leading to the room. The app-based unlock doesn't work reliably so multiple tries are needed. I seriously implore the owners to reconsider the mobile app and instead issue a keycard that works reliably. Or simply use the four digit passcode all the time.
Another minor downside is that the entrance can be difficult to locate. There are large signboards on the street but the actual entrance is tiny. I missed it and had to ask around.

Ryan, loc & divina fueron muy buenos anfitriones, siempre al pendiente y con indicaciones claras.
El lugar esta muy bien ubicado y el acceso es muy facil
the place is nice , close to mrt too. really recomended
位置很棒，房间虽然小，但够用。Loc的服务到位，关键是沟通顺畅。

Thanks for reception, Ryan is so kind and friendly, location is great, there are so many restaurants near by, and it only takes me 5 minutes to get to MRT station, it’s a perfect experience!!!
Loc was great! Easy check in, very responsive, good location

Registrierung über die App war leider etwas umständlich und die Koffer mussten wir die Treppen hochschleppen. Ansonsten war die Unterkunft wie beschrieben. Klein aber fein. Das Beste ist definitiv die Lage. Alle Sehenswürdigkeiten bequem zur Fuß zu erreichen.

We really enjoy our stay. Great little place to stay. Divina, Loc & Ryan are really nice, friendly and quick to response to our questions. We would definitely stay here for future visit. Highly recommended.

Stayed in the premium loft with river view. Compact but exactly what I needed as a solo traveler. Only a short walk to MRT, great location, overlooking the river. And a street full of restaurants to pick from. Pretty smooth check-in and very responsive, helpful hosts!  I was also able to store my luggage for a few hours after check out, which was fantastic as my flight was later in the day. Thanks Davina, Loc and Ryan for a great stay :)
Clean, perfect Location. i totally recommend it. they helped us a lot with everything.

Great arrangement to store the luggage before check-in time

Facilities in good condition plus good enough for most of the needs

Very neat, modern, comfy little service apartment in a very buzzy yet touristy area in Singapore. Easy to reach and near very cool spot in town. Well connected via public transport and close to all sort of amenities. Hosts was very responsive and proactive; self check in procedure very smart but a bit laborious through the Heritage app that you need to download (after you get used to it, it's all very easy).

Our stay with Heritage in Boat Quay was absolutely incredible. The communication was beyond amazing. The staff on site, Divina, Loc & Ryan were extremely responsive. The location was great for us wanting to go out and experiencing the night life and easily traveling to the convention center.
Really convenient location and the staff were very communicative. I mostly interacted with Loc who consistently checked in to make sure I had everything I needed.

Wir hatten ein Zimmer mit Blick auf den Fluss, haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt und können die Unterkunft ohne Einschränkungen empfehlen. Das Team um Divina, Loc und Ryan war stets erreichbar, blitzschnell, proaktiv und sehr freundlich.

My husband and I enjoyed our stay. The host Ryan, Loc and Devina were quick to respond and we were pleasantly greeted when we walked into the building. The room was very clean. Had a little issue using the app and scanning in my passport but with the help of the team we worked out quickly while I was flying and everything was ready for me!
Had some issues with getting digital key but other than that everything is perfect.  Will come back.

Very responsive to all communication, easy instructions, great team Loc, Ryan, Grace and Divina.
Only comment, due to stairs, may not be suitable for an older couple.
Fab place in a great location. Bed comfy. Washing machine useful. We stayed for a short stopover. Perfect location for a couple of days.

What a gem! Place was perfect for my travels. Great location, clean, and responsive host.

Perfect for a few days in Singapore. It has everything you need, is clean and cool, and is in a brilliant location (with good noise cancelling from the bars below!)

位置优越，房间干净，服务跟进好，满意的度过一周

Great area, excellent communication and service, highly recommend!

First off Edmar and the team were excellent. I would give them a five out of five 👍. They always answered our questions really quick. This place is definitely in the middle of everything and  that made it easy to access different food options and entertainment.

Great accomodation and great hosts!
I was notified a few days before my booking started that the room I booked wasn’t not up to standard and that I was being upgraded to a different room.
The room was spacious and super clean. It featured a large bed, washing machine and kitchen. The accommodation was easy to find and check in was a breeze using the heritage app.
I was able to store my luggage on site before and after my stay to make the most of my time in Singapore. My luggage was even taken up to my room and brought back down for me!
Shannen, Divina, Mae, and Ryan were fantastic hosts. They were super responsive and helpful when I had questions and regularly checked in on my stay to ensure everything went smoothly.

I had a great 2-day stay at the Heritage Airbnb at 76 Boat Quay. The location was perfect—right by the river and close to major attractions. The room was clean, well-equipped, and check-in was smooth. It was a bit noisy at night, but overall a comfortable and convenient stay.
房间很好，隔音还是不错的，地段也很好，周围很多景点，地铁也方便。Edmar, Daphne, and Nica很热情友好，回复也很及时。

You truly can’t beat this location. Walkable to so many sites downtown. The apartment was great for two people and communication with the building was seamless. Edmar, Daphne and Nica were very helpful.

Logement très bien situé pour visiter Singapour. Marina, Chinatown, little india à quelques stations de métro. La chambre donnait sur la rue parallèle à celle animée donc pas bruyante. Le personnel accueillant et aidant. Nickel pour un premier séjour à Singapour

It was really comfortable and clean to use during my journey. If i come SIN again i will come here again🥰

Fair price for a new room within reasonable walking distance to all the major attractions in Singapore and the subway. Like others, we had a lot of challenges with our digital keys. The location is super convenient, right by the river and close to so much of what Singapore has to offer. Just a heads-up: if you’re staying over a weekend, you may hear some noise from the nearby bars — it’s part of the lively Boat Quay atmosphere. It didn’t bother me too much, but it’s something to be aware of.
That said, if you know what to expect, I think you’ll be happy here. Comfortable, well-run, and in the heart of the action.
Great place in the heart of it all. Would recommend.

The value for location was great for my short stay. The accommodations are cozy, but I didn’t need much space since I was out and about most of the time. The staff were proactive and helpful in making sure I had everything I needed and was taken care of.
Great Location, easy to get in, super responsive and proactive staff. Highly recommended
Good location on a lively street with lots of bars and restaurants nearby.

Very central location with lots of bars and night life, can be noisy and the sound proofing in the rooms isn't the best but the staff are lovely a helpful.

Nice modern condo in the bumping heart of Singapore! Even though apartment is straight above from the restaturant street, we slept very well, even my husband, who gets easilly disturbed. Bed was really comfy.

This was a fantastic place to stay. What a great location. We did like the lovely atmosphere, but with the windows closed it was peaceful and we slept well,
We loved our stay here.
Great stay right in the heart of all the action in Singapore. Great hosts. Would highly recommend.
Thank you so very much for affording me the opportunity to change my booking dates. Even though there were multiple checks that felt unattainable, you managed to eventually grant my booking change.

Very comfortable and convenient stay. The room isn’t too big but I didn’t mind. Location was honestly perfect as far as being in decent proximity to everything. If you can’t sleep with hearing some music from the outside bars then this isn’t the place for you.

Stayed here for few nights. Very nice place and easy to find. It is in a bustling and partying area so there’s lots to do around. Unlike other reviewers stated, noise from the street didn’t bother us at all but it is present.

Everything great, as described. Very small but everything you need for a night or two in Singapore. Close to subway and bus to get anywhere in the city extremely easily. Immediately walkable neighborhood is cool with some nice restaurants and bars.
Only hitch was the check-in. Singapore are very strict on short term rentals so all these places have to operate under some kind of hotel business model. This involves downloading the company's app, submitting all your passport info, etc just like checking in for a flight. And just like checking in for a flight, theapp works differently on different phones, it's buggy, it's not clear which bitsyou do at which time, and so on. Overall it ended just fine so if you need a basic, budget space with great facilities in a central location then this is hard to beat. But there are a few frictions with the check-in process. I recommend having the app downloaded and having the WiFi info saved ahead of time so that you can at least get to the building and then all you have to do is connect to the WiFi, open the app and check in. Your phone becomes your key so make sure you have a relatively modern phone with NFC/tap capabilities.

My stay at Heritage Collections in Singapore was outstanding. The host team was incredibly responsive, ensuring smooth communication throughout. Great stay, great location. Shannon & Lyla were very helpful despite the check in being fully automated. Thanks so much!
Sehr zentrale und saubere Unterkunft. Die Beschreibung hat voll und ganz zugetroffen.
nice place

The host Shannen & Lyla responded me very timely and given useful information.

Sehr zentrales Hotel und sehr sauber. Wir blieben zwei Tage hier um Singapur zu erkunden. wir hatten alles was wir brauchten. Die Crew hatte uns sogar einen frühen Check-in ermöglicht. Sehr empfehlenswert

Le logement était conforme a la description.

Nous avons globalement été content de cette chambre et recommandons !
Would stay again. Less expensive than most other places. Room looks as described. A taller person mal struggle in the shower, but okay for a couple days. Great location.
There were some minor issues with our airbnb but Shannen and Jarwin resolved it right away, great communication.
Great location easy to get around the city really helpful staff thanks so much Shannen, Grace and Kalvin

It was a nice room in a good location, small but well designed. This stay would not suit someone who isn’t a little technologically savvy, but I liked the check in process and the digital concierge. Grace and Shannen were extremely helpful and pleasant. Would 100% stay again!

The concierges were great! I primarily interacted with Shannen, but also Grace. Highly responsive. Even before my travels (12hr time difference) they responded to my inquiries within a couple of hours.
Additional services I utilized included luggage storage before check in / after check out, plus loan of a power / plug converter.

Check in was a little too much to do, too many procedures. Would be nice if there are other ways or more convenient ways instead of using an app and having to do so much the few days before check-in, and there was one time when the app didnt work and we had to uninstall then install again so that it would work again.
Also, not sure if it's the dust inside the air conditioner or if it's just because there's no window in such a small room but it makes us cough easily after a night of leaving the aircon turned on.
Otherwise, everything else is perfect.

The check in was very smooth.. they allowed us an early check in so it was really helpful for us because we got to rest after a tiring trip. The accommodation is near many restaurants and shops, and we love the vibe there. The staff are so helpful and very responsive even if we didnt meet them personally. Will probably stay here again if we go back in sg! Thank you so much heritage

Klein aber fein! Man hat alles was man braucht.

Excelente experiencia, el alojamiento era tal cual como se describió. Shannen y Andrew estuvieron muy atentos siempre, desde antes de llegar y nos ayudaron con un early check-in. Muy buena ubicación.
es tal cual se ve en las fotos. Pequeño pero perfecto para aprovechar la ciudad y llegar a descansar.

We had a fantastic stay at this property! The location is incredibly convenient, with lots of shops and eateries nearby, and it’s also close to public transport. Great stay!

The streets around this place are very vibrant but you won’t hear a thing. The room was also very clean!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden in der Unterkunft, alles war sauber und der service war super!!

great place with attentive hosts

Shannen, Andrew, and Ryan were excellent hosts that provided all the information I needed and checked on me daily. Excellent hospitality. Highly recommend this place especially for solo travelers!

Mae, Ryan, Divina and Shannen were welcoming and warm hosts. They were flexible with check ins, luggage storage and check out. Mae contacted us every day to make sure we are ok, needed any recommendations and if we needed anything. I could not fault this hotel. Great and well worth the money.

I traveled to Singapore to celebrate my birthday. We originally booked a stay at Heritage Collection Arab, but due to a door lock issue, we were smoothly relocated to their newest property—Heritage Collection on Victoria. The transfer was hassle-free, and they even covered the Grab fare for us. Looking back, I’m glad we made the switch because the Victoria property exceeded our expectations. The place was significantly more spacious than what we initially booked, and everything felt brand new. We even had our own garden area, which was perfect for enjoying morning coffee or doing daily workouts.
Throughout our stay, Anj, Divina, and Ryan were incredibly responsive and helpful. They proactively gave us clear instructions and local recommendations, making our stay even more enjoyable. The hotel is also conveniently located between two MRT stations—Bugis and Lavender—just an 8 to 10-minute walk away.
Special thanks to Shannen, who assisted us on-site during the door lock issue at Arab.
Very clean and in a great location! Anj, Divina and Ryan were a great help through our stay and very responsive. Bed was really comfy too! Highly recommend 😊

One of the best decisions I made on this trip was booking here! My stay here made my time in Singapore all the more memorable. The location is hard to beat—close to key spots in the city, but still quiet enough to relax at the end of the day.

The area around the property has everything you’d want—souvenir shops, and a solid mix of budget to mid-range restaurants and cafés. If you don’t feel like going far, a short walk around the neighborhood is already enough to enjoy.
The room was very comfortable—clean, thoughtfully designed, and a great place to come back to after a day out.
It’s everything you’d want in an Airbnb. 10/10 recommend and would definitely come back again with friends and family!

There is so much to see and do, while using this location as a base to explore the fascinating city of Singapore from the Bugis MRT which is close by.

Great place to stay for a short trip in Singapore! Might not recommend a longer trip here just because the space is quite small and doesn’t have any windows. But otherwise it’s a clean place, and is also close to all the main attractions and popular areas in the city.

I really enjoyed my time staying here. The staff members were extremely hospitable, and responsive.
The room was really nice and well maintained. The bed was comfortable and cozy. One thing to note if you stay in the loft and are a tall person, it might bit tight due to the low ceilings.
The location was quite central and I had easy access to many parts of the city, restaurants, and transit. I will definitely stay here again on my
Next trip to Singapore.
这所房子很小，但是很干净，位置也很不错，周边就是热闹的商业街，但入住晚上不是很吵，睡觉也算安静，除了旁边的清真寺诵经时候，但还好时间不长。但这里有一个问题对于中国大陆的住客不太方便，就是必须下载他们的网站才能进出楼和房间，因为手机开锁，这个网站在大陆地区无法下载，只能到新加坡才可以，下载又出现了很大问题，以至于我在门口弄了一个多小时才能进去
Buena ubicación, cerca del metro, acogedor.

I had an amazing stay here. The place was in a great location with lots of restaurants, nightlife, and convenience stores less than a minute away. The hosts helped me a lot, were very proactive, and made sure I had everything I needed. Shout out to Kalvin, Shannen, and Grace for helping me out during my entire stay. I will definitely stay here again next time I’m in Singapore.

Instruction for checking in is slightly complicated. But it’s doable as long as you read the instructions carefully. I recommend to use their app instead of the web-based checking in system because it’s slightly buggy and easy to be crashed.
Other than that, I don’t have nothing to say. This is almost perfect. Room is clean. Staffs are always responsive and kind.

Definitely a comfortable and super clean space to stay in for a few days - the location is ideal and close to many nice places
Special shoutout to Shannen and Kalvin for their support and constant attention during my stay

Un endroit chaleureux au calme avec clim bien équilibrée, dans un quartier coloré, safe où l’on trouve de tout. Très propre, il y a même un lave-linge et un sèche-linge très utiles, micro-onde, bouilloire, vaisselle…
La serrure numérique permet une arrivée autonome mais si vous avez besoin de renseignements, Shennon & Andrew répondent immédiatement avec précision et anticipent tout. Tout au long du séjour, vous avez des petits messages sympas et la déco du couloir est très sympathique ! Assurément, je reviens dans un lieu héritage ce d’autant qu’on vous offre une réduction
Excellent!  really cute little nook. Everyone was super helpful and quick to respond if I asked any questions in the online chat!

The place was exactly as listed, had everything I needed and was great walking distance and safe. I wasn’t a fan of needing to pay $200 on a separate platform to secure my  deposit but overall it turned out to be a pleasant stay!
Nice choice for me. This is the second time I choose when I visit Singapore.

The appartment is exactly as mentioned, newly done so very clean ! Great communication and reaction time from Shannen, Andrew and Jarwin, they really made the stay !
Just a little note for those that are light sleepers, you’re going to hear the adhan, and if you take showers longer than 10 minutes, the water wont be has hot.

I am a very difficult person to please and I can absolutely say that Shannen and Jarwin were Not at all bothered by my demanding nature. When I was not pleased with my first location, they immediately sought and found a more suitable domicile. I do not heap praise often, but I believe this type of commitment to customer satisfaction is very rare in the service and hospitality industry.

Location on a very touristy street, but also convenient to many metro/bus and food options nearby.
Didn’t have any issues during my stay but shout out to Andrew and Shannen for being super friendly and responsive.

Petit logement. Pas très loin de l'arrêt MRT Bugis qui permet ensuite d'aller n'importe où. Shannen, Andrew et Ryan, les ambassadeurs sont très réactifs que ce soit par message ou sur place.
Il vous faudra télécharger une application qui vous servira de clé digitale.
Chose à savoir, une caution de 200$ vous sera demandée avant votre séjour.

Excellent stay with Heritage in Singapore! The customer service from the crew was outstanding. They were very attentive and involved in making sure I had everything I needed from the very beginning of my stay. The place is small but it's understandable given how expensive and precious real estate is in Singapore. It was well equipped with everything one needs for a cozy stay. The area is vibrant and well connected to the rest of the city. I would absolutely recommend staying with Heritage when visiting Singapore

Perfect for a couple of days in Singapore.
Shoutout to Andrew and Shannen for taking care of my booking and giving me advices.
Great job guys, keep it real
交通方便，很安静
Had a sounder full couple of days here in Singapore. The staff were very quick to reply and super friendly

十分推薦！酒店內的環境十分美麗乾淨，設施齊全，房間雖然細小（如同相片中顯示一樣），但所有的設備都有，而且很乾淨！附近鄰近小印度，到MRT都只需要步行5分鐘，亦有很多巴士，很多美食！酒店保安設備十分高，是次自己一個女生來都不會感到害怕！另外，要為Cora & Shannen給一個大大的讚賞，服務態度非常好，很友善！問他們有什麼餐廳好推介，他們十分快速回應了好多選項，並且態度友善！每天都會關心住客的狀況！感謝這次旅行入住了一間很棒的酒店！

Cora and Shannen were the absolute best. They made my experience such an amazing one during my 6-day stay with them. Everything about my stay was beyond my expectations. The location was so close to everything I could ever need. Such an amazing deal. I am glad to say because of my experience at Heritage, I can’t wait to go back to SG.
Great host and lovely stay :) Thank you for your kind support!

O espaço condiz com as fotos exceto pelo tamanho, nas fotos parece ser um pouco mais amplo, mas estava limpo, cama confortável, a localização é excelente, fui a vários pontos turisticos caminhando, na rua e arredores muitas lojas e restaurantes.
Everything was perfect, Communication was great and super easy!
Good location and good staff. Got lucky and didn’t have to compete for the washer and dryer during my stay. Cool sights and good food near by. I would stay again and would recommend.
Great location and responsive communication

It was overall good stay, location, cleanliness, and the staff support was good.
A few things to note: (1) check in process was quite a hassle, I am expected to download the app of the property and that's what people seem not like (incld. me). Communication from the property keeps popping up everywhere including Airbnb, Whtsapp, and their proporter App, which sometimes was a bit too much. Some msgs appeared in only certain places so I had to skim through everything to find the necessary steps to check in. (2) The bed is located right beneath the roof, which some people might feel cosy but others with claustrophobia might not like it. When it rains, it can be quite noisy as you can hear rainfalls hitting the metal panel right above your head.

The perfect hotel for exploring the city. Centrally located with many bars, restaurants and public transportation close by. Yet surprisingly quiet at night - even by my high standards for serenity. I could hear the mosque sometimes, but it was not loud enough to wake me up. The apartment is clean and cozy and equipped with everything a traveler needs. The managers Mae, Shannen, Divina and Ryan were very responsive and friendly. I can highly recommend staying at Heritage at Arab Street.

Över förväntan!
Kommer att komma tillbaka.
Exactly as described and the support team are fantastic!
Great location, professional and excellent support.
到最近地铁站步行大约需要5分钟。房间是在四楼，有斜屋顶，不适合个子高的人群
Very convenient place and easy check in

Everything about the place is so well thought out and planned so that not even the tiniest details are not overlooked ensuring a comfortable and secure stay.  The bed and pillows were super comfortable.  The hosts were always available and communicated in real time. They have a positive and pleasant attitude.  It was small but I knew that going in and as a matter of fact I enjoyed its coziness.  Just have to watch your head around the bed if you’re over average height. Highly recommended.
Great place to stay. Great communication
Thank you will stay again

A small quaint tuckaway in the heart of little India. The location is right by a few popular restaurants and things to do, and the MRT isn’t too far of a walk away too. The concierge crew at these properties are there to help you with anything and everything, and check in with you often to ensure you are having a good time. Shoutout to Shannen, Divina, Mae, and Ryan for offering the best customer service I’ve experienced while using Airbnb.

Everything was on point, the accommodation & the location.
The communication with the stuff was perfect (thanks to Mae, Divina, Shannen and Ryan).

Mae, Ryan and Shannen were very assisting. The digital process was very smooth. Clean apartment, with all the amenities in a prime location. Thanks for upgrading my stay. Really enjoyed it! Best of luck to the team :))

Anj, Divina, and Ryan all did a nice job communicating throughout my stay. The location couldn’t be beat, given I visited during Ramadan and so close to the Sultan Mosque and a wonderful night market where I go my fill visiting wonderful food stalls.   Just a very memorable stay.
The room was clean and communication good but I have to warn you. The whole room is really really small and has not one window. You live right below the roof.

Very nice place, perfect for a short stay for one person. The space is small, but that is what I expected and it was very comfy. I was in the loft room on the fourth floor. The bed was a good size for me, but I am on the shorter side (66 cm), so if you are taller maybe request not the top loft room.
Divinia was very helpful
Very nice small place to stay for a short term

Logements propre et bien placé.
Une bonne communication avec l’hôte je recommande.
Loved staying here! Very quiet, private, clean, and easy to find. The host had excellent communication and was very friendly. Thank you for a lovely stay! 😊

I enjoyed my stay at Heritage. The location was great -- Arab street is a very happening street in Singapore. The place was clean and there were lots of good places to eat near the apartment. The internet was fast as well. All in all, it was a great experience.

Είχα μια πολύ όμορφη διανομή στο κατάλυμα! Οτιδήποτε απορία κι αν έχεις είναι πάντα εκεί για να σε βοηθήσουν! Πολύ καλή τοποθεσία επίσης κοντά σε όλα και χωρίς φόβο. Πολύ καλό για solo traveler για λίγες μέρες στη Σιγκαπούρη!
一个人短期旅行的好选择
デジタルキーの発行がスムーズに行かなかったことと、床の清掃が十分でなかった点以外は満足できる滞在でした。

I had a great stay at this hotel. The staff - Belle, Loc, Popo and Divina - were incredibly friendly and helpful, always making sure everything was perfect. The room was small but clean and comfortable.
so glad i got to stay here! its in a perfect location, easy to get around and the host was very quick to respond. absolutely recommend!

Excellent stay in central Singapore, room was as advertised, and the Heritage Collection team were responsive on comms and made everything very easy, including storing my luggage for a few hours after check out. Thank you for a great stay!

Beautifully renovated loft apartment. My bathroom was spectacularly well equipped and in pristine condition. My bed was firm and comfortable, enabling super sleep quality. The kitchen had splendid appliances. Great design meant that the loft never felt short on space. The shared laundry area was also equipped with high end appliances. The digital key mechanism feels natural after settling in.
The Heritage concept is well implemented here. The support staff were always available online within minutes to answer questions.
Great location

Great place to stay..close to transport and very clean.Only problem there was 3 of us who payed and stayed and the complimentary breakfast was only for 2 which we didn’t find out until we went .So we couldn’t leave one of us out so we didn’t go for breakfast
Location is great.  Restaurants, shops, food, transport are all right outside the door.  Apartment is spacious with all necessary facilities and secure access.
Fiona communicated the necessary information. Its location is excellent but the place needs renovation.

The place is really nice and perfect for the family. The location was also near a lot of restaurants and stores, and public transport was also very accessible. It may seem a but pricey but it still quite worth it given the location and that it's such a spacious unit.
Amazing place close to MRT. Would stay again.
Great location & clean apartment
Pleasant stay. Would definitely stay there again and everything was all walkable distance. Recommended

We stayed at APAC location at 80 Kim Yam Rd. The location is excellent, very near the river (5 minutes walk). Many great restaurants near by and also grocery store. Fort Canning MRT station is very near by (5 mins walk). Travelling anywhere in Singapore by MRT or Bus is very easy.
The apartment was little tight, but in good shape and clean. All amenities were provided including washer / drier which is essential for a longer stay. I would stay here again and recommend it to friends.
This was our second stay at Apac.  We stayed 6 weeks and loved our stay.  We will surely stay again.
This place makes you feel home. Well-secured, clean and very comfortable. If you are looking for a place to stay I recommend this place 100%
Great place to stay, close to MRT with easy access to the city and attractions
Was excellent and at good location.
A fantastic place to stay. About 6 minutes walk to Novena MRT and shopping centre.
Had a great stay here. Good location and a few minutes walk to shopping mall, MRT. Katherine and Kim response to the messages very quickly. Room was perfect, everything we needed was there.

Loved our stay!  The apartment is nice size with lots of natural light.  It's very clean has everything we needed from comfy pillows to kitchen basics.   Including a washing machine with dryer that is essential for us. Location is ideal too. The MRT is just a few minutes' walk and lots of good restaurants to choose from. Our host was super quick in responding to our many questions. The on-site manager made our stay easy, was very helpful and keeps the place very clean. We will stay again!

very clean and well organized apartment, very friendly & quick responsive staff and near to the bus station and MRT.
Worth the money and I enjoyed the stay a lot.
No doubt, I will come back.

Great location and clean space! We did have some issues with the washer/dryer. After the housekeeper told us what settings to use, we used said settings to wash and dry our clothes but when we took them out they had shrank. Also be aware that they take pictures of your passport/id to check in.
Kim was very responsive! 5 stars!

My stay was great. The apartment is clean and pretty spacious for two. Utilities all work pretty well. Onsite staff is extremely friendly and helpful - she responds to texts and calls immediately. The neighborhood is pretty quiet as well.  Highly recommend the apartment and would come back!

Everything was wonderful.  I stayed there 3 months with my 3yo and Kim the receptionist was always there to make sure we have everything we need!  She's the best. The room was very spacious, well designed - there was plenty of storage space for my 4 pieces of luggage's worth of stuff, and even then we still had space for my kid to play.  Location wise, with a 3yo walking it would take about 12-14 minutes to Novena MRT.  An adult pushing a stroller would take about 7-9 minutes. There's a very family friendly mall nearby - United Square Mall (15 min walk, no stroller) and there's also an outdoor playground next to that mall, so we ended up going there often.  The mall has a pretty good indoor playground, clinic, pharmacy, grocery store, all the amenities you would need if staying with a young kid.  All in all, I had a very comfortable and great stay and would definitely stay there again next trip!
Gracias Yiyi y todo su equipo disfrute enormemente mi estancia. Y sobre todo el amable servicio y buen trato. Todo impecable y mucha privacidad. Exactamente como las fotos y la zona muy accesible.

The pros this Airbnb are:
I Love the location. A 5-7 minute walk to restaurants and shops. Same walk to the subway (known as the MRT) station which makes the rest of Singapore easily accessible.
The cons are:
A big cockroach walked by my bed one nite.
It would have been helpful to have an Info Sheet for guests. I find it inconvenient to have to ask and wait for an answer. Eg cleaning request need to be made or there won’t be any housekeeping done, tv doesn’t have local tv channels and a code is needed to access some Netflix shows.
Guest have to take out garbage themselves, etc.
I did not see the host during my entire stay and we communicate only by texts. The cleaning lady Kathy who is super friendly checked me in on my first day.
Would I stay there again? The answer is no. I would prefer to stay in the Airbnb just next door which is better managed.

The area was perfect for me since I did not drive. The subway was only a ten minute healthy walk to get to. And from there, I was able to go to every area of Singapore.  Yiyi was most helpful. The service apartment was perfect for my two week stay. The cleaning staff was efficient and meticulous and ever so friendly. I appreciated Yiyi’s spontaneous action to my needs if and when they arouse which was rear. Thank you Yiyi and thank you Airbnb for always supplying me with fabulous places to stay every winter. Roseanna

Yiyi’s apartment was one of the best we’ve ever stayed. Everything was super clean, lots of storage for a longer term stay. Communication with Yiyi and the team on site was great. Cathy offered to clean our apartment up to three times per week, which is outstanding.
Other positive aspect worth mentioning:
- two separate air conditioning units allowing for great sleep
- fully equipped kitchen
- washing machine
- ironing board
- very quiet
- safe within gates
Would certainly recommend!!

The apartment met all my needs (location, bed type, size, amenities, wheelchair accessible).
Yiyi and team were very helpful with all my requests.
As with everything in singapore, the price is abit high but i gladly paid it as KC studios is a right fit for my needs.

We enjoyed our stay at the apartment very much! It was conveniently located near the MRT (walkable), and buses. Lots of shops and eateries as well. Kim was such a helpful and kind caretaker/host. She kept the apartment clean and stocked with drinking water. Thank you!
Perfect for a weeks stay.  About 10 minute walk to Novena MRT station, where you have access to a shopping mall and the MRT.  Only a few stops to Orchard Rd.  Really convenient.

Clean, quiet and cosy place for a long term stay. Friendly cleaners and staff that keep everything tidy. Lovely and convenient location with lots of food and amenities nearby. Thanks again for everything.

Wei was prompt in his replies and was very accommodating. The apartment was also spacious, clean and modern and well equipped and felt like home.
Location was also perfect, near Novena station and malls.

Good location walking distance 500m to Novena Square MRT & shopping mall food court etc, flexible check in, the apartment look just like the photos on listing. Two AC in apartment. Blackout curtain. High speed internet wifi at 100mbps average with good signal. Linens are change every two days. Netflix on tv included. A lot of storage space. One sofa chair to sit in room to watch tv, a dining table at kitchen area. Bathroom was good with all shampoo, bath gel and conditioner, washing machine work well with dryer built in. Small stove but we didn’t need to cook, many restaurants in the area nearby. Kim the manager can be found at anytime at working hours, she is super helpful with everything you need. Wei the owner very fast communication over the app and very accommodating with our request. Will come back again in future, if the price not going over the roof. Thanks Kim & Wei.

Room is clean. Kim is very flexible in accomodating our cleaning request. Wei's response is prompt after my booking is confirmed.
Location is good. Accessible by bus and MRT.
As it is facing a main road n near a hospital, noise of cars n ambulance sometime can be heard even at wee hours.

Apartment is new, well maintained and spotlessly clean. Gated compound and sheltered parking.
Excellent location with easy access to CTE or PIE. Just short walk to Novena/Velocity or Pek Kio Market.
Love the stay !!
Thanks to Kim for his good care and smile every day, all was perfect
Wei is easy to contact. Kim also very helpful. 5 mins to bus stop. 10mins to mrt and velocity square. Tons of food and close to top hospitals
Cozy and warm apartment. I recommend it to anyone who wants to stay there.

Wei is very reponsive to questions and very helpful.
Place is clean and nice, good location. Have buses to town, train station is walking distance. Have few shopping malls nearby too. Many food options. Quiet environment.

Located in a very strategic location with many eateries accessible just within 5 mins drive or 15 mins walk.
Great place to be in
Wei is a great host, and the place is perfect for people coming to the city. There's a bus and metro connectivity nearby which runs throughout the city.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Wei’s apartment. Initially we booked this apartment, but he upgraded us (free of charge) to Deluxe one bedroom with a bathtub. The communication was great and the property manager (Cathy) is an amazing host.
About the apartment: it has everything you could possibly need for an enjoyable stay. It is very spacious (much bigger than we thought it would be based on the photos), clean, and well-equipped. It is in a nice and quiet area, but still very close to multiple bus stations and a metro stop.
Hope to stay here again some time soon, thank you for this very positive experience!
Stayed here for a month and was a great location, short walk to nearest MRT station. Place was spacious and clean. Regular housekeeping service as well. Would recommend and stay again. Thank you.

It had a very good time there. The only two things that were a bit unpleasant were the noise in the morning because it is close to the road and that there is not a lot of natural light source in the room. I still had a very good time.
Everything went smoothly,  no problems and was very comfortable. easy to walk to Novena or United Square for shopping and food
Great stay, thank you Katherine!
Great location - walking distance to novena square. Everything is tidy and clean. Host and staff were friendly and thoughtful.

Had a great experience at Katherine’s place, she was super responsive throughout the whole stay and leading up to it. There were also very attentive and nice on-site staff to help with anything you need.
The place itself has great air conditioning, is very clean, and is in a good location near Novena. Would definitely stay here again next time we visit!

We had our solemnisation in Moulmein Studios and had a pleasant stay during our stay. She’s accommodating and answers all our queries with prompt response. And Kim was really helpful to us. We will definitely book here again.
Apart clean and location near to novena square

Kat is amazing!

As our family has lived in Singapore for about seven years, coming back to this city is like coming back to our second home. We are very grateful that Kat from the beginning was very warm to answer and accommodate all our queries. Even when there's some problem with our booking, Kat continued to make sure we got what we needed. She even upgraded our unit! Wow. It was a superb experience.
The apartment is very comfortable. It's very close to Novena MRT and several bus stops which makes it easy to travel anywhere.
The unit itself is equipped with high quality equipment and home furnishings that make it very comfortable. All the amenities available (tv, refrigerator, microwave, washing machine, cutlery, bed linen, towels, even toilet paper) were prepared with an excellent touch. Simply put, this place provides everything you need for a comfortable stay.
My wife is a very clean person. Yet she had absolutely no complaints from day one until we left this place.
Highly recommended.
Definitely will come back here again.
Great location. Apartment was clean and new

The place is super lovely, and there were no problem at all during our stay. All the staff there were super nice and the place itself was very spacious and clean. Really recommend this for anyone planning to stay in Singapore.

Enjoyed my stay here! Loved that it had all the amenities for a comfortable stay and was super convenient too with only a few minutes walk to the mrt and also shops! Hope to come back the next time I’m in Sg :)
All was accurate, very confortable, thank you Katherine!!!
The 2 months was incredible, the location is great, and the housekeeper Kim was very efficient and helpful. All amenities you could need and close to shops. Highly recommended

The place was good and overall I’m happy with my stay. The only downside is the building is beside a quite busy road and the windows’ noise isolation is not too good, therefore one would hear the noise of cars passing by, especially at night. There was also an isolated incident at one of the units upstairs was a bit worrysome but that was because of the specific tenant.
great place
really love it!

Katherine is a perfect host, the apartment had everything we needed, the transport system is great in the neighborhood with bus and train within easy walking distance. Terrific stay! thankyou Katherine.

Great and super clean apartment in a good location, easy access to many busses and the MRT. Has everything one needs for a stay with the kitchen, the washing machine and the additional servicing. Air conditioning works great as well.

Kim was a wonderful hostess.  She checked with us often if we needed anything.  The apartment was extremely clean and in a great location, close to the MRT (subway), close to supermarket and shopping mall with multiple restaurants.

The apartment was very clean and tidy and provided all the amenities we wanted. The cleaner was lovely.
The location was perfect for catching buses and the MRT. We would recommend staying here :)
Nice stay, good locationa
The housekeeper aunty was very nice and friendly, took us inside and described very clearly.

Excellent apartment and excellent friendly hosting. It is a 10 minute walk from the nearest mrt which in the Singapore heat and himidity will leave you sweaty. However, there is a bus stop just 2 -3 minutes walk. Google Maps works very well in Singapore so using buses is straightforward. It is easy to get to Orchard Road and other central attractions. The local malls (10/15 min. walk) are well supplied with food establishments of all sorts so finding a meal is not a problem.
Functional, clean and practical apartment. Very friendly concierge !

From the studio it's easy to get to most of the attractions in Singapore . There is a twin bed in the bedroom and the host arranged an extra fold-out bed which is really helpful because it's not easy to find a hotel room in Singapore for 3 ppl to share.The fold-out bed could be a bit uncomfortable if you are more used to mattress. We are grateful that the studio provided us sufficient bottled water in the room.
This is a very good and calm place. Very close to Novena MRT and just 50m to a bus stop which you can easily visit many places including Orchard and Marina.
Clean, comfortable. MRT and shopping centre just 8-10mins easy walk. Cathy was lovely, friendly, helpful and responsive. Overall, a very good stay.

Es war eine angenehme Unterkunft, super eine Waschmaschine/Trockner zu haben.
Für die Küche muss man Gewürze/Öl usw selber mitbringen. Es gibt Toaster und Reiskocher.
Man bekommt immer wieder alles aufgefrischt wie bspw Trinkwasserflaschen.
Die Wohnung konnte man gut klimatisieren.
Geschäfte sind weiter weg und man muss zum Bahnhof laufen. Man kann aber super Taxis dorthin bestellen und dort auch selber parken. Auch genug Fahrräder in der Nähe. Ein netter Fuß-/Radweg ist möglich,
Zu der nach einer Weile zu little India führt.
Great location

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The place was exceptionally neat and peaceful, providing the perfect environment for relaxation. The location was incredibly convenient, with an MRT station, bus stop, and a Shell Select store just a short walk away, making it easy to get around and grab essentials.
A special thanks to Cathy for her quick responses and for ensuring everything was perfect during my stay. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

This is my second stay, and I am sure I will stay again whenever I travel to SG.
Convenient location, spacious room with fully equipped amenities, clean room and nice service.
How can I ask more?? You will not find such this place from any hotel or other Airbnb place. Thank you for hosting me and helping me during Lunar New Year period. I feel like Katherine 's place is now my home in SG, I hope I can come back soon!

Had a wonderful stay. Katherine and Cathy were very responsive and helpful
Location was great, walkable to Novena MRT and, shopping malls with lots of eateries and supermarkets.
The only compliant I had was the bed was a little hard. But the apartments was clean and laundry machine was very helpful for a 15 day stay. The kitchen was great for making coffees and teas and warming or cooking foods.
Highly recommend. Thank you Katherine.
对于睡眠不好的人并不足够友好。在周边医院的主干马路边上,厚厚的窗帘也挡不住疾驶的大小车辆，尤其是刺耳的摩托车发出的声音。
Quiet apartment and the lady cleaner is friendly and polite!

Nice safe condo. Katherine was a great host who always replies quickly with helpful information. Room was clean and had good wifi. Nice working double A/C unit. Quiet on the inside and outside. Right near multiple key bus stops. A great place to stay in singapore
Good to have à location near Novena. Very easy to access.
lovely place , host was very accomidation , would absolutly come back

Thai is my third stay, and I am determined to stay here whenever come back to Singapore.
Easy access to MRT station/ bus stop, various types of amenities, and nice Host and listing manager.
This is my home in SG, and I’ll definitely come back whenever I stay SG.
Thank you for having me and hosting as always!

Great place to stay if you are looking for cozy, simple and centrally located. As i was told over and over, everything in Singapore is 20 minutes away. At this place, you are a hop, skip and jump from some really good eating! Carms, Mary, and Maica made my short stay very comfortable. This Airbnb was in a great location with restaurants and shopping right outside the front door. I appreciate their easy instructions and the fact they were always responsive very quickly. I would definitely stay here again.

Absolutely loved my stay here! A gem of a stay. Highly recommended for anyone who values thoughtful design and TRULY STELLAR service.
Absolutely happy with our stay! The hosts were very hospitable and easy to contact. Will definitely stay here or at another one of their locations when I go back to Singapore!!

really good and convenient place, nice and friendly stuff and easy check in

Perfect place to explore Singapore, right outside the Chinatown MRT!

Lastly- Mary and Ken were amazing!! They bent over backwards for us and were really the cherry on top. Kind, helpful and pleasant to deal with- BOOK NOW :) you won’t find better at this price!
Great place to stay, Mary was a super duper host. Friendly and helpful.

Thank you for the hospitality, i strongly recommended if you have a couple trip to see others side of singapore..

Liked the chat to communicate with the staff, very efficient customer service. will stay there again.

Alex, Mary, and Maica were great hosts. The location is great, right off off the Chinatown MRT station, plenty of shops and food nearby. The stairs in the room were a little intimidating at first but you’ll get used to them quickly. Special thanks to Alex, he was really helpful.

Our stay at Heritage Collection was disappointing.
The room was much smaller than advertised, making it impossible to fully open our luggage.
Despite listed amenities, there were no on-site laundry facilities, and we were directed to use another property's services—an inconvenient solution.
Hot water was severely limited, allowing only for brief showers before running cold due to a small water tank.
Access to the property was challenging, with numerous steps and a distance from the roadside, complicating luggage transport.
After raising these issues, our request for a refund was denied, and the alternative accommodation offered was unsatisfactory and still plagued by hot water issues.
Additionally, a maintenance person entered our room without prior notice, violating our privacy.
The property failed to meet basic hospitality standards, resulting in a stressful experience that fell short of our expectations.
We cannot recommend Heritage Collection.
Very optimal stay, was right in the middle of Chinatown and in front of Chinatown station, so the perfect place to explore Singapore. Will come back again and recommend to others! :)

Very convenient location right outside Chinatown MRT. Maica, Mary and Nina have been very helpful!

has an absolutely great time in the apartment,  great location the food market over the pedestrian bridge is fantastic.

Very cool hotel room! Easy to reach from the airport, take the green line from the airport, 1st stop “expo” then go to the blue line and get off at stop 19 “chinatown”. This place was a wonderful place to stay and right in the middle of a lot of areas that have good food! Yani and the team did a wonderful job keeping up with updates and making sure the hospitality was on point. Good place for a good price

Die Unterkunft ist mitten in Chinatown in der Straße 'Pagoda St.', von dort kann man zu Fuß vieles entdecken und die Metro (blau & violette) ist auch in unmittelbarer Nähe zu Fuß.

Great place Middle of Chinatown. 10 metres from Train exit. Clean and responsive host, steep access stairs but no surprises. Make sure to follow all electronic check in instructions prior to arriving. Would stay there again

I had a wonderful time in this place, the location is ideal if you want to leave the Chinatown life fully. The staff was super friendly and make my stay even better. I’ll be back next time I visit Singapore.

Top-notch service! Staff are all really helpful and keen to make you feel right at home and comfortable. Superbly impressed by the fast response times despite the lack of a concierge. There are no lifts so you have to carry your luggage up and down a flight of stairs. Not an issue, just be mindful if you have mobility challenges or are travelling with a heavy suitcase. Value for money though! It’s right in front of Chinatown MRT and very accessible to most places in Singapore
ideally located next to train station and shops

The stay at Heritage has been great everything was perfect, I particularly was impressed by Shannen, the host lady who  voluntarily helped with setting e-keys and luggage, thumbs up for this proactive cheerful young lady, definitely an asset for Heritage! 👍

Fijn en gemakkelijk verblijf gehad in het Heritage Hotel op Pagoda Street. Ligt midden in China town, voor degenen die van lekker eten houden zijn er een aantal geweldige Hawker Centres in de buurt. Deze zijn allemaal op +-5 min lopen.
Ook de hosts in het Hotel zijn vriendelijk en behulpzaam, de online service desk is 24/7 bereikbaar als je hulp nodig hebt. Bedankt voor het fijne verblijf!

The hotel room was very clean, and the staff were extremely kind and helpful. We needed to leave our luggage before check-in, and they assisted us without any problem. The location is perfect. Right on Pagoda Street, with a metro station just next to it. A big thank you to Yani, Mary, and Shannen for making our stay such a wonderful experience!

Perfectly located in a pedestrian mall in downtown Chinatown, double-glazed windows PLUS a window shutter prevented any street noise entering, and I am a very light sleeper. I did however on one of my 3 nights hear the neighbours in next room laughing, so shared wall insulation not perfect. If you are interested in clever use of small spaces, this place is perfect. If you are fat or have a beer gut, lose it, cos the shower cubicle with inward turning screen door, is size of a phone booth. Excellent hot water pressure. It is also extremely clean, and well-equipped, you can ask for an iron, cooking apparatus. Has 2 very quiet air-conditioning units. Help was available using the app which malfunctioned due to the Android version I have, otherwise it’s super easy to use once the concierge came and fixed problem in seconds. 41 stairs to loft level, a nice shared terrace, highly recommend the Monster ‘free’ Chinatown walk (pamphlet in lobby). Easy to get to from Changi Airport. Loved it!

Great location, close to MRT and very walkable. Room was exceptionally clean. Not pictured but the room does have a tv hung across the bed.
A few other guests have already mentioned, the only issue that stood out during our stay was the check in process. It’s required to download the app for the initial verification, you submit your documents and they approve those within a few working hours. The issue came when we arrived at the stay before 3pm, the next step within the app is available only after 3pm, you need to take a selfie and verify some other details, host then needs to approve again. The process is very lengthy. The code to enter ended up not working and the app kept erroring out. It was unfortunate, having to wait outside the hotel for about 25 minutes to get everything figured out, otherwise this would have been a perfect stay. Aside from this, we enjoyed our stay, just need to be aware of the check in process.
Perfect and very nice even if we booked very last minute
great spot right in the heart of chinatown!

Very responsive host, the place is small but it’s walkable to few hawker centers within few mins. I’m grateful for the customer service that saved me ton of headaches.
Nice place!

the space was very minimalistic which we love. A tad on the narrow side, making my claustrophobia a bit squeamish. However, at 4am I messaged the concierge and within minutes they had called them and asked them to be quiet and they made the issue way better. The communication was immediate and helpful. Very sweet interaction with Shannon at the end to help us check out and take our luggage out. (Loud guests are not their fault and I so appreciated their with problem solving). All in all, great place, great location, as mentioned in the ad a lot of stairs to be conscious of, but other than that a great place to stay in Singapore if you want to be in the middle of it all

This is my second stay here, and once again it was an excellent experience. The host was very helpfull even before you arrive. The quality provided is consistently top-notch. CON's: Host did not mention heavy construction going on, view is no longer as in pictures - there are now two new tall buildings and a pool with kids' playground area in front of the window (no more full privacy), open-air condo (cannot close balcony anymore as there is no door because host squeezed in additional room and used half of the balcony for this - now there is no aircon in half of the condo), no normal doorbell (intercom linked to host's phone means you cannot receive a package whenever she is unavailable), one of the two tenants screams while playing computer games all day every day till late night (up to 4am). I'm also not a fan of that retrofit maisonette construction in the room, with steep stairs, a mere mattress on the floor, no ability to stand where you sleep. The hotel is located in Chinatown and near chinatown metro station. it was easy to get to the hotel by the train. The hotel is completely renovated and everything is new and modern. (the design kind of reminds of a hotel room at Helsinki). I was asked for a deposit (104 singaporian dollars) that I paid in euros and I got reimbursed when I left this morning. There are many many restaurants in nearby but still it was not noisy and I could sleep comfortably. I also visited several temples in the area. Little India area is also not far from the hotel. Maxwell metro was about 10 min away and I took it to visit Botanical garden and Orchid garden. Everyone at the hotel were friendly (I asked many questions). I was given some info about where to buy water, sim cards, etc. great value for money!

The hotel is very close to Chinatown St! It was really convenient to go everywhere. The room is exactly same as described. It’s not big room, but we’ll organized. Definitely i will stay again next time.

Perfect place to stay with family. Assembly place gives what I need, you can save your money for food coz  you can cook by your self here. The perfect stay at SG
We stayed here for three weeks. The studio is perfect for two people, with a kitchen and washer in the unit.
