Kim is the best host!

There was some type of communication breakdown with the host maybe not being the AirBnB account holder for the listing.
Communication only happened through WA and at the in-person front desk onsite; and I received no responses to the messages and requests I sent through AirBnB.
I needed to check out earlier than originally booked, and tried to arrange this through AirBnB, but my host sent messages through WA like "I haven't heard anything from AirBnB yet . . ." and generally acted as though AirBnB was another party to the transaction who was the barrier to my receiving a partial refund instead of a facilitating software platform for the host.
Additionally, the bathroom was dirty when I arrived with hair stuck to the walls of the shower, and the unit had a foul odor that persisted throughout my stay.
The unit was described as a "suite" in the listing, but it was a single room with much less space than the pictures for the listing suggested.
The location was very good for access to local transport, the staff was excellent and overall the unit met all my expectations.
Very Good place near bus stop and MRT station. One stop away from Newton food hawker! Place is really clean! Will definitely come back!

The unit was as described in the listing and is located in a quite neighborhood. The place is 8 mins walk to Stevens MRT station and just 4 mins walk to Bus Stop where you can get buses to Orchard Road. We received housekeeping twice during our 7 day stay. The unit has AC, refrigerator, cooktop, microwave, and a washing/dryer appliance.Kim was quite responsive to our enquiries and provided us clear instructions for self check-in.

Would love to stay here again if we visit Singapore in future.

We really enjoyed and loved our stay. The apartment was fabulous - top quality queen size bed, very neat and easily accessible by the MRT. There is a beautiful swimming pool for lap swimming. The apartment was serviced once during our eight days stay. The staff were very friendly.
Small issues were. Contacting the host beforehand was difficult for check in instructions and we had to do it through AirBnb. After check in we had to ask for some missing cutlery like spoons, forks and glasses not supplied. We had to buy our own plastic wine glasses, tea towels, dish cloth and cutting board to prepare food, as none of these are supplied.
This was a first for an Airbnb as one assumes this to be normal.
We would very highly recommend this place.

The bed was extremely comfortable and everything was clean and as expected. We tried to contact them before our visit but unfortunately they didn’t reply. Overall though, it was easy to find, easy access to the MRT and close to other stations that were busy and vibrant. Despite being so central, it was very quiet, so sleeping was great! Would recommend.

Central location and neighborhood felt very safe. Room was clean and recently renovated, kitchenette was a bit small but effective for our needs. Great experience overall, would stay again.

Do not book this place. I would give 0 stars if we could. This place is unsafe to stay in with mould in the air conditioning unit. Windows that don’t close. Unexplained stains in the cupboard and hairs in the cutlery drawer. It has tried to disguise itself with photos across multiple rooms or a ‘show room’. Look at booking. com reviews and Google reviews for further evidence.
Our room was fine but the building was terrible. Not worth its price

Great serviced apartment….. staff could not have been more helpful…..home from home …services from the hotel were great. Buggy service to the apartments was a godsend in the rain. Two pools to choose from and a gym, several in house restaurants - the Chinese one was really good - and only a short walk to the MTR at Orchard to get anywhere. The apartment made the holiday easy and memorable …. would definitely return.
非常便利！

The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed. The River Walk neighborhood was great for walks and restaurants. The staff at the building were very friendly and helpful . I would definitely rent it again. Easy to get mail forwarded to the apartment, like FedEx or DHL

Great place for a short stay in Singapore. The manager Kim Lee is amazing and helpful. Great and quiet location with easy access to the metro. When I am back to Singapore, I will definitely stay there again.

Very nice and luxury apartment, the host was also very helpful and nice. I do recommend renting this place when in Singapore 😄

The bedroom is very inconvenient. The bed was pushed against the far wall. The head against another wall. To get into bed, one person has to climb over to the far side. The foot of the bed is 20-40cm from the wall. To get out of bed, one person has to either climb over the other person or carefully walk sideways, crabwise by the side and foot of the bed.
We were able to pushed the bed away from this far wall by about 40cm. But there is no side table on this side. Luckily we had a cardboard box to use.
The kitchen utensils are inadequate. There is no dish cloth/tea towel, no tissue box (suggest bring your own). There are exactly two cups, two plates each of 2 or 3 sizes, one drinking glass. It was hard to wipe the table top and areas around the kitchen sink with no tissue or tea towel (suggest, bring your own).
Likewise the bathroom does not provide small face towels to wipe down the washbasin. Will not stay here again.

- I sent a request to change reservation dates, and the host took more than 24h to read it (by which time the request has timed out)
- Some basic common sense amenities were missing: for example any kind of dishwashing liquid, or detergent for the washing machine. We ended up buying our own
- The neighbourhood, although very quiet and peaceful, is all just residences. There are no food courts nearby, and even the shops are few and far between. Fortunately there is a bus station as well as MRT station nearby, so it's not a big problem.
Overall, a pleasant place to stay, and a good deal considering the price - just maybe not a full 5 star experience

Great stay in a fantastic location. 5 minutes away from both the bus stop and the MRT. The lady at the reception, Ms Kim, was friendly and very helpful in terms of directions and local recommendations.
In terms of the apartment itself, iron, hair dryer, fresh towels were available at the apartment we stayed in, although not listed in amenities. The house-keeping was done twice a week.
Also note: bring tea, coffee, sugar, any and all ingredients if you plan to cook. The kitchen does not have anything except utensils. The nearest supermarket is 3 bus stops away. The 7-Elevens here do not have milk.
We ate all meals outside, but it would have been good to have a dish-washing soap, scrub and kitchen towels for the coffee/tea mugs. The dish-washing items were promptly provided on request by Ms Kim. Like I said, she was very helpful.
All in all, we had a lovely time, and would definitely love to stay here again.

Our 2 bedroom apartment (each with an attached bathroon) was very convenient to use for our family of 3.  It was quite spacious, so our 17-day stay passed very comforatble.  Good kitchen, though it should have had more cups.  The washer-dryer + iron were very useful.  The manageress Mrs Kim Lee was always very helpful.
Good value & location.
Very convenient, big, well located. it's maybe not the most beautiful apartment ever, but it's a very good value for Singapore. The kitchen could be better equipped.
Great spot to stay, plenty of room. Two bathrooms and a small kitchen. 5 minute walk to Stevens MRT. 2 minute walk to bus stop. Great value for money.

Excellent place to stay in Singapore. Just a 5-minute walk from the MRT station, which is only a few stops from Orchard Road. Place was clean, spacious, comfortable. Will be staying here again next time I'm in town.

Had a great week-long stay visiting Singapore! The apartment is close to the metro as well as a few good restaurants and just a mile walk from the botanic gardens which we loved. Apartment was very clean and matched the pictures and the host was responsive to our needs

2nd stay at this location, but 1st time under new Management.
Standard of cleaning has dropped significantly. We found a plastic water bottle & used vape container stuffed between sofa cushions - not good when you have an inquisitive 21 month old. We had to request to have tile floors mopped, as cleaner advised “it is not part of the standard rooming cleaning”.
General condition & upkeep of unit is poor - stains on sofa, old carpets that need to be steam cleaned & some furniture items coming apart.
New management do not provide any kitchen cleaning items - tea towels, wash clothes or dishwash liquid. Appears that a lot of what should be ‘standard’ items are now only available on request, such as a toaster.
Com certeza um lugar excelente, bonito, calmo, perto de tudo. Na próxima vez pretendo ficar novamente.
Quiet  peaceful place to stay. Nice neighbourhood to walk around. Restaurants and cafes within walking distance
Great place for a family, very peaceful location with easy access to Stevens MRT. The apartment was very spacious, and provided all the basics to cook and watch TV

The location was very convenient which I was aware already as I almost grew up in Singapore. BUT the apartment shown in the pictures was not provided to us neither was I informed.. it was very dirty upon my arrival, flees everywhere, dusty beds, hair in washroom and thick layers of dust in washrooms. Attleast 20 larvas were hanging just in one bedroom roof..
Three cups, three glasses, three plates, three cereal bowls n even the same number of cutlery was provided as we had mentioned three number of guests arriving.
Only one wok which was all scratched from inside was given to cook.. NOTHING ELSE!!!
Servicing apartment facility was provided but just once in our 18 days stay.. and no cleaning equipments were present in the listing so that atleast we could do it ourselves..
Over all I wasn't happy to stay in such a place and honestly it was shocking too.
I have taken photos of everything as I received it.

Positives: Comfortable beds, quiet location help make up for shabby decor.
Negatives: Apartment booked for a week for 3 people contained only 2 spoons (0 teaspoons), and no way to clean dishes properly (no plug, detergent, sponge, teatowel). No-one at reception the entire week we were there. No-one answers the phone number after hours. This was a problem when other guests arrived and couldn't access their room late at night (they rang our doorbell at 11pm to see if we could help) and when the fire alarm went off one evening.
Useful to know: Obtain hot water for shower by turning on switch outside bathroom door which looks like another light switch. Seafood restaurant next door at the YMCA is very good.
방 2개(방 하나는 커다란 킹 사이즈 침대, 또 다른 방은 싱글 침대)와 거실, 조그만 주방이 있습니다. 각 방 마다 샤워룸이 있고, 화장실은 3개, 냉장고, 세탁기 비치되어 있습니다. 다소 시설이 노후화되었고, 타월을 자주 갈아주지 않아 불편했지만 가격대비 매우 훌륭한 숙소입니다. 3인 가족이 편하게 이용했습니다. 다음에 다시 이용할 의향이 있습니다.
excellent location
this place is very pleasant,  close to the mrt, I will come back here again
The host was slow to respond before our arrival. The promised key card was not available and we could not get into the apartment. We could not reach the host at the day of our arrival.

When we saw our room it was not the room we booked. We booked 2 rooms, 1 king and 1 single bed. We were taken to 2 bedrooms with double beds. And it was a terribly old and run down apartment. The bathrooms looked like what you would expect in jail. I told the person this was not what we booked, he checked and did move us. Our room was better but very weathered. The couch had lots of stains. Luckily I had read some reviews about the age of these rooms and brought extra sheets which we used to cover the couch so we could sit on it.
The kitchen is stocked but does not come with dish towels or dish soap. Which made me wonder how the dishes got cleaned before they were put away! Definitely bring or buy dish soap and cleaning supplies. I did a full clean and wipe down before we unpacked. Lots of dust on counters and around the bed. The doors of the bathroom were filthy.
The beds were comfortable and sheets on single bed were clean. The king bed you could see some stains under the sheets.

Read other reviews for more accurate description and "how to's" for this listing.
Cons: No essentials for cleaning dishes- it'd behoove the host to provide these, along with a vacuum, so guests can maintain unit and checkout cleaning is easier. Only one bathtowel was provided for each guest, no handtowels or facecloths. Carpet needed vacuuming really bad, and no vacuum provided. no response from host about this.
Pros:
Spacious 2bdrm 3 bath apartment in a quiet neighborhood near public transportation, perfect for our group of 3 attending a convention in the area. Comfy clean beds and pillows, washer/dryer combo ( YouTube videos show how to clean filter and operate machine- bring uour own laundry soap); nice pool- altho we didn't have time to use, YMCA next door. Air conditioner worked great. Enough dishes and cups for our use. markets close by or off the MRT.
Great place for a family visiting Singapore

The location of the unit is good with easy access to public transportation.  However, the unit itself was old, needed maintenance to remove the mold and pest that were present.  The host is slow to respond, sometimes even slower than the response times they post.

This could be such a great place, but needs some tender loving care on maintenance. I repaired some items that were not responded to, while others were attended to. Open hallway access covered in bugs frequently, but only swept weekly, but only if I pointed out the fact the had not been swept. This needs daily, not weekly. Insufficient towels provided (one per week is not sufficient for this climate.) The is to provision for simple dishwashing supplies. Luckily I had a family member near by that provided simple supplies that should have been provide. Some maintenance things were responded to, others I fixed with tools from my son's home. Furniture needs replacement and provision of adequate table chairs.  This could be a really great place, but it is being neglected. Be cautious as refrigerator is on raised ledge and not secured. Luckily I just happened to be walking towards it when it fell over and was able to catch it a push it back in place. Convenient to MRT and Bus stop.

We stayed here because it was practical for our size group
however it was lacking many things like cleaning supplies the unit had a smell and it had mould and damages that had been patched up there was a tin can collecting water in a cupboard there was no place to put rubbish and no one cleaning even though it said serviced apartment there was not enough plates bowls that sort of thing
The pool was ok but not suitable to use all the time as it is often to cold use and that is saying something in Singapore.

Great place to stay. Great host. Will be back again.

We stayed for a month, paying SGD 10,800. The price wasn't cheap.There was no reception when we checked in, and we encountered many issues but couldn't contact the landlord because the phone number was invalid.
1. At the beginning, the fire alarm kept sounding without any response or measures. We couldn't reach the landlord and had to seek help from security in the neighboring building, which was very dangerous.
2. The microwave kept sparking when used, and it took three replacements before we could use it properly after reporting the issue.
3. Initially, there was no hot water, and despite reporting it, we were told there was no problem. It was only after asking neighboring tenants that we found out we needed to switch on the outside switch near the toilet for hot water.

My family were visiting Singapore on holiday for a week. We wanted a self contained apartment so we could cook light meals and do laundry. We booked this apartment as it was close to the city and in our price range.
Pros - The apartment was quite large and each room had its own onsuite bathroom. The apartment is also only 2 mins walk to Stevens MRT.
Cons - The apartment belongs to the neighbouring YMCA builing and is very dated and had marks on all walls from wear and tear. The ceilings in 70% of the apartment had water danage/ stains or mould. The kitchen had no toaster/ kettle or washing up equipment. It looks like the ower has bought and done no maintence.
We spoke to the host and they brought us a toaster, kettle and rubbish bags. They also came to inspect and patch the ceilings in the bathrooms.
I believe this building is scheduled for redevelopment, so they are just renting as is till it's torn down.
It's okay place if you don't mind it looking a bit shabby and dated.
离地铁站二百多米，步行很方便，入住便捷全程自助，房间比较老旧，房东回复消息太慢，询问能否寄存行李在前台，不给回复

An excellent stay. Everything was taken care of, and if you had any questions, you could always turn to Mark. Very nice people I'm glad to have met.
The apartment it's small but functional. It's located near of a small shopping where you can find everything, and the best is that there is a subway station where you can get to anywhere quickly.

Wonderful and spacious room within Oasia, shares hotel facilities.

Mary is a very helpful and excellent host. She responds quickly and politely to messages and always made me feel at ease during my stay. She made my trip very comfortable.
The accommodation is within walking distance of the RWS. Of course, the monorail is also convenient. There are many Grab cars near the hotel, so we rarely had to wait to go out to the City.

Me and my family loved the hotel and the location.

Nice

exactly as promoted, clean , safe close to everything as well as the public transit system. I'd recommend it.

the place is very accessible to the Bugis Street where its only a walking distance from the place. surrounded by restaurant as well.

Leider kleiner als auf den Fotos. Kein Dampabzug in der Dusche oder Fenster, das Zimmer trocknet gefühlt nie.

Wir haben nicht viel erwartet aber wurden trotzdem enttäuscht, es war viel klein als gedacht. Die Dusche konnte man nicht richtig benutzen ohne alles nass zu machen.

The room was bigger than I expected from the pictures, it was very easy to access with the phone key method and very easy to access. Ich schreibe sehr selten Bewertungen, aber hier war es mir wichtig!

The room was much smaller than expected, and the toilet and shower were in a tiny wet room inside the bedroom, separated only by a thin wall rather than being a proper en-suite. There were no windows, and the room had a damp, musky smell. I also noticed stains on the bedsheets.
Overall, it was okay but not great, and quite expensive for what you get.
it was a nice t stay and very convenient- near lots of food spots and there was 24/7 host help available. The place is a bit crammed, but it cannot be helped :) we booked a small room.

We did try to sleep in one morning, but there was construction noise in the building starting around 8 a.m., which made it difficult. Not the host’s fault, but something to be aware of.
All in all, it served its purpose for a short stay, and the location was convenient for getting around.

总体感觉：位置绝佳空间宽敞，细节提升后体验会更棒。
我在爱彼迎上有多次租整栋房源的经验，地点包括荷兰、西班牙、法国、美国、日本等国家。这次在新加坡东海岸附近的别墅小区入住，是我在爱彼迎上第一次与房东同住一个屋檐下。女房东亲自在房屋里迎接我们入住，并详细讲解了门禁、电器等设施的使用，也说她重视我们的意见，希望我们有一个好的入住体验，这点让我们安心。 有一天早上我的孩子因起床时发生流鼻血，滴了血迹在床单上，女房东马上安排佣人取走床单去处理，并更换新床单，也没要求我们赔偿，这些非常感谢。房源有不少亮点，也有需要改进的地方。
优点：
· 地理位置超棒： 步行5分钟到地铁站， 10 分钟左右到公交车站，出行很方便。房屋位于高档住宅区，环境干净优美，车辆不吵杂，晚上安静有安全感。附近走路 15 分钟就到公共泳池，离海边也不远。
· 空间宽敞舒适： 我们住的三楼区域，包括卫生间在内超过20平方米，在新加坡算是比较大了。房间里可打开两张1.5米长的沙发床，住着不压抑。
需要留意的地方：
因为是合住，房屋三层之间的声音是互通的。早上6：30左右，房东一家起床在客厅活动的声音对睡眠有影响；由于新加坡白天气温比较高，我们晚上游览户外景点，通常22～23点之间回到房屋，之后看电视或聊天，也不确定是否影响到他们。
入住期间反馈问题时，女房东响应很及时，这点非常感谢。但她常会解释很多原因，主要是佣人新来上班不熟悉物品放置位置及房屋布置标准，所以达不到预期，改进后也比较强调他们付出的努力。作为房客，我的感受是，房费本应换来相应的舒适度，过多的解释反而让人不太自在。
设施方面：
我们住的三楼区域基础用品比较简陋。比较满意的是有冰箱、洗衣机、烘干机、空调、热水壶、微波炉、可观看Netflix等内容大电视，灯光比较明亮。 对入住体验有影响的是我们入住当天下午六点钟左右才逐步完善洗衣液，沐浴露、洗发水、空调被、被套、吹风机，凳子等必需用品。沙发床偏薄，睡上去会感觉到床垫里的弹簧；卫生间马桶也有点黄旧痕迹。如果能把这些细节提升一下，相信住起来会舒服很多。
总结：
这里的地理位置和房间大小真的挺好，如果对睡眠要求不高，这里是不错的选择。也希望房东能优化一下隔音和设施，让后续房客有更好体验。

Only point which affected me was there are no windows and no provisions for fresh air. The glass in the bedroom cannot be slides. Hence felt a bit claustrophobic. Specially in morning
Otherwise a very good stay Kitchen adequately equipped and also a bit more storage wud have been better

My stay at Alma House was exceptional. I felt right at home thanks to the convenient location and the extremely friendly management team. The facility was neat and clean, and the check-in process was welcoming and helpful.
During my stay, the team provided timely service for any room needs. The location in New Bahru is vibrant, with plenty of options like pilates studios, table tennis, cafes, restaurants, bars, and an art studio. They even have a shuttle bus every half an hour that goes to Somerset from where you can take the MRT to ION in one stop.
Due to the vibrant location, it can a bit noisy at times, but the staff is very accommodating and will gladly switch your room to meet your needs. They were particularly compassionate of my special requirements due to medical reasons, which I truly appreciated. I look forward to returning to Alma House for my next stay in Singapore.

Wonderful stay at Alma House! The check-in was quick and helpful, the room was clean, housekeeping was responsive, and it’s a peaceful and relaxing environment. I was especially impressed with the water fill stations at the end of the hallway and the market just downstairs to stock the refrigerator. The market also sells adapters, should you forget one, but there’s a usb port near the bed. Alma House sells individual laundry detergent pods, so you won’t need to buy an entire pack. I thought that was a generous touch. The neighborhood is residential, but Robertson Quay is steps away for restaurants and shopping. Overall, I was highly impressed and would definitely return to Alma House. Thank you for everything!
Extended my stay and stayed there for 2 weeks due to my lovely experience at Alma House!! Can’t wait to be back.

We had a great stay at Alma House! The location is ideal—surrounded by plenty of hangout spots like cafes, bars, restaurants, and even a nearby supermarket, making everything convenient and accessible.
The room was spacious enough to comfortably fit the three of us. We really appreciated the added amenities like the washing machine and mini fridge, and the shower was excellent—great water pressure and temperature control.
The neighborhood has a young, vibrant energy, which added to the overall experience. It felt safe, lively, and full of character.
The staff were incredibly attentive, promptly responding to our needs. Special thanks to Farhand for going above and beyond to make sure we had a smooth and enjoyable stay.
We definitely look forward to staying at Alma House again in the future when we go back to Singapore. Highly recommended!
P.S., No comment though about the proximity of the MRT station as we had always booked Grab whenever we went outside.

The property is right by the river, making it a beautiful and convenient spot. My parents are both over 75 years old and were still able to walk to most major attractions, including Clarke Quay, Merlion Park, Chinatown, Orchard Road, ION Orchard, Haji Lane, and Sultan Mosque. There's even a supermarket on the ground floor of the building, which made everything incredibly convenient. Thank you!
A very clean hotel but not close to any transits, but still the area is super nice and fun to walk around and explore. They do have a shuttle that takes you to all the popular places.

Really enjoyed our stay. FYI the lobby to check in is on the third floor. So many options to eat, get coffee and the grocery store downstairs is a huge plus. Staff was also extremely quick to respond and helpful.
房间大小很合适，附近500米有公交，地铁略微远点，一公里左右。和其他民宿不同，有前台服务，感觉非常便利。如果能把入住路线写的更明确一点就更要完美了。

The room was neat and tidy. Space was adequate for 3 people,  though the sofa bed is not very comfortable for sleep.  The kitchen was well-equipped. The staff were helpful and responded to our needs quickly. One drawback is the location which is a bit far from the nearest MRT station.

Would recommend to anyone staying In Singapore
Complex had a variety of shops and restaurants
Rooms where very clean and spacious
Would definitely stay again if we return to Singapore
Great location and clean, practical space for 3 of us. Great value. Recommended!

We stayed at Alma house for 4 nights. The place is located in a commercial complex with many restaurants and a supermarket downstairs. While we were happy to find groceries easily available, the prices were at a higher end as compared to other supermarkets . The nearest MRT was 15-20 mins away, which became quite a walk for us after exploring the city. They do have a shuttle, which is useful if you can plan your day around its schedule. The cleaning happens twice in a week and there are no cleaning tools provided in the room. There are no cooking essentials provided like, salt, oil etc which we had to buy but otherwise, overall it was a comfortable stay.

Perfect location for our long weekend in Singapore. There seem to be a variety of different room configurations so the pictures will not always match your room - it’s more of a boutique hotel than a traditional Airbnb. Cute space, had everything you’d need with a friendly and responsive front desk. We loved going to the cafe downstairs for breakfast and getting our Alma stay discount :)
Had a fantastic stay, definitely planning to return!
Good place for family trip

My family and I had a wonderful stay at the Alma house. This place is very kid friendly, they had baby beds, a baby highchair and were able to store a stroller outside. It’s also a really well located by nice restaurants and playgrounds. Would definitely say here again.
白天出门的时候坐巴士到索美塞地铁站很方便，晚上八点半之后没有巴士就要从公交车站走回来，大概450米，楼下有超市很方便可以自己做饭，房子在艺术区里，可以遛弯看看。
All good, just that the location is around 15 min walk to any public transport, so going with small kids and stroller, after day long walks we had to take grab most of the days. Rest was all perfect
Fijne studio, keukenblokje erg welkom, lounche bij binnenkomst goede werkruimte met moderne zitjes op locatie boven trending (maar dure) winkels en eetgelegenheden.
Tolle Unterkunft, super Lage. Wir haben uns mit unseren 2 Kindern sehr wohl und willkommen gefühlt!
Je recommande vivement
Alles war super. Würde es immer wieder machen :)
Trendy place, goede bereikbaarheid.

Le logement était conforme aux photos. Idéalement situé, beaucoup de visites peuvent se faire à pied à partir de l’hôtel si on aime marcher. Sinon, il y a deux stations de métro pas trop loin de l’hôtel.
Nous étions trois à occuper ce logement. À noter que le canapé peut être occupé par une personne et n’est pas très confortable.
Le personnel était agréable , réactif et accueillant.
Je recommande cette adresse .
It is nice and clean lroperty. Very well manged. Staff was very helpful. Just below there are many good restaurants an place is very livly
Great location and there are some cute shops and restaurants on New Bahru.
It is a good environment. We were in a community with convenient facilities.

We stayed at Alma House for 4 nights. The check in desk is in the communal lounge room on L3. The room was super clean and the beds were comfortable.
Even though there is a kitchenette, there is no cooking oil, salt, tea, coffee or sugar provided. We would have liked maybe a few teabags / coffee sachets. I guess they want you to buy coffee from the cafe instead!
There is a supermarket downstairs but it’s very expensive.
Travel adapters are free and provided by reception. You can also buy individual detergent pods for the washing machine.
For some reason there was very loud music playing from the lift lobby downstairs, which we could hear from the bedroom at night.
The reception team is very responsive and helpful and communication was easy.
The free shuttle runs from 11am to 9pm and takes you to the Somerset MRT (otherwise it’s a 15 min walk to the nearest MRT).
Overall, a very comfortable stay! Next time I would choose somewhere closer to the MRT.

Our little apartment had a fridge, a washing machine (!), and a tiny kitchen, which lacked basic utensils (no knife?), but was still practical. There is a supermarket in the same building and a small playground outside.

로버슨 강 근처의 힙한 숙소였습니다. 예쁜 카페와 식당, 소품점 등이 아기자기하게 모여 있어요.
아들과 둘이 4일 동안 행복하게 머물렀습니다.
아침 마다 산책했던 시간이 기억에 남을 것 같아요.

Ubytování bylo jednoduché, ale velmi čisté, útulné, s klimatizací. S obchody a restauracemi na dosah ruky. Pozitivně hodnotíme shuttle bus, který jezdí k obchodnímu centru a zastávce metra co 30 minut. Poměr cena kvalita - v pořádku. Rozhodně doporučujeme všema deseti a děkujeme za příjemné ubytování :).
写真とは違う部屋でしたが、角部屋だったので快適でした。　ラウンジが静かで気に入りました。
距離地鐵站有10幾分鐘距離，不是太便利，但有grab就十分便利！樓下有超市，民宿在一個商圈裏，衣食住行都很便利！服務很好，立即回應你的問題。
So I don't want to book anymore that place.very bad experience
Perfect place to stay with family!!
The host answered quickly to our needs. In the middle of a great restaurants and a grocery store. Easy access to most of the surrounding places
nice place

飞机时间原因到民宿早上9点，正常下午3点才能办理入住，对方尽早为我们办理了入住，这样我们的行程能在下午就开始。沙发床按我们的要求提供了被子，总之一切的问题都通过沟通解决了，非常感谢团队的付出！
因为是三人出行，所以特意选了这家，空间足够用，床也很舒适，出行需要步行十五分钟左右到相邻的地铁站，也算方便。
这里是废弃中学改造的文创区，所以生活很便利，一楼有好几家餐厅和一个超市，ppp coffe早餐很好吃，三楼的Dearborn cafe是本地网红店，需要排队就餐，营业时间为早上9点到下午3点，很遗憾这次没能体验。总之，住在这儿体感非常好！

its a great place to stay, lots of restaurants around and the super market right at the bottom, and they have shuttle bus to the MRT.
Room is big and clean. well worth the price.

Some initial confusion about the actual location due to unclear directions. Once this was sorted, everything else was fine. A clean room and very helpful staff. Handy location. We would stay there again.
Just loved the concept of living in urban area with local people…. But same time surrounded by interesting shops and fab restaurants

We had a good experience at Alma House overall. The location is great, in a very lively neighborhood with restaurants, markets, and coffee shops all around—perfect if you enjoy that kind of vibrant atmosphere. It usually quiets down after 10pm, so we were able to rest well at night.
It’s not very close to an MRT station, but that wasn’t a big issue since using Grab for commuting was very convenient. The staff were friendly and responsive. We had a small issue with the room at the beginning, but it was addressed very quickly.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay, and I’d recommend Alma House to friends looking for a lively yet comfortable place to stay in Singapore.
Very easy, had everything I needed, great location

Overall a great place to stay. There is a supermarket where you can buy milk and eggs and modern restaurants. Location is about 12 mins walk from Fort canning MRT. Great atmosphere surrounding the area, bit of an uphill walk. The hotel staff is super responsive. There is an complementary bus shuttle, though if you are in Singapore prefer cycling. Washing machine was convenient with a good drying feature. Mini kitchen for light meals such as cereals, bread and eggs. Utensils are provided but the knife is dull and could be sharper. Rooms are meant for long stays such as 2-3 weeks. We were only there for about a week though. They did provide us with early check in without any charge and any request from us so keep them updated about travel plans. Sofa bed is comfy enough for young people without back problems. Queen size bed is good for 2 people. You cannot open the windows so need to rely on AC for air circulation. Tide pods are provided separately at the counter for a charge.
There are many restaurants, boutiques and fitness studios in the same complex and in the area. The room itself is quiet and the interior cool. Would stay here again.

Alma House was an absolute gem for my week-long stay in Singapore!
The host was super responsive and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed.
The room was perfectly equipped - mini fridge, washer/dryer, especially the AC. It was a lifesaver on those hot and humid Singapore days!
The bed could have been a bit comfier, same with the pull-out bed.
One minor downside was the shower. There’s no door, so water tends to splash out.
It’s about a 15-minute walk to the nearest MRT. They do have a shuttle that goes back and forth to the Orchard area, which was really helpful.
Located in a great neighborhood with a grocery store below, lots of restaurants, and cute little shops nearby. It’s a great place to stay if you’re looking for a cozy and convenient base in Singapore.
Would stay again if ever back in Singapore!

Went during the grand prix weekend so this property was very good value for what we got! Only thing that wasn’t 100% is that while this properly can sleep 3 people, the pullout couch was not comfortable
좋은 숙소 친절한 직원
All the staff were very forthcoming and the gentleman at the time of check out was so helpful in guiding us. Overall loved it.
My mom had a lovely stay. She found the place really pretty and well kept. Great location. Hosts were super helpful, flexible and proactive. Thanks!!! We will be coming back!
Great stay , spacious , host responsive and helpful.
Great location, very nice rooms!
In a good location and well planned.
we had incredible day in the Alma House. we will visit again.
Our stay has been truly great, exceeding the expectations!
Forced into booking a second room due to misleading advertising (completely incorrect floor plan). Felt like a scam.

The staff was really the heart of the place! And I would say that they lift the overall experience and recommendation.
The apartment smelled pretty mushy when we arrived and it didn’t really help using the aircondition. Also there were no cups to drink from in the kitchen, and there were only two plates and two bowls. We stayed a family of four (two younger children), so had to be creative when eating. The apartment was more worn out than the pictures and there were a lot of noise from the area, especially in the evening when people came to dine at the restaurants.
It is also 15-20 minutes walk to the nearest train station, which we had not looked into before booking.
Would we stay here again? Probably not. But the staff should really be applauded for helping us during our stay.
Always a pleasure to stay at Alma house. This is my second stay and will certainly return.
Great place easy to find

This place was incredible. Very clean, quiet, comfortable, and safe. There is a large grocery store right downstairs. There are many restaurants just downstairs and just outside the complex. Easy for Grab taxi to pickup/drop off location. Location is convenient to many places in Singapore. Highly recommend.
Best place to stay you can walk to anyplace you want and it’s clean and private also, the man at the reception was very helpful and nice, good restaurant around and lovely neighborhood.

Good place, a bit small for 2 people, but its a studio.
There are many asian restaurants downstairs and a super nice grocery store too.

Set in a hive of trendy shops and restaurants, a walk away from the train stations and a cute little apartment.
We found it difficult to find the lobby to start with as I hadn’t quite realised it was part of the New Baru complex. But once we sorted that out and oriented ourselves it was a fabulous place to stay.
Excellent location and hostes. They went out of their way to assist my husband with a surprise delivery birthday gifts

Tôi rất hài lòng về chỗ ở này.
Phòng hiện đại, sạch sẽ, đầy đủ tiện nghi, đặc biệt, máy giặt quần áo có chức năng sấy nên rất tiện, không cần phải phơi quần áo.
Chủ nhà hỗ trợ nhiệt tình, đặc biệt khi gặp sự cố với thẻ credit và tôi không thể đặt cọc thì đã được chủ nhà đồng ý không cần đặt cọc.
Vị trí thuận tiện, có một siêu thị ở ngay tầng trệt, tôi có thể mua mọi thứ ở đó.

The cleanliness and facilities of the accommodation are excellent.
In particular, it is located within an outlet, so cafés and grocery stores are just downstairs. However, if you’re using public transport, you’ll need to walk a little to get to the nearest stop. If you’re planning to stay out late in the city, the location might feel a bit far.
Overall, my stay was very clean and enjoyable!
Loved our stay and would definitely stay here again when we’re back in Singapore.
Exceedingly clean, centrally located accommodation, with very helpful staff, we would have no issue recommending to anyone, and will no doubt be back when we next visit Singapore

A hidden gem!
Extremely friendly staff, very good location.
Will be returning for sure.
非常好的选择，出入哪里都方便，性价比很高，在一个高档小区里。
It was a pleasant check in, and was a very nice room

I thoroughly enjoyed my three days stay at the Alma House. The location is perfect for tourists. There are plenty of nice shops, cafés and grocery stores in the same building. The main sightseeing spots are within walking distance. The room is spotless and the staff are very caring and supportive. I had a medical emergency during my stay and the host was checking in with me regularly and pro-actively offering their assistance. Highly recommend!
Great space with everything you need. 15 minute walk to metro and grocery store and restaurants are in the shopping area that is on the first floor. I enjoyed my time here and would stay again

優點：地理位置佳，環境安靜，樓下有超市賣場，購物方便
缺點：房間打掃不確實，前房客喝過的水瓶沒有丟掉，浴室地板有前房客掉落的頭髮
跟櫃檯人員索取毛巾，櫃檯人員說國定假日沒有提供，隔日回覆說，要等下午才會送來乾淨的毛巾，但跟房務人員索取，很快就拿到乾淨的毛巾

New Bharu is a great location made even more convenient with the free shuttle bus to / from Gateway (Orchard Road) and Fort Canning MRT station (MRT = transit train system). Lots of nice retail and tasty eateries in the area make it a fun and vibrant location. Well recommended.
お部屋が広くきれいで、スタッフの方々も親切でした。最寄りの駅までのシャトルバスが夕方は混んで乗れないことがありましたが、駅までは徒歩でも行けるのでよかったです。
Great all the way
Will come back for sure!
Very efficient, very convenient. Checked in and out with no problems. The location is near lots of bars, restaurants and a supermarket, and is 5-10 minutes from 7-Eleven and the nearest MRT station.

We stayed there for 4 days and loved it. It was clean, comfortable and near the bus/ train station. There were restaurants, bars and a supermarket around the corner. The stuff was also very kind and helpful.
I would definitely come here again.
cute

The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Check-in was seamless, and the staff were incredibly helpful and responsive throughout our stay. The location was perfect, situated in a very walkable area with easy access to everything we needed. Highly recommend!

Spacious studio (for SG). Great location, lots of restaurants and cafes nearby. Friendly staff and very nice communal lounge / lobby area (good for relaxing or working). Would definitely stay here again.
I had a good stay here. The staff were friendly and helpful. Thank you for everything

Great place. We made the residence our home.
There’s a grocery store on the first floor so we got all that we needed and made home made meals away from home. The place is well equipped with kitchen ware. It’s very near malls and you can easily connect to the biggest mall in Singapore.
The staff were also great and very responsive.

I will be back again. Everything was of a great standard, really pleasant staff and the studio room was exactly as the photos. Great location above the grocer, cafe and restaurants. Grab’s arrive within minutes. See you next month!
Had a pleasant stay at Alma House. The neighborhood is nice with lots of good food options. Would definitely stay here again for my next trip

全体的にサービスの品質が高く、何より部屋が広く清潔でした。

Could be more consistent with alternate day cleaning, daily towel changes. Also they need to have more clothes dry hanger stands for guests use.
Overall the property is located in nice locality for all daily needs.
We had a great stay here for a few days - really nice selection of shops / restaurants and a great supermarket right in the same complex. Not too difficult to get anywhere from the location.
Awesone spot, clean and close to cafes and shops

Great location with many modern restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, and grocery store in the same building. Staff were friendly and very helpful with recommending ride share, places of interest, and general insight about Singapore geography and culture. Room was clean, new, well designed, great layout, spacious. Bed very comfortable, bathroom and kitchenette were pleasant with thoughtful amenities. Late check-in not a problem, check-out very easy. Stayed here over a week and felt at home, comfortable, safe, and well taken care of. Would stay again!

Lovely place…. Mostly ticked out boxes a couple of things that were not as expected… no oil or salt and pepper unfortunately I noticed that after I sorted a solution but the oddest thing which I think guests should know, no hot water in the kitchen sink… there is in the bathroom but not the kitchen sink 🙄 Otherwise nice spot good standard… bed typically firm for this part of the world… 👍

Great place to stay. Kind staff, quiet neighbor hood. Walkable distance from mrt stations and bus stops. (10-20 minutes). Room was clean and neat. There is a cooking area with utensils. House keeping service every mondays and thurdays and additional fee is required for more towels on other days.
Ottimo alloggio in un complesso tranquillo ma ricco di bei negozi, bar, supermercato. Zona residenziale. Consigliato

My daughter and I enjoyed our stay. The place was well kept and tidy. The staff were helpful and responsive and the location was great...also having the grocery shop and restaurants downstairs was very convenient. We definitely recommend this place to those staying in Singapore.
Great location tons of amenities and places to eat. Great staff. Will stay again when we are in Singapore next!

What's great about the place is the convenience it offers. Just 10 mins walk to the Fort Canning MRt, and along the way, you can drop by cafes and 7/11 if ever you decide to grab a quick bite or buy something. The room itself is clean and just have the amenities we need to make our stay as comfortable as possible.
The sofa is soo soft that it is really tempting to just sleep in it to relax and not go out.
The host is also very responsive whenever we have questions or requests and we really appreciate how friendly they all are.

I really enjoyed my stay at Alma House in Singapore. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. I loved that there were restaurants right downstairs—it made grabbing a meal super easy. The free shuttle to Somerset MRT was also a big plus and made getting around the city so convenient. Overall, a great spot to stay if you want comfort and convenience in one place!

We really enjoyed staying at Alma House as we had a really lovely room and everything we needed was within easy access. The staff were very friendly when we arrived and made us very welcome. Lots of shops within the complex and the River Valley was a short walk away to many restaurants and coffee houses.
The MRT at Great World is a 15 minute walk to open up the main City .
A great stay

Alma House was a great stay overall. The property was well maintained and clean, which made for a comfortable experience. Property matches exactly as per the description.
It required a bit of walking to get to the main area, but other than that, everything was excellent. The apartment complex also has many eateries and cafes.
Alkaff Quay is accessible by a short walk; you may spend your evening here.
I would recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful and well-kept place to stay.
Great location within New Bahru with some great cafes/restaurants and a supermarket in the same complex. Highly recommended.

Place was easy to locate with clear instructions from host. Check in was easy. Room though small but functional. Lots of eateries in the complex and also shuttle bus service to Somerset mrt station.
We noted that the bathroom should be better build like a shower curb /recess on the floor to prevent the whole bathroom wet.
We also noticed the room is not exactly sound proof as we were able to hear late night conversations of people outside in the restaurant areas.
Grand studio climatisé avec petite cuisine basique et lave linge. Calme et à proximité des commerces et des principaux sites. Hôte très réactif et efficace. Très bon accueil. Nous recommandons.
Le studio était spacieux propre et calme. Très bon accueil. Je recommande.

Ficamos encantados com a hospedagem, o lugar foi maravilhoso, ótima estrutura, perto de restaurantes, lojas o apartamento muito bom e a estadia muito agradável. Gostaria de agradecer pelo suporte da equipe, sempre respondiam nossas mensagens rapidamente e estiveram pendente de nossas solicitações
Não temos nada a reclamar, tudo pelo contrário, só agradecer por ter tornado nossa viagem maravilhosa.
Sugestão: Poderiam colocar mais copos ou xicaras (só tinham duas), também sentimos falta de algumas panelas e principalmente foi difícil cortar a cebola, sendo assim os utensílios de cozinha poderiam melhorar, mas nada que afetasse nossa estadia
Obrigada por tudo

I'm going to be honest, I had an average stay at Alma House. The staff was incredibly nice and the location was also good, but I didn't really feel comfortable because upon arrival my bedding smelled really musty and the ground was dusty. However, they did follow up to clean and switch the bedding right away so I really appreciate the staff's accommodation. Unfortunately I didn't have a very good rest staying here though, since the windows are not soundproof and downstairs are shops and restaurants (which is a plus in itself) blasting music daily, so I couldn't really sleep well because of that. I do think there are things to be improved, and I found it a shame they did not accommodate in refunding me partially because of the lacking points above. The service was nice but I don't think they were being flexible enough.
Good location and value

Great stay in Alma House.  Easier 24/7 check-in with a real person.  Great location within walking distance to Clarke Quay and other attractions.  Supermarket on-site.  Linked in on What's App and responded immediately to any requests for equipment and information.  Lovely people who are very keen to assist.  Will definitely stay here again.

La chambre ne reflète pas du tout les photos. Chris ne réponds pas du tout. Le lieu est surchargé de monde. C’est très propre le prix ne correspond pas du tout. Nous avons passé un mauvais moment, il y avait des cafards, lézard. Équipement cassé, toilette et douche ensemble pas terrible. Nécessaire de toilette vide donc le ménage peut être pas sûr d’avoir été correctement faite. Je vous déconseille ce logement merci a Airbnb surtout a son agent qui m’ont aidé à trouvé un autre logement avec le remboursement de ma réservation j’ai pu me reloger dans un logement de qualité supérieure.

The location is excellent, right in front of a bus stop, so we didn't have to walk far. The neighborhood is pleasant as well.
The host upgraded our room, which was very nice and comfortable. It included a private kitchen, a washing machine, an iron and ironing board, and all the amenities mentioned in the description.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for accommodation while vacationing in Singapore.
We have a peaceful stay. The room is clean. Thank you again.
非常不错的住宿体验，房间干净整洁，公寓有公共泳池和健身房，周围超市和饭店很多，很方便。

Jc’s place was exactly what the host represented in the pictures. I’m awfully picky about bathrooms, kitchens and bedding - it was very, very clean. Helps that room keeping came in twice a week and they do a good job. A special mention is that the bathroom grouts are clean!
It wasn’t too much of a hassle so I didn’t Otherwise, furnishings were well thought out - good use of space, kitchen and closet storage.
I have two kids, aged 11 & 14. It was safe for them to move around to the swimming pool, gym and L1 car park compound.
We really enjoyed our stay at Jc’s and would definitely recommend it.

It’s a great space for family of 4.
Kitchen and laundry definitely were huge plus during our stay.
We enjoy coming back to a quiet residential neighbourhood.

The only downside was that every morning between 2am and 3:30am, a motorcyclist just below our window would start their motorbike and let it idle for about 5 minutes before roaring off. We booked this place because we were attending a conference at the Singapore EXPO center. Because it was called the "Executive Suite," we assumed executives would stay there. We should have done more research - this is a family-style vacation center for people who want to get away or meet up with relatives. There are lots of families and kids around, it is in NO way built for business people. Even the gym hours were insane, though the staff kindly let me in early a few days. However, only club members can enter before 9 am. No business traveler can go to the gym after 9 am. It's also in a difficult spot that requires Grab cars most of the time, as the walk to the metro is short, but the station is awkwardly located. It would have been far cheaper to stay at a standard business hotel in a more convenient location on the metro line. I would happily return here for a vacation (it looked really fun!); however, I would not recommend coming here for business travel.

Review for Hotel Lucky 81 (Singapore)
Rating: 3/5
Posted: May 25, 2025
I stayed at Hotel Lucky 81 for one night (May 24, 2025) during a 14-hour layover in Singapore, paying about CAD 145. In a city where hotel prices are steep, this budget option delivered on the basics but had some drawbacks worth noting.
Positives: The room and bed were clean, which was my top priority for a quick rest during a layover. It was surprisingly quiet, with no disruptive noises, so I got a solid few hours of sleep. The air conditioning worked like a charm, a lifesaver in Singapore’s humidity, and the Wi-Fi was fast and reliable for catching up on emails and planning the next leg of my trip.
Negatives: The room was quite small, and the furnishings were very modest—think bare-bones functionality. The bathroom felt primitive, with no shower curtain, which led to a wet floor after every shower. The neighborhood around the hotel has a noticeable presence of prostitutes and massage parlors. This didn’t bother me

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this stay was honestly very disappointing. The bathroom had visible mould, and the whole apartment had a strange damp smell that never went away no matter how much we aired it out. The walls were incredibly thin — you could hear neighbours and hallway noise constantly, which made it hard to relax or sleep; and on top of this we were falsely accused of making excessive noise during quiet hours.
The room itself was much smaller than the photos suggested, with barely any space to move around or store luggage comfortably. It felt cramped the entire stay. On top of that, the experience felt completely impersonal. There was zero human interaction or hospitality — just automated messages and self-check-in, which made the place feel cold and unwelcoming.
Overall, it did not feel clean, comfortable, or worth the price. I would not stay here again.

Here are some tips to get you settled in sooner:
1) Confirm that your door and locker code are shared before your arrival. I was lucky that staff was present when I arrived and was able to share the information with me right away.
2) Even though there's only one bathroom and shower, you can go upstairs where there are multiple toilets and showers to use.
3) I had trouble finding the light switch for the pod. It's at the end of the curtain rod.
Overall I had a great stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.
